facts.fact: There are traps and random items in the left side of the area.
facts.detect: Finding traps or items in the left side of the area
facts.action: Be cautious and prepared to disarm traps and pick up valuable items.

facts.fact: Polyself into a phasing monster to pass through walls, but it is time-consuming and dangerous.
facts.detect: Having a phasing monster form available
facts.action: Consider polymorphing into a phasing monster to avoid the undiggable walls, but be cautious of the time and danger.

facts.fact: Aspects of The Silence are extremely lethal in melee, especially for the unprepared. They drain levels via their vampiric tentacles, inflict deadly illnesses, and disintegrate first your gear and then you.
facts.detect: Encountering an Aspect of The Silence on the map.
facts.action: Avoid melee combat with Aspects of The Silence and use ranged attacks, spells, or wands instead.

facts.fact: Aspects can be warded off with any ward versus U (elder sign, gorg, hexa?, hepta?).
facts.detect: Having a ward versus U in inventory.
facts.action: Use wards versus U to safely wear down Aspects of The Silence from a distance.

facts.fact: Spellcasters can use a Naen syllable to bypass both the power drain and the elevated spell failure chance.
facts.detect: Having learned the Naen syllable.
facts.action: Use the Naen syllable to cast spells effectively against Aspects of The Silence.

facts.fact: A wand-using character will find their wands to be a reliable means of dealing damage, particularly fire and lightning.
facts.detect: Having wands of fire or lightning in inventory.
facts.action: Use wands of fire or lightning to deal damage to Aspects of The Silence.

facts.fact: The First Word and the Nurturing Word are Words of Creation that are both highly effective against Aspects.
facts.detect: Having learned the First Word or the Nurturing Word.
facts.action: Use the First Word or the Nurturing Word to deal significant damage to Aspects of The Silence.

facts.fact: The Astral Plane is the final level of NetHack where you must bring the Amulet of Yendor to the high altar of your alignment and #offer it to your deity.
facts.detect: Entering the Astral Plane, finding the high altar of your alignment.
facts.action: Find and approach the high altar of your alignment with the Amulet of Yendor.

facts.fact: High altars cannot be converted, but it is possible to fool the gods by wearing a helm of opposite alignment to match your alignment to that of the altar.
facts.detect: Having a helm of opposite alignment in inventory.
facts.action: Wear the helm of opposite alignment to match your alignment to the high altar.

facts.fact: The Astral Plane is home to the three Riders—Death, Pestilence, and Famine—and to large numbers of aligned priests, Angels, and player monsters.
facts.detect: Encountering Riders, aligned priests, and Angels on the Astral Plane.
facts.action: Avoid or deal with the Riders and hostile coaligned priests and Angels.

facts.fact: Upon arriving at the Astral Plane, you may be sent tame or hostile Angels depending on your alignment record and whether you are generating conflict.
facts.detect: Encountering tame or hostile Angels upon arrival.
facts.action: Deal with hostile Angels and avoid conflict if possible.

facts.fact: Most creatures on the Astral Plane (with the notable exception of the Riders) are vulnerable to stoning attacks.
facts.detect: Having a chickatrice corpse or other stoning attacks.
facts.action: Use stoning attacks to thin the hordes of monsters.

facts.fact: Astral vision allows the hero to see nearby squares, even if they are unlit or else blocked from regular line-of-sight.
facts.detect: The bot can detect the presence of astral vision through messages such as 'Your vision seems to dim for a moment but is normal now.' or 'Your vision seems to brighten for a moment but is normal now.'
facts.action: The bot should prioritize finding and equipping The Eyes of the Overworld to gain astral vision, which can help in navigating dark or blocked areas.

facts.fact: Astral vision allows the hero to view any tile within a 3-square radius, with monsters, items and tiles being completely visible regardless of anything that would block the character's view otherwise.
facts.detect: The bot can detect the presence of items or monsters within a 3-square radius that would otherwise be hidden.
facts.action: The bot should use astral vision to scout for traps, secret doors, and valuable items before moving into unexplored areas.

facts.fact: Astral vision on its own does not negate blindness: The Eyes of the Overworld suppresses the effects of blindness as long as they are worn.
facts.detect: The bot can detect blindness through messages such as 'You are blinded.'
facts.action: The bot should equip The Eyes of the Overworld to cure blindness and continue playing.

facts.fact: Items viewed using the farlook command are described as if the hero is handling them personally.
facts.detect: The bot can detect the use of the farlook command and the detailed description of items.
facts.action: The bot should use the farlook command to inspect items from a distance, especially in dangerous areas.

facts.fact: Atonal instruments cannot be used to play the passtune.
facts.detect: Item name (bell, Bell of Opening, leather drum, drum of earthquake, tin whistle, magic whistle)
facts.action: Do not attempt to use these items to play the passtune.

facts.fact: When you apply an atonal instrument, you do not get a 'Improvise? (yn)' prompt.
facts.detect: Applying an atonal instrument (bell, Bell of Opening, leather drum, drum of earthquake, tin whistle, magic whistle)
facts.action: Do not expect to get an 'Improvise? (yn)' prompt when using these items.

facts.fact: Mundane bells are primarily used to wake up monsters.
facts.detect: Item name (bell)
facts.action: Use bells to wake up sleeping monsters.

facts.fact: Leather drums can additionally be used to scare monsters.
facts.detect: Item name (leather drum)
facts.action: Use leather drums to scare monsters.

facts.fact: Atonal instruments can be used to enable Elbereth squares.
facts.detect: Item name (bell, Bell of Opening, leather drum, drum of earthquake, tin whistle, magic whistle)
facts.action: Use atonal instruments to engrave Elbereth on squares.

facts.fact: Valkyrie can gain Basic skill in the Attack school of spells.
facts.detect: Role: Valkyrie
facts.action: Learn and use Attack spells as part of the strategy.

facts.fact: Attack spells deal direct damage to monsters.
facts.detect: Spellbook names and descriptions
facts.action: Use Attack spells to damage monsters effectively.

facts.fact: Secondary effects of some Attack spells can be beneficial.
facts.detect: Spell descriptions mentioning secondary effects
facts.action: Use Attack spells with secondary effects strategically.

facts.fact: Claw attacks, bite attacks, touch attacks, and melee weapon attacks can be blocked by magic cancellation.
facts.detect: When encountering monsters with claw, bite, touch, or melee weapon attacks, such as imps, jaguars, mimics, cockatrices, and rust monsters.
facts.action: Equip magic cancellation items to block these attacks.

facts.fact: Spitting attacks, breath weapons, gaze attacks, and active explosion attacks can be blocked by cancellation.
facts.detect: When facing monsters with spitting, breath, gaze, or active explosion attacks, such as cobras, adult dragons, floating eyes, and both lights.
facts.action: Ensure the hero is cancelled to block these attacks.

facts.fact: Melee attacks targeted at a hero's displaced image will always miss the hero.
facts.detect: When the hero has displacement and is attacked by melee attackers.
facts.action: Use displacement to avoid melee attacks.

facts.fact: Gaze attacks ignore displacement and invisibility.
facts.detect: When facing monsters with gaze attacks, such as floating eyes, umber hulks, and Medusa.
facts.action: Avoid gaze attacks by not looking at the monster or using reflection.

facts.fact: Engulfing attacks can be dangerous as they trap the target within the attacker's mass.
facts.detect: When facing monsters with engulfing attacks, such as fog clouds, purple worms, and air elementals.
facts.action: Avoid getting close to these monsters to prevent engulfing.

facts.fact: Intelligent monsters will use these wands on you.
facts.detect: Intelligent monsters in the vicinity, such as high-level monsters or monsters with spellcasting abilities.
facts.action: Avoid or prepare to defend against wands when facing intelligent monsters.

facts.fact: If monsters resist the attack, the damage is cut in half.
facts.detect: Monster resistance to fire, cold, lightning, magic missile, or striking.
facts.action: Use other methods of attack or avoid using attack wands against resistant monsters.

facts.fact: Valkyrie has a starting Strength of 10\30% and a maximum Strength of 18/**
facts.detect: Starting character attributes and racial maximums
facts.action: Ensure to prioritize increasing Strength to 18/** if possible to maximize melee combat effectiveness and carrying capacity

facts.fact: Valkyrie has a starting Wisdom of 7\7% and a maximum Wisdom of 17
facts.detect: Starting character attributes and racial maximums
facts.action: Since Wisdom is required for spellcasting, ensure to increase Wisdom to at least 17 to enable spellcasting

facts.fact: Constitution affects healing rate and HP gain on level up
facts.detect: Character's Constitution attribute
facts.action: Maintain a high Constitution to ensure faster healing and more HP gain on level up

facts.fact: Dexterity affects the chance of hitting monsters in melee and with missiles or spells
facts.detect: Character's Dexterity attribute
facts.action: Increase Dexterity to improve accuracy in combat

facts.fact: Intelligence is useful for reading spellbooks and encounters with foocubi
facts.detect: Character's Intelligence attribute
facts.action: Maintain a decent Intelligence level to handle spellbooks and foocubi encounters

facts.fact: An amulet of reflection will auto-identify if the hero sees a ray reflected by the worn amulet.
facts.detect: Seeing a ray reflected by the amulet
facts.action: Note the auto-identification of the amulet

facts.fact: An amulet of strangulation will auto-identify if the hero puts it on and gradual strangulation begins.
facts.detect: Gradual strangulation begins
facts.action: Note the auto-identification of the amulet

facts.fact: An elven cloak or pair of elven boots will auto-identify when a hero without stealth wears either of them and gains stealth, or if they take off the armor and do not have another source of stealth.
facts.detect: Gaining stealth upon wearing or losing stealth upon removing
facts.action: Note the auto-identification of the cloak or boots

facts.fact: A cloak of invisibility will auto-identify if the hero either wears it and gains invisibility from it, or if they take it off and lose invisibility.
facts.detect: Gaining or losing invisibility
facts.action: Note the auto-identification of the cloak

facts.fact: A ring of invisibility will auto-identify if a hero wears it and becomes invisible or takes it off and becomes visible.
facts.detect: Becoming invisible or visible
facts.action: Note the auto-identification of the ring

facts.fact: Automatic searching is a property that causes you to automatically search every square around you at the end of every game turn.
facts.detect: You feel perceptive!
facts.action: No action needed, as this is an intrinsic ability that the bot will automatically have if it reaches the appropriate level as a monk, archaeologist, rogue, or tourist.

facts.fact: Automatic searching can be acquired as an intrinsic if you start out as a ranger, at level 9 as a monk, or at level 10 as an archaeologist, rogue, or tourist.
facts.detect: You feel perceptive!
facts.action: No action needed, as this is an intrinsic ability that the bot will automatically have if it reaches the appropriate level.

facts.fact: Wearing a ring of searching gives you automatic searching as an extrinsic, which costs you nutrition and prevents you from wearing other rings on that hand.
facts.detect: You feel perceptive!
facts.action: If the bot finds a ring of searching, it should decide whether to wear it based on the need for automatic searching versus the cost in nutrition and the inability to wear other rings.

facts.fact: Wielding Excalibur grants automatic searching as an extrinsic without the normal ring hunger.
facts.detect: You feel perceptive!
facts.action: If the bot finds Excalibur, it should wield it to gain automatic searching without the nutrition cost.

facts.fact: Autopickup is an option that automatically picks up any item on the square the player moves onto.
facts.detect: Options menu or pressing '@' key
facts.action: Toggle autopickup on or off based on the situation, such as when moving onto a teleport trap or hole.

facts.fact: pickup_types can be set to pick up only items considered 'generally safe' such as gold, scrolls, potions, wands, rings, amulets, and spellbooks.
facts.detect: Checking .nethackrc file for pickup_types setting
facts.action: Configure pickup_types to only pick up safe items to avoid picking up dangerous or heavy items.

facts.fact: pickup_burden can be set to ask the player before picking up an item that would exceed a certain burden level.
facts.detect: Checking .nethackrc file for pickup_burden setting
facts.action: Configure pickup_burden to avoid overburdening the player.

facts.fact: AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION can be used to refine autopickup options further, such as picking up a magic lamp but not a worthless piece of paper.
facts.detect: Checking .nethackrc file for AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION settings
facts.action: Configure AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION to avoid picking up specific dangerous or heavy items.

facts.fact: Autopickup can be used to pick up items on the same turn as movement, which is useful for speed ascension or when fleeing.
facts.detect: Moving onto a square with items and observing if they are picked up immediately
facts.action: Use autopickup to save turns when necessary, especially in Sokoban or when fleeing.

facts.fact: AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION is a configuration option that allows defining what items are automatically picked up based on the name of the item.
facts.detect: The bot can notice this by checking its configuration file for AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION rules.
facts.action: The bot should configure AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION rules to avoid picking up dangerous items like loadstones, and to pick up valuable items like wands of wishing.

facts.fact: You can use AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION to avoid picking up loadstones, regardless of your knowledge of loadstones.
facts.detect: The bot can detect loadstones by their name or description.
facts.action: The bot should add AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION rules to avoid picking up loadstones.

facts.fact: You can use AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION to pick up formally identified artifacts, but leave unidentified ones on the floor.
facts.detect: The bot can detect formally identified artifacts by their name or description.
facts.action: The bot should add AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION rules to pick up formally identified artifacts.

facts.fact: You can use AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION to avoid picking up corpses, but pick up lichen, lizards, newts, floating eyes, and wraiths.
facts.detect: The bot can detect corpses by their name or description.
facts.action: The bot should add AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION rules to avoid picking up corpses, but pick up lichen, lizards, newts, floating eyes, and wraiths.

facts.fact: You can use AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION to avoid picking up dangerous items like scrolls of scare monster.
facts.detect: The bot can detect scrolls of scare monster by their name or description.
facts.action: The bot should add AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION rules to avoid picking up scrolls of scare monster.

facts.fact: Axe-type weapons deal +d4 damage versus wood golems.
facts.detect: Encountering a wood golem
facts.action: Attack wood golems with axe-type weapons for increased damage

facts.fact: Felling a tree with an axe has a 1/5 chance of generating a fruit comestible.
facts.detect: Chopping a tree with an axe
facts.action: Chop trees with an axe to potentially get fruit

facts.fact: Applying an axe-type weapon to chop into a statue will produce a unique message and may cause the hero to take 2 points of physical damage.
facts.detect: Message: 'Sparks fly as you whack the statue.'
facts.action: Avoid chopping statues to prevent damage

facts.fact: A hero attempting to chop through a shop's door with an axe weapon will produce a message and cause the hero to abort the attempt.
facts.detect: Message: 'This door seems too hard to chop through.'
facts.action: Avoid chopping shop doors to prevent angering the shopkeeper

facts.fact: Do not attempt to chop through any doors and trees in view of a Minetown watchman, or you will instantly anger them.

facts.fact: A gelatinous cube cannot normally eat objects made of bone and will only engulf them.
facts.detect: Encounter with a gelatinous cube
facts.action: If a gelatinous cube engulfs bone items, the items will not be eaten and can be retrieved later.

facts.fact: Polypiling enough bone objects has a chance of creating a skeleton (the closest monster available to a 'bone golem').
facts.detect: Polypiling bone objects
facts.action: Polypiling bone objects can potentially summon a skeleton, which may be a useful or dangerous encounter depending on the situation.

facts.fact: Only one bones file is stored per dungeon level, with a 1/3 chance of being loaded in place of a standard map for that level.
facts.detect: Loading a level and seeing a message indicating a bones level is being loaded.
facts.action: Be cautious and prepare for potential cursed items and dangerous monsters.

facts.fact: Traps in early dungeon levels can feature 'fake bones' that emulate actual bones files.
facts.detect: Stepping on a trap and finding a pile of cursed objects and a pre-aged corpse.
facts.action: Avoid picking up items from fake bones traps unless you are sure they are not cursed.

facts.fact: A bones level will contain some remnant of the former hero, usually a named ghost or monster related to the cause of death.
facts.detect: Seeing a named ghost or monster that is unusual for the level.
facts.action: Be cautious and avoid waking up the ghost or monster until you can determine its type and intentions.

facts.fact: Former pets will become hostile on a bones level.
facts.detect: Seeing a pet that turns hostile upon entering the level.
facts.action: Avoid engaging with hostile pets and try to neutralize them from a distance if necessary.

facts.fact: The presence of fruit with a different name from yours is often a dead giveaway of a bones level.
facts.detect: Seeing fruit with a name that does not match the hero's name.
facts.action: Be cautious and check the fruit for curses before using it.

facts.fact: A +3 small shield almost certainly used to belong to a Valkyrie, but requires identification or wearing to reveal the enchantment.
facts.detect: +3 small shield
facts.action: Identify or wear the +3 small shield to confirm it belongs to a Valkyrie.

facts.fact: Finding one's own bones is an even more difficult position.
facts.detect: Encountering bones with personal items.
facts.action: Avoid or carefully approach bones with personal items to prevent self-bones encounter.

facts.fact: Using bones items can often make a difficult game much easier by providing items that the current player has not 'earned' yet.
facts.detect: Finding bones items.
facts.action: Utilize bones items to gain an advantage, such as better equipment or resources.

facts.fact: Every bones pile looks 'free' until you are blindsided by Yeenoghu or a former pet arch-lich!
facts.detect: Approaching a bones pile.
facts.action: Be cautious and prepared for potential threats like Yeenoghu or former pet arch-liches when approaching bones piles.

facts.fact: Speed boots, jumping boots, and water walking boots have a base price of 50 zm.
facts.detect: Boots with a base price of 50 zm and not identified as speed or jumping boots are water walking boots.
facts.action: Identify boots with a base price of 50 zm as water walking boots if they do not grant speed or jumping.

facts.fact: Cursed levitation boots are very likely to be found in the statue of Perseus.
facts.detect: Finding boots in the statue of Perseus.
facts.action: Do not wear boots found in the statue of Perseus without testing for curses.

facts.fact: Fumble boots can be identified by wearing them and seeing whether you fumble.
facts.detect: Fumbling while wearing boots.
facts.action: Identify boots as fumble boots if you start fumbling after wearing them.

facts.fact: Kicking boots are the only magic boots to be metallic.
facts.detect: Boots that are metallic and increase spell failure rates.
facts.action: Identify metallic boots that increase spell failure rates as kicking boots.

facts.fact: Water walking boots can be identified by zapping a wand of enlightenment.
facts.detect: Zapping a wand of enlightenment while wearing boots.
facts.action: Identify boots as water walking boots if zapping a wand of enlightenment identifies them as such.

facts.fact: A boulder fort can be used to control the generation or movement of monsters around you.
facts.detect: The presence of boulders on the map.
facts.action: Place boulders strategically to control monster movement and generation.

facts.fact: A boulder fort can be used to trap a temple priest to convert an altar without interference.
facts.detect: The presence of a temple priest and an altar.
facts.action: Create a boulder fort around the altar to trap the priest.

facts.fact: Boulder forts are vulnerable to wands of striking, ghosts, giants, and xorns.
facts.detect: The appearance of these monsters or the sound of a wand being zapped.
facts.action: Avoid using boulder forts if these threats are present.

facts.fact: A boulder-jelly fort can be made more secure by placing blue jellies under boulders.
facts.detect: The presence of blue jellies and boulders.
facts.action: Create a boulder-jelly fort for better security.

facts.fact: For maximum security, place a scroll of scare monster under each jelly in a boulder-jelly fort.
facts.detect: The presence of scrolls of scare monster and blue jellies.
facts.action: Enhance boulder-jelly fort security with scrolls of scare monster.

facts.fact: Rangers will always start with knowledge of all bow and arrow weapons.
facts.detect: Starting role is Ranger
facts.action: Use bow and arrow weapons effectively from the start

facts.fact: The enchantment of a bow weapon contributes to the to-hit value that determines the accuracy of arrows fired from that bow.
facts.detect: Bow with positive enchantment
facts.action: Use enchanted bows to improve arrow accuracy

facts.fact: All arrow weapons can be poisoned, and arrows created in the initial inventory and randomly by any means have a 100% chance of being poisoned.
facts.detect: Poisoned arrow in inventory
facts.action: Be cautious with poisoned arrows to avoid poisoning yourself

facts.fact: When using the firing or quiver command while wielding a bow weapon, the game will prioritize a stack of matching arrow weapons if the autoquiver option is enabled.
facts.detect: Autoquiver option enabled
facts.action: Ensure matching arrows are available for efficient shooting

facts.fact: Worn gauntlets of power apply a -2 to-hit penalty for a hero firing from a bow weapon.
facts.detect: Wearing gauntlets of power
facts.action: Remove gauntlets of power to improve shooting accuracy

facts.fact: The Gnomish Mines is eight or nine levels deep and biased toward lawful alignment.
facts.detect: Entering the Gnomish Mines from the Dungeons of Doom
facts.action: Explore the Gnomish Mines to find lawful-aligned items and possibly gain alignment bonuses.

facts.fact: Sokoban is always four levels high and biased toward neutral alignment.
facts.detect: Entering Sokoban from the Dungeons of Doom
facts.action: Explore Sokoban to find neutral-aligned items and avoid alignment penalties.

facts.fact: The Quest is 5-7 levels deep and contains your role's quest artifact as well as the Bell of Opening.
facts.detect: Receiving the quest artifact and the Bell of Opening
facts.action: Complete the quest to obtain the quest artifact and the Bell of Opening.

facts.fact: Fort Ludios may be accessible through a magic portal found in a vault.
facts.detect: Finding a magic portal in a vault
facts.action: Use the magic portal to access Fort Ludios.

facts.fact: Vlad's Tower is always 3 levels high, contains the Candelabrum of Invocation, and is biased toward chaotic alignment.
facts.detect: Entering Vlad's Tower from Gehennom
facts.action: Explore Vlad's Tower to find the Candelabrum of Invocation and avoid chaotic-aligned items.

facts.fact: Branchporting creates a temporary 'portal' from the hero's current level to any other dungeon branch that they have visited that game.
facts.detect: The hero has visited other dungeon branches in the current game.
facts.action: Use The Eye of the Aethiopica to branchport to a previously visited branch to find the way down or to escape danger.

facts.fact: Branchporting from any branch to the Dungeons of Doom will always place the hero at the deepest previously-visited level.
facts.detect: The hero is attempting to branchport to the Dungeons of Doom.
facts.action: If the hero needs to go deeper in the Dungeons of Doom, branchporting will place them at the deepest level they have visited.

facts.fact: Branchporting to Gehennom from any branch other than Vlad's Tower will always place them at the Valley of the Dead.
facts.detect: The hero is attempting to branchport to Gehennom.
facts.action: If the hero needs to go to Gehennom, branchporting will place them at the Valley of the Dead.

facts.fact: Attempting to branchport to the hero's current dungeon branch or any branch within the End Game, or else attempting to branchport at all while carrying the Amulet of Yendor, will have no effect.
facts.detect: The hero is carrying the Amulet of Yendor or attempting to branchport to the current branch or an End Game branch.
facts.action: Do not attempt to branchport under these conditions.

facts.fact: Adjacent monsters that can follow the hero to other levels will also follow them into the new branch.
facts.detect: The hero is branchporting with adjacent monsters.
facts.action: Be cautious when branchporting with monsters that can follow, as they will also enter the new branch.

facts.fact: There are eight types of breath weapons, including magic missile, fire, cold, sleep gas, disintegration, lightning, poison gas, and acid.
facts.detect: Encountering monsters such as gray dragons, hell hounds, red dragons, winter wolves, silver dragons, blue dragons, green dragons, and yellow dragons.
facts.action: Equip reflection or the appropriate resistance (e.g., fire resistance for fire breath).

facts.fact: Intrinsic or extrinsic resistance is necessary to protect against breath weapons, but does not protect gear from fire, cold, or lightning; disintegration resistance extends its protection to armor.
facts.detect: Having fire, cold, lightning, or disintegration resistance.
facts.action: Ensure you have the correct resistance for the breath weapon you are facing.

facts.fact: A monster will never use its breath weapon if it can hit in melee, unless it is impaired.
facts.detect: Engaging in melee combat with a monster that has a breath weapon.
facts.action: Fight the monster in melee to prevent it from using its breath weapon.

facts.fact: Pets can use their breath weapons against both hostile and peaceful monsters, but are less likely to do so if they are hungry.
facts.detect: Observing a pet that is hungry and near a monster.
facts.action: Feed your pet to reduce the likelihood of it using its breath weapon.

facts.fact: Pets will not breath in the direction of the hero unless the hero is invisible or has displacement, or if the pet is confused.
facts.detect: A pet near the hero that is not confused and the hero is not invisible or has displacement.
facts.action: Ensure the hero is not in a position where the pet might use its breath weapon.

facts.fact: The amulet of magical breathing grants the breathless property, allowing the hero to breathe in any environment and travel underwater.
facts.detect: Amulet of magical breathing
facts.action: Equip the amulet of magical breathing to survive in underwater environments and breathe in lethal environments.

facts.fact: While breathless, the hero is protected from the effects of sleeping gas traps and poison clouds, and cannot choke from eating too much food.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You are laden with moisture and find it mildly uncomfortable.' or 'You choke, but recover your composure.'
facts.action: Wear the amulet of magical breathing to avoid the effects of sleeping gas traps, poison clouds, and choking.

facts.fact: Breathless heroes cannot gain the 1000 experience point bonus for killing sea monsters with drowning attacks.
facts.detect: Killing sea monsters while underwater
facts.action: Avoid killing sea monsters with drowning attacks while breathless to maximize experience points.

facts.fact: Breathless monsters include all undead, certain elemental creatures, and specific named monsters like the Wizard of Yendor.
facts.detect: Encountering undead or elemental creatures
facts.action: Be prepared for breathless monsters in certain environments and levels.

facts.fact: When breathless, the hero will 'vomit voluminously' instead of choking if they eat too much food, losing 1000 nutrition.
facts.detect: Eating too much food
facts.action: Avoid overeating while breathless to prevent losing nutrition.

facts.fact: Lawful demon princes in Gehennom will ask for a bribe if you have gold in open inventory, and the amount requested is normally 21-100% of your visible gold.
facts.detect: When encountering a lawful demon prince in Gehennom and having gold in open inventory, the demon will ask for a bribe.
facts.action: Calculate the amount of gold needed for the bribe and offer it to avoid hostility and ensure the demon disappears with its inventory.

facts.fact: If you are carrying the Amulet of Yendor, you cannot bribe a demon.
facts.detect: Carrying the Amulet of Yendor when encountering a lawful demon prince.
facts.action: Avoid carrying the Amulet of Yendor when dealing with lawful demon princes to maintain the option to bribe.

facts.fact: Soldiers can be bribed by throwing a suitable amount of gold at them, turning them peaceful.
facts.detect: Encountering soldiers on the Castle level.
facts.action: Calculate the required amount of gold to bribe soldiers and throw it to them to pacify them.

facts.fact: Pacifying a shopkeeper will also pacify any watchmen or watch captains on the level.
facts.detect: Encountering an angry shopkeeper.
facts.action: Bribe the shopkeeper to pacify them and any watchmen or watch captains on the level.

facts.fact: Beware of throwing gold at peaceful shopkeepers: they have a chance of becoming hostile.
facts.detect: Throwing gold at a peaceful shopkeeper.
facts.action: Avoid throwing gold at peaceful shopkeepers to prevent them from becoming hostile.

facts.fact: c represents a cockatrice (chickatrice, cockatrice, pyrolisk)
facts.detect: c on the map
facts.action: Avoid touching or stepping on it, especially if barefoot or wearing leather boots. Use a wand of cancellation or a spell to identify it before approaching.

facts.fact: C represents a centaur (plains centaur, forest centaur, mountain centaur)
facts.detect: C on the map
facts.action: Be cautious as centaurs can be dangerous, especially if you are low on hit points or have low AC. Use ranged attacks or summon pets to distract them.

facts.fact: Press c to close a door
facts.detect: Open door on the map
facts.action: Press c to close the door if you want to block monsters or hide from them.

facts.fact: Press shift+C to call a monster, item or type of item by a particular name
facts.detect: Need to summon a specific monster or item
facts.action: Press shift+C and type the name to summon it.

facts.fact: Calling or naming a monster will change most messages regarding that monster to use only the monster's name.
facts.detect: Pressing shift+c and entering a name
facts.action: Name monsters to differentiate them or for roleplay purposes.

facts.fact: Ghosts are a special case: a named ghost will be described as 's ghost rather than simply ''
facts.detect: Seeing a ghost and naming it
facts.action: Name ghosts to differentiate them from other ghosts.

facts.fact: Unique monsters will resist the naming attempt.
facts.detect: Attempting to name a unique monster and receiving a message indicating resistance
facts.action: Avoid naming unique monsters.

facts.fact: Monsters whose names display as something other than their base type cannot usefully be called anything different.
facts.detect: Attempting to name a shopkeeper, aligned priest, or minion and seeing no change in messages
facts.action: Do not waste time trying to name these types of monsters.

facts.fact: Naming a monster can be used to leave a funny death message.
facts.detect: Dying and seeing a custom death message
facts.action: Name monsters before dying to leave a custom death message.

facts.fact: Cancellation removes magical charges and blessed/cursed status from objects, sets enchantment to +0, and removes charges from magical objects.
facts.detect: Inventory items becoming uncursed, weapons/armor enchantment resetting to +0, magical objects losing charges.
facts.action: Use wand of cancellation on cursed or over-enchanted items to uncurse them and reset enchantment.

facts.fact: Scrolls and spellbooks (except scroll of mail and spellbook of cancellation) are blanked when cancelled.
facts.detect: Inventory scrolls and spellbooks turning blank.
facts.action: Use wand of cancellation on scrolls and spellbooks to obtain blank ones.

facts.fact: Potions are converted to uncursed water, except for potions of see invisible and sickness which become fruit juice.
facts.detect: Inventory potions turning into uncursed water or fruit juice.
facts.action: Use wand of cancellation on potions to convert them to water or fruit juice.

facts.fact: Cancellation stops many monster attacks and abilities, including fire, cold, shock, poison, paralysis, and spellcasting.
facts.detect: Monster attacks being ineffective or monsters losing special abilities.
facts.action: Use wand of cancellation on dangerous monsters to neutralize their special abilities.

facts.fact: Self-cancellation affects only items in inventory, reverting them to uncursed and +0, but does not affect the player monster.
facts.detect: Self-cancellation message and inventory items reverting.
facts.action: Drop or bag everything before self-cancelling to remove cursed gear.

facts.fact: Canines are carnivorous animals that are quadrupedal and lack hands, and are also visible via infravision.
facts.detect: Infravision
facts.action: Use infravision to detect canines in dark areas.

facts.fact: Fantastic canines except for the warg also have a breath weapon.
facts.detect: Hell hound, winter wolf, Cerberus
facts.action: Avoid close combat with fantastic canines to prevent breath weapon attacks.

facts.fact: Randomly generated canines that are not domestic are always created hostile.
facts.detect: Hostile canines
facts.action: Avoid or prepare to fight hostile canines.

facts.fact: You notice a dog smell. (A monster polymorphed into a dog outside of your sight range.)
facts.detect: Message: You notice a dog smell.
facts.action: Be cautious as a polymorphed monster may be dangerous.

facts.fact: Canines that eat mimic corpses may assume the form of a sink for the duration of the meal.
facts.detect: Sink form
facts.action: Avoid eating mimic corpses to prevent transforming into a sink.

facts.fact: A hero that eats a corpse, tin or egg of the same species as them will gain the aggravate monster intrinsic and lose 2–5 points of luck.
facts.detect: You cannibal! You will regret this!
facts.action: Avoid eating corpses, tins, or eggs of the same species as the hero.

facts.fact: Heroes that are human and not Cavepeople should only use blessed tins of nurse meat to fully restore their HP in emergencies, where being a live cannibal is preferable and easier to recover from than dying with a 'clean' conscience.
facts.detect: Emergency situation where HP is critically low and blessed tins of nurse meat are available.
facts.action: Eat blessed tins of nurse meat to restore HP in emergencies.

facts.fact: Early in the game, committing cannibalism by eating a tainted corpse can be a death sentence.
facts.detect: Ulch - that meat was tainted, you cannibal!
facts.action: Avoid eating any corpse that seems suspicious or rotten.

facts.fact: Dwarves and gnomes can readily identify members of their race via glyph and/or monster name.
facts.detect: Glyph or monster name indicating a dwarf or gnome.
facts.action: Avoid eating corpses of dwarves or gnomes.

facts.fact: The message 'You feel a deep sense of kinship to the ! Eat anyway?' may appear if you are non-cannibalistic and about to eat the corpse or tin of a monster of your race.
facts.detect: You feel a deep sense of kinship to the ! Eat anyway?
facts.action: Do not eat the corpse or tin.

facts.fact: Carnivores prefer to eat meat and tripe when tamed.
facts.detect: Meat or tripe item names
facts.action: Feed carnivores meat or tripe to keep them happy and prevent them from eating 'people food'.

facts.fact: Carnivores will eat any safe corpses and eggs they find on the ground.
facts.detect: Safe corpse or egg names
facts.action: Ensure carnivores have access to safe corpses and eggs to prevent them from eating 'people food'.

facts.fact: Carnivores will eat 'people food' such as food rations, pancakes, or fortune cookies if they are hungry.
facts.detect: Messages like 'The <carnivore> eats your <food item>.'
facts.action: Avoid letting carnivores eat 'people food' by feeding them meat or tripe.

facts.fact: Carnivores will eat vegetarian food such as fruit and melons if starving.
facts.detect: Messages like 'The <carnivore> eats your <vegetarian food item>.'
facts.action: Ensure carnivores are well-fed to prevent them from eating vegetarian food.

facts.fact: Carnivores will not eat vegan corpses such as mold or lichens, nor will they eat tins.
facts.detect: Vegan corpse or tin names
facts.action: Avoid leaving vegan corpses or tins around carnivores.

facts.fact: The Castle level is located between DL 25 and 29 and contains a guaranteed wand of wishing in a chest.
facts.detect: Chest marked with {{brightgreen|(}} and guarded by two soldiers.
facts.action: Retrieve the wand of wishing from the chest.

facts.fact: The drawbridge is guarded and can be opened by guessing the correct 5-note combination or using a wand of opening.
facts.detect: Drawbridge symbol {{brown|#}}.
facts.action: Open the drawbridge safely to cross the moat.

facts.fact: The moat contains dangerous creatures such as sharks and giant eels.
facts.detect: Moat symbol {{black|.}}.
facts.action: Avoid the moat or find a safe way to cross.

facts.fact: The walls inside the castle are undiggable, but the walls of the mazes and the two vertical walls separating the mazes from the moats are diggable.
facts.detect: Maze symbol {{black|m}}.
facts.action: Diggable walls can be used to create holes for crossing the moat.

facts.fact: The four rooms marked 'store' have an item on each square and may contain magical items or artifacts.
facts.detect: Store room symbol.
facts.action: Explore store rooms for valuable items.

facts.fact: Cave Dwellers start with a +1 club and a +2 sling.
facts.detect: The bot starts with a +1 club and a +2 sling.
facts.action: Use the +2 sling for ranged attacks and the +1 club for melee combat.

facts.fact: Cave Dwellers do not suffer any penalty for cannibalism.
facts.detect: The bot can eat corpses of domestic animals without any negative effects.
facts.action: Eat corpses of domestic animals to keep fed if necessary.

facts.fact: Cave Dwellers never get nausea from eating tripe rations.
facts.detect: The bot eats tripe rations and does not experience nausea.
facts.action: Eat tripe rations to keep fed without worrying about nausea.

facts.fact: Cave Dwellers get a +1 multishot bonus when throwing spears or firing proper ammunition from a sling.
facts.detect: The bot throws spears or fires proper ammunition from a sling.
facts.action: Use spears or proper ammunition from a sling to take advantage of the multishot bonus.

facts.fact: Dwarven Cave Dwellers start with 18 HP and 1 Pw.
facts.detect: The bot starts with 18 HP and 1 Pw.
facts.action: Focus on melee combat and heavy armor to maximize the benefits of high HP.

facts.fact: The Cave Dweller quest involves fighting the Chromatic Dragon for The Sceptre of Might.
facts.detect: Encounter with the Chromatic Dragon
facts.action: Prepare to fight the Chromatic Dragon and obtain the Sceptre of Might.

facts.fact: The home level is The Caves of the Ancestors, which is no-teleport and has undiggable walls and floor.
facts.detect: Arrival at The Caves of the Ancestors
facts.action: Avoid teleportation and digging in The Caves of the Ancestors.

facts.fact: The goal level is Tiamat's Chamber, where the Chromatic Dragon guards the Sceptre of Might.
facts.detect: Arrival at Tiamat's Chamber
facts.action: Prepare to fight the Chromatic Dragon in Tiamat's Chamber.

facts.fact: Random monsters on the quest branch include bugbears (55%), hill giants (14%), and normal random monsters (14%).
facts.detect: Encounter with bugbears or hill giants
facts.action: Be prepared to fight bugbears and hill giants during the quest.

facts.fact: The Chromatic Dragon will occasionally utter maledictions that can discourage the player.
facts.detect: Chromatic Dragon's maledictions
facts.action: Ignore the Chromatic Dragon's discouraging messages and focus on the task.

facts.fact: Cave dwellers are not generated randomly and are normally created as peaceful towards lawful heroes before specific adjustments are made.
facts.detect: Encounter with a cave dweller that does not attack initially.
facts.action: Do not attack unless provoked or necessary for survival.

facts.fact: Cave dwellers generated on the Astral Plane will have a random color of dragon scale mail.
facts.detect: Entering the Astral Plane and encountering a cave dweller with dragon scale mail.
facts.action: Be cautious as the armor may be highly enchanted and dangerous.

facts.fact: Cave dwellers generated on the Astral Plane have a chance of generating with a long sword that can turn into Vorpal Blade.
facts.detect: Encountering a cave dweller with a long sword on the Astral Plane.
facts.action: Avoid or quickly deal with the cave dweller to prevent the long sword from turning into Vorpal Blade.

facts.fact: Cave dwellers always generate with a weapon, which can be a mace, club, long sword, or randomly chosen melee weapon.
facts.detect: Encountering a cave dweller with a mace, club, long sword, or other melee weapon.
facts.action: Be prepared to fight or avoid the cave dweller based on the weapon type.

facts.fact: Cave dwellers generated on the Astral Plane have a chance of being given a cheap plastic imitation of the Amulet of Yendor.
facts.detect: Encountering a cave dweller on the Astral Plane with an imitation Amulet of Yendor.
facts.action: Be cautious as the imitation amulet may be cursed or have negative effects.

facts.fact: Certain Quest home levels, the Plane of Air, the Plane of Fire, the Plane of Water, the Astral Plane do not have a ceiling.
facts.detect: Level name or description indicating these special levels
facts.action: Be aware that these levels lack a ceiling and adjust tactics accordingly.

facts.fact: Monsters with the M1_CLING flag can move on the ceiling and avoid falling into pits or triggering traps.
facts.detect: Monster names like large mimic, giant mimic, piercers, wumpus
facts.action: Be cautious when encountering these monsters as they can move unpredictably and avoid traps.

facts.fact: Piercers and lurker above can hide on the ceiling and surprise the player when moving onto their square.
facts.detect: Monster names piercer, lurker above
facts.action: Be cautious when moving onto squares where these monsters might be hiding.

facts.fact: Quaffing a cursed potion of levitation causes damage from hitting the head on the ceiling.
facts.detect: Cursed potion of levitation
facts.action: Avoid quaffing cursed potions of levitation unless on a level without a ceiling.

facts.fact: Zapping a wand of digging or using the dig spell upwards dislodges a rock from the ceiling.
facts.detect: Wand of digging or dig spell
facts.action: Avoid using these items upwards unless necessary and on levels without a ceiling.

facts.fact: Centaurs are designated internally by the macro S_CENTAUR and represented by the uppercase C glyph.
facts.detect: Encountering a centaur on the map will show the uppercase C glyph.
facts.action: Be prepared for a strong and intelligent opponent that can wield weapons and use magical items.

facts.fact: Centaurs can wield weapons and use magical items, and will seek out weapons, armor, food, and gold to pick up.
facts.detect: Observing a centaur picking up weapons, armor, or gold on the map.
facts.action: Avoid letting centaurs acquire powerful items and keep an eye on your inventory to prevent them from stealing.

facts.fact: Randomly generated centaurs may be peaceful towards heroes of the same alignment as them.
facts.detect: A centaur approaches and does not attack.
facts.action: Attempt to tame the centaur if it is peaceful and of the same alignment.

facts.fact: Centaurs have a 2 chance of being generated with a launcher and missiles.
facts.detect: A centaur is generated with a bow or crossbow and a supply of arrows or bolts.
facts.action: Be prepared for ranged attacks and try to neutralize the centaur's ranged capabilities.

facts.fact: Centaurs can be quite fearsome and highly-damaging enemies in the early and mid-game.
facts.detect: Engaging in combat with a centaur and experiencing repeated melee and ranged attacks.
facts.action: Use ranged attacks or pets to weaken the centaur before engaging in melee combat.

facts.fact: Centaur is typically created hostile.
facts.detect: Hostile centaur on the map
facts.action: Avoid or prepare to fight hostile centaurs

facts.fact: Centaurs have a 1/2 chance of generating with a crossbow and 1/2 chance of the crossbow being cursed, along with 3-14 crossbow bolts.
facts.detect: Centaurs carrying a crossbow and bolts
facts.action: Steal or disarm crossbow before engaging

facts.fact: Dead centaurs provide 500 nutrition.
facts.detect: Killed centaur corpse
facts.action: Eat centaur corpse to gain nutrition

facts.fact: Wands can be charged a limited number of times, with a chance of exploding if they are recharged too many times.
facts.detect: Wand explosion message (e.g., 'The wand explodes!')
facts.action: Avoid recharging wands excessively, especially wands of wishing which explode after the first recharge.

facts.fact: Charging a ring has a chance of exploding the ring based on its current enchantment.
facts.detect: Ring explosion message (e.g., 'The ring explodes!')
facts.action: Avoid charging rings with enchantments outside the safe range (-1 to +6).

facts.fact: Oil lamps and brass lanterns use their 'charges' to measure their duration of activity.
facts.detect: Oil lamp or brass lantern in inventory with charge counter
facts.action: Recharge oil lamps and brass lanterns before they run out of charges.

facts.fact: Cursed charging sets the wand's number of charges to 0.
facts.detect: Cursed scroll of charging or cursed Platinum Yendorian Express Card
facts.action: Avoid using cursed charging sources on wands.

facts.fact: Blessed charging adds 1-3 points to a ring's enchantment, uncursed adds 1 point, and cursed subtracts 1-2 points.
facts.detect: Blessed, uncursed, or cursed charging source
facts.action: Use blessed charging sources to increase ring enchantment safely.

facts.fact: Charisma influences the effectiveness of conflict.
facts.detect: Not directly detectable by the bot, but can be inferred from the charisma value.
facts.action: Try to increase charisma to improve conflict effectiveness.

facts.fact: Charisma increases the chance of a positive result in amorous demon encounters and gives more control over whether they remove the hero's armor.
facts.detect: Encounter with an amorous demon.
facts.action: Increase charisma to improve chances of positive outcomes and control over armor removal.

facts.fact: Charisma affects the prices offered by shopkeepers for buying and selling items.
facts.detect: Shopkeeper offers unusually high or low prices.
facts.action: Increase charisma to get better prices when buying and selling.

facts.fact: Charisma influences the chances of successfully bribing demons with less money than they demand.
facts.detect: Encounter with a demon demanding a bribe.
facts.action: Increase charisma to improve chances of successful bribery.

facts.fact: Charisma affects the amount of gold required to bribe the Yendorian army.
facts.detect: Encounter with the Yendorian army demanding a bribe.
facts.action: Increase charisma to reduce the amount of gold needed for bribery.

facts.fact: Only nymphs (wood nymph, water nymph, and mountain nymph) have charming abilities and will use 'claw' attacks to initiate charming and steal items.
facts.detect: monster name (wood nymph, water nymph, mountain nymph)
facts.action: Avoid or quickly kill these nymphs to prevent item theft.

facts.fact: Charming attacks cannot be blocked by magic cancellation.
facts.detect: monster initiating a charm attack
facts.action: Do not rely on magic cancellation to protect against charm attacks.

facts.fact: If a nymph steals a footrice corpse without gloves, it will be instantly stoned.
facts.detect: footrice corpse being stolen
facts.action: Do not let nymphs near footrice corpses without gloves.

facts.fact: Charming attacks will fail if there is nothing eligible to steal.
facts.detect: nymph attempting to steal but failing
facts.action: Let nymphs steal items if you have unwanted cursed items.

facts.fact: A charmed hero will be immobilized while removing worn items.
facts.detect: message 'charms you. You gladly remove your ...'
facts.action: Avoid being charmed by nymphs to prevent item theft and immobilization.

facts.fact: The hero cannot chat if they are polymorphed into a silent monster, strangled, engulfed, underwater, or deaf.
facts.detect: The bot should check its status and surroundings (e.g., being underwater, polymorphed, etc.).
facts.action: Avoid chatting in these conditions.

facts.fact: Chatting to a steed while it is asleep or immobilized will use up a turn.
facts.detect: The bot should detect if it is riding a steed that is asleep or immobilized.
facts.action: Avoid chatting to a steed in these conditions.

facts.fact: Chatting to an aligned priest will make them hostile if they are sleeping or immobile, regardless of location.
facts.detect: The bot should detect peaceful aligned priests and avoid chatting to them unless it has gold to donate.
facts.action: Avoid chatting to peaceful aligned priests unless it has gold to donate.

facts.fact: Chatting to a foocubus of the opposite sex will initiate an encounter.
facts.detect: The bot should detect foocubi of the opposite sex.
facts.action: Avoid chatting to foocubi of the opposite sex unless it is prepared for an encounter.

facts.fact: Chatting to a skeleton paralyzes the hero for a short time.
facts.detect: The bot should detect skeletons nearby.
facts.action: Avoid chatting to skeletons.

facts.fact: The home level contains 8 kitchen porters, 8 giant beetles, and 4 bloodworms, with 2 polymorph traps and 4 other random traps.
facts.detect: Arriving at the home level, encountering kitchen porters, giant beetles, bloodworms, and traps.
facts.action: Avoid polymorph traps and be cautious of giant beetles and bloodworms. Prioritize rescuing kitchen porters for experience and items.

facts.fact: The upper filler level is lit and undiggable, containing 15 random objects, 6 random traps, 14 giant beetles, and 9 bloodworms.
facts.detect: Navigating the upper filler level, encountering traps, giant beetles, and bloodworms.
facts.action: Be cautious of traps and monsters, prioritize finding objects and avoiding traps.

facts.fact: The goal level is dark with a ring of lava pools, containing 4 fire traps, 2 other random traps, 14 random objects, and 9 giant beetles and 9 bloodworms.
facts.detect: Arriving at the goal level, encountering lava pools, fire traps, and monsters.
facts.action: Avoid fire traps and lava pools, prioritize finding the Deluxe Yendorian Knife and defeating The Immortal Rot.

facts.fact: The Immortal Rot is a unique hostile monster with high AC, MR, and resistances, capable of stealing the Amulet.
facts.detect: Encountering The Immortal Rot on the goal level.
facts.action: Prepare for a challenging fight, focus on avoiding its attacks and stealing the Amulet.

facts.fact: The walls and ground of the home and upper filler levels are undiggable.
facts.detect: Attempting to dig through walls or ground.
facts.action: Avoid digging through walls or ground, find alternative paths.

facts.fact: Clairvoyance reveals a 19x11 region around you, showing walls, stairs, objects, and unseen monsters marked as 'I'.
facts.detect: The bot notices walls, stairs, objects, and unseen monsters marked as 'I' on the map.
facts.action: Use clairvoyance to map areas that cannot be mapped by magic mapping, such as the Valley of the Dead and Gehennom.

facts.fact: Intrinsic clairvoyance occurs with 50% probability every 15th turn, unless in the endgame.
facts.detect: The bot notices that clairvoyance activates every 15th turn with 50% probability.
facts.action: Wait for clairvoyance to activate to map the area around you.

facts.fact: Intrinsic clairvoyance can be obtained temporarily by donating gold to an aligned priest.
facts.detect: The bot notices an aligned priest and has gold to donate.
facts.action: Donate gold to an aligned priest to gain intrinsic clairvoyance.

facts.fact: Clairvoyance reveals objects but not their appearances.
facts.detect: The bot notices objects on the map but does not know their specific types.
facts.action: Use clairvoyance to locate objects without revealing their types.

facts.fact: Clairvoyance can be obtained as an extrinsic by wearing a cornuthaum as a wizard or carrying the Amulet of Yendor.
facts.detect: The bot notices a cornuthaum or the Amulet of Yendor.
facts.action: Wear a cornuthaum or carry the Amulet of Yendor to gain extrinsic clairvoyance.

facts.fact: Thick-skinned monsters take halved damage (rounded up) from claw attacks.
facts.detect: Monster name or description indicating thick skin (e.g., crocodile, certain golems)
facts.action: Be cautious when attacking thick-skinned monsters with claw attacks; they will deal less damage.

facts.fact: Using a claw attack on a cockatrice or chickatrice without wearing gloves (or wielding a weapon, for the hero) will turn the attacker to stone.
facts.detect: Encountering a cockatrice or chickatrice
facts.action: Ensure gloves or a weapon are equipped before engaging in melee with these monsters.

facts.fact: A claw attack will cause passive attacks from the defender to trigger.
facts.detect: Being attacked by a monster with a claw attack
facts.action: Be prepared for additional damage or effects from passive attacks when defending against claw attacks.

facts.fact: If an engulfing attack is landed during the grace period where a hero or monster cannot be re-engulfed, and that engulfing attack does not deal acid, fire, shock, or cold damage, the engulfing attack is converted to a 1d6 claw attack of the same damage type.
facts.detect: Being engulfed by a monster and receiving a claw attack message
facts.action: Be aware that certain engulfing attacks can convert to claw attacks, potentially dealing damage.

facts.fact: Magic cancellation can block claw attacks if they use damage types that are also blocked by magic cancellation.
facts.detect: Equipping magic cancellation and encountering a claw attack
facts.action: Use magic cancellation to block claw attacks that match blocked damage types.

facts.fact: Each Priest starts with a blessed +1 mace (wielded), a +0 robe, a +0 small shield, 4 potions of holy water, 1-2 cloves of garlic, 1-2 sprigs of wolfsbane, 2 random spellbooks for clerical, divination or healing spells of level 3 or lower, and either an uncursed magic marker or an uncursed oil lamp.
facts.detect: Upon starting the game, the bot will see these items in its inventory.
facts.action: The bot should use the blessed +1 mace for melee combat, the +0 robe and small shield for defense, and the potions of holy water for uncursing and blessing items. Garlic and wolfsbane should be used to deal with undead and lycanthropy respectively.

facts.fact: Priests have inherent knowledge of any item's beatitude, whether or not they can see or even touch it.
facts.detect: The bot will know the beatitude of items without needing to use a scroll of remove curse or altar.
facts.action: The bot should use this knowledge to bless and uncursed items as needed.

facts.fact: Priests can utilize the #turn extended command to turn away undead.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter undead monsters in the dungeon.
facts.action: The bot should use the #turn command to turn away undead monsters, especially in large groups.

facts.fact: Priests have a +2 bonus to casting emergency spells.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter situations where it needs to cast emergency spells such as remove curse or create monster.
facts.action: The bot should use emergency spells more frequently and rely on them for quick solutions.

facts.fact: Priests do not receive multishot bonuses unless they have Expert skill with the given weapon.
facts.detect: The bot will attempt to throw or fire more than one missile per action.
facts.action: The bot should avoid using ranged weapons unless it has reached Expert skill with them.

facts.fact: The Priest's quest contains several graveyards with boxes of loot on each floor, but also major demons, wraiths, and vampires.
facts.detect: Encountering graveyards with boxes of loot, major demons, wraiths, and vampires.
facts.action: Be cautious and prepared for hostile monsters, especially if you are not confident in handling level drain attacks.

facts.fact: Drain resistance, MC3, and viable ranged attacks are ideal for preventing or minimizing the impact of level drain attacks.
facts.detect: Encountering major demons, wraiths, and vampires.
facts.action: Equip items or spells that provide drain resistance and use ranged attacks to avoid close combat.

facts.fact: Stealth is ideal to allow Priests to clear the graveyards without awakening the denizens too quickly.
facts.detect: Being in a graveyard with monsters nearby.
facts.action: Use stealth to avoid awakening monsters and clear the area slowly and carefully.

facts.fact: The Priest nemesis Nalzok respects Elbereth and the scroll of scare monster.
facts.detect: Encountering Nalzok.
facts.action: Use Elbereth or the scroll of scare monster to avoid or delay combat with Nalzok.

facts.fact: Priests should be skilled in divination spells, particularly magic mapping and detect monsters, in the late game.
facts.detect: Reaching the late game and needing to navigate Gehennom.
facts.action: Learn and use divination spells to map and track hostile monsters.

facts.fact: Clerics are not generated randomly and are normally peaceful towards neutral heroes before specific adjustments are made.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter a peaceful cleric monster.
facts.action: The bot should avoid attacking peaceful monsters unless necessary, as they may be beneficial or neutral.

facts.fact: Clerics generate with 1-3 random offensive items, 1-3 random defensive items, and 1-3 random miscellaneous items.
facts.detect: The bot finds a cleric with a variety of items in its inventory.
facts.action: The bot should loot the cleric's items, prioritizing offensive and defensive items for immediate use or later identification.

facts.fact: Clerics generated on the Astral Plane have a chance of having a cheap plastic imitation of the Amulet of Yendor, valuable gems, and a weapon with a high chance of being an artifact.
facts.detect: The bot encounters a cleric on the Astral Plane with an imitation Amulet of Yendor or valuable gems.
facts.action: The bot should prioritize taking the imitation Amulet of Yendor and valuable gems, as they can be useful for trading or later use.

facts.fact: Clerics on the Astral Plane have a chance of generating with a long sword that can turn into Vorpal Blade.
facts.detect: The bot sees a cleric with a long sword on the Astral Plane.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious and avoid engaging in combat with the cleric if it has a long sword, as it could result in the generation of Vorpal Blade.

facts.fact: Clerics always generate with a weapon, which can be a mace, long sword, or randomly chosen melee weapon.
facts.detect: The bot sees a cleric with a mace, long sword, or other melee weapon.
facts.action: The bot should take the weapon if it is useful and can be used to improve its combat capabilities.

facts.fact: Every level of the Cleric quest is considered a graveyard level, meaning undead monsters are less likely to leave corpses.
facts.detect: Encountering a high number of undead monsters on any level of the quest.
facts.action: Avoid eating undead corpses to prevent potential negative effects.

facts.fact: The Great Temple level contains twelve human zombies surrounding the Temple and four random traps.
facts.detect: Seeing twelve human zombies and traps on the map.
facts.action: Carefully navigate around traps and zombies, avoiding unnecessary combat.

facts.fact: The Temple of Nalzok is surrounded by a graveyard filled with undead.
facts.detect: Entering a large graveyard area with numerous undead.
facts.action: Use #turn to incapacitate undead and avoid direct combat.

facts.fact: Nalzok's Lair contains sixteen human zombies, eight wraiths, and four fire traps.
facts.detect: Entering a lava plain area with numerous human zombies and wraiths.
facts.action: Be cautious of fire traps and use ranged attacks or magic to avoid close combat.

facts.fact: Drain resistance is recommended due to the number of wraiths and vampires.
facts.detect: Encountering wraiths or vampires.
facts.action: Equip an artifact that confers drain resistance or use polymorph control to gain resistance.

facts.fact: A priest's starting robe provides MC2, and can either be replaced with a cloak of protection or supplemented with a ring of protection to obtain MC3.
facts.detect: Starting robe, cloak of protection, ring of protection
facts.action: Equip a cloak of protection or a ring of protection to achieve MC3 for better stealth and drain resistance.

facts.fact: A source of speed will also allow the player to keep a safe distance most of the time.
facts.detect: Speed source (e.g., speed boots, potion of speed)
facts.action: Use a speed source to maintain distance from dangerous monsters.

facts.fact: With a solid supply of nutrition (such as the various rations that can found in containers within graveyards) and optionally a ring of slow digestion, a patient player can easily reach level 30 this way.
facts.detect: Containers within graveyards, rations, ring of slow digestion
facts.action: Collect and consume rations and use a ring of slow digestion to manage nutrition.

facts.fact: Repeatedly casting the spell of create monster near the portal has a 14% chance of generating a wraith.
facts.detect: Spell of create monster, wraith
facts.action: Cast the spell of create monster near the portal to generate wraiths for the quest.

facts.fact: Some players target vampires or zombies for a blessed scroll of genocide to increase the amount of wraiths generated randomly and in the Quest's graveyards.
facts.detect: Vampire, zombie, blessed scroll of genocide
facts.action: Target vampires or zombies to obtain a blessed scroll of genocide for increased wraith generation.

facts.fact: A cloak is one of two primary sources of magic cancellation.
facts.detect: Wearing a cloak
facts.action: Wear a cloak to gain magic cancellation.

facts.fact: A cloak protects armor underneath it from erosion, rust traps, and attacks from black puddings and rust monsters.
facts.detect: Wearing a cloak over armor
facts.action: Wear a cloak over armor to protect it from erosion and rust.

facts.fact: A greased cloak protects the wearer from holding attacks and drowning attacks.
facts.detect: Wearing a greased cloak
facts.action: Grease a cloak to protect against holding and drowning attacks.

facts.fact: An elven cloak grants stealth while worn and can be enchanted to +7.
facts.detect: Finding an elven cloak
facts.action: Keep an elven cloak for its stealth and potential to be enchanted.

facts.fact: Popular cloaks for the late game include the cloak of magic resistance, cloak of protection, oilskin cloak, and cloak of displacement.
facts.detect: Reaching the late game
facts.action: Acquire and use a cloak of magic resistance, protection, oilskin, or displacement for ascension.

facts.fact: Closed doors can only be opened by humanoid creatures.
facts.detect: The door is closed and the monster lacks hands.
facts.action: Close doors behind you to avoid monsters.

facts.fact: Closing and locking doors can deter other humanoid monsters.
facts.detect: The door is closed and locked, and a humanoid monster is nearby.
facts.action: Lock doors to deter humanoid monsters.

facts.fact: Closing doors can help guess at a monster's location.
facts.detect: A door is closed and a nymph has stolen an item.
facts.action: Use closed doors to deduce the nymph's location.

facts.fact: Closing the shop door prevents pets from eating food.
facts.detect: The shop door is open and the pet is near food items.
facts.action: Close the shop door to protect food items.

facts.fact: Closing the shop door prevents pets from attacking mimics or the shopkeeper.
facts.detect: The shop door is open and the pet is near a mimic or the shopkeeper.
facts.action: Close the shop door to prevent pet attacks.

facts.fact: Closets are only created in ordinary rooms and appear on the top or bottom edge of a room.
facts.detect: The bot will notice a single square niche behind a door or wall, often on the top or bottom edge of a room.
facts.action: The bot should explore these areas as they may contain useful items or be used as a safe area.

facts.fact: 7/8 of closets will have a door leading into them, with 4/5 of doors being secret doors.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter a door, often a secret door, leading to a closet.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious when opening doors, especially secret doors, as they may lead to traps or dangerous situations.

facts.fact: If a closet is created with no door, there is a 50% chance that the wall blocking the closet is replaced with iron bars.
facts.detect: The bot will see iron bars blocking a closet.
facts.action: The bot should be prepared to dig through iron bars if necessary to access the closet.

facts.fact: A closet may contain a scroll of teleportation and an additional random item.
facts.detect: The bot will find a scroll of teleportation or other items inside a closet.
facts.action: The bot should collect the scroll of teleportation and any other items found.

facts.fact: Some closets can be generated with a teleportation trap that points to a vault or a level teleporter, indicated by a faded engraving of 'ad aerarium' or 'Vlad was here'.
facts.detect: The bot will see a faded engraving of 'ad aerarium' or 'Vlad was here' near a closet.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious and prepared for teleportation traps or level changes.

facts.fact: Cloth items are vulnerable to burning and rotting.
facts.detect: Item name (e.g., cornuthaum, Hawaiian shirt, cloak of invisibility, bag of holding)
facts.action: Avoid burning or rotting cloth items by not using fire or water-based attacks near them and keeping them in a safe inventory slot.

facts.fact: Cornuthaum is a helm made of cloth.
facts.detect: Cornuthaum
facts.action: Store the cornuthaum in a safe inventory slot to prevent burning or rotting.

facts.fact: Hawaiian shirt is a shirt made of cloth.
facts.detect: Hawaiian shirt
facts.action: Store the Hawaiian shirt in a safe inventory slot to prevent burning or rotting.

facts.fact: Cloak of invisibility is a cloak made of cloth.
facts.detect: Cloak of invisibility
facts.action: Store the cloak of invisibility in a safe inventory slot to prevent burning or rotting.

facts.fact: Bag of holding is a tool made of cloth.
facts.detect: Bag of holding
facts.action: Store the bag of holding in a safe inventory slot to prevent burning or rotting.

facts.fact: Clouds allow unobstructed passage but block line of sight.
facts.detect: Character's line of sight is blocked but movement is not.
facts.action: Proceed with caution, as monsters and items may be present but not visible.

facts.fact: On the Plane of Air, clouds are much larger and subject to storms that emit rays of lightning.
facts.detect: Character is on the Plane of Air and sees a large cloud.
facts.action: Avoid staying in large clouds on the Plane of Air to prevent paralysis from lightning strikes.

facts.fact: In the Lethe patch, small clouds appear near the temple on the seventh level of the Lethe Gorge.
facts.detect: Character is on the seventh level of the Lethe Gorge near the temple.
facts.action: Be cautious when moving through clouds near the temple to avoid traps or hidden dangers.

facts.fact: In the Biodiversity patch, the home level for priests of the Knight's pantheon features cloudy terrain.
facts.detect: Character is on a level with cloudy terrain and is a priest of the Knight's pantheon.
facts.action: Proceed with caution, as the terrain may be unpredictable.

facts.fact: The club and the aklys both use the club skill.
facts.detect: Weapon name: 'club' or 'aklys'
facts.action: Use clubs or aklys to improve club skill proficiency.

facts.fact: There are no artifacts that use the club skill.
facts.detect: No artifact weapon with club skill.
facts.action: Do not expect to find artifact clubs.

facts.fact: In NetHack Fourk, gnomish heroes have increased skill caps in clubs.
facts.detect: Character race: Gnome
facts.action: If playing as a gnome, aim for higher club skill proficiency.

facts.fact: The Big Stick is a chaotic artifact club that replaces The Sceptre of Might as the Caveman quest artifact.
facts.detect: Quest artifact for Caveman: 'The Big Stick'
facts.action: If playing as a Caveman, aim to find 'The Big Stick' instead of 'The Sceptre of Might'.

facts.fact: All monsters in the cockatrice monster class are omnivorous animals of neutral alignment that are small in size at most.
facts.detect: Encountering a small neutral monster with the lowercase 'c' glyph (white c)
facts.action: Be cautious and prepare to fight or flee, as these monsters can be dangerous due to their stoning ability.

facts.fact: Cockatrices and chickatrices can turn the player to stone with their gaze or touch.
facts.detect: Seeing a cockatrice or chickatrice (lowercase 'c' glyph) or being petrified
facts.action: Wear a helm of opposite alignment or use a stone to flesh spell to avoid petrification.

facts.fact: Pyrolisks are part of the cockatrice class but lack the stoning properties of cockatrices and chickatrices.
facts.detect: Seeing a pyrolisk (lowercase 'c' glyph) or being attacked by fire
facts.action: Wear a helm of opposite alignment and be prepared for fire attacks.

facts.fact: Randomly generated cockatrice monsters are always created hostile.
facts.detect: Encountering a cockatrice or chickatrice in a hostile manner
facts.action: Be prepared to fight or use ranged attacks to avoid close combat.

facts.fact: A cockatrice nest has a 1/8 chance of being generated from dungeon levels 17 onward, but only if no other special room has generated on the level, making its actual chance around 1 in 44 on a level with no shops.
facts.detect: You enter a disgusting nest!
facts.action: Carry a stack of lizard corpses or have a means to safely pray. If you have stealth, you can try to avoid waking them up and fight them one at a time.

facts.fact: Getting surrounded by several cockatrices can result in a much higher likelihood that you begin the stoning process every turn.
facts.detect: You begin to feel a strange sensation.
facts.action: Use lizard corpses or polymorph into a stoning-resistant form immediately if you start to feel the stoning process.

facts.fact: A stack of lizard corpses is the most common preventative against the stoning process.
facts.detect: Lizard corpse in inventory.
facts.action: Eat a lizard corpse to prevent stoning if you are in danger.

facts.fact: Stealth should allow you to avoid waking them up, so you can fight them one at a time.
facts.detect: You have the stealth skill.
facts.action: Use stealth to avoid waking up cockatrices and fight them one at a time.

facts.fact: A sufficiently powerful melee character has a reasonable chance of being able to clear a cockatrice nest without the stoning process starting.
facts.detect: High melee combat skill and strength.
facts.action: Attempt to clear the nest quickly if you are a powerful melee character, but ensure you have a means to prevent stoning.

facts.fact: Cold damage can destroy potions in the open inventory of a hero or monster, dealing +d4 damage for each shattered potion.
facts.detect: Your freezes and shatters!
facts.action: Stash potions in a bag or container to prevent destruction.

facts.fact: Cold rays and explosions can destroy doors, freeze pools and moats into ice, and cool and solidify lava into normal rock.
facts.detect: The water freezes.
facts.action: Avoid using cold spells or wands near doors, pools, moats, or lava.

facts.fact: Monsters with fire resistance but no cold resistance take roughly 57% more damage from cold rays and double damage from frosty explosions.
facts.detect: Winter wolves or their cubs attacking.
facts.action: Gain cold resistance to avoid increased damage from cold-based monsters.

facts.fact: Cold resistance protects items in open inventory from freezing and shattering 99/100 of the time.
facts.detect: You feel cold.
facts.action: Equip cold resistance to protect open inventory items.

facts.fact: Asmodeus's cone of cold spell can deal nearly 200 points of cold damage.
facts.detect: Asmodeus attacking with cone of cold.
facts.action: Gain cold resistance before facing Asmodeus.

facts.fact: Valkyries start each game with intrinsic cold resistance
facts.detect: Player character class is Valkyrie
facts.action: No action needed, as the bot starts with cold resistance

facts.fact: Cold resistance nullifies cold damage from attacks and wands
facts.detect: Encounter with cold-based attacks or wands
facts.action: No action needed, as cold resistance is already active

facts.fact: Cold resistance protects items in open inventory from freezing 99/100 of the time
facts.detect: Using a wand of cold or encountering cold-based attacks
facts.action: No action needed, as cold resistance is already active

facts.fact: Monsters resistant to cold but not fire take 57% more damage from fire rays and doubled damage from fiery explosions
facts.detect: Encounter with cold-resistant monsters and fire-based attacks
facts.action: Be cautious around fire-based attacks if fighting cold-resistant monsters

facts.fact: Cold resistance can be obtained by eating corpses of certain monsters
facts.detect: Finding corpses of brown mold, gelatinous cube, winter wolf cub, yeti, frost giant, winter wolf, ice troll, white dragon
facts.action: Eat corpses to gain cold resistance if not already intrinsic

facts.fact: The hero can perform two weapon combat using shift+X, allowing them to wield a weapon in each hand and attack in melee with them twice per action.
facts.detect: The bot can notice this by checking its inventory and seeing if it has two weapons that can be wielded in each hand.
facts.action: The bot should use shift+X to engage in two weapon combat if it has suitable weapons.

facts.fact: Monsters can move and use ranged attacks in the same turn, and almost all monsters have a sequence of one or more attacks available to them.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this by observing the monster's behavior and seeing if it moves and attacks in the same turn.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious and avoid getting too close to monsters that can use ranged attacks.

facts.fact: Passive attacks have a chance of triggering automatically when a monster is hit in melee, and will 'counter-attack' whoever hits them.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this by observing if a monster retaliates with a passive attack after being hit.
facts.action: The bot should avoid hitting monsters that are known to have passive counter-attacks.

facts.fact: Throwing certain types of food at domestic animals will either pacify them or tame them.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this by observing domestic animals in the dungeon.
facts.action: The bot should throw food at domestic animals to pacify or tame them.

facts.fact: Monsters carrying cream pies will throw them at the hero.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this by observing monsters carrying cream pies.
facts.action: The bot should avoid getting too close to monsters carrying cream pies.

facts.fact: Comestibles comprise 20% of all randomly-generated items in the main dungeon, 15% in containers, 22% on the Rogue level, and 16% in Gehennom. Sokoban is a branch that always contains a large amount of food.
facts.detect: Sokoban level, containers, main dungeon, Rogue level, Gehennom
facts.action: Explore Sokoban and other food-rich areas early to stockpile food.

facts.fact: Non-corpse comestibles have a chance of being generated in stacks of two, with a 2/6 chance for kelp fronds and 1/6 chance for other food.
facts.detect: Kelp fronds, other food items
facts.action: Prioritize eating kelp fronds and other food items in stacks to maximize nutrition gain.

facts.fact: Most non-tinned comestibles have a chance of being rotten when first eaten - uncursed and older than 30 turns, or blessed and older than 50 turns, have a 7/16 chance of being rotten; cursed comestibles are always rotten.
facts.detect: Eating food, seeing age of food
facts.action: Avoid eating old or cursed food to prevent negative effects.

facts.fact: Lembas wafers and cram rations are never rotten unless they are cursed.
facts.detect: Lembas wafers, cram rations
facts.action: Eat lembas wafers and cram rations without worry of them being rotten.

facts.fact: Food priority: Lizard corpses (though these are best saved for when you are turning to stone), non-homemade tins, known homemade tins and stone to flesh products, cream pies and lichen corpses, tripe rations, fruits and vegetables, C-rations, food rations, K-rations, fortune cookies (never rotten), cram rations (slightly better for dwarves; never rotten if not cursed), nameable fruit and candy bar, pancakes and lumps of royal jelly, Lembas wafers (never rotten if not cursed).
facts.detect: Types of food available
