facts.action: Eat food in order of priority to maximize nutrition and minimize carrying weight.

facts.fact: Royal jelly increases your strength by one and can cure wounded legs and restore up to 20 HP. If it would make your HP higher than your current maximum, it has a 17/20 chance of increasing your maximum HP by one and sets your HP to the new maximum.
facts.detect: Item name: Royal jelly
facts.action: Eat royal jelly to heal and potentially increase maximum HP.

facts.fact: A non-cursed eucalyptus leaf cures sickness and nausea.
facts.detect: Item name: Eucalyptus leaf
facts.action: Eat eucalyptus leaf to cure sickness and nausea.

facts.fact: Praying to your god when weak or fainting from hunger may make your stomach content, setting your nutrition to 900.
facts.detect: Messages: 'You are weak.', 'You are fainting from hunger.'
facts.action: Pray to your god when weak or fainting from hunger to reset nutrition.

facts.fact: Polymorphing into your own race resets your hunger.
facts.detect: Message: 'Your hunger is gone.'
facts.action: Polymorph into your own race to reset hunger.

facts.fact: A liquid diet does not violate foodless conduct—potions of fruit juice, water, or booze each give a small amount of nutrition.
facts.detect: Item names: Potion of fruit juice, Potion of water, Potion of booze
facts.action: Drink potions of fruit juice, water, or booze to gain nutrition without violating foodless conduct.

facts.fact: Key 'g' (Go mode) allows moving to a specific location on the map.
facts.detect: The bot can notice this by checking the map for desired locations.
facts.action: Use 'g' to move to specific coordinates or locations on the map.

facts.fact: Key 'j' (Move south / Jump) allows moving south or jumping.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this by checking its current position and the direction it needs to move.
facts.action: Use 'j' to move south or jump over obstacles.

facts.fact: Key 'k' (Move north / Kick) allows moving north or kicking a door.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this by checking its current position and the direction it needs to move, or by seeing a closed door.
facts.action: Use 'k' to move north or kick a closed door.

facts.fact: Key 'l' (Move east / Loot) allows moving east or looting a corpse.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this by checking its current position and the direction it needs to move, or by seeing a corpse.
facts.action: Use 'l' to move east or loot a corpse.

facts.fact: Key 'p' (Pay bill) allows paying bills in shops.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this by entering a shop and seeing a bill to pay.
facts.action: Use 'p' to pay bills in shops to avoid negative consequences.

facts.fact: Cone of cold is cast exclusively by Asmodeus.
facts.detect: Asmodeus
facts.action: Avoid melee combat with Asmodeus until you have cold resistance or half spell damage.

facts.fact: When used while adjacent to the target, it deals damage based on the monster's level plus any additional damage dice provided.
facts.detect: You are covered in frost!
facts.action: Gain cold resistance or half spell damage before engaging Asmodeus in melee.

facts.fact: Half spell damage halves damage inflicted by the spell in either form.
facts.detect: You are covered in frost!
facts.action: Gain half spell damage before engaging Asmodeus in melee.

facts.fact: Cold resistance completely negates damage to the hero from the spell in either form.
facts.detect: You are covered in frost!
facts.action: Gain cold resistance before engaging Asmodeus in melee.

facts.fact: When used by Asmodeus in melee, the cone of cold spell can deal upwards of 186 points of damage against a target that lacks cold resistance.
facts.detect: You are covered in frost!
facts.action: Gain cold resistance or half spell damage before engaging Asmodeus in melee.

facts.fact: Conflict affects monsters up to 8 squares of Euclidean distance away.
facts.detect: Monsters within 8 squares start attacking each other or the hero.
facts.action: Use conflict to clear out dense groups of enemies, but be cautious near strong pets, shopkeepers, or other peaceful monsters.

facts.fact: The chance of conflict taking effect on a given monster move is (CH + XL - ML)/20, capped at 19/20.
facts.detect: Monsters' reactions to conflict vary based on their level and the player's charisma and experience level.
facts.action: Adjust strategy based on the likelihood of conflict affecting specific monsters.

facts.fact: Generating conflict on the Astral Plane causes hostile Angels to replace the usual tame one.
facts.detect: Arriving on the Astral Plane with conflict active.
facts.action: Avoid generating conflict before entering the Astral Plane to prevent hostile Angels.

facts.fact: Elbereth will continue to work against those who respect it as long as the engraving remains intact.
facts.detect: Monsters ignoring the hero and attacking each other near an Elbereth engraving.
facts.action: Use Elbereth to control the conflict and minimize damage.

facts.fact: Eating a ring of conflict will burn through nutrition very quickly.
facts.detect: Hunger increasing rapidly after eating a ring of conflict.
facts.action: Avoid eating the ring of conflict to preserve nutrition.

facts.fact: Confuse is a directed spell that can be used by any monster of at least level 3 with the ability to cast clerical spells.
facts.detect: Encountering a monster of level 3 or higher that can cast spells, especially clerical ones.
facts.action: Be cautious and prepare for potential confusion if facing such monsters.

facts.fact: The spell confuses the hero when cast, even if they are already confused, with the duration being equal to the caster's level and divided in half if the hero has half spell damage.
facts.detect: Feeling confused or seeing the message 'You feel confused!' or 'You feel !' (depending on hallucination state).
facts.action: Use a confusion cure or wait for the spell to wear off, especially if you are already confused.

facts.fact: Magic resistance completely blocks the effects of the spell.
facts.detect: Having magic resistance or seeing the message 'You feel momentarily dizzy.'
facts.action: Ensure you have magic resistance to avoid being affected by the spell.

facts.fact: Attempting to cast a forgotten spell can cause confusion and stun you.
facts.detect: Message: You try to cast a spell, but you don't know how.
facts.action: Avoid casting spells you don't know or have forgotten.

facts.fact: Quaffing a potion of confusion or a non-blessed potion of booze causes confusion.
facts.detect: Message: You feel disoriented.
facts.action: Avoid drinking potions of confusion or non-blessed potions of booze.

facts.fact: Being hit by Magicbane causes confusion.
facts.detect: Message: You feel disoriented.
facts.action: Avoid being hit by Magicbane.

facts.fact: Being hit by Yeenoghu causes confusion.
facts.detect: Message: You feel disoriented.
facts.action: Avoid being hit by Yeenoghu.

facts.fact: Reading a cursed scroll of confuse monster causes confusion.
facts.detect: Message: You feel disoriented.
facts.action: Avoid reading cursed scrolls of confuse monster.

facts.fact: Having a high constitution increases your healing rate and the number of HP you gain when leveling up.
facts.detect: Checking character stats and messages like 'You feel tough! You must be leading a healthy life-style.'
facts.action: Maintain a high constitution by avoiding abuse and exercising it regularly.

facts.fact: Constitution is reduced by one when an amulet of life saving saves your life.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel fragile! You haven't been watching your health.' after using an amulet of life saving.
facts.action: Avoid using amulet of life saving unless absolutely necessary.

facts.fact: Constitution is exercised by having a hunger status of 'Not hungry' on a turn whose number is a multiple of 10.
facts.detect: Hunger status 'Not hungry' and turn number divisible by 10.
facts.action: Ensure you are not hungry on turns divisible by 10.

facts.fact: Constitution is abused by having a nutrition status of 'Fainting' or 'Fainted' on a turn whose number is a multiple of 10.
facts.detect: Nutrition status 'Fainting' or 'Fainted' and turn number divisible by 10.
facts.action: Avoid being in a state of 'Fainting' or 'Fainted' on turns divisible by 10.

facts.fact: Constitution is exercised by being healed by a nurse (one in three chance).
facts.detect: Message 'You feel tough! You must be leading a healthy life-style.' after being healed by a nurse.
facts.action: Seek out nurses for healing to exercise constitution.

facts.fact: A bag of holding cannot contain an object that would cause it to explode.
facts.detect: Item name and description
facts.action: Avoid placing volatile items like bombs, cursed artifacts, or certain types of wands in a bag of holding.

facts.fact: Large boxes, ice boxes, and chests can generate with a lock and a trap.
facts.detect: Locked container message
facts.action: Use a wand of opening, the spell of knock, or an unlocking tool to open locked containers safely.

facts.fact: Containers can protect their contents from fire, cold, shock, and cancellation, but not lava.
facts.detect: Container type and proximity to lava
facts.action: Avoid dropping containers into lava or near lava to prevent destruction of contents.

facts.fact: Containers can be polymorphed, but their contents are lost.
facts.detect: Polymorph message
facts.action: Avoid polymorphing containers that have valuable items inside.

facts.fact: Randomly generated containers often contain useful items like gems, comestibles, potions, scrolls, spellbooks, gold, wands, rings, and amulets.
facts.detect: Opening a container
facts.action: Check containers for valuable items, especially on levels known to have stashes.

facts.fact: Chests and large boxes each have a 10% chance of being protected by a container trap.
facts.detect: Applying, looting, kicking open, or using an unlocking tool on a chest or large box.
facts.action: Use the #untrap command to check for traps before interacting with the container.

facts.fact: Wishing for a 'poisoned' large box or chest will create one that is guaranteed to be trapped.
facts.detect: Wishing for a 'poisoned' large box or chest.
facts.action: Avoid wishing for 'poisoned' large boxes or chests.

facts.fact: The chance of finding a trap on a container is 10/(31 - Xlvl).
facts.detect: Using the #untrap command on a chest or large box.
facts.action: Check containers multiple times if you are below level 21.

facts.fact: If a trap is set off, there is a chance it will be harmless, but dangerous traps can destroy the container and its contents.
facts.detect: Messages like 'The explodes!', 'A cloud of noxious gas billows from the ...', etc.
facts.action: Avoid setting off traps if possible, especially if you lack poison resistance, fire resistance, and free action.

facts.fact: To disarm a trapped container safely, you need poison resistance, fire resistance, and to drop or stash certain items.
facts.detect: Having poison resistance, fire resistance, and removing vulnerable items.
facts.action: Ensure you have poison and fire resistance and remove vulnerable items before attempting to disarm a trap.

facts.fact: You can convert an altar to your alignment by making a normal sacrifice on a non-coaligned non-high altar outside of Gehennom while your alignment record is not negative.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel a strange aura emanating from the altar.'
facts.action: Make a sacrifice on the altar to convert it to your alignment.

facts.fact: You can change your alignment by putting on a helm of opposite alignment.
facts.detect: Item name: 'helm of opposite alignment'
facts.action: Put on the helm to change your alignment.

facts.fact: Sacrificing on a cross-aligned altar while your alignment record is negative converts you permanently to the alignment of the altar.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel a strange aura emanating from the altar.'
facts.action: Sacrifice on the cross-aligned altar to change your alignment.

facts.fact: By converting yourself, you can pick up an opposite-aligned quest artifact and continue to hold it if you change alignment again while holding it.
facts.detect: Item name: 'quest artifact'
facts.action: Convert your alignment to pick up and hold the quest artifact.

facts.fact: You can ascend at a cross-aligned high altar by converting your alignment.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel a strange aura emanating from the altar.'
facts.action: Convert your alignment and ascend at the cross-aligned high altar.

facts.fact: Copper items can be eaten by metallivores.
facts.detect: Metallivore monster (e.g., rust monster, xorn) attacking or targeting copper items.
facts.action: Avoid eating copper items if a metallivore is nearby or if you suspect one might be in the level.

facts.fact: Polypiling enough copper objects may create either a stone golem or a clay golem.
facts.detect: Collecting multiple copper objects and attempting to polypile them.
facts.action: Be cautious with polypiling copper objects, especially if you are low on hit points or surrounded by dangerous monsters.

facts.fact: Certain monsters designated as corpseless do not leave behind a corpse upon dying.
facts.detect: Monster names such as 'eye', 'manes', 'lemure', 'vortex', 'grid bug', 'light', 'angelic being', 'elemental', 'lich', 'mummy', 'pudding', 'vampire', 'barrow wight', 'Nazgul', 'zombie', 'ghost', 'shade', 'Ashikaga Takauji', 'Dark One', 'Thoth Amon', 'golem', 'demon', except for specific exceptions.
facts.action: Do not expect to find a corpse or any special items from these monsters upon killing them.

facts.fact: Some corpseless monsters leave behind special death drops instead of regular corpses.
facts.detect: Monster names such as 'kobold mummy', 'kobold zombie', 'gnome mummy', 'gnome zombie', 'orc mummy', 'orc zombie', 'dwarf mummy', 'dwarf zombie', 'elf mummy', 'elf zombie', 'human mummy', 'human zombie', 'vampire', 'gray ooze', 'brown pudding', 'black pudding', 'green slime', 'paper golem', 'gold golem', 'leather golem', 'wood golem', 'clay golem', 'stone golem', 'glass golem', 'iron golem'.
facts.action: Expect to find specific items such as old corpses, globs of ooze, scrolls of blank paper, gold pieces, armor, quarterstaffs, rocks, statues, worthless pieces of glass, or iron chains upon killing these monsters.

facts.fact: Digesting a corpseless monster breaks the foodless conduct.
facts.detect: Attempting to digest a corpseless monster.
facts.action: Avoid digesting corpseless monsters if you are trying to maintain the foodless conduct.

facts.fact: Digesting a corpseless monster does not provide nutrition or intrinsics.
facts.detect: Attempting to digest a corpseless monster.
facts.action: Do not expect to gain nutrition or intrinsics from digesting corpseless monsters.

facts.fact: Some corpseless monsters leave behind special death drops that correspond to a different monster's corpse.
facts.detect: Killing a 'kobold mummy', 'kobold zombie', 'gnome mummy', 'gnome zombie', 'orc mummy', 'orc zombie', 'dwarf mummy', 'dwarf zombie', 'elf mummy', 'elf zombie', 'human mummy', 'human zombie'.
facts.action: Expect to find a corpse of a different monster type upon killing these monsters.

facts.fact: Corridors are usually single file and always unlit.
facts.detect: The absence of light sources or the presence of dark corridors.
facts.action: Use a light source or a wand of light to light the corridor permanently.

facts.fact: Telepathy, Warning or Infravision are helpful when walking in corridors.
facts.detect: The player's status effects or inventory.
facts.action: Equip or use items that grant telepathy, warning, or infravision.

facts.fact: Corridors end when you find a door. If the corridor ends and there is no door, there is likely a secret door nearby.
facts.detect: The end of a corridor without a visible door.
facts.action: Search the walls for a secret passage.

facts.fact: If a boulder is blocking your path, either destroy it (if you can) or drop everything you have so you can squeeze by the boulder and try to push it to a better location.
facts.detect: A boulder blocking the path.
facts.action: Destroy the boulder if possible, or drop all items and squeeze past to push it.

facts.fact: Corridors are usually single file, so you are less likely to be overwhelmed by numbers alone. Also, since they are only one tile wide, enemies are lined up for convenient disposal by wands, spells or ranged attacks.
facts.detect: A single file corridor with enemies.
facts.action: Use wands, spells, or ranged attacks to dispose of enemies.

facts.fact: Covetous monsters will attack any monster carrying an item they covet, except for the high priest of Moloch and the Wizard of Yendor.
facts.detect: Monster attacking another monster carrying a quest artifact, Bell of Opening, Candelabrum of Invocation, Book of the Dead, or Amulet of Yendor.
facts.action: Avoid carrying coveted items when near covetous monsters or ensure the covetous monster is not in a position to attack other monsters with coveted items.

facts.fact: Covetous monsters will pick up coveted items from the ground, regardless of who drops the item.
facts.detect: Coveted item being picked up by a covetous monster.
facts.action: Avoid dropping coveted items on the ground near covetous monsters.

facts.fact: Quest artifacts and unique items are vulnerable to theft by covetous monsters with stealing attacks.
facts.detect: Message indicating a covetous monster has stolen an item from your inventory.
facts.action: Store quest artifacts and unique items in containers to protect them from theft.

facts.fact: Covetous monsters will warp to the up stairs to heal when damaged.
facts.detect: Covetous monster warping to the up stairs after taking damage.
facts.action: Block the up stairs to prevent the monster from healing or use teleport control to teleport to the up stairs before the monster does.

facts.fact: Covetous monsters prioritize obtaining their coveted items over attacking the player character.
facts.detect: Covetous monster ignoring the player to pick up a coveted item.
facts.action: Intercept the coveted item before the covetous monster can pick it up or block the monster's path to the item.

facts.fact: The Longbow of Diana is the only artifact with the 'create ammo' effect.
facts.detect: The Longbow of Diana
facts.action: Seek and invoke the Longbow of Diana to create arrows.

facts.fact: A blessed Longbow of Diana produces arrows with enchantment ranging from +0 to +10.
facts.detect: Blessed Longbow of Diana
facts.action: Invoke the blessed Longbow of Diana to create highly enchanted arrows.

facts.fact: A cursed Longbow of Diana produces arrows with enchantment ranging from -10 to +0.
facts.detect: Cursed Longbow of Diana
facts.action: Invoke the cursed Longbow of Diana to create arrows, but be cautious of negative enchantments.

facts.fact: An uncursed Longbow of Diana produces arrows with enchantment ranging from -10 to +10.
facts.detect: Uncursed Longbow of Diana
facts.action: Invoke the uncursed Longbow of Diana to create arrows with a wide range of enchantments.

facts.fact: The Longbow of Diana is less effective for non-human Rangers due to racial multishot bonuses.
facts.detect: Non-human Ranger character
facts.action: Consider the Longbow of Diana less valuable if you are a non-human Ranger.

facts.fact: Fire and frost brand can always be wielded together.
facts.detect: Item names 'Fire Brand' and 'Frost Brand'.
facts.action: Wield both Fire Brand and Frost Brand simultaneously.

facts.fact: Some artifacts have a chance to appear with different base objects from game to game.
facts.detect: Artifact names like 'Lucifer', 'Skullcrusher', etc.
facts.action: Be prepared for artifacts to appear as different base objects.

facts.fact: Fire Brand has +d5 to-hit and double damage to non-fire-resistant monsters, and provides fire resistance.
facts.detect: Item name 'Fire Brand'.
facts.action: Wield Fire Brand for its fire resistance and damage bonus against fire-sensitive monsters.

facts.fact: Frost Brand has +d5 to-hit and double damage to non-cold-resistant monsters, and provides cold resistance.
facts.detect: Item name 'Frost Brand'.
facts.action: Wield Frost Brand for its cold resistance and damage bonus against cold-sensitive monsters.

facts.fact: Magicbane randomizes to a completely random weapon.
facts.detect: Item name 'Magicbane'.
facts.action: Be prepared for Magicbane to appear as any weapon type.

facts.fact: Grass is commonly found growing on the early floors of the dungeon. It can spread to adjacent tiles, and is highly flammable.
facts.detect: Grass tile on the map
facts.action: Avoid setting grass on fire or stepping on it if carrying flammable items.

facts.fact: Ash is left in the wake of fire and sometimes lightning. It can be kicked in the faces of monsters in order to blind them.
facts.detect: Ash tile on the map
facts.action: Kick ash at monsters to blind them, giving you an advantage in combat.

facts.fact: Blood is left behind when creatures die.
facts.detect: Blood tile on the map
facts.action: Ignore blood unless it's from a specific monster you're tracking.

facts.fact: A thrown or boiling potion bottle splatters its contents onto nearby squares in the form of puddles.
facts.detect: Potion puddles on the map
facts.action: Be cautious around potion puddles as they can alchemize with other puddles or items, potentially causing explosions.

facts.fact: Broken glass cuts the feet of those that walk upon it.
facts.detect: Broken glass tile on the map
facts.action: Avoid walking on broken glass to prevent damage.

facts.fact: During the day, the player's field of view is larger than normal, peaking at noon.
facts.detect: Time of day is 'Noon'.
facts.action: Be more cautious and prepare for increased monster encounters.

facts.fact: Sunsword deals double damage at noon.
facts.detect: Equipped weapon is a Sunsword and time of day is 'Noon'.
facts.action: Use Sunsword for combat if available.

facts.fact: During the night, the player's field of view is reduced.
facts.detect: Time of day is 'Night'.
facts.action: Be more cautious and explore less.

facts.fact: Bats will spawn instead of birds during the night.
facts.detect: Spawned monsters are bats.
facts.action: Be prepared for bat encounters.

facts.fact: The hundred turns prior to and following the middle of the night are considered midnight.
facts.detect: Time of day is 'Midnight'.
facts.action: Take extra precautions and avoid unnecessary exploration.

facts.fact: Drinking a potion will leave behind an empty bottle, which can be refilled.
facts.detect: Empty Bottle
facts.action: Collect and refill empty bottles with water or other liquids to conserve potions.

facts.fact: The weight of potions is halved.
facts.detect: Potion
facts.action: Carry more potions due to reduced weight.

facts.fact: Scroll of genocide has been renamed to 'Scroll of Erasure'.
facts.detect: Scroll of Erasure
facts.action: Use the scroll to remove unwanted monsters.

facts.fact: Shepherd's Crook causes pets to follow more closely when wielded.
facts.detect: Shepherd's Crook
facts.action: Wield the Shepherd's Crook to control pets better.

facts.fact: Potion of Hazardous Waste instantly explodes when mixed with other potions.
facts.detect: Potion of Hazardous Waste
facts.action: Avoid mixing Potion of Hazardous Waste with other potions.

facts.fact: Dwarves start with 20% fire resistance, -20% cold resistance, -20% sleep resistance, and 20% poison resistance.
facts.detect: Race: Dwarf
facts.action: Dwarves should be cautious of cold and sleep damage but can take advantage of their natural fire and poison resistance.

facts.fact: If a resistance is less than 0%, damage of the given type is increased proportional to the resistance.
facts.detect: Negative resistance value
facts.action: Avoid situations that would increase negative resistance effects.

facts.fact: If a resistance is positive but less than 100%, damage of the given type is reduced proportional to the resistance.
facts.detect: Partial resistance value between 0% and 99%
facts.action: Use armor to increase resistance to dangerous damage types.

facts.fact: If a resistance is at least 100% but less than 200%, damage of the given type is ignored as if the player was intrinsically resistant to it.
facts.detect: Resistance value between 100% and 199%
facts.action: Seek out armor or items to reach 100% resistance for full protection.

facts.fact: If a resistance is 200% or more, damage of the given type is instead beneficial.
facts.detect: Resistance value of 200% or more
facts.action: Exploit beneficial resistances to heal from fire, cold, shock, poison, and disintegration damage.

facts.fact: Mirrored Glasses provide extrinsic reflection and can be wished for with specific properties or materials.
facts.detect: Mirrored Glasses
facts.action: Wish for Mirrored Glasses to gain extrinsic reflection and flexibility in armor choice.

facts.fact: Cockatrice Blood functions as an area denial tool and can be used to stone many monsters at once.
facts.detect: Cockatrice Blood
facts.action: Use Cockatrice Blood to stone multiple monsters at once.

facts.fact: Elven Helm can be safely enchanted to a high AC value and wished for with specific materials and object properties.
facts.detect: Elven Helm
facts.action: Wish for an Elven Helm with specific materials and object properties.

facts.fact: Cockatrice Corpse is more dangerous due to slipping hazards and monster tripping.
facts.detect: Cockatrice Corpse
facts.action: Avoid wielding Cockatrice Corpse due to increased danger.

facts.fact: Black Holes can teleport items to random squares, dealing cold damage.
facts.detect: Black Hole
facts.action: Use erasure to remove Black Holes to prevent item teleportation.

facts.fact: Most pets will only pick up a single piece of gold, with gold-loving monsters being the exception.
facts.detect: Pet type and behavior when encountering gold.
facts.action: Use a container like a sack to allow the pet to steal gold in groups.

facts.fact: A distinct advantage for Rogues and Archeologists who both start with an uncursed sack.
facts.detect: Starting inventory includes a sack.
facts.action: Use the sack to start credit cloning early.

facts.fact: The best shops for credit cloning are ones with lightweight expensive items like rings, wands and identified gems.
facts.detect: Shop type and inventory items.
facts.action: Target shops with expensive lightweight items for credit cloning.

facts.fact: General stores are also good because you can sell many of your own items at the beginning, increasing the size of the initial pile of gold.
facts.detect: Shop type and personal inventory.
facts.action: Target general stores for early credit cloning.

facts.fact: Be careful that your pet doesn't starve to death while credit-cloning.
facts.detect: Pet hunger status.
facts.action: Feed the pet regularly to prevent starvation.

facts.fact: You may be crowned as a result of prayer if you are at least piously aligned and extremely lucky.
facts.detect: Player's alignment and luck level
facts.action: Ensure alignment is pious and luck is extremely high to potentially receive crowning benefits.

facts.fact: Lawful characters receive the title 'Hand of Elbereth' and may receive Excalibur as a crowning gift if not already existing in the game.
facts.detect: Message 'I crown thee... The Hand of Elbereth!'
facts.action: Wield a long sword and ensure Excalibur does not exist to receive Excalibur as a gift.

facts.fact: Neutral characters receive the title 'Envoy of Balance' and may receive Vorpal Blade as a crowning gift if not already existing in the game.
facts.detect: Message 'Thou shalt be my Envoy of Balance!'
facts.action: Wield a long sword and ensure Vorpal Blade does not exist to receive Vorpal Blade as a gift.

facts.fact: Chaotic characters receive the title 'Glory of Arioch' and may receive Stormbringer as a crowning gift if not already existing in the game.
facts.detect: Message 'Thou art chosen to steal souls for My Glory!'
facts.action: Wield a broadsword and ensure Stormbringer does not exist to receive Stormbringer as a gift.

facts.fact: Crowning involves receiving several intrinsic resistances and an additional skill slot, but also greatly increases prayer timeout.
facts.detect: Player's intrinsic resistances and skill slots after prayer
facts.action: Evaluate the need for resistances and skill slots against the increased prayer timeout before praying.

facts.fact: Press Ctrl+d to kick something.
facts.detect: When the bot is in a situation where kicking an object or monster might be beneficial, such as when stuck or when a monster is blocking a path.
facts.action: Use Ctrl+d to kick the object or monster.

facts.fact: Press Ctrl+t to teleport.
facts.detect: When the bot is in a dangerous situation or needs to quickly escape.
facts.action: Use Ctrl+t to teleport to a safer location.

facts.fact: Press Ctrl+z to suspend NetHack on tty.
facts.detect: When the bot needs to pause the game temporarily, such as for debugging or taking a break.
facts.action: Use Ctrl+z to pause the game.

facts.fact: Press Ctrl+r to redraw the screen.
facts.detect: When the screen is corrupted or needs to be refreshed.
facts.action: Use Ctrl+r to redraw the screen.

facts.fact: Press Ctrl+w to wish for an object.
facts.detect: When the bot has accumulated enough wishes and needs a specific item to progress.
facts.action: Use Ctrl+w to wish for a useful item, such as a scroll of teleportation or a magic lamp.

facts.fact: When used, the spell will heal the caster for 3d6 health.
facts.detect: Foo looks better.
facts.action: If the bot encounters a message indicating a monster has healed itself, it should be cautious as this indicates the presence of a healing spell-capable monster nearby.

facts.fact: Curse items is a melee-range spell that can be used by any monster of a sufficient level that can cast spells: monsters that cast mage spells must be at least level 10, and monsters that cast clerical spells must be at least level 9.
facts.detect: Encountering a high-level monster that can cast spells.
facts.action: Be cautious and prepare for potential curse effects if facing high-level spellcasting monsters.

facts.fact: When cast, it selects up to 6 random items if the hero's inventory, which is reduced to a maximum of 3 items if a hero has either half spell damage or magic resistance and a maximum of 2 items if a hero has both.
facts.detect: Having half spell damage or magic resistance.
facts.action: Keep track of inventory and prioritize protecting important items if you have half spell damage or magic resistance.

facts.fact: Intelligent artifacts each have a 4/5 chance of individually resisting the effect of the spell, and wielding Magicbane has a 19/20 chance of the artifact absorbing the spell's effect and nullifying it entirely.
facts.detect: Equipping intelligent artifacts or Magicbane.
facts.action: Equip intelligent artifacts or Magicbane to significantly reduce the risk of being affected by the curse items spell.

facts.fact: Cursed rings and armor will become welded to your finger, cursed weapons will additionally disrupt two-weaponing when welded to you, and cursed food confers less nutrition and may render you unconscious.
facts.detect: Eating food or equipping weapons, rings, or armor that become welded.
facts.action: Avoid equipping or eating items that become welded or cursed to prevent negative effects.

facts.fact: The contents of bags and other containers are not targeted by this spell, so it is worth bagging certain items when facing spellcasters to avoid having them cursed.
facts.detect: Facing a spellcasting monster.
facts.action: Store valuable items in bags or containers to protect them from being cursed.

facts.fact: Read a non-cursed scroll of remove curse to uncurse loadstones and anything worn or wielded.
facts.detect: scroll of remove curse
facts.action: Read a non-cursed scroll of remove curse to uncurse items.

facts.fact: Dip the cursed item into a potion of holy water to uncurse it.
facts.detect: potion of holy water
facts.action: Dip the cursed item into a potion of holy water.

facts.fact: Pray to uncurse items, especially blindfolds, towels, levitation items, two-handed weapons, and wearing both cursed weapon and cursed shield.
facts.detect: message indicating you can pray
facts.action: Pray to uncurse items.

facts.fact: Drop everything else and let a nymph steal the cursed item to remove it.
facts.detect: nymph steals item
facts.action: Let a nymph steal the cursed item.

facts.fact: Polymorph into something that can't wear armor or wield weapons to remove cursed armor or weapon.
facts.detect: ability to polymorph
facts.action: Polymorph into a form that can't wear armor or wield weapons.

facts.fact: Priests can see the beatitude of all objects.
facts.detect: The bot's character class is Priest.
facts.action: Use this ability to identify the blessing status of items.

facts.fact: Items dropped on an altar will glow black if cursed and amber if blessed.
facts.detect: Dropping an item on an altar and observing the glow color.
facts.action: Use this method to test items for curse status.

facts.fact: A pet will 'move only reluctantly' over any stack or pile of objects that contains one or more cursed objects.
facts.detect: Observing pet's behavior when it approaches a pile of objects.
facts.action: Use pet to test for cursed items.

facts.fact: Reading a scroll of identify will reveal the BUC of any items identified.
facts.detect: Reading a scroll of identify.
facts.action: Use identify scroll to determine item status.

facts.fact: Dipping an item in a fountain has a 4/30 chance of uncursing it if cursed.
facts.detect: Dipping an item in a fountain and observing the result.
facts.action: Use fountain dipping to test items for curse status.

facts.fact: D represents a dragon in NetHack.
facts.detect: monster names like 'gray dragon', 'silver dragon', etc.
facts.action: Avoid or prepare for combat with high-level dragons, especially if you are not well-equipped.

facts.fact: d represents a dog or other canine in NetHack.
facts.detect: monster names like 'dog', 'wolf', 'hell hound', etc.
facts.action: Consider taming or using a magic whistle to summon a dog for help in combat or as a pet.

facts.fact: Press d to drop an item.
facts.detect: having an item in inventory that you want to discard.
facts.action: Use 'd' to drop items you no longer need to manage your inventory better.

facts.fact: Press shift+d to drop several items.
facts.detect: having multiple items of the same type in inventory that you want to discard.
facts.action: Use 'shift+d' to drop multiple items at once.

facts.fact: Press ctrl+d to kick something.
facts.detect: being in a situation where kicking an object might be useful, like a door or a boulder.
facts.action: Use 'ctrl+d' to kick objects when needed.

facts.fact: Dagger-type weapons may be automatically quivered if the hero uses the firing command without any projectiles or ammo quivered.
facts.detect: Using the firing command without projectiles or ammo quivered.
facts.action: Ensure to have projectiles or ammo quivered before using the firing command to avoid automatically quivering a dagger-type weapon.

facts.fact: Rangers throwing any projectile except for dagger-type weapons gain a +1 multishot bonus.
facts.detect: Hero is a Ranger and throwing a non-dagger-type weapon.
facts.action: Consider using non-dagger-type weapons for multishot bonus if playing as a Ranger.

facts.fact: Rogues throwing dagger-type weapons gain a +1 multishot bonus.
facts.detect: Hero is a Rogue and throwing a dagger-type weapon.
facts.action: Use dagger-type weapons for multishot bonus if playing as a Rogue.

facts.fact: A hero that wields a dagger-type weapon while eating a non-blessed tin will open the tin in 3 turns at most.
facts.detect: Wielding a dagger-type weapon and eating a non-blessed tin.
facts.action: Avoid wielding a dagger-type weapon while eating a non-blessed tin to prevent quick opening and potential bad effects.

facts.fact: Damage reduces the current hit points of the player or monster. If reduced to 0 or fewer HP, the player or monster dies.
facts.detect: Player or monster HP reaching 0 or fewer
facts.action: Avoid taking damage by using defensive tactics or healing when necessary

facts.fact: If the player is a monster (due to polymorph or lycanthropy) and is reduced to 0 or fewer HP, they revert to their original form unless wearing an amulet of unchanging, in which case they die.
facts.detect: Player HP reaching 0 or fewer while polymorphed or lycanthropic
facts.action: Avoid taking lethal damage while polymorphed or lycanthropic, or wear an amulet of unchanging

facts.fact: Physical damage can be increased by wearing a ring of increase damage and decreased by erosion of the weapon being used.
facts.detect: Wearing a ring of increase damage or noticing weapon erosion
facts.action: Equip a ring of increase damage or avoid using eroded weapons

facts.fact: Damage from some spells and effects can be reduced or eliminated by having the appropriate resistance, magic cancellation, or magic resistance, or by having the half physical damage or half spell damage extrinsic property.
facts.detect: Encountering a spell or effect that can be resisted
facts.action: Gain appropriate resistances or extrinsics to mitigate damage

facts.fact: Magic cancellation can block fire, cold, sleep, shock, poison, slow, paralysis, drain life, drain energy, sticking, teleport, lycanthropy, sliming, and disenchanting damage types.
facts.detect: The bot can notice these situations when encountering monsters or traps that use these damage types, such as fire ants, blue dragons, or green dragons.
facts.action: The bot should equip items that provide magic cancellation, such as a t-shirt or a robe of cancellation.

facts.fact: Cancellation blocks ordinary physical damage, magic missile, disintegration, digestion, drain intelligence, illness, the Riders' special damage types, and the Amulet-stealing damage type.
facts.detect: The bot can notice these situations when encountering monsters or traps that use these damage types, such as jackals, gray dragons, or mind flayers.
facts.action: The bot should avoid being cancelled by not wearing cursed items or by using a cancellation-resistant item like a cloak of magic resistance.

facts.fact: Fire damage may burn up scrolls, potions, spellbooks, and globs of green slime in the defender's inventory.
facts.detect: The bot can notice this situation when encountering fire-breathing monsters like red nagas or traps that emit fire.
facts.action: The bot should equip fire resistance or carry a large supply of blessed potions and scrolls.

facts.fact: Cold damage may freeze and shatter potions in the defender's inventory.
facts.detect: The bot can notice this situation when encountering cold-breathing monsters like winter wolves or traps that emit cold.
facts.action: The bot should equip cold resistance or carry a large supply of blessed potions.

facts.fact: Poison versus strength damage may lower strength and has a chance of causing instadeath.
facts.detect: The bot can notice this situation when encountering monsters like green dragons or soldier ants.
facts.action: The bot should equip poison resistance or carry antidotes.

facts.fact: Reading a cursed scroll of light or a scroll of light while confused will darken lit squares in a 5-square circular radius around the hero and extinguish any active light sources other than the wielded Sunsword.
facts.detect: Message: 'The light is snuffed out.' or 'The room is plunged into darkness.'
facts.action: Avoid reading scrolls of light or light-producing items while confused or when carrying a cursed scroll of light. If you must read a scroll of light, ensure you are not confused and do not have a cursed scroll.

facts.fact: Rooms can naturally generate as unlit during level creation, with the frequency of such rooms increasing as the hero delves deeper into the Dungeons of Doom.
facts.detect: Map feature: Unlit room upon entering a new level.
facts.action: Carry a light source (torch, wand of light, etc.) to light up unlit rooms.

facts.fact: Being deaf will prevent you from hearing things, with several sound-related messages no longer printing and others using an alternate message.
facts.detect: Status line showing 'Deaf'
facts.action: Use a unicorn horn to cure deafness as soon as possible.

facts.fact: You can end up deafened through the following methods: The monster-summoning effect of a magic trap.
facts.detect: Appearance of multiple monsters after stepping on a trap
facts.action: Avoid traps or disarm them before stepping on.

facts.fact: You can end up deafened through the following methods: Falling unconscious from lack of nutrition.
facts.detect: Message 'You are hungry.' or 'You are starving.'
facts.action: Eat food to avoid falling unconscious.

facts.fact: You can end up deafened through the following methods: Applying a leather drum.
facts.detect: Item 'leather drum'
facts.action: Avoid using a leather drum.

facts.fact: You can end up deafened through the following methods: In the Plane of Air, being caught inside a cloud during a storm will deafen you.
facts.detect: Message 'You are caught in a storm.'
facts.action: Avoid storms or find shelter.

facts.fact: A monster has a 1/6 chance of leaving a random item upon death, except for corpseless monsters or Keystone Kops.
facts.detect: Upon killing a monster, the absence of a corpse or the monster being a Keystone Kop.
facts.action: Expect a 1/6 chance of a death drop when killing a monster that is not corpseless or a Keystone Kop.

facts.fact: Small monsters can only leave food rations, leashes, figurines, or items that weigh at most three units.
facts.detect: Killing a small monster and checking if the death drop is within the specified item types.
facts.action: Be prepared for limited types of items from small monsters.

facts.fact: Certain monsters leave specific non-random body parts upon death.
facts.detect: Killing a dragon, unicorn, long worm, iron golem, glass golem, clay golem, stone golem, wood golem, leather golem, gold golem, paper golem, gray ooze, brown pudding, black pudding, or green slime.
facts.action: Expect specific items from these monsters upon death.

facts.fact: Cloned monsters and monsters occupying the player's square cannot leave death drops.
facts.detect: Killing a cloned monster or a monster that occupies the player's square.
facts.action: Do not expect a death drop from these monsters.

facts.fact: Monsters with death resistance are immune to the instant death effect of the touch of death monster spell, rays from a wand of death, and rays from the finger of death spell.
facts.detect: Encountering monsters with death resistance (nonliving, major demons, vampires in shapeshifter forms, or those with player-style magic resistance).
facts.action: Avoid using wands of death or casting finger of death on these monsters.

facts.fact: If a monster is nonliving, a major demon, a vampire in one of their shapeshifter forms, or has player-style magic resistance, they are unaffected by death rays and touch of death.
facts.detect: Encountering nonliving monsters, major demons, vampires in shapeshifter forms, or monsters with player-style magic resistance.
facts.action: Do not use death-related spells or wands on these monsters.

facts.fact: The hero resists death magic if they are polymorphed into a death-resistant monster.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a nonliving or major demon form.
facts.action: Use death-related spells or wands while polymorphed into a death-resistant form.

facts.fact: Magic resistance will block the effects of the touch of death and death rays, but not a death ray zapped directly at oneself.
facts.detect: Having magic resistance and using a wand of death or casting finger of death.
facts.action: Avoid using death-related spells or wands on oneself while having magic resistance.

facts.fact: The deathmatch opponent has the name, role, experience level, hit points, some intrinsic resistances, and inventory of a random previously-ascended character on the system.
facts.detect: A voice echoes in the arena: 'Thou art brave indeed, mortal! Now prove thy prowess!'
facts.action: Prepare for a tough fight with a high-level opponent.

facts.fact: The opponent will be generated asleep. There is no penalty for leaving the arena while the opponent is still asleep.
facts.detect: You feel on edge when entering the arena.
facts.action: Leave the arena if the opponent is still asleep to avoid a difficult fight.

facts.fact: The opponent will have a weapon with +5 to +7 enchantment and ranged weapons with +4 to +5 enchantment.
facts.detect: The opponent wields a weapon or uses ranged attacks.
facts.action: Be prepared for high-damage attacks and use defensive tactics.

facts.fact: The opponent will have several attack wands, including at least one wand of death.
facts.detect: The opponent uses a wand.
facts.action: Equip magic resistance or reflection to survive wand attacks.

facts.fact: The opponent's possessions will coalesce on the ground where they died, and only one can be picked up.
facts.detect: A voice echoes in the arena: 'Choose thy trophy from the spoils!'
facts.action: Carefully choose the most valuable item to pick up.

facts.fact: The 95_enh_engulf_prayers.dpatch patch makes being engulfed a major trouble, so that a successful prayer while engulfed will get you expelled and cause the engulfing monster to flee.
facts.detect: You hear a growl of divine fear! / You feel a strange distortion in your surroundings!
facts.action: Pray while engulfed to get expelled and make the engulfing monster flee.

facts.fact: The message 'You hear a growl of divine fear!' indicates that the engulfing monster is an animal and will flee after you are expelled.
facts.detect: You hear a growl of divine fear!
facts.action: Pray while engulfed to get expelled and make the engulfing monster flee.

facts.fact: The message 'You feel a strange distortion in your surroundings!' indicates that the engulfing monster is not an animal and will flee after you are expelled.
facts.detect: You feel a strange distortion in your surroundings!
facts.action: Pray while engulfed to get expelled and make the engulfing monster flee.

facts.fact: The message ' looks rather nauseated.' indicates that the engulfing animal monster has fled after you were expelled.
facts.detect: looks rather nauseated.
facts.action: Check surroundings for safety after being expelled from an animal monster.

facts.fact: The message ' looks rather shook up.' indicates that the engulfing non-animal monster has fled after you were expelled.
facts.detect: looks rather shook up.
facts.action: Check surroundings for safety after being expelled from a non-animal monster.

facts.fact: When a monster's level equals or exceeds the roll of a d50, it has a chance to receive a defensive item.
facts.detect: The bot should notice when a monster is generated with a defensive item, such as a scroll of teleportation, wand of teleportation, potion of healing, etc.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious around monsters that have a defensive item, especially if the item is a scroll of teleportation or wand of teleportation, as these can be dangerous.

facts.fact: Regular soldiers have a 12/13 chance of missing out on the defensive item roll.
facts.detect: The bot should notice that regular soldiers rarely have defensive items.
facts.action: The bot should not be overly cautious around regular soldiers, as they are unlikely to have defensive items.

facts.fact: Peaceful monsters will quaff a healing potion if they have hands, but not attempt to use any other defensive items.
facts.detect: The bot should notice when peaceful monsters are near and have hands.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious around peaceful monsters with hands, as they may use healing potions and become hostile if their HP is low.

facts.fact: Non-peaceful monsters that are not stuck or immobile will attempt to flee through stairs or traps if their HP is below a certain threshold.
facts.detect: The bot should notice when non-peaceful monsters are near and have low HP.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious around non-peaceful monsters with low HP, as they may attempt to flee and become more dangerous.

facts.fact: Mercenaries will use a bugle if there are more mercenaries within 3 squares that can be woken up.
facts.detect: The bot should notice when mercenaries are near and there are other mercenaries within 3 squares.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious around mercenaries, as they may use a bugle to summon more mercenaries.

facts.fact: Stoning can be cured by eating the tin or corpse of a lizard or any acidic monster, quaffing a potion of acid, casting stone to flesh on yourself, or polymorphing into a monster with stoning resistance.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel your bones turning to stone.' or 'You are hit by a footrice corpse.'
facts.action: Eat a lizard corpse or tin, quaff potion of acid, cast stone to flesh, or polymorph into a monster with stoning resistance.

facts.fact: Sliming can be cured by burning it away with any source of fire, wearing an amulet of unchanging, polymorphing into a green slime or a fiery monster, casting cure sickness, invoking the Staff of Aesculapius, or wearing an amulet of life saving.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel slimy.'
facts.action: Burn away with fire, wear amulet of unchanging, polymorph into a green slime or fiery monster, cast cure sickness, invoke Staff of Aesculapius, or wear amulet of life saving.

facts.fact: Sickness can be cured by applying a non-cursed unicorn horn, quaffing a potion of extra healing or full healing, quaffing holy water, casting cure sickness, eating a non-cursed eucalyptus leaf, invoking the Staff of Aesculapius, sitting on a throne, being healed by a nurse attack, or polymorphing into a monster with sickness resistance.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel sick.'
facts.action: Apply non-cursed unicorn horn, quaff potion of extra healing or full healing, quaff holy water, cast cure sickness, eat non-cursed eucalyptus leaf, invoke Staff of Aesculapius, sit on throne, be healed by nurse attack, or polymorph into a monster with sickness resistance.

facts.fact: Lava will kill you if you fall into it without fire resistance, or gradually kill you if you have fire resistance.
facts.detect: Message: 'You fall into lava.'
facts.action: Zap wand of cold downward, break wand of cold, or teleport.

facts.fact: Digestion from purple worms, trappers, and lurkers above can be prevented by wearing a ring of slow digestion or forcing your way out via knock, wand of opening, taming, or wand of digging.
facts.detect: Message: 'You are engulfed!'
facts.action: Wear ring of slow digestion, zap spell of knock or wand of opening, tame the monster, or zap wand of digging.

facts.fact: Shopkeepers will refer to the player as 'most gracious,' 'esteemed,' or 'most renowned and sacred' before 'sir' or 'lady' (or 'creature').
facts.detect: Shopkeepers' dialogue changes to include these phrases.
facts.action: No action required, as this is a cosmetic change.

facts.fact: Prayer timeout is increased by roughly a factor of three.
facts.detect: Player notices longer wait times between prayers.
facts.action: Manage prayer usage more conservatively.

facts.fact: Monster generation increases.
facts.detect: More monsters appear in the dungeon.
facts.action: Be more cautious and prepared for tougher fights.

facts.fact: The Wizard of Yendor will start harassing the player until they reach the Astral Plane.
facts.detect: Messages indicating the Wizard's harassment.
facts.action: Prioritize reaching the Astral Plane to stop harassment.

facts.fact: Demons are represented by the ampersand glyph (&).
facts.detect: Glyph on the map is &
facts.action: Be cautious as this glyph often indicates a powerful enemy.

facts.fact: The demon class includes major demons such as Balrog, Dispater, and Asmodeus.
facts.detect: Monster names like Balrog, Dispater, Asmodeus
facts.action: Avoid or prepare extensively before engaging these powerful enemies.

facts.fact: The demon class also includes non-demonic monsters like sandestin and djinni.
facts.detect: Monster names like sandestin, djinni
facts.action: Treat these as potentially dangerous foes, especially if they have special abilities.

facts.fact: Demons are designated internally by the macro S_DEMON.
facts.detect: Not directly detectable by the player
facts.action: Understand that any monster with the S_DEMON designation is part of this dangerous class.

facts.fact: The demon class contains a variety of powerful monsters, including demon lords and princes.
facts.detect: Monster names like Hezrou, Vrock, Marilith
facts.action: Approach with caution and prepare for a challenging fight.

facts.fact: Demons are typically created hostile and are primarily generated randomly in Hell.
facts.detect: Encountering a demon in the Hell levels or in graveyards.
facts.action: Avoid or prepare for combat with demons, especially in Hell or graveyards.

facts.fact: Praying to the gods while they are angry has a chance of generating a hostile demon adjacent to the hero.
facts.detect: Receiving a message indicating the gods are angry or a hostile demon appears nearby after praying.
facts.action: Avoid praying when the gods are angry to prevent hostile demon generation.

facts.fact: Quaffing from or dipping into a fountain has a 3% chance of generating a peaceful demon that grants a wish.
facts.detect: A peaceful demon appears after quaffing or dipping into a fountain.
facts.action: If a peaceful demon appears, make a wish for a useful item or spell.

facts.fact: Lawful demon princes are generated peaceful and will demand gold when they detect you.
facts.detect: A peaceful demon prince appears on the map and demands gold.
facts.action: Pay the bribe if possible to avoid combat.

facts.fact: Demon lords and princes warp to the stairs to flee and heal.
facts.detect: A demon lord or prince warps to the stairs.
facts.action: Follow the demon to its lair or intercept it before it reaches the stairs.

facts.fact: Wielding Excalibur or Demonbane causes lawful princes to be generated hostile.
facts.detect: Wielding Excalibur or Demonbane near a lawful demon prince.
facts.action: Avoid wielding these weapons near lawful demon princes.

facts.fact: Any level in Gehennom where a demon lord or prince is present is considered a non-teleport level.
facts.detect: A demon lord or prince is present on the level.
facts.action: Be cautious of teleportation hazards and avoid teleporting while on the same level as a demon lord or prince.

facts.fact: Lawful demon princes covet the Amulet of Yendor and will attack any monster carrying it.
facts.detect: A lawful demon prince appears with the Amulet of Yendor.
facts.action: Avoid carrying the Amulet of Yendor when lawful demon princes are present.

facts.fact: Destroy armor is a melee-range spell used by monsters of at least level 9 with mage spellcasting ability.
facts.detect: Encountering a monster with mage spellcasting ability, such as a lich or golden naga, and being within melee range.
facts.action: Maintain distance from such monsters to avoid the spell or ensure you have magic resistance.

facts.fact: The spell targets random worn armor, eroding or destroying it if it is not erodeproof.
facts.detect: Receiving messages such as 'Your cloak crumbles and turns to dust!', 'Your armor turns to dust and falls to the !', etc.
facts.action: Equip erodeproof armor or avoid engaging in melee combat with high-level spellcasting monsters.

facts.fact: Magic resistance fully protects against the destroy armor spell.
facts.detect: Having magic resistance and seeing the message 'A field of force surrounds you!'.
facts.action: Prioritize obtaining magic resistance before entering the mid-game.

facts.fact: If no armor is worn, the spell has no effect and the message 'Your skin itches.' is displayed.
facts.detect: Receiving the message 'Your skin itches.'
facts.action: Wear armor to protect against the spell.

facts.fact: The spell stops if it destroys a piece of armor, skipping the rest of the 'hits'.
facts.detect: Armor disintegrating message followed by no further damage.
facts.action: Ensure valuable armor is erodeproof or avoid high-level spellcasting monsters.

facts.fact: Devteam members are very powerful and can displace monsters as the Riders do.
facts.detect: Encountering a devteam member in the DevTeam Office or any other location.
facts.action: Avoid angering devteam members and do not attack them unless absolutely necessary.

facts.fact: Chatting to Mike Stephenson is required to initiate the DevTeam Quest and return the three scrolls of missing code.
facts.detect: Encountering Mike Stephenson in the DevTeam Office and receiving the quest message.
facts.action: Chat with Mike Stephenson to initiate the quest and receive hints about the scrolls.

facts.fact: Be very careful not to anger any of the devteam members: they are very powerful and can displace monsters as the Riders do. There is also no reward for killing any of them, as the game immediately ends if a devteam member dies by any means.
facts.detect: Observing a devteam member's aggressive behavior or receiving a hostile message.
facts.action: Avoid combat with devteam members and do not kill them.

facts.fact: Devteam members have sleep resistance, poison resistance and stoning resistance.
facts.detect: Observing a devteam member's resistance to sleep, poison, or stoning attacks.
facts.action: Use alternative attack methods or avoid combat with devteam members.

facts.fact: When you begin the DevTeam Quest, Mike Stephenson will give you a quest to find three scrolls of missing code.
facts.detect: Receiving the quest message from Mike Stephenson.
facts.action: Search for the scrolls of missing code and return them to Mike Stephenson to complete the quest.

facts.fact: Dexterity affects your chance of hitting monsters in melee combat, with a +1 to-hit bonus at 15 dexterity and increasing by 1 for each point above 15 up to +11 at 25 dexterity.
facts.detect: Checking the bot's dexterity score and comparing it to the table.
facts.action: The bot should aim to increase its dexterity to at least 15 to improve its combat effectiveness.

facts.fact: A pair of gauntlets of dexterity can increase or decrease your dexterity by the amount of its enchantment, up to a maximum of 25.
facts.detect: Finding gauntlets of dexterity in the inventory or on the ground.
facts.action: The bot should equip gauntlets of dexterity if they are found and have a positive enchantment.

facts.fact: Dexterity is exercised by successfully kicking monsters, uncovering secret doors and corridors, and kicking food out of trees.
facts.detect: The bot notices messages like 'You feel agile!' or 'You uncover a secret door.'
facts.action: The bot should kick monsters, uncover secret doors, and kick food out of trees to exercise dexterity.

facts.fact: Dexterity is abused by being satiated on a turn whose number is a multiple of 10, being strained or overtaxed, and having wounded legs.
facts.detect: The bot receives messages like 'You feel clumsy!' or 'You are strained.'
facts.action: The bot should avoid actions that lead to dexterity abuse, such as overeating or kicking when legs are wounded.

facts.fact: Dexterity is exercised by hitting monsters in melee combat and by reading a non-cursed scroll of enchant weapon while not wielding a weapon.
facts.detect: The bot notices messages like 'You feel agile!' after melee combat or reading a scroll of enchant weapon.
facts.action: The bot should engage in melee combat and read non-cursed scrolls of enchant weapon to exercise dexterity.

facts.fact: Most character types are omnivores, although monks are effectively herbivores, suffering an alignment penalty for eating non-vegetarian food.
facts.detect: Character type (Valkyrie) and food type (meat, vegetables, fruit, etc.)
facts.action: Eat a variety of foods unless playing as a monk, in which case avoid meat and prefer vegetables.

facts.fact: Being a carnivore or herbivore does not restrict your ability to eat, but does make the respective food types more delicious.
facts.detect: Food type (meat, vegetables, fruit, etc.)
facts.action: Eat preferred food types for better satisfaction and potentially better conduct tracking.

facts.fact: Pets must continually eat to stave off starvation. A pet is hungry when a stethoscope or #chatting indicates it, and starving when it is confused from hunger or you feel worried about it.
facts.detect: Pet's condition (stethoscope, #chatting, confused from hunger, worried)
facts.action: Feed pets regularly to prevent starvation and loss of hit points.

facts.fact: Carnivores prefer meats and herbivores prefer vegetable matter. Omnivores generally apply the more favorable grade out of both.
facts.detect: Pet's species (carnivore, herbivore, omnivore) and food type (meat, vegetables, fruit, etc.)
facts.action: Feed pets according to their dietary preferences for better taming and satisfaction.

facts.fact: Metallivores subsist on metals, including metallic weapons and armor, rings, amulets, and wands. They do not get hungry unless they also eat meat or vegetables.
facts.detect: Metallivore pet or polymorphed self
facts.action: Eat metal objects to gain intrinsics and avoid hunger, but be cautious with non-metallic food.

facts.fact: Digestion attacks by monsters like lurker above, trapper, and purple worm can lead to instadeath if not escaped from or countered.
facts.detect: Messages like 'digests you!', 'thoroughly digests you!', 'utterly digests you!', 'totally digests you!'
facts.action: Escape or kill the engulfing monster immediately. Use melee attacks, spells, or wands to ensure hits.

facts.fact: Wearing a ring of slow digestion prevents digestion damage and forces the monster to regurgitate the hero.
facts.detect: Wearing a ring of slow digestion
facts.action: Equip a ring of slow digestion to avoid digestion damage.

facts.fact: Zapping a wand of digging or casting the dig spell while inside an engulfing monster will force it to spit the hero out.
facts.detect: Using a wand of digging or casting dig spell
facts.action: Use a wand of digging or cast dig spell to escape.

facts.fact: Being polymorphed into a web-spinning monster or a huge monster form forces the engulfing monster to spit the hero out.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a web-spinning monster or a huge monster form
facts.action: Polymorph into a web-spinning monster or a huge monster form to escape.

facts.fact: If the hero is totally digested, they can be revived with an amulet of life saving or in explore/wizard mode.
facts.detect: Totally digested message
facts.action: Use an amulet of life saving or switch to explore/wizard mode to revive.

facts.fact: Non-diggable walls and floors prevent digging tools and magic from creating holes or pits.
facts.detect: Sokoban walls, Castle walls between maze sections, Valley of the Dead walls and floors, Wizard's Tower walls, level with vibrating square floors, Moloch's Sanctum walls and floors, Elemental Planes floors, Astral Plane walls and floors
facts.action: Avoid digging through non-diggable areas to prevent getting stuck or wasting time.

facts.fact: Digging downwards with a digging tool will eventually create a pit in the floor.
facts.detect: Digging downwards with a tool
facts.action: Be cautious when digging downwards to avoid falling into pits, especially in shops or near water.

facts.fact: Digging through shop doors and walls with a digging tool will anger the shopkeeper and incur a repair charge.
facts.detect: Messages like 'This seems too hard to dig.' or 'Shopkeeper demands 400 gold.'
facts.action: Avoid digging through shop walls and doors to prevent angering the shopkeeper and incurring repair charges.

facts.fact: Digging on the Plane of Earth can generate earth elementals and xorns, and has a chance of cave-ins.
facts.detect: Messages like 'The debris from your digging comes to life!' or 'Crash! The ceiling collapses around you!'
facts.action: Avoid digging on the Plane of Earth unless necessary, and be prepared for potential cave-ins or monster generation.

facts.fact: Digging speed varies based on dexterity, strength, dwarf status, tool enchantment, and ring of increase damage.
facts.detect: Time taken to dig through walls or floors
facts.action: Enhance digging speed by improving dexterity, strength, or using enchanted tools and rings of increase damage.

facts.fact: A dig for victory requires a digging instrument and a tonal musical instrument to open the castle drawbridge.
facts.detect: Player inventory and dungeon level features
facts.action: Collect a pick-axe and a tonal musical instrument (e.g., flute, horn) early in the game.

facts.fact: The dig for victory strategy involves digging down to the Castle level as quickly as possible.
facts.detect: Player location and dungeon level features
facts.action: Dig down through dungeon levels as quickly as possible, but be cautious of traps and monsters.

facts.fact: A wand of digging is highly desirable for escaping tough monsters and advancing through the dungeon.
facts.detect: Player inventory and dungeon level features
facts.action: Acquire a wand of digging to quickly dig through floors and escape dangerous situations.

facts.fact: Establishing a permanent Elbereth on the upstairs of the Castle level and near the drawbridge is highly recommended.
facts.detect: Player inventory and dungeon level features
facts.action: Use a wand of fire or lightning to engrave permanent Elbereth symbols near the drawbridge and upstairs.

facts.fact: Having a source of reflection or magic resistance greatly contributes to survival in the Castle.
facts.detect: Player inventory and dungeon level features
facts.action: Obtain magic resistance or reflection before attempting to reach the Castle.

facts.fact: When performing alchemy, only 2–9 of the dipped potions (determined randomly) will actually be affected.
facts.detect: Alchemy attempt message
facts.action: Ensure you have enough potions to account for the random effect rate when performing alchemy.

facts.fact: Dipping a scroll into water blanks it. It retains its BUC status.
facts.detect: Scroll and water message: 'That scroll is now blank.'
facts.action: Use this method to safely blank scrolls without risking BUC status.

facts.fact: Dipping a long sword into a fountain as a lawful character at experience level 5 or higher is a common way of receiving Excalibur.
facts.detect: Fountain and long sword message: 'You feel a strange sensation...'
facts.action: Dip a long sword into a fountain when you are lawful, have a long sword, and are at experience level 5 or higher.

facts.fact: Dipping an object into a potion of unholy water will make a blessed object uncursed, and will curse an uncursed object.
facts.detect: Potion of unholy water message: 'The object is now cursed.'
facts.action: Use potion of unholy water to curse uncursed objects or to make blessed objects uncursed.

facts.fact: Dipping a unicorn horn into a potion of sickness will turn it into a potion of fruit juice.
facts.detect: Unicorn horn and potion of sickness message: 'The potion turns into fruit juice.'
facts.action: Dip a unicorn horn into a potion of sickness to turn it into a potion of fruit juice.

facts.fact: Disappear is a non-directed spell that can be used by any monster of at least level 5 with the ability to cast mage spells.
facts.detect: Encountering a monster of level 5 or higher that can cast spells.
facts.action: Be cautious and prepare for the possibility of the monster becoming invisible.

facts.fact: The spell grants the caster permanent invisibility, marked by a white 'I' on the map if the hero saw them cast it.
facts.detect: A white 'I' on the map.
facts.action: Immediately prepare to track the invisible monster.

facts.fact: A monster will only cast the spell if they are not already invisible and/or wearing a mummy wrapping that would block the spell.
facts.detect: A monster casting the spell and becoming invisible.
facts.action: Avoid getting too close to monsters that are not already invisible and do not have a mummy wrapping.

facts.fact: Tame and peaceful monsters will only cast the spell if the hero currently has the see invisible property.
facts.detect: A tame or peaceful monster casting the spell.
facts.action: Ensure you have the see invisible property if dealing with tame or peaceful spellcasters.

facts.fact: Messages indicating a monster has cast the spell: 'suddenly disappears!' or 'suddenly turns transparent!'
facts.detect: Messages 'suddenly disappears!' or 'suddenly turns transparent!'
facts.action: Immediately check surroundings and prepare to track the invisible monster.

facts.fact: Starting equipment is fully identified.
facts.detect: The bot starts with certain items.
facts.action: No action needed, as the bot already knows the properties of starting equipment.

facts.fact: Racial armor and weapons are fully identified for non-human characters.
facts.detect: The bot is a non-human character (dwarvish Valkyrie).
facts.action: No action needed, as the bot already knows the properties of racial armor and weapons.

facts.fact: Mundane weapons and armor are fully identified for certain roles.
facts.detect: The bot is a Valkyrie.
facts.action: No action needed, as Valkyries know mundane weapons and armor.

facts.fact: Knowledge of one type of water potion grants knowledge of all water potions.
facts.detect: The bot encounters a potion of unholy water, potion of water, or potion of holy water.
facts.action: No action needed, as identifying one type of water potion automatically identifies the others.

facts.fact: Healers start off knowing the potion of full healing.
facts.detect: The bot is a Healer (though the bot is a Valkyrie, this fact is listed for completeness).
facts.action: No action needed, as this does not apply to the bot.

facts.fact: A hero hit by a disenchanter loses a point of enchantment from a worn chargeable ring or outermost worn piece of armor.
facts.detect: Disenchanter attack message
facts.action: Carry non-enchanted side weapons and projectiles to avoid losing enchantment on vital equipment.

facts.fact: Active disenchanting attacks can be blocked by magic cancellation.
facts.detect: Magic cancellation effect
facts.action: Wear a magic cancellation item when facing a disenchanter.

facts.fact: Artifacts have a 9/10 chance of resisting disenchantment.
facts.detect: Artifact item name
facts.action: Use artifacts as primary equipment when facing disenchanters.

facts.fact: Passive disenchantment attacks can drain a point of enchantment from the attacker's weapon, gloves, or boots.
facts.detect: Disenchanter attack message
facts.action: Avoid using enchanted weapons, gloves, or boots when attacking disenchanters.

facts.fact: Preemptive genocide of disenchanters is a common strategy.
facts.detect: Disenchanter monster name
facts.action: Genocide disenchanters to avoid the risk of disenchantment.

facts.fact: The black dragon's breath weapon and the Chromatic Dragon's random breath can cause disintegration.
facts.detect: Black dragon or Chromatic Dragon in the vicinity
facts.action: Avoid or prepare to reflect disintegration breath

facts.fact: A sufficiently angry god can smite the hero with a wide-angle disintegration beam.
facts.detect: Message 'A wide-angle disintegration beam hits you!'
facts.action: Gain disintegration resistance or reflection

facts.fact: The beholder has a gaze attack that can disintegrate targets.
facts.detect: Beholder in the vicinity
facts.action: Avoid beholder gaze or gain disintegration resistance

facts.fact: Disintegration destroys worn shield, body armor, and cloak in order of priority.
facts.detect: Wearing a shield, body armor, or cloak
facts.action: Gain disintegration resistance or reflection

facts.fact: A wide-angle disintegration beam cannot be blocked by reflection but can be resisted.
facts.detect: Message 'A wide-angle disintegration beam hits you!'
facts.action: Gain disintegration resistance

facts.fact: A hero with disintegration resistance is completely immune to the breath weapon of a black dragon and the wide-angle disintegration beam of an angry god.
facts.detect: Messages like 'A wide-angle disintegration beam aimed at you hits !' or 'You bask in its glow for a minute...'
facts.action: Seek disintegration resistance through eating a black dragon corpse or wearing black dragon scales/scale mail.

facts.fact: Disintegration resistance protects worn items such as shield, cloak, body armor, and shirt from disintegration rays.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You feel very firm.' after eating a black dragon corpse.
facts.action: Ensure you have disintegration resistance before wearing valuable items.

facts.fact: Disintegration resistance can be gained by eating the corpse or tin of a black dragon or the Chromatic Dragon.
facts.detect: Finding a black dragon corpse or tin in the dungeon.
facts.action: Eat the corpse or tin to gain disintegration resistance.

facts.fact: Disintegration resistance can also be obtained by wearing black dragon scales or black dragon scale mail.
facts.detect: Finding black dragon scales or scale mail in the dungeon.
facts.action: Wear black dragon scales or scale mail to gain extrinsic disintegration resistance.

facts.fact: Certain monsters, such as black dragons and energy vortices, have disintegration resistance.
facts.detect: Encountering a black dragon or energy vortex.
facts.action: Be cautious when fighting these monsters as they can survive disintegration attacks.

facts.fact: Disintegrators have an attack that disintegrates a random worn or wielded piece of equipment with a 5% chance of resistance for ordinary items (50% for artifacts).
facts.detect: Disintegrator attack message
facts.action: Avoid wearing or wielding non-artifact items, especially important ones like your main weapon. Equip artifact items for higher resistance.

facts.fact: Disintegrators can disintegrate objects they are hit with, including gloves if fighting without a wielded object.
facts.detect: Disintegrator attack message
facts.action: Wear gloves and wield a weapon when fighting disintegrators.

facts.fact: Touching a disintegrator causes instant death.
facts.detect: Touching a disintegrator
facts.action: Avoid touching disintegrators, do not try to help them out of pits or saddle them.

facts.fact: Disintegrators have disintegration resistance and petrification resistance.
facts.detect: Disintegrator attributes
facts.action: Use disintegration resistance or petrification resistance to survive disintegrator attacks.

facts.fact: Disintegrators do not leave corpses.
facts.detect: Disintegrator death message
facts.action: Do not attempt to tin disintegrators.

facts.fact: A cloak of displacement causes your image to appear a tile or two away from where you actually are, which can misdirect the attacks of hostile monsters.
facts.detect: You feel that monsters have difficulty pinpointing your location.
facts.action: Wear the cloak of displacement to misdirect monsters and avoid attacks.

facts.fact: A particular hostile monster will perceive a character with displacement as occupying a random square within a 5x5 area centered on them.
facts.detect: A monster attacks a spot where they believed you to be as a result of displacement.
facts.action: Move to confuse the monster's perception and avoid prolonged combat.

facts.fact: A monster that does not know the location of a character with displacement has a 1/4 chance of discovering it during each of its turns.
facts.detect: Your displaced image doesn't fool !
facts.action: Move to regain the benefit of displacement.

facts.fact: If a lawful demon prince teleports to demand a bribe from a character with displacement, they may warp next to their displaced image - this will cause them to become hostile without a chance of being pacified.
facts.detect: The invisible whispers at thin air.
facts.action: Avoid lawful demon princes or be prepared to fight them.

facts.fact: Displacement is invaluable when running from a fight that the character are ill-equipped for, especially in the early game.
facts.detect: You feel that monsters have difficulty pinpointing your location.
facts.action: Use the cloak of displacement to escape from dangerous situations.

facts.fact: Gremlins, brown molds, and blue jellies can divide into two with half the HP and maximum HP of the original from any source of water and the latter two from inflicting damage with their passive cold attacks.
facts.detect: Encountering gremlins, brown molds, or blue jellies and noticing water or cold damage.
facts.action: Avoid using water or cold attacks on these monsters to prevent division.

facts.fact: Brown and black puddings will divide into two with half the current HP but the same maximum HP as the original monster when hit with any iron item.
facts.detect: Encountering brown or black puddings and using an iron item.
facts.action: Avoid using iron items on puddings to prevent division.

facts.fact: Long worms can have part of their tail cut off, sometimes resulting in a new worm as the old tail.
facts.detect: Encountering a long worm and attempting to cut its tail.
facts.action: Avoid cutting the tail of a long worm to prevent division.

facts.fact: The Wizard of Yendor can cast Double Trouble, creating a copy of himself at full HP, provided no copy already exists.
facts.detect: Encountering the Wizard of Yendor and noticing the spell Double Trouble being cast.
facts.action: Avoid engaging the Wizard of Yendor until you are confident you can defeat both him and his copy.

page: Do not pass go. Do not collect 200 zorkmids.

facts.fact: A Knight attempting to #ride their pony can die on the first turn if they fall off and take enough damage.
facts.detect: Attempting to ride a pony and receiving a message indicating failure or falling off.
facts.action: Avoid riding the pony until it is sufficiently tame and you have enough hit points.

facts.fact: Zapping an offensive wand that produces a ray (e.g., fire, cold, magic missile) can kill the player if the ray bounces back.
facts.detect: Zapping a wand and receiving a message indicating the ray has bounced back.
facts.action: Avoid aiming wands at walls unless you can resist the damage or have a means of reflection.

facts.fact: Autopickup of unidentified objects that can kill you (e.g., cursed wands) can trigger death on the first turn.
facts.detect: Picking up an unidentified object and immediately dying.
facts.action: Disable autopickup for unidentified objects or avoid picking up unidentified objects.

facts.fact: Wizards can intentionally die on the first turn by using scrolls of genocide, fire, or earth.
facts.detect: Reading a scroll and receiving a message indicating death.
facts.action: Avoid reading scrolls until you are certain of their effects.

facts.fact: Overflowing the turn counter to turn 1 and then dying can trigger the message.
facts.detect: The game running for an extremely long time and then ending on turn 1.
facts.action: Avoid actions that could potentially overflow the turn counter.

facts.fact: A domestic animal can be tamed by throwing a treat, a suitable corpse, or certain other food items.
