facts.detect: Encounter with a kitten, housecat, large cat, little dog, dog, large dog, pony, horse, or warhorse
facts.action: Throw a tripe ration, meat item, safe non-vegan corpse, food ration, candy bar, pancake, lump of royal jelly, fortune cookie, apple, banana, orange, pear, slime mold, carrot, clove of garlic, kelp frond, eucalyptus leaf, sprig of wolfsbane, or lichen corpse to tame the animal.

facts.fact: At night during a full moon, dogs are more likely to resist taming.
facts.detect: Nighttime with a full moon and encountering a dog
facts.action: Avoid taming dogs during a full moon at night or use alternative methods to pacify them.

facts.fact: A tame domestic animal starts with a tameness of 10; any other tame monster starts with a tameness of 5.
facts.detect: Taming a domestic animal
facts.action: Recognize that the tameness level is higher for domestic animals, which can make them more loyal and less likely to attack.

facts.fact: A domestic animal which can be saddled (i.e., a horse) has a 100% chance of being equipped with a saddle when it is generated.
facts.detect: Encounter with a pony, horse, or warhorse
facts.action: Check if the horse is saddled and use it for transportation if needed.

facts.fact: Eating the corpse of certain domestic animals (cats and dogs) confers the aggravate monster intrinsic, unless the character is a Caveman or an Orc.
facts.detect: Eating a cat or dog corpse
facts.action: Avoid eating cat or dog corpses unless the character is a Caveman or an Orc to prevent the aggravate monster intrinsic.

facts.fact: Kicking down a door makes noise and destroys the door.
facts.detect: You kick a closed door and receive messages like 'As you kick the door, it shatters to pieces!' or 'WHAMMM!!!'.
facts.action: Avoid kicking down doors unless necessary, especially in Minetown or near shops.

facts.fact: Locked doors can be opened with a skeleton key, lock pick, credit card, or by using a wand of opening or casting the knock spell.
facts.detect: A closed door with a '+' symbol and the message 'This door is locked.' when attempting to open it.
facts.action: Unlock the door using a skeleton key, lock pick, or wand of opening before opening it.

facts.fact: Some walls are secret doors that can be discovered by searching, brute force, or magic.
facts.detect: A wall that looks like a normal wall but can be searched or detected with a wand of secret door detection.
facts.action: Search or use magic to reveal secret doors.

facts.fact: At level 5 and below, about 3% of non-shop doors are booby-trapped.
facts.detect: Attempting to open a closed door and receiving the message 'You find a trap on the door!'.
facts.action: Attempt to disarm the trap before opening the door.

facts.fact: Monsters can unlock locked doors if they are larger than tiny, have hands, and have a key.
facts.detect: A monster with hands and a key approaches a locked door.
facts.action: Dispose of keys or prevent monsters from unlocking doors.

facts.fact: The shop door reappears after being damaged.
facts.detect: The shop door reappears!
facts.action: Avoid damaging shop doors to prevent attracting shopkeepers' attention.

facts.fact: Shopkeepers may block your way when you attempt to enter or leave their shop.
facts.detect: blocks your way!
facts.action: Be cautious when entering or leaving shops to avoid confrontation with shopkeepers.

facts.fact: Damaging a shop door will upset the shopkeeper.
facts.detect: How dare you (damage/dig into) my door?
facts.action: Avoid damaging shop doors to prevent angering shopkeepers.

facts.fact: You feel more claustrophobic when a shop door is damaged.
facts.detect: You feel more claustrophobic than before.
facts.action: Avoid damaging shop doors to prevent feeling more claustrophobic.

facts.fact: Attempting to pick up a door will not work.
facts.detect: It won't come off the hinges
facts.action: Do not attempt to pick up doors.

facts.fact: The Doppelganger quest involves fighting Transmuter for The Medallion of Shifters.
facts.detect: Transmuter, Medallion of Shifters
facts.action: Seek out and defeat Transmuter to obtain the Medallion of Shifters.

facts.fact: Random monsters on the quest branch include 55% chameleons, 14% guardian nagas, and 14% random white monsters.
facts.detect: chameleon, guardian naga, white monster
facts.action: Be cautious of chameleons and guardian nagas, as they are common and dangerous.

facts.fact: The entire Circle of Change level is no-teleport and has undiggable walls and floor.
facts.detect: Circle of Change level
facts.action: Avoid teleportation and digging in the Circle of Change level.

facts.fact: The Transmuter's Cave contains fourteen chameleons, nine guardian nagas, and six random traps.
facts.detect: Transmuter's Cave
facts.action: Be prepared for a high number of chameleons and guardian nagas, and watch for traps.

facts.fact: The Transmuter's Lair contains the Bell of Opening and the Medallion of Shifters on an unaligned altar.
facts.detect: Bell of Opening, Medallion of Shifters, unaligned altar
facts.action: Retrieve the Bell of Opening and the Medallion of Shifters from the unaligned altar.

facts.fact: The Wizard of Yendor can cast Double Trouble at level 19 or higher.
facts.detect: Encounter with a high-level Wizard of Yendor
facts.action: Use the Staff of Aesculapius or Stormbringer to level drain the Wizard to level 18 or below to prevent Double Trouble.

facts.fact: The clone has a 50% chance of being created with a cheap plastic imitation of the Amulet of Yendor.
facts.detect: A clone appearing with an item that looks like the Amulet of Yendor but is not the real one.
facts.action: Be cautious and do not immediately attack the clone if it appears to have the Amulet.

facts.fact: The clone will temporarily take on the appearance of one of the listed monsters before its first move.
facts.detect: A human, water demon, vampire, red dragon, troll, umber hulk, xorn, xan, cockatrice, floating eye, guardian naga, or trapper appearing in the vicinity of the Wizard of Yendor.
facts.action: Attack or move towards the disguised clone to reveal its true form.

facts.fact: The clone's shifted appearance functions similarly to the cloaking of a mimic.
facts.detect: A mimic-like behavior from a disguised clone.
facts.action: Attack or move towards the disguised clone to reveal its true form.

facts.fact: Double damage doubles the weapon's base damage and enchantment damage bonus, but not situation bonuses like blessed weapon against undead, axe against wooden monsters, silver against silver haters, light against light haters, or bonuses from rings of increase damage, weapon skill, Strength, poisoned weapon, or jousting.
facts.detect: The bot should notice when it has an artifact weapon with double damage property, which can be seen in the weapon's description.
facts.action: The bot should prioritize using double damage weapons against broad groups of monsters or specific types of monsters as indicated by the weapon's description.

facts.fact: Double damage does not double the erosion penalty, but fixing erosion on a double damage weapon yields higher returns compared to standard weapons.
facts.detect: The bot should check for erosion on its double damage weapons and notice the weapon's description indicating double damage.
facts.action: The bot should fix erosion on double damage weapons to maximize damage output.

facts.fact: Double damage does not double the backstab damage bonus.
facts.detect: The bot should notice when it is backstabbing a monster.
facts.action: The bot should still use double damage weapons for backstabbing, but it should be aware that the backstab bonus is not doubled.

facts.fact: Double damage does not double the bonuses from rings of increase damage, weapon skill, Strength, poisoned weapon, or jousting.
facts.detect: The bot should notice when it is using a weapon with these bonuses.
facts.action: The bot should use double damage weapons in conjunction with these bonuses, but it should be aware that these bonuses are not doubled.

facts.fact: Double damage applies after the base damage and enchantment bonus are calculated, but before situation bonuses and other special damages.
facts.detect: The bot should notice when it is hitting a monster with a double damage weapon.
facts.action: The bot should be aware of the sequence of damage calculations to optimize its combat strategy.

facts.fact: Adult dragons have an AC of -1 and MR of 20, and their breath attacks can be dangerous.
facts.detect: Breath weapon attack message (e.g., 'The red dragon breathes fire!')
facts.action: Equip reflection or magic resistance before engaging adult dragons.

facts.fact: Adult dragons have a +2 to-hit bonus when attacked with weapons that use the spear skill.
facts.detect: Weapon skill message (e.g., 'You are using a spear.')
facts.action: Use a spear or other spear skill weapon to attack adult dragons.

facts.fact: Adult dragons have a 1/3 chance of dropping a set of uncursed +0 scales upon death.
facts.detect: Corpse message (e.g., 'You get a set of red dragon scales.')
facts.action: Loot the corpse for scales to forge into armor.

facts.fact: Eating an adult dragon corpse often grants intrinsic resistance to the appropriate element.
facts.detect: Corpse message (e.g., 'You feel invulnerable to fire.')
facts.action: Eat the corpse to gain intrinsic resistance.

facts.fact: Dragonbane has +1d5 to-hit and double damage versus all dragons.
facts.detect: Weapon name (e.g., 'dragonbane')
facts.action: Use dragonbane to attack dragons.

facts.fact: A dragon has a single attack and a fire breath weapon.
facts.detect: monster symbol D
facts.action: Avoid melee combat and stay out of breath weapon range (8 squares).

facts.fact: A dragon corpse is poisonous to eat, and eating its corpse always grants fire resistance.
facts.detect: dragon corpse
facts.action: Eat dragon corpse if you have poison resistance and need fire resistance.

facts.fact: Black dragon breath causes instadeath.
facts.detect: black dragon symbol D
facts.action: Avoid black dragons entirely or genocide them if possible.

facts.fact: Dragons are among the monsters that can be generated in throne rooms.
facts.detect: throneroom
facts.action: Be cautious when entering throne rooms.

facts.fact: Red dragons are the only guaranteed source of fire resistance.
facts.detect: red dragon symbol D
facts.action: Prioritize killing a red dragon if you need fire resistance.

facts.fact: Dragon scale mail (DSM) provides 9 base AC, the most of any single piece of body armor.
facts.detect: Checking the armor's AC value.
facts.action: Wear dragon scale mail to maximize AC.

facts.fact: Different colors of dragon scale mail confer different extrinsic properties such as shock resistance, disintegration resistance, magic resistance, poison resistance, light source, hallucination resistance, sleep resistance, free action, fire resistance, infravision, reflection, cold resistance, acid resistance, and stoning resistance.
facts.detect: Checking the color of the dragon scale mail.
facts.action: Choose and wear the color of dragon scale mail that provides the most useful extrinsic properties for the current game situation.

facts.fact: Dragon scale mail can be created by reading a non-cursed scroll of enchant armor while wearing a set of dragon scales.
facts.detect: Finding dragon scales and a scroll of enchant armor.
facts.action: Use a scroll of enchant armor to create dragon scale mail from dragon scales.

facts.fact: Avoid polymorph traps and other sources of polymorph while wearing dragon scale mail that is not gray in color, especially if you lack a source of magic resistance.
facts.detect: Encountering polymorph traps or polymorph sources.
facts.action: Avoid polymorph traps or use a source of magic resistance while wearing non-gray dragon scale mail.

facts.fact: Gray and silver dragon scale mail are the most coveted varieties due to their magic resistance and reflection properties, respectively.
facts.detect: Checking the color of the dragon scale mail.
facts.action: Prioritize obtaining gray or silver dragon scale mail for magic resistance and reflection.

facts.fact: Adult dragons have a 1/3 chance of leaving behind dragon scales, while dragons revived by undead turning have a 1/20 chance.
facts.detect: Upon killing an adult dragon, the message 'You find some dragon scales.' or 'You find a pile of dragon scales.'
facts.action: Prioritize killing adult dragons to acquire dragon scales.

facts.fact: Dragon scales confer different extrinsic properties based on their color, such as shock resistance for blue scales and disintegration resistance for black scales.
facts.detect: Checking the properties of dragon scales when worn.
facts.action: Wear dragon scales of the color that provides the most beneficial extrinsic properties for the character's playstyle.

facts.fact: Scrolls of enchant armor can turn dragon scales into dragon scale mail, but scales enchanted above +3 may evaporate.
facts.detect: Reading a scroll of enchant armor while wearing dragon scales.
facts.action: Use scrolls of enchant armor to turn dragon scales into dragon scale mail, but be cautious with scales enchanted above +3.

facts.fact: Polymorphing while wearing dragon scales will turn the character into that color of dragon, destroying other body armor.
facts.detect: Polymorphing while wearing dragon scales.
facts.action: Avoid polymorphing while wearing dragon scales to prevent character transformation.

facts.fact: Dragon scales can be acquired by generating adult dragons in throne rooms or quest branches, or by using scrolls of genocide.
facts.detect: Generating adult dragons or using scrolls of genocide.
facts.action: Use these methods to generate and kill adult dragons to acquire dragon scales.

facts.fact: Drain for gain was a bug that allowed increasing maximum hit points and power by losing experience levels and manipulating stats, but this bug was fixed in NetHack 3.6.0.
facts.detect: None, as this is a historical bug fix.
facts.action: Do not attempt to exploit this bug as it no longer works in NetHack 3.6.0.

facts.fact: At the beginning of the game, characters usually start with lower stats, allowing them to reach and exceed the maximum HP and power potential for average characters of the same level through this strategy.
facts.detect: None, as this is a general observation.
facts.action: Focus on other strategies for gaining HP and power, as the specific drain for gain strategy is no longer effective.

facts.fact: You can buy a lot more protection more cheaply by draining to XL1, allowing you to buy protection for only 400 gold.
facts.detect: Message when buying protection from a shop.
facts.action: Drain to XL1 and buy protection cheaply.

facts.fact: If you drain your own level through a level-draining monster, you need to take caution not to die by over-draining yourself below XL1.
facts.detect: Messages like 'Goodbye level *', 'Sayonara level *', etc.
facts.action: Use MSGTYPE to stop at each level drain and ensure you do not over-drain.

facts.fact: Having MC3 makes the risk of dying to monster's level drain attack almost negligible.
facts.detect: Message when a monster drains your level.
facts.action: Ensure you have MC3 or level drain resistance before attempting to drain levels.

facts.fact: Drain life attack has a 1/3 chance of taking effect if it hits and passes through magic cancellation.
facts.detect: Message 'Goodbye level', 'Fare thee well level', 'Sayonara level', 'Aloha level', 'Farvel level'
facts.action: Equip magic cancellation items or artifacts to reduce the chance of level drain.

facts.fact: Drain life reduces the character's experience level by 1, killing them if their level reaches 0.
facts.detect: Message 'Goodbye level', 'Fare thee well level', 'Sayonara level', 'Aloha level', 'Farvel level'
facts.action: Carry potions of restore ability to regain lost levels.

facts.fact: Vampires, wraiths, and Demogorgon have the drain life attack.
facts.detect: Monster names 'vampire', 'wraith', 'Demogorgon'
facts.action: Avoid or prepare for encounters with these monsters.

facts.fact: Foocubi have a drain life attack if the system configuration option SEDUCE is not set.
facts.detect: Monster name 'foocubi' and lack of seduction attack
facts.action: Treat foocubi encounters with caution and prepare for level drain.

facts.fact: Drain resistance prevents the attack from taking effect.
facts.detect: Equipped drain resistance artifacts or items
facts.action: Equip drain resistance artifacts or items to prevent level drain.

facts.fact: Drain resistance blocks the drain life attack of vampires, wraiths, and Demogorgon.
facts.detect: Encountering a vampire, wraith, or Demogorgon
facts.action: Seek out or wield a source of drain resistance before facing these monsters

facts.fact: Drain resistance blocks the drain life ability of The Staff of Aesculapius and Stormbringer.
facts.detect: Picking up or wielding The Staff of Aesculapius or Stormbringer
facts.action: Wield a source of drain resistance before using these items

facts.fact: Drain resistance prevents level loss from being seduced by a succubus foocubus with the SEDUCE compile-time option enabled.
facts.detect: Encountering a succubus foocubus
facts.action: Gain drain resistance before engaging with a succubus foocubus

facts.fact: Drain resistance can be acquired extrinsically by wielding Stormbringer, Excalibur, or the Staff of Aesculapius.
facts.detect: Wielding Stormbringer, Excalibur, or the Staff of Aesculapius
facts.action: Wield one of these items to gain extrinsic drain resistance

facts.fact: Drain resistance is intrinsic to all major demons, undead monsters, lycanthropes in either form, and Death.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a major demon, undead monster, or lycanthrope
facts.action: Polymorph into a monster with intrinsic drain resistance if necessary

facts.fact: Drain strength is a melee-range spell used by monsters that cast mage spells and are at least level 7.
facts.detect: Engaging in melee combat with a spellcasting monster at level 7 or higher.
facts.action: Avoid melee combat with such monsters until obtaining magic resistance.

facts.fact: The hero loses strength equal to 1d(ML - 6), where ML is the caster's level, with a minimum of 3 strength.
facts.detect: Receiving the message 'You suddenly feel weaker!' or 'You feel momentarily weakened.'
facts.action: Immediately seek magic resistance or sustain ability to prevent further damage.

facts.fact: Magic resistance completely nullifies the spell's effects.
facts.detect: Having magic resistance equipped or intrinsic.
facts.action: Equip or obtain magic resistance before engaging in melee with spellcasting monsters.

facts.fact: Sustain ability stops actual strength loss from occurring, but does not prevent HP damage if strength would drop below 3.
facts.detect: Having sustain ability equipped or intrinsic.
facts.action: Use sustain ability to prevent strength loss, but be prepared for HP damage if strength is critically low.

facts.fact: Any maximum HP loss from drain strength cannot be reversed with unicorn horns or potions of restore ability.
facts.detect: HP loss after being affected by drain strength.
facts.action: Avoid situations where drain strength can be cast to prevent permanent HP loss.

facts.fact: A closed drawbridge is represented by {{brown|#}}, and an open one is represented by {{brown|.}}.
facts.detect: Map symbols # or .
facts.action: Identify drawbridge status to avoid danger.

facts.fact: If a drawbridge is hit by a force bolt, it is destroyed, and any non-phasing monster in the affected squares is very likely to die.
facts.detect: Force bolt effect on drawbridge.
facts.action: Avoid using force bolts near drawbridges.

facts.fact: Once destroyed, a drawbridge can never be recreated.
facts.detect: Destroyed drawbridge (no longer exists).
facts.action: Do not rely on destroyed drawbridges for entry or exit.

facts.fact: The Castle drawbridge can be opened by playing the passtune on a musical instrument, which can be given by your god or deduced by playing musical mastermind.
facts.detect: Message indicating passtune received or deduced.
facts.action: Use passtune to open drawbridge safely.

facts.fact: Standing in a line with the drawbridge and the castle fountain may cause soldiers inside to zap you with wands of striking, destroying the drawbridge.
facts.detect: Soldiers in the castle courtyard.
facts.action: Stand a knight's move away from the drawbridge when using it.

facts.fact: It is not possible to drop a cursed loadstone or a cursed weapon or weapon-tool that you are wielding.
facts.detect: Attempting to drop a cursed loadstone or a cursed weapon while wielding it.
facts.action: Do not attempt to drop these items to avoid being unable to drop them.

facts.fact: It is not possible to drop any worn armor.
facts.detect: Attempting to drop worn armor.
facts.action: Do not attempt to drop worn armor.

facts.fact: While levitating, the item is dropped from a height; if the item is fragile, it may shatter.
facts.detect: Levitating and attempting to drop a fragile item.
facts.action: Avoid dropping fragile items while levitating.

facts.fact: While walking on water or lava, dropped items will sink.
facts.detect: Walking on water or lava and attempting to drop an item.
facts.action: Avoid dropping items while on water or lava.

facts.fact: Items dropped on a down staircase may fall down, as may other items on that square.
facts.detect: Dropping an item on a down staircase.
facts.action: Use this to your advantage to move heavy items to lower levels.

facts.fact: There are many secret passages in the drider caves.
facts.detect: scuffling sounds in the corridors, vague mumblings in the distance
facts.action: Explore areas with scuffling sounds and vague mumblings to find secret passages.

facts.fact: Eclavdra will occasionally utter maledictions.
facts.detect: Maledictions from Eclavdra
facts.action: Avoid direct confrontation with Eclavdra until prepared.

facts.fact: When killing the nemesis: Eclavdra falls to her knees, blood running down her forehead and into her eyes.
facts.detect: Eclavdra falling to her knees, blood running down her forehead
facts.action: Prepare for a final confrontation with Eclavdra.

facts.fact: When picking up your quest artifact: The Rod's tentacles wave languidly at you as you pick it up.
facts.detect: Picking up the Tentacle Rod
facts.action: Be cautious when picking up the Tentacle Rod.

facts.fact: When talking to Seyll Auzkovyn after getting the Amulet: 'You have it! You have recovered the Amulet of Yendor!'
facts.detect: Seyll Auzkovyn saying 'You have recovered the Amulet of Yendor!'
facts.action: Prepare to sacrifice the Amulet to Eilistraee.

facts.fact: Drowning occurs when submerged in water without breathlessness or amphibiousness.
facts.detect: Being in water without breathlessness or amphibiousness.
facts.action: Avoid water if not breathless or amphibious.

facts.fact: Stepping or falling into water with too much encumbrance can cause drowning.
facts.detect: Having too much encumbrance and stepping into water.
facts.action: Reduce encumbrance before entering water.

facts.fact: Falling into water with no adjacent, non-occupied land tile to escape to can cause drowning.
facts.detect: Falling into water with no escape route.
facts.action: Avoid falling into water without an escape route.

facts.fact: Being pulled under water by a monster's drowning attack can cause drowning.
facts.detect: Monster with drowning attack.
facts.action: Avoid or kill monsters with drowning attacks.

facts.fact: Teleporting can save you from drowning if you have sufficient energy and teleport control.
facts.detect: Being in water and having teleport control.
facts.action: Teleport to safety if in danger of drowning.

facts.fact: Altars are represented by {{lightgray|_}} and are fixed on a single square.
facts.detect: Altar symbol '_', especially when it's a lawful altar for a Valkyrie.
facts.action: Approach the altar to pray for help if in trouble, especially when hungry or low on health.

facts.fact: Fountains are represented by {{blue|{}} or {{blue|¶}} and are fixed on a single square.
facts.detect: Fountain symbol '{' or '¶'.
facts.action: Drink from the fountain to quench thirst and possibly gain intrinsic properties.

facts.fact: Doors are represented by {{brown|+}}, {{brown|-}}, or {{brown||}} and are fixed on a single square.
facts.detect: Door symbols '+', '-', or '|'.
facts.action: Open and pass through doors to explore new areas.

facts.fact: Drawbridges are represented by {{brown|#}} and are fixed on a single square.
facts.detect: Drawbridge symbol '#'.
facts.action: Operate the drawbridge to cross water or prevent monsters from crossing.

facts.fact: Water is represented by {{cyan|#}} and is fixed on a single square.
facts.detect: Water symbol '#'.
facts.action: Avoid walking into water unless wearing boots of walking on water or having intrinsic water walking.

facts.fact: In Sokoban, level difficulty increases as depth decreases.
facts.detect: Stairway to Sokoban on dungeon level 9
facts.action: Expect higher level difficulty as you go up in Sokoban.

facts.fact: If carrying the Amulet of Yendor, level difficulty is the depth of the deepest level reached.
facts.detect: Carrying the Amulet of Yendor
facts.action: Expect higher level difficulty everywhere after obtaining the Amulet.

facts.fact: Depth influences the number of gold pieces in random piles and vaults.
facts.detect: Dlvl: X
facts.action: Expect more gold on deeper levels.

facts.fact: Level difficulty influences the experience level of generated monsters.
facts.detect: Higher level difficulty
facts.action: Prepare for stronger monsters as level difficulty increases.

facts.fact: Level difficulty influences the number of traps in a room.
facts.detect: Higher level difficulty
facts.action: Expect more traps on deeper levels.

facts.fact: The entrance to the Gnomish Mines appears on levels 2-4.
facts.detect: entrance to Gnomish Mines
facts.action: Explore the Gnomish Mines for useful items and gold.

facts.fact: The Oracle level appears on levels 5-9. The entrance to Sokoban always appears on the level following the Oracle.
facts.detect: entrance to Sokoban
facts.action: Consult the Oracle and explore Sokoban for guaranteed gold and gems.

facts.fact: Medusa's Island appears 1 to 4 levels above the last level of the Dungeons of Doom.
facts.detect: Medusa's Island
facts.action: Avoid Medusa's Island or prepare to fight Medusa.

facts.fact: The Castle is the lowest level of the Dungeons of Doom, on level 25-29, and connects to Gehennom.
facts.detect: entrance to Gehennom
facts.action: Prepare for the transition to Gehennom by ensuring you have the necessary equipment and spells.

facts.fact: Random maze levels between Medusa's Island and the Castle have an 80% chance of generating as a maze.
facts.detect: maze level
facts.action: Be cautious and prepared for maze navigation and potential traps.

facts.fact: All dwarven monsters have the word 'dwarf' in their name.
facts.detect: monster name containing 'dwarf'
facts.action: Identify and avoid cannibalism or same-race sacrifice if the monster name contains 'dwarf'.

facts.fact: Dwarven player characters are more likely to have peaceful interactions with dwarf and gnome monsters.
facts.detect: Encounter with dwarf or gnome monsters
facts.action: Attempt to make peaceful interactions with dwarf and gnome monsters.

facts.fact: Eating a dwarf or gnome monster is considered cannibalism for a dwarven player character.
facts.detect: Eating a monster named 'dwarf' or 'gnome'
facts.action: Avoid eating any monster named 'dwarf' or 'gnome'.

facts.fact: Sacrificing a dwarf or gnome monster is considered a same-race sacrifice for a dwarven player character.
facts.detect: Sacrificing a monster named 'dwarf' or 'gnome'
facts.action: Avoid sacrificing any monster named 'dwarf' or 'gnome'.

facts.fact: Dwarves have intrinsic infravision.
facts.detect: In-game status message or inventory screen
facts.action: Use infravision to navigate dark areas and detect hidden objects.

facts.fact: Dwarves are the fastest-digging race when wielding a digging tool.
facts.detect: Digging speed comparison or digging tool usage
facts.action: Use digging tools efficiently to explore and find secret passages.

facts.fact: Gnomes and other dwarves generate as peaceful for a dwarven hero.
facts.detect: Peaceful monster designation in the game
facts.action: Engage peacefully with gnomes and other dwarves to avoid unnecessary combat.

facts.fact: Dwarves have the highest HP gains of all races.
facts.detect: Character level-up messages or health points display
facts.action: Focus on physical combat and take risks that other races might avoid due to lower HP.

facts.fact: Dwarves have the highest-quality spears, helms, and mithril-coats.
facts.detect: Item quality or material in the inventory
facts.action: Prioritize using dwarven-made weapons and armor for better combat performance.

facts.fact: The home level of the Dwarf quest is The Laketown.
facts.detect: You find yourself on the familiar bank of the Long Lake, with the buildings of Esgaroth visible nearby.
facts.action: Cross the water to enter the buildings of Esgaroth.

facts.fact: The nemesis of the Dwarf quest is Smaug.
facts.detect: When first encountering the quest nemesis: 'Well, , good of you to come..I haven't tasted Dwarf in a while. Chomped a few when I moved in, though.'
facts.action: Prepare for a fight against Smaug.

facts.fact: The quest artifact is The Arkenstone.
facts.detect: When picking up your quest artifact: 'The Arkenstone shines as you pick it up, it's white light red through your skin.'
facts.action: Retrieve the Arkenstone from Smaug's hoard.

facts.fact: The Great Hall of Thrain is the goal level.
facts.detect: When first entering the goal level: 'As you near the Great Hall of Thrain, the dragon-stench increases to almost unbearable levels.'
facts.action: Navigate to the Great Hall of Thrain to find Smaug.

facts.fact: The Lonely Mountain contains a boulder blocking the entrance to the walled-in area with the downstair.
facts.detect: The entrance to the walled-in area with the downstair is blocked by a boulder.
facts.action: Remove the boulder to access the downstair.

facts.fact: When you reach zero hit points, you die.
facts.detect: You die...
facts.action: Avoid reaching zero hit points by managing health and using healing items or spells.

facts.fact: An amulet of life saving will bring you back from almost all deaths at the cost of one point of constitution.
facts.detect: Wearing an amulet of life saving
facts.action: Use the amulet of life saving to resurrect after dying, but be aware of the constitution cost.

facts.fact: If you run out of hit points while polymorphed and not wearing an amulet of unchanging, you will return to your normal form.
facts.detect: Polymorphed state and not wearing an amulet of unchanging
facts.action: Avoid dying while polymorphed unless wearing an amulet of unchanging to prevent permanent death.

facts.fact: Death in NetHack is permanent; you only have one life.
facts.detect: No save files or resurrection methods available
facts.action: Be cautious and avoid unnecessary risks to prevent permanent death.

facts.fact: If playing in explore mode or wizard mode, you can choose whether or not to die.
facts.detect: Playing in explore mode or wizard mode
facts.action: Use explore mode or wizard mode to test strategies without risking permanent death.

facts.fact: E represents an elemental (stalker, air elemental, fire elemental, earth elemental, water elemental)
facts.detect: monster name (stalker, air elemental, fire elemental, earth elemental, water elemental)
facts.action: Identify and prepare for elemental encounters, possibly engraving Elbereth to avoid melee attacks

facts.fact: e represents an eye or sphere (gas spore, floating eye, freezing sphere, flaming sphere, shocking sphere)
facts.detect: monster name (gas spore, floating eye, freezing sphere, flaming sphere, shocking sphere)
facts.action: Be cautious around these dangerous monsters, especially if you are vulnerable to their effects

facts.fact: Press e to eat
facts.detect: low hunger status
facts.action: Eat when hungry to maintain health and energy

facts.fact: Press shift+e to engrave something on the ground
facts.detect: need to engrave Elbereth or other messages
facts.action: Engrave Elbereth or other messages to protect yourself from hostile monsters

facts.fact: Press alt+e to enhance your skills
facts.detect: need to improve skills
facts.action: Use this option to enhance your skills when appropriate

facts.fact: Several pit traps will occur within the hero's proximity, possibly including on their square.
facts.detect: Messages like 'The ground suddenly gives way!'
facts.action: Avoid standing in open areas and be cautious when moving around, especially near known traps.

facts.fact: Doors, altars, fountains, sinks, graves and thrones in the affected area will be destroyed.
facts.detect: Messages like 'The altar crumbles to dust.'
facts.action: Avoid standing near important items or features that might be destroyed.

facts.fact: All immobile monsters on the dungeon level will regain their mobility, and awaken all sleeping monsters on the level.
facts.detect: Messages like 'The monster awakens.'
facts.action: Be prepared for sudden monster activity and potential hostility from nearby monsters.

facts.fact: Monsters within a distance of 4*[(XL - 1) / 3 + 1]+1 to the hero that are awakened by the earthquake will become hostile.
facts.detect: Monsters becoming hostile and attacking the player.
facts.action: Avoid causing earthquakes if there are many monsters nearby or if the player is low on hit points and items.

facts.fact: Any peaceful monsters that are dropped into a pit due to the earthquake will also become hostile.
facts.detect: Messages like 'The peaceful monster falls into a pit.'
facts.action: Avoid causing earthquakes in areas with peaceful monsters.

facts.fact: The hero is always considered omnivorous, but adheres to a vegetarian diet if the Monk role is chosen and consumes non-vegetarian food, taking a -1 penalty to alignment record.
facts.detect: Role selection: Monk, consuming non-vegetarian food
facts.action: As a lawful Valkyrie, avoid the Monk role and ensure vegetarian food consumption if playing as Monk to maintain alignment.

facts.fact: Monsters with special diets, such as gelatinous cubes, can engulf and 'eat' most organic items.
facts.detect: Encountering a gelatinous cube
facts.action: Avoid or destroy gelatinous cubes to prevent them from engulfing and eating organic items.

facts.fact: Rust monsters are metallivores that eat items made of iron and other rust-prone metals.
facts.detect: Encountering a rust monster
facts.action: Avoid or destroy rust monsters to prevent them from eating metal items.

facts.fact: Pets will avoid corpses that are normally harmful to them and only eat certain types of food when they are otherwise about to starve.
facts.detect: Pet's behavior around harmful corpses or starvation
facts.action: Ensure pets have access to safe and appropriate food to prevent them from eating harmful corpses.

facts.fact: Digestion attacks enable the direct consumption of other monsters.
facts.detect: Encountering a monster with digestion attacks
facts.action: Avoid or prepare for monsters with digestion attacks to prevent being consumed.

facts.fact: Eating a ring has a 33% chance of conveying its powers to the eater, while eating an amulet only has a 20% chance of conveying its powers.
facts.detect: The bot should check the material of rings and amulets and the polymorphed form of the player to determine if they can eat them.
facts.action: The bot should polymorph into a metallivore (like a rock mole) to eat iron rings and amulets, and into a gelatinous cube to eat wooden rings.

facts.fact: Eating rings is the only source of intrinsic conflict, regeneration, voracious hunger, polymorphitis, polymorph control, protection from shape changers, increased damage or increased accuracy.
facts.detect: The bot should identify rings and amulets to know their effects.
facts.action: The bot should prioritize eating rings for these intrinsics if it needs them and has the means to polymorph.

facts.fact: Eating amulets is the only source of intrinsic magical breathing.
facts.detect: The bot should identify amulets to know their effects.
facts.action: The bot should eat amulets for magical breathing if it needs it and has the means to polymorph.

facts.fact: Most amulets are iron, so they are edible for metallivores: rock moles, rust monsters, and xorns.
facts.detect: The bot should polymorph into a metallivore to eat iron amulets.
facts.action: The bot should polymorph into a metallivore to eat iron amulets.

facts.fact: Eating rings and amulets may require eating many items to get the desired intrinsic.
facts.detect: The bot should keep track of the number of rings and amulets eaten and the intrinsics gained.
facts.action: The bot should continue eating rings and amulets until it gains the desired intrinsic.

facts.fact: A monster that respects Elbereth will not attack you in melee combat or cast a directed spell at you while you are on a square where the word 'Elbereth' is written.
facts.detect: The word 'Elbereth' is correctly engraved on the floor.
facts.action: Engrave 'Elbereth' on the floor to avoid melee attacks and directed spells from monsters.

facts.fact: Elbereth will not protect you from missile or spell attacks, nor anything else that allows a monster to inflict damage from a distance.
facts.detect: A monster is firing a missile or casting a spell.
facts.action: Move to a different square or use a scroll of scare monster to protect yourself from ranged attacks.

facts.fact: Elbereth stops working when it degrades into a different word.
facts.detect: The word 'Elbereth' on the floor is no longer visible or has changed.
facts.action: Re-engage in engraving 'Elbereth' to maintain protection.

facts.fact: No monster represented by '@' or 'A' will respect the word, nor will minotaurs, or the Riders.
facts.detect: A monster with '@' or 'A' symbol or a minotaur or Rider approaches.
facts.action: Do not rely on Elbereth for protection against these monsters.

facts.fact: A blinded monster that can ordinarily see will not respect Elbereth while it is blind.
facts.detect: A monster is blinded and approaches.
facts.action: Do not rely on Elbereth for protection against blinded monsters.

facts.fact: Elementals are strong, inedible, and neutral-aligned monsters.
facts.detect: Encounter with an elemental (air, earth, fire, water) or stalker
facts.action: Avoid combat if not prepared, especially against primary elementals due to their high MR and resistances.

facts.fact: Primary elementals (air, earth, fire, water) have 3 times the normal HP on their home planes.
facts.detect: Encounter with an elemental on its home plane (Plane of Air, Plane of Fire, Plane of Earth, Plane of Water)
facts.action: Avoid or prepare extensively for combat, as these elementals are significantly tougher.

facts.fact: Elementals deal doubled damage on their home planes.
facts.detect: Encounter with an elemental on its home plane
facts.action: Avoid or prepare extensively for combat, as damage dealt is significantly higher.

facts.fact: Elementals do not leave behind corpses upon death (minus the stalker).
facts.detect: Elemental dies in combat
facts.action: No action required, but note that no corpse or items will be left behind.

facts.fact: The Plane of Earth is entered by climbing the upstair on dungeon level 1 with the Amulet of Yendor in your possession.
facts.detect: Climbing upstair on dungeon level 1 with Amulet of Yendor
facts.action: Climb upstair with Amulet of Yendor to enter Plane of Earth

facts.fact: A cursed potion of gain level is a foolproof way to test if your Amulet is real.
facts.detect: Quaffing cursed potion of gain level while holding Amulet
facts.action: Quaff cursed potion of gain level to test Amulet authenticity

facts.fact: Once you enter the Planes successfully, it is impossible to return to any of the earlier dungeon branches.
facts.detect: Entering Plane of Earth
facts.action: Ensure all necessary items are obtained before entering Plane of Earth

facts.fact: Movement from one plane to the next requires finding a magic portal.
facts.detect: Finding magic portal on current plane
facts.action: Search for and use magic portal to move to next plane

facts.fact: It is impossible to move backwards to an earlier plane, or to move forward without the real Amulet of Yendor.
facts.detect: Attempting to move backwards or forward without Amulet
facts.action: Ensure possession of real Amulet of Yendor before moving planes

facts.fact: If you are an elven player, elf monsters are more likely to be peaceful.
facts.detect: Encountering an elf monster with no hostile reaction
facts.action: Approach and talk to elf monsters to gain benefits or information.

facts.fact: Eating an elf monster is considered cannibalism for an elven player.
facts.detect: Attempting to eat an elf corpse or monster
facts.action: Avoid eating elf corpses or monsters to prevent cannibalism.

facts.fact: Sacrificing an elf monster is considered a same-race sacrifice for an elven player.
facts.detect: Attempting to sacrifice an elf monster
facts.action: Avoid sacrificing elf monsters to prevent same-race sacrifice penalties.

facts.detect: Finding a corpse labeled as 'elf' in a grave or dropped by an elf mummy or zombie
facts.action: Avoid eating or using elf corpses to prevent cannibalism.

facts.fact: An elf monster may be created by reviving an elf corpse.
facts.detect: Reviving an elf corpse
facts.action: Revive elf corpses to potentially create peaceful elf monsters.

facts.fact: The home level of the Elf quest is The Great Circle of Earendil/Elwing, which is under siege by Uruk-hai and goblins.

facts.fact: The locate level is The Goblins' Cave, which contains Uruk-hai, goblins, ogres, and traps.
facts.detect: Descending into the Goblins' Cave and encountering Uruk-hai, goblins, and ogres.
facts.action: Navigate through the cave using secret passageways and avoid traps.

facts.fact: The goal level is The Castle of the Goblin King, where the Goblin King holds the Palantir of Westernesse.
facts.detect: Entering the Castle of the Goblin King and encountering the Goblin King.

facts.detect: Encountering Uruk-hai, goblins, and ogres throughout the quest levels.

facts.fact: The entire level is no-teleport, and has undiggable walls.
facts.detect: Attempting to teleport or dig and failing.

facts.action: Eat an elf-noble corpse or tin to gain sleep resistance if needed.

facts.fact: Elf-nobles can be generated with elven equipment, including bows, arrows, and daggers.
facts.detect: Encountering an elf-noble with a bow or a dagger.

facts.fact: Elf-nobles can grow up into elven monarchs if they have potions of gain level.

facts.fact: Elf-nobles can be generated by hostile monsters that cast the summon nasties spell.
facts.detect: Encountering a group of elf-nobles.

facts.fact: Elf-nobles are eligible for offensive, defensive, and miscellaneous items.
facts.detect: Elf-noble with a variety of items.

facts.fact: Valkyries have a +2 bonus to success when casting emergency spells.

facts.fact: Tourists have a -1 success penalty when casting emergency spells.

facts.fact: Rangers have a -2 success penalty when casting emergency spells.
facts.detect: The bot's role is not a Ranger.

facts.fact: Empty bottles are made of glass, weigh 2 aum and have a base price of 0 zorkmids.

facts.fact: When used in melee, a wielded empty bottle deals 1d2 damage to small and 1d4 damage to large.

facts.fact: Wishing for a 'bottle' or 'flask' both yield an empty bottle.

facts.fact: Overloaded: cannot move.

facts.fact: Quaffing a non-cursed potion of gain energy increases your current and maximum energy.
facts.detect: Potion of gain energy

facts.fact: Reading any scroll of charging while confused recharges your energy to its maximum.
facts.detect: Scroll of charging and being confused
facts.action: Read scroll of charging while confused to recharge energy.

facts.fact: Eating a newt corpse sometimes increases energy by 1 to 3 points.

facts.action: Eat newt corpses to potentially increase energy.

facts.fact: Attacking a spellcasting monster with Magicbane has a chance of cancelling it and increasing your current and maximum energy by 1.

facts.fact: When you gain a level, both your current and maximum energy are increased based on various factors.

facts.fact: Energy drain is caused by the energy vortex, which has a 3/4 chance of draining energy from an engulfed hero based on their experience level, with a base damage dice of 2d6, adjusted by current and maximum energy.

facts.fact: If a hero is hit by the energy vortex's energy-draining attack during the grace period where they cannot be re-engulfed, the attack is converted to a claw attack with a 1/4 chance of draining energy.

facts.detect: Polymorphed into an energy vortex

facts.fact: A monster hit by the converted claw attack of an energy vortex has a 1/4 chance of losing the ability to use magic abilities or breath weapons for several turns.
facts.detect: Monster hit by the energy vortex's claw attack
facts.action: Exploit this effect to weaken monsters that rely on magic or breath weapons.

facts.fact: Engraving Elbereth with a non-instantaneous method can leave the player unprotected until the engraving is complete.
facts.detect: Player is described as 'helpless' in the death reason if killed while engraving.
facts.action: Use an instantaneous engraving method to write Elbereth, such as fingers or a non-cursed athame.

facts.fact: Permanent engravings are created with a wand of fire or lightning and do not degrade.
facts.detect: Player uses a wand of fire or lightning to engrave.
facts.action: Use a wand of fire or lightning to engrave Elbereth for permanent protection.

facts.fact: Temporary engravings made with fingers or soft objects have a 25% chance of mis-engraving per letter.
facts.detect: Player attempts to engrave Elbereth with fingers or a soft object.
facts.action: Avoid using fingers or soft objects to engrave Elbereth due to high risk of mis-engraving.

facts.fact: Semi-permanent engravings can erode over time and are subject to degradation from movement and combat.
facts.detect: Player stands on or moves over an engraving.
facts.action: Avoid standing on or moving over semi-permanent engravings to prevent erosion.

facts.fact: Tiny or handless monsters cannot engrave, so preexisting engravings may be left untouched.
facts.detect: Player encounters a preexisting engraving.
facts.action: Be cautious around preexisting engravings as they may not be Elbereth and could be misleading.

facts.fact: Digesters will digest you completely and instantly kill you if you wait inside them.
facts.detect: Monster name: trapper, lurker above, purple worm
facts.action: Escape immediately upon being engulfed by a digester.

facts.fact: Wearing a ring of slow digestion prevents digestion attacks, causing the monster to immediately expel you.
facts.detect: Item name: ring of slow digestion
facts.action: Equip ring of slow digestion when facing a digester.

facts.fact: Whirlies and blobs will eventually release you after a certain amount of turns, but digesters will digest you completely and instantly kill you.
facts.detect: Monster name: ochre jelly, Juiblex
facts.action: Avoid being engulfed by blobs and whirlies if possible, especially if you are low on health or resources.

facts.fact: Elemental vortices, especially the energy vortex, can be unexpectedly dangerous just after releasing you, because the touch attack they briefly get can damage your inventory.
facts.detect: Monster name: energy vortex
facts.action: Be cautious and ready to defend yourself immediately after being released by an energy vortex.

facts.fact: You do not receive damage reduction from your AC while engulfed.
facts.detect: Being engulfed by any monster
facts.action: Prioritize escaping from engulfing monsters quickly to avoid taking damage.

facts.fact: Enlightenment can be triggered by quaffing a potion of enlightenment, zapping a wand of enlightenment, invoking The Eyes of the Overworld, drinking from a fountain (one in 30 chance), or pressing ctrl+X in wizard or explore mode.
facts.detect: The bot can detect enlightenment messages such as 'You feel self-knowledgeable' or specific attribute messages.
facts.action: The bot should trigger enlightenment to check its attributes and resistances, especially before entering dangerous areas or fighting powerful monsters.

facts.fact: Alignment record is displayed during enlightenment, indicating the player's alignment status.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You are piously aligned', 'You are devoutly aligned', etc.
facts.action: The bot should ensure it maintains a positive alignment record to avoid penalties and gain benefits.

facts.fact: Resistances such as fire resistance, cold resistance, disintegration resistance, shock resistance, poison resistance, and others are displayed during enlightenment.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You are fire resistant', 'You are cold resistant', etc.
facts.action: The bot should use enlightenment to check its resistances before facing elemental attacks or dangerous environments.

facts.fact: Luck is displayed during enlightenment, indicating the player's luck level.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You are extremely unlucky', 'You are unlucky', 'Your luck is zero', 'You are lucky', etc.
facts.action: The bot should check its luck before making critical decisions or entering high-risk situations.

facts.fact: God's anger or ability to pray is always displayed during a game, indicating the player's standing with their god.
facts.detect: Messages like ' is angry with you', ' is very angry with you', 'You can safely pray', 'You can not safely pray'.
facts.action: The bot should avoid praying if it cannot safely do so to prevent angering its god.

facts.fact: Rust affects items made of iron and is caused by water damage and the bite of a gray ooze or the touch attacks and passive attack of a rust monster.
facts.detect: Water damage, gray ooze bite, rust monster touch or passive attack
facts.action: Avoid water, gray oozes, and rust monsters to prevent rusting of iron items.

facts.fact: Corrosion affects items made of copper or iron and is caused by the potion of acid, acid breath weapon of a yellow dragon, passive acid attacks of certain molds and jellies, and the bite and passive of a black pudding.
facts.detect: Potion of acid, yellow dragon, green mold, spotted jelly, ochre jelly, black pudding
facts.action: Avoid or neutralize these sources of acid to prevent corrosion of copper and iron items.

facts.fact: Burning affects items made of wood, leather, cloth, and plastic and is caused by fire damage and attacking certain fire-element monsters.
facts.detect: Fire damage, fire-element monsters
facts.action: Avoid fire and fire-element monsters to prevent burning of wood, leather, cloth, and plastic items.

facts.fact: Rotting affects items made of wood, leather, and cloth and is caused by the bite attack of a brown pudding.
facts.detect: Brown pudding bite attack
facts.action: Avoid brown puddings to prevent rotting of wood, leather, and cloth items.

facts.fact: Erosion does not affect body armor worn under a cloak, and does not affect a shirt worn under body armor or a cloak.
facts.detect: Wearing a cloak or body armor
facts.action: Wear a cloak or body armor to protect items worn underneath from erosion.

facts.fact: Scroll of teleportation: teleports you out of trouble. A cursed scroll of teleportation will teleport you to a different dungeon level.
facts.detect: Inventory item: scroll of teleportation
facts.action: Use scroll of teleportation when cornered by tough monsters or in danger.

facts.fact: Cursed potion of gain level: moves you to an upper dungeon level.
facts.detect: Inventory item: cursed potion of gain level
facts.action: Drink cursed potion of gain level when being pulled underwater or in danger.

facts.fact: Wand of teleportation: can teleport you or the monster away, useful on no-teleport levels.
facts.detect: Inventory item: wand of teleportation
facts.action: Use wand of teleportation to teleport away from danger or teleport the monster away.

facts.fact: Wand of cold: freezes water, preventing drowning by sea monsters.
facts.detect: Inventory item: wand of cold
facts.action: Use wand of cold when being pulled underwater by a sea monster.

facts.fact: Non-cursed scroll of earth: creates a boulder fort around you, giving time to heal.
facts.detect: Inventory item: non-cursed scroll of earth
facts.action: Use scroll of earth to create a boulder fort when cornered.

facts.fact: Valkyrie can gain Basic skill in the Escape school.
facts.detect: Role: Valkyrie
facts.action: Learn and use escape spells to evade dangerous situations.

facts.fact: Escape spells allow evasion of denizens in the Mazes of Menace.
facts.detect: Entering the Mazes of Menace
facts.action: Use escape spells to avoid or escape from dangerous monsters.

facts.fact: Barbarian, Monk, Rogue, Ranger, Tourist, and Wizard can gain skills in the Escape school.
facts.detect: Role: Barbarian, Monk, Rogue, Ranger, Tourist, Wizard
facts.action: If playing as one of these roles, learn and use escape spells.

facts.fact: Basic skill in Escape school is available for Valkyrie, Barbarian, and Ranger.
facts.detect: Role: Valkyrie, Barbarian, Ranger
facts.action: Learn and use basic escape spells for evasion.

facts.fact: Skilled and Expert skill levels are available for Monk, Rogue, Tourist, and Wizard.
facts.detect: Role: Monk, Rogue, Tourist, Wizard
facts.action: Learn and use skilled or expert escape spells for better evasion.

facts.fact: Climb the staircase on dungeon level 1 without the Amulet of Yendor in the hero's possession, and answer 'yes' when prompted.
facts.detect: When the bot reaches level 1 and is prompted to escape by climbing the staircase.
facts.action: Answer 'yes' to escape the dungeon.

facts.fact: Level teleport to any level from −1 to −9 while flying or levitating, or else level teleport to any negative 'level' while wearing an amulet of life saving.
facts.detect: When the bot has the ability to level teleport, is flying or levitating, or is wearing an amulet of life saving.
facts.action: Use level teleport to any level from −1 to −9 while flying or levitating, or teleport to any negative level while wearing an amulet of life saving to escape.

facts.fact: Reach the Astral Plane and sacrifice the Amulet of Yendor on the high altar of a god other than the hero's current god.
facts.detect: When the bot reaches the Astral Plane and finds a high altar of a god other than its current god.
facts.action: Sacrifice the Amulet of Yendor on the high altar to escape in celestial disgrace.

facts.fact: In wizard mode, wishing for a magic portal and then entering it will cause the hero to escape the dungeon.
facts.detect: When the bot is in wizard mode and has the ability to wish for a magic portal.
facts.action: Wish for a magic portal and enter it to escape the dungeon.

facts.fact: In explore mode or wizard mode, offering the Amulet of Yendor on the high altar to Moloch in his Sanctum will cause him to retain dominion over the hero's god and snuff out the hero's life.
facts.detect: When the bot reaches Moloch's Sanctum and has the Amulet of Yendor.
facts.action: Offer the Amulet of Yendor to Moloch to escape in a cloud of black smoke.

facts.fact: Exercising an attribute has a chance of (18 - current attribute value) in 19 of incrementing the attribute's exercise counter, whose maximum value is 50.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the situation by observing its attribute values and the effects of actions on them.
facts.action: The bot should engage in melee combat or push boulders around to exercise strength, hit monsters in melee or with projectiles, or use an unlocking tool to lock or unlock doors or containers for dexterity, eat and avoid becoming hungry or satiated for constitution, and cast spells, search for hidden things, or engrave Elbereth for wisdom.

facts.fact: NetHack does exercise checks at certain times: the first check happens on turn 600, and subsequent checks occur at random intervals of rn1(200, 800) turns from the last one.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the situation by tracking its turn count and observing changes in attribute values.
facts.action: The bot should continue exercising attributes as described above to maximize the chance of attribute increases during exercise checks.

facts.fact: Each act of abuse has an exactly 50% chance of reducing the attribute's exercise counter by 1.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the situation by observing actions that are likely to cause abuse, such as wearing gauntlets of power which prevent strength from being exercised.
facts.action: The bot should avoid wearing items that prevent exercise, such as gauntlets of power, and avoid actions that are likely to cause abuse.

facts.fact: Wearing gauntlets of power has a side-effect of completely preventing strength from being exercised.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the situation by identifying the item and observing the lack of strength exercise.
facts.action: The bot should avoid wearing gauntlets of power or remove them if they are preventing strength exercise.

facts.fact: If your stats get lowered, use a unicorn horn, potion or spell of restore ability to heal any such loss.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the situation by observing a decrease in attribute values.
facts.action: The bot should use a unicorn horn, potion or spell of restore ability to heal any attribute loss.

facts.fact: Your maximum hit points and their recovery increase with each level.
facts.detect: Notice an increase in maximum hit points after gaining a level.
facts.action: Continue to gain levels to increase hit points and recovery.

facts.fact: At levels divisible by three, your spellcasting success rate increases.
facts.detect: Notice an increase in spellcasting success rate after reaching levels 3, 6, 9, etc.
facts.action: Focus on spellcasting if you are a spellcaster and reach these levels.

facts.fact: Monster groups are larger as you gain levels.
facts.detect: Notice larger groups of monsters as your level increases.
facts.action: Be more cautious and prepared for larger groups of monsters.

facts.fact: You must be at least level 14 to get permission to begin the Quest from your Quest leader.
facts.detect: Receive a message from your Quest leader requiring you to be level 14.
facts.action: Ensure you are level 14 before attempting the Quest.

facts.fact: The experience points required to reach each level double with each level.
facts.detect: Notice the steep increase in required experience points as you approach higher levels.
facts.action: Use alternative leveling methods such as potions of gain level or wraith corpses to reach higher levels.

facts.fact: Eating tripe yields 1 XP, provided the hero is not an orc and is not in a polyform that enjoys tripe.
facts.detect: Item name 'tripe' in inventory or on the ground
facts.action: Eat tripe to gain 1 XP

facts.fact: Consulting the Oracle for the first major consultation and the first minor consultation gives experience points.
facts.detect: Message 'You consult the Oracle.'
facts.action: Consult the Oracle for the first time to gain XP

facts.fact: Quaffing from a sink can give 1 XP with a 5% chance.
facts.detect: Item name 'sink' in the level
facts.action: Quaff from a sink to potentially gain 1 XP

facts.fact: Untrapping a squeaky board gives 1 XP.
facts.detect: Message 'You untrap a squeaky board.'
facts.action: Untrap squeaky boards to gain 1 XP

facts.fact: The first novel read gives 20 XP.
facts.detect: Item name 'novel' in inventory or on the ground
facts.action: Read the first novel to gain 20 XP

facts.fact: In explore mode, you can refuse death by typing 'n' when prompted 'Die? [yn]' and receive the message 'Okay, so you don't die.'
facts.detect: Die? [yn]
facts.action: Type 'n' to refuse death.

facts.fact: If you refuse death from brainlessness, your intelligence is arbitrarily set to 5 ('You feel like a scarecrow.')
facts.detect: You feel like a scarecrow.
facts.action: Accept the reduced intelligence and continue playing.

facts.fact: Starting a new game in explore mode gives you a pre-identified uncursed wand of wishing.
facts.detect: Starting a new game in explore mode
facts.action: Use the wand of wishing to obtain specific objects.

facts.fact: Inputting ctrl+x while in explore mode will display attributes as if you had used an uncursed wand or potion of enlightenment.
facts.detect: Inputting ctrl+x
facts.action: Press ctrl+x to see enlightenment attributes.

facts.fact: Explore mode allows you to keep your old save file whenever you restore a game.
facts.detect: Do you want to keep the save file? [yn] (n)
facts.action: Type 'y' to keep the save file.

facts.fact: Large explosions cover a 3x3 range of squares and damage heroes or monsters caught in the area, sometimes affecting items on those squares as well. Damage from these explosions is dealt to other monsters first, with the hero saved for last.
facts.detect: Explosion message on the map or damage taken from an explosion
facts.action: Avoid standing in 3x3 areas where explosions might occur, especially near monsters or items you want to protect.

facts.fact: Some monster attack types involve explosions that use a directed explosion of the given damage type targeted at the square of a hero or monster, killing the attacker in the process regardless of if the attack hits.
facts.detect: Monster attack message indicating an explosion attack
facts.action: Avoid or prepare to resist attacks from monsters known to use explosion attacks.

facts.fact: A fiery explosion deals fire damage, which can be reduced or nullified by fire resistance, and is produced by applying a wand of fire with charges to break it, casting the fireball spell, reading a scroll of fire, or throwing a lit potion of oil.
facts.detect: Fire damage message or fireball/wand of fire explosion message
facts.action: Gain fire resistance or avoid using items that can cause fiery explosions.

facts.fact: A frosty explosion deals cold damage, which can be reduced or nullified by cold resistance, and is produced by applying a wand of cold with charges to break it, casting the cone of cold spell, or using a freezing sphere.
facts.detect: Cold damage message or cold explosion message
facts.action: Gain cold resistance or avoid using items that can cause frosty explosions.

facts.fact: A shocking explosion deals shock damage, which can be reduced or nullified by shock resistance, and is produced by applying a wand of lightning with charges to break it or using a shocking sphere.
facts.detect: Shock damage message or lightning explosion message
facts.action: Gain shock resistance or avoid using items that can cause shocking explosions.

facts.fact: A monster that has an explosion attack will attempt to self-destruct and direct the explosion at the square of a hero or monster, which will automatically hit if the target (or any other monster) is present at that square.
facts.detect: explodes!
facts.action: Avoid standing next to monsters with explosion attacks or use displacement, invisibility, or confusion to misdirect them.

facts.fact: If a hero is hit by a targeted explosion that deals HP damage, they have a dexterity-based chance of taking only halved damage (rounded up) from the blast.
facts.detect: You get blasted!
facts.action: Increase dexterity to reduce damage from explosions.

facts.fact: A cancelled monster will be unable to use this attack.
facts.detect: explodes!
facts.action: Cancel monsters with explosion attacks to prevent them from attacking.

facts.fact: A hero or monster that resists the explosion's damage type will be completely unaffected by it.
facts.detect: You seem unaffected by it.
facts.action: Gain resistance to the elemental damage type of spheres (cold, fire, shock) to avoid damage.

facts.fact: Spheres and lights can also be confused or else fooled by displacement and invisibility, causing them to target the wrong square and usually self-destruct harmlessly.
facts.detect: You hear a blast.
facts.action: Use confusion, displacement, or invisibility to misdirect spheres and lights.

facts.fact: A creature is extinct when 120 of its kind are generated. The creatures do not have to be killed to be extinct.
facts.detect: The bot notices that it has generated 120 of the same monster type.
facts.action: The bot should avoid further generation of that monster type to prevent extinction.

facts.fact: Reverse-genociding a monster increments the born counter and respects extinction.
facts.detect: The bot uses a scroll of genocide to reverse-genocide a monster.
facts.action: The bot should avoid reverse-genociding monsters to prevent extinction.

facts.fact: Pudding and gremlin division does not increment the born counter but respects extinction.
facts.detect: The bot notices a pudding or gremlin dividing.
facts.action: The bot should not interfere with pudding or gremlin division to prevent extinction.

facts.fact: Bees in a beehive (queen bees, killer bees) do not respect extinction.
facts.detect: The bot enters a beehive.
facts.action: The bot should avoid entering beehives to prevent extinction of bees.

facts.fact: Keystone Kops do not become extinct even after 120 of each kind have been created.
facts.detect: The bot notices Keystone Kops being summoned.
facts.action: The bot should not worry about Keystone Kops becoming extinct.

facts.fact: Eye of doom has a gaze attack that can study the player, potentially causing high damage (1d20).
facts.detect: When the bot sees the symbol 'e' on the map or receives the message 'You feel as if you are being studied.'
facts.action: Avoid looking directly at the Eye of Doom. Use items or spells with reflection properties to deflect its gaze.

facts.fact: Eye of Doom has a passive paralysis attack (1d7).
facts.detect: When the bot is paralyzed and sees the message 'You feel numb and cannot move.'
facts.action: Carry a cure paralysis scroll or potion to counteract paralysis.

facts.fact: Eye of Doom is immune to sleep and poison.
facts.detect: When attempting to use sleep or poison-based attacks/items on the Eye of Doom and seeing no effect.
facts.action: Avoid using sleep or poison-based attacks/items against the Eye of Doom.

facts.fact: Eye of Doom has resistance to fire.
facts.detect: When attempting to use fire-based attacks/items on the Eye of Doom and seeing no effect.
facts.action: Avoid using fire-based attacks/items against the Eye of Doom.

facts.fact: Eye of Doom is amphibious and can fly.
facts.detect: When the Eye of Doom moves across water or flies over obstacles.
facts.action: Be prepared for the Eye of Doom to move in unexpected ways, such as flying over pits or moving across water.

facts.fact: Gas spores and all spheres except floating eye explode on death or attack, covering a 3x3 square radius centered on their position, dealing 4-24 base damage and potentially destroying vulnerable items.
facts.detect: Monster name (gas spore, flaming sphere, freezing sphere, shocking sphere) or explosion sound effect
facts.action: Avoid standing near these monsters and keep valuable items protected with extrinsic resistances or dwarvish cloak

facts.fact: Floating eye can paralyze with gaze, making it a significant threat early in the game.
facts.detect: Monster name (floating eye) or paralysis message
facts.action: Equip blindfold or other blinding item to avoid gaze paralysis

facts.fact: Elemental spheres (flaming, freezing, shocking) have a speed of 13, slightly higher than a normal hero, and can be put to sleep or immobilized.
facts.detect: Monster name (flaming sphere, freezing sphere, shocking sphere) or high speed value
facts.action: Use sleep or immobilization spells/objects to control them

facts.fact: Cancellation can disable the explosive abilities of spheres, rendering them harmless.
facts.detect: Monster name (flaming sphere, freezing sphere, shocking sphere) or cancellation spell/effect
facts.action: Use cancellation to disable their explosive abilities

facts.fact: Shocking spheres are a frequent target for genocide due to their potential to destroy valuable rings and wands.
facts.detect: Monster name (shocking sphere) or valuable items in inventory
facts.action: Consider genocide of shocking spheres to protect valuable items

facts.fact: Eyeless monsters are immune to properties or effects that rely on eyesight, including gaze attacks and blindness from venom, hallucination attacks, paralysis attacks, and poison cloud blinding.
facts.detect: Encountering monsters like yellow light, black light, floating eye, Archon, or any monster that can cause blindness or gaze attacks.
facts.action: Approach and engage eyeless monsters without fear of blindness or gaze attacks, but be cautious of other attacks.

facts.fact: Eyeless monsters cannot block a player's kick attacks.
facts.detect: Attempting to kick an eyeless monster.
facts.action: Use kick attacks against eyeless monsters without fear of retaliation.

facts.fact: Eyeless monsters cannot read scrolls.
facts.detect: Eyeless monsters attempting to pick up and use scrolls.
facts.action: Loot scrolls from eyeless monsters after defeating them.

facts.fact: Eyeless monsters are unaffected by thrown potions of blindness.
facts.detect: Using a potion of blindness on an eyeless monster.
facts.action: Do not waste potions of blindness on eyeless monsters.

facts.fact: Eyeless monsters do not ignore Elbereth as an extrinsically blinded monster would.
facts.detect: Eyeless monsters stepping on Elbereth symbols.
facts.action: Place Elbereth symbols to deter eyeless monsters.

facts.fact: F represents a fungus or mold, which can be dangerous.
facts.action: Avoid or safely destroy these dangerous fungi.

facts.fact: Press f to start firing a quivered object in a chosen direction.
facts.detect: f key press
facts.action: Use this to fire objects in a chosen direction for ranged attacks.

facts.fact: Press shift+f to force-fight in a chosen direction.
facts.detect: shift+f key press
facts.action: Use this to attack a monster in a chosen direction.

facts.fact: Press alt+f to try and force a lock.
facts.detect: alt+f key press
facts.action: Use this to attempt to force open a locked door or chest.

facts.fact: Two Fake Wizard's Towers are located on separate levels between DL 15 and DL 22 in Gehennom.
facts.detect: The level number when exploring Gehennom.
facts.action: Explore levels between DL 15 and DL 22 to find the Fake Wizard's Towers.

facts.fact: One of the towers contains a magic portal to the real Wizard's Tower, while the other contains an amulet.
facts.detect: Finding a magic portal or an amulet at the 'x' position in the tower structure.
facts.action: If a magic portal is found, proceed to the real Wizard's Tower; if an amulet is found, take it and leave.

facts.fact: Teleporting into the tower will fail and place you randomly in the level, outside of the tower.
facts.detect: Attempting to teleport into the tower structure.
facts.action: Avoid teleporting into the tower and dig to enter instead.

facts.fact: Each tower contains a vampire lord, a random lich, and a single kraken in the moat.
facts.detect: Encountering a vampire lord, a lich, or a kraken.
facts.action: Be prepared to fight or avoid these powerful monsters.

facts.fact: A falling rock trap will either drop a rock that hits the player for 2d6 damage or disappear with a 1/5 chance.
facts.detect: A trapdoor in the ceiling/sky opens and a rock falls on your head!
facts.action: Wear a metallic helm to reduce damage to 2 points.

facts.fact: If a trap door would be randomly generated on a level with a non-diggable floor, it is replaced with a falling rock trap.
facts.detect: A trapdoor in the ceiling/sky opens and a rock falls on your head!
facts.action: Be cautious around trapdoors, especially on non-diggable floors.

facts.fact: One way to remove a falling rock trap is to trigger it repeatedly until it runs out of rocks.
facts.detect: A trapdoor in the ceiling/sky opens, but nothing falls out!
facts.action: Trigger the trap repeatedly until it disappears.

facts.fact: Early pet deaths are often due to falling rock traps, earning it the nicknames 'Puppy Pounder' and 'Kitty Killer'.
facts.detect: A trapdoor in the ceiling/sky opens and a rock falls on your head!
facts.action: Keep pets away from trapdoors.

facts.fact: An elven leather helm does not protect against damage from falling rock traps.
facts.detect: Your does not protect you.
facts.action: Equip a metallic helm instead of an elven leather helm.

facts.fact: Far look command (pressing ;) allows you to look at a square other than the one you are standing on.
facts.detect: Pressing ; and selecting a square
facts.action: Use far look to identify objects or monsters at a distance, especially when you need to know if a door is closed or if a symbol represents a dangerous monster.

facts.fact: Far look will inform you about a square if a symbol is present, giving information about what the symbol represents.
facts.detect: Presence of a symbol on the map
facts.action: Use far look to determine what a symbol represents before approaching it, especially for symbols that could represent dangerous items or monsters.

facts.fact: Far look will display if a monster is peaceful, tame, or hostile, and will also display any name you have called them.
facts.detect: Monster symbol on the map
facts.action: Use far look to identify if a monster is peaceful or tame before approaching it, and to remember the names of your pets.

facts.fact: Far look will display the detection method used for monsters beyond the normal field of vision, such as telepathy or infravision.
facts.detect: Monster symbol beyond normal field of vision
facts.action: Use far look to determine if a monster is detected by telepathy or infravision, which can be crucial for avoiding dangerous monsters.

facts.fact: Far look will only give remembered information on an object if the item has been moved since it was last in your line of sight, treating that item as unseen.
facts.detect: Object symbol on the map
facts.action: Use far look to check if an object has been moved since you last saw it, which can be important for identifying traps or dangerous items.

facts.fact: Gremlin farming is still viable as they leave corpses that can be used for sacrificing.
facts.detect: Gremlin corpses
facts.action: Sacrifice gremlin corpses on altars for benefits.

facts.fact: Medusa farming provides an easy source of experience points.
facts.detect: Medusa
facts.action: Stone and revive Medusa repeatedly for XP.

facts.fact: Giant farming on the home level of the quest can be done for strength gain and death drops.
facts.detect: Giant
facts.action: Kill giants on the quest home level for strength gain and loot.

facts.fact: Throne looting is still possible but is no longer farmable to the same extent.
facts.detect: Throne room monster
facts.action: Loot thrones while confused but be aware of the 10% chance of marking the throne as 'looted'.

facts.fact: Werecreature farming can be a viable alternative to usual monster creation methods.
facts.detect: Werecreature
facts.action: Trap a werecreature in a locked space to summon animals for monster sources.

facts.fact: Felines are quadrupedal and carnivorous animals that possess infravision.
facts.detect: Infravision on the feline monster
facts.action: Use magic cancellation or other means to negate infravision if you have it to avoid being seen by felines in dark areas.

facts.fact: Felines primarily attack via bites, as well as claws for the big cats and displacer beasts.
facts.detect: Feline monsters approaching
facts.action: Equip high AC and resistances, and use weapons that deal high damage to avoid being overwhelmed by their attacks.

facts.fact: Randomly-generated domestic felines are sometimes created as peaceful towards neutral heroes.
facts.detect: Feline monster approaching without hostility
facts.action: Consider taming peaceful domestic felines for companionship and aid in combat.

facts.fact: A random feline is always generated on the College Town map of Minetown.
facts.detect: Entering the College Town map of Minetown
facts.action: Be prepared for a feline encounter when exploring this area.

facts.fact: The displacer beast is a mid-game terror due to its incredible -10 AC and intrinsic displacement abilities.
facts.detect: Displacer beast monster
facts.action: Avoid or prepare extensively for encounters with displacer beasts, as they are extremely dangerous.

facts.fact: Moving into a hostile monster will automatically perform an attack.
facts.detect: The bot encounters a hostile monster on its path.
facts.action: Avoid moving into hostile monsters unless necessary.

facts.fact: Using the fight command by pressing F and then pressing in one of eight directions will perform an attack towards the adjacent square in that direction.
facts.detect: The bot uses the F key followed by a direction key.
facts.action: Use the F key to attack in a specific direction.

facts.fact: A hero that walks into a hostile monster, moves towards a square where a monster was sensed (which is marked with an I), or moving into any monster while wielding a bloodthirsty weapon (i.e. Stormbringer) will automatically perform an attack with their wielded weapon targeted at the monster's square.
facts.detect: The bot senses a monster with an 'I' or wields Stormbringer.
facts.action: Avoid moving into squares marked with 'I' or wielding Stormbringer unless necessary.

facts.fact: Attacking with Cleaver and hitting a monster directly will strike in an arc that hits the squares to a 45-degree angle on each side of that monster in the attack's direction.
facts.detect: The bot attacks a monster with Cleaver.
facts.action: Be cautious when attacking with Cleaver to avoid hitting peaceful or tame monsters.

facts.fact: Force-fighting in the direction of a location where a monster was sensed and marked with an I will hit any unseen monster occupying the square.
facts.detect: The bot uses the F key towards a square marked with 'I'.
facts.action: Use the F key to attack unseen monsters in squares marked with 'I'.

facts.fact: Fire damage can occur from various items, terrain and obstacles, including fire traps, fireball spell, fire horn, fire breath weapon, and lava.
facts.detect: Messages like 'The door is consumed in flames!', 'You smell smoke.', 'You hear hissing gas.', 'Water evaporates.', 'The fire doesn't feel hot!', 'You're on fire!', 'You feel rather warm.', 'You are suddenly very hot!', 'You are burning to a crisp!', 'You feel mildly hot.', 'You feel mildly warm.', 'is melting!', 'is burning to a crisp!', 'burns completely!', 'May roast in peace.'
facts.action: Avoid fire traps, lava, and monsters with fire breath. Use fire resistance or reflection to protect against fire damage. Keep flammable items in containers to prevent destruction.

facts.fact: Fire damage can erode organic material armor and destroy flammable items like scrolls and spellbooks.
