facts.detect: Messages like 'Your boils and explodes!', 'of your boil(s) and explode(s)!', 'Your ignites and explodes!', 'of your ignite(s) and explode(s)!'
facts.action: Avoid carrying flammable items in open inventory when facing fire damage sources. Use fireproof containers or intrinsic fire resistance.

facts.fact: Paper and straw golems are especially susceptible to fire damage, burning up completely and dying instantly.
facts.detect: Messages like 'burns completely!', 'You smell burning paper.', 'May roast in peace.'
facts.action: Avoid polymorphing into paper or straw golems if fire damage is present.

facts.fact: Fire resistance reduces or nullifies fire damage, but does not protect items.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You don't feel hot!', 'You feel rather warm.', 'You feel mildly hot.', 'You feel mildly warm.'
facts.action: Obtain fire resistance before entering Gehennom to protect against fire traps and fiery monsters.

facts.fact: Fire rays and explosions can destroy doors and boil away pools of water, leaving behind pits.
facts.detect: Messages like 'The door is consumed in flames!', 'Water evaporates.', 'You hear hissing gas.'
facts.action: Be cautious around fire damage sources to avoid traps and water pools that could be destroyed.

facts.fact: Fire Dagger grants +1d4 to-hit and deals +1d4 damage against monsters without fire resistance.
facts.detect: monster without fire resistance
facts.action: Use Fire Dagger against monsters without fire resistance for increased damage and to-hit bonus.

facts.fact: While wielded, Fire Dagger grants cold resistance.
facts.detect: wielding Fire Dagger
facts.action: Wield Fire Dagger when facing cold damage to gain cold resistance.

facts.fact: Fire pillar deals 8d6 fire damage and can burn flammable items.
facts.detect: A pillar of fire strikes all around you!
facts.action: Equip fire-resistant armor and wield fire-resistant weapons. Avoid flammable items when under attack.

facts.fact: Half spell damage reduces fire pillar damage to half, rounded up.
facts.detect: A pillar of fire strikes all around you!
facts.action: Gain half spell damage resistance to mitigate damage.

facts.fact: Fire resistance nullifies fire pillar damage entirely.
facts.detect: A pillar of fire strikes all around you!
facts.action: Gain fire resistance to avoid damage.

facts.fact: Fire pillar cures sliming.
facts.detect: Slimed status message.
facts.action: Allow fire pillar to cure sliming if necessary.

facts.fact: Fire resistance nullifies any fire damage that a hero or monster takes from attacks and wands, but will not prevent that fire damage from also affecting their inventory unless it is from an extrinsic source.
facts.detect: The bot can detect fire damage to inventory through messages like 'Your scroll of identify burns up.'
facts.action: The bot should prioritize obtaining extrinsic fire resistance to protect its inventory from fire damage.

facts.fact: A hero with fire resistance that falls in lava still takes damage, but the resistance prevents the lava from being immediately lethal, providing a limited amount of turns for the hero to escape it before they sink beneath its surface and die.
facts.detect: The bot can detect falling into lava through the message 'You fall into lava!'
facts.action: The bot should prioritize escaping lava as soon as possible, even with fire resistance.

facts.fact: Monsters that have fire resistance include fire-element monsters, some golems and most major demons.
facts.detect: The bot can detect these monsters by their names or descriptions.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious around these monsters due to their fire resistance.

facts.fact: Fire resistance can be obtained through various items and methods, including eating a ring of fire resistance, polymorphing into a valid monster with fire resistance, or eating the corpse, glob, or tin of certain monsters.
facts.detect: The bot can detect these items or monsters through inventory or level exploration.
facts.action: The bot should prioritize obtaining fire resistance through these methods.

facts.fact: Fire resistance is often considered a must-have property for a hero preparing to enter Gehennom, as fire traps are prevalent there and capable of reducing your maximum hit points otherwise.
facts.detect: The bot can detect its approach to Gehennom through level numbers or messages.
facts.action: The bot should ensure it has fire resistance before entering Gehennom.

facts.fact: Fire traps are generated in Gehennom, mazes, some quests, notably the Valkyrie quest, and the Plane of Fire. 20% of all randomly generated traps in Gehennom are guaranteed to be fire traps.
facts.detect: A tower of flame erupts from the floor!
facts.action: Obtain fire resistance before entering Gehennom and keep scrolls, potions, and spellbooks in a container.

facts.fact: If you lack fire resistance, you take 2d4 damage, and your maximum HP is reduced by between zero and the damage you took.
facts.detect: A tower of flame erupts from the floor!
facts.action: Equip fire-resistant gear and obtain fire resistance before entering dangerous areas.

facts.fact: Fire traps will still activate if you jump over them, but will not activate if you levitate or fly over them.
facts.detect: Jumping over a trap.
facts.action: Use levitation or flying to avoid fire traps.

facts.fact: If a fire trap is created on top of ice, stepping on it will melt the ice and replace it with a pool of water, potentially resulting in drowning.
facts.detect: A tower of flame erupts from the floor!
facts.action: Avoid fire traps on ice to prevent drowning.

facts.fact: Fire traps may burn an article of clothing with an equal chance of each of 5 types (helm, torso, shield, gloves, or boots) being selected.
facts.detect: A tower of flame erupts from the floor!
facts.action: Wear fireproof or blessed armor to reduce the chance of burning.

facts.fact: When a monster uses the fireball spell in melee range, it deals damage based on the monster's level plus any additional damage dice provided.
facts.detect: You are enveloped in flames!
facts.action: Gain fire resistance or half spell damage to mitigate damage.

facts.fact: Fire resistance completely negates damage to the hero from the fireball spell in either form.
facts.detect: You are enveloped in flames!
facts.action: Acquire fire resistance if not already resistant.

facts.fact: Half spell damage halves damage inflicted by the spell in either form.
facts.detect: You are enveloped in flames!
facts.action: Gain half spell damage if not already resistant.

facts.fact: The fireball spell can boil potions and destroy scrolls and spellbooks in the inventory of any monsters it hits.
facts.detect: Potion boils/scroll burns/spellbook burns.
facts.action: Avoid carrying important scrolls and spellbooks in inventory when facing monsters that might use fireball.

facts.fact: Firestar grants +1d5 to-hit and deals double damage against monsters without fire resistance.
facts.detect: Monsters without fire resistance (e.g., orcs, kobolds)
facts.action: Equip Firestar when fighting monsters without fire resistance for increased damage and to-hit bonus.

facts.fact: While wielded, Firestar grants fire resistance.
facts.detect: Fire-based hazards or attacks (e.g., fire traps, fireballs, fire giants)
facts.action: Equip Firestar when encountering fire-based hazards or attacks to gain fire resistance.

facts.fact: If the hero is wielding an aklys and their quiver is either empty or has ammo other than missiles, it will ignore the quiver and prompt the player for a cardinal direction to throw the aklys in.
facts.detect: Wielding an aklys and having an empty quiver or quiver with non-missile ammo.
facts.action: Ensure the quiver contains appropriate missiles for the aklys or manually throw the aklys.

facts.fact: If the hero is wielding a lance, any type of polearm or the artifact Snickersnee, it will prompt the player for a square to target or else auto-target a square if it was previously used via the firing command.
facts.detect: Wielding a lance, polearm, or Snickersnee.
facts.action: Target a specific square when firing.

facts.fact: If the hero is wielding a bullwhip, it will prompt the player for a cardinal direction to apply it in.
facts.detect: Wielding a bullwhip.
facts.action: Choose a cardinal direction to use the bullwhip.

facts.fact: If the hero's offhand weapon slot contains a lance, polearm or Snickersnee, and that weapon is known to not be cursed, the hero will use an action to switch to that weapon if possible, and the player will be prompted for a square to target if the hero is not interrupted.
facts.detect: Offhand weapon slot containing a lance, polearm, or Snickersnee.
facts.action: Switch to the offhand weapon and target a square.

facts.fact: If none of the above apply and the hero has projectiles quivered, it will prompt for a cardinal direction that the player wants to fire in.
facts.detect: Having projectiles quivered.
facts.action: Choose a cardinal direction to fire projectiles.

facts.fact: The Flame Mage quest involves fighting the Water Mage for The Candle of Eternal Flame.
facts.detect: The Water Mage, The Candle of Eternal Flame
facts.action: Seek out and defeat the Water Mage to obtain the Candle of Eternal Flame.

facts.fact: Random monsters on the quest levels are 55% water elementals, 14% random E, 14% rust monsters, 3% random R, and 14% normal random monsters.
facts.detect: Water elementals, rust monsters, random E, random R
facts.action: Be prepared for water elementals and rust monsters, which can corrode metal equipment.

facts.fact: The Great Circle of Flame is besieged by six water elementals and four rust monsters.
facts.detect: Water elementals, rust monsters
facts.action: Be cautious of water elementals and rust monsters on the Great Circle of Flame level.

facts.fact: The Lair of the Water Mage contains twelve water elementals and four rust monsters.
facts.detect: Water elementals, rust monsters
facts.action: Be prepared for a high number of water elementals and rust monsters in the Water Mage's Lair.

facts.fact: The Water Mage will occasionally utter maledictions that can demoralize the player.
facts.detect: Maledictions from the Water Mage
facts.action: Ignore or counter the Water Mage's maledictions to maintain morale.

facts.fact: Most corpses are made of flesh.
facts.detect: Monster corpses
facts.action: Avoid eating flesh if playing as a vegan or vegetarian character.

facts.fact: Flesh items include tripe ration, egg, meatball, meat stick, huge chunk of meat, and meat ring.
facts.detect: Item names
facts.action: Avoid eating these items if playing as a vegan or vegetarian character.

facts.fact: Polypiling enough flesh items on a single square can create a flesh golem.
facts.detect: Polypiling multiple flesh items
facts.action: Be cautious when polypiling flesh items to avoid creating a dangerous flesh golem.

facts.fact: A flimsy helm can be worn by a monster with horns, as long as the monster is not tiny and has hands.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a horned monster form.
facts.action: If polymorphed into a horned form, a flimsy helm can be worn without being pushed off.

facts.fact: A non-flimsy helm will be pushed off your head if you polymorph into a form with horns.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a horned monster form while wearing a non-flimsy helm.
facts.action: Avoid wearing non-flimsy helms if polymorphing into a horned form is expected.

facts.fact: Flimsy objects will not scratch a gray stone; rubbing them together will create streaks on the stone instead of scratches.
facts.detect: Rubbing flimsy objects on gray stone.
facts.action: Do not use flimsy objects to scratch gray stone for engraving.

facts.fact: A flimsy weapon cannot be shattered.
facts.detect: Using a flimsy weapon in combat.
facts.action: Use flimsy weapons without fear of shattering.

facts.fact: Flint stones are ammunition made for firing with slings and do 1d6 damage against small and large enemies.
facts.detect: A gray stone that appears in shops, jewelers, or as loot from cavepeople or in Mines' End.
facts.action: Pick up and carry flint stones as ammunition for a sling.

facts.fact: Flint stones are the safest to pick up and carry among gray stones.
facts.detect: A gray stone that is not a touchstone, luckstone, or loadstone.
facts.action: Carry flint stones without worry.

facts.fact: Flint stones can be wished for safely in stacks of up to 20 in NetHack 3.7.0.
facts.detect: Wishing for flint stones.
facts.action: Wish for flint stones in stacks of up to 20 if playing a future version.

facts.fact: If a hobbit or other hostile monster slings a gray stone at you, it is most likely flint.
facts.detect: A gray stone being slung by a hobbit or other hostile monster.
facts.action: Do not fear the attack as it is likely a flint stone.

facts.fact: Flint stones are the only gray stone to be a non-magical item.
facts.detect: A gray stone that is not magical.
facts.action: Identify and carry flint stones as non-magical.

facts.fact: A hero with flight can pick up items inside pits and spiked pits without falling in.
facts.detect: The bot notices it is standing next to a pit or spiked pit with items inside.
facts.action: The bot picks up items from pits and spiked pits.

facts.fact: A hero with flight can move up or down stairs without risk of falling due to encumbrance, fumbling, or punishment.
facts.detect: The bot is on a staircase and has items in inventory.
facts.action: The bot moves up or down stairs freely.

facts.fact: A hero with flight can pass over most ground-based traps without triggering them.
facts.detect: The bot detects a trap on the ground.
facts.action: The bot moves over the trap.

facts.fact: A hero with flight can move over pools, moats, and lava safely.
facts.detect: The bot sees a pool, moat, or lava.
facts.action: The bot moves over the hazardous terrain.

facts.fact: A hero with flight can dip items into moats and pools while flying over them.
facts.detect: The bot is flying over a moat or pool and has items to dip.
facts.action: The bot dips items into the moat or pool.

facts.fact: Elbereth will prevent a monster from following if the monster respects it.
facts.detect: Monster name and respect for Elbereth (e.g., 'Elbereth' written on the floor near the monster)
facts.action: Carve 'Elbereth' on the floor near the monster to prevent it from following.

facts.fact: The Wizard of Yendor will never follow if he's carrying the real Amulet of Yendor, and always otherwise.
facts.detect: Wizard of Yendor carrying the Amulet of Yendor
facts.action: Avoid changing levels if the Wizard of Yendor is nearby and carrying the Amulet of Yendor.

facts.fact: Pets (unless they're eating) and hostile shopkeepers will always follow.
facts.detect: Pet monster or hostile shopkeeper
facts.action: Ensure pets are eating before changing levels to prevent them from following.

facts.fact: Other monsters will follow if they have the M2_STALK attribute defined, provided either they're not fleeing or you're carrying the real Amulet.
facts.detect: Monster name and M2_STALK attribute (e.g., 'gremlin', 'stalker', 'salamander', 'ghost', 'shade', 'Croesus')
facts.action: Avoid changing levels if these monsters are nearby and not fleeing.

facts.fact: Not all covetous monsters are followers. In particular, liches won't follow you down stairs.
facts.detect: Lich monster
facts.action: Changing levels is safe near liches.

facts.fact: Foocubi have a seduction attack that can be dangerous and empowering for the hero unless the foocubus is cancelled.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter a foocubus and receive a message indicating the start of a seduction attempt.
facts.action: Avoid initiating a seduction encounter with a foocubus unless the bot is prepared to handle the potential negative effects.

facts.fact: Foocubi can steal items and teleport away if the hero applies a mirror to them.
facts.detect: The bot sees a foocubus and attempts to use a mirror on it.
facts.action: Avoid using mirrors on foocubi to prevent item loss and teleportation.

facts.fact: Foocubi can initiate seduction encounters that may leave the hero disrobed and vulnerable to other monsters.
facts.detect: The bot receives messages indicating the removal of worn armor items during a seduction encounter.
facts.action: Ensure the area is clear of other monsters before engaging in a seduction encounter with a foocubus.

facts.fact: Foocubi can drain the hero's power and reduce their maximum energy, lower constitution, wisdom, and dexterity, and potentially cause level drain.
facts.detect: The bot receives messages indicating negative effects such as 'You feel drained of energy' or 'You are down in the dumps'.
facts.action: Avoid seduction encounters unless the bot has high intelligence and charisma to mitigate the risk of negative effects.

facts.fact: Foocubi can teleport away after a seduction encounter and may take gold from the hero.
facts.detect: The bot sees a foocubus teleport away after a seduction encounter.
facts.action: Ensure the bot has sufficient gold to withstand potential theft without significant impact.

facts.fact: Higher charisma and intelligence increase the odds of a beneficial effect from an encounter with a foocubus.
facts.detect: Player's charisma and intelligence stats
facts.action: Boost charisma and intelligence before encountering foocubus

facts.fact: Female characters may lose their ring of levitation if wearing two non-adornment rings and carrying an additional ring of adornment when encountering an incubus.
facts.detect: Wearing two non-adornment rings and carrying a ring of adornment
facts.action: Remove non-essential rings before encountering foocubus

facts.fact: Foocubi can remove cursed armor, providing a possible alternative to nymphs for removing cursed armor.
facts.detect: Cursed armor in inventory
facts.action: Allow foocubus to remove cursed armor

facts.fact: Characters at experience level 1 should stay well away from foocubi, as one of the possible negative outcomes is a level drain.
facts.detect: Player's experience level
facts.action: Avoid foocubus until level 2 or higher

facts.fact: Always be sure to double-check and put back all of your armor once you and the foocubus are done.
facts.detect: Completion of encounter with foocubus
facts.action: Check and re-equip armor after encounter

facts.fact: Food appraisal warns of potentially harmful food effects before eating, such as tainted food, stoning, sliming, poisoning, and conduct violations.
facts.detect: Messages like 'This smells like it could be tainted!', 'This smells like it might be poisonous!', 'This smells like it might have been poisoned.', 'This smells like it could be something very dangerous!', 'This smells foul and unfamiliar to you.', 'This smells unfamiliar to you.', 'This smells rather acidic.', 'This smells unhealthy.', 'This smells disgusting to you right now.'
facts.action: Avoid eating the food if warned of harmful effects.

facts.fact: Food appraisal does not warn against certain harmful effects such as choking, instant death from eating a Rider corpse, hallucination, stunning, cannibalism, monster aggravation, polymorphing, and unwanted intrinsics.
facts.detect: Not receiving a warning message for these effects.
facts.action: Be cautious and avoid eating corpses or food that could cause these effects.

facts.fact: Food appraisal can be obtained by reading a blessed scroll of food detection or casting the detect food spell with Skilled level or higher in divination spells.
facts.detect: Message 'Your starts to tingle and you smell food.'
facts.action: Gain food appraisal by reading a blessed scroll of food detection or casting the detect food spell.

facts.fact: Food appraisal warns of food that might be rotten, acidic, or rustproof if polymorphed into a rust monster.
facts.detect: Messages like 'This smells unhealthy.', 'This smells rather acidic.', 'This smells disgusting to you right now.'
facts.action: Avoid eating food that might be rotten, acidic, or rustproof.

facts.fact: Food appraisal warns of food that violates vegetarian or vegan conduct.
facts.detect: Messages like 'This smells foul and unfamiliar to you.', 'This smells unfamiliar to you.'
facts.action: Avoid eating food that violates vegetarian or vegan conduct.

facts.fact: A hero can use a bladed weapon to pry open a locked container, which carries the risk of the weapon breaking.
facts.detect: Message: 'You try to force the lock with your [weapon name]. It bends and breaks!'
facts.action: Avoid using bladed weapons on locks unless the weapon is unimportant or cursed.

facts.fact: A hero can use a blunt weapon to smash a locked container, which carries the risk of destroying the container and its contents.
facts.detect: Message: 'You smash the [container] with your [weapon name]. The [container] is destroyed!'
facts.action: Avoid using blunt weapons on locks unless the contents are unimportant or the container is cursed.

facts.fact: The success rate of forcing a lock with a weapon is 2x+1%, where x is the weapon's damage against large monsters.
facts.detect: Weapon damage against large monsters.
facts.action: Use weapons with higher damage against large monsters for better success rates.

facts.fact: Cursed weapons will not break when forcing a lock.
facts.detect: Weapon is cursed.
facts.action: Use cursed bladed weapons for forcing locks if no other options are available.

facts.fact: Successfully forcing a lock with a bladed weapon exercises dexterity, while a blunt weapon exercises strength.
facts.detect: Message: 'You try to force the lock with your [weapon name]. You feel your muscles working.'
facts.action: Consider using blunt weapons to exercise strength if needed.

facts.fact: Fort Ludios is a no-teleport level and is ineligible to leave bones files.
facts.detect: The bot will not find bones files or be able to teleport out of the level.
facts.action: The bot should be prepared to fight its way out or find an exit through the map.

facts.fact: Entering Fort Ludios triggers an alarm that wakes up all monsters on the floor.
facts.detect: The message 'You have penetrated a high security area! An alarm sounds!' will appear.
facts.action: The bot should prepare for combat and be cautious of the sudden increase in monster activity.

facts.fact: The level contains 16 soldiers, one lieutenant, four dragons, and four giant eels, all placed at specific locations.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter soldiers, a lieutenant, dragons, and giant eels at the specified locations on the map.
facts.action: The bot should be prepared to fight these specific monsters and use ranged attacks or pets to handle them.

facts.fact: Each square has a 1/3 chance of containing a trap, with 2/3 being land mines and 1/3 being spiked pits.
facts.detect: The bot will trigger traps when moving on unsearched squares.
facts.action: The bot should search all squares before moving to avoid traps.

facts.fact: Fort Ludios contains around 50,000zm on average, which is about half of a strong character's total carrying capacity.
facts.detect: The bot will find large amounts of gold in the left half of the fort.
facts.action: The bot should bring a bag of holding to carry the gold out.

facts.fact: Fountains on non-special levels have a 7/50 (14%) chance of being magic.
facts.detect: Quaffing or dipping in a fountain and receiving a message indicating a magic effect (e.g., 'Wow! This makes you feel great!')
facts.action: If a fountain is magic, quaff or dip to gain benefits (e.g., nutrition, attribute restoration, wish).

facts.fact: Quaffing from a non-magic fountain can result in negative effects such as losing nutrition, HP, or strength.
facts.detect: Quaffing from a fountain and receiving a negative message (e.g., 'The water is foul! You gag and vomit.')
facts.action: Avoid quaffing from non-magic fountains unless necessary or beneficial.

facts.fact: Dipping a long sword in a fountain at level 5 or higher has a 6/10 chance of turning it into Excalibur if lawful.
facts.detect: Dipping a long sword in a fountain and receiving a message indicating Excalibur (e.g., 'The sword is now Excalibur.')
facts.action: Dip a long sword in a fountain at level 5 or higher if lawful to potentially obtain Excalibur.

facts.fact: Fountains have a 1/3 chance of drying up after certain actions, except in Minetown where you get a warning.
facts.detect: Receiving a warning message from the Minetown watch or seeing the fountain dry up.
facts.action: Avoid repeatedly quaffing or dipping in the same fountain to prevent it from drying up.

facts.fact: Quaffing from fountains in Minetown will anger the Minetown watch if the fountain dries up.
facts.detect: Receiving a warning message from the Minetown watch or seeing the watch's reaction.
facts.action: Avoid quaffing from fountains in Minetown to prevent angering the watch.

facts.fact: Once you know a fountain is non-magical, it is best to dip objects rather than quaff them to get wishes from it.
facts.detect: Non-magical fountain (no message after quaffing)
facts.action: Dip objects into the fountain instead of quaffing to get wishes.

facts.fact: The expected number of items cursed per gain ability effect is i/20, where i is the number of items in your inventory while quaffing.
facts.detect: Number of items in inventory
facts.action: Reduce the number of items in inventory before quaffing to minimize the risk of items becoming cursed.

facts.fact: Standing on a fountain and digging down can create several pools of water, allowing for repeated dipping without using up your water supply.
facts.detect: Fountain on the map
facts.action: Stand on a fountain and dig down to create pools for repeated dipping.

facts.fact: Dipping items into fountains is one of the more readily-available means to uncurse them once your character becomes powerful enough to withstand bad fountain results.
facts.detect: Cursed items in inventory
facts.action: Dip cursed items into fountains to uncurse them.

facts.fact: Quaffing from fountains can curse a very large number of items at once, which can be useful for certain strategies but requires careful preparation.
facts.detect: Message 'This water's no good!' after quaffing
facts.action: Prepare for hazards and carry only necessary items when quaffing to curse items.

facts.fact: Fragile items are destroyed when thrown, kicked, hit with a force bolt or wand of striking, or dropped from a height.
facts.detect: Item names such as 'Eggs', 'Potions', 'Expensive cameras', 'Cream pies', 'Melons', 'Venom', 'Mirrors', 'Pairs of lenses', 'Crystal balls', 'Wands with glass/crystal appearance', 'Crystal plate mail'.
facts.action: Avoid throwing, kicking, or dropping fragile items, especially when levitating or riding. Keep them in a bag of holding or a nested bag for safety.

facts.fact: Eggs, mirrors, and other fragile items inside containers can break when the container is kicked, thrown, or otherwise abused.
facts.detect: Container names such as 'chest', 'box', 'bag', 'sack'.
facts.action: Handle containers with fragile items carefully to avoid breaking them.

facts.fact: Breaking eggs that you have laid or mirrors carries a Luck penalty.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel a little less lucky.' after breaking an egg or mirror.
facts.action: Avoid breaking eggs and mirrors to maintain luck.

facts.fact: For stackable fragile items, each damaged stack will lose only one item.
facts.detect: Item names such as 'stackable potions', 'stackable eggs'.
facts.action: Handle stackable fragile items with care to avoid losing items.

facts.fact: Items inside a bag of holding or a nested bag are immune to breaking.
facts.detect: Item names such as 'bag of holding', 'nested bag'.
facts.action: Store fragile items in a bag of holding or nested bag for protection.

facts.fact: Free action nullifies or blunts the effects of paralyzing container traps, potions of sleeping or paralysis, and paralyzing attacks from various sources.
facts.detect: Messages such as 'You momentarily stiffen', 'You stiffen momentarily', 'You momentarily stiffen under X's gaze', 'You stiffen momentarily under X's gaze', 'You stiffen momentarily under your gaze', 'You stiffen briefly'.
facts.action: Equip the ring of free action to protect against paralysis.

facts.fact: Free action prevents paralyzing attacks from monsters such as floating eyes, gelatinous cubes, ghouls, Yeenoghu, guardian nagas, and shades.
facts.detect: Monster names: floating eye, gelatinous cube, ghoul, Yeenoghu, guardian naga, shade.
facts.action: Equip the ring of free action to protect against these monsters' paralyzing attacks.

facts.fact: Free action prevents the paralyze monster spell from affecting the hero for more than 1 turn.
facts.detect: Message: 'You stiffen briefly'.
facts.action: Equip the ring of free action to protect against the paralyze monster spell.

facts.fact: Free action is often considered essential for endgame areas such as Moloch's Sanctum and the Astral Plane.
facts.detect: Entering endgame areas such as Moloch's Sanctum or the Astral Plane.
facts.action: Ensure the ring of free action is equipped before entering these areas.

facts.fact: Players often combine a ring of free action with a wielded potion of paralysis to immobilize and dispose of difficult monsters.
facts.detect: Possession of a ring of free action and a potion of paralysis.
facts.action: Use the potion of paralysis to immobilize difficult monsters while wearing the ring of free action.

facts.fact: If player is female and wearing a maid dress: -4 AC, magic resistance
facts.detect: maid dress and frilled apron in inventory, female character
facts.action: Equip maid dress and frilled apron for AC and magic resistance benefits

facts.fact: A male character who wears the frilled apron will only gain aggravate monster
facts.detect: frilled apron in inventory, male character
facts.action: Do not wear frilled apron if male

facts.fact: Wearing gauntlets of fumbling or fumble boots causes you to fumble, making movement and actions less reliable.
facts.detect: Wearing gauntlets of fumbling or fumble boots
facts.action: Remove gauntlets of fumbling or fumble boots as soon as detected.

facts.fact: Fumbling causes you to slip or trip every d20 turns, making you helpless for 2 turns and possibly alerting nearby monsters.
facts.detect: Slip or trip message
facts.action: Avoid moving or carrying heavy items when fumbling.

facts.fact: Fumbling causes you to fall when going down stairs.
facts.detect: Falling down stairs message
facts.action: Avoid going down stairs when fumbling.

facts.fact: Fumbling reduces the chance of disarming traps and escaping them.
facts.detect: Attempting to disarm a trap or escape from one
facts.action: Avoid disarming or escaping traps when fumbling.

facts.fact: Fumbling causes Mjollnir to hit your arm rather than be caught on its return for a Valkyrie.
facts.detect: Mjollnir hitting your arm message
facts.action: Avoid using Mjollnir when fumbling.

facts.fact: Brown molds have a passive cold attack and possess poison and cold resistance. Eating their tin or corpse can grant either resistance.
facts.detect: Brown mold
facts.action: Eat brown mold corpse or tin to gain poison or cold resistance if needed.

facts.fact: Yellow molds have a passive stun attack and possess poison resistance. Eating their tin or corpse can grant poison resistance, but the corpse is poisonous to consume and eating yellow mold always causes hallucination upon finishing the meal.
facts.detect: Yellow mold
facts.action: Avoid eating yellow mold corpse unless hallucination is needed or if hallucination resistance is high.

facts.fact: Green molds have a passive acid attack, and possess acid resistance and stoning resistance. Eating their tin or corpse cures stoning immediately, and finishing the meal can temporarily grant either resistance.
facts.detect: Green mold
facts.action: Eat green mold corpse or tin to cure stoning and potentially gain acid or stoning resistance.

facts.fact: Red molds have a passive fire attack, and possess poison and fire resistance. Eating their tin or corpse can grant either resistance.
facts.detect: Red mold
facts.action: Eat red mold corpse or tin to gain poison or fire resistance if needed.

facts.fact: Fungi and molds have a 1/4 chance of being generated on floor squares within swamps during level creation.
facts.detect: Swamp level
facts.action: Be cautious when exploring swamp levels due to the high chance of encountering dangerous molds.

facts.fact: Fountains are represented by {{blue|{}} and {{blue|¶}}
facts.detect: Fountains (represented by { or ¶)
facts.action: Approach fountains to quench thirst and restore health if hungry or thirsty

facts.fact: Thrones are represented by {{yellow|", and sitting on a throne can be beneficial or detrimental depending on alignment and the throne's alignment
facts.detect: Thrones (represented by ")
facts.action: Sit on thrones if they match your alignment or if you are a wizard (to gain experience)

facts.fact: Sinks are represented by {{lightgray|#}}
facts.detect: Sinks (represented by #)
facts.action: Avoid sinks as they can be dangerous if you are a wizard or if you have a cursed item

facts.fact: Graves are represented by {{lightgray||}}
facts.detect: Graves (represented by |)
facts.action: Avoid graves as they can contain dangerous traps or cursed items

facts.fact: Altars are represented by {{lightgray|_}}
facts.detect: Altars (represented by _)
facts.action: Approach altars to pray if you are in need of help and your alignment matches the altar's

facts.fact: G represents a gnome, which can be a gnome, gnome lord, gnomish wizard, or gnome king.
facts.detect: gnome, gnome lord, gnomish wizard, gnome king
facts.action: Approach and kill gnomes to gain experience and loot, especially gnomish wizards for potential magic items.

facts.fact: g represents a gremlin, which can be a gremlin, gargoyle, or winged gargoyle.
facts.detect: gremlin, gargoyle, winged gargoyle
facts.action: Avoid or kill gremlins as they can be dangerous and may steal your items.

facts.fact: Pressing g or shift+g activates go mode when numpad movement is off.
facts.detect: numpad movement is off
facts.action: Use go mode to move in a straight line until you encounter a wall, monster, or other interesting feature.

facts.fact: Silver dragon scale mail (SDSM) provides reflection, protecting you and your equipment from wands and breath attacks of fire, cold, and lightning, which are common and can deal tremendous amounts of damage.
facts.detect: Encountering wands of fire, cold, lightning, or breath weapons of these elements.
facts.action: Prioritize obtaining SDSM for early game protection.

facts.fact: Gray dragon scale mail (GDSM) provides magic resistance, protecting against many monster spells, including destroy armor and touch of death.
facts.detect: Encountering monsters capable of casting destroy armor or touch of death spells.
facts.action: Prioritize obtaining GDSM if facing such monsters.

facts.fact: Silver dragon scale mail (SDSM) protects against disintegration breath from black dragons.
facts.detect: Encountering a black dragon.
facts.action: Prioritize SDSM if facing black dragons.

facts.fact: Gray dragon scale mail (GDSM) protects against polymorph traps, keeping the GDSM itself safe from polymorphing.
facts.detect: Stepping on a polymorph trap.
facts.action: Prioritize GDSM if polymorph traps are a concern.

facts.fact: Silver dragon scale mail (SDSM) frees up the amulet and off-hand slots, allowing for two-weapon combat and spellcasting.
facts.detect: Wishing for SDSM and finding an amulet of life saving or a suitable weapon.
facts.action: Wish for SDSM to free up slots for amulet and off-hand items.

facts.fact: A steed can be made to gallop by kicking or applying a whip while riding. If successful, this will cause the mount's movement rate to randomly increase for certain types of movement. If unsuccessful, the rider will be forcefully dismounted from the steed.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the situation by attempting to kick or whip the steed and observing if it successfully gallops or the rider is dismounted.
facts.action: The bot should attempt to gallop the steed if the sum of the player's experience level and the steed's tameness (after kicking) is at least 21 and the steed remains tame.

facts.fact: Galloping will last for 30-49 turns.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the duration of the gallop effect by tracking the number of turns after successfully galloping the steed.
facts.action: The bot should use the gallop effect to move quickly and efficiently during the 30-49 turn window.

facts.fact: Movement that benefits from the speed boost is any command that causes multiple movements, such as shift+H, 9H, _, etc.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the eligible commands by using them and observing the increased movement speed.
facts.action: The bot should use commands like shift+H or _ to take advantage of the speed boost during galloping.

facts.fact: Each turn of galloping with eligible movement, the steeds speed is increased temporarily by either four-thirds (~1.33) or five-thirds (~1.67), averaging 1.5 times its non-galloping speed.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the speed increase by comparing movement times before and during galloping.
facts.action: The bot should maximize movement efficiency by using the speed boost to move faster and cover more ground.

facts.fact: Moving everywhere using _ travel will give you the speed boosts, even if you're only moving 1 space each time.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the speed boost by using _ travel and observing the increased movement speed.
facts.action: The bot should use _ travel extensively during the gallop to maximize movement speed and efficiency.

facts.fact: Any monster represented by an 'a' is a huge threat to an early character due to high speed and multiple attacks.
facts.detect: Monster name or symbol (e.g., soldier ant, killer bee, fire ant, giant ant, giant beetle)
facts.action: Engrave Elbereth at first sight and use attack wands if necessary.

facts.fact: Leocrotta are fast and have three highly damaging attacks but lack resistances and respect Elbereth.
facts.detect: Leocrotta name or symbol
facts.action: Engrave Elbereth and use attack wands.

facts.fact: Unicorns have potent attacks but will remain a knight's move away from you unless you are fast or invisible.
facts.detect: White, gray, or black unicorn name or symbol
facts.action: Throw a gem to pacify or engrave Elbereth.

facts.fact: Lycanthropes can infect you with lycanthropy and summon up to five normal animals of their kind.
facts.detect: Wererat, werejackal, werewolf name or symbol
facts.action: Throw a gem to pacify or engrave Elbereth and pray if infected.

facts.fact: Starting pets (horses, dogs, cats) are much faster than you and have strong attacks.
facts.detect: Brown horse, white dog, white cat name or symbol
facts.action: Tame them by throwing food they like or pacify them with other food.

facts.fact: The Riders (Famine, Pestilence, Death) are unique monsters on the Astral plane.
facts.detect: Encountering Famine, Pestilence, or Death on the Astral plane.
facts.action: Prepare for unique challenges and strategies for each Rider.

facts.fact: The Wizard of Yendor will return from the dead an infinite number of times until you reach the Astral plane.
facts.detect: Encountering the Wizard of Yendor repeatedly.
facts.action: Focus on reaching the Astral plane to stop the Wizard's endless reappearance.

facts.fact: Air Elementals on the Plane of Air are substantially stronger and can rapidly kill characters with a subpar Armor Class.
facts.detect: Encountering an Air Elemental on the Plane of Air.
facts.action: Ensure you have a quick method to defeat or neutralize Air Elementals.

facts.fact: Mind flayers and master mind flayers can cause amnesia, requiring remapping levels with The Wizard of Yendor pursuing.
facts.detect: Encountering a mind flayer or master mind flayer.
facts.action: Avoid or prepare to deal with amnesia if encountered.

facts.fact: Cockatrice corpses are a common choice on the Astral Plane but be careful with them.
facts.detect: Possession of a Cockatrice corpse.
facts.action: Handle Cockatrice corpses with extreme caution to avoid petrification.

facts.fact: A monster's gaze is rendered impotent if it is invisible, provided the victim cannot see invisible.
facts.detect: Cannot see invisible message when encountering a monster with gaze attack
facts.action: Use a scroll of remove curse or a wand of cancellation to make the monster visible

facts.fact: Blinding yourself in advance protects you from gaze attacks.
facts.detect: Blind status when encountering a monster with gaze attack
facts.action: Use a blindfold or similar item to blind yourself

facts.fact: Hallucination has a 3/4 chance of protecting you from any gaze attack.
facts.detect: Hallucination status when encountering a monster with gaze attack
facts.action: Enter hallucination state if not already

facts.fact: Monsters with gaze attacks include Floating eye, Pyrolisk, Archon, Umber hulk, Medusa, and Baalzebub.
facts.detect: Monster names Floating eye, Pyrolisk, Archon, Umber hulk, Medusa, and Baalzebub
facts.action: Avoid or prepare to fight these monsters with appropriate protections

facts.fact: Gehennom is full of mazes and contains special levels such as Asmodeus' Lair, Juiblex's swamp, Baalzebub's Lair, Orcus-town, Wizard's Tower, Fake Wizard's Towers, Vibrating Square, and Moloch's Sanctum.
facts.detect: Map features and level names
facts.action: Explore and navigate through the maze levels carefully, and be prepared for special levels with unique challenges.

facts.fact: Items generated on the floor of Gehennom levels and as local death drops follow a different distribution from the rest of the dungeon, with more weapons, armor, rings, amulets, tools, and wands, and virtually no potions, scrolls, or spellbooks outside of special levels.
facts.detect: Item distribution on the floor
facts.action: Prioritize picking up weapons, armor, rings, amulets, tools, and wands, and be cautious with potions, scrolls, and spellbooks.

facts.fact: Gehennom excludes lawful monsters and includes fire-resistant and ice-sensitive monsters.
facts.detect: Monster names and behavior
facts.action: Carry a Frost Brand or other ice-based weapon and be prepared for fire-resistant monsters.

facts.fact: Moloch is the only god with any power in Gehennom, and religious activities will only result in negative outcomes.
facts.detect: Prayer attempts and altar interactions
facts.action: Avoid praying and sacrificing at altars to prevent negative outcomes.

facts.fact: Fire resistance is recommended before entering Gehennom to prevent fire traps from reducing your maximum HP.
facts.detect: Fire traps and fire resistance status
facts.action: Obtain fire resistance before entering Gehennom and fireproof your equipment.

facts.fact: If you map level N, N+2, N+4, ... through Gehennom, you get all the others for free.
facts.detect: Arriving on an odd level number (N+1) and mapping N+2, N+4, etc.
facts.action: Map only alternate levels (N, N+2, N+4, ...) to save time and resources.

facts.fact: If the castle is at level C, you may need to map all of C+9 to C+13 to find the upstair leading to Vlad's Tower.
facts.detect: Arriving at level C+9 or higher in Gehennom.
facts.action: Map all levels from C+9 to C+13 thoroughly to find the upstair to Vlad's Tower.

facts.fact: Most players will want to avoid magically mapping the level with the vibrating square.
facts.detect: Arriving on level 70 (vibrating square level).
facts.action: Switch to digging down until you hit rock bottom to avoid the vibrating square.

facts.fact: If you have cold resistance, telepathy, teleport control and enough sources of teleports, Asmodeus can find all the upstairs and downstairs in Gehennom for you.
facts.detect: Finding Asmodeus's lair and having the required resistances and teleports.
facts.action: Chase Asmodeus up through Gehennom to locate all the stairs.

facts.fact: Using a pick-axe is recommended for digging through maze levels.
facts.detect: Having a pick-axe in inventory.
facts.action: Use the pick-axe to dig through maze levels efficiently.

facts.fact: Valuable identified gems may be sold for relatively large amounts of money at most general stores, which makes them valuable as a compact form of money.
facts.detect: Identified valuable gems (diamond, ruby, etc.)
facts.action: Sell identified valuable gems at shops for money.

facts.fact: Shopkeepers will always buy unidentified gems as if they are worthless glass, and will always sell unidentified gems as if they are valuable, possibly subject to a further 33% surcharge for being unidentified.
facts.detect: Unidentified gems
facts.action: Formally identify gems before selling them to avoid losing money.

facts.fact: Valuable gems may also be thrown to a co-aligned unicorn to get a large Luck increase.
facts.detect: Co-aligned unicorn
facts.action: Throw valuable gems to co-aligned unicorns to increase Luck.

facts.fact: An uncursed touchstone can easily separate glass from valuable gems.
facts.detect: Uncursed touchstone
facts.action: Use an uncursed touchstone to formally identify gems.

facts.fact: Gray stones can be touchstones, luckstones, loadstones, or flint stones, and unidentified gray stones are priced by shopkeepers at their normal values.
facts.detect: Gray stones
facts.action: Identify gray stones using an uncursed touchstone or by selling them.

facts.fact: Gemstone is a non-organic material that cannot normally be eaten or subjected to erosion.
facts.detect: Item descriptions or inventory listing
facts.action: Do not attempt to eat gemstone items.

facts.fact: Rings with randomized appearances of 'tiger eye', 'jade', 'agate', 'topaz', 'sapphire', 'ruby', 'diamond', or 'emerald' are made of gemstone.
facts.detect: Ring appearance descriptions
facts.action: Do not attempt to eat gemstone rings.

facts.fact: Casting stone to flesh on gemstone objects will turn them into flesh objects.
facts.detect: Casting stone to flesh spell on gemstone items
facts.action: Avoid casting stone to flesh on gemstone items unless intended to convert them into meat rings or meatballs.

facts.fact: Polypiling enough gemstone objects has a chance of creating a golem, with a roughly equal probability of creating a stone golem or a clay golem.
facts.detect: Polypiling gemstone objects
facts.action: Consider polypiling gemstone objects to potentially create a golem, but be prepared for the risk of creating a hostile stone or clay golem.

facts.fact: Genocide can take place in the form of a scroll of genocide or by #sitting on a throne. Genocides gained from a throne are always safe, while scrolls may not be if they are cursed or if you are confused.
facts.detect: Message: 'You sit on a throne.' or 'You read a scroll of genocide.'
facts.action: If reading a scroll of genocide, check if the scroll is cursed or if you are confused before proceeding.

facts.fact: Some species are widely considered to be so nasty, or so annoying, that players commonly genocide them as soon as possible: liches, mind flayers, sea monsters.
facts.detect: Encountering liches, mind flayers, or sea monsters.
facts.action: If you have a blessed scroll of genocide, genocide liches, mind flayers, and sea monsters as soon as possible.

facts.fact: Reverse genociding a cursed scroll of genocide will create 4-6 of the specified monster. Useful monsters to reverse genocide include wraiths, white dragons, nurses, tengu, kraken, mind flayers, stone giants, white unicorns, purple worms, and cockatrices.
facts.detect: Reading a cursed scroll of genocide.
facts.action: If you read a cursed scroll of genocide, consider reverse genociding wraiths, white dragons, nurses, tengu, kraken, mind flayers, stone giants, white unicorns, purple worms, or cockatrices for useful items or experience.

facts.fact: Genocide does not break the pacifist conduct, but there is a small alignment penalty for a lawful that genocides a single human species.
facts.detect: Being lawful and genociding a human species.
facts.action: Avoid genociding human species if you are lawful and want to maintain pacifist conduct.

facts.fact: If you genocide your base race or role, you will die. For dwarves, genociding dwarves with a blessed scroll of genocide is instantly fatal.
facts.detect: Being a dwarf and considering genocide of dwarves.
facts.action: Never genocide your base race or role, especially dwarves with a blessed scroll of genocide.

facts.fact: Geyser is a monster spell used by clerical spell casters at least level 14, causing 8d6 damage to the player, halved if the player has half physical damage resistance.
facts.detect: A sudden geyser slams into you from nowhere!
facts.action: Seek out and destroy or avoid high-level clerical monsters to prevent being hit by the geyser spell.

facts.fact: Monsters at level 15 or higher have a lower chance of casting the geyser spell and may use open wounds instead.
facts.detect: Level of the monster casting the spell.
facts.action: Prioritize dealing with lower-level clerical monsters that are more likely to cast the geyser spell.

facts.fact: Ghosts and shades are represented by a blank space ({{black| }}).
facts.detect: A blank space on the map where a monster should be.
facts.action: Use the SYMBOLS option to give ghosts and shades a different appearance for easier detection.

facts.fact: Ghosts and shades are medium-sized, humanoid, unsolid, and unbreathing undead monsters.
facts.detect: Encountering a ghost or shade that passes through walls or objects.
facts.action: Be prepared for ghosts and shades to move through walls and floors, and be cautious when they are nearby.

facts.fact: Ghosts and shades are always generated hostile and cannot be polymorphed or genocided.
facts.detect: Encountering a ghost or shade in the dungeon.
facts.action: Avoid or prepare to fight ghosts and shades as they cannot be avoided by polymorphing or genociding.

facts.fact: Ghosts and shades can follow a player to other levels.
facts.detect: A ghost or shade following the player to another level.
facts.action: Be cautious when moving between levels as ghosts and shades may follow.

facts.fact: Players can change the 'monsters' option to use a different symbol for ghosts and shades.
facts.detect: The default OPTIONS setting for monsters.
facts.action: Modify the OPTIONS setting to use a different symbol for ghosts and shades for better visibility.

facts.fact: Giants can break through locked doors due to their size.
facts.detect: The bot encounters a locked door and a giant is nearby.
facts.action: The bot should avoid trying to open the door manually and wait for the giant to break it.

facts.fact: Giants can pick up and throw boulders.
facts.detect: The bot sees a boulder near a giant.
facts.action: The bot should avoid standing near boulders when giants are around.

facts.fact: Giants have low monster magic resistance.
facts.detect: The bot notices a giant is vulnerable to wands and spells.
facts.action: The bot should use wands and spells against giants.

facts.fact: Giants can generate with a boulder or a club.
facts.detect: The bot sees a giant with a boulder or club.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious and prepare for a thrown boulder or melee attack.

facts.fact: Eating giant corpses can increase strength.
facts.detect: The bot finds a giant corpse.
facts.action: The bot should use a tinning kit to safely eat the giant corpse.

facts.fact: Giant humanoids are designated internally by the macro S_GIANT.
facts.detect: Not directly detectable by the bot, but relevant for understanding the monster class.
facts.action: Understand that any giant humanoid encountered will be part of the S_GIANT class.

facts.fact: Minus the ettin and minotaur, all giant humanoids are capable of walking over, lifting and throwing boulders.
facts.detect: Encounter a giant humanoid walking over a boulder or lifting/throwing one.
facts.action: Avoid boulder-related traps and areas with boulders when facing giant humanoids, except ettin and minotaur.

facts.fact: The non-unique giants in the monster class can generate as peaceful towards heroes of the same alignment, while the ettin and minotaur are always generated as hostile.
facts.detect: Encounter a giant humanoid that is peaceful or hostile.
facts.action: Approach peaceful giants cautiously and be prepared for combat with ettin and minotaur.

facts.fact: The giant humanoid is the second quest monster class for Valkyries, and makes up 6/175 (~3.42%) of the monsters randomly generated on the Valkyrie quest.
facts.detect: Reaching the Valkyrie quest level.
facts.action: Expect to encounter giant humanoids frequently during the Valkyrie quest.

facts.fact: Giant humanoids are large enough to always leave corpses upon death.
facts.detect: Killing a giant humanoid and observing the corpse.
facts.action: Collect corpses for potential use in magic or as food.

facts.fact: Glass items, except for artifacts and gems, will always be destroyed if damaged.
facts.detect: Any glass item that is damaged or thrown from a height.
facts.action: Avoid damaging or throwing glass items from a height, especially valuable ones like the Orb of Fate.

facts.fact: Potions will always shatter when subjected to damage and may release vapors.
facts.detect: Shattering sound of a potion or vapor release effect.
facts.action: Handle potions with care to avoid dropping or damaging them.

facts.fact: Glass armor has a 10% chance of becoming cracked and increasing erosion level when damaged.
facts.detect: Armor becoming cracked or increasing erosion level.
facts.action: Avoid damaging glass armor and consider erosion-proofing it.

facts.fact: Wands made of glass have a minimum strength requirement of 5 to apply and break them.
facts.detect: Wand with randomized appearance of 'glass wand' or 'crystal wand'.
facts.action: Handle glass wands with care to avoid breaking them accidentally.

facts.fact: Polypiling enough glass objects has a chance of creating a glass golem.
facts.detect: Stacking multiple glass objects.
facts.action: Avoid polypiling glass objects to prevent accidental creation of a glass golem.

facts.fact: Eating any tin that contains fried monster (i.e., deep fried, french fried or stir fried) can make the hero's fingers slippery for 11-15 turns.
facts.detect: Eating a tin of fried monster
facts.action: Avoid eating tins of fried monster unless in a safe location with a non-cursed towel nearby to clean slippery fingers.

facts.fact: Applying a cursed towel or cursed can of grease can make the hero's fingers slippery for 11-15 turns.
facts.detect: Applying a cursed towel or can of grease
facts.action: Avoid using cursed towels or cans of grease unless in a safe location with a non-cursed towel nearby to clean slippery fingers.

facts.fact: Applying or dipping a cursed potion of oil can make the hero's fingers slippery for 11-15 turns.
facts.detect: Applying or dipping a cursed potion of oil
facts.action: Avoid applying or dipping cursed potions of oil unless in a safe location with a non-cursed towel nearby to clean slippery fingers.

facts.fact: While a hero's fingers are slippery, non-cursed rings may slip from their fingers.
facts.detect: Rings slipping from fingers
facts.action: Ensure rings are blessed or worn on all fingers to prevent slipping, and carry a non-cursed towel to clean slippery fingers.

facts.fact: Items dropped in a shop as a result of slippery fingers automatically become the property of the shopkeeper.
facts.detect: Dropping items in a shop
facts.action: Avoid eating or using items that can cause slippery fingers in shops.

facts.fact: Globs of gray ooze, brown pudding, and green slime are considered vegetarian but not vegan, while globs of black pudding are neither vegetarian nor vegan.
facts.detect: Item name (glob of gray ooze, glob of brown pudding, glob of green slime, glob of black pudding)
facts.action: Eat vegetarian globs to break vegetarian conduct but not vegan conduct. Avoid eating black pudding globs if you want to maintain vegetarian or vegan conduct.

facts.fact: Eating globs of gray ooze, brown pudding, or green slime can grant resistances such as fire, cold, shock, or poison resistance.
facts.detect: Item name (glob of gray ooze, glob of brown pudding, glob of green slime)
facts.action: Eat these globs to gain resistances, especially if you need poison resistance or other applicable intrinsic resistances.

facts.fact: Globs of green slime always cause sliming when eaten unless the hero is in the form of a fiery monster.
facts.detect: Item name (glob of green slime)
facts.action: Avoid eating green slime globs unless you are in a fiery monster form or have a way to prevent sliming.

facts.fact: Two globs of the same type can coalesce into a larger glob if they are on the same floor squares, adjacent floor squares, or in the same inventory or container.
facts.detect: Message (The [adjacent] globs of coalesce.)
facts.action: Separate globs of the same type to prevent them from merging and to increase the chances of obtaining desired resistances.

facts.fact: Globs are acidic and will cure stoning when bitten into.
facts.detect: Item name (glob of green slime)
facts.action: Eat a glob of green slime to cure stoning if you are a stoned character and in a fiery monster form.

facts.fact: A glorkum is a glitched item with an unknown category, named 'glorkum' followed by three integers.
facts.detect: You drop a glorkum 1 0 0.
facts.action: Avoid interacting with the glorkum and report the bug to the developers.

facts.fact: Gauntlets of power provide strength 25 and interfere with spellcasting.
facts.detect: Gauntlets of power
facts.action: Wear gauntlets of power to increase strength and carrying capacity, but be prepared to remove them when casting spells.

facts.fact: Gauntlets of dexterity provide a dexterity bonus, which is useful for attacks that do not involve luck.
facts.detect: Gauntlets of dexterity
facts.action: Wear gauntlets of dexterity if you need a dexterity boost for attacks that do not rely on luck, such as throwing potions or casting magic missile.

facts.fact: Leather gloves provide no special properties but do not inhibit spellcasting.
facts.detect: Leather gloves
facts.action: Wear leather gloves if you need to cast spells without interference.

facts.fact: Cursed gloves prevent putting on or removing rings.
facts.detect: Cursed gloves
facts.action: Avoid wearing cursed gloves to prevent being unable to manage your rings.

facts.fact: Gauntlets of fumbling are usually generated cursed and cause fumbling.
facts.detect: Gauntlets of fumbling
facts.action: Do not put on unknown magical gloves without curse testing to avoid fumbling.

facts.fact: If you are a gnomish player, dwarf and gnome monsters are more likely to be peaceful.
facts.detect: Encountering a gnome or dwarf monster with a peaceful attitude.
facts.action: Approach and interact peacefully with these monsters if you are a gnomish player.

facts.fact: Eating a monster is cannibalism for a gnomish player if the monster is a gnome or dwarf.
facts.detect: Attempting to eat a corpse of a gnome or dwarf monster.
facts.action: Avoid eating corpses of gnome or dwarf monsters to prevent cannibalism.

facts.fact: A sacrifice is considered of your own race for a dwarven player if the sacrifice is a gnome or dwarf.
facts.detect: Attempting to sacrifice a gnome or dwarf monster.
facts.action: Avoid sacrificing gnome or dwarf monsters to prevent same-race sacrifice.

facts.fact: Gnomes are peaceful towards gnomish and dwarven heroes, and hostile towards heroes of other races.
facts.detect: The bot's race is dwarven and the monster is a gnome (uppercase G).
facts.action: Approach and interact with gnomes peacefully if the bot is a dwarven hero.

facts.fact: Gnomes may collect items they can use, such as weapons, armor, and wands.
facts.detect: Gnome carrying or picking up items.
facts.action: Avoid letting gnomes pick up dangerous items like wands or tools.

facts.fact: Gnomes are generated in large numbers in the Gnomish Mines and Minetown.
facts.detect: Entering the Gnomish Mines or Minetown levels.
facts.action: Be cautious and prepared for large numbers of gnomes.

facts.fact: Gnomes have a chance of being generated with a candle, which may be lit in dark areas.
facts.detect: Gnome with a lit candle in a dark area.
facts.action: Be cautious of gnomes with lit candles in dark areas.

facts.fact: Gnomes can be generated with offensive and defensive items, including weapons and armor.
facts.detect: Gnome with a weapon or armor.
facts.action: Be cautious of gnomes equipped with weapons or armor.

page: Gnome With the Wand of Death

facts.fact: Intelligent monsters can pick up and use wands, including very powerful ones like the wand of death.
facts.detect: Encounter with a gnome, hobbit, goblin, or kobold carrying a wand of death.
facts.action: Avoid or kill the monster immediately to prevent it from using the wand.

facts.fact: Magic resistance does not protect against elemental wands like the wand of cold and wand of lightning.
facts.detect: Being hit by a wand of cold or wand of lightning while having magic resistance.
facts.action: Identify and avoid elemental wands or ensure you have protection against them.

facts.fact: Hostile intelligent monsters may use wands against you even if their normal attacks would not damage you.
facts.detect: Encounter with a foocubi, nymph, or nurse.
facts.action: Be cautious and avoid or disarm these monsters to prevent them from using wands.

facts.fact: Nymphs can steal wands from you to zap, especially on non-teleport levels.
facts.detect: A nymph stealing a wand from your inventory.
facts.action: Keep wands in a safe place or use them immediately to prevent theft.

facts.fact: Picking up and engraving-test unknown wands can identify them and reduce the risk of encountering a dangerous wand.
facts.detect: Finding an unknown wand on the floor.
facts.action: Pick up and engrave-test the wand to identify it.

facts.fact: Gnome leaders are generated in the Gnomish Mines and Minetown with a chance of being hostile to non-gnomish and non-dwarven heroes.
facts.detect: Encounter hostile gnome leader in Gnomish Mines or Minetown.
facts.action: Avoid direct confrontation if not prepared; use ranged attacks or magic resistance if available.

facts.fact: Gnome leaders have a 5/12 chance of being generated with offensive items such as darts, crossbows, bows, daggers, or aklys.
facts.detect: Gnome leader with ranged weapon or multiple darts/daggers.
facts.action: Use ranged attacks or magic resistance to counter; avoid melee if possible.

facts.fact: Gnome leaders can collect items and use them against the player.
facts.detect: Gnome leader picking up items.
facts.action: Stealthily avoid or prepare for combat with magic resistance or ranged attacks.

facts.fact: Gnome leaders respect Elbereth but will still use ranged attacks when fleeing.
facts.detect: Gnome leader running away and using ranged attacks.
facts.action: Continue to use Elbereth to slow down the gnome leader.

facts.fact: Gnome leaders have a 1/6 chance of being generated with a candle in the Gnomish Mines.
facts.detect: Gnome leader with a candle.
facts.action: Be cautious of potential light sources that could reveal hidden items or monsters.

facts.fact: The level contains ten drow, seven ogres, fourteen random objects, and six random traps.
facts.detect: Encountering drow, ogres, traps, and objects on the level.
facts.action: Be cautious of traps and avoid unnecessary fights with drow and ogres to conserve resources.

facts.fact: The walls of the Lair are undiggable; teleportation is permitted.
facts.detect: Attempting to dig and finding it impossible.
facts.action: Use teleportation to bypass undiggable walls and avoid direct confrontation with Lareth.

facts.fact: Lareth will occasionally utter maledictions.
facts.detect: Hearing Lareth's maledictions.
facts.action: Maintain neutral alignment to avoid being targeted by Lareth's maledictions.

facts.fact: When picking up the Pick of Flandal Steelskin, it grants fire resistance and warning.
facts.detect: Picking up the Pick of Flandal Steelskin.
facts.action: Equip the Pick of Flandal Steelskin to gain fire resistance and warning.

facts.fact: The Pick of Flandal Steelskin deals double damage to non-aligned monsters not resistant to fire.
facts.detect: Attacking non-aligned monsters with the Pick of Flandal Steelskin.
facts.action: Use the Pick of Flandal Steelskin against non-aligned monsters to maximize damage.

facts.fact: A gnome ruler is the strongest type of gnome and has a weapon attack that deals 2d6 physical damage.
facts.detect: Encountering a hostile gnome ruler or seeing the message 'You feel very comfortable here.' when sitting on a throne as a gnome ruler.
facts.action: Prepare for combat with a gnome ruler by ensuring you have adequate AC and HP, and consider using ranged attacks or wands of sleep to avoid melee.

facts.fact: Gnome rulers have a 20 MR score and no special resistances, but they can use magical items such as wands and scrolls.
facts.detect: Observing a gnome ruler using a wand or scroll in combat.
facts.action: Carry wands of sleep or other offensive wands to counteract the gnome ruler's use of magical items.

facts.fact: Gnome rulers have a 10 AC and can collect items that they can use, including enchanted weapons and candles.
facts.detect: Seeing a gnome ruler pick up items or carrying an enchanted weapon.
facts.action: Avoid letting a gnome ruler collect items and ensure you have a mix of escape items and ranged attacks.

facts.fact: Gnome rulers may be encountered in the Gnomish Mines and Minetown, especially in throne rooms and specific rooms.
facts.detect: Entering the Gnomish Mines or Minetown and encountering a gnome ruler.
facts.action: Be cautious in these areas and prepare for potential encounters with gnome rulers.

facts.fact: A gnome ruler may be generated with a candle, which has a chance of being lit and used against the player.
facts.detect: Seeing a gnome ruler carrying a lit candle.
facts.action: Avoid being in dark areas where a gnome ruler may use a lit candle against you.

facts.fact: The entrance to the Gnomish Mines will always generate somewhere on dungeon levels 2-4.
facts.detect: The bot will notice the entrance to the Gnomish Mines when it reaches dungeon levels 2-4.
facts.action: The bot should prepare for the entrance to the Gnomish Mines by ensuring it has enough food, light sources, and tools before venturing into these levels.

facts.fact: Gnomish Mines levels will have 6 random traps, one tool, 3 random gems or piles of gems, and 3 random objects.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter traps, tools, gems, and random objects as it explores the Gnomish Mines.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious around traps, search before stepping on uncertain squares, and collect tools and gems for later use.

facts.fact: The Mines are rich in tools, loot, and other resources, but also very dangerous to the unprepared.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter hostile monsters, traps, and loot in the Gnomish Mines.
facts.action: The bot should move cautiously, avoid traps, and be willing to back off and try again later if it gets in over its head.

facts.fact: Be careful of gray stones. Kick any gray stone before picking it up, or else you might get a load stone.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter gray stones in the Gnomish Mines.
facts.action: The bot should kick any gray stone before picking it up to avoid getting a load stone.

facts.fact: The lower mines, all the way to Mines' End, are much more dangerous to most players than the upper mines due to traps.
facts.detect: The bot will notice that it is in the lower mines when it reaches deeper levels of the Gnomish Mines.
facts.action: The bot should be extra cautious in the lower mines, avoid traps, and ensure it has magic resistance and poison resistance before venturing further.

facts.fact: Each role's pantheon contains one lawful, one neutral, and one chaotic god.
facts.detect: The bot's role determines the pantheon of gods.
facts.action: Identify the lawful god of the chosen role to know who to sacrifice the Amulet of Yendor to.

facts.fact: Atheist conduct tries to avoid actions directly involving any of the gods and other aspects of religion.
facts.detect: The bot's conduct is set to atheist.
facts.action: Avoid praying, sacrificing, or engraving Elbereth to maintain atheist conduct.

facts.fact: Elbereth is an elf-goddess whose name can be engraved to frighten most (but not all) monsters.
facts.detect: The bot encounters a monster that is frightened by Elbereth.
facts.action: Engrave Elbereth to scare away monsters.

facts.fact: Moloch is the unaligned god who holds dominion over prayers and altars in Gehennom.
facts.detect: The bot enters Gehennom and encounters Moloch's altars.
facts.action: Pray at Moloch's altars in Gehennom if needed.

facts.fact: The Convict and Pirate patches add new roles with their own pantheons.
facts.detect: The bot's role is not one of the standard roles.
facts.action: Identify the specific pantheon of the chosen role to know the correct god to sacrifice the Amulet to.

facts.fact: Metallivores can eat any gold item minus the Candelabrum.
facts.detect: Encountering rock moles or xorns with gold items in inventory or on the level.
facts.action: Avoid carrying gold items except the Candelabrum when in areas where metallivores are common.

facts.fact: A noncursed scroll of gold detection will reveal all gold pieces and gold golems on the level; a blessed scroll will additionally reveal other items made of gold.
facts.detect: Using a scroll of gold detection.
facts.action: Use a scroll of gold detection to locate gold pieces and items made of gold, especially before attempting to create a gold golem.

facts.fact: Polypiling enough gold items may create a gold golem.
facts.detect: Having a large number of gold items in inventory.
facts.action: Polypile gold items to attempt to create a gold golem, which can be a powerful ally.

facts.fact: Gold lovers will catch gold thrown at them and have a 25% chance of becoming hostile thereby.
facts.detect: Throwing gold at a gold lover and observing if it becomes hostile.
facts.action: Avoid throwing gold at gold lovers to prevent hostility.

facts.fact: Gold lovers may be generated with some gold depending on the level difficulty.
facts.detect: Observing gold lovers with gold in their inventory.
facts.action: Stealthily approach and steal gold from gold lovers if possible.

facts.fact: Gold lovers may seek you out if you are mimicking a gold piece.
facts.detect: Being mimicked as a gold piece and observing gold lovers moving towards you.
facts.action: Avoid mimicking as a gold piece in the presence of gold lovers.

facts.fact: All varieties of dwarf are gold lovers.
facts.detect: Encountering any variety of dwarf.
facts.action: Be cautious with dwarves and avoid throwing gold at them.

facts.fact: Leprechauns are gold lovers and have a special steal gold attack.
facts.detect: Encountering a leprechaun.
facts.action: Avoid provoking leprechauns to prevent their steal gold attack.

facts.fact: Golems are large and nonliving humanoid monsters that are neutral-aligned, and are all unbreathing and mindless.
facts.detect: Monster name and description in game
facts.action: Avoid melee combat with golems if possible due to their high HP and lack of fear.

facts.fact: Golems typically attack using their 'claws' with the exception of the iron golem, which is the only golem that can wield and attack with weapons.
facts.detect: Monster name and description in game
facts.action: Be cautious around iron golems as they can wield weapons and deal more damage.

facts.fact: Golems possess sleep resistance and poison resistance.
facts.detect: Monster name and description in game
facts.action: Avoid using sleep or poison attacks on golems.

facts.fact: Any golem subjected to stoning will turn into a stone golem if they are not yet extinct.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel the ground shake as a golem turns to stone.'
facts.action: Avoid stoning attacks near golems unless you want to create a stone golem.

facts.fact: Iron golems drop 2-12 iron chains upon death, while rope golems drop 2-3 leashes and/or bullwhips upon death.
facts.detect: Item drop messages after killing a golem
facts.action: Loot iron chains and leashes/bullwhips from iron and rope golems respectively.

facts.fact: A graveyard level is a level where undead creatures are less likely to leave corpses - there is a 9/10 chance of an undead monster leaving a corpse if you kill it, and a 1/3 chance otherwise.
facts.detect: Killing an undead monster and checking if it leaves a corpse.
facts.action: Be prepared to deal with fewer corpses from undead, which means less food and fewer items.

facts.fact: Wraiths are a common occurrence in graveyards, and their corpses are highly desirable.
facts.detect: Encountering wraiths and noting their corpses.
facts.action: Prioritize killing wraiths and preserving their corpses for later use.

facts.fact: The Castle is considered a graveyard level.
facts.detect: Being on the Castle level.
facts.action: Expect fewer corpses from undead and be cautious of wraiths.

facts.fact: Undead deal twice normal damage between 00:00 and 00:59.
facts.detect: The message 'away! away!' when entering a graveyard during these hours.
facts.action: Avoid entering graveyards during these hours or be prepared for increased danger.

facts.fact: Graveyards are capable of generating major demons outside of Gehennom.
facts.detect: Encountering major demons in a graveyard level.
facts.action: Be prepared for the possibility of fighting major demons in graveyards.

facts.fact: Gray dragon scale mail (GDSM) confers 9 base AC and magic resistance.
facts.detect: Wearing gray dragon scale mail
facts.action: Prioritize obtaining and wearing gray dragon scale mail for its magic resistance and AC.

facts.fact: Uncontrolled polymorph while wearing GDSM will revert them to scales and turn the wearer into a gray dragon.
facts.detect: Quaffing a potion of polymorph or zapping a wand of polymorph at yourself
facts.action: Avoid uncontrolled polymorph while wearing GDSM to prevent turning into a gray dragon.

facts.fact: GDSM is one of the two most coveted types of dragon scale mail, with the other being silver dragon scale mail.
facts.detect: Finding or wishing for gray dragon scale mail
facts.action: Consider wishing for gray dragon scale mail early in the game for its magic resistance and AC.

facts.fact: GDSM keeps the cloak slot open, which can be used for a source of MC3 if desired.
facts.detect: Having the cloak slot available
facts.action: Use the cloak slot for a source of MC3 if you have GDSM.

facts.fact: GDSM protects against teleport traps, level teleporters, polymorph traps, and monster spells cast by vicious spellcasters.
facts.detect: Encountering teleport traps, level teleporters, polymorph traps, or spellcasting monsters
facts.action: Wear GDSM to protect against these hazards.

facts.fact: Gray dragon scales are a type of body armor with AC 3 and provide magic resistance.
facts.detect: Item name: gray dragon scales
facts.action: Equip gray dragon scales for their AC and magic resistance.

facts.fact: Gray dragon scales have a 1/3 chance of being dropped by a gray dragon's corpse and a 1/20 chance if the dragon is revived by undead turning.
facts.detect: Monster name: gray dragon
facts.action: Search for gray dragon corpses or revive gray dragons to find gray dragon scales.

facts.fact: Gray dragon scales are always generated +0 and uncursed when dropped by a gray dragon.
facts.detect: Item name: gray dragon scales with +0 and uncursed status
facts.action: Keep gray dragon scales uncursed and +0 until enchanted with scrolls of enchant armor.

facts.fact: Reading a non-cursed scroll of enchant armor on gray dragon scales will convert them into gray dragon scale mail.
facts.detect: Item name: gray dragon scales, scroll of enchant armor
facts.action: Use scrolls of enchant armor on gray dragon scales to upgrade them.

facts.fact: Uncontrolled polymorph while wearing gray dragon scales will turn the wearer into a gray dragon.
facts.detect: Message: You feel a strange transformation coming over you.
facts.action: Avoid uncontrolled polymorph while wearing gray dragon scales.

facts.fact: All gray stones except cursed loadstones can be thrown or slung.
facts.detect: Attempting to throw or sling a gray stone
facts.action: Throw or sling the stone to test if it breaks (flint) or remains intact (luckstone, touchstone, loadstone)

facts.fact: If an unidentified gray stone is in a container, use #tip rather than #loot to remove the stone.
facts.detect: Gray stone inside a container
facts.action: Use #tip to remove the stone from the container

facts.fact: If your strength is 3, and you are neither Samurai nor Monk nor wearing kicking boots, all objects will produce 'Thump!', so this method doesn't work.
facts.detect: Strength of 3 and not wearing kicking boots
facts.action: Wait until strength increases to at least 4 before attempting to kick the stone

facts.fact: Rubbing an iron item on a touchstone produces its signature 'scritch, scritch'.
facts.detect: Rubbing an iron item on a gray stone
facts.action: Listen for 'scritch, scritch' to identify a touchstone

facts.fact: Price identification: the base price of a luckstone is 60 zorkmids, a touchstone is 45 zorkmids, and a flint stone or loadstone is 1 zorkmid.
facts.detect: Using price identification on a gray stone
facts.action: Identify the stone by its price

facts.fact: Green dragon scale mail provides poison resistance and base AC of 9.
facts.detect: Wearing green dragon scale mail
facts.action: Wear green dragon scale mail for poison resistance and AC boost.

facts.fact: Uncontrolled polymorph while wearing green dragon scale mail will revert them to scales and turn the wearer into a green dragon.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a green dragon
facts.action: Avoid uncontrolled polymorph while wearing green dragon scale mail.

facts.fact: Green dragon scale mail may be a better option than gray dragon scale mail or silver dragon scale mail for conduct players who cannot eat.
facts.detect: Being a foodless atheist or similar conduct player
facts.action: Consider green dragon scale mail for its poison resistance if you cannot eat.

facts.fact: Green dragon scale mail provides sickness resistance, which can be useful against Demogorgon.
facts.detect: Fighting Demogorgon
facts.action: Wear green dragon scale mail when fighting Demogorgon for sickness resistance.

facts.fact: Green dragon scales confer poison resistance while worn.
facts.detect: Item name: green dragon scales
facts.action: Equip green dragon scales if available and needed for poison resistance.

facts.fact: Green dragon scales have a 3/20 chance of being dropped by a green dragon revived by wand of undead turning or spell of turn undead.
facts.detect: Message: 'The green dragon collapses into a pile of green dragon scales.'
facts.action: Wish for or look for bones with green dragon scales if needed.

facts.fact: Green dragon scales can be converted into green dragon scale mail by reading a scroll of enchant armor.
facts.detect: Item name: green dragon scales, scroll of enchant armor
