facts.fact: Nymphs can steal items, making it useful to carry extra junk to reduce the chance of losing important items.
facts.detect: Encounter with a nymph.
facts.action: Carry extra junk items to reduce the chance of nymph stealing useful items.

facts.fact: Curse items fodder: Having extra junk items in inventory can protect useful items from being cursed by monsters that can cast curse items.
facts.detect: Encounter with a monster that can cast curse items.
facts.action: Carry extra junk items to protect useful items from being cursed.

facts.fact: Polyfodder: Junk items can be polymorphed into something useful.
facts.detect: Possession of junk items and access to a source of polymorph.
facts.action: Polymorph junk items into useful items.

facts.fact: Junk items can be disposed of by various methods such as engraving Elbereth, throwing into water or lava, letting metallivores or gelatinous cubes eat them, or dropping into pits.
facts.detect: Presence of junk items and access to disposal methods.
facts.action: Dispose of junk items using appropriate methods to keep inventory clean.

facts.fact: K represents a Keystone Kop, including Kop Sergeant, Kop Lieutenant, and Kop Kaptain
facts.detect: Keystone Kop, Kop Sergeant, Kop Lieutenant, Kop Kaptain
facts.action: Be cautious and prepare for combat if encountering Keystone Kops, as they can be numerous and persistent

facts.fact: K represents a kobold, including large kobold, kobold lord, and kobold shaman
facts.detect: kobold, large kobold, kobold lord, kobold shaman
facts.action: Engage in combat or avoid if low on hit points or weapons

facts.fact: Press k to move north if numpad movement is off
facts.detect: numpad movement is off
facts.action: Use k to move north when navigating the dungeon

facts.fact: Press k to kick if numpad movement is on
facts.detect: numpad movement is on
facts.action: Use k to kick objects or doors when needed

facts.fact: Kary, the Fiend of Fire, has a difficulty level of 16 and is found on level 12.
facts.detect: Encountering a gigantic, red '&' symbol on the map.
facts.action: Avoid engaging Kary until the bot is significantly stronger or has fire resistance and other defensive measures.

facts.fact: Kary has resistance to fire, cold, and poison.
facts.detect: Kary is unaffected by fireballs or cold-based attacks.
facts.action: Use non-elemental attacks or items to damage Kary.

facts.fact: Kary can see invisible and has infravision.
facts.detect: Kary moves towards the bot even when it is invisible or in darkness.
facts.action: Use stealth tactics or avoid areas where Kary is present.

facts.fact: Kary is a hostile, slithy, and nasty demon.
facts.detect: Kary attacks the bot on sight.
facts.action: Prioritize avoiding or preparing for encounters with Kary.

facts.fact: Kary does not leave a corpse after death.
facts.detect: Kary disappears without leaving a corpse after being killed.
facts.action: Ensure the bot has the necessary items or preparations before attempting to kill Kary.

facts.fact: A hero gains a +2 to-hit bonus when attacking kebabable monsters using any weapon with the spear skill.
facts.detect: Monster names or descriptions indicating they belong to classes D, H, J, N, or X (e.g., Naga, Dragon, Harpy)
facts.action: Use a spear or any weapon with the spear skill to attack these monsters for a +2 to-hit bonus.

facts.fact: Kebabable monsters include classes D (Dragon), H (Harpy), J (Jelly), N (Naga), and X (Xorn).
facts.detect: Monster names or descriptions indicating they belong to these classes.
facts.action: Identify and prioritize these monsters for spear attacks to maximize the +2 to-hit bonus.

facts.fact: Kebabable status is most useful for training spear skill in early stages of the game.
facts.detect: Early game stages, low weapon skill in spears.
facts.action: Use kebabable monsters to train spear skill by taking advantage of the +2 to-hit bonus.

facts.fact: Most kebabable monsters are encountered later in the game when to-hit is less of a problem.
facts.detect: Encountering kebabable monsters in later levels or branches.
facts.action: Consider using other tactics or weapons against these monsters in later stages.

facts.fact: Keystone Kops are generated if you steal from a shop and step outside near the shop.
facts.detect: Stealing from a shop and stepping outside near it.
facts.action: Avoid stealing from shops to prevent Keystone Kops from appearing.

facts.fact: Each swarm of Kops consists of DL + d5 ordinary Kops, {{frac|3}} + 1 as many Kop Sergeants, {{frac|6}} as many Kop Lieutenants, and {{frac|12}} as many Kop Kaptains.
facts.detect: Seeing a large group of Kops with varying ranks.
facts.action: Prepare for combat or find a way to avoid them.

facts.fact: Kops have a 40% chance of respawning elsewhere on the level when they die.
facts.detect: Kops dying and respawning elsewhere.
facts.action: Be prepared for Kops to respawn and block your path.

facts.fact: Kops can pick up items and respect Elbereth.
facts.detect: Kops picking up items or avoiding Elbereth-protected areas.
facts.action: Use Elbereth to deter Kops from picking up items or blocking your path.

facts.fact: Kops can be a good source of experience and cream pies.
facts.detect: Kops in the dungeon.
facts.action: Consider using a single gold piece to generate Kops for experience and loot if you are prepared.

facts.fact: Khaamnun tannin has a pull attack that draws the target closer and switches to mindwipe attacks when adjacent.
facts.detect: Pull attack message (e.g., 'You feel a strange force pulling you closer!')
facts.action: Avoid getting too close to the Khaamnun tannin and use ranged attacks or spells to keep distance.

facts.fact: Mindwipe attacks drain one level from the target and cause amnesia proportional to the fraction of levels lost.
facts.detect: Mindwipe attack message (e.g., 'You feel your mind being wiped clean!')
facts.action: Equip magic cancellation or resist mindwipe to mitigate damage.

facts.fact: Khaamnun tannin jets 4 squares away from the source of any attack, allowing it to evade subsequent melee attacks.
facts.detect: Jetting movement (e.g., 'The khaamnun tannin jets away!')
facts.action: Use ranged attacks or spells to avoid melee combat.

facts.fact: Forgetfulness madness increases spell timeout and periodically loses levels to mindwipe.
facts.detect: Forgetfulness madness message (e.g., 'You feel your mind slipping away...')
facts.action: Keep sanity high and avoid prolonged exposure to Khaamnun tannin.

facts.fact: Kicking a peaceful monster will anger it.
facts.detect: Peaceful monster name
facts.action: Avoid kicking peaceful monsters or be prepared to fight.

facts.fact: Kicking a stack of gold pieces will scatter them and awaken nearby sleeping monsters.
facts.detect: Stack of gold pieces
facts.action: Avoid kicking gold pieces unless necessary.

facts.fact: Kicking a fragile object will break it and may cause damage to the hero.
facts.detect: Fragile object name
facts.action: Avoid kicking fragile objects.

facts.fact: Kicking a closed door while levitating will cause physical damage and may wound the hero's legs.
facts.detect: Closed door
facts.action: Avoid kicking closed doors while levitating.

facts.fact: Kicking a statue trap will activate it and bring the statue to life.
facts.detect: Statue trap
facts.action: Avoid kicking statue traps.

facts.fact: Successfully kicking down doors exercises strength unless the door was trapped, in which case the resulting explosion abuses strength instead.
facts.detect: Message: 'You kick down a door.' followed by explosion sound effects or message.
facts.action: Avoid kicking trapped doors to prevent strength abuse.

facts.fact: Kicking a secret door or secret corridor may reveal the door or passage, exercising dexterity, or cause physical damage and abuse dexterity and strength.
facts.detect: Message: 'Crash! You kick open a secret door!' or 'Crash! You uncover a secret door!' or similar.
facts.action: Be cautious when kicking unknown doors or corridors.

facts.fact: Kicking a throne has a chance of destroying it and leaving gold, a chance of knocking loose gold and gems, or a chance of opening a trap door.
facts.detect: Message: 'You kick the throne.' followed by messages about gold, gems, or trap door.
facts.action: Consider kicking thrones for potential rewards but be prepared for traps.

facts.fact: Kicking an altar exercises dexterity but may cause physical damage and anger the god of the altar, affecting alignment and luck.
facts.detect: Message: 'You kick the altar.' followed by messages about damage, alignment penalties, or god's wrath.
facts.action: Avoid kicking altars to maintain alignment and luck.

facts.fact: Kicking a headstone may cause physical damage, generate a hostile ghoul, or destroy the headstone.
facts.detect: Message: 'You kick the headstone.' followed by messages about damage, ghoul, or destroyed headstone.
facts.action: Avoid kicking headstones to prevent damage and ghoul generation.

facts.fact: You cannot kick a monster while levitating due to their size.
facts.detect: You failed to kick a monster while levitating due to their size.
facts.action: Avoid kicking monsters while levitating to prevent failure.

facts.fact: A monster can block your kick attempt.
facts.detect: A monster blocked your kick attempt.
facts.action: Be cautious when attempting to kick a monster if it is blocking your path.

facts.fact: A monster can dodge your kick and move to an adjacent square.
facts.detect: A monster dodging your kick and moving to another square.
facts.action: Be prepared for monsters to move after dodging your kick.

facts.fact: A successful kick sends a monster reeling.
facts.detect: A monster reels from the blow.
facts.action: Continue to kick monsters if they are reeling to potentially defeat them faster.

facts.fact: A hero performing a kick attack with training in martial arts will use that skill when calculating to-hit and damage.
facts.detect: The bot should check if it has martial arts training and is using a kick attack command.
facts.action: If the bot has martial arts training, it should use kick attacks to improve its chances of hitting and dealing damage.

facts.fact: Kicking boots are not checked for during monster-versus-monster combat that involves kicks.
facts.detect: The bot should notice when it is fighting a monster that can perform a kick attack.
facts.action: The bot should avoid using kicking boots when fighting monsters that can perform kick attacks to prevent damage.

facts.fact: Kicks that target thick-skinned monsters will have their base damage reduced to 0 before bonuses are applied.
facts.detect: The bot should identify thick-skinned monsters such as trolls, ogres, and orcs.
facts.action: The bot should avoid using kick attacks against thick-skinned monsters unless it has significant bonuses to damage.

facts.fact: A kick attack will cause passive attacks from the defender to trigger, and kicks used against a target with passive disenchantment attacks can drain a point of enchantment from the attacker's boots.
facts.detect: The bot should identify monsters that can perform passive disenchantment attacks such as certain demons and undead.
facts.action: The bot should avoid using kick attacks against monsters that can perform passive disenchantment attacks to prevent damage to its boots.

facts.fact: Using a kick attack on a cockatrice or chickatrice without wearing boots will turn the attacker to stone.
facts.detect: The bot should identify cockatrices and chickatrices.
facts.action: The bot should avoid using kick attacks against cockatrices and chickatrices unless it is wearing boots.

facts.fact: All knife weapons other than the scalpel are designed to be thrown.
facts.detect: Weapon name (knife, stiletto, worm tooth, crysknife)
facts.action: Use knives for throwing when possible, especially at skilled level or better for Healers.

facts.fact: The knife is the only weapon class that gives Healers a multishot bonus when thrown at Skilled level or better.
facts.detect: Weapon name (knife) and player role (Healer)
facts.action: If playing as a Healer, aim to reach skilled level or better with knives to gain multishot bonus.

facts.fact: The crysknife has damage roughly comparable to a long sword.
facts.detect: Weapon name (crysknife)
facts.action: Prioritize picking up and using the crysknife in melee combat.

facts.fact: The scalpel has damage on par with an orcish dagger.
facts.detect: Weapon name (scalpel)
facts.action: Use the scalpel in melee combat as it has better damage than other knives.

facts.fact: Knights start with a +1 long sword and a +1 lance, and have a chance to transform the long sword into Excalibur at level 5.
facts.detect: Player character starts with a +1 long sword and a +1 lance. Upon reaching level 5, the player can dip the long sword into a fountain.
facts.action: Keep the +1 long sword and attempt to transform it into Excalibur at level 5. Use the lance sparingly to avoid breaking it.

facts.fact: Knights have a special jump ability that allows them to move two squares horizontally and one square vertically (or vice versa).
facts.detect: Player character can jump like a knight piece in chess.
facts.action: Use the jump ability to escape dangerous situations or to reach high places.

facts.fact: Knights take half damage from breaking wands by applying them.
facts.detect: Player character breaks a wand.
facts.action: Use wands more freely, as breaking them is less dangerous.

facts.fact: Knights have a +2 bonus to casting emergency spells.
facts.detect: Player character is casting an emergency spell.
facts.action: Use emergency spells more frequently due to the bonus.

facts.fact: Knights can utilize the #turn command to turn away undead, with a chance to pacify them.
facts.detect: Player character encounters undead monsters.
facts.action: Use the #turn command to turn away or pacify undead monsters.

facts.fact: Black dragons are the worst threat for Knight riders due to their disintegration breath weapon, which can destroy a mount's saddle and make it difficult to obtain disintegration resistance for the mount.
facts.detect: Black dragon
facts.action: Avoid or prepare for black dragons by dismounting temporarily or equipping a mount with reflection (amulet or shield).

facts.fact: Knights can detect dragons beforehand using Dragonbane or monster detection to avoid breath weapons.
facts.detect: Dragonbane or monster detection
facts.action: Use Dragonbane or monster detection to avoid dragon breath weapons.

facts.fact: Knights can feed their mounts intrinsic-granting corpses to shore up their survival odds, especially for disintegration resistance.
facts.detect: Intrinsic-granting corpses
facts.action: Feed intrinsic-granting corpses to mounts to provide them with necessary resistances.

facts.fact: Ki-rin are among the most likely candidates to survive through Gehennom, but they are very hard to obtain and not immune to death rays and disintegration.
facts.detect: Ki-rin
facts.action: Wish for a blessed ki-rin figurine to obtain a tamed ki-rin.

facts.fact: Knights can use jousting to deal severe damage to monsters such as minotaurs, dragons, and high-level demons without losing hit points.
facts.detect: Fast mount and Expert in lances
facts.action: Use jousting to deal damage to high-level monsters.

facts.fact: The home level of the Knight quest is Camelot Castle.
facts.detect: You materialize in the shadows of Camelot Castle.
facts.action: Prepare to fight quasits and avoid traps.

facts.fact: The Isle of Glass is the locate level with quasits, ochre jellies, and traps.
facts.detect: You stand at the foot of the Isle of Glass.
facts.action: Be cautious of traps and monsters.

facts.fact: The Dragon's Lair is the goal level with Ixoth, traps, and monsters.
facts.detect: As you exit the swamps, you before you a huge, gaping hole in the side of a hill.
facts.action: Prepare to fight Ixoth and collect the Magic Mirror of Merlin.

facts.fact: Random monsters on the quest branch are mostly quasits (55%).
facts.detect: Encounter quasits frequently.
facts.action: Use fire or cold attacks to deal with quasits effectively.

facts.fact: The Magic Mirror of Merlin is the quest artifact.
facts.detect: As you pick up the Magic Mirror of Merlin...
facts.action: Keep the Magic Mirror of Merlin safe and use it against Ixoth.

facts.fact: A monster can knock back another monster if the attacker is at least 2 sizes larger than the defender.
facts.detect: Monster size comparison
facts.action: Avoid engaging in melee combat with monsters that are significantly larger than the bot's current size.

facts.fact: The defender must not be unsolid or steadfast.
facts.detect: Monster description or status
facts.action: Check if the monster is unsolid or steadfast before engaging in combat.

facts.fact: The attack must be a claw, kick, butt, or weapon attack that deals physical damage.
facts.detect: Attack type
facts.action: Avoid engaging in melee combat with monsters that use attacks other than claws, kicks, butts, or physical weapon attacks.

facts.fact: If a weapon is used, it must be a blunt, non-flimsy weapon.
facts.detect: Weapon type
facts.action: Avoid engaging in melee combat with monsters wielding blunt, non-flimsy weapons.

facts.fact: The target must be able to hurtle at least 1 space, so it won't happen if they are up against a wall or being knocked diagonally into an open door.
facts.detect: Map layout and monster position
facts.action: Avoid knocking back monsters when they are up against a wall or in a position where they can't hurtle.

facts.fact: Kobolds are small, chaotic and omnivorous intelligent humanoids with poison resistance.
facts.detect: Encountering a kobold on the map or seeing the message 'You see a kobold.'
facts.action: Be cautious of poison attacks and avoid eating kobold corpses.

facts.fact: Kobolds have a 1/4 chance of generating with a stack of darts.
facts.detect: Seeing a kobold with a stack of darts in its inventory or on the ground near it.
facts.action: Steal or disarm the darts if possible, or be prepared to dodge ranged attacks.

facts.fact: Kobolds can pick up and use weapons and armor, and kobold shamans focus on magical items.
facts.detect: Seeing a kobold equipped with armor or wielding a weapon, or a kobold shaman with a magical item.
facts.action: Be prepared for a more dangerous encounter if a kobold is well-equipped.

facts.fact: Kobolds are among the earliest monsters that can wield weapons and use items, making them more dangerous to a starting character.
facts.detect: Encountering a kobold in the early game.
facts.action: Equip yourself with basic melee or ranged weapons and armor as soon as possible.

facts.fact: A kobold with an attack wand can be very dangerous to an early game character.
facts.detect: Seeing a kobold with a wand in its inventory or on the ground near it.
facts.action: Steal or disarm the wand if possible, or be prepared to avoid its effects.

page: Kops Make Great Theft Prevention Experts

facts.fact: L represents a lich, demilich, master lich, or arch-lich.
facts.detect: L (monster name)
facts.action: Avoid or prepare to fight powerful liches, especially if you are low on hit points or magic resistance.

facts.fact: Press l to move east if numpad movement is off.
facts.detect: Numpad movement is off in settings.
facts.action: Use l to move east when navigating the dungeon.

facts.fact: Press l to loot a container if numpad movement is on.
facts.detect: Numpad movement is on in settings and you are near a container.
facts.action: Use l to loot containers for items.

facts.fact: Ladders appear only in Vlad's Tower and the Wizard's Tower.
facts.detect: The map location or level name indicating Vlad's Tower or Wizard's Tower.
facts.action: Be cautious when encountering ladders in these specific towers.

facts.fact: Objects dropped on a down ladder are more likely to fall down a level than objects dropped on a down staircase.
facts.detect: Dropping an object on a down ladder.
facts.action: Avoid dropping valuable or important items on down ladders.

facts.fact: Stepping into lava without fire resistance will result in instant death.
facts.detect: Lava terrain
facts.action: Equip fire-resistant items or boots before approaching lava.

facts.fact: Falling into lava with fire resistance is a delayed instadeath.
facts.detect: Message: You fall into the lava.
facts.action: Escape immediately or freeze the lava.

facts.fact: Items submerged in lava can be retrieved using a similar process to retrieving them from water.
facts.detect: Message: Your item fell into the lava.
facts.action: Freeze the lava and dig out the item.

facts.fact: Walking directly on lava using fireproof water walking boots will deal 6d6 damage per move.
facts.detect: Lava terrain
facts.action: Equip fireproof water walking boots before walking on lava.

facts.fact: Certain actions which do not take any time on the turn counter will still decrement the variable which tracks how far you have sunk into lava.
facts.detect: Message: You are sinking into the lava.
facts.action: Avoid actions that do not take time while sinking.

facts.fact: Leather items are vulnerable to burning and rotting.
facts.detect: Item type (e.g., leather armor, leather cloak) and effects of fire or water
facts.action: Avoid burning or rotting leather items by keeping them out of water and fire

facts.fact: Gelatinous cubes will eat any leather items they come across
facts.detect: Encountering a gelatinous cube
facts.action: Avoid or kill gelatinous cubes to prevent them from eating leather items

facts.fact: Consuming leather items while polymorphed into a gelatinous cube has no effect beyond nutrition gain
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a gelatinous cube and eating leather items
facts.action: Eat leather items for nutrition if polymorphed into a gelatinous cube

facts.fact: Leprechaun halls are special rooms filled with sleeping leprechaun monsters, each one on top of a pile of gold.
facts.detect: Upon entering a room, the bot notices multiple sleeping leprechauns with piles of gold next to them.
facts.action: Stealthily approach the room and pick up the gold without waking the leprechauns. If a leprechaun wakes up, use a ranged weapon or spell to avoid melee combat.

facts.fact: A leprechaun hall is a special room filled with sleeping leprechauns and gold.
facts.detect: You enter a leprechaun hall!
facts.action: Bring a bag to store gold and prepare to fight leprechauns if necessary.

facts.fact: Leprechaun halls are generated with a 1/8 chance on levels 6 and above without shops or throne rooms.
facts.detect: You enter a leprechaun hall!
facts.action: Check the level number and avoid entering if it's early in the game.

facts.fact: Polearms skill can be trained by pounding a leprechaun surrounded by sleeping leprechauns.
facts.detect: A sleeping leprechaun surrounded by other sleeping leprechauns.
facts.action: Use a polearm to train skill on a surrounded leprechaun.

facts.fact: Leprechauns can be kept alive and undisturbed until teleport control or a tinning kit is available.
facts.detect: You enter a leprechaun hall!
facts.action: Leave leprechauns undisturbed until you have teleport control or a tinning kit.

facts.fact: Leprechauns can be eaten for teleportitis.
facts.detect: A leprechaun corpse.
facts.action: Eat a leprechaun corpse to gain teleportitis.

facts.fact: Don't try to cancel your own spellcasting by pressing Escape, especially when polypiling. Skipping the direction prompt releases the magic power to the previously used direction!
facts.detect: Attempting to cancel spellcasting with Escape
facts.action: Press Enter to confirm the direction or use a different method to cancel spellcasting

facts.fact: When you get a blessed scroll of genocide, @ means you, even when you aren't a human.
facts.detect: Blessed scroll of genocide in inventory
facts.action: Do not use it to genocide yourself or any species that includes yourself

facts.fact: A blessed scroll of genocide will wipe out all species in a monster class, even if you explicitly specify a single species.
facts.detect: Using a blessed scroll of genocide
facts.action: Be cautious and specify only the exact species you intend to genocide

facts.fact: You have to really be INSIDE a temple for sanctuary to work. The door isn't good enough.
facts.detect: Attempting to use sanctuary while standing at the temple door
facts.action: Enter the temple and stand inside to use sanctuary

facts.fact: Don't carry wands/scrolls/potions outside bags. Nothing like standing on the vibrating square with the Bell of Opening (0:0), complaining about exploding wand of cancellation and wand of wishing and not having a scroll of charging handy, or losing that brand new, unused wand of wishing to an electric eel.
facts.detect: Carrying wands, scrolls, or potions outside bags
facts.action: Keep wands, scrolls, and potions in bags or containers

facts.fact: Eating a chickatrice corpse does not make you petrification resistant.
facts.detect: chickatrice corpse
facts.action: Do not eat chickatrice corpse to gain petrification resistance.

facts.fact: Don't eat eggs unless you're sure of what's in them.
facts.detect: egg
facts.action: Do not eat unidentified eggs.

facts.fact: Don't dip for Excalibur if you aren't equipped for some possible nasty surprises!
facts.detect: Excalibur
facts.action: Avoid dipping for Excalibur unless prepared for potential negative effects.

facts.fact: Don't eat wraith corpses when satiated. You don't get a warning.
facts.detect: wraith corpse
facts.action: Do not eat wraith corpses when full.

facts.fact: Don't eat an unknown tin whilst hallucinating. It WILL be cockatrice meat.
facts.detect: unknown tin
facts.action: Do not eat unidentified tins while hallucinating.

facts.fact: Carrying around a lot of potions in your main inventory is a bad idea. You will step on a magic trap and die when a blast of fire causes all of your potions to boil and explode.
facts.detect: Message: 'A blast of fire causes all of your potions to boil and explode.'
facts.action: Stash potions in a container or bag of holding.

facts.fact: Don't try that genocide scroll until you've BUC tested it! A room full of Liches at level 3 leads to YASD!
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel a strange sensation.'
facts.action: BUC test the scroll before using it.

facts.fact: A throne room full of dragons is fantastic for intrinsics but take your damn time in eating them. They're a lot to choke down and it sucks to find out that you have just choked on your disintegration resistance.
facts.detect: Message: 'You choke on a dragon corpse.'
facts.action: Eat them one at a time or use a tinning kit.

facts.fact: Using a cursed scroll of create monster to create sacrifice fodder is never a good idea.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel a strange sensation.'
facts.action: Avoid using cursed scrolls of create monster.

facts.fact: Don't throw Mjollnir while blind -- you won't catch it, and will likely be hit and lose all your wands and rings.
facts.detect: Message: 'You are blind.'
facts.action: Do not throw Mjollnir while blind.

facts.fact: Do not try eating anything, especially a randomly generated newt in the lower levels of Gehennom just to try and get that one extra point of power for the heck of it.
facts.detect: Randomly generated newt in the lower levels of Gehennom
facts.action: Avoid eating the newt

facts.fact: Back off and make SURE you've got a lizard corpse handy in your inventory. Be a good Boy Scout and always be prepared.
facts.detect: Cockatrices and weapon-wielding monsters in the same area
facts.action: Carry a lizard corpse

facts.fact: Do not teleport at will while hungry if there is a demon prince attacking you.
facts.detect: Demon prince attacking while hungry
facts.action: Avoid teleporting at will

facts.fact: Levitation does not protect you from the kraken in Rodney's moat.
facts.detect: Kraken in Rodney's moat
facts.action: Avoid levitating near the kraken

facts.fact: Using water walking boots on the plane of water will result in you drowning. Levitation, on the other hand, will work safely.
facts.detect: Water walking boots on the Plane of Water
facts.action: Use levitation instead

facts.fact: Uncontrolled level teleportation will deposit you on any level between 1 and your current level plus 3, except that you will not go below your current dungeon branch.
facts.detect: Current dungeon branch and level number
facts.action: Avoid uncontrolled level teleportation unless you are prepared to handle any level between 1 and your current level + 3.

facts.fact: You cannot levelport from above the Valley of the Dead to below it; you will end up in the Valley instead.
facts.detect: Message 'You materialize on a different level!' followed by finding yourself in the Valley of the Dead
facts.action: Avoid level teleporting from levels above the Valley of the Dead to levels below it.

facts.fact: You cannot levelport in Sokoban.
facts.detect: Being in Sokoban
facts.action: Do not attempt level teleporting while in Sokoban.

facts.fact: You cannot levelport while carrying the real Amulet of Yendor.
facts.detect: Carrying the Amulet of Yendor
facts.action: Do not attempt level teleporting while carrying the real Amulet of Yendor.

facts.fact: Controlled levelporting to level 0 will kill you, but an amulet of life saving can save your life.
facts.detect: Message 'Go to Nowhere. Are you sure? [ynq]'
facts.action: Do not attempt to levelport to level 0 unless you have an amulet of life saving.

facts.fact: A level teleporter teleports you to a random location on a random level, but never down out of the main dungeon or into the Sanctum before the invocation ritual.
facts.detect: The trap is a magenta-colored trap that appears on levels 5 and above.
facts.action: If you have teleport control, you can specify the level you will go to, unless you are stunned, fainted, paralyzed, or confused. Otherwise, avoid triggering it unless you are in a situation where you want to explore new levels.

facts.fact: If you trigger the trap once, it vanishes, whether the teleportation was successful or not.
facts.detect: The trap disappears after you trigger it.
facts.action: If you trigger the trap and it vanishes, you can explore the level without fear of re-triggering it.

facts.fact: Magic resistance will prevent you from being teleported, but not monsters.
facts.detect: You feel a wrenching sensation.
facts.action: If you have magic resistance, you can safely trigger the trap to explore new levels without being teleported.

facts.fact: In the Endgame, you, monsters with the Amulet, and elementals on their plane cannot level teleport at all.
facts.detect: You are in the Endgame and trying to trigger the trap.
facts.action: Avoid triggering the trap in the Endgame as it will not work.

facts.fact: The trap only disappears when you trigger it personally; it is not removed when a monster triggers it.
facts.detect: A monster triggers the trap.
facts.action: The trap remains active and you should avoid it until you trigger it yourself.

facts.fact: Levels in Gehennom are hot unless overruled.
facts.detect: Entering a level in Gehennom after the Valley of the Dead.
facts.action: Expect potions to be at risk of destruction when dropped on the ground.

facts.fact: Cold levels can appear as filler levels in Gehennom.
facts.detect: Message 'It is cold here.' after entering a Gehennom level.
facts.action: Expect cold-resistant monsters and be cautious with fire-based attacks and equipment.

facts.fact: The Valley of the Dead and Juiblex's Swamp are temperate.
facts.detect: Entering the Valley of the Dead or Juiblex's Swamp.
facts.action: No special temperature-related actions are necessary.

facts.fact: Levitation causes you to lose contact with the floor, making actions like drinking from a fountain, digging downwards, and going down stairs impossible.
facts.detect: Trying to drink from a fountain or go down stairs while levitating.
facts.action: Avoid drinking from fountains or going down stairs while levitating.

facts.fact: Levitation can be gained extrinsically by wearing a ring of levitation or levitation boots, or by invoking the Heart of Ahriman.
facts.detect: Equipping a ring of levitation or levitation boots, or invoking the Heart of Ahriman.
facts.action: Be cautious when using these items, especially in dangerous situations like crossing lava or water.

facts.fact: Uncontrolled teleportation will only teleport you above lava if you are levitating extrinsically.
facts.detect: Teleporting while levitating and being near lava.
facts.action: Avoid teleporting near lava while levitating unless you are certain it will not cause you to fall into it.

facts.fact: Levitation can be ended by levitating over a sink, which deals up to 25 damage and ends timeouts.
facts.detect: Approaching a sink while levitating.
facts.action: Avoid sinks while levitating to prevent damage and loss of levitation.

facts.fact: You have a 3 in 8 chance of avoiding being killed by a drawbridge while levitating.
facts.detect: Approaching a drawbridge while levitating.
facts.action: Be cautious around drawbridges while levitating, as there is a risk of falling.

facts.fact: Liches are chaotic, medium-sized undead humanoids that are intelligent spellcasters. All liches are breathless, inediate, poisonous to digest, and have enhanced regeneration and infravision.
facts.detect: Encounter with a lich on the map
facts.action: Avoid eating liches and be cautious of their regeneration and infravision.

facts.fact: Liches possess a cold touch attack and the ability to cast mage monster spells once per round.
facts.detect: Lich casting a spell or using cold touch
facts.action: Equip magic resistance and avoid cold touch attacks if possible.

facts.fact: A lich will 'mumble incomprehensibly' when chatting to one.
facts.detect: Lich mumbling incomprehensibly
facts.action: Avoid chatting with liches to prevent unnecessary interactions.

facts.fact: Liches are generally annoying at best and incredibly lethal at worst: Many of them will frequently cast monster spells such as curse items, use aggravate to awaken other hostiles, and severely weaken your defenses with destroy armor.
facts.detect: Lich casting curse items, aggravate, or destroy armor
facts.action: Prioritize killing liches that cast these spells and use magic resistance.

facts.fact: All types of lich can be pacified by reading the blessed Book of the Dead.
facts.detect: Encounter with a lich
facts.action: Use the blessed Book of the Dead to pacify liches if available.

facts.fact: If a hero's life is saved by an amulet of life saving, they lose a point of constitution.
facts.detect: Wearing an amulet of life saving and losing a point of constitution upon revival.
facts.action: Avoid using the amulet of life saving unless absolutely necessary to prevent constitution loss.

facts.fact: If a hero's nutrition is below 500 or they died from overeating, their nutrition is set to 900.
facts.detect: Nutrition level below 500 or death message indicating overeating.
facts.action: If nutrition is low, eat food to avoid dying from overeating and ensure nutrition is restored to 900 upon revival.

facts.fact: A hero trapped in lava becomes untrapped upon revival.
facts.detect: Being trapped in lava and receiving a message indicating untrapping.
facts.action: If trapped in lava, revive to become untrapped.

facts.fact: A hero killed by a drowning attack is released from the grip of the monster that drowned them upon reviving.
facts.detect: Being held by a monster that causes drowning and receiving a message indicating release.
facts.action: If held by a drowning monster, revive to be released.

facts.fact: Life saving will not resurrect a hero in the following circumstances: death by self-genocide or becoming brainless.
facts.detect: Attempting self-genocide or becoming brainless.
facts.action: Avoid self-genocide or becoming brainless as it will result in immediate death.

facts.fact: Yellow and black lights are neutral monsters that are amorphous, mindless, and unsolid, with 0 AC and no MR score.
facts.detect: yellow light, black light
facts.action: Avoid melee combat with them as they are unsolid and can only be hit by magic missiles or wands of cancellation.

facts.fact: Yellow lights cause blindness upon explosion, black lights cause hallucination or confusion.
facts.detect: Explosion sound and status effect message (e.g., 'You are blinded!', 'You feel disoriented.')
facts.action: Equip light sources and wear protection to avoid blindness and disorientation.

facts.fact: Lights are immune to blinding effects of flashes from expensive cameras, but a sleeping light will be awakened by one.
facts.detect: Message 'A sleeping yellow/black light wakes up!'
facts.action: Avoid using expensive cameras near sleeping lights to prevent them from waking up.

facts.fact: Randomly-generated lights are always hostile.
facts.detect: Appearance of yellow or black light on the map
facts.action: Be cautious and prepared to deal with them as they are hostile and can cause status effects.

facts.fact: Scroll of light summoning multiple tame and cancelled lights if not extinct or subjected to genocide.
facts.detect: Scroll of light read message and subsequent appearance of yellow or black lights
facts.action: Be cautious when reading a scroll of light, especially if confused, as it can summon multiple hostile lights.

facts.fact: Brass lanterns and oil lamps can be refilled by charging them; blessed charging will refill them to 1500 turns, and uncursed charging will add 750 turns to a maximum of 1500.
facts.detect: The bot should have a brass lantern or oil lamp in its inventory.
facts.action: Charge the lantern or lamp with a blessed object to refill it to 1500 turns.

facts.fact: An oil lamp with 1000 or fewer turns left can also be refilled by #dipping it into a potion of oil, getting twice the remaining turns left in the potion.
facts.detect: The bot has an oil lamp with 1000 or fewer turns and a potion of oil in its inventory.
facts.action: Dip the oil lamp into the potion of oil to refill it.

facts.fact: The Candelabrum of Invocation acts like an ordinary light source if at least one candle is applied to it.
facts.detect: The bot finds the Candelabrum of Invocation and has candles in its inventory.
facts.action: Apply candles to the Candelabrum to use it as a light source.

facts.fact: The Sunsword acts as a light source whenever wielded, either by you or by a monster.
facts.detect: The bot finds the Sunsword in its inventory or sees a monster wielding it.
facts.action: Wield the Sunsword to use it as a light source.

facts.fact: Candles can be randomly generated or wished for, and some can nearly always be found in Izchak's lighting shop in Minetown.
facts.detect: The bot is in Minetown and sees Izchak's lighting shop.
facts.action: Visit Izchak's lighting shop to purchase candles.

facts.fact: Corridors are always generated as unlit by default, while a room can be generated as entirely lit or unlit, with the frequency of dark rooms increasing as the hero enters deeper dungeon levels.
facts.detect: The bot can notice unlit corridors and dark rooms by the lack of visibility of items and monsters.
facts.action: The bot should carry light sources such as lamps or candles to light dark areas and improve visibility.

facts.fact: A hero that is not blind can see any object or monster that currently occupies a lit square, as long as there is no wall, cloud (including poison clouds) or closed door obstructing the hero's line of sight.
facts.detect: The bot can detect walls, clouds, and closed doors that obstruct its line of sight.
facts.action: The bot should avoid or remove obstacles that block its line of sight to see objects and monsters in lit squares.

facts.fact: Infravision makes certain monsters in the hero's line of sight visible to them, regardless of if that monster's current square is lit or unlit.
facts.detect: The bot can detect monsters that are visible through infravision.
facts.action: The bot should use items or spells that grant infravision to see monsters in dark areas.

facts.fact: It is possible to permanently light a hero's surroundings through the following methods: Reading a non-cursed scroll of light, Casting the light spell, Zapping a wand of light.
facts.detect: The bot can detect scrolls of light, wands of light, and the light spell.
facts.action: The bot should use these items or spells to light dark areas permanently.

facts.fact: Gremlins take damage from light sources and the light spell.
facts.detect: The bot can detect gremlins.
facts.action: The bot should use light sources or the light spell to damage gremlins.

facts.fact: Lightning can be cast by any monster that can cast clerical spells and is at least level 12, dealing 8d6 shock damage and blinding the hero for up to 100 turns.
facts.detect: A bolt of lightning strikes down at you from above!
facts.action: Equip shock resistance or reflection before encountering high-level clerical monsters.

facts.fact: Half spell damage and shock resistance prevent damage from the spell, while reflection completely prevents damage, blindness, and item destruction.
facts.detect: A monster cast lightning at you.
facts.action: Ensure you have reflection or shock resistance before facing high-level clerical monsters.

facts.fact: The spell can destroy wands and rings in open inventory.
facts.detect: A bolt of lightning strikes down at you from above!
facts.action: Wear rings and keep wands in the equipment slot to protect them.

facts.fact: The spell blinds the hero for up to 100 turns.
facts.detect: A bolt of lightning strikes down at you from above!
facts.action: Carry a blessed lantern or light source to avoid blindness penalties.

facts.fact: In NetHack 3.7.0, the spell will destroy any iron bars if the hero is targeted while occupying their square.
facts.detect: A bolt of lightning strikes down at you from above!
facts.action: Avoid standing on iron bars when facing high-level clerical monsters.

facts.fact: If thy wand hath run out of charges, thou mayst zap it again and again; though naught will happen at first, verily, thy persistence shall be rewarded, as one last charge may yet be wrested from it!
facts.detect: Wand with 0 charges
facts.action: Continue zapping the wand until it has no effect

facts.fact: Though the shopkeepers be wary, thieves have nevertheless stolen much by using their digging wands to hasten exits through the pavement.
facts.detect: Digging wand
facts.action: Use digging wand to exit shops quickly

facts.fact: If thou hast had trouble with rust on thine armor or weapons, thou shouldst know that thou canst prevent this by, while in a confused state, reading the magical parchments which normally are used to cause their enchantment.
facts.detect: Confused state and magical parchment
facts.action: Read magical parchments to prevent rust

facts.fact: Behold the cockatrice, whose diminutive stature belies its hidden might. The cockatrice can petrify any ordinary being it contacts--save those wise adventurers who eat a dead lizard or blob of acid when they feel themselves slowly turning to stone.
facts.detect: Feeling of petrification
facts.action: Eat a dead lizard or acid blob to counteract petrification

facts.fact: While the consumption of lizard flesh or water beloved of the gods may clear the muddled head, the application of the horn of a creature of utmost purity can alleviate many other afflictions as well.
facts.detect: Confused state
facts.action: Use the horn of a creature of utmost purity to clear confusion

facts.fact: Living dolls do not randomly generate and are only found in specific locations within the Neutral Quest.
facts.detect: Messages indicating entrance to the lost cities level, river head levels, or stockade levels.
facts.action: Explore these specific levels to find living dolls.

facts.fact: A living doll will always be generated peaceful and can be chatted to.
facts.detect: Message indicating a peaceful living doll is present.
facts.action: Chat to the living doll to obtain valuable items.

facts.fact: Killing a lifeless doll will make it return hostile upon reawakening.
facts.detect: Message indicating a lifeless doll is present.
facts.action: Avoid killing lifeless dolls to prevent hostility.

facts.fact: Living dolls sell various types of consumable doll items for 800 zorkmids and a doll tear for 8000 zorkmids.
facts.detect: Chatting to a living doll.
facts.action: Purchase items from the living doll to enhance gameplay.

facts.fact: A parasitized doll will be generated on the Alhoon's Fortress level.
facts.detect: Message indicating entrance to Alhoon's Fortress level.
facts.action: Be prepared for a parasitized doll encounter on this level.

facts.fact: Salamanders are chaotic and intelligent humanoids with a slithy lower body, lacking legs rather than hands.
facts.detect: Salamander
facts.action: Avoid or prepare for a difficult fight if encountered, as they are intelligent and chaotic.

facts.fact: Salamanders are the only lizard to be inediate and the only ones that attack through means other than bites, utilizing weapons as well as bearhug and touch attacks.
facts.detect: Salamander
facts.action: Be prepared for a variety of attack types, including weapon attacks, bearhugs, and touch attacks.

facts.fact: Salamanders are the only lizard that have more than one intrinsic resistance property.
facts.detect: Salamander
facts.action: Expect salamanders to have multiple resistances, making them harder to defeat.

facts.fact: Chameleons and lizards are the only lizards with an MR score, with a fairly low 10 MR.
facts.detect: Chameleon or Lizard
facts.action: Be cautious of chameleons as they can shapeshift into dangerous forms.

facts.fact: Randomly-generated lizards are always created as hostile.
facts.detect: Any lizard monster
facts.action: Attack lizards on sight as they are always hostile.

facts.fact: Both long swords and katanas use the long sword skill.
facts.detect: Weapon name (long sword or katana)
facts.action: Identify and use long swords or katanas for better skill progression.

facts.fact: The long sword skill has the most artifacts associated with it at seven.
facts.detect: Artifact names (Excalibur, Fire Brand, Frost Brand, Giantslayer, Snickersnee, Sunsword, Vorpal Blade)
facts.action: Prioritize finding and using these artifacts for significant power boosts.

facts.fact: A lawful or neutral hero that is crowned will unlock the long sword skill, even if they do not receive Excalibur or Vorpal Blade from crowning.
facts.detect: Crowning message
facts.action: Seek crowning to unlock the long sword skill.

facts.fact: The ability to create Excalibur by dipping into a fountain is exclusive to the long sword as an item.
facts.detect: Dipping a long sword into a fountain
facts.action: Dip a long sword into a fountain to potentially create Excalibur.

facts.fact: Large boxes and chests may be generated locked. To loot a locked container, you must first unlock it.
facts.detect: Locked chest or box
facts.action: Unlock the container before looting.

facts.fact: Sometimes looting a container may trigger a trap, such as a poison needle.
facts.detect: Poison needle trap message
facts.action: Use the #untrap command to check for traps before looting.

facts.fact: When a bag of tricks is #looted, it will bite you (for 1 to 10 hit points damage) and become identified.
facts.detect: Bag of tricks
facts.action: Be prepared to take damage when looting a bag of tricks.

facts.fact: If you try to loot when there is no container present, you will be told 'You don't find anything here to loot.'
facts.detect: Message 'You don't find anything here to loot.'
facts.action: Do not attempt to loot if there is no container.

facts.fact: Attempting to loot a throne while confused generates a throne room monster and deposits a random amount of your gold in its inventory.
facts.detect: Confused state and throne
facts.action: Avoid looting thrones when confused.

facts.fact: A lord gains a +1 multishot bonus when throwing or shooting projectiles.
facts.detect: Monster name (e.g., 'dwarf lord', 'kobold lord')
facts.action: Avoid engaging in ranged combat with lords if possible, especially if you are weak.

facts.fact: A lord is more likely to receive one of the default weapon sets when generating monster starting inventory.
facts.detect: Monster name (e.g., 'dwarf lord', 'kobold lord')
facts.action: Be cautious when encountering lords as they are more likely to be armed with dangerous weapons.

facts.fact: An angelic being that is a lord will always generate with a shield of reflection and an upgraded weapon.
facts.detect: Monster name (e.g., 'Archon')
facts.action: Treat angelic lords with extreme caution as they are likely to have powerful equipment.

facts.fact: Demon summoning by performing same-race sacrifice will always summon a demon lord if possible.
facts.detect: Attempting to summon a demon with a sacrifice
facts.action: Avoid performing sacrifices that could summon demon lords.

facts.fact: Winged gargoyles, ki-rin, and vampire lords are lords but cannot receive or equip weapons or armor.
facts.detect: Monster name (e.g., 'winged gargoyle', 'ki-rin', 'vampire lord')
facts.action: These lords do not pose a threat in terms of weapons and armor, but still be cautious due to their other abilities.

facts.fact: Luck is the sum of natural luck and bonus luck, with natural luck ranging from -10 to +10 and bonus luck ranging from -3 to +3.
facts.detect: Checking the enlightenment list or observing luck-related events.
facts.action: Maintain a high natural luck by avoiding actions that reduce it and using luckstones to prevent natural luck from timing out.

facts.fact: Natural luck times out at a rate of one point per 600 turns, faster if carrying the Amulet of Yendor or if your god is angry.
facts.detect: Observing the passage of turns or carrying the Amulet of Yendor.
facts.action: Carry luckstones to prevent natural luck from timing out and maintain a high luck.

facts.fact: Certain actions, such as breaking a mirror or killing a peaceful monster, can reduce natural luck.
facts.detect: Receiving messages like 'You hear a crackling sound.' or 'You murderer!'
facts.action: Avoid actions that reduce natural luck, such as breaking mirrors or killing peaceful monsters.

facts.fact: Bonus luck is determined by the number of blessed, uncursed, and cursed luckstones in your inventory.
facts.detect: Counting the number of luckstones and their status (blessed, uncursed, cursed).
facts.action: Ensure a balance of luckstones to maximize bonus luck and prevent natural luck from timing out.

facts.fact: Praying with negative natural luck can reset it to 0, but praying on a cross-aligned altar or before prayer timeout can reduce it.
facts.detect: Observing messages like 'You feel slightly mollified.' or 'Thou shalt pay, infidel!'
facts.action: Pray only when natural luck is positive or when you feel your god is mollified.

facts.fact: A luck item changes the hero's luck and/or luck timeout.
facts.detect: Carrying a luck item such as a luckstone, The Heart of Ahriman, The Tsurugi of Muramasa, or The Orb of Fate.
facts.action: Carry a luck item to improve luck and luck timeout.

facts.fact: Some characters may postpone their trip to the Gnomish Mines in favor of Sokoban or Minetown to obtain quest artifacts that act as luck items.
facts.detect: Character role and quest artifact availability.
facts.action: Prioritize obtaining quest artifacts over the guaranteed luckstone in Mines' End.

facts.fact: Blessing a luck item provides a buffer against the curse items monster spell and other similar effects.
facts.detect: Blessing a luck item.
facts.action: Ensure luck items are blessed to avoid bad luck effects.

facts.fact: Intelligent artifacts resist the curse items spell 80% of the time.
facts.detect: Carrying an intelligent artifact.
facts.action: Carry intelligent artifacts to resist curse items spell.

facts.fact: Quest artifacts are always generated as blessed.
facts.detect: Obtaining a quest artifact.
facts.action: Use quest artifact as a primary luck item.

facts.fact: The Lycanthrope quest involves fighting Sir Lorimar for The Staff of Withering.
facts.detect: Encounter with Sir Lorimar or finding the Staff of Withering.
facts.action: Prepare to fight Sir Lorimar and retrieve the Staff of Withering.

facts.fact: The Nightmare Forest level is no-teleport and has undiggable walls and floor.
facts.detect: Attempting to teleport or dig in the Nightmare Forest.
facts.action: Avoid teleporting or digging in the Nightmare Forest.

facts.fact: The Lair of Sir Lorimar contains Sir Lorimar with the Bell of Opening and the Staff of Withering.
facts.detect: Encounter with Sir Lorimar.
facts.action: Fight Sir Lorimar and retrieve the Staff of Withering.

facts.fact: Random monsters on the quest branch include Woodland-elves, forest centaurs, and fiends.
facts.detect: Encounter with Woodland-elves, forest centaurs, or fiends.
facts.action: Be prepared to fight these monsters.

facts.fact: The Calerin Forest level contains four Woodland-elves, three forest centaurs, and a random C.
facts.detect: Encounter with Woodland-elves, forest centaurs, or a random C.
facts.action: Be prepared to fight these monsters.

facts.fact: A hero can only be given lycanthropy from being bitten by a werecreature or eating the corpse or tin of a werecreature.
facts.detect: Being bitten by a werecreature or finding a werecreature corpse.
facts.action: Avoid eating werecreature corpses and use a ring of protection from shape changers or wield Werebane to prevent infection from bites.

facts.fact: A hero with lycanthropy becomes vulnerable to silver, forcing them to drop any worn silver items and take damage.
facts.detect: Wearing silver items and receiving the message 'You can't handle your !'.
facts.action: Avoid wearing silver items and prioritize finding a potion of holy water or an amulet of unchanging to prevent transformations.

facts.fact: Quaffing a potion of holy water will cure lycanthropy and return the hero to normal form.
facts.detect: Having lycanthropy and finding a potion of holy water.
facts.action: Drink potion of holy water immediately upon detecting lycanthropy.

facts.fact: Lycanthropic heroes can summon tame monsters of the same species by using the #monster command.
facts.detect: Shifting into animal form and having enough power to use the #monster command.
facts.action: Use the #monster command to summon tame monsters for protection or to use as meat shields.

facts.fact: Praying successfully can cure lycanthropy as it is considered a major trouble.
facts.detect: Having lycanthropy and being able to pray.
facts.action: Pray to your god to cure lycanthropy.

facts.fact: {{white|m}} represents a mimic (when it is not disguised as something else)
facts.detect: m
facts.action: Be cautious and prepare to attack or identify the mimic before approaching it closely.

facts.fact: {{white|M}} represents a mummy
facts.detect: M
facts.action: Be prepared to attack or use holy water on the mummy to avoid curses or negative levels.

facts.fact: Press {{kbd|m}}, then a direction, to move your character without performing any other actions
facts.detect: Pressing m followed by a direction
facts.action: Use this command to move safely past dangerous items or monsters without picking them up or attacking.

facts.fact: Press {{kbd|m}}{{kbd|,}} to pick up items off the floor using a menu
facts.detect: Pressing m, followed by selecting items from the menu
facts.action: Use this command to pick up specific items without picking up unwanted items.

facts.fact: Press {{kbd|Shift|M}}, then a direction, to move your character as far as they can go in that direction
facts.detect: Pressing Shift+M followed by a direction
facts.action: Use this command to move quickly through corridors or to escape from dangerous situations.

facts.fact: Amphibious monsters can survive equally well on land and in water.
facts.detect: Monster names such as jellyfish, piranha, shark, giant eel, electric eel, kraken, floating eye, water elemental, Medusa, Juiblex, newt, baby crocodile, crocodile, Orion.
facts.action: Be cautious when encountering these monsters on land as they can also be found in water and may have additional dangerous traits.

facts.fact: Mondata.h defines an amphibious monster as having either of the M1_AMPHIBIOUS and M1_BREATHLESS tags in monst.c.
facts.detect: Not directly detectable by the bot, but useful for understanding the underlying mechanics.
facts.action: Understand that some monsters listed as amphibious may also have breathless properties, which could affect their behavior and vulnerabilities.

facts.fact: All boulder-throwing monsters are giant humanoids except for the titan and quest nemesis monsters like Cyclops and Lord Surtur.
facts.detect: Monster names such as 'giant', 'stone giant', 'hill giant', 'fire giant', 'frost giant', 'storm giant', 'titan', 'Cyclops', 'Lord Surtur'.
facts.action: Be cautious around these monsters as they can throw boulders which can be dangerous.

facts.fact: A boulder-throwing monster will actively pick up and throw boulders at the hero.
facts.detect: Seeing a boulder-throwing monster near a boulder.
facts.action: Avoid getting too close to boulders when near these monsters or find a way to neutralize them.

facts.fact: A polymorphed hero can pick up and throw boulders if they are in the form of a boulder-throwing monster.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a boulder-throwing monster form.
facts.action: Use this ability to move boulders out of the way or to throw them at enemies.

facts.fact: In Sokoban, a polymorphed hero cannot pick up boulders and moving onto a boulder's square incurs a -1 luck penalty.
facts.detect: Being in Sokoban and polymorphed into a boulder-throwing monster.
facts.action: Avoid moving onto boulder squares in Sokoban to prevent luck penalties.

facts.fact: A hero riding a steed cannot move onto squares containing boulders and requires Basic skill or higher to pick up boulders while mounted.
facts.detect: Being mounted and near a boulder.
facts.action: Dismount before attempting to move boulders or pick them up.

facts.fact: Many monsters carry filth-crusted scalpels that inflict deadly sickness.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel very ill.' or 'You are struck with deadly sickness.'
facts.action: Carry a unicorn horn or other means of curing illness.

facts.fact: Contaminated patients may transform into dangerous forms such as human dream leeches, coiling brawn, fungal brains, and byakhee.
facts.detect: Monster name: 'human dream leech', 'coiling brawn', 'fungal brain', 'byakhee'
facts.action: Avoid or prepare to fight dangerous forms of patients.

facts.fact: Player-monsters in the second half of the quest are likely to spawn with offensive wands.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel a sudden blast of energy.' or 'You are struck by a wand of death.'
facts.action: Gain reflection or magic resistance before proceeding.

facts.fact: The true Home level blocks teleportation but is not unphaseable.
facts.detect: Message: 'You cannot teleport here.'
facts.action: Use a source of phasing to access the quest artifact.

facts.fact: The quest artifact, The Star of Hypernotus, is found on the Home level.
facts.detect: Item name: 'The Star of Hypernotus'
facts.action: Retrieve the artifact to protect against confusion, stunning, sanity loss, and madness effects.

facts.fact: Magic cancellation (MC) offers protection against special melee attacks such as poison, lycanthropy, and sliming attacks. MC3 reduces the success rate of these attacks to 10%.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You are protected' for MC3, 'You are guarded' for MC2, and 'You are warded' for MC1.
facts.action: Wear armor with the highest possible MC rating (up to 3) and use extrinsic protection to boost MC to 3 if possible.

facts.fact: The most common source of MC is armor, with each piece having an MC number from 0 to 3. The player's MC is the maximum of any single piece of armor worn.
facts.detect: Armor names and their MC ratings (e.g., cloak of protection, cornuthaum, plate mail).
facts.action: Equip armor with the highest MC rating available.

facts.fact: Extrinsic protection (ring of protection, Tsurugi of Muramasa, Mitre of Holiness) augments MC by 1 to a maximum of 3.
facts.detect: Equipping items like the ring of protection, Tsurugi of Muramasa, or Mitre of Holiness.
facts.action: Equip these items to boost MC to 3 if wearing armor with MC2.

facts.fact: Intrinsic protection (from aligned priests or praying) provides MC1 and does not stack with armor or extrinsic protection.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You feel protected' or 'You feel warded' after praying or donating to an aligned priest.
facts.action: Pray or donate to an aligned priest to gain intrinsic protection.

facts.fact: MC does not protect against paralyzing passive attacks or gaze attacks, such as those from floating eyes and Medusa.
facts.detect: Monster names like 'floating eye' or 'Medusa'.
facts.action: Avoid or prepare countermeasures for these monsters.

facts.fact: Magic cancellation protects against certain special melee attacks, such as poison from killer bee stings, lycanthropy from werejackal bites, and green slime's sliming attacks.
facts.detect: Encountering killer bees, werejackals, or green slimes.
facts.action: Wear armor with a high magic cancellation number (MC 2 or 3) to protect against these special melee attacks.

facts.fact: The magic cancellation number (MC number) ranges from 0 to 3, with 3 being the highest protection.
facts.detect: Finding armor with MC 2 or 3, such as orcish cloak, dwarvish cloak, or elven mithril-coat.
facts.action: Equip armor with the highest MC number available to maximize protection against special melee attacks.

facts.fact: Magic cancellation does not protect against passive attacks, spitting attacks, engulfing attacks, breath attacks, explosions from proximity or dying, gaze attacks, magic spells, or ranged weapon attacks.
facts.detect: Encountering monsters that use passive attacks, spitting attacks, etc.
facts.action: Be cautious and avoid such attacks by using other forms of protection or avoiding these monsters.

facts.fact: Magic cancellation reduces the probability of special melee attacks succeeding, but does not prevent damage from ordinary physical attacks.
facts.detect: Taking damage from a monster's attack.
facts.action: Ensure you have high magic cancellation to reduce the chance of special effects, but also maintain good armor class to avoid damage.

facts.fact: Cloaks of magic resistance provide the highest level of magic cancellation (MC 3) and also offer magic resistance.
facts.detect: Finding a cloak of magic resistance.
facts.action: Equip the cloak of magic resistance for both high magic cancellation and magic resistance.

facts.fact: Magic missile damage can be blocked with magic resistance.
facts.detect: Player's magic resistance status or monster's MR score
facts.action: Gain magic resistance to block magic missile damage

facts.fact: The wand of magic missile can be used by heroes or monsters to inflict magic missile damage.
facts.detect: Wand of magic missile item
facts.action: Use wand of magic missile to attack enemies

facts.fact: Angels, the Oracle, and Yeenoghu use magic missile monster spell.
facts.detect: Encountering Angels, the Oracle, or Yeenoghu
facts.action: Be prepared for magic missile attacks from these monsters

facts.fact: Gray dragons have a breath weapon that is a magic missile attack.
facts.detect: Encountering gray dragons
facts.action: Be cautious of their magic missile breath weapon

facts.fact: Monsters with magic missile attacks or breath weapons have magic resistance.
facts.detect: Monsters with magic missile attacks or breath weapons
facts.action: Expect these monsters to have magic resistance

facts.fact: Magic missile is used by Angels, Yeenoghu, and the Oracle as a passive attack.
facts.detect: Encountering Angels, Yeenoghu, or the Oracle in the game.
facts.action: Avoid melee combat with these monsters if possible, especially if you do not have magic resistance or half spell damage.

facts.fact: When used in melee range, magic missile deals damage based on the monster's level plus any additional damage dice provided.
facts.detect: Being hit by a shower of missiles in melee combat.
facts.action: Equip magic resistance or half spell damage protection before engaging in melee with high-level monsters.

facts.fact: When zapped at range, magic missile can be blocked by reflection.
facts.detect: Being hit by a shower of missiles from a distance.
facts.action: Equip a mirror or other reflecting item if you anticipate ranged attacks from these monsters.

facts.fact: Half spell damage halves damage inflicted by the spell in either form.
facts.detect: Having half spell damage as a status effect.
facts.action: Ensure you have half spell damage before engaging in combat with these monsters.

facts.fact: Magic resistance completely negates damage from the spell in either form.
facts.detect: Having magic resistance as a status effect.
facts.action: Ensure you have magic resistance before engaging in combat with these monsters.

facts.fact: A magic portal leading to the Quest will occur on a dungeon level from 11 to 16.
facts.detect: You receive a faint telepathic message from [quest leader] about a ...ic transporter.
facts.action: Explore the level thoroughly to find the magic portal.

facts.fact: A magic portal leading to Fort Ludios can appear in a vault anywhere from dungeon level 11 to Medusa.
facts.detect: Finding a vault on a level between 11 and Medusa.
facts.action: Carefully explore any vaults to find the magic portal.

facts.fact: A one-way portal is randomly placed on each of the Elemental Planes.
facts.detect: Feeling dizzy for a moment, but nothing happens... (without Amulet of Yendor).
facts.action: Avoid stepping on portals on the Elemental Planes without the Amulet of Yendor.

facts.fact: The portal to your Quest will disappear if you are rejected with prejudice.
facts.detect: Messages from the quest leader indicating rejection.
facts.action: Avoid actions that may lead to rejection by the quest leader.

facts.fact: Wearing or wielding the Amulet of Yendor confers a form of magic portal detection.
facts.detect: The Amulet of Yendor glowing with varying intensity.
facts.action: Wear or wield the Amulet of Yendor to detect magic portals.

facts.fact: Magic resistance protects against death magic from external sources, including Death's touch attacks, zapped wand of death, and finger of death spell.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You feel a chill...' or 'You are struck by Death's touch!'
facts.action: Seek out and obtain magic resistance through items like cloak of magic resistance or quest artifacts.

facts.fact: Magic resistance protects against polymorph magic from external sources, such as polymorph traps and vapors from a potion of polymorph.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You feel a strange sensation...' or 'You are polymorphed into a ...'
facts.action: Obtain magic resistance to avoid unwanted polymorphing.

facts.fact: Magic resistance protects against damage from pure magic, including magic missile attacks and exploding spellbooks.
facts.detect: Messages like 'A magic missile strikes you!' or 'The spellbook explodes!'
facts.action: Prioritize obtaining magic resistance to protect against these attacks.

facts.fact: Magic resistance protects against teleport and level teleport traps.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You feel a strange pull...' or 'You are teleported to another level!'
facts.action: Obtain magic resistance to avoid unwanted teleportation.

facts.fact: Magic resistance reduces the chance of being scared by Magicbane and reduces the effects of certain monster spells.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You feel a strange sensation...' or 'You are scared!'
facts.action: Obtain magic resistance to mitigate the effects of Magicbane and reduce damage from certain monster spells.

facts.fact: A monster with a magic resistance score higher than 0 has a chance of taking halved damage when subjected to certain magical items and effects by a hero or another monster.
facts.detect: Monster name and MR score (e.g., mind flayer MR 90)
facts.action: Avoid using magic items or spells that are likely to be resisted by high-MR monsters.

facts.fact: The chance of a monster resisting an effect is given by MR/(100 + (attack level) - (defense level)).
facts.detect: Monster name and MR score, source of attack (e.g., wand, spell)
facts.action: Calculate the resistance chance and choose a different tactic if the chance of resistance is high.

facts.fact: Monster magic resistance affects the effectiveness of conflict, taming, and polymorphing.
facts.detect: Monster name and MR score
facts.action: Avoid using conflict, taming, or polymorphing on high-MR monsters.

facts.fact: Monster magic resistance is used in determining the outcomes of various effects, including explosions, sleeping, and wand of striking.
facts.detect: Monster name and MR score, effect (e.g., explosion, wand of striking)
facts.action: Choose a different tactic if the effect is likely to be resisted.

facts.fact: Mind flayers have 90 monster magic resistance, making strategies such as polymorph magic or scaring from a musical instrument unlikely to work.
facts.detect: Mind flayer
facts.action: Avoid using magic items or spells that are likely to be resisted by mind flayers.

facts.fact: A magic trap can cause a magical explosion dealing up to 10 points of damage and increasing the hero's maximum energy by 2.
facts.detect: You are caught in a magical explosion!
facts.action: Avoid stepping on magic traps unless you are prepared to handle the damage and are fire resistant.

facts.fact: A magic trap can create up to 4 monsters around the trap, blinding the hero for 1-5 turns and deafening them for 1-5 turns if already deaf, otherwise 2-30 turns.
facts.detect: You are momentarily blinded by a flash of light!
facts.action: Prepare for blindness and deafness by engraving Elbereth, having fire resistance, and being ready to deal with unseen monsters.

facts.fact: A magic trap can replicate the effects of a fire trap.
facts.detect: A tower of flame erupts from the floor!
facts.action: Ensure you have fire resistance before stepping on magic traps.

facts.fact: A magic trap can increase the hero's charisma by 1 and tame adjacent monsters.
facts.detect: You feel charismatic!
facts.action: Step on magic traps to increase charisma if you are prepared to handle the potential monster generation.

facts.fact: A magic trap can replicate the effect of reading an uncursed scroll of remove curse.
facts.detect: You feel like someone is helping you.
facts.action: Step on magic traps to potentially remove curses, but be cautious of other effects.

facts.fact: Only specific types of armor are considered magical, such as elven boots, cloak of invisibility, gauntlets of dexterity, helm of brilliance, shield of reflection, and dragon scale mail.
facts.detect: Item names like 'elven boots', 'cloak of invisibility', etc.
facts.action: Prioritize keeping these items if found, as they are valuable and can be useful for survival and advancement.

facts.fact: Unicorn horns are magical items by default, but regrown unicorn horns are non-magical.
facts.detect: Item name 'unicorn horn' and context of the horn's origin (e.g., dropped by a revived unicorn).
facts.action: Keep unicorn horns but be cautious with regrown ones, as they may not polymorph into magical items.

facts.fact: All potions except certain types (acid, booze, fruit juice, oil, sickness, water) are magical.
facts.detect: Potion names like 'potion of healing', 'potion of gain level', etc.
facts.action: Prioritize keeping magical potions for alchemy and polypiling.

facts.fact: Scrolls of blank paper, mail, blank spellbooks, wand of nothing, meat stick, meat ring, and cheap plastic imitation of the Amulet of Yendor are not magical.
facts.detect: Item names like 'scroll of blank paper', 'wand of nothing', etc.
facts.action: Avoid keeping these items as they are less valuable and may not polymorph into useful items.

facts.fact: No weapon, food, boulder, statue, or gold is magical.
facts.detect: Item names like 'long sword', 'roasted chicken', 'statue', etc.
facts.action: Do not prioritize these items for polymorphing or alchemy.

facts.fact: A male character who wears the maid dress will gain aggravate monster instead.
facts.detect: Wearing a maid dress as a male character
facts.action: Avoid wearing the maid dress if you are a male character.

facts.fact: Major demons are always generated hostile and possess fire resistance, poison resistance, drain resistance, and death resistance.
facts.detect: Encountering a hostile demon with the listed resistances.
facts.action: Prepare for combat with fire, poison, draining, and death attacks.

facts.fact: Non-unique major demons have a 4/5 chance of being created asleep unless the hero possesses the Amulet of Yendor.
facts.detect: A demon appearing asleep on the level.
facts.action: Silently approach and kill the demon while it is asleep.

facts.fact: Demon lords and princes have a 1/20 chance of summoning a co-aligned demon lord and a 1/4 chance of summoning a co-aligned demon prince.
facts.detect: A demon lord or prince acting adjacent to the hero.
facts.action: Be prepared for additional demons to appear.

facts.fact: Demon lords and princes have a 1/50 chance of summoning a demon prince.
facts.detect: A demon lord or prince acting adjacent to the hero.
facts.action: Be prepared for a powerful demon prince to appear.

facts.fact: Demonbane completely blocks all forms of demon gating while wielded.
facts.detect: Possessing Demonbane.
facts.action: Wield Demonbane to prevent additional demons from being summoned.

facts.fact: The Catacombs, Valley of the Dead, Moloch's Sanctum, and Astral Plane are non-mappable levels.
facts.detect: The Catacombs, Valley of the Dead, Moloch's Sanctum, Astral Plane
facts.action: Do not use a scroll of magic mapping or the magic mapping spell on these levels.

facts.fact: Attempting magic mapping on a non-mappable level confuses the hero for up to 30 turns.
facts.detect: Your spins as something blocks the spell!
facts.action: Avoid using magic mapping on non-mappable levels to prevent confusion.

facts.fact: Non-mappable levels do not suppress clairvoyance.
facts.detect: Clairvoyance spell or potion effect
facts.action: Use clairvoyance to navigate non-mappable levels.

facts.fact: Martial arts base damage is 1d4, but it applies full damage bonus even if it rolls a 1 on its primary damage die.
facts.detect: The bot can notice this by observing the damage dealt in combat messages.
facts.action: The bot should continue using martial arts as a primary offense in the early game, relying on skill level and strength to increase damage.

facts.fact: There is a chance of dealing a staggering blow, knocking the enemy backwards, when attacking without body armor or a shield.
facts.detect: The combat message will indicate if the enemy is knocked back.
facts.action: The bot should avoid wearing body armor or a shield when using martial arts to maximize the chance of staggering blows.

facts.fact: Martial arts has a chance of making an 'off-hand' attack, up to 4/5 at Grand Master skill level.
facts.detect: The combat message will indicate if an off-hand attack is made.
facts.action: The bot should aim to increase its martial arts skill level to maximize the chance of off-hand attacks.

facts.fact: Wearing a silver ring and no gloves deals silver damage, adding +1d4 damage against major demons and undead with blessed gloves or boots.
facts.detect: The bot can check its inventory for silver rings and blessed gloves or boots.
facts.action: The bot should equip a silver ring and blessed gloves or boots when fighting demons and undead.

facts.fact: Rings of increase damage are incredibly valuable for martial arts practitioners.
facts.detect: The bot can identify rings of increase damage.
facts.action: The bot should prioritize eating rings of increase damage to increase damage output.

facts.fact: Iron may rust or corrode.
facts.detect: Iron items becoming rusty or corroded
facts.action: Avoid exposing iron items to water or acidic environments

facts.fact: Wood may burn or rot.
facts.detect: Wood items becoming flammable or rotting
facts.action: Avoid exposing wooden items to fire or damp environments

facts.fact: Certain item materials may be edible for the hero and monsters.
facts.detect: Items listed as edible in the game
facts.action: Eat edible items to gain nutrition

facts.fact: Scrolls of fire and spellbooks of fireball are not flammable like other scrolls and spellbooks.
facts.detect: Scrolls of fire or spellbooks of fireball
facts.action: Do not worry about these items catching fire

facts.fact: Rings of fire resistance cannot be burnt, even if they are made of a material like wood that can normally burn.
facts.detect: Rings of fire resistance
facts.action: Do not worry about these rings catching fire

facts.fact: Maze levels may have walls composed of solid rock, making them diggable.
facts.detect: Attempting to dig through a wall and seeing the message 'You hit solid rock.'
facts.action: Use a wand of digging or pick-axe to dig through solid rock walls to navigate.

facts.fact: Maze levels may contain minotaurs, which are dangerous enemies.
facts.detect: Encountering a minotaur on the level.
facts.action: Avoid or prepare to fight minotaurs with appropriate weapons and spells.

facts.fact: Magic mapping is recommended to navigate maze levels.
facts.detect: Having a magic mapping item or spell.
facts.action: Use magic mapping to see the layout of the maze and find the stairs.

facts.fact: Wand of digging beams only dig a single space in maze levels.
facts.detect: Using a wand of digging and seeing it only digs one space.
facts.action: Use digging strategically to conserve wands.

facts.fact: Medusa's Island is 1-4 levels above the Castle.
facts.detect: Medusa's Island level
facts.action: If the bot finds itself on Medusa's Island, it should be aware that the Castle is 1-4 levels below and plan accordingly.

facts.fact: The Castle is the deepest level in the Dungeons of Doom.
facts.detect: Castle level
facts.action: Upon reaching the Castle, the bot should prepare for the end of the Dungeons of Doom branch and be ready to descend to Gehennom.

facts.fact: The Valley of the Dead is the topmost level of Gehennom and is always the level directly below the Castle.
facts.detect: Valley of the Dead level
facts.action: When the bot reaches the Valley of the Dead, it should know that it is the first level of Gehennom and prepare for the challenges of deeper levels.

facts.fact: The Vibrating Square is the deepest accessible level of Gehennom.
facts.detect: Vibrating Square level
facts.action: Upon reaching the Vibrating Square, the bot should be aware that it is at the deepest level of Gehennom and prepare for the final ascent to the Astral Plane.

facts.fact: Each level can be special in at most one way, and (additionally) host at most one branch entrance.
facts.detect: Special level or branch entrance
facts.action: The bot should be cautious when encountering special levels or branch entrances, as they may have unique challenges or hazards.
