facts.fact: Prisoners are generated meditating and are classified as STRAT_CLOSE.
facts.detect: Encountering a prisoner on the level.
facts.action: Approach and talk to the prisoner to gain information or free them.

facts.fact: All quest leaders are generated meditating and are classified as STRAT_CLOSE.
facts.detect: Encountering a quest leader on the level.
facts.action: Approach and talk to the quest leader to gain information or complete quests.

facts.fact: Medusa is generated meditating and is classified as STRAT_WAITFORU.
facts.detect: Encountering Medusa on the level.
facts.action: Avoid disturbing Medusa until you have a way to petrify resistance or protection.

facts.fact: The Wizard of Yendor is generated meditating and is classified as STRAT_WAITFORU.
facts.detect: Encountering the Wizard of Yendor on the level.
facts.action: Avoid disturbing the Wizard of Yendor until you are prepared for a fight or have a way to avoid detection.

facts.fact: All guaranteed demon lords and princes are generated meditating and are classified as STRAT_WAITFORU.
facts.detect: Encountering a demon lord or prince on the level.
facts.action: Avoid disturbing them until you are prepared for a fight or have a way to avoid detection.

facts.fact: Medusa's Island is always 1 to 4 levels above the Castle, placing it between dungeon levels 21 and 28.
facts.detect: The game will inform the player when they are on Medusa's Island.
facts.action: Prepare for a level with chaotic monsters and specific hazards.

facts.fact: There is a historic statue of a knight named Perseus with a cursed +0 shield of reflection (25% chance) and a +0 pair of levitation boots (25% chance).
facts.detect: The player will see a statue of Perseus on the level.
facts.action: Approach the statue carefully and use a scroll of remove curse if the shield is picked up.

facts.fact: Medusa is waiting on the down stairs with the statue of Perseus, and the doors to her room are locked.
facts.detect: The game will inform the player that Medusa is waiting on the down stairs.
facts.action: Avoid Medusa until adequately prepared to deal with her and the level's hazards.

facts.fact: The level is non-teleport and ineligible to leave bones files.
facts.detect: The game will not leave bones files after the player dies on this level.
facts.action: Be extra cautious as there are no bones files to return to.

facts.fact: There are four different versions of the island map, each with unique layouts and hazards.
facts.detect: The layout and specific hazards of the level will vary.
facts.action: Adapt strategies based on the specific layout and hazards encountered.

facts.fact: Using a wand of cold, a frost horn or the cone of cold spell can freeze a path across the water.
facts.detect: Water squares on the map
facts.action: Use a wand of cold, frost horn, or cast cone of cold to freeze the water and create a path.

facts.fact: At least eight boulders are needed for the first and fourth maps, 16 are needed for the second, and a variable number are used for the third depending on which island the down stair is located on.
facts.detect: Boulder count and map layout
facts.action: Collect and push boulders to the water to create a path, ensuring enough boulders are available based on the map.

facts.fact: An amulet of magical breathing may be used to traverse the level underwater.
facts.detect: Possession of an amulet of magical breathing
facts.action: Use the amulet to breathe underwater and cross the water.

facts.fact: Digging a hole to the next level is an option, but be careful not to dig on a water-adjacent square to avoid drowning.
facts.detect: Water-adjacent squares on the map
facts.action: Dig a hole to the next level, ensuring not to dig on water-adjacent squares.

facts.fact: The down stairs to the next level is in the same room as Medusa.
facts.detect: Medusa's presence in the room
facts.action: Prepare to fight Medusa before descending to the next level.

facts.fact: A melee attack is a close proximity hand-to-hand attack.
facts.detect: Adjacent to a monster
facts.action: Evaluate if the adjacent monster is safe to attack or if ranged attack is better

facts.fact: Moving into a monster initiates a melee attack against it.
facts.detect: Moving into a monster
facts.action: Avoid moving into monsters unless you intend to attack

facts.fact: You can use the Shift-F command to force your next input to be interpreted as a melee attack.
facts.detect: Intent to attack a monster
facts.action: Use Shift-F to ensure melee attack when needed

facts.fact: You are only vulnerable to a monster's melee attack if you are adjacent to it.
facts.detect: Adjacent to a monster
facts.action: Maintain distance from dangerous monsters

facts.fact: Almost all special attacks count as melee (e.g. stealing or cursing items, but not summoning monsters).
facts.detect: Monster performing a special attack
facts.action: Be prepared for special attacks when in melee range

facts.fact: Mercenaries are chaotic and cannot be polymorphed into.
facts.detect: Monster name (soldier, sergeant, lieutenant, captain, guard, watchman, watch captain)
facts.action: Avoid or prepare to fight chaotic mercenaries as they cannot be polymorphed.

facts.fact: Mercenaries can be bribed with gold to turn peaceful.
facts.detect: Message: 'That should do. Now beat it!'
facts.action: Bribe mercenaries with the appropriate amount of gold to avoid combat.

facts.fact: Mercenaries have a chance to generate with specific weapons and armor based on rank.
facts.detect: Weapon or armor name (e.g., short sword, crystal plate mail)
facts.action: Prepare to face mercenaries with potentially high-quality equipment.

facts.fact: Mercenaries do not respect Elbereth.
facts.detect: Mercenary approaching Elbereth-protected area
facts.action: Do not rely on Elbereth to protect against mercenaries.

facts.fact: Mercenaries will follow the player to other levels.
facts.detect: Mercenary following player between levels
facts.action: Be cautious when descending or ascending with mercenaries nearby.

facts.fact: Metallivores that are not restricted to rustable metals (i.e. rock moles and xorns) are capable of eating metal items.
facts.detect: Encounter with rock moles or xorns
facts.action: Avoid or kill rock moles and xorns to prevent them from eating metal items.

facts.fact: Polypiling enough metal objects has a chance of creating an iron golem.
facts.detect: Polypiling a large number of metal objects
facts.action: Be cautious when polypiling metal objects to avoid creating an iron golem.

facts.fact: Wearing a metallic helm protects against damage from falling objects and monsters.
facts.detect: Wearing a metallic helm
facts.action: Wear a metallic helm to protect against falling objects and monsters.

facts.fact: Wearing metallic armor makes spellcasting more difficult for the hero.
facts.detect: Wearing metallic armor
facts.action: Avoid wearing metallic armor if spellcasting is important.

facts.fact: Metallivores can eat metallic items, including rust monsters eating rustable metallic materials.
facts.detect: Polymorphed into a metallivore or encountering a rust monster
facts.action: Eat metallic items if polymorphed into a metallivore, but be cautious of rust monsters.

facts.fact: Metallic armor often provides better armor class, but non-metallic armor facilitates spellcasting better.
facts.detect: Choosing between metallic and non-metallic armor
facts.action: Choose non-metallic armor if spellcasting is a priority, otherwise consider metallic armor for better protection.

facts.fact: Polymorphing into a metallivore is a key step in eating jewelry to gain intrinsics from them.
facts.detect: Polymorphed into a metallivore
facts.action: Eat jewelry while polymorphed into a metallivore to gain intrinsics.

facts.fact: Rock moles, xorns, and rust monsters are metallivores that eat metallic objects.
facts.detect: monster name (rock mole, xorn, rust monster)
facts.action: Avoid letting these monsters near metallic items, especially iron items for rust monsters.

facts.fact: Rust monsters can only eat iron items and will spit out rustproofed items, becoming stunned.
facts.detect: monster name (rust monster) and item type (iron)
facts.action: If you have rustproofed items, keep them away from rust monsters.

facts.fact: Non-tame metallivores heal from eating metallic objects and may leave behind rocks.
facts.detect: monster eating metallic item
facts.action: Avoid letting non-tame metallivores eat your metallic items.

facts.fact: Metallivores avoid eating amulets of strangulation, rings of slow digestion, and most artifacts.
facts.detect: item name (amulet of strangulation, ring of slow digestion) or artifact
facts.action: Keep these items safe from metallivores.

facts.fact: Metallivores avoid eating poisoned items unless they have poison resistance.
facts.detect: poisoned item and metallivore eating
facts.action: Ensure metallivores do not eat poisoned items.

facts.fact: Mimics are represented by the lowercase 'm' glyph and can cloak themselves by imitating items or dungeon features.
facts.detect: Lowercase 'm' glyph, strange object glyph (])
facts.action: Be cautious around items or features that seem out of place, especially in shops or doorways.

facts.fact: Large and giant mimics can stick to the hero, preventing movement or use of stairs.
facts.detect: Being unable to move or use stairs after encountering a mimic.
facts.action: Use ranged attacks or scare tactics to avoid being stuck.

facts.fact: Mimics can uncloak if attacked, searched, or if a stethoscope is applied.
facts.detect: Attacking, searching, or applying a stethoscope to a suspicious item.
facts.action: Use these methods to safely uncloak mimics before engaging them.

facts.fact: Eating a mimic corpse causes the hero to temporarily mimic a pile of gold or an orange.
facts.detect: Feeling immobile and seeing gold or an orange where the hero stands.
facts.action: Avoid eating mimic corpses unless necessary for dismounting.

facts.fact: Mimics are commonly generated in shops and on new dungeon floors with a high level difficulty.
facts.detect: Entering shops or new dungeon floors.
facts.action: Be extra cautious in these areas.

facts.fact: Mind flayers and master mind flayers have a 20% chance of using their mind blast ability during each of their turns.
facts.detect: The message 'The concentrates.' when a mind flayer or master mind flayer is visible.
facts.action: Avoid or prepare to defend against a potential mind blast if a mind flayer or master mind flayer is nearby.

facts.fact: A mind flayer's mind blast can lock on to a hero or monster with a roughly 2/10 chance if the hero has intrinsic telepathy, always if the hero has extrinsic telepathy and can sense the flayer, and otherwise has a 1/10 chance.
facts.detect: The message 'It locks on to your !' when a mind flayer or master mind flayer is targeting the hero.
facts.action: If targeted, prepare to take d15 damage, potentially reduced by half spell damage if applicable.

facts.fact: Monsters hit by a mind flayer's mind blast are not subject to invulnerability or half spell damage.
facts.detect: The message 'It locks on to .' when a mind flayer or master mind flayer targets another monster.
facts.action: If a mind flayer targets another monster, be aware that the monster will not be invulnerable to the mind blast.

facts.fact: A monster damaged by a mind flayer's mind blast will be awakened from any sleep.
facts.detect: The monster's status changes from 'sleeping' to 'awake' after a mind blast.
facts.action: Be prepared for an awakened monster to attack after a mind blast.

facts.fact: A hero polymorphed into a mind flayer or master mind flayer can use the #monster command to fire a mind blast for 10 power.
facts.detect: The message 'You concentrate.' when attempting to use a mind blast.
facts.action: Use the mind blast to damage hostile monsters within an 8-square radius.

facts.fact: A mindless monster cannot pick up items unless they have the M2_COLLECT flag.
facts.detect: Monster types listed as mindless in the game (e.g., b, e, j, v, y, E, F, M, P, Z, ')
facts.action: Do not expect mindless monsters to pick up items or use them, except for weapons and armor they are generated with.

facts.fact: Mindless monsters cannot use most amulets, any scrolls, any wands, any potions, or most tools.
facts.detect: Monster types listed as mindless in the game (e.g., b, e, j, v, y, E, F, M, P, Z, ')
facts.action: Do not fear mindless monsters using cursed items or scrolls to harm you.

facts.fact: Mindless monsters cannot be detected by telepathy.
facts.detect: Monster types listed as mindless in the game (e.g., b, e, j, v, y, E, F, M, P, Z, ')
facts.action: Do not rely on telepathy to detect mindless monsters.

facts.fact: Mindless monsters are unaffected by the brain-eating attacks of mind flayers.
facts.detect: Mind flayer or master mind flayer
facts.action: Do not worry about mindless monsters being harmed by mind flayers.

facts.fact: Mindless monsters cannot be scared by musical instruments.
facts.detect: Monster types listed as mindless in the game (e.g., b, e, j, v, y, E, F, M, P, Z, ')
facts.action: Do not use musical instruments to scare mindless monsters.

facts.fact: A hero casting the stone to flesh spell on mineral objects will turn them into flesh objects.
facts.detect: Casting 'stone to flesh' spell on mineral objects
facts.action: Avoid casting 'stone to flesh' on mineral objects to preserve valuable items.

facts.fact: Mineral rings will be transformed into meat rings.
facts.detect: Ring with randomized appearance of 'granite', 'opal', 'clay', 'coral', 'black onyx', or 'moonstone'
facts.action: Avoid using 'stone to flesh' on mineral rings to preserve them.

facts.fact: Figurines and statues of monsters will usually come to life as the actual monsters they represent if they are fleshy.
facts.detect: Figurine or statue of a monster
facts.action: Avoid using 'stone to flesh' on figurines or statues of monsters unless you want them to come to life.

facts.fact: Mineral wands will be transformed into meat sticks.
facts.detect: Wand with randomized appearance of 'marble'
facts.action: Avoid using 'stone to flesh' on mineral wands to preserve them.

facts.fact: Rocks and gray stones will be transformed into meatballs.
facts.detect: Rock or gray stone
facts.action: Avoid using 'stone to flesh' on rocks or gray stones to preserve them.

facts.fact: Mines' End is the lowest level of the Gnomish Mines and has an undiggable floor.
facts.detect: Attempting to dig downwards with a wand of digging.
facts.action: Do not attempt to dig downwards, as it will produce a pit instead.

facts.fact: Each version of Mines' End contains a luckstone.
facts.detect: Exploring the level and finding a gray stone.
facts.action: Collect the luckstone as it is valuable.

facts.fact: The Mimic of the Mines level contains hidden places with mimics pretending to be luckstones or loadstones.
facts.detect: Finding a pile of gems with a gray stone on top.
facts.action: Carefully examine the pile to identify the mimic and avoid it.

facts.fact: The Gnome King's Wine Cellar level contains a gem cache behind secret doors with a luckstone.
facts.detect: Finding a locked secret door in the northeast.
facts.action: Use a pickaxe to dig through the rock to reach the gem cache.

facts.fact: The Catacombs level is unmappable and contains teleporter traps with luckstones or flint stones.
facts.detect: Stepping onto a teleporter trap.
facts.action: Use magic resistance or teleport control to safely retrieve the luckstone.

facts.fact: Minetown is located on either the 3rd or 4th level of the Gnomish Mines, giving it a 6/10 chance of occurring on dungeon level 5 or 8 in the branch.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the level number when it teleports or descends into the Gnomish Mines.
facts.action: The bot should be aware of the level number to anticipate the presence of Minetown and prepare accordingly.

facts.fact: Minetown is home to the Watch, composed of several watchmen and one or two watch captains who are always generated as peaceful but can be angered through actions such as attacking peacefuls, digging through walls, trying to break open doors or pick their locks, or stealing from any of the shopkeepers.
facts.detect: The bot can detect watchmen and watch captains by their names or symbols on the map.
facts.action: The bot should avoid aggressive actions around watchmen and shopkeepers to prevent angering the Watch.

facts.fact: Minetown often has a collection of shops, a temple, and some fountains (which are always non-magical in nature).
facts.detect: The bot can detect shops, a temple, and fountains by their names or symbols on the map.
facts.action: The bot should explore and interact with shops to find useful items, visit the temple to pray, and use the fountains to quench thirst.

facts.fact: The Watch can be angered through actions such as attacking peacefuls, digging through walls, trying to break open doors or pick their locks, or stealing from any of the shopkeepers.
facts.detect: The bot can detect the Watch's anger through messages like 'The watchman is angry at you!' or 'The watch captain is angry at you!'
facts.action: The bot should avoid actions that anger the Watch to prevent being attacked by them.

facts.fact: Minetown is biased towards lawful monsters, and a dwarven or gnomish hero will have two-thirds of the peaceful monsters replaced by random and often-hostile monsters.
facts.detect: The bot can detect the presence of hostile monsters by their names or symbols on the map.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious and prepared to fight hostile monsters, especially if it is a dwarven or gnomish hero.

facts.fact: The Watch (watchmen and watch captains) become hostile if the player attacks peaceful monsters, steals from shops, destroys/dries up fountains, digs through walls/doors, or applies a bugle.
facts.detect: Messages such as 'The watchman sees you and becomes hostile!', 'The watchman shouts,

facts.action: Avoid attacking peaceful monsters, stealing from shops, destroying/drying up fountains, digging through walls/doors, or applying a bugle. If the player has already angered the watch, they should avoid further actions that might provoke them.

facts.fact: There are guaranteed shops in Minetown, including a lighting shop, a general shop, a hardware store, and a food store. The food store may be a health food shop for Monk heroes.
facts.detect: The presence of shop signs or the names of shops in the level description.
facts.action: Explore and use the shops to restock on supplies, especially food and light sources. If the player is a Monk, they should look for a health food shop.

facts.fact: Orcish Town is a variant of Minetown that has been ransacked by orcs, with barricaded iron bars and hostile orcish monsters.
facts.detect: The presence of orcish monsters, barricaded iron bars, and desecrated temple with an unaligned altar.
facts.action: Avoid entering Orcish Town unless necessary, as it is filled with hostile orcs and traps. If the player must enter, they should be well-prepared for combat.

facts.fact: There are peaceful gnomes, gnome lords, dwarves, hobbits, goblins, kobolds, and dogs randomly placed in Minetown.
facts.detect: The presence of these peaceful monsters on the map.
facts.action: Avoid attacking peaceful monsters to prevent the Watch from becoming hostile.

facts.fact: The temple in Minetown is guaranteed to be present, and it contains an aligned cleric.
facts.detect: The presence of a temple and an aligned cleric in the level description.
facts.action: Explore the temple to pray and restock on supplies. Avoid attacking the aligned cleric to prevent the Watch from becoming hostile.

facts.fact: Dipping for Excalibur will dry up the fountain and anger the watch, even if they are not in sight.
facts.detect: Dipping an item into a fountain and receiving Excalibur
facts.action: Avoid dipping for Excalibur in Minetown to prevent angering the watch and drying up the fountain.

facts.fact: Kicking a door will anger the watch if the door is destroyed.
facts.detect: Kicking a door and seeing it break
facts.action: Avoid kicking doors to prevent angering the watch.

facts.fact: Spending multiple turns locking or unlocking doors will anger the watch.
facts.detect: Spending more than one turn on a door
facts.action: Avoid spending multiple turns on a single door to prevent angering the watch.

facts.fact: Being warned for tampering with doors causes the door to become trapped.
facts.detect: Receiving a warning from the watch for tampering with a door
facts.action: Avoid tampering with doors to prevent them from becoming trapped and to avoid angering the watch.

facts.fact: Minetown has a high likelihood of having a temple and shops, making it an ideal early goal.
facts.detect: Finding a temple or shops in Minetown
facts.action: Explore Minetown to find and use the temple and shops for early game benefits.

facts.fact: If you try to convert an altar and your experience level is at least 7 and also your alignment record close to its maximum, then there is a chance that the altar's god sends a hostile minion.
facts.detect: The voice of booms: 'Thou shalt pay for thy indiscretion!'
facts.action: Avoid converting altars when your alignment record is near maximum and your experience level is 7 or higher.

facts.fact: If a god is angry with you, either from repeated prayer or praying to the wrong god, one of the possible responses is to send a hostile minion after you.
facts.detect: Thou durst me? Then, die !
facts.action: Avoid praying excessively or praying to the wrong god to prevent angering the gods.

facts.fact: If you are at the Sanctum or on the Astral Plane, and you have angered a god into zapping you with lightning, then hitting you with the wide-angle disintegration beam and successfully survived both, then the god will summon three minions against you.
facts.detect: Thou cannot escape my wrath, mortal! Destroy, my servants!
facts.action: Avoid angering gods to the point of being zapped with lightning and disintegration on the Astral Plane or in Moloch's Sanctum.

facts.fact: Lawful minions have much easier access to minions (through prayer) and gain significantly stronger minions.
facts.detect: The bot's alignment is lawful and it has a high experience level.
facts.action: Use prayer to summon powerful lawful minions such as tengu, couatl, white unicorn, movanic deva, monadic deva, ki-rin, astral deva, Archon, Planetar, and Solar.

facts.fact: Neutral minions tend to be too weak to bother keeping around by the mid-game.
facts.detect: The bot's alignment is neutral and it has reached mid-game levels.
facts.action: Avoid relying on neutral minions for combat support as they become weak and less useful.

facts.fact: Monsters may be generated with a miscellaneous item if that monster's level equals or exceeds the roll of a d100.
facts.detect: Monster generation
facts.action: Be prepared to encounter monsters with miscellaneous items, especially in deeper levels.

facts.fact: Regular soldiers have a 12/13 chance of missing out on the miscellaneous item roll.
facts.detect: Soldier monster generation
facts.action: Expect soldiers to rarely have miscellaneous items, so prioritize other monsters for item acquisition.

facts.fact: If the monster difficulty is 5 or less, it has a 30% chance of receiving a polymorph item.
facts.detect: Monster difficulty level
facts.action: Be cautious around low-difficulty monsters as they may have polymorph items which can be dangerous.

facts.fact: Living monsters have a 40% chance of receiving an amulet of life saving.
facts.detect: Living monster generation
facts.action: Prioritize acquiring amulets of life saving from living monsters as they can be crucial for survival.

facts.fact: Guards will not use speed-boosting items, and according to the code are not meant to receive them.
facts.detect: Guard monster generation
facts.action: Do not expect guards to have speed-boosting items, but check their inventory for other useful items.

facts.fact: Mithril is completely immune to erosion, including from scrolls of destroy armor or the destroy armor monster spell.
facts.detect: Reading a scroll of destroy armor or being targeted by the destroy armor spell while wearing mithril armor.
facts.action: Wear mithril armor to protect against erosion effects.

facts.fact: Wearing mithril armor increases spellcasting failure rates for most classes, except for Knights casting clerical spells.
facts.detect: Increased spell failure messages when casting spells while wearing mithril armor.
facts.action: Remove mithril armor before casting spells, unless the bot is a Knight casting clerical spells.

facts.fact: Rock moles and xorns can eat mithril objects, but will not eat unique mithril items like the Amulet of Yendor.
facts.detect: Encountering rock moles or xorns while carrying mithril objects.
facts.action: Be cautious around rock moles and xorns to avoid losing mithril items.

facts.fact: Dwarvish and elven mithril-coats are the lightest mithril suits of body armor, providing 6 and 5 base AC respectively.
facts.detect: Finding dwarvish or elven mithril-coats in the game.
facts.action: Equip dwarvish or elven mithril-coats for optimal protection and weight.

facts.fact: The Amulet of Yendor is made of mithril and is completely indestructible.
facts.detect: Picking up or wearing the Amulet of Yendor.
facts.action: Keep the Amulet of Yendor safe as it cannot be damaged or destroyed.

facts.fact: Moats and pools are bodies of deep water where you cannot swim in your natural form and will drown if encumbered.
facts.detect: You sink like a rock!
facts.action: Avoid entering water unless you have a means to cross it safely, such as levitation, water walking boots, or an amulet of magical breathing.

facts.fact: Moats and pools can be destroyed by freezing or evaporating them, but only pools can be evaporated with fire.
facts.detect: The water freezes.

facts.action: Use a wand of cold to freeze water, or a wand of fire to evaporate pools.

facts.fact: Items that fall into water remain at the bottom and can be retrieved by freezing or filling the water.
facts.detect: There is a large splash as the boulder fills the water.
facts.action: Retrieve items by freezing or filling the water and digging them out.

facts.fact: Moats and pools behave differently in some aspects, such as the chance of containing kelp fronds and the likelihood of digging a pit filling with water.
facts.detect: Note the type of water based on its location.
facts.action: Use the location to determine the type of water and adjust tactics accordingly.

facts.fact: Moloch is the antagonist who stole the Amulet of Yendor and hides it in Gehennom.
facts.detect: Introduction text mentioning Moloch and the Amulet of Yendor.
facts.action: Avoid praying at unaligned altars in Gehennom and do not attempt to convert them.

facts.fact: Praying in Gehennom goes to Moloch, who dislikes anyone and will punish you with lightning or disintegration.
facts.detect: Attempting to pray in Gehennom.
facts.action: Do not pray in Gehennom unless absolutely necessary.

facts.fact: Unaligned altars in Quests and Minetown can be converted, but those in Gehennom cannot.
facts.detect: Attempting to convert an unaligned altar in Gehennom.
facts.action: Avoid converting unaligned altars in Gehennom.

facts.fact: Bad Things happen if you try to convert unaligned altars in Gehennom.
facts.detect: Attempting to convert an unaligned altar in Gehennom.
facts.action: Do not attempt to convert unaligned altars in Gehennom.

facts.fact: Moloch's Sanctum is the lowest level of Gehennom, Dungeon Level 45–53, and is always the 20th–24th level of Gehennom.
facts.detect: The level number in the game will be between 45 and 53.
facts.action: Prepare for a high-level challenge with powerful enemies and traps.

facts.fact: The entrance to the temple is a secret door randomly placed on one of the four walls.
facts.detect: A secret door is indicated by a blue line on the map or by the message 'You hear a faint whisper.' when using a stethoscope.
facts.action: Use a Bell of Opening, wand of secret door detection, or stethoscope to find the secret door.

facts.fact: The high priest of Moloch will drop the Amulet of Yendor when killed.
facts.detect: The high priest is carrying the Amulet of Yendor.
facts.action: Kill the high priest as quickly as possible to obtain the Amulet of Yendor.

facts.fact: The high priest is initially peaceful and must be provoked by entering the temple.
facts.detect: The high priest says 'Infidel, you have entered Moloch's Sanctum! Be gone!'
facts.action: Enter the temple to provoke the high priest.

facts.fact: Do not convert Moloch's High Altar as it will result in instadeath for nonresistant characters.
facts.detect: The high priest is standing on the High Altar.
facts.action: Avoid converting the High Altar and do not attack the high priest outside the temple.

facts.fact: Monks start with a +2 pair of leather gloves.
facts.detect: The bot will receive leather gloves with a +2 enchantment in its inventory.
facts.action: Keep the gloves equipped to enhance bare-handed combat and shuriken throwing.

facts.fact: Monks start with a +1 robe.
facts.detect: The bot will receive a robe with a +1 enchantment in its inventory.
facts.action: Keep the robe equipped to enhance spellcasting and avoid penalties from wearing armor.

facts.fact: Monks gain the intrinsic 'see invisible' at level 1.
facts.detect: The bot will notice it has the 'see invisible' intrinsic when checking its status.
facts.action: Use this ability to detect invisible traps and monsters.

facts.fact: Monks gain the intrinsic 'speed' at level 1.
facts.detect: The bot will notice it has the 'speed' intrinsic when checking its status.
facts.action: Move faster to explore and escape danger.

facts.fact: Monks take a -1 penalty to alignment record for consuming non-vegetarian food.
facts.detect: The bot will notice a decrease in alignment record when consuming non-vegetarian food.
facts.action: Maintain a vegetarian diet to avoid alignment penalties.

facts.fact: The monk quest is generally considered one of the hardest quests.
facts.detect: The quest is introduced as 'one of the hardest quests'.
facts.action: Prepare for a challenging quest with a focus on strategy and resource management.

facts.fact: Master Kaen is one of the most dangerous monsters in the game.
facts.detect: The quest nemesis is identified as Master Kaen.
facts.action: Develop a specific strategy to defeat Master Kaen, such as using the Eyes of the Overworld or elemental strengths.

facts.fact: The Monastery of Chan-Sune has eight earth elementals and four xorns outside.
facts.detect: Upon entering the Monastery of Chan-Sune, the bot encounters earth elementals and xorns.
facts.action: Be prepared to fight or avoid these powerful monsters.

facts.fact: The Locate level has 2 blessed tins of spinach placed randomly.
facts.detect: The bot finds blessed tins of spinach on the Locate level.
facts.action: Eat the spinach to gain strength and hit points.

facts.fact: Master Kaen's Lair has nine earth elementals and nine xorns randomly placed.
facts.detect: Upon entering Master Kaen's Lair, the bot encounters earth elementals and xorns.
facts.action: Use elemental weaknesses to your advantage, such as summoning earth elementals to fight other earth elementals.

facts.fact: Some monsters will wear armor, wield weapons, or use other items.
facts.detect: Monster equipped with armor or weapon
facts.action: Assess the threat level and loot the items if the monster is defeated

facts.fact: Monsters may be tame, peaceful, or hostile.
facts.detect: Monster behavior or reaction to the player
facts.action: Avoid or tame peaceful monsters, be cautious with tame monsters, and fight hostile monsters

facts.fact: Monsters may be in possession of items, either by being generated with them or by picking them up, which you may claim upon their death.
facts.detect: Monster carrying items
facts.action: Loot items from dead monsters

facts.fact: Other items, such as their corpses, will only be generated when they die.
facts.detect: Monster corpse
facts.action: Eat or use the corpse for nutrition or other benefits

facts.fact: The many species of monsters are grouped into monster classes, corresponding to their ASCII symbols.
facts.detect: Monster ASCII symbol
facts.action: Refer to the bestiary for information on the monster's class and behavior

facts.fact: When polymorphed into a dragon, you can use the breath weapon ability with a cost of 15 power.
facts.detect: Polymorphed into a dragon
facts.action: Use #monster command to use breath weapon if needed and have enough power.

facts.fact: When riding a monster with a breath weapon, using the #monster command makes the steed use the breath, if there are any valid targets.
facts.detect: Riding a monster with a breath weapon
facts.action: Use #monster command to make the steed use its breath weapon if there are valid targets.

facts.fact: When polymorphed into a mind flayermaster mind flayer, you can use the psychic blast ability with a cost of 10 power.
facts.detect: Polymorphed into a mind flayermaster mind flayer
facts.action: Use #monster command to use psychic blast if needed and have enough power.

facts.fact: When polymorphed into a werecreature, you can summon other creatures of the same type with a cost of 10 power.
facts.detect: Polymorphed into a werecreature
facts.action: Use #monster command to summon other creatures of the same type if needed and have enough power.

facts.fact: When polymorphed into a vampire, you can change form with no power cost.
facts.detect: Polymorphed into a vampire
facts.action: Use #monster command to change form if needed.

facts.fact: Humanoids have arms and can wield weapons if they have a weapon attack.
facts.detect: Monster description or behavior indicating it is humanoid and wielding a weapon.
facts.action: Be cautious around humanoid monsters wielding weapons as they can attack effectively.

facts.fact: Strong monsters have a bigger carrying capacity and can use two-handed weapons.
facts.detect: Monster description or behavior indicating it is strong and wielding a two-handed weapon.
facts.action: Avoid engaging strong monsters that wield two-handed weapons as they can deal significant damage.

facts.fact: Slithy monsters lack feet and cannot kick or wear boots.
facts.detect: Monster description or behavior indicating it is slithy.
facts.action: Do not expect slithy monsters to kick or wear boots, which can inform your strategy.

facts.fact: Flying monsters can pass over some traps and obstacles without being affected by them.
facts.detect: Monster description or behavior indicating it is flying.
facts.action: Be aware that flying monsters can bypass certain traps and obstacles.

facts.fact: Monsters that are human, dwarf, elf, etc., incur a penalty for cannibalism if you eat them.
facts.detect: Monster description indicating it is human, dwarf, elf, etc.
facts.action: Avoid eating monsters that are of the same race as your character to avoid cannibalism penalties.

facts.fact: Dwarves are always peaceful towards dwarves and gnomes, and always hostile towards orcs.
facts.detect: Monster name (e.g., dwarf, gnome, orc)
facts.action: Avoid combat with peaceful dwarves and gnomes, be prepared to fight hostile orcs.

facts.fact: Certain monsters are always peaceful when randomly generated, such as shopkeepers, guards, prisoners, and quest leaders.
facts.detect: Monster name (e.g., shopkeeper, guard, prisoner, quest leader)
facts.action: Avoid combat with these peaceful monsters unless necessary.

facts.fact: Monsters generated from a blessed figurine are highly likely to be tame, while those from an uncursed figurine are highly likely to be peaceful.
facts.detect: Figurine type and blessing status
facts.action: Use blessed figurines to summon tame pets, use uncursed for peaceful monsters.

facts.fact: Purple worms will attack adjacent shriekers.
facts.detect: Adjacent purple worm and shrieker
facts.action: Avoid placing these monsters next to each other.

facts.fact: Killing peaceful monsters incurs penalties to alignment record.
facts.detect: Peaceful monster name and attacking it
facts.action: Avoid attacking peaceful monsters unless necessary.

facts.fact: Nymphs have functionally unlimited carrying capacity, although they won't pick up boulders or statues.
facts.detect: Encountering a nymph in the game.
facts.action: Avoid heavy items when near nymphs to prevent them from stealing them.

facts.fact: Giants can carry any number of boulders.
facts.detect: Encountering a giant in the game.
facts.action: Do not worry about boulders near giants.

facts.fact: A monster's carrying capacity is  rac{1000 	imes 	ext{monster weight}}{	ext{weight of human}} (	imes  rac{1}{2} 	ext{if not strong}).
facts.detect: Encountering a monster with a known weight.
facts.action: Calculate the carrying capacity to determine how much a monster can carry.

facts.fact: A monster's carrying capacity is  rac{1000 	imes 	ext{monster size}}{	ext{size of human}} (	imes  rac{1}{2} 	ext{if not strong}) if the monster has zero weight.
facts.detect: Encountering a monster with zero weight.
facts.action: Calculate the carrying capacity to determine how much a weightless monster can carry.

facts.fact: A strong monster's carrying capacity is set to 1000 if it would have less than 1000 based on weight.
facts.detect: Encountering a strong monster with a low calculated carrying capacity.
facts.action: Treat the carrying capacity as 1000 for strong monsters.

facts.fact: A blessed scroll of genocide allows you to wipe out some or all the species of a certain class.
facts.detect: Blessed scroll of genocide
facts.action: Use the scroll to eliminate dangerous monster classes like demons, wraiths, or other high-level threats.

facts.fact: Some classes have individual members that are in many ways an 'odd one out', such as stalker and gas spore.
facts.detect: Stalker or gas spore
facts.action: Be cautious and prepared for unique abilities of these monsters, such as the stalker's invisibility or gas spore's poisonous cloud.

facts.fact: Monsters can be examined with the far look (;) or what is (/) commands to reveal their class and additional information.
facts.detect: Using ; or / on a monster
facts.action: Examine monsters to identify their class and prepare appropriate tactics or items.

facts.fact: Ghosts and shades are represented by   and can be changed to X or 8 for better visibility.
facts.detect: Ghosts or shades
facts.action: Change the appearance of ghosts and shades to X or 8 to make them more visible and easier to track.

facts.fact: Some monster classes have unique members that behave differently, such as the stalker and gas spore.
facts.detect: Stalker or gas spore
facts.action: Treat these monsters with caution and prepare for their unique abilities.

facts.fact: Unique monsters and those marked with the flag G_NOGEN cannot be randomly generated.
facts.detect: Monster name or description indicating it is unique or marked with G_NOGEN
facts.action: Avoid using items or spells that generate monsters in areas where unique or G_NOGEN monsters are likely to appear.

facts.fact: If the hero is in Gehennom, lawful monsters and those marked with the flag G_NOHELL are excluded from random generation.
facts.detect: Being in Gehennom
facts.action: Expect to encounter only chaotic and neutral monsters in Gehennom, and be prepared for monsters marked with G_NOHELL.

facts.fact: On the Elemental Planes, only specific types of monsters are eligible for random generation based on the plane's properties.
facts.detect: Being on the Plane of Water, Fire, or Air
facts.action: Be prepared for only swimmers, fire-resistant, or flying/whirly monsters respectively on these planes.

facts.fact: At the end of each turn, there is a 70% chance of normal monster generation, 50% chance in Gehennom, and 25% chance if the demigod flag is set.
facts.detect: End of turn message
facts.action: Be cautious and prepared for potential monster generation at the end of each turn, especially in Gehennom or with the demigod flag set.

facts.fact: Certain items or spells that create monsters have specific probabilities and restrictions.
facts.detect: Using a scroll of create monster, wand of create monster, spellbook of create monster, or bag of tricks
facts.action: Be cautious when using these items, especially in Gehennom or on special levels.

facts.fact: Quaffing a non-blessed potion of monster detection or casting the detect monsters spell at Basic or lower skill reveals the current location of all monsters on the dungeon level for a short time.
facts.detect: Message 'You sense the presence of monsters.'
facts.action: Use the temporary map to navigate and avoid dangerous monsters.

facts.fact: Quaffing a blessed potion of monster detection or casting the detect monsters spell at Skilled or higher skill grants intrinsic monster detection for 21-60 turns.
facts.detect: Message 'You sensing the presence of monsters.'
facts.action: Maintain blessed monster detection to continuously see all monsters on the level.

facts.fact: Quaffing from a fountain has a 30% chance to grant temporary monster detection.
facts.detect: Message 'The water tastes like nothing.'
facts.action: Quaff from fountains to potentially gain temporary monster detection.

facts.fact: Intrinsic monster detection reveals the locations of invisible monsters.
facts.detect: Message 'You sensing the presence of monsters.'
facts.action: Use intrinsic monster detection to locate invisible monsters.

facts.fact: Quaffing a blessed potion of monster detection grants 100-199 turns of intrinsic monster detection if the hero does not already have at least 300 turns.
facts.detect: Message 'You sensing the presence of monsters.'
facts.action: Prioritize quaffing blessed potions of monster detection to extend intrinsic detection duration.

facts.fact: A monster is 'too strong' to be randomly generated when its difficulty is greater than the average of your experience level and your dungeon level.
facts.detect: The bot should notice when it encounters a monster with a difficulty higher than the average of its experience level and dungeon level.
facts.action: Avoid or retreat from such monsters to prevent unnecessary danger.

facts.fact: A monster is 'too weak' to be randomly generated when its difficulty is less than your dungeon level divided by 6, rounded down.
facts.detect: The bot should notice when it encounters a monster with a difficulty lower than the dungeon level divided by 6.
facts.action: Exploit weak monsters for experience and items, but be cautious of traps or other dangers.

facts.fact: You must sacrifice a monster corpse of difficulty 7 or greater (11 or greater if you are chaotic) in order to mollify the god.
facts.detect: The bot should notice when its god is angry and the need to sacrifice a corpse of sufficient difficulty.
facts.action: Sacrifice a suitable corpse to mollify the god.

facts.fact: Difficulty is used to determine the type of offensive, defensive, or miscellaneous item a monster may receive.
facts.detect: The bot should notice when a monster is equipped with unusually powerful items.
facts.action: Be cautious of monsters with high difficulty and powerful items.

facts.fact: A monster considers itself weak enough to try polymorphing itself if its difficulty is low.
facts.detect: The bot should notice when a monster attempts to polymorph.
facts.action: Be prepared to deal with polymorphed monsters.

facts.fact: Monsters with a frequency of '0' are not randomly generated on unaligned levels but are generated on aligned levels and branches.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter 'baby' monsters (dragons, naga, worms, crocodiles) on aligned levels and branches.
facts.action: The bot should be prepared to encounter and deal with 'baby' monsters on aligned levels and branches.

facts.fact: On aligned levels, the frequency of monsters is adjusted based on their alignment relative to the level's alignment.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter more or fewer of certain monsters based on the level's alignment.
facts.action: The bot should adapt its strategy based on the frequency of monsters encountered, especially on aligned levels.

facts.fact: The Gnomish Mines is a lawful level, the Oracle Level and Sokoban are neutral levels, and Medusa's Island and Vlad's Tower are chaotic levels.
facts.detect: The bot will enter specific levels with known alignments.
facts.action: The bot should prepare for the specific monster frequency adjustments on these levels.

facts.fact: A neutral kitten with a frequency of '1' will have its frequency increased to '6' on a neutral level.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter kittens more frequently on neutral levels.
facts.action: The bot should be prepared to deal with an increased number of kittens on neutral levels.

facts.fact: A chaotic black unicorn with a frequency of '1' will have its frequency increased to '4' on a neutral level.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter black unicorns more frequently on neutral levels.
facts.action: The bot should be prepared to deal with an increased number of black unicorns on neutral levels.

facts.fact: Monster level is used in the calculation of a monster's hit points and experience point value, and in determining whether or not a monster's attack hits you.
facts.detect: Monster level displayed in game status or monster page.
facts.action: Be aware of monster levels to assess danger and potential experience gain.

facts.fact: The Wizard of Yendor's level is 30 plus the number of times he has been killed, up to a maximum of 49.
facts.detect: Encountering the Wizard of Yendor.
facts.action: Avoid or prepare for a high-level Wizard of Yendor if you have killed him before.

facts.fact: Named demons and the mail daemon have fixed starting hit points and a starting level based on one-fourth of their hit points.
facts.detect: Encountering named demons or the mail daemon.
facts.action: Be prepared for high-level and high-hit point demons.

facts.fact: When polymorphed into a monster, your hit dice (HD) will be equal to the monster's base level without adjustment for dungeon depth or your natural form's level.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a monster.
facts.action: Understand your hit points and level when polymorphed.

facts.fact: Player monsters generated on the Astral Plane or the final level of the Wizard quest are at a random level between 16 and 29.
facts.detect: Arriving on the Astral Plane or the final level of the Wizard quest.
facts.action: Be prepared for a range of player monster levels.

facts.fact: A hero will attack a peaceful or tame monster instead of displacing them if they are confused, stunned, hallucinating, with no warning occurring.
facts.detect: The bot's status (confused, stunned, hallucinating) can be checked through the status messages or inventory.
facts.action: Avoid moving into peaceful or tame monsters when in a confused, stunned, or hallucinating state.

facts.fact: Tame and peaceful monsters can be displaced if the hero attempts to move into their square, causing them to switch places with a 6/7 chance under normal conditions.
facts.detect: Seeing a tame or peaceful monster on the map.
facts.action: Move into tame or peaceful monsters to displace them and avoid combat, unless wielding Stormbringer.

facts.fact: Monsters that are confused and/or stunned will move more erratically and may attack the hero by accident.

facts.detect: Exploring aligned levels or branches.
facts.action: Be prepared for naga hatchlings in these areas.

facts.fact: You can name an individual item or a class of items using the #name command.
facts.detect: Using the #name command on an item or a class of items
facts.action: Use #name to rename items for better inventory management and identification.

facts.fact: Naming the Amulet of Yendor will allow you to identify it from all the fakes if you drop it or it gets stolen.
facts.detect: Naming an amulet 'Amulet of Yendor'
facts.action: Name the Amulet of Yendor to distinguish it from fake amulets.

facts.fact: Naming a class of items can help in distinguishing between items that look the same, such as different types of gray stones.
facts.detect: Finding a gray stone and using #name to identify it as a specific type
facts.action: Name different types of gray stones to avoid picking up loadstones.

facts.fact: Autopickup exceptions can match on individual item name or what an object class is called.
facts.detect: Setting up autopickup exceptions in the options menu
facts.action: Configure autopickup exceptions based on item names to avoid picking up unwanted items.

facts.fact: To remove a name given to an object or class of objects, enter a name that consists only of spaces.
facts.detect: Attempting to remove a name from an item or class of items
facts.action: Use spaces to remove a name from an item or class of items.

facts.fact: Nasty monsters have a higher chance of better weapons in their starting inventory.
facts.detect: Upon encountering a nasty monster, the bot should notice if the monster is wielding a better weapon than usual.
facts.action: Prepare to fight nasty monsters with caution, as they may have better weapons.

facts.fact: Nasty monsters grant extra experience points to the player upon being killed.
facts.detect: After killing a nasty monster, the bot should notice an increase in experience points.
facts.action: Prioritize killing nasty monsters to gain extra experience points.

facts.fact: Adult dragons that are nasty can tear through webs.
facts.detect: If an adult dragon is nasty, the bot should observe it moving through webbed areas without being slowed.
facts.action: Avoid webbing paths that nasty adult dragons might use to reach the bot.

facts.fact: Many monsters eligible for summoning via the 'summon nasties' spell are also considered nasty.
facts.detect: Upon encountering a monster that can be summoned by the 'summon nasties' spell, the bot should recognize it as a nasty monster.
facts.action: Be prepared for nasty monsters if the bot has the 'summon nasties' spell in its inventory.

facts.fact: A list of specific nasty monsters includes mind flayers, master mind flayers, long worms, purple worms, jabberwocks, owlbears, skeletons, high priests, Wizard of Yendor, Croesus, shades, angelic beings, adult dragons, giant humanoids, vampires, major demons, Riders, Grand Master, and quest nemeses.
facts.detect: Upon encountering any of the listed monsters, the bot should recognize them as nasty.
facts.action: Treat encounters with listed nasty monsters with caution due to their enhanced capabilities.

facts.fact: Using the near look command takes no in-game time unless you are blind.
facts.detect: The bot's blindness status.
facts.action: Use the near look command to check the current square without losing a turn.

facts.fact: If blind, feeling around on the ground can cause YASD if there is a cockatrice or chickatrice corpse on the square without gloves.
facts.detect: Feeling around on the ground while blind and detecting a cockatrice or chickatrice corpse.
facts.action: Avoid feeling around on the ground if there is a risk of a cockatrice or chickatrice corpse without gloves.

facts.fact: The Necromancer quest involves fighting Maugneshaagar for The Great Dagger of Glaurgnaa.
facts.detect: Chatting with the Dark Lord or entering the quest.
facts.action: Prepare for a quest involving a specific artifact and a powerful nemesis.

facts.fact: The Tower of the Dark Lord is no-teleport and has undiggable walls and floor.
facts.detect: Attempting to teleport or dig in the Tower.
facts.action: Avoid teleporting and digging in the Tower.

facts.fact: The Lair of Maugneshaagar has nine spiked pits, one magic trap, and three dart traps.
facts.detect: Exploring the Lair and encountering traps.
facts.action: Be cautious and use tools like a wand of cancellation or a magic cancellation spell to detect and disarm traps.

facts.fact: Maugneshaagar's Dungeon has hostile monsters placed randomly, including four mongbats, nine random {{mcsl|&}}, eight nupperibo, and seven blood imps.
facts.detect: Encountering these monsters in the Dungeon.
facts.action: Be prepared to fight these monsters, especially the nupperibo and blood imps which can be dangerous.

facts.fact: The Great Dagger of Glaurgnaa is a powerful artifact that can be used to destroy Maugneshaagar.
facts.detect: Picking up the Great Dagger of Glaurgnaa.
facts.action: Use the Great Dagger of Glaurgnaa to destroy Maugneshaagar.

facts.fact: Negative gold is created when a stack of more than 2147483647 gold pieces is combined, resulting in a stack of -2147483648 gold.
facts.detect: Wishing for 2147483647 gold pieces and then wishing for 1 more gold piece.
facts.action: Avoid wishing for such large amounts of gold to prevent negative gold creation.

facts.fact: Negative gold decreases your burden level due to its negative weight.
facts.detect: Carrying a stack of negative gold.
facts.action: Be cautious as negative gold can make you overconfident about your carrying capacity.

facts.fact: Eating negative gold as a rock mole or other metallivore makes you more hungry.
facts.detect: Eating negative gold.
facts.action: Avoid eating negative gold to prevent excessive hunger and fainting.

facts.fact: Dropping negative gold in a shop causes you to accrue debt instead of credit.
facts.detect: Dropping negative gold in a shop.
facts.action: Avoid dropping negative gold in shops to prevent accruing debt.

facts.fact: You cannot split a stack of negative gold; attempting to drop just part of it will always drop the entire stack.
facts.detect: Attempting to drop part of a stack of negative gold.
facts.action: Be aware that dropping any amount of negative gold will drop the entire stack.

facts.fact: The hero consumes 400 Cal/hour continuously (no sleep).
facts.detect: The bot does not need to sleep and can continuously play.
facts.action: The bot should focus on finding food and eating regularly to avoid starvation.

facts.fact: A NetHack tile is approximately 10.4 m × 10.4 m × 7 m.
facts.detect: The bot can estimate distances and sizes of dungeon features based on tile dimensions.
facts.action: The bot should use this information to better navigate and estimate the size of rooms and corridors.

facts.fact: The hero ascends in 4 days and 8 hours of Correlated NetHack Time (CNT) on average.
facts.detect: The bot can estimate the time it takes to ascend based on game progress.
facts.action: The bot should aim to ascend within a reasonable timeframe, considering the average ascension time.

facts.fact: The hero eats a full meal every 1 hour 40 minutes CNT.
facts.detect: The bot should monitor its food supply and eat when necessary.
facts.action: The bot should eat food rations every 1 hour 40 minutes of game time to avoid starvation.

facts.fact: The bot can throw a zorkmid up to 52 m away.
facts.detect: The bot can use the throwing distance to estimate its throwing range.
facts.action: The bot should use this information to better aim when throwing items.

facts.fact: XP loss from XL 1-30 for bullet molds & phlebotomy kits increases significantly after XL 15
facts.detect: Player's experience level
facts.action: Avoid using bullet molds and phlebotomy kits after reaching experience level 15 to prevent significant XP loss

facts.fact: At XL 30, XP loss for bullet molds & phlebotomy kits is 34500
facts.detect: Player's experience level
facts.action: Never use bullet molds or phlebotomy kits at XL 30 to avoid losing 34500 XP

facts.fact: A nobleman or noblewoman is a player monster added in the Noble role patch, corresponding to the default version of the Noble role.
facts.detect: Encountering a player monster with the symbol '@' and the name 'nobleman' or 'noblewoman'.
facts.action: Avoid engaging in combat with nobles unless necessary, as they are well-equipped and can be dangerous.

facts.fact: Noblemen and noblewomen on the Astral Plane carry a rapier with a random enchantment between +4 and +8, and it will be either erodeproof or greased.
facts.detect: Encountering a noble on the Astral Plane and seeing a rapier in their inventory.
facts.action: Steal the rapier if possible, as it is a powerful weapon.

facts.fact: Nobles on the Astral Plane are equipped with 1d3 random offensive items, 1d3 random defensive items, 1d3 random miscellaneous items, some gold, and a cheap plastic imitation of the Amulet of Yendor.
facts.detect: Encountering a noble on the Astral Plane and seeing a variety of items in their inventory.
facts.action: Steal useful items from the noble's inventory, especially if they have offensive or defensive items.

facts.fact: Most nobles encountered in the main dungeon will turn out to be doppelgangers.
facts.detect: Encountering a noble in the main dungeon and observing unusual behavior or noticing that it is not a true noble.
facts.action: Avoid or prepare for combat with doppelgangers, as they can be deceptive and dangerous.

facts.fact: Nobleman and noblewoman corpses may be found in the Valley of the Dead.
facts.detect: Finding a corpse labeled 'nobleman' or 'noblewoman' in the Valley of the Dead.
facts.action: Avoid the corpses to prevent reviving them as hostile player monsters.

facts.fact: Entering Fort Ludios while Croesus is still alive produces noise that wakes sleeping monsters on the entire level.
facts.detect: Entering Fort Ludios and seeing Croesus alive.
facts.action: Avoid entering Fort Ludios if Croesus is alive or be prepared for a large number of awakened monsters.

facts.fact: Entering a throne room, swamp, graveyard or treasure zoo for the first time without stealth has a 1 in 3 chance of waking each monster on the level.
facts.detect: Entering a throne room, swamp, graveyard or treasure zoo for the first time.
facts.action: Use stealth or be prepared for a large number of awakened monsters.

facts.fact: Turning undead produces noise that wakes sleeping monsters in line of sight.
facts.detect: Using a holy water, blessed weapon, or other means to turn undead.
facts.action: Avoid turning undead in areas with many sleeping monsters or use it cautiously.

facts.fact: Using a drum of earthquake produces noise that wakes sleeping monsters in a radius of 41.
facts.detect: Using a drum of earthquake.
facts.action: Avoid using a drum of earthquake in areas with many sleeping monsters.

facts.fact: Stepping on a squeaky board produces noise that wakes sleeping monsters in a radius of 4.5 × sqrt(XL) for you, 6.3 for monsters.
facts.detect: Stepping on a squeaky board.
facts.action: Avoid stepping on squeaky boards in areas with many sleeping monsters.

facts.fact: On a non-teleport level, you cannot escape monsters by teleporting yourself, but neither can monsters escape from you.
facts.detect: A mysterious force prevents you from teleporting!
facts.action: Change strategy to avoid or fight monsters directly instead of trying to teleport away.

facts.fact: Covetous monsters can still warp to the up-staircase on non-teleport levels.
facts.detect: Master lich, arch-lich, quest nemesis, or demon lord/prince warping to up-staircase.
facts.action: Stand on the up-staircase to block the monster's warping.

facts.fact: If engulfed on a non-teleport level, you cannot escape by teleporting yourself, but teleporting the engulfing monster will free you.
facts.detect: Engulfed by a monster.
facts.action: Use a wand of teleportation to teleport the engulfing monster away.

facts.fact: Demon lairs are non-teleport levels.
facts.detect: Entering a level with a demon lair.
facts.action: Be prepared for non-teleport restrictions and covetous monsters.

facts.fact: Moloch's Sanctum is a non-teleport level.
facts.detect: Entering Moloch's Sanctum.
facts.action: Prepare for high-density monster encounters and use teleportation wands defensively.

facts.fact: Noncorporeal monsters are immune to sliming and intelligence drain attacks.
facts.detect: Encountering a ghost or shade
facts.action: Avoid using sliming items or intelligence-draining attacks on ghosts or shades

facts.fact: Noncorporeal monsters can move through and over moats, lava, doors, diagonal gaps, and walls of any kind.
facts.detect: Seeing a ghost or shade moving through walls or obstacles
facts.action: Do not rely on walls or obstacles to block ghosts or shades

facts.fact: Noncorporeal monsters are unaffected by drawbridges, portcullises, and falling boulders.
facts.detect: Observing a ghost or shade unaffected by drawbridges, portcullises, or falling boulders
facts.action: Do not use drawbridges or portcullises to block ghosts or shades

facts.fact: Noncorporeal monsters are ineligible to function as steeds.
facts.detect: Attempting to ride a ghost or shade
facts.action: Do not attempt to ride ghosts or shades

facts.fact: Noncorporeal monsters are vegan to consume.
facts.detect: Encountering a ghost or shade
facts.action: Do not eat ghosts or shades

facts.fact: Nonliving monsters are unaffected by poison clouds and death rays.
facts.detect: Encounter with a golem, undead, vortex, or manes
facts.action: Avoid using poison clouds or death rays against nonliving monsters

facts.fact: Nonliving monsters will not benefit from an amulet of life saving.
facts.detect: Encounter with a nonliving monster while wearing an amulet of life saving
facts.action: Do not rely on the amulet of life saving to resurrect after being killed by a nonliving monster

facts.fact: NetHack 3.6.0 added the overview and annotate commands, which allow you to keep in-game notes of the dungeon overview.
facts.detect: Using the 'overview' or 'annotate' command in-game.
facts.action: Use the 'annotate' command to mark important locations such as Elbereth retreat squares, stashes, and unexplored vaults.

facts.fact: You may want to annotate certain levels with things that are not automatically tracked, such as the location of durable Elbereth retreat squares, stashes, and floors with unexplored vaults.
facts.detect: Finding durable Elbereth retreat squares, stashes, or unexplored vaults.
facts.action: Mark these locations using the 'annotate' command.

facts.fact: Last turn prayed, which is useful for tracking prayer timeout.
facts.detect: Praying in-game.
facts.action: Note the turn number when praying to track prayer timeout.

facts.fact: If your pet becomes separated from you, noting the level in which this occurred may be useful, as well as the turn on which separation took place.
facts.detect: Pet becoming separated from the player.
facts.action: Note the level and turn number when the pet becomes separated.

facts.fact: Annotate, a companion web app for Nethack with many useful notetaking features.
facts.detect: Using the Annotate web app.
facts.action: Use the Annotate web app to keep track of important in-game events and locations.

page: Numbers used in the warning system

facts.fact: The nurse cap, when worn with the nurse uniform by a female character, grants level drain resistance, immunity to sickness, and hallucination resistance.
facts.detect: Wearing a nurse uniform and nurse cap as a female character.
facts.action: Equip the nurse cap and nurse uniform if available and if female.

facts.fact: A male character wearing the nurse uniform or nurse cap will instead gain aggravate monster.
facts.detect: Wearing a nurse uniform or nurse cap as a male character.
facts.action: Avoid wearing the nurse uniform or nurse cap if male.

facts.fact: The nurse cap and nurse uniform make the player more proficient in the use of scissors and bandages.
facts.detect: Having scissors or bandages in inventory.
facts.action: Use scissors and bandages more frequently when wearing the nurse uniform and nurse cap.

facts.fact: If you are naked and wielding nothing, a nurse will heal you instead of hurting you.
facts.detect: Being naked and wielding nothing when a nurse is present.
facts.action: Remain naked and unarmed to receive healing from nurses.

facts.fact: A cursed scroll of genocide can create multiple nurses around you.
facts.detect: Reading a cursed scroll of genocide.
facts.action: Use a cursed scroll of genocide to generate multiple nurses for healing.

facts.fact: Nurses will not teleport away on no-teleport levels such as the Castle or Sokoban.
facts.detect: Being on a no-teleport level like Sokoban.
facts.action: Choose a no-teleport level to nurse dance.

facts.fact: There is a 1-in-7 chance that a nurse will raise your max HP by one.
facts.detect: Receiving a message indicating a max HP increase.
facts.action: Continue nurse dancing until max HP is maximized.

facts.fact: If you have a wand of speed monster, zapping nurses with it will make them hit you more often.
facts.detect: Possession of a wand of speed monster.
facts.action: Use a wand of speed monster to speed up nurse dancing.

facts.fact: The nurse uniform grants immunity to sickness and level drain resistance if the player is female and wearing a nurse cap.
facts.detect: Wearing a nurse uniform and nurse cap, being female
facts.action: Equip the nurse uniform and nurse cap if available and if female to gain level drain resistance and immunity to sickness.

facts.fact: A male character who wears the nurse uniform or nurse cap will instead gain aggravate monster.
facts.detect: Wearing a nurse uniform or nurse cap, being male
facts.action: Avoid wearing the nurse uniform or nurse cap if male to prevent aggravate monster.

facts.fact: Nurse clothing makes one more proficient in the use of scissors and bandages.
facts.detect: Wearing a nurse uniform
facts.action: Use scissors and bandages more effectively when wearing the nurse uniform.

facts.fact: A hero starts the game with 900 points of nutrition and loses 1 point per turn under normal circumstances.
facts.detect: Hero's nutrition level decreases by 1 point per turn unless invulnerable, wearing a ring of slow digestion, or polymorphed into an inediate monster.
facts.action: Eat food or use other means to maintain nutrition levels above 150 to avoid entering the 'Hungry' state.

facts.fact: A hero loses additional nutrition points on odd and even turns based on certain conditions such as encumbrance level, regeneration property, and voracious hunger property.
facts.detect: Hero's encumbrance level is stressed or worse, hero has regeneration or voracious hunger property.
facts.action: Manage inventory to avoid being stressed, avoid gaining regeneration or voracious hunger properties unless necessary.

facts.fact: Every twenty game turns, the hero loses nutrition for each worn amulet and ring (excluding chargeable rings with +0 enchantment) and for carrying the Amulet of Yendor.
facts.detect: Wearing amulets or rings, carrying the Amulet of Yendor.
facts.action: Minimize the number of worn amulets and rings, especially those with +0 enchantment, and avoid carrying the Amulet of Yendor unless necessary.

facts.fact: Attacking a monster in combat uses the same amount of nutrition that would be consumed on a normal whole turn in addition to the normal nutrition rate.
facts.detect: Hero is in combat with a monster.
facts.action: Avoid unnecessary combat or use 'safe' movement commands to avoid burning nutrition.

facts.fact: Spellcasting reduces nutrition by the spell's energy cost times 2, except for detect food spell which costs 0 nutrition.
facts.detect: Hero is casting a spell.
facts.action: Avoid casting spells when nutrition is low, especially those with high energy costs, unless absolutely necessary.

facts.fact: Minetown often has a food shop where you can stock up on a lasting supply of food.
facts.detect: Arriving in Minetown and seeing a shop with food items.
facts.action: Buy or take food from the shop to ensure a lasting supply.

facts.fact: Sokoban is easier to reach if you are not playing a dwarf or a gnome.
facts.detect: Reaching Sokoban level.
facts.action: Prioritize reaching Sokoban to stock up on comestibles.

facts.fact: Praying while weak can restore nutrition status, but only after 300 turns or if it is safe to pray.
facts.detect: Reaching 300 turns or encountering an emergency situation where food is scarce.
facts.action: Pray to restore nutrition status if it is safe to do so.

facts.fact: The message 'needs food, badly!' indicates severe hunger and weakness.
facts.detect: Receiving the message 'needs food, badly!' as a Valkyrie.
facts.action: Immediately seek food or pray if it is safe to do so.

facts.fact: Lembas wafers provide 200 extra nutrition to elves while providing 200 less nutrition to orcs, with a nutrition/weight ratio of 120 for orcs.
facts.detect: elf or orc character
facts.action: Dwarvish Valkyrie does not benefit from this, but should be aware of the effect for other races.

facts.fact: Cram rations provide 100 extra nutrition for dwarves.
facts.detect: cram ration item
facts.action: Eat cram rations first as a dwarf to maximize nutrition gain.

facts.fact: Lump of royal jelly has a nutrition/weight ratio of 100.
facts.detect: lump of royal jelly item
facts.action: Eat lump of royal jelly before other foods to maximize nutrition efficiency.

facts.fact: Pancake has a nutrition/weight ratio of 100.
facts.detect: pancake item
facts.action: Eat pancakes before other foods to maximize nutrition efficiency.

facts.fact: Egg has a nutrition/weight ratio of 80.
facts.detect: egg item
facts.action: Eat eggs before other foods to maximize nutrition efficiency.

facts.fact: Nymphs have a base AC of 9, a level of 3, and an MR score of 20.
facts.detect: Nymphs are represented by the lowercase 'n' glyph and have a base AC of 9.
facts.action: Approach nymphs cautiously and avoid melee combat unless you have a high dexterity and a wooden harp to pacify them.

facts.fact: Applying a wooden harp or an uncharged magic harp can pacify nymphs nearby with a dexterity-based chance.
facts.detect: The hero has a wooden harp or an uncharged magic harp and is near nymphs.
facts.action: Use the wooden harp or uncharged magic harp to pacify nymphs before approaching them.

facts.fact: Nymphs can steal items from the hero, including worn items such as armor, and will teleport away after stealing.
facts.detect: The hero notices items missing from their inventory and sees a nymph teleport away.
facts.action: Keep critical items in a chest or container and avoid letting nymphs get close.

facts.fact: Eating a nymph's corpse or tin has a 3/10 chance of granting teleportitis.
facts.detect: The hero eats a nymph's corpse or tin.
facts.action: Avoid eating a nymph's corpse or tin unless absolutely necessary.

facts.fact: A hero polymorphed into a nymph can steal items from monsters and is immune to theft from other nymphs.
facts.detect: The hero polymorphs into a nymph and approaches a monster.
facts.action: Use the polymorphed nymph form to steal items from monsters, but be cautious of the monster's level and HP.

facts.fact: O represents an ogre or its variants (ogre, ogre lord, ogre king)
facts.detect: O on the map
facts.action: Avoid or prepare for a strong melee combat encounter

facts.fact: o represents an orc or its variants (goblin, hobgoblin, orc, hill orc, Mordor orc, Uruk-hai, orc shaman, orc-captain)
facts.detect: o on the map
facts.action: Engage in combat or attempt to tame if low level

facts.fact: Press shift+o to set game options
facts.detect: Not applicable for bot
facts.action: Not applicable for bot

facts.fact: Press o to open a door
facts.detect: Closed door symbol on the map
facts.action: Press o to open the door

facts.fact: Quaffing a potion of object detection reveals all items on the current level, including buried and submerged objects.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel your mind expand.'
facts.action: Quaff a potion of object detection to reveal all items on the current level.

facts.fact: A blessed potion of object detection will display detected items as if the hero has seen them up close.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel your mind expand.' followed by detailed descriptions of items.
facts.action: If you have a blessed potion of object detection, quaff it to get detailed information about items.

facts.fact: Reading a non-cursed scroll of food detection reveals all comestible items on the current level.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel a sudden craving for food.'
facts.action: Read a non-cursed scroll of food detection to find all food items on the level.

facts.fact: Reading a non-cursed scroll of gold detection reveals the location of all gold pieces and gold golems on the current level.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel a sudden urge to count your wealth.'
facts.action: Read a non-cursed scroll of gold detection to locate all gold pieces and gold golems.

facts.fact: Clairvoyance maps a roughly-circular 19-by-11 area centered on the hero's location, detecting submerged objects.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel a sudden urge to know everything.'
facts.action: Use a source of clairvoyance to map the area around you and detect submerged objects.

facts.fact: Wiping your face is an occupation that takes multiple turns to finish.
facts.detect: Message indicating the start of wiping your face
facts.action: Avoid wiping your face unless necessary, as it can be interrupted by monsters or other events.

facts.fact: Digging is an occupation that takes multiple turns to finish.
facts.detect: Message indicating the start of digging
facts.action: Avoid digging unless necessary, as it can be interrupted by monsters or other events.

facts.fact: Setting a trap (beartrap or land mine) is an occupation that takes multiple turns to finish.
facts.detect: Message indicating the start of setting a trap
facts.action: Avoid setting traps unless necessary, as it can be interrupted by monsters or other events.

facts.fact: Reading a spellbook is an occupation that takes multiple turns to finish.
facts.detect: Message indicating the start of reading a spellbook
facts.action: Avoid reading spellbooks unless necessary, as it can be interrupted by monsters or other events.

facts.fact: Putting on or taking off armor is an occupation that takes multiple turns to finish.
facts.detect: Message indicating the start of putting on or taking off armor
facts.action: Avoid changing armor unless necessary, as it can be interrupted by monsters or other events.

facts.fact: Ettins, skeletons, iron golems, and Keystone Kops are ineligible for offensive items.
facts.detect: Monster name (Ettin, Skeleton, Iron Golem, Keystone Kop)
facts.action: Ignore offensive item possibility when encountering these monsters.

facts.fact: If the monster difficulty is 8 or higher, there is a 1/35 chance that the item will be a wand of death.
facts.detect: Monster difficulty level (8 or higher)
facts.action: Be cautious and prepare for the possibility of a wand of death when encountering high-difficulty monsters.

facts.fact: For difficulty 3 or less, there is a 1/8 chance of receiving a scroll of earth or wand of striking.
facts.detect: Monster difficulty level (3 or less)
facts.action: Be prepared for a scroll of earth or wand of striking when encountering low-difficulty monsters.

facts.fact: For difficulty 4-6, there is a 1/9 chance of receiving a scroll of earth or wand of striking.
facts.detect: Monster difficulty level (4-6)
facts.action: Be prepared for a scroll of earth or wand of striking when encountering medium-difficulty monsters.

facts.fact: For difficulty 7 or more, there is a 1/13 chance of receiving a scroll of earth or wand of striking.
facts.detect: Monster difficulty level (7 or more)
facts.action: Be prepared for a scroll of earth or wand of striking when encountering high-difficulty monsters.

facts.fact: All ogres are chaotic monsters with infravision.
facts.detect: Infravision on the map or monster name 'ogre', 'ogre lord', 'ogre king'.
facts.action: Use infravision to detect ogres in dark areas.

facts.fact: Ogresmasher has +1d5 to-hit and doubled damage against all ogres.
facts.detect: Item name 'Ogresmasher'.
facts.action: Equip Ogresmasher if available to fight ogres.

facts.fact: Ogres may generate as peaceful towards chaotic heroes.
facts.detect: Monster name 'ogre' with peaceful alignment.
facts.action: Convert to chaotic alignment if possible to avoid combat.

facts.fact: Ogres are generated with some gold and either a club or a battle-axe.
facts.detect: Gold and weapon items on the ground near ogres.
facts.action: Loot gold and weapons from fallen ogres.

facts.fact: Ogres can generate with offensive wands and ogre lords and kings may have a wand of death.
facts.detect: Item name 'wand' in ogre's inventory.
facts.action: Equip reflection if facing ogre lords or kings.

facts.fact: All carnivores, herbivores, and humanoids (except monks, abbots, the Grand Master, and Master Kaen) are omnivores when tamed.
facts.detect: Monster name (e.g., 'kitten', 'dwarf', 'necromancer')
facts.action: Feed tamed pets a variety of food types, including eggs, corpses, and vegetables.

facts.fact: Gelatinous cubes can eat any organic material, including wood, leather, cloth, paper, and wax.
facts.detect: Message 'The cube eats your [item].'
facts.action: Avoid letting gelatinous cubes near organic items you need, or use them to dispose of unwanted items.

facts.fact: Only the gas spore monster has an on-death explosion attack.
facts.detect: Gas spore monster
facts.action: Avoid killing gas spores unless necessary, especially in confined spaces.

facts.fact: An on-death explosion creates a 3x3 explosion centered on the monster's former square.
facts.detect: Explosion noise or message 'You hear a blast.'
facts.action: Move away from the gas spore before it dies to avoid damage.

facts.fact: The explosion deals physical damage to any hero or monster caught in the 3x3 area.
facts.detect: Message 'You are caught in explosion!'
facts.action: If caught, prepare for damage and possibly death.

facts.fact: Engulfing a gas spore will cause an explosion that only damages the engulfing monster.
facts.detect: Message 'You hear an explosion.' or ' seems to have indigestion.'
facts.action: Avoid engulfing gas spores if you are not prepared for the explosion.

facts.fact: If a hero or monster is caught in a holding attack when hit by an on-death explosion, the grabber takes double damage.
facts.detect: Being in a holding attack when a gas spore dies.
facts.action: Release any grabbed monsters before killing a gas spore.

facts.fact: Splat! - An egg or melon broke.
facts.detect: Splat!
facts.action: Avoid throwing eggs or melons at monsters unless necessary.

facts.fact: Crash! - A potion hit a monster that you can't see.
facts.detect: Crash!
facts.action: Be cautious when throwing potions in areas with unseen monsters.

facts.fact: THUD! - You kicked a large box or a chest, and it did not move because it is either too heavy or against a wall.
facts.detect: THUD!
facts.action: Do not waste actions trying to kick heavy or immovable objects.

facts.fact: Clash! - You tried to dig outside the map area with a pick-axe.
facts.detect: Clash!
facts.action: Avoid digging near the edge of the map unless certain of the area's safety.

facts.fact: Whoops... - You failed to untrap a trap and just made things worse.
facts.detect: Whoops...
facts.action: Be cautious when attempting to untrap traps, especially if unsure.

facts.fact: A hero wielding a one-handed weapon can wear a shield alongside that weapon.
facts.detect: The hero is wielding a one-handed weapon and has a shield equipped.
