facts.action: Wear a shield while wielding a one-handed weapon for extra protection.

facts.fact: If both the hero's primary weapon and alternate weapon slots are occupied by a one-handed weapon, and they are not also wearing a shield, they can engage in two-weapon combat to attack with both weapons simultaneously.
facts.detect: The hero has two one-handed weapons equipped and no shield.
facts.action: Engage in two-weapon combat to deal more damage.

facts.fact: If a cursed one-handed weapon is wielded by a hero, the hand holding that weapon will weld to it, preventing the hero from swapping weapons, removing worn gloves, and putting on or taking off rings.
facts.detect: The hero notices that their weapon is cursed.
facts.action: Avoid using cursed one-handed weapons to prevent hand welding.

facts.fact: If the hero has a cursed shield in their other hand while wielding a cursed one-handed weapon, they cannot loot or apply containers and cannot cast spells.
facts.detect: The hero notices they have a cursed shield and a cursed one-handed weapon.
facts.action: Avoid using cursed shields or one-handed weapons to prevent these restrictions.

facts.fact: One-handed weapons are preferred by players for the ability to wear a shield and engage in two-weapon combat, which can output much more damage.
facts.detect: The hero has a one-handed weapon and a shield equipped.
facts.action: Continue using one-handed weapons and a shield for optimal damage and defense.

facts.fact: Press {{kbd|o}} to open a door.
facts.detect: A closed door symbol (D) on the map.
facts.action: Press 'o' and then the direction to open the door.

facts.fact: After opening a door successfully, the door will remain open unless closed or zapped with a wand of locking, or with wizard lock spell.
facts.detect: An open door symbol (O) on the map.
facts.action: Do nothing, the door remains open.

facts.fact: Attempting to open down (>) will not allow you to open a container. Use #loot, {{kbd|alt|l}}, or if the number_pad option is on, {{kbd|l}}.
facts.detect: A down arrow (>) symbol on the map.
facts.action: Use #loot or the appropriate key to open a container.

facts.fact: Open wounds is a melee-range spell that deals (ML/2 + 1)d6 damage or (ML/2 + x)dy damage if the monster's casting attack specifies any dice.
facts.detect: Messages such as 'Your skin itches badly for a moment.', 'Wounds appear on your body!', 'Severe wounds appear on your body!', 'Your body is covered with painful wounds!'
facts.action: Equip magic resistance or half spell damage protection to halve the damage from open wounds.

facts.fact: The damage from open wounds is halved if the hero has either half spell damage or magic resistance, and reduced to 1/4 if they have both properties.
facts.detect: Having magic resistance or half spell damage protection.
facts.action: Ensure you have magic resistance or half spell damage protection to significantly reduce the damage from open wounds.

facts.fact: The relative frequency of open wounds being cast decreases from monster levels 1 to 14, but increases again from monster levels 14 to 49.
facts.detect: Encountering monsters with levels between 14 and 49.
facts.action: Be more cautious and prepared for open wounds when facing higher-level clerical casters.

facts.fact: Higher-level clerical casters such as Master Kaen will favor the spell more often against a hero.
facts.detect: Encountering high-level clerical casters like Master Kaen.
facts.action: Be extra cautious and prepared for open wounds when facing high-level clerical casters.

facts.fact: The Oracle level is always generated somewhere from dungeon level 5 to 9 inclusive in the Dungeons of Doom.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You hear a strange wind.' or 'You hear convulsive ravings.'
facts.action: Seek out the Oracle to receive hints and guidance.

facts.fact: The Oracle's room is in the center of the level, surrounded by centaur statues.
facts.detect: Centaur statues in the larger room surrounding the Oracle's room.
facts.action: Avoid breaking centaur statues unless you are an early Archeologist or you are spellbook-hunting.

facts.fact: The Oracle level has a total of five random monsters, three random traps, and six random items placed within the rooms.
facts.detect: Presence of traps and items in the rooms.
facts.action: Be cautious of traps and collect useful items.

facts.fact: The Oracle level is a common target level to dip for Excalibur with lawful characters that obtain a long sword.
facts.detect: Obtaining a long sword and being lawful.
facts.action: Visit the Oracle level to dip for Excalibur.

facts.fact: The presence of naga hatchlings and baby dragons on a main dungeon level typically indicates that a character has found the Oracle level.
facts.detect: Naga hatchlings and baby dragons on the level.
facts.action: Explore the level to find the Oracle.

facts.fact: Orange dragon scale mail provides sleep resistance.
facts.detect: Wearing orange dragon scale mail
facts.action: Wear orange dragon scale mail to gain sleep resistance and protect against sleep attacks and traps.

facts.fact: Orange dragon scale mail has a base AC of 9.
facts.detect: Wearing orange dragon scale mail
facts.action: Wear orange dragon scale mail to improve armor class and reduce damage from attacks.

facts.fact: Uncontrolled polymorph while wearing orange dragon scale mail will revert them to scales and turn the wearer into a orange dragon.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a dragon while wearing orange dragon scale mail
facts.action: Avoid uncontrolled polymorphs while wearing orange dragon scale mail to prevent becoming an orange dragon.

facts.fact: Orange dragon scale mail is not randomly generated.
facts.detect: Not finding orange dragon scale mail in the dungeon
facts.action: Look for orange dragon scale mail in shops or as a starting item for player monsters on the Astral Plane.

facts.fact: Orange dragon scale mail is more useful compared to other colors of dragon mail due to sleep resistance.
facts.detect: Encountering sleep attacks or traps
facts.action: Prioritize orange dragon scale mail over other dragon mail if sleep resistance is needed.

facts.fact: Orange dragon scales confer sleep resistance and 3 base AC.
facts.detect: Item name: 'orange dragon scales'
facts.action: Equip orange dragon scales if you need sleep resistance and have no better option.

facts.fact: Orange dragon scales have a 1/3 chance to be dropped by a killed orange dragon.
facts.detect: Monster death message: 'The orange dragon collapses, leaving behind a corpse.'
facts.action: Search the corpse of a killed orange dragon for orange dragon scales.

facts.fact: Orange dragon scales can be wished for or found in bones.
facts.detect: Wishing for 'orange dragon scales' or finding bones with the item.
facts.action: Wish for orange dragon scales if you need sleep resistance and have no better option.

facts.fact: Uncontrolled polymorph while wearing orange dragon scales will turn the wearer into a orange dragon.
facts.detect: Polymorph message: 'You feel yourself turning into a orange dragon!'
facts.action: Avoid uncontrolled polymorph while wearing orange dragon scales.

facts.fact: Orange dragon scales are useless for elven characters at level 4 due to intrinsic sleep resistance.
facts.detect: Character race: 'Elven' and experience level: '4'
facts.action: Do not equip orange dragon scales if you are an elven character at level 4 or higher.

facts.fact: Orcs attacking you while you are riding have a 2/4 chance of hitting your steed versus the standard 1/4 chance for other monsters.
facts.detect: The bot is riding a steed and encounters orcs.
facts.action: Avoid riding a steed when fighting orcs to prevent your steed from being targeted.

facts.fact: Wielding Sting or Orcrist will warn you of any orcs on the current level.
facts.detect: The bot wields Sting or Orcrist and receives a warning message about orcs.
facts.action: Equip Sting or Orcrist to detect orcs on the level.

facts.fact: Orcs may generate peaceful towards chaotic characters, but will always be hostile to elven characters.
facts.detect: The bot is a chaotic character and encounters peaceful orcs, or the bot is an elven character and encounters hostile orcs.
facts.action: If chaotic, approach peaceful orcs cautiously; if elven, be prepared for immediate hostility from orcs.

facts.fact: Orcs have a default 1/2 chance of generating with an orcish helm and a separate 1/2 chance of being given an orcish dagger or a scimitar.
facts.detect: The bot encounters an orc with an orcish helm, dagger, or scimitar.
facts.action: Be prepared for orcs to be equipped with orcish helms, daggers, or scimitars.

facts.fact: Orcish Town is a variant of Minetown overrun by orcs, with the usual inhabitants all dead.
facts.detect: The bot enters a level described as 'Orcish Town' with numerous hostile orcs.
facts.action: Be prepared for a high concentration of hostile orcs and loot in Orcish Town.

facts.fact: Orc warrior has a resistance to sleep (resistances=sleep)
facts.detect: Orc warrior is encountered
facts.action: Avoid using sleep spells or wands of sleep on orc warriors

facts.fact: Orc warrior has an AC of 10
facts.detect: Orc warrior is encountered
facts.action: Prepare for combat with weapons or spells that can penetrate AC 10

facts.fact: Orc warrior has a strength attribute (strong=1)
facts.detect: Orc warrior is encountered
facts.action: Be cautious in melee combat as orc warriors may be strong fighters

facts.fact: Orc warrior has a greed attribute (greedy=1)
facts.detect: Orc warrior is encountered
facts.action: Be wary of orc warriors approaching your inventory or equipped items

facts.fact: Orc warrior has an infravision attribute (infravisible=1)
facts.detect: Orc warrior is encountered
facts.action: Be cautious in dark areas as orc warriors can see in the dark

facts.fact: Orcus-town is placed between the 10th and 15th levels of Gehennom.
facts.detect: The bot will notice the level number when it teleports or descends into Gehennom.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious and prepare for a challenging level with unique features.

facts.fact: Orcus is on the downstair, accompanied by several powerful undead monsters.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter Orcus and his entourage when it reaches the downstair.
facts.action: The bot should avoid direct confrontation and consider alternative strategies like digging or teleporting to the level below.

facts.fact: There are two shops with many items and lots of mimics.
facts.detect: The bot will see the shop signs and encounter mimics.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious when entering shops and consider genociding mimics before arriving on this level.

facts.fact: The level contains various traps including magic traps, fire traps, spiked pits, anti-magic traps, and sleeping gas traps.
facts.detect: The bot will trigger traps or see trap descriptions when moving through the level.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious and use tools like magic cancellation or fire resistance to avoid traps.

facts.fact: Orcus' wand of death is a valuable item.
facts.detect: The bot will see Orcus and his wand when it reaches the downstair.
facts.action: The bot should attempt to acquire the wand of death, possibly by stoning Orcus from a distance.

facts.fact: Organic items are vulnerable to fire and can rot away if buried.
facts.detect: Item description or engulfed by a gelatinous cube
facts.action: Avoid burying organic items and protect them from fire.

facts.fact: If engulfed by a gelatinous cube, an organic item has a 95% probability of dissolving.
facts.detect: Engulfed by a gelatinous cube
facts.action: Avoid being engulfed by gelatinous cubes or wear protection from engulfment.

facts.fact: An overlord gains a +2 multishot bonus when throwing or shooting projectiles.
facts.detect: The bot should identify monsters with the 'prince' designation, such as 'dwarf king', 'ogre king', etc.
facts.action: Avoid engaging in projectile combat with these monsters, especially from a distance.

facts.fact: Overlords are more likely to receive default weapon sets with a minimum enchantment of +1 and armor with a minimum enchantment of +0.
facts.detect: Identify the overlord monsters by their names and observe their equipped items.
facts.action: Prioritize disarming and weakening these monsters before engaging in melee combat.

facts.fact: Demon princes can only be generated by demon gating from the melee attacks of other demon lords and princes.
facts.detect: Encounter with demon lords or princes in melee combat.
facts.action: Avoid prolonged melee combat with demon lords and princes to prevent the generation of demon princes.

facts.fact: Overlords often rule over throne rooms and are the final stage of growth for certain monsters.
facts.detect: Entering a throne room or encountering a monster that is the final form of its kind.
facts.action: Be cautious and prepared for a powerful opponent when entering throne rooms or encountering the final form of a monster.

facts.fact: Sitting on a throne while in the form of a monster overlord results in a specific message.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel very comfortable here.'
facts.action: Avoid sitting on thrones while in the form of a monster overlord to prevent unwanted effects.

facts.fact: The #overview command displays notable features of the explored dungeon, including altars, thrones, fountains, sinks, graves, trees, special rooms, and stairs to other dungeon branches.
facts.detect: The bot can invoke the #overview command by pressing ctrl+o or alt+O.
facts.action: The bot should use the #overview command to gather information about the dungeon layout and notable features on each level.

facts.fact: Special rooms such as shops and temples are reported in the overview, with multiple shops being described as 'some shops' or 'many shops'.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the presence of shops or temples in the overview description.
facts.action: The bot should prioritize visiting shops to buy necessary items and temples to pray for blessings or to recover.

facts.fact: Stairs to other dungeon branches are listed in the overview.
facts.detect: The bot can see the mention of stairs to other branches in the overview description.
facts.action: The bot should use the information about stairs to navigate to deeper levels or other branches as needed.

facts.fact: If a level was loaded from bones, the overview will list the name, race, role, and alignment of the character along with their cause of death.
facts.detect: The bot can see the bones level information in the overview description.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious and avoid repeating the same mistakes that led to the previous character's death.

facts.fact: Pressing m before entering the #overview command allows editing of annotations on any level.
facts.detect: The bot can press m before invoking the #overview command.
facts.action: The bot should use this feature to add notes about important features or dangers on each level.

facts.fact: Some randomly-generated eggs are the eggs of oviparous monsters and will hatch into that monster's 'youngest' available form unless they are left in a container.
facts.detect: Egg item in inventory or on the ground
facts.action: Store eggs in a container to prevent them from hatching into young monsters

facts.fact: If the player is polymorphed into a female oviparous monster, the #sit command can be used to lay an egg, which will hatch into a tame monster.
facts.detect: Polymorphed into a female oviparous monster
facts.action: Use #sit command to lay an egg and potentially tame a monster

facts.fact: All adult dragons except the Chromatic Dragon and Ixoth are oviparous.
facts.detect: Adult dragon polymorph form
facts.action: If polymorphed into an adult dragon, laying an egg may result in a young dragon

facts.fact: All avian monsters are oviparous.
facts.detect: Polymorphed into an avian monster
facts.action: Use #sit command to lay an egg and potentially tame a young avian monster

facts.fact: All mammalian monsters are oviparous.
facts.detect: Polymorphed into a mammalian monster
facts.action: Use #sit command to lay an egg and potentially tame a young mammalian monster

facts.fact: P represents a pudding or ooze (gray ooze, brown pudding, black pudding, green slime)
facts.detect: P on the map or exact monster name in inventory or level
facts.action: Avoid or prepare to fight oozes and puddings with fire or acid attacks, or polymorph

facts.fact: Press p to pay the hero's shop bill
facts.detect: Shopkeeper says 'You owe me money!'
facts.action: Type p to pay the bill

facts.fact: Press shift+p to put on a ring, an amulet, or other accessory
facts.detect: Wearing a ring or amulet in inventory
facts.action: Use shift+p to equip or unequip rings and amulets

facts.fact: Press ctrl+p to repeat previous messages
facts.detect: Need to review previous messages
facts.action: Use ctrl+p to scroll back through messages

facts.fact: Pairs of lenses make up 0.5% of all tools that are randomly generated on the ground, in general shops or as death drops.
facts.detect: Finding a pair of lenses in a general shop or on the ground.
facts.action: Pick up and wear the lenses if not blindfolded or wearing a towel.

facts.fact: Worn lenses block the blinding effect of the raven's claw attack and blinding venom from spitting attacks.
facts.detect: Encountering a monster with blinding venom or a raven's claw attack.
facts.action: Wear the lenses before engaging in combat with such monsters.

facts.fact: Lenses improve the hero's luck-based odds of finding secret doors and secret corridors when searching.
facts.detect: Attempting to search for secret doors or corridors.
facts.action: Wear the lenses when searching to increase the chances of finding secret areas.

facts.fact: Lenses increase the hero's chances of successfully reading a spellbook by 10%, while reducing the time taken reading by 1/3.
facts.detect: Picking up a spellbook and attempting to read it.
facts.action: Wear the lenses when reading spellbooks to increase success rate and reduce reading time.

facts.fact: Applying a cursed towel while wearing a non-cursed pair of lenses has a 1/3 chance of pushing those lenses off.
facts.detect: Applying a cursed towel while wearing lenses.
facts.action: Avoid applying a cursed towel while wearing lenses to prevent them from falling off.

facts.fact: If the player is caught in any source of fire damage, paper items in their inventory have a chance of catching fire and burning, with the exception of the Book of the Dead.
facts.detect: Inventory items burning or the message 'You feel the heat.'
facts.action: Avoid fire sources or remove paper items from inventory if necessary.

facts.fact: Paper golems can be randomly generated in the Dungeons of Doom; they may also form as a result of polypiling several paper objects, and are instantly killed by some fire attacks.
facts.detect: Encountering a paper golem or seeing the message 'A paper golem forms.'
facts.action: Use fire attacks or wands of fireball to instantly kill paper golems.

facts.fact: Attacking a floating eye has a 2/3 chance of paralyzing you for d70 turns.
facts.detect: Attacking a floating eye and seeing the message 'You feel a strange sensation.'
facts.action: Avoid melee attacks on floating eyes unless you have reflection.

facts.fact: Being hit by a thrown or wielded potion of paralysis paralyzes you for 1-5 turns.
facts.detect: Picking up or wielding a potion of paralysis and seeing the message 'This potion feels strange.'
facts.action: Avoid picking up or wielding unidentified potions with a price of 300.

facts.fact: Drinking a potion of paralysis paralyzes you for 13-46 turns depending on BUC.
facts.detect: Drinking a potion of paralysis and seeing the message 'You feel a strange sensation.'
facts.action: Avoid drinking unidentified potions with a price of 300.

facts.fact: Wearing a ring of free action protects against all forms of paralysis.
facts.detect: Wearing a ring of free action and seeing the message 'You feel more agile.'
facts.action: Wear a ring of free action, especially on the Astral Plane and in the Sanctum.

facts.fact: Monsters can be paralyzed and have a 10% chance of waking up when physically attacked.
facts.detect: Attacking a paralyzed monster and seeing the message 'It stirs.'
facts.action: Avoid attacking paralyzed monsters unless necessary.

facts.fact: Paralyze is a melee-range spell used by monsters of at least level 5 with the ability to cast clerical spells.
facts.detect: Encountering a monster with the ability to cast clerical spells, such as a hostile aligned priest or high priest of Moloch.
facts.action: Equip a ring of free action and/or a source of magic resistance to reduce the duration of the paralysis effect to at most one turn.

facts.fact: The spell lasts for a number of turns equal to the caster's level plus four.
facts.detect: Noticing the duration of paralysis based on the caster's level.
facts.action: Use a source of free action or magic resistance to halve the duration of the paralysis effect.

facts.fact: Hostile clerical casters are not especially common, but can be found in Moloch's Sanctum and as quest nemesis Master Kaen for Monks.
facts.detect: Entering Moloch's Sanctum or undertaking the Monk's quest.
facts.action: Prepare for the possibility of encountering a hostile clerical caster by equipping protective items.

facts.fact: The high priest of Moloch must be fought for the Amulet of Yendor within Moloch's temple and will be backed up by the evil god aiming bolts of lightning.
facts.detect: Fighting the high priest of Moloch in Moloch's temple.
facts.action: Ensure you have a ring of free action and/or a source of magic resistance before engaging the high priest.

facts.fact: Messages 'You are frozen in place!' and 'You stiffen briefly.' indicate the hero has been hit by the paralyze spell.
facts.detect: Receiving the messages 'You are frozen in place!' or 'You stiffen briefly.'
facts.action: Immediately use a source of free action or magic resistance to reduce the duration of the paralysis effect.

facts.fact: Floating eye's paralysis gaze - hitting a floating eye normally paralyses the player for a period of time, during which they are vulnerable to outside attack.
facts.detect: Floating eye
facts.action: Avoid melee combat with floating eyes; use ranged weapons or polearms.

facts.fact: Acid damage from acid blobs, spotted jellies, ochre jellies, green molds - 50% chance of acid damage, 1/30 chance of armor corrosion, and 1/6 chance of weapon erosion.
facts.detect: Acid blob, spotted jelly, ochre jelly, green mold
facts.action: Wear corrosion-resistant armor and carry rustproof weapons when fighting these monsters.

facts.fact: Stoning from chickatrices and cockatrices - hitting with a bare appendage turns the player to stone and dies instantly unless stoning resistant.
facts.detect: Chickatrice, Cockatrice
facts.action: Wear gloves or use weapons when attacking these monsters.

facts.fact: Rust from rust monsters - 1/6 chance that weapon/gloves are subject to rust.
facts.detect: Rust monster
facts.action: Carry rustproof weapons and wear rustproof gloves when fighting these monsters.

facts.fact: Paralysis from gelatinous cubes and floating eyes - 2/3 chance of paralysis.
facts.detect: Gelatinous cube, Floating eye
facts.action: Avoid melee combat with these monsters; use ranged weapons or polearms.

facts.fact: The passtune is a 5-note tune composed of the 7 diatonic notes: A, B, C, D, E, F, G. H is also accepted and is equivalent to B.
facts.detect: None, as this is a rule to be followed.
facts.action: Use the notes A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H (equivalent to B) to guess the passtune.

facts.fact: Playing a tune on a tonal musical instrument when standing near the drawbridge will give clues: a tumbler click means a correct note in the wrong place, and a gear turn means a correct note in the correct place.
facts.detect: Hearing a tumbler click or a gear turn.
facts.action: Adjust the guessed notes based on the feedback received.

facts.fact: The brute force solution involves guessing AAAAA, BBBBB, CCCCC, DDDD, EEEEE, FFFFF, GGGGG to find the notes in the passtune.
facts.detect: None, as this is a strategy to be followed.
facts.action: Systematically guess each note five times to identify the notes in the passtune.

facts.fact: The slightly clever solution involves making guesses as you discover information, such as guessing AAAAA, then BBBBB, CCCCC, and adjusting based on feedback.
facts.detect: None, as this is a strategy to be followed.
facts.action: Adjust guesses based on feedback to narrow down the correct notes and positions.

facts.fact: The best solution involves using schemes for solving general mastermind games, which require random guesses but on average only a small number of them.
facts.detect: None, as this is a strategy to be followed.
facts.action: Use a known mastermind solving strategy to minimize the number of guesses.

facts.fact: Pressing p while near a shopkeeper will attempt to pay them.
facts.detect: Near a shopkeeper in a shop or adjacent to them outside.
facts.action: Use the pay command (p) to pay off any debts or to attempt to bribe an angry shopkeeper.

facts.fact: If a shopkeeper is angry but not robbed, the hero can attempt to bribe them with 1000 zorkmids for a 2/3 chance of calming them down.
facts.detect: An angry shopkeeper who is not robbed.
facts.action: Pay 1000 zorkmids to the angry shopkeeper to try to calm them down.

facts.fact: If a shopkeeper is robbed, the hero must pay at least half of the amount the shopkeeper was robbed for to calm them down.
facts.detect: A robbed shopkeeper.
facts.action: Pay at least half of the amount the shopkeeper was robbed for to calm them down.

facts.fact: A shopkeeper who is robbed will not take any gold if the hero does not have at least half the value in gold that the shopkeeper was robbed for.
facts.detect: A robbed shopkeeper and insufficient gold.
facts.action: Avoid paying if you do not have enough gold to calm the shopkeeper.

facts.fact: If the hero has only one unpaid item, the player will be prompted to pay for that item.
facts.detect: Only one unpaid item.
facts.action: Pay for the unpaid item.

facts.fact: The statue of Perseus appears on the down stair on the first and second maps of Medusa's Island.
facts.detect: Upon entering Medusa's Island, the bot should look for a statue of Perseus on the down stair.
facts.action: If the bot finds the statue, it should check for a cursed +0 shield of reflection (4/4 chance on the second map, 3/4 chance elsewhere) and a +0 pair of levitation boots (3/4 chance on the second map, 4/4 chance elsewhere).

facts.fact: On the third and fourth maps, the statue of Perseus is placed on the center square of a 3x3 building or room.
facts.detect: Upon entering the third or fourth map, the bot should look for a 3x3 building or room and check the center square for the statue of Perseus.
facts.action: If the bot finds the statue, it should check for a blessed +2 scimitar (2/2 chance) and a sack (2/2 chance).

facts.fact: The statue of Perseus can provide a source of reflection and levitation, which are crucial for survival and progression.
facts.detect: The bot should notice the presence of a shield of reflection or levitation boots when breaking the statue.
facts.action: The bot should prioritize breaking the statue to obtain these items if they are needed for survival or progression.

facts.fact: In the raven-filled variant of Medusa's Island, the statue of Perseus is likely on a different island from Medusa.
facts.detect: Upon entering Medusa's Island, the bot should notice the presence of ravens and the absence of Medusa near the statue.
facts.action: The bot should consider the increased difficulty of reaching Medusa and the statue due to the ravens and plan accordingly.

facts.fact: A lawful dwarvish Valkyrie starts with a little dog as a pet.
facts.detect: The bot will start with a little dog named Hachi.
facts.action: The bot should treat the little dog as a companion and take care of it.

facts.fact: Pets will avoid cursed items and may avoid moving into squares with cursed items.
facts.detect: The bot will see messages like 'Hachi avoids the cursed item.'
facts.action: The bot should avoid moving the pet onto squares with cursed items.

facts.fact: Pets can be trained to drop items near the hero by giving them treats after they drop something.
facts.detect: The bot notices the pet dropping items near it.
facts.action: The bot should give treats to the pet after it drops items.

facts.fact: Pets will try to avoid known traps and may whine or whimper to indicate a trap is near.
facts.detect: The bot hears the pet whine or whimper.
facts.action: The bot should avoid moving into squares where the pet whines or whimpers.

facts.fact: Pets can gain resistances by eating certain corpses.
facts.detect: The bot notices the pet eating a corpse.
facts.action: The bot should feed the pet corpses to gain resistances.

facts.fact: A pet's level decreases by 1, 2, or 3 if its health is at least 40%, 20%, or below 20% of maximum, respectively.
facts.detect: Pet's health status messages or using a stethoscope or wand of probing.
facts.action: Feed the pet or heal it if its health is low to prevent its level from dropping.

facts.fact: A pet's level up involves gaining a random number of hit points, with a minimum of one and a maximum equal to the defeated monster's level plus one.
facts.detect: Pet defeating monsters and gaining levels.
facts.action: Allow pets to level up by letting them fight monsters, but manage their health to prevent them from dying.

facts.fact: Abusing a pet (attacking it) carries a -15 penalty to alignment record and -1 Luck penalty.
facts.detect: Attacking the pet.
facts.action: Avoid attacking the pet under any circumstances.

facts.fact: A pet that dies can be revived using a wand of undead turning or the turn undead spell, but may not return tame if the hero killed it or abused it.
facts.detect: Pet death messages.
facts.action: Revive the pet if it dies, but be cautious of its tameness status.

facts.fact: Pets can use potions, scrolls, and certain tools if they have a means to, and will avoid cursed items and silver items if vulnerable.
facts.detect: Pet using items or avoiding certain items.
facts.action: Ensure pets have access to beneficial items and avoid giving them cursed or silver items.

facts.fact: Alchemy smocks grant only poison resistance.
facts.detect: Item name: Alchemy smock
facts.action: Do not equip alchemy smocks on pets as they only provide poison resistance, which is less useful compared to other resistances.

facts.fact: Dragon scales and dragon scale mail provide their extrinsics as usual, while other armor properties than those discussed do not affect monsters.
facts.detect: Item name: Dragon scales or Dragon scale mail
facts.action: Equip dragon scales or dragon scale mail on pets for their extrinsics, but be aware that other properties of the armor do not affect the pet.

facts.fact: Pets can gain resistances and other properties from corpses, making reflection a less crucial property.
facts.detect: Message: Your pet is eating a corpse
facts.action: Feed your pet corpses to help it gain resistances and other beneficial properties.

facts.fact: Magic whistles will bring all pets to as close to the hero as possible.
facts.detect: Item name: Magic whistle
facts.action: Use magic whistles to summon pets to your location.

facts.fact: Stethoscopes will reveal information about your pet, including how injured it is, its level, and its maximum HP.
facts.detect: Item name: Stethoscope
facts.action: Use stethoscopes to check your pet's status and health.

facts.fact: Phasing allows walking through walls and boulders, but not through water or non-phasing areas like Sokoban, Moloch's Sanctum, Wizard's Tower, and Astral Plane.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You feel much slimmer.' or 'You start to feel bloated.'
facts.action: Use phasing to bypass walls and boulders to access items or escape dangerous situations.

facts.fact: Praying while stuck in a wall grants phasing for 4d4+4 turns if teleportation fails.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel much slimmer.'
facts.action: Pray when stuck in a wall to gain phasing ability.

facts.fact: Phasing can be used to bypass some areas of maps, such as Castle turrets and the Valley of the Dead, but it is not a universal solution to non-teleport mazes due to the xorn's slowness and vulnerability to level drain.
facts.detect: Map features like Castle turrets or the Valley of the Dead
facts.action: Use phasing to quickly navigate these areas, but be cautious of level drain and slow movement.

facts.fact: Phasing can be used to approach a shop from across an unmapped level and steal from it.
facts.detect: Unmapped level with a shop on the other side
facts.action: Use phasing to steal from the shop.

facts.fact: Polymorphing into a xorn or earth elemental grants phasing, but these forms are weak and cannot wear armor or cloaks.
facts.detect: Polymorph into xorn or earth elemental
facts.action: Use phasing ability but avoid combat and be cautious of traps and level drain.

facts.fact: Physical damage is the most basic damage type in NetHack and uses the AD_PHYS damage type flag.
facts.detect: Not directly detectable by the bot, but implied by the type of attacks and damage taken.
facts.action: Understand that most attacks and damage taken are physical damage.

facts.fact: Physical damage is not affected by cancellation or magic cancellation.
facts.detect: Not directly detectable by the bot, but implied by the lack of effect of cancellation on physical attacks.
facts.action: Do not rely on cancellation to protect against physical attacks.

facts.fact: Physical damage may be reduced by armor class.
facts.detect: Armor class value of equipped armor.
facts.action: Equip armor with high armor class to reduce physical damage.

facts.fact: The half physical damage property halves physical damage from most sources.
facts.detect: Items with the 'half physical damage' property.
facts.action: Equip items with the 'half physical damage' property to reduce physical damage.

facts.fact: Only monsters medium or smaller can wear cloaks, and only exactly medium monsters can wear shirts or armor.
facts.detect: Item descriptions or messages like 'You can't wear that.' when trying to wear a cloak, shirt, or armor.
facts.action: Avoid wearing cloaks, shirts, or armor if the bot's size is not medium.

facts.fact: Huge monsters cannot be engulfed, while large ones can.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You are too large to be engulfed.' when a monster tries to engulf the bot.
facts.action: If the bot is huge, it cannot be engulfed by monsters.

facts.fact: Huge monsters cannot fall through trap doors, though they can fall through holes.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You are too large to fall through this trap door.' when standing on a trap door.
facts.action: If the bot is huge, it cannot fall through trap doors but can fall through holes.

facts.fact: Size is only one component that is checked when determining if armor and other items can be worn.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You can't wear that.' when trying to wear armor or other items.
facts.action: Be cautious when wearing armor or items, as size is only one factor in determining if they can be worn.

facts.fact: Statues can only be placed in containers if the monster they depict is medium or smaller.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You can't put that in a container.' when trying to place a statue in a container.
facts.action: Avoid placing statues of large or huge monsters in containers.

facts.fact: If the item would take you past your maximum carrying capacity, you can't pick it up, unless the item is a loadstone.
facts.detect: You are carrying too much weight to pick up this item.
facts.action: Do not pick up the item unless it is a loadstone.

facts.fact: If you have already filled all of your 52 knapsack slots (a-zA-Z), you can't pick up any further items unless they stack with your current inventory, or the item is gold (which gets the letter $) or a loadstone (which gets #).
facts.detect: Your knapsack is full.
facts.action: Do not pick up items unless they stack with your current inventory, are gold, or are loadstones.

facts.fact: Levitating prevents you picking up items off the ground unless you have a bullwhip on hand.
facts.detect: You are levitating.
facts.action: Do not pick up items unless you have a bullwhip.

facts.fact: A cross-aligned quest artifact is likely to evade your grasp and prevent you picking it up.
facts.detect: You try to pick up the artifact, but it slips from your grasp.
facts.action: Do not attempt to pick up cross-aligned quest artifacts.

facts.fact: Monsters can pick up items from the floor as well.
facts.detect: A monster picks up an item from the floor.
facts.action: Be cautious around monsters that might pick up useful items.

facts.fact: Pick-axe weapons have +2 to-hit bonuses against xorns and earth elementals.
facts.detect: Encountering xorns or earth elementals
facts.action: Use pick-axe weapons when fighting xorns or earth elementals for better chances of hitting.

facts.fact: A hero can dig downward into the floor to create a pit or turn a pit into a hole.
facts.detect: Standing on a floor tile
facts.action: Use pick-axe to dig downward to create a pit or turn a pit into a hole.

facts.fact: A hero digging down with a pick while caught in a bear trap has a luck-based chance of destroying the trap and freeing themselves.
facts.detect: Being caught in a bear trap
facts.action: Use pick-axe to dig downward to potentially destroy the bear trap and free oneself.

facts.fact: A hero attempting to dig through a shop's door or wall with a pick will anger the shopkeeper.
facts.detect: Being in a shop with a pick
facts.action: Avoid using a pick in shops to prevent angering the shopkeeper.

facts.fact: A hero digging through the Plane of Earth with a non-blessed pick has a 1/6 chance of causing a 3x3 area around them to cave in.
facts.detect: Digging in the Plane of Earth
facts.action: Use a blessed pick in the Plane of Earth to reduce the risk of cave-ins.

facts.fact: Piercers are designated internally by the macro S_PIERCER and represented by the lowercase p glyph.
facts.detect: piercer monster glyph 'p'
facts.action: Identify the monster as a piercer to prepare for its unique behavior.

facts.fact: Piercers can hide on the ceiling and fall onto targets passing beneath them, dealing 4d6 damage (halved by half physical damage).
facts.detect: A suddenly drops off the ceiling! / You are almost hit by a falling ! / You are hit by a falling !
facts.action: Avoid walking under the ceiling where piercers may be hiding.

facts.fact: Wearing a hard helm will always result in a hit from a falling piercer but only 2 HP damage.
facts.detect: Its blow glances off your helm.
facts.action: Equip a hard helm to mitigate damage from falling piercers.

facts.fact: Tame piercers will not attack the hero and will drop off the ceiling harmlessly.
facts.detect: A suddenly drops off the ceiling! (when tame)
facts.action: Tame piercers to avoid damage from their falling attack.

facts.fact: Piercer corpses provide decent nutrition for non-vegetarian heroes and meat-eating pets.
facts.detect: Piercer corpse
facts.action: Eat piercer corpses for nutrition if not vegetarian.

facts.fact: Piety is a measure of how much your god likes you, starting at 0.
facts.detect: Enlightenment message or prayer on an altar.
facts.action: Maintain positive piety by sacrificing appropriate items.

facts.fact: Sacrificing your own race as a non-chaotic reduces piety by 3000.
facts.detect: Sacrificing a corpse of your own race.
facts.action: Avoid sacrificing your own race unless chaotic.

facts.fact: Killing a pet decreases piety by 1000.
facts.detect: Killing a pet.
facts.action: Avoid killing pets.

facts.fact: Piety >= 15000 on an altar prayer results in a crown and piety reset to 5000.
facts.detect: Praying on an altar with high piety.
facts.action: Pray on an altar when piety is >= 15000 to receive a crown.

facts.fact: Sacrificing certain items increases piety (e.g., Gold: Amount / 2, Food Ration: 100, Corpse: (Difficulty + 1) * 150).
facts.detect: Sacrificing items on an altar.
facts.action: Sacrifice items to increase piety and receive gifts.

facts.fact: When a pink pill is eaten, it will have one of seven equally likely effects, including getting a wish, gaining 600 points of nutrition, becoming very fast for 200-209 turns, being poisoned, falling asleep for up to 49 turns, hallucinating for 150 turns, or being stunned for 30 turns.
facts.detect: Message upon eating a pink pill (e.g., 'The pink sugar coating hid a silver wishing pill! You may wish for an object.')
facts.action: Eat pink pills only in a safe location and when not starving or satiated to avoid negative effects.

facts.fact: The four negative effects (poison, sleep, hallucination, and stun) may be resisted or fixed with a unicorn horn.
facts.detect: Message upon eating a pink pill (e.g., 'You feel your stomach twinge.')
facts.action: Carry a unicorn horn to resist or fix negative effects.

facts.fact: Medical kits can contain pills, phials, and bandages, with a 7/10 chance of a pill giving a wish.
facts.detect: Looting a medical kit reveals pills, phials, and bandages.
facts.action: Bury a medical kit, wait for it to rot, and dig up the items inside to potentially gain infinite wishes.

facts.fact: Attempting to dig up the items too early or too late will reset the rot timer or cause the pills to rot away.
facts.detect: Using a wand of probing, potion of object detection, or spellbook of detect treasure to check on the medical kit without disturbing the timer.
facts.action: Wait the correct amount of time before digging up the items to avoid resetting the rot timer or causing the pills to rot.

facts.fact: Medical kits have more than seven pills on average, but there is a nontrivial chance of receiving zero wishes from a medical kit.
facts.detect: Looting a medical kit and checking the number of pills inside.
facts.action: Wish for more medical kits to potentially gain infinite wishes, but be aware of the risk of receiving zero wishes.

facts.fact: Falling into a pit causes 1d6 damage and can abuse strength and dexterity.
facts.detect: You fall into a pit!
facts.action: Avoid stepping on unexplored squares or use levitation to avoid falling into pits.

facts.fact: Pits can be removed by pushing a boulder into them.
facts.detect: A boulder is pushed into a pit.
facts.action: Push boulders into pits to remove them and prevent monsters from falling in.

facts.fact: Player-dug pits can anger peaceful monsters who fall into them.
facts.detect: A peaceful monster falls into a pit.
facts.action: Avoid digging pits near peaceful monsters to prevent angering them.

facts.fact: Pits can be used to control monster movement and make Fort Ludios soldiers easier to kill.
facts.detect: Fort Ludios soldiers are trapped in pits.
facts.action: Dig pits to control monster movement and make Fort Ludios soldiers easier to kill.

facts.fact: You cannot create pits with a pick-axe or by zapping a wand of digging down at an altar.
facts.detect: Attempt to dig down on an altar.
facts.action: Do not use a pick-axe or wand of digging on an altar to avoid wasting resources.

facts.fact: Movement on the Plane of Air without levitation or flight has a 3/4 chance of failing, with equal chances of exercising dexterity, abusing it, or neither.
facts.detect: Attempting to move without levitation or flight.
facts.action: Carry light junk objects to throw in the opposite direction to move more efficiently.

facts.fact: There is an 8% chance of lightning strikes every turn, which can paralyze and deafen you for up to 50 turns if you are inside the clouds.
facts.detect: Lightning strike message.
facts.action: Avoid moving through clouds and use levitation or flight to move safely.

facts.fact: Air elementals are tougher and faster than those in dungeons, and can re-engulf you after expelling you with wands or spells.
facts.detect: Engulfed by an air elemental.
facts.action: Use wands of sleep or teleportation to escape, and prioritize escaping over killing them.

facts.fact: Scroll of scare monster and tooled horns work normally, but Elbereth cannot be used due to lack of normal floor.
facts.detect: Using a scroll of scare monster or tooled horn.
facts.action: Use these items to deter monsters and keep them away.

facts.fact: The portal to the next plane is stationary but not immediately visible, and can be found easily with the Amulet.
facts.detect: Searching for the portal with the Amulet.
facts.action: Use the Amulet to locate the portal.

facts.fact: The Plane of Earth is the first of the Elemental Planes and is reached by going up from the top level of the Dungeons of Doom while carrying the Amulet of Yendor.
facts.detect: The message 'You ascend to the Plane of Earth.'
facts.action: Carry the Amulet of Yendor and go up from the top level of the Dungeons of Doom.

facts.fact: The entrance cavern contains a minotaur with a guaranteed wand of digging and an Elvenking with a guaranteed pick-axe.
facts.detect: Encountering a minotaur and an Elvenking in the entrance cavern.
facts.action: Collect the wand of digging and pick-axe from the minotaur and Elvenking.

facts.fact: Digging with a pick-axe or dwarvish mattock has a 1/3 chance of generating earth elementals and xorns.
facts.detect: The message 'The debris from your digging comes to life!'
facts.action: Avoid digging in areas where earth elementals and xorns can be a threat.

facts.fact: Digging with blessed tools has a 1/3 chance of a 3x3 area of rock immediately clearing around the hero.
facts.detect: The message 'A mysterious force caves around you!'
facts.action: Bless digging tools to clear rock faster.

facts.fact: The portal to the Plane of Air is randomly placed in one of the other caverns.
facts.detect: Using a scroll of gold detection or spell of detect unseen to locate the portal.
facts.action: Search each cavern to find the portal.

facts.fact: The Plane of Fire is full of lava, fire elementals, salamanders, pit fiends, fire and steam vortices, fire traps, and a guaranteed red dragon. Only monsters with fire resistance will be randomly generated.
facts.detect: Lava, fire elementals, salamanders, pit fiends, fire and steam vortices, fire traps, red dragon
facts.action: Ensure fire resistance and levitation before entering. Use a blindfold or turn off 'sparkle' option to avoid message overload.

facts.fact: There are 40 fire traps placed at random on the level.
facts.detect: Fire traps
facts.action: Use confused gold detection to find the portal to the Plane of Water.

facts.fact: The lava emits poison clouds (green) randomly.
facts.detect: Poison clouds (green)
facts.action: Have antidotes or a way to quickly cure blindness and poison.

facts.fact: The level is no-teleport and has an undiggable floor.
facts.detect: No teleportation or digging
facts.action: Avoid trying to teleport or dig through the floor.

facts.fact: The entire level is unlit.
facts.detect: Unlit level
facts.action: Use a light source or light wand to illuminate the area.

facts.fact: The Plane of Water is completely full of water, except for several moving air bubbles.
facts.detect: Arrival in a bubble on the left-hand side of the screen
facts.action: Stay within air bubbles and avoid water unless equipped with amulet of magical breathing

facts.fact: The magic portal to the Astral Plane is located in another one of the bubbles and travels around the map along with the bubble.
facts.detect: Magic portal moves with its bubble
facts.action: Use a non-cursed scroll of gold detection while confused to safely locate the portal

facts.fact: Only monsters capable of swimming will be randomly generated, including 19 water elementals, nine kraken, eight giant eels, eight electric eels, four sharks, four piranhas, and four jellyfish.
facts.detect: Encounter with sea monsters
facts.action: Use a musical instrument to scare away sea monsters

facts.fact: The player cannot engrave on this level by any means, and cannot cast a targeted spell.
facts.detect: Attempt to cast a targeted spell
facts.action: Avoid casting targeted spells

facts.fact: The entire level is no-teleport and has an undiggable floor.
facts.detect: Attempt to teleport or dig
facts.action: Avoid teleporting or digging

facts.fact: Plastic is a non-organic flimsy material that is flammable and vulnerable to being burnt.
facts.detect: Item names: ice box, credit card, expensive camera, magic marker, rubber hose, cheap plastic imitation of the Amulet of Yendor
facts.action: Avoid burning plastic items or wearing flammable plastic armor to prevent catching on fire.

facts.fact: Polypiling enough plastic objects may result in the creation of a straw golem.
facts.detect: Polypiling plastic objects
facts.action: Avoid polypiling plastic objects to prevent summoning a straw golem.

facts.fact: The player character can be a Valkyrie with lawful alignment.
facts.detect: Starting character role and alignment
facts.action: Ensure the bot is playing as a lawful dwarvish Valkyrie

facts.fact: Lawful dwarves have limited role options: Archaeologist, Caveman, and Valkyrie.
facts.detect: Starting character role
facts.action: Ensure the bot is playing as a Valkyrie

facts.fact: Non-human races have fixed alignments: lawful for Dwarves.
facts.detect: Character race and alignment
facts.action: Ensure the bot is lawful if playing as a dwarf

facts.fact: Some special names have minor effects on the game, such as 'Croesus' allowing truthful claims to vault guards.
facts.detect: Character name
facts.action: Avoid using special names like 'Croesus' to prevent alignment penalties

facts.fact: Shopkeepers in bones files remember the name of the character that angered them. If you have the same name, they'll be angry at you, too.
facts.detect: Character name in bones files
facts.action: Avoid using names that have angered shopkeepers in previous games

facts.fact: Valkyrie player monsters have cold resistance similar to a starting Valkyrie
facts.detect: The player monster is a Valkyrie and has cold resistance
facts.action: Exploit cold resistance to fight cold-based enemies or use cold traps

facts.fact: Valkyrie player monsters have strong individual attacks
facts.detect: The player monster is a Valkyrie and has a high attack strength
facts.action: Avoid direct combat if not well-equipped, use ranged attacks or magic

facts.fact: Player monsters on the Astral Plane are hostile and tough
facts.detect: Encounter a player monster on the Astral Plane
facts.action: Avoid or prepare for combat with high-level, well-equipped enemies

facts.fact: Player monsters on the Astral Plane are given an ascension kit-like inventory
facts.detect: Encounter a player monster on the Astral Plane with a cheap plastic imitation of the Amulet of Yendor
facts.action: Steal the ascension kit-like inventory if possible, especially the Amulet of Yendor imitation

facts.fact: Valkyrie player monsters have a war hammer (50%) or long sword (25%) as their weapon
facts.detect: The player monster is a Valkyrie and is wielding a war hammer or long sword
facts.action: Be prepared for strong melee attacks, especially if the weapon is enchanted

facts.fact: Wizard has a 75% chance of helm of brilliance, 21.875% chance of random helm, and 3.125% chance of nothing.
facts.detect: Wizard character generation
facts.action: If generated as a wizard, prioritize finding a helm of brilliance or a random helm.

facts.fact: Wizard has no shield.
facts.detect: Wizard character generation
facts.action: If generated as a wizard, do not expect to receive a shield.

facts.fact: Player monsters on the Astral Plane may wield Vorpal Blade and cause instadeath by beheading.
facts.detect: Encountering player monsters on the Astral Plane
facts.action: Avoid melee combat with player monsters on the Astral Plane until you are certain they do not wield Vorpal Blade.

facts.fact: Player monsters may use specific hostile messages when chatting.
facts.detect: Receiving hostile messages from player monsters
facts.action: Avoid engaging in conversation with hostile player monsters to prevent instadeath.

facts.fact: Poison damage can occur from various hazards, including venomous melee attacks, clouds of poisonous gas, poisoned weapons, failing to read a spellbook of level 6 or higher, poison traps, eating a poisonous corpse, and quaffing a potion of sickness.
facts.detect: Message indicating when the effects of poison occur, such as 'You feel sick.' or 'You are poisoned.'
facts.action: Avoid or resist poison by equipping an anti-poison item, using a unicorn horn, or gaining poison resistance through potions or artifacts.

facts.fact: For a hero without poison resistance, poison from spiked pits, poisoned weapons, poison clouds, and poisonous attacks from monsters have a chance of inflicting bonus HP damage and may drain points from one of their attributes (typically strength).
facts.detect: Message indicating attribute loss, such as 'You feel weaker.'
facts.action: Gain poison resistance or use an anti-poison item to avoid attribute loss.

facts.fact: A hero without poison resistance that is hit by poison takes extra damage, up to 6 HP for thrown weapons and rn1(10, 6) HP otherwise, and has a chance of one of their physical attributes being drained by 2-4 points.
facts.detect: Message indicating HP damage and attribute loss, such as 'You feel weaker and sick.'
facts.action: Gain poison resistance or use an anti-poison item to avoid damage and attribute loss.

facts.fact: Poison resistance is a property that can prevent the hero from suffering poison damage or attribute loss via most sources of poison, and also lowers the severity of the effects from other sources of poison.
facts.detect: Message indicating poison resistance, such as 'You are immune to poison.'
facts.action: Gain poison resistance through potions, artifacts, or by eating certain corpses.

facts.fact: Poisoned weapons and projectiles that hit a hero or monster ignore magic cancellation, and poison resistance blocks all adverse effects of poisoned weapons other than physical damage.
facts.detect: Message indicating hit by a poisoned weapon, such as 'You feel a sharp pain.'
facts.action: Gain poison resistance or use an anti-poison item to avoid poison damage.

facts.fact: Container traps can release noxious gas which deals damage and abuses constitution with a 1/3 chance of draining strength, a 1/15 chance of severe poison, and otherwise dealing 6-10 damage. Poison resistance prevents instadeath and blocks damage to HP or attributes.
facts.detect: Container trap releasing noxious gas
facts.action: Avoid stepping on container traps without poison resistance or use magic cancellation to detect and avoid them.

facts.fact: Container traps can also fire a poisoned needle which abuses constitution with a 1/2 chance of draining constitution, a 1/10 chance of severe poison, and otherwise dealing 6-10 damage. Poison resistance prevents instadeath and blocks damage to HP or attributes.
facts.detect: Container trap firing a poisoned needle
facts.action: Avoid stepping on container traps without poison resistance or use magic cancellation to detect and avoid them.

facts.fact: Dart traps have a 1/6 chance of firing a poisoned dart that has a 1/6 chance of draining constitution, a 1/30 chance of severe poison, and otherwise deals +1d6 damage. Poison resistance blocks all effects except physical damage.
facts.detect: Dart trap firing a poisoned dart
facts.action: Avoid stepping on dart traps without poison resistance or use magic cancellation to detect and avoid them.

facts.fact: Spiked pits have a 1/6 chance of poisoning the victim each time they fall into one, with a 5/8 chance of draining strength and a 1/8 chance of severe poison, and otherwise dealing 6-10 additional damage. Poison resistance blocks all effects.
facts.detect: Falling into a spiked pit
facts.action: Avoid falling into spiked pits without poison resistance or wear iron boots to prevent damage.

facts.fact: Poisoned spellbooks can cause the hero to lose up to 10 HP and drain 3-6 points of strength. Poison resistance reduces damage to 1-6 HP and 1-2 points of strength.
facts.detect: Reading a spellbook of level six or higher
facts.action: Avoid reading spellbooks of level six or higher without poison resistance.

facts.fact: Green dragon breathes poison (4d6, drains strength) and cannot be engulfed
facts.detect: Green dragon
facts.action: Avoid or prepare for poison resistance before engaging

facts.fact: Yellow mold causes hallucination and cannot be engulfed
facts.detect: Yellow mold
facts.action: Avoid or prepare for hallucination resistance

facts.fact: Medusa's bite causes instant stoning and has poison resistance
facts.detect: Medusa
facts.action: Avoid or prepare for reflection or petrifaction resistance

facts.fact: Various monsters (e.g., vampire, vampire lord, Vlad the Impaler) have poisonous bites in vampire bat form
facts.detect: Vampire, vampire lord, Vlad the Impaler
facts.action: Avoid or prepare for poison resistance

facts.fact: Eating a poisonous corpse results in HP damage and strength loss
facts.detect: This smells like it might be poisonous!
facts.action: Do not eat unless certain of poison resistance

facts.fact: Poison clouds are represented by {{brightgreen|#}} and are only displayed when in the hero's line of sight.
facts.detect: Bright green '#' symbol on the map
facts.action: Avoid walking into areas with bright green '#' symbols to prevent blindness and poison damage.

facts.fact: Walking through poison clouds renders the hero blind and inflicts steady poison damage each turn.
facts.detect: Message 'Your eyes sting!' or 'You cough and spit blood!' when entering a poison cloud
facts.action: Immediately try to leave the poison cloud area to avoid further damage and blindness.

facts.fact: Poison clouds can be generated by the poison breath of certain monsters, such as green dragons and iron golems.
facts.detect: Encountering a green dragon or iron golem
facts.action: Avoid or prepare to fight these monsters to prevent them from generating poison clouds.

facts.fact: Poison clouds can be created by reading a scroll of stinking cloud.
facts.detect: Having a scroll of stinking cloud in inventory
facts.action: Avoid using scrolls of stinking cloud to prevent creating poison clouds.

facts.fact: Wearing a wet towel halves damage from poison clouds (upcoming in NetHack 3.7.0).
facts.detect: Having a wet towel in inventory
facts.action: Wear a wet towel to reduce damage from poison clouds if encountered.

facts.fact: A hero with poison resistance will not suffer additional poison damage or loss of attribute points from most sources of poison.
facts.detect: The bot can detect poison resistance through the game's status screen or inventory items that grant poison resistance.
facts.action: The bot should prioritize obtaining poison resistance through items or by eating corpses of monsters that grant poison resistance.

facts.fact: Poison resistance completely blocks the effects of poison from being poisoned from a hit by a poisoned weapon.
facts.detect: The bot can detect poisoned weapons through the weapon's description or by being hit by a poisoned weapon.
facts.action: The bot should seek out and equip weapons that grant poison resistance or use items that provide poison resistance.

facts.fact: Poison resistance partially blocks the effects of quaffing a potion of sickness that is not blessed.
facts.detect: The bot can detect a potion of sickness through the potion's description or by quaffing it.
facts.action: The bot should avoid quaffing potions of sickness unless blessed or have poison resistance.

facts.fact: Poison resistance partially blocks the effects of being inside a poison cloud.
facts.detect: The bot can detect poison clouds through the game's status screen or by entering an area with a stinking cloud spell or poison breath weapon.
facts.action: The bot should avoid entering areas with poison clouds or use items that provide poison resistance.

facts.fact: Poison resistance can be obtained through various items such as a ring of poison resistance or an amulet versus poison.
facts.detect: The bot can detect these items through the game's inventory or by finding them in the dungeon.
facts.action: The bot should prioritize equipping items that grant poison resistance.

facts.fact: Barbarians have innate poison resistance.
facts.detect: Role selection screen or character creation.
facts.action: Choose Barbarian as the role if available.

facts.fact: Monks gain poison resistance at level 3.
facts.detect: Character level up message: 'You gain poison resistance.'
facts.action: Level up to level 3 as a Monk.

facts.fact: Poison resistance is crucial for dealing with killer bees and soldier ants.
facts.detect: Encounter with killer bees or soldier ants.
facts.action: Gain poison resistance before encountering these monsters.

facts.fact: Orcish heroes have intrinsic poison resistance.
facts.detect: Race selection screen or character creation.
facts.action: Choose Orc as the race if available.

facts.fact: Eating certain corpses grants poison resistance but can be dangerous.
facts.detect: List of corpses that grant poison resistance.
facts.action: Eat safe corpses or use a tinning kit to avoid poison damage.

facts.fact: A chaotic hero has a 100% chance of compatible projectiles in their starting inventory generating as poisoned.
facts.detect: Starting inventory contains poisoned projectiles
facts.action: Be cautious with starting poisoned projectiles to avoid alignment penalties and potential poisoning.

facts.fact: Darts, shuriken, crossbow bolts, and all types of arrow weapons have a 100% chance of generating as poisoned.
facts.detect: Finding darts, shuriken, crossbow bolts, or arrows
facts.action: Avoid using these weapons if not poison resistant to prevent damage and alignment penalties.

facts.fact: Orcish arrows generated in a monster's starting inventory are always poisoned.
facts.detect: Encountering orcs with poisoned arrows
facts.action: Be cautious when fighting orcs with poisoned arrows to avoid poisoning.

facts.fact: The artifact Grimtooth is always created as permanently poisoned.
facts.detect: Picking up Grimtooth
facts.action: Avoid using Grimtooth unless poison resistant to prevent severe damage and alignment penalties.

facts.fact: Each time a hero hits with a poisoned weapon, there is a weight-based chance equal to 1 in (10 - wt/10) of the weapon's poisonous coating wearing off.
facts.detect: Weapon loses its coating after hitting a monster
facts.action: Keep track of weapon durability and avoid using poisoned weapons that are close to losing their coating.

facts.fact: Polearms can be used to attack monsters from two squares away.
facts.detect: The bot can notice this when it sees a polearm in its inventory and understands the mechanics of polearms.
facts.action: Use polearms to attack monsters from a distance to avoid melee combat.

facts.fact: Polearms can be 'fired' via the 'f' command to pound monsters repeatedly if there is a single valid target.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this when it sees a polearm and a single valid target within range.
facts.action: Use the 'f' command to repeatedly attack a single monster from a distance.

facts.fact: Trolls have a roughly 50% chance of being generated with a ranseur, partisan, glaive, or spetum.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this when it encounters a troll and the troll is wielding one of these polearms.
facts.action: Be cautious when encountering trolls as they may be wielding polearms.

facts.fact: Polearms can be used to trigger known traps at a distance.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this when it sees a trap on the map and has a polearm in its inventory.
facts.action: Use a polearm to trigger traps from a distance to avoid taking damage.

facts.fact: Polearms can be used to pound monsters regardless of whether or not they are visible to the hero.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this when it has a polearm and encounters a hidden monster.
facts.action: Use a polearm to attack hidden monsters from a distance.

facts.fact: Polymorphing without control has a 19 - Con/20 chance of system shock, causing 1d30 damage and constitution abuse.
facts.detect: You shudder for a moment.
facts.action: Avoid using polymorph without control unless necessary and have healing and constitution recovery ready.

facts.fact: Polymorphing into a form that is not the same as your starting race breaks the polyselfless conduct.
facts.detect: Breaking polyselfless conduct message.
facts.action: Avoid polymorphing into a different race if you want to maintain polyselfless conduct.

facts.fact: Polymorphing into a form that is too large or small can destroy or drop armor.
facts.detect: Ripping/cracking sound or clank/thud noise.
facts.action: Be cautious with polymorphing into large or small forms, especially if wearing valuable armor.

facts.fact: Polymorphing a monster can result in a weaker or stronger monster, but powerful monsters may resist polymorphing.
facts.detect: Monster polymorphing message.
facts.action: Use polymorphing cautiously on powerful monsters as it may backfire.

facts.fact: Polymorphing yourself is never permanent unless you polymorph into your own race.
facts.detect: You return to form!
facts.action: Use polymorphing strategically to gain temporary benefits without permanent consequences.

facts.fact: Polymorphing into your own race adjusts your experience level by -2 to +2 levels.
facts.detect: You feel like a new !
facts.action: If polymorphing into your own race, be prepared for a potential level change that could affect your stats and skills.

facts.fact: Polymorphing into your own race changes your strength, dexterity, constitution, and charisma by -2 to +2 points.
facts.detect: You feel like a new !
facts.action: After polymorphing into your own race, check your stats to see if they have changed and adjust your strategy accordingly.

facts.fact: Polymorphing into your own race sets your nutrition to a random value from 500 to 999.
facts.detect: You feel like a new !
facts.action: After polymorphing, check your nutrition level and eat if necessary to avoid hunger.

facts.fact: Polymorphing into your own race cures both illness and food poisoning.
facts.detect: You feel like a new !
facts.action: If you are ill or poisoned, polymorphing into your own race can cure these conditions.

facts.fact: Polymorphing into your own race does not cure blindness.
facts.detect: You feel like a new !
facts.action: If you are blind, polymorphing into your own race will not cure this condition.

facts.fact: If the hero polymorphs while they have polymorph control, and is not stunned or unconscious, a prompt will appear asking what type of monster they want to become.
facts.detect: Prompt asking what type of monster to become after polymorphing
facts.action: Choose a form with high hit dice and good base armor class, such as a master mind flayer, lich, or vampire lord.

facts.fact: Choosing to polymorph into a monster of the hero's own species will cause random adjustments to their attributes and experience level, while polymorphing into the hero's own species while in the form of another monster will return them to their base form.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into the hero's own species
facts.action: Avoid polymorphing into the hero's own species unless returning to base form is desired.

facts.fact: Master mind flayers have 0 base AC and can fly. They have five brain-sucking attacks; each one causes d10 damage to monsters with brains.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a master mind flayer
facts.action: Use master mind flayer form for high damage output and flying ability, but be cautious of stoning from cockatrices and green slimes.

facts.fact: Vampire lords are speed 14 with base AC 0 and HD 12. They regenerate and are unbreathing.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a vampire lord
facts.action: Use vampire lord form for high speed and regeneration, but avoid silver weapons and silver rings.

facts.fact: Elvenkings are speed 12, base AC 10 (same as you) and HD 9. They allow you to hit with your weapon damage twice per move, with a 2d4 bonus to each attack.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into an elvenking
facts.action: Use elvenking form for high speed and double weapon attacks, but avoid if elven character.

facts.fact: Green dragon polymorph can permanently gain poison resistance by eating poisonous corpses.
facts.detect: Eating a poisonous corpse and receiving the message 'You feel especially healthy'.
facts.action: Eat poisonous corpses to gain permanent poison resistance.

facts.fact: Green dragon polymorph form has intrinsic properties and can fly.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a green dragon.
facts.action: Polymorph into a green dragon to gain flight and intrinsic properties.

facts.fact: Wearing an amulet of unchanging after polymorphing allows permanent form change.
facts.detect: Wearing an amulet of unchanging while polymorphed.
facts.action: Wear an amulet of unchanging to permanently stay in a polymorphed form.

facts.fact: Polymorphing into a monster form with bite attacks without stoning resistance can cause instadeath from cockatrice attacks.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a monster form with bite attacks and no stoning resistance.
facts.action: Avoid polymorphing into forms with bite attacks and no stoning resistance.

facts.fact: Silver-hating forms such as major demons and vampires cannot use the Bell of Opening.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a silver-hating form.
facts.action: Avoid polymorphing into silver-hating forms to ensure the ability to use the Bell of Opening.

facts.fact: Polymorph traps are only generated on floors starting from dungeon level 8 in any dungeon branch, with the exception of bones.
facts.detect: Dungeon level 8 or higher
facts.action: Be cautious and check for traps before stepping on any new floor

facts.fact: A polymorph trap is always generated on the locate level of the Wizard quest.
facts.detect: Wizard quest locate level
facts.action: Be extra cautious and prepared for traps when entering the Wizard quest

facts.fact: If a character steps on a polymorph trap and does not have either magic resistance or unchanging, the following will occur: If you have polymorph control, you get to choose which monster to become.
facts.detect: Stepping on a polymorph trap without magic resistance or unchanging
facts.action: Equip magic resistance or unchanging before exploring dangerous areas

facts.fact: If you have valuable armor which you would rather not have destroyed by the trap, you can proceed in relative safety by searching (s) every square until you find it.
facts.detect: Valuable armor and need to explore a potentially trapped area
facts.action: Search every square before stepping on it to avoid destroying valuable armor

facts.fact: The presence of out-of-depth monsters, or unusual, Gehennom-only, or non-randomly generated monsters such as woodchucks, is a likely indicator of a polymorph trap on the level.
facts.detect: Unusual or out-of-depth monsters
facts.action: Proceed with caution and check for traps if you encounter unusual monsters

facts.fact: The intrinsic property polymorphitis gives a 1% chance per turn of polymorphing into a random monster.
facts.detect: The bot will notice changes in its form and stats.
facts.action: Avoid wearing the ring of polymorph unless necessary, and if worn, remove it as soon as polymorphitis is acquired.

facts.fact: You stay in the new form for 500 to 999 turns, unless your polymorphitis causes you to polymorph again earlier, or unless your new form is higher level than your original, in which case this time is reduced.
facts.detect: The bot will notice changes in its form and stats.
facts.action: If polymorphed into a higher level form, be cautious as the duration might be shorter and the form might change again.

facts.fact: Polymorphitis can be acquired permanently only by eating the ring of polymorph.
facts.detect: The bot will notice eating the ring of polymorph.
facts.action: Avoid eating the ring of polymorph to prevent permanent polymorphitis.

facts.fact: Like teleportitis, polymorphitis is not that desirable unless it can be controlled, or you are at a very low level and like to gamble.
facts.detect: The bot will notice its intrinsic properties and level.
facts.action: Avoid acquiring polymorphitis unless at a very low level and willing to take risks.

facts.fact: Polymorphed items do not change item class: Potions will always yield potions, scrolls will yield scrolls, armor will always yield armor, etc.
facts.detect: Item class remains the same after polymorphing
facts.action: Ensure polyfodder includes items of the desired class to increase chances of getting useful items

facts.fact: Unicorn horns are especially popular polyfodder because they may polymorph into other magical tools, such as magic markers.
facts.detect: Unicorn horn item in inventory
facts.action: Use unicorn horns as polyfodder to increase chances of getting magical tools

facts.fact: Polymorphing retains the charges and enchantment of polymorphed items.
facts.detect: Item with charges or enchantment
facts.action: Include charged or enchanted items in polyfodder to retain their properties

facts.fact: The probability of an item stack undergoing system shock depends on its BUC status, unless it is a wand, and its size.
facts.detect: Item stack size and BUC status
facts.action: Bless items and keep stack sizes under 5 to reduce system shock probability

facts.fact: For each item stack in the pile that undergoes a system shock, there is a chance of a golem being created.
facts.detect: System shock message
facts.action: Avoid polypiling in areas with valuable items to prevent golem creation and destruction

facts.fact: The game will try twice to turn a roll of blank paper into a scroll of blank paper again (with a 6% chance of success) and then turn it into any scroll according to the probabilities in the scroll table (which gives it an additional 2.8% chance to end up as blank paper again).
facts.detect: Encountering a roll of blank paper and attempting to polymorph it.
facts.action: Avoid polymorphing rolls of blank paper to reduce the chance of wasting polymorph attempts on blank scrolls.

facts.fact: The following items cannot be produced by polymorph: magic lamp, wand of wishing, wand of polymorph, potion of polymorph, spellbook of polymorph, artifacts, and any item not normally randomly generated.
facts.detect: Identifying items such as magic lamps, wands of wishing, wands of polymorph, potions of polymorph, spellbooks of polymorph, artifacts, and non-randomly generated items.
facts.action: Do not attempt to polymorph these items as they will not produce anything useful.

facts.fact: Max out your luck to minimize golem creation. That reduces the total material lost.
facts.detect: Checking your luck level.
facts.action: Increase your luck to +13 to minimize the chance of golem creation during polypiling.

facts.fact: Configure autopickup exceptions to pick up good morphs and your want-to-keeps from the pile.
facts.detect: Setting up autopickup exceptions in the game settings.
facts.action: Configure autopickup exceptions to automatically pick up desired items from the polypile.

facts.fact: Polypiling is most often used by conduct players who need certain items: It can substitute for wishing, prayer and sacrifice benefits, or literacy, and it can be done relatively safely.
facts.detect: Identifying the need for specific items that are hard to obtain otherwise.
facts.action: Use polypiling to obtain specific items that are difficult to get through other means, such as wishing or prayer.

facts.fact: By putting the rocks on top we ensure that they get processed first.
facts.detect: The bot notices that the rocks are on top of the pile.
facts.action: Ensure rocks are on top of the pile before polypiling.

facts.fact: Minimizing our luck increases the chances that our rocks will give rise to a golem once they shudder.
facts.detect: The bot's luck attribute is checked.
facts.action: Minimize luck before polypiling.

facts.fact: The probability of an individual stack not giving rise to a golem, if it shudders, is (luck + 44)/(luck + 45) to the power of stack size.
facts.detect: The bot calculates the probability based on its luck and stack size.
facts.action: Ensure stacks are of size 5 and minimize luck.

facts.fact: There is a 5% chance of a normal item resisting polymorph and reaching this point unchanged.
facts.detect: The bot notices an item resisting polymorph.
facts.action: Avoid polypiling items that might resist polymorph.

facts.fact: If you know stone to flesh spell, you should cast it at your rocks to turn them into meatballs.
facts.detect: The bot knows the stone to flesh spell.
facts.action: Cast stone to flesh on rocks before polypiling.

facts.fact: Player can raise HP and Pw by dancing with vampires.
facts.detect: Encounter with a vampire and have high HP and Pw.
facts.action: Dance with a vampire to increase HP and Pw.

facts.fact: Boost hit point and energy maximums through any applicable method.
facts.detect: Having potions of healing, extra healing, full healing, or gain energy.
facts.action: Drink potions to boost HP and Pw.

facts.fact: Level drain yourself to reach experience level one.
facts.detect: Using drain life spell, Stormbringer, The Staff of Aesculapius, or encountering wraiths or vampires.
facts.action: Self-level drain to level one.

facts.fact: Polyself into your own race to adjust experience level.
facts.detect: Polymorph into your own race (e.g., dwarvish Valkyrie).
facts.action: Polyself into your own race to increase HP and Pw.

facts.fact: Repeat polymorphing and draining level back to one to significantly increase HP and Pw.
facts.detect: Having multiple amulets of life saving.
facts.action: Repeat the process of polymorphing and self-level draining with amulets of life saving.

facts.fact: Read a blessed or uncursed scroll of gold detection while confused to find and display all traps on the screen.
facts.detect: Scroll of gold detection, confused status
facts.action: Read the scroll while confused to reveal all traps on the screen.

facts.fact: Read a cursed scroll of gold detection to show a pile of gold at every trap location.
facts.detect: Cursed scroll of gold detection, gold pile
facts.action: Read the cursed scroll to reveal gold piles at trap locations, memorize their locations.

facts.fact: Use a crystal ball to search for '^' to detect portals, but beware of paralysis and intelligence requirement.
facts.detect: Crystal ball, '^' symbol
facts.action: Use the crystal ball to search for '^', but be cautious of paralysis and low intelligence.

facts.fact: Zap a wand of secret door detection or use the detect unseen spell to detect portals within radius of 8.
facts.detect: Wand of secret door detection, detect unseen spell
facts.action: Use the wand or spell to detect portals within the specified radius.

facts.fact: Wield or wear the Amulet of Yendor to detect portals with a 1/15 chance each turn within 12 squares.
facts.detect: Amulet of Yendor, 'The Amulet of Yendor feels warm.'
facts.action: Wear or wield the Amulet of Yendor to detect portals nearby.
