facts.fact: Potions of water are always clear and automatically identified as such.
facts.detect: clear potion
facts.action: Identify as potion of water without further testing.

facts.fact: Potions of oil can be identified by applying them; if the potion lights, it is a potion of oil.
facts.detect: Apply potion and observe if it lights up.
facts.action: Identify as potion of oil if it lights up.

facts.fact: Potions of healing, extra healing, full healing, blindness, invisibility, polymorph, speed, acid, gain level, and paralysis are commonly carried by monsters.
facts.detect: Monster drinking or throwing a potion.
facts.action: Observe the effect on the monster to identify the potion.

facts.fact: Potions of sickness and hallucination can be identified by their taste or message when quaffed.
facts.detect: Taste or message when quaffing.
facts.action: Identify based on taste or message.

facts.fact: Potions of acid and oil are harmful and should be avoided unless identified as such.
facts.detect: Potion of acid or oil.
facts.action: Avoid quaffing unless identified as beneficial.

facts.fact: Potions dropped onto very hot ground (e.g. in Gehennom or the Plane of Fire) may shatter with a 30% chance if blessed, or 50% otherwise. The chance is reduced by double the value of your Luck if the potion has been in your inventory.
facts.detect: The heat up as they hit the hot ground.
facts.action: Avoid dropping potions on very hot ground or increase Luck to reduce shattering risk.

facts.fact: Diluted potions of booze do not cure 1HP of damage.
facts.detect: Inventory shows a diluted potion of booze.
facts.action: Avoid drinking diluted potions of booze for healing purposes.

facts.fact: Diluted potions of fruit juice give half the nutrition of a non-diluted one.
facts.detect: Inventory shows a diluted potion of fruit juice.
facts.action: Drink diluted potions of fruit juice only when nutrition is critical.

facts.fact: A potion of acid will cause an explosion and damage the character if diluted.
facts.detect: Inventory shows a potion of acid.
facts.action: Avoid immersing or dipping a potion of acid into water.

facts.fact: When a potion shatters, it can affect adjacent monsters and the player with its vapors.
facts.detect: Crash! or You hear a shattering noise.
facts.action: Avoid throwing or wielding potions near yourself or allies.

facts.fact: Clerics start the game with 4 potions of holy water.
facts.detect: Starting inventory as a Cleric
facts.action: If starting as a Cleric, use the initial potions of holy water to bless and uncurse items.

facts.fact: 53% of all games will randomly generate holy water somewhere in the dungeon above Medusa's Island.
facts.detect: Finding potions of holy water in the dungeon
facts.action: Collect any potions of holy water found in the dungeon to use for blessing and uncurse items.

facts.fact: Dipping an item or stack of items into holy water will uncurse them if they are cursed or bless them otherwise.
facts.detect: Uncursed or cursed items
facts.action: Use holy water to uncurse or bless items, especially important items like weapons and armor.

facts.fact: Dipping Sunsword, gold dragon scales or gold dragon scale mail into holy water will generally increase the radius of light they emit while wielded or worn.
facts.detect: Sunsword, gold dragon scales, or gold dragon scale mail
facts.action: Bless these items with holy water to increase their light radius.

facts.fact: A hero quaffing a potion of holy water cures any lycanthropy they have.
facts.detect: Feeling like a werecreature
facts.action: Quaff a potion of holy water if you suspect you have lycanthropy.

facts.fact: A potion of unholy water appears as a 'cursed clear potion' when unidentified.
facts.detect: Item name: cursed clear potion
facts.action: Avoid drinking unidentified clear potions to prevent potential damage or unwanted effects.

facts.fact: Quaffing a potion of unholy water polymorphs a lawful hero into their animal form (if lycanthrope) and deals 2d6 damage.
facts.detect: Message: This burns like acid!
facts.action: If you are lawful and a lycanthrope, avoid drinking unholy water to prevent damage and unwanted polymorphing.

facts.fact: Dipping uncursed potions of water into unholy water will convert them into unholy water.
facts.detect: Item name: unholy water
facts.action: If you need unholy water, you can convert uncursed water into unholy water by dipping them into an existing unholy water potion.

facts.fact: Praying on another god's altar curses any potions of water on that altar.
facts.detect: Message: You feel full of dread.
facts.action: Avoid praying on altars of deities that are not your own to prevent cursing your potions.

facts.fact: Dipping an item in a fountain has a 30% chance of cursing it, potentially creating unholy water.
facts.detect: Item name: cursed clear potion
facts.action: If you need unholy water, you can try dipping items in a fountain to potentially curse them.

facts.fact: Quaffing a milky or smoky potion may produce a hostile ghost or djinni with a chance of 1/(13+2n), where n is the number of ghosts or djinn already produced.
facts.detect: Message 'A ghost appears!' or 'A djinni appears!'
facts.action: Avoid quaffing milky or smoky potions unless necessary.

facts.fact: Potion of hallucination makes you hallucinate for 300-499 turns (uncursed), 600-799 turns (blessed), or 900-1099 turns (cursed).
facts.detect: Message 'Oh wow! Everything looks so cosmic!' or similar.
facts.action: Avoid quaffing unidentified potions of hallucination unless you have a way to cure it.

facts.fact: Potion of water, if blessed and you are chaotic or polymorphed to a demon or undead creature, burns like acid and abuses constitution.
facts.detect: Message 'This burns like acid!'
facts.action: Do not quaff blessed water if you are chaotic or polymorphed to a demon or undead.

facts.fact: Potion of booze, unless blessed, makes you confused for 3d8 turns and heals 1 hit point if not diluted.
facts.detect: Message 'Ooph! This tastes like liquid fire!'
facts.action: Avoid quaffing unidentified potions of booze unless you are prepared to deal with confusion.

facts.fact: Potion of invisibility, if blessed, makes you permanently invisible.
facts.detect: Message 'Gee! All of a sudden, you can see right through yourself' or similar.
facts.action: Quaff blessed potion of invisibility if you are prepared to deal with permanent invisibility.

facts.fact: Quaffing a potion of polymorph will cause the player to polymorph unless they have the intrinsic property of unchanging.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel a little strange.' or 'You feel a little normal.'
facts.action: Avoid quaffing potion of polymorph unless you are certain you want to polymorph or you are hallucinating and want to potentially revert to normal form.

facts.fact: If the player is hallucinating, quaffing a potion of polymorph will result in the message 'You feel a little normal.'
facts.detect: Message 'You feel a little normal.'
facts.action: If hallucinating, quaffing a potion of polymorph may be a way to revert to normal form, but proceed with caution as it can still polymorph into other forms.

facts.fact: Potion of full healing: When blessed, heals up to 400 HP and/or raises your max HP by 8; also cures sickness. Ascending with 6 or so provides a safe number of emergency outs, but save these for when you need them.
facts.detect: Potion of full healing
facts.action: Save and bless potions of full healing for emergencies and ascension.

facts.fact: Potion of holy water: Increments BUC status of #dipped objects. This provides the most reliable way to bless an object or uncurse items that get cursed during the ascension run.
facts.detect: Potion of holy water
facts.action: Save and use holy water to bless or uncurse items, especially during ascension.

facts.fact: Potion of gain level: When cursed, teleports you up one level. Useful for Moloch's Sanctum, Gehennom and emergency escapes.
facts.detect: Potion of gain level
facts.action: Save and use cursed potions of gain level for emergency escapes or reaching the quest.

facts.fact: Potion of speed: Without speed boots, useful for difficult combat. Otherwise, alchemize with healing potions to make extra healing.
facts.detect: Potion of speed
facts.action: Use potion of speed in combat if you lack speed boots, otherwise alchemize with healing potions.

facts.fact: Potion of levitation: Alchemize with enlightenment to make gain level. A single blessed potion is enough for the endgame run. Can be used to cross Medusa's level if found in sufficient quantities.
facts.detect: Potion of levitation
facts.action: Save and alchemize with enlightenment to make gain level, or use to cross Medusa's level.

facts.fact: Pounding with a lance or polearm allows attacking a target two squares away, with the range dependent on the wielder's skill level (Unskilled, Skilled, Expert).
facts.detect: Weapon skill level and target distance
facts.action: Use pounding to attack distant enemies safely, especially those with dangerous melee attacks like sea monsters.

facts.fact: Pounding does not trigger passive attacks from monsters but scuffs engravings and fades Elbereth, incurring an alignment penalty.
facts.detect: Passive attack messages, scuffed engravings, Elbereth fading
facts.action: Avoid pounding on squares with Elbereth or important engravings to preserve alignment.

facts.fact: Knights can reach Expert skill level in lance, while no roles can reach more than Skilled in polearms.
facts.detect: Weapon skill level
facts.action: Choose a lance if aiming for Expert skill to maximize pounding range.

facts.fact: Most monsters can only pound with a skill level equivalent of Unskilled, except trolls which can pound at Skilled level.
facts.detect: Monster type and behavior
facts.action: Be cautious of trolls as they can pound effectively from a distance.

facts.fact: Pounding can be used for hit and run tactics, making it safer than melee attacks.
facts.detect: Monster movement and attack patterns
facts.action: Use pounding to harass and retreat from dangerous monsters.

facts.fact: Praying takes 3 turns, during which the hero is helpless.
facts.detect: The bot can notice this by attempting to pray and seeing the message 'You begin to pray.' followed by a countdown of turns.
facts.action: The bot should avoid praying when in immediate danger or when there are hostile monsters nearby.

facts.fact: If your alignment record is negative, praying is unsafe.
facts.detect: The bot can check its alignment record through enlightenment or by attempting to pray and receiving a message indicating it is unsafe.
facts.action: The bot should avoid praying if its alignment record is negative and seek to improve it before praying.

facts.fact: Praying while standing on another god's altar will anger your god and may result in smiting.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this by standing on an altar with a different alignment and attempting to pray.
facts.action: The bot should avoid praying on altars of other gods unless it is certain it is safe to do so.

facts.fact: Praying in Gehennom is unsafe and may anger your god.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this by entering Gehennom and attempting to pray.
facts.action: The bot should avoid praying in Gehennom unless it is absolutely necessary.

facts.fact: A successful prayer can fix major and minor problems, and grant a favor based on alignment and luck.
facts.detect: The bot can detect a successful prayer by receiving messages such as 'You feel a warm glow.' or 'Your god is pleased with you.'
facts.action: The bot should prioritize praying when it has major problems or when it is in a position to gain significant benefits from a favor.

facts.fact: Initial prayer timeout is 300 turns and decreases by one each game turn.
facts.detect: Prayer timeout message or enlightenment message.
facts.action: Wait until turn 301 to pray.

facts.fact: Gods will accept prayer for major trouble if timeout is less than 201.
facts.detect: Message indicating major trouble (e.g., cockatrice hissing, new moon).
facts.action: Pray if prayer timeout is less than 201.

facts.fact: Prayer timeout is reset after praying and can be significantly increased if crowned or after killing Wizard of Yendor.
facts.detect: Message indicating you are crowned or have killed Wizard of Yendor.
facts.action: Be cautious about praying immediately after these events.

facts.fact: Prayer timeout can be decreased by sacrificing corpses at a co-aligned altar.
facts.detect: Message after sacrificing corpse.
facts.action: Sacrifice corpses to reduce prayer timeout.

facts.fact: Successful wish increases prayer timeout by 145 to 150 turns.
facts.detect: Message after successful wish.
facts.action: Avoid praying immediately after wishing.

facts.fact: Scrolls of identify cost 20zm, uniquely identifying them.
facts.detect: Scroll price is 20zm
facts.action: Use the scroll to identify other items

facts.fact: Scrolls of amnesia cost 200zm, ten times as much as scrolls of identify.
facts.detect: Scroll price is 200zm
facts.action: Avoid reading if not identified

facts.fact: Scrolls of fire and destroy armor cost 100zm and are dangerous.
facts.detect: Scroll price is 100zm
facts.action: Protect items before reading

facts.fact: Price identification can be used to distinguish bad items from good ones.
facts.detect: Price of an item is unusually high or low
facts.action: Avoid or prioritize items based on price

facts.fact: Price identification is more reliable when selling items than buying them.
facts.detect: Shopkeeper offers a price
facts.action: Compare offered price to known base price

facts.fact: If the scroll costs 200zm, the only dangerous scroll is the scroll of amnesia. Don't read an unknown 200-zorkmid scroll unless it is identified by other means.
facts.detect: Scroll of amnesia or scroll with a price of 200zm
facts.action: Do not read the scroll unless it is identified as safe by other means.

facts.fact: If the scroll costs 300zm, the only dangerous scroll is the scroll of punishment. Don't read the scroll unless you have a non-cursed scroll of remove curse or a wand of opening, or unless you know and can cast a knock spell, or can polymorph into a nymph or metallivore. Alternatively, you can bless the scroll and then read it.
facts.detect: Scroll of punishment or scroll with a price of 300zm
facts.action: Do not read the scroll unless you have a non-cursed scroll of remove curse, a wand of opening, or can cast a knock spell, or can polymorph into a nymph or metallivore. Alternatively, bless the scroll and then read it.

facts.fact: If the potion costs 250zm, you can ensure it is not cursed, then try to apply it. If it is a potion of oil, it will be lit. Do not do this when the potion is owned by a shop.
facts.detect: Potion with a price of 250zm
facts.action: Ensure the potion is not cursed before applying it. If it is a potion of oil, it will be lit. Do not do this when the potion is owned by a shop.

facts.fact: All 200zm rings, provided they are non-cursed, are useful and safe to wear. These include the rings of free action, slow digestion, searching, levitation, and regeneration.
facts.detect: Ring with a price of 200zm
facts.action: Wear the ring if it is non-cursed and you are sure it is not a ring of aggravate monster or polymorph.

facts.fact: The 300zm rings include the rings of conflict, teleport control, polymorph, and polymorph control. Conflict can be easily identified by wearing it for a turn or two around a peaceful monster. Teleport control can be identified by putting on the ring and triggering a teleport.
facts.detect: Ring with a price of 300zm
facts.action: Do not wear the ring unless you can identify it as conflict or teleport control. Use a scroll, spell, a handy sink or a source of enlightenment to reliably identify the other 300zm rings.

facts.fact: A prison guard demands a bribe of experience level * 500 zorkmids to avoid re-arrest.
facts.detect: The prison guard demands to avoid re-arrest
facts.action: Pay the bribe to avoid re-arrest and keep the guard peaceful.

facts.fact: Prison guards are generated only in the quest, as a challenge to the Convict seeking the Iron Ball of Liberation.
facts.detect: Encountering a prison guard in the quest level.
facts.action: Prepare for a prison guard encounter by ensuring you have enough gold to pay the bribe.

facts.fact: Prison guards have a 50% chance of being generated with a silver saber instead of a long sword.
facts.detect: Prison guard wielding a silver saber or long sword.
facts.action: Be cautious if the prison guard wields a silver saber, as it is more dangerous than a long sword.

facts.fact: Prison guards are coded as mercenaries and outfitted as such.
facts.detect: Prison guard with typical mercenary equipment.
facts.action: Expect prison guards to be well-equipped and prepared for combat.

facts.fact: Prison guards have an AC of 10 and MR of 15.
facts.detect: Prison guard's stats.
facts.action: Be prepared for a moderately challenging combat encounter if you cannot pay the bribe.

facts.fact: Cold resistance is an intrinsic property for a Valkyrie.
facts.detect: Character creation screen or enlightenment message
facts.action: No action needed as it is an innate property for a Valkyrie.

facts.fact: Teleport control can be gained by eating a tengu or the Wizard of Yendor.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel strangely at ease.' or 'You feel strangely disoriented.'
facts.action: Eat a tengu or the Wizard of Yendor to gain teleport control.

facts.fact: Telepathy can be gained by eating a floating eye or (master) mind flayer corpse.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel strangely telepathic.'
facts.action: Eat a floating eye or (master) mind flayer corpse to gain intrinsic telepathy.

facts.fact: Protection from shape changers can be gained by eating a ring of protection from shape changers.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel strangely protected.'
facts.action: Eat a ring of protection from shape changers to gain protection from shape changers.

facts.fact: Magic resistance can be gained by wearing a cloak of magic resistance or gray dragon scale mail.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel strangely resistant.'
facts.action: Wear a cloak of magic resistance or gray dragon scale mail to gain magic resistance.

facts.fact: slow digestion decreases the rate that you lose nutrition, allowing you to survive longer before starvation
facts.detect: low nutrition or starvation
facts.action: wear a ring of slow digestion or white dragon scale mail

facts.fact: warned of monster type detects all monsters on the dungeon level that match certain monster types
facts.detect: wield Sting
facts.action: wield Sting to be warned of orcs

facts.fact: stun causes movement commands to step in a random direction and high chance of randomizing direction of zapping, spellcasting and firing
facts.detect: random movement or random direction of zapping, spellcasting and firing
facts.action: avoid eating bat, giant bat or stalker corpse and avoid polymorphing into bat, giant bat, vampire bat, raven or stalker

facts.fact: blindness disables your eyes, blocking your sight
facts.detect: attack of a raven or explosion of a yellow light
facts.action: wear a blindfold or towel or polymorph into a monster without eyes

facts.fact: slime will overtake your body and kill you unless you can remove the slime or gain sliming resistance
facts.detect: attack from a green slime or eating a green slime corpse
facts.action: avoid green slime attacks and corpses

facts.fact: Protection from shape changers prevents shape changers from transforming while active.
facts.detect: Message 'You are protected from shape changers.' or 'You have protection from shape changers' via enlightenment.
facts.action: Wear a ring of protection from shape changers or eat one to gain the intrinsic.

facts.fact: Werecreatures will appear in their human form most of the time and cannot summon help or infect with lycanthropy.
facts.detect: Encountering a werecreature that does not summon help or shift to animal form.
facts.action: Ensure protection from shape changers is active when dealing with werecreatures.

facts.fact: Mimics are de-cloaked and cannot disguise themselves.
facts.detect: Encountering a mimic that does not disguise itself.
facts.action: Ensure protection from shape changers is active when dealing with mimics.

facts.fact: Monsters with digestion attacks will not polymorph when swallowing a shape changer whole.
facts.detect: Encountering a monster with digestion attacks that does not polymorph after swallowing a shape changer.
facts.action: Ensure protection from shape changers is active when dealing with monsters that have digestion attacks.

facts.fact: The property's effects cease once a source of the property is removed, even if another source is active (bug in 3.6.7).
facts.detect: Removing a ring of protection from shape changers or losing the intrinsic.
facts.action: Keep track of sources of protection from shape changers and ensure at least one is active.

facts.fact: The protection racket involves reaching the temple in Minetown at a low experience level with lots of gold and purchasing a large amount of divine protection. As of NetHack 3.6.0, there is a 1/8 chance of Minetown not having any shops or a priest.
facts.detect: Checking Minetown for shops or a priest
facts.action: If no shops or priest, abandon the protection racket and find another strategy

facts.fact: Starting as a healer or a tourist is recommended for the protection racket due to their starting gold and food.
facts.detect: Starting character role is healer or tourist
facts.action: Ensure you start as a healer or tourist

facts.fact: To avoid death by pits, gas spores, and level drain, gain 1-2 levels before entering the mines and then level drain yourself in the Minetown temple.
facts.detect: Reaching level 1 or 2
facts.action: Gain 1-2 levels before entering the mines

facts.fact: Being a gnome or dwarf generally makes the mines easier due to their infravision and peaceful monster encounters.
facts.detect: Character race is gnome or dwarf
facts.action: Ensure you are a gnome or dwarf

facts.fact: To determine how much gold is needed for divine protection, refer to the table provided which shows the maximum gold required per donation based on experience level.
facts.detect: Checking experience level
facts.action: Calculate the required gold based on the table

facts.fact: Psi bolt deals (ML/2 + 1)d6 damage, halved if the hero has half spell damage or magic resistance, and reduced to 1/4 if both properties are present.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You get a slight ache.', 'Your brain is on fire!', 'Your suddenly aches painfully!', 'Your suddenly aches very painfully!'
facts.action: Equip magic resistance and/or half spell damage items to reduce damage from psi bolts.

facts.fact: The chance of a high-level monster using psi bolt increases if the hero has magic resistance or is hallucinating.
facts.detect: Hallucination status or presence of magic resistance.
facts.action: Avoid high-level monsters if hallucinating or with magic resistance to reduce risk of psi bolt.

facts.fact: Orcus and Demogorgon deal +8d6 damage with psi bolt, Dispater deals +6d6, Archons and golden naga deal +4d6, ki-rin deal +2d6, and other monsters deal +1d6.
facts.detect: Encountering these specific monsters.
facts.action: Be extra cautious and prepared for increased damage when facing these monsters.

facts.fact: Psi bolt is a melee-range spell used by monsters that cast mage spells.
facts.detect: Engaging in melee combat with spellcasting monsters.
facts.action: Maintain distance or use ranged attacks to avoid melee contact.

facts.fact: The chance of a monster using psi bolt decreases from 100% to 4.3% from levels 1 to 23, but increases to 12% at level 25 and about 18% at level 50 if the hero has magic resistance or is hallucinating.
facts.detect: Monster level and hero's magic resistance or hallucination status.
facts.action: Be prepared for psi bolt from high-level monsters if you have magic resistance or are hallucinating.

facts.fact: Puddings and oozes are neutral, amorphous and omnivorous amoeboids with acid resistance and stoning resistance.
facts.detect: Encountering a monster with the uppercase P glyph (P)
facts.action: Avoid melee combat with puddings and oozes, use ranged attacks or magic if possible.

facts.fact: Most puddings and oozes use bite attacks and can induce erosion in objects made of certain materials.
facts.detect: Observing a monster with the uppercase P glyph (P) attacking or touching objects
facts.action: Keep valuable items away from puddings and oozes, use acid-resistant or stoning-resistant equipment.

facts.fact: Green slime uses a touch attack and turns a target into slime.
facts.detect: Encountering a green slime (P)
facts.action: Avoid contact with green slime, use ranged attacks or magic if possible.

facts.fact: Puddings and oozes leave behind globs instead of corpses.
facts.detect: Seeing a glob on the ground after a pudding or ooze is killed
facts.action: Eat globs carefully to avoid food poisoning, do not attempt to revive or sacrifice them.

facts.fact: A puddingbane can be created by engraving with an iron weapon to reduce its enchantment to -3.
facts.detect: Engraving with an iron weapon and checking its enchantment level.
facts.action: Engrave with an iron weapon until its enchantment is -3.

facts.fact: A -3 (or less) dagger or knife will always do 1 point of damage no matter what your damage bonus.
facts.detect: Weapon name and enchantment level (-3 or less).
facts.action: Use a -3 dagger or knife for consistent damage output.

facts.fact: Any non-weapon iron item will do d2 damage (or at least 1 if corroded).
facts.detect: Iron item name and whether it can be corroded.
facts.action: Corrode non-weapon iron items for consistent damage output.

facts.fact: Wielding a non-weapon iron item will preserve weaponless conduct.
facts.detect: Weaponless conduct status.
facts.action: Wield non-weapon iron items to maintain weaponless conduct.

facts.fact: Punishment occurs when reading a scroll of punishment or as a result of prayer to an angry god.
facts.detect: Message: 'You are being punished for your misbehavior!' or 'Your iron ball gets heavier.'
facts.action: Avoid reading scrolls of punishment and be cautious when praying to an angry god.

facts.fact: Falling into a pit or trap door with an iron ball attached deals 25-31 damage and can cause death.
facts.detect: Falling into a pit or trap door while punished.
facts.action: Avoid falling into pits or trap doors while punished.

facts.fact: Going down stairs while punished may cause the hero to drop the iron ball and take damage.
facts.detect: Stumbling and falling down stairs while punished.
facts.action: Be cautious when going down stairs while punished.

facts.fact: There are several ways to end punishment, such as zapping a wand of opening, reading a scroll of remove curse, or praying successfully.
facts.detect: Having a wand of opening, scroll of remove curse, or being able to pray.
facts.action: Use available means to end punishment as soon as possible.

facts.fact: Polymorphing into a nymph, metallivore, or amorphous/whirly monster can end punishment.
facts.detect: Having the ability to polymorph into these forms.
facts.action: Polymorph into a nymph, metallivore, or amorphous/whirly monster to end punishment.

facts.fact: Pressing $ displays the amount of gold in your wallet and any credit/debt in a shop.
facts.detect: Pressing $ key
facts.action: Check gold amount and debt in shops.

facts.fact: Failing to learn a spell or sitting on a throne can cause all gold in your wallet to disappear.
facts.detect: Message 'Your wallet contains zorkmid(s)' or 'Your wallet is empty' after failing a spell or sitting on a throne.
facts.action: Protect gold by removing it from wallet before risky actions.

facts.fact: Dipping an item in a fountain may cause you to lose up to 10% of your gold.
facts.detect: Message 'An urge to take a bath overwhelms you! You lost some of your gold in the fountain!'
facts.action: Avoid dipping gold-containing items in fountains.

facts.fact: Looting a throne while confused and carrying gold may generate a throne room monster or deposit gold in a chest.
facts.detect: Message 'The exchequer accepts your contribution' or 'Thank you for your contribution to reduce the debt'.
facts.action: Avoid looting thrones while confused and carrying gold.

facts.fact: Leprechauns will steal gold from your wallet if you have any and attack you.
facts.detect: Message 'Your purse feels lighter' or 'Your purse feels heavier'.
facts.action: Avoid carrying gold when leprechauns are nearby or hide gold in containers.

facts.fact: You are unable to put anything else on when wearing an amulet, two rings, and one piece of eyewear.
facts.detect: Inventory check showing an amulet, two rings, and one piece of eyewear.
facts.action: Do not attempt to put on additional items until one of these items is removed.

facts.fact: You can't put rings on if you are wearing cursed gloves or wielding a cursed two-handed weapon.
facts.detect: Inventory check showing cursed gloves or a cursed two-handed weapon.
facts.action: Do not attempt to put on rings until the cursed item is removed or destroyed.

facts.fact: If you are wielding a cursed one-handed weapon, you can still put on or remove the left-hand ring.
facts.detect: Inventory check showing a cursed one-handed weapon.
facts.action: Only attempt to put on or remove the left-hand ring if wielding a cursed one-handed weapon.

facts.fact: You do not have to take off your gloves to put a ring on.
facts.detect: Inventory check showing gloves.
facts.action: Put on rings without taking off gloves.

facts.fact: Q represents a quantum mechanic
facts.detect: quantum mechanic
facts.action: Treat quantum mechanics with caution as they can teleport and are dangerous

facts.fact: q represents a quadruped
facts.detect: rothe, mumak, leocrotta, wumpus, titanothere, baluchitherium, mastodon
facts.action: Be prepared for large, potentially dangerous quadruped monsters

facts.fact: Quadrupeds are represented by the lowercase q glyph.
facts.detect: Glyph q on the map
facts.action: Identify quadruped monsters to prepare for combat or evasion.

facts.fact: All quadrupeds are large, non-equine animals that lack hands and can be seen via infravision.
facts.detect: Infravision reveals quadruped monsters
facts.action: Use infravision to detect quadruped monsters in dark areas.

facts.fact: Quadrupeds are generally slow and hard-hitting monsters who can take a few hits before dying.
facts.detect: Observing quadruped's movement and attack patterns
facts.action: Use hit and run tactics or ranged weapons to avoid direct combat.

facts.fact: Quadruped corpses are generally quite filling for non-vegetarian heroes and carnivorous pets.
facts.detect: Eating a quadruped corpse
facts.action: Eat quadruped corpses to regain hit points and nutrition.

facts.fact: Quaffing from a fountain may release a water demon that may grant you a wish, but it might also just summon an endless stream of snakes.
facts.detect: Water demon, endless stream of snakes
facts.action: Avoid quaffing from fountains unless you are prepared to deal with water demons or snakes.

facts.fact: Quaffing from a sink may result in finding a random ring, but you risk creating a water elemental instead.
facts.detect: Water elemental
facts.action: Avoid quaffing from sinks unless you are prepared to deal with water elementals.

facts.fact: The quarterstaff is a weapon skill in NetHack.
facts.detect: Quarterstaff item name
facts.action: Use quarterstaves if available to improve quarterstaff skill.

facts.fact: The Staff of Aesculapius is an artifact quarterstaff.
facts.detect: Staff of Aesculapius item name
facts.action: Treat the Staff of Aesculapius with care and respect as it is a powerful artifact.

facts.fact: You must be of your original alignment, not wearing a helm of opposite alignment, have at least 20 alignment record, and have at least experience level 14 to receive permission to enter the quest.
facts.detect: Message from quest leader and alignment record check
facts.action: Ensure alignment and alignment record are sufficient before attempting to enter the quest.

facts.fact: The quest nemesis is generated asleep or meditating, carrying the Bell of Opening and the quest artifact on the floor of the square the nemesis occupies.
facts.detect: Encountering the quest nemesis on the goal level
facts.action: Prepare for combat with the quest nemesis, ensuring you have the necessary equipment and spells to defeat it.

facts.fact: Killing the quest leader will permit you to access the Quest, but it has severe repercussions such as negative alignment record, increased god's anger, and luck penalties.
facts.detect: Killing the quest leader
facts.action: Avoid killing the quest leader unless absolutely necessary, as it can have severe consequences.

facts.fact: The Valkyrie quest nemesis is Lord Surtur, who is a powerful fire-based enemy with stoning resistance.
facts.detect: Encountering Lord Surtur on the goal level
facts.action: Be prepared for a challenging fight against Lord Surtur, focusing on fire resistance and stoning resistance.

facts.fact: The Valkyrie quest involves fire ants and fire giants as quest monsters, which are dangerous due to their fire-based attacks.
facts.detect: Encountering fire ants and fire giants in the quest branch
facts.action: Equip fire resistance and be cautious when dealing with fire-based monsters.

facts.fact: The quest artifact for a Valkyrie is The Orb of Fate, which is a crystal ball with a neutral alignment.
facts.detect: The Orb of Fate
facts.action: Pick up The Orb of Fate if found, as it provides valuable extrinsic qualities such as warning, half spell damage, half physical damage, and luckstone.

facts.fact: The Orb of Fate is an intelligent artifact and will adjust to the player's alignment, which is lawful in this case.
facts.detect: The Orb of Fate
facts.action: Ensure the Orb of Fate is not blasted upon pickup, as it will adjust to the player's lawful alignment.

facts.fact: The Orb of Fate provides the ability to levelport when invoked.
facts.detect: The Orb of Fate
facts.action: Use the Orb of Fate's levelport ability to navigate the dungeon more efficiently.

facts.fact: The Orb of Fate provides crystal ball selective object detection when applied.
facts.detect: The Orb of Fate
facts.action: Use the Orb of Fate's selective object detection to identify useful items or dangerous traps.

facts.fact: The Orb of Fate toggles invisibility when wielded or worn.
facts.detect: The Orb of Fate
facts.action: Wear or wield The Orb of Fate to toggle invisibility for stealth or safety.

facts.fact: Killing a quest guardian decreases your current alignment record by MAX/8, where MAX is your current maximum possible alignment.
facts.detect: That was probably a bad idea...
facts.action: Avoid killing quest guardians to maintain alignment.

facts.fact: Killing a quest guardian will anger your god and incur a -4 Luck penalty in NetHack 3.7.
facts.detect: Not applicable in 3.6, but awareness of the message.
facts.action: Avoid killing quest guardians to maintain luck and god's favor.

facts.fact: Quest guardians will become angry if they see you attack a peaceful monster.
facts.detect: Observing quest guardians' reaction to attacking peaceful monsters.
facts.action: Avoid attacking peaceful monsters to keep quest guardians friendly.

facts.fact: All quest guardians on the level become angry if you kill the quest leader.
facts.detect: Observing the reaction of other quest guardians after killing the quest leader.
facts.action: Avoid killing the quest leader to keep other quest guardians friendly.

facts.fact: Any object in your quiver can be fired with the f command, followed by a direction.
facts.detect: The f command
facts.action: Use the f command to fire items in your quiver without specifying an item letter.

facts.fact: Quivering an item is considered a free action and does not use up movement turns.
facts.detect: Pressing shift+q to set quiver items
facts.action: Switch quivered items freely to take advantage of bonuses such as blessed arrows.

facts.fact: Be wary of firing food to a pet that is eating, as it may hit the pet and reduce its tameness.
facts.detect: Pet eating message
facts.action: Avoid firing food to a pet that is eating to prevent tameness reduction.

facts.fact: Any item can be quivered, including tripe rations for feeding or taming pets, potions, cockatrice eggs, or any rocks or glass in your inventory.
facts.detect: Inventory items like tripe rations, potions, cockatrice eggs, rocks, or glass
facts.action: Quiver useful items like tripe rations for feeding or taming pets.

facts.fact: R represents a rodent (sewer rat, giant rat, rabid rat, wererat, rock mole, woodchuck)
facts.detect: R on the map or in inventory
facts.action: Avoid or kill if dangerous, eat if food (e.g., woodchuck)

facts.fact: R represents a rust monster or disenchanter
facts.detect: R on the map
facts.action: Avoid or kill with non-metallic weapons or spells

facts.fact: Press r to read an object in your inventory
facts.detect: Book, scroll, or other readable item in inventory
facts.action: Read the item to identify or use its effects

facts.fact: Press shift+R to remove an item
facts.detect: Worn or held item in inventory
facts.action: Remove item if it is cursed or no longer needed

facts.fact: Press ctrl+r to redraw the screen
facts.detect: Screen glitch or lag
facts.action: Redraw the screen to fix display issues

facts.fact: Dwarves are always lawful.
facts.detect: Starting character alignment is lawful.
facts.action: Ensure alignment actions and choices align with lawful requirements.

facts.fact: Dwarves have double digging speed.
facts.detect: Notice increased digging speed in mines.
facts.action: Efficiently dig through walls and floors.

facts.fact: Gnomes and dwarves in the Mines are always generated peaceful.
facts.detect: Peaceful dwarves and gnomes in the Mines.
facts.action: Avoid unnecessary combat with peaceful dwarves and gnomes.

facts.fact: Dwarves have excellent physical stats.
facts.detect: High strength and dexterity stats.
facts.action: Focus on melee combat and heavy armor.

facts.fact: Cannot blessed-genocide humans to kill off mind flayers and master mind flayers.
facts.detect: Mind flayers or master mind flayers in the game.
facts.action: Use two uncursed scrolls to genocide mind flayers.

facts.fact: Elven weapons are described as 'runed' and are all made of wood, which does not erode through rust or corrosion but is vulnerable to rotting or burning.
facts.detect: Weapon name includes 'elven' and material is wood
facts.action: Use elven weapons if encountered, but be cautious of fire or water-based attacks that can cause rotting or burning.

facts.fact: Elven armor has slightly lower AC values than its dwarven equivalents, but all types of elven armor can be safely enchanted to +7.
facts.detect: Armor name includes 'elven'
facts.action: Enchant elven armor to +7 if possible to maximize defensive benefits.

facts.fact: Dwarvish mithril-coat is inferior only to the iron and crystal plate mails, and dragon scale mail, but its good weight-to-AC ratio gives it an advantage over the plate mails.
facts.detect: Armor name is 'dwarvish mithril-coat'
facts.action: Prioritize equipping the dwarvish mithril-coat for its excellent weight-to-AC ratio.

facts.fact: Dwarvish mattock is one of the most powerful non-artifact weapons.
facts.detect: Weapon name is 'dwarvish mattock'
facts.action: If found, equip the dwarvish mattock as a primary weapon due to its high damage.

facts.fact: Crossbows and crossbow bolts are explicitly noted as gnomish racial weapons, and gnomish Rangers will start with a crossbow and bolts.
facts.detect: Player is a gnomish Ranger
facts.action: Use crossbow and bolts as primary weapon and ammunition.

facts.fact: Raglayim tannin has high physical damage output (Claw 1d24 physical, Claw 1d24 physical, Bearhug 2d12 physical, Tentacle 1d8 constitution drain, Tentacle 1d8 constitution drain, Tentacle 1d8 constitution drain).
facts.detect: Encounter with a raglayim tannin
facts.action: Avoid melee combat and use ranged attacks or magic from a distance.

facts.fact: Raglayim tannin drains constitution with its tentacles (1d8 constitution drain).
facts.detect: Loss of constitution points
facts.action: Equip items that protect against constitution drain or use spells that negate constitution drain effects.

facts.fact: Raglayim tannin is immune to poison resistance.
facts.detect: Attempting to use poison resistance against constitution drain
facts.action: Equip items or use spells that provide resistance to constitution drain.

facts.fact: Raglayim tannin causes 'It's too big' madness, preventing spellcasting, music playing, spirit powers, and speaking.
facts.detect: Character unable to cast spells or use spirit powers
facts.action: Avoid melee combat and use non-magical ranged attacks or physical items.

facts.fact: Raglayim tannin has high AC (-14) and resistances (cold, shock, poison, acid, petrification, disease).
facts.detect: Difficulty in hitting the raglayim tannin
facts.action: Use high-damage weapons or spells that bypass resistances.

facts.fact: A randomized breath attack can use one of the following damage types: magic missile, fire, frost, sleep gas, disintegration, lightning, poison clouds, acid.
facts.detect: Chromatic Dragon
facts.action: Avoid or prepare for a variety of damage types when facing a Chromatic Dragon. Carry items that protect against fire, frost, disintegration, lightning, poison, and acid.

facts.fact: Monsters with randomized breath are given intrinsic magic resistance.
facts.detect: Chromatic Dragon
facts.action: Be aware that the Chromatic Dragon has intrinsic magic resistance, which means it will be immune to certain spells and attacks.

facts.fact: Monsters with randomized breath are immune to poison clouds.
facts.detect: Chromatic Dragon
facts.action: Do not use poison clouds against the Chromatic Dragon as it will be immune.

facts.fact: A hero eating a scroll labeled YUM YUM while polymorphed into a gelatinous cube will cause the game to print YAFM.
facts.detect: Scroll labeled 'YUM YUM' and polymorphed into a gelatinous cube
facts.action: Avoid eating scrolls labeled 'YUM YUM' while polymorphed into a gelatinous cube

facts.fact: The smoky potion and milky potion have special effects regardless of their actual identity.
facts.detect: Potion labeled 'smoky' or 'milky'
facts.action: Avoid drinking potions labeled 'smoky' or 'milky' until identified

facts.fact: A 'dull spellbook' has a chance of causing a hero to fall asleep unless they have sleep resistance.
facts.detect: Spellbook labeled 'dull'
facts.action: Avoid reading spellbooks labeled 'dull' unless sleep resistant

facts.fact: The 'vellum spellbook' and 'parchment spellbook' break vegetarian conduct if eaten by a hero in the form of a gelatinous cube.
facts.detect: Spellbook labeled 'vellum' or 'parchment'
facts.action: Avoid eating spellbooks labeled 'vellum' or 'parchment' while polymorphed into a gelatinous cube

facts.fact: The appearance of rings determines what monsters can eat them and thus what polymorph forms the hero can use to do the same.
facts.detect: Ring appearance (e.g., 'wooden', 'iron', 'opal')
facts.action: Avoid polymorphing into metallivores or gelatinous cubes when wearing rings

facts.fact: Ranged attacks will not trigger many of the passive attacks that can occur in melee.
facts.detect: Monster names such as 'blue jelly', 'floating eye', 'gremlin', 'mind flayer', 'cockatrice', 'nymph', 'mimic', 'minotaur', 'mumakil', 'Riders', and 'Vorpal Blade'.
facts.action: Use ranged attacks to avoid triggering these monsters' passive attacks.

facts.fact: Against monsters with very dangerous special attacks, such as mind flayers (amnesia) and cockatrices (petrification), ranged attacks are safer.
facts.detect: Monster names such as 'mind flayer' and 'cockatrice'.
facts.action: Use ranged attacks to avoid their special attacks.

facts.fact: Against powerful melee-only enemies that can outrun you, such as minotaurs, it helps to deal ranged damage to them to 'soften them up' before they close into melee range.
facts.detect: Monster name 'minotaur'.
facts.action: Use ranged attacks to weaken them before engaging in melee.

facts.fact: In situations where an enemy cannot easily be engaged in melee, such as fighting a monster on the opposite side of a boulder in Sokoban, use ranged attacks.
facts.detect: Map features such as boulders and trap doors.
facts.action: Use ranged attacks to avoid melee.

facts.fact: Using thrown daggers as your main combat strategy is known as daggerstorming, and can be very effective in the late game.
facts.detect: Item name 'dagger' and skill level 'expert'.
facts.action: Accumulate and use daggers for ranged attacks.

facts.fact: All spears, including javelins, can be used as ranged weapons.
facts.detect: Item name (dwarvish spear, silver spear, elven spear, spear, orcish spear, javelin)
facts.action: Use spears and javelins as ranged weapons for combat.

facts.fact: Arrows and crossbow bolts are ranged weapons.
facts.detect: Item name (ya, silver arrow, elven arrow, arrow, orcish arrow, crossbow bolt)
facts.action: Use arrows and crossbow bolts as ranged weapons for combat.

facts.fact: Daggers, including the knife, can be used as ranged weapons.
facts.detect: Item name (silver dagger, elven dagger, dagger, orcish dagger, knife)
facts.action: Use daggers and the knife as ranged weapons for combat.

facts.fact: Stones, including flint stone, rock, loadstone, and luckstone, can be used as ranged weapons.
facts.detect: Item name (flint stone, rock, loadstone, luckstone)
facts.action: Use stones as ranged weapons for combat.

facts.fact: Cream pies can be used as ranged weapons.
facts.detect: Item name (cream pie)
facts.action: Use cream pies as ranged weapons for combat.

facts.fact: Rangers can safely use a shield to complement their (cross)bow, with wooden shields being the lightest and having the lowest spellcasting penalties.
facts.detect: Item name: wooden shield
facts.action: Equip a wooden shield for defense while using a bow.

facts.fact: The Ranger quest involves fast-moving centaurs with dangerous wands, and the chance of a wand of death may warrant a source of reflection or magic resistance.
facts.detect: Monster name: centaur, item name: wand of death
facts.action: Carry a source of reflection or magic resistance to protect against wands.

facts.fact: Poisoned projectiles are a Ranger's most efficient way of fighting back at long range, reserving melee weapons for resistant or less dire threats.
facts.detect: Item name: poisoned projectile
facts.action: Use poisoned projectiles for long-range combat and reserve melee weapons for close combat.

facts.fact: The Longbow of Diana is a priority target for human Rangers, as it covers for their lack of a racial multishot bonus.
facts.detect: Item name: Longbow of Diana
facts.action: Prioritize acquiring the Longbow of Diana for its multishot bonus.

facts.fact: A small shield, elven shield, or shield of reflection is most likely to be part of a Ranger's ascension kit.
facts.detect: Item name: small shield, elven shield, shield of reflection
facts.action: Include a small shield, elven shield, or shield of reflection in the ascension kit.

facts.fact: The Ranger quest involves fighting Scorpius for The Longbow of Diana.
facts.detect: Chatting with Orion or encountering Scorpius
facts.action: Prepare to fight Scorpius and retrieve The Longbow of Diana

facts.fact: Orion's Camp level has undiggable walls and floor, and petrified trees that cannot be chopped down.
facts.detect: Attempting to dig or chop trees
facts.action: Avoid digging or chopping trees

facts.fact: The Cave of the Wumpus level has undiggable walls and floor.
facts.detect: Attempting to dig
facts.action: Avoid digging

facts.fact: The Cavern of Scorpius level has undiggable walls.
facts.detect: Attempting to dig
facts.action: Avoid digging

facts.fact: Random monsters on the Quest are generated with a high frequency of forest centaurs, scorpions, and mountain centaurs.
facts.detect: Encountering these monsters
facts.action: Be prepared to fight these monsters

facts.fact: Valkyrie starts as a Stripling at experience level 1-2 and progresses to Lady (Lord) at experience level 30.
facts.detect: Rank changes from Stripling to Lady (Lord) as experience level increases.
facts.action: Monitor rank progression to gauge character development and approach quest requirements.

facts.fact: At experience level 14-17, the Valkyrie's rank is (Wo)man-at-arms, which is the quest requirement.
facts.detect: Rank changes to (Wo)man-at-arms when experience level reaches 14.
facts.action: Prepare for the quest when reaching the rank of (Wo)man-at-arms.

facts.fact: Valkyrie's rank progression includes Fighter at experience level 6-9.
facts.detect: Rank changes to Fighter when experience level reaches 6.
facts.action: Focus on combat skills and equipment when reaching Fighter rank.

facts.fact: Warrior rank is achieved at experience level 18-21 for the Valkyrie.
facts.detect: Rank changes to Warrior when experience level reaches 18.
facts.action: Enhance combat and strategic skills to maintain progress.

facts.fact: Champion rank is reached at experience level 26-29 for the Valkyrie.
facts.detect: Rank changes to Champion when experience level reaches 26.
facts.action: Prepare for the final stages of the game and focus on ascension.

facts.fact: A standard ray will bounce if it hits a wall or a creature with reflection.
facts.detect: A wall or a creature with reflection (e.g., a mirror image or a reflection-wielding monster).
facts.action: Use rays carefully to avoid bouncing back and hitting yourself or allies.

facts.fact: Rays are halted by doors, although many will destroy the door in the process.
facts.detect: A door in the path of a ray.
facts.action: Avoid using rays near doors unless you are prepared to destroy them.

facts.fact: A ray will travel 7 to 13 squares.
facts.detect: The range of the ray as it travels.
facts.action: Calculate the range to avoid hitting yourself or allies.

facts.fact: If fire passes over water or a fountain, or cold passes over water or lava, range may decrease by 1, 3, or the ray may stop entirely.
facts.detect: Water, fountains, lava, or other terrain features.
facts.action: Avoid using fire or cold rays near these features to maintain full range.

facts.fact: A ray hitting a wall straight on will move one square into the wall and then bounce straight back, meaning it may hit a monster twice, even one standing against the wall hit.
facts.detect: A wall and a monster standing against it.
facts.action: Avoid using rays near walls where monsters are standing to prevent double hits.

facts.fact: NetHack allows you to read objects in your inventory such as fortune cookies, T-shirts, alchemy smocks, scrolls, spellbooks, credit cards, magic markers, gold pieces, the Orb of Fate, and candy bars.
facts.detect: Item names in inventory (fortune cookies, T-shirts, alchemy smocks, scrolls, spellbooks, credit cards, magic markers, gold pieces, Orb of Fate, candy bars)
facts.action: Press 'r' to read the item to gain information or activate it.

facts.fact: You automatically read any floor engravings or headstones that you encounter in vanilla NetHack.
facts.detect: Floor engravings or headstones on the map
facts.action: Approach and automatically read the engraving or headstone.

facts.fact: In NetHack brass, you automatically read any floor engravings, but not headstones. To read headstones, press 'r' and answer 'y' to the question, 'Do you want to read an epitaph on the grave?'
facts.detect: Headstones on the map
facts.action: Press 'r' and answer 'y' to read the epitaph on the grave.

facts.fact: Reaver is an artifact scimitar that steals one item from an opponent with each successful hit.
facts.detect: Ye steal: [item name]
facts.action: Wield Reaver to steal useful items from monsters, such as potions of full healing, amulets of life saving, and attack wands.

facts.fact: If the player has no room for a stolen object, it will be dropped at the player's feet.
facts.detect: Ye snatched but dropped [item name]
facts.action: Manage inventory space to avoid dropping stolen items.

facts.fact: Stealing a footrice corpse from an opponent while not wearing gloves can lead to petrification.
facts.detect: Stealing a footrice corpse
facts.action: Avoid stealing footrice corpses unless wearing gloves.

facts.fact: Reaver is the only artifact weapon Pirates can receive from their deity.
facts.detect: A Pirate was crowned.
facts.action: Wield Reaver if you are a Pirate and receive it from your deity.

facts.fact: Reaver is identified when a Pirate is crowned while already wielding it.
facts.detect: Yer rings with the sound o' waves!
facts.action: Wield Reaver before being crowned to identify it.

facts.fact: Red dragon scale mail provides fire resistance and 9 base AC.
facts.detect: Item name: red dragon scale mail
facts.action: Equip red dragon scale mail to gain fire resistance and improve AC.

facts.fact: Uncontrolled polymorph while wearing red dragon scale mail will revert them to scales and turn the wearer into a red dragon.
facts.detect: Message: You feel a strange sensation as you polymorph.
facts.action: Avoid uncontrolled polymorphs while wearing red dragon scale mail to prevent becoming a red dragon.

facts.fact: Foodless atheist characters may consider red dragon scale mail to protect against fire traps in Gehennom.
facts.detect: Player status: foodless atheist
facts.action: Equip red dragon scale mail to protect against fire traps in Gehennom.

facts.fact: In NetHack 3.7.0, red dragon scale mail provides infravision.
facts.detect: Item name: red dragon scale mail
facts.action: Equip red dragon scale mail to gain infravision.

facts.fact: Dwarvish cloaks protect against inventory damage from fire and cold 9/10 of the time.
facts.detect: Item name: dwarvish cloak
facts.action: Equip dwarvish cloak for better protection against fire and cold damage to inventory.

facts.fact: Red dragon scales have a fire resistance property.
facts.detect: Wearing red dragon scales and encountering fire-based attacks or traps.
facts.action: Wear red dragon scales to gain fire resistance and protect against fire damage.

facts.fact: Red dragon scales have a 1/3 chance of being dropped by a red dragon's corpse.
facts.detect: Killing a red dragon and checking its corpse.
facts.action: Search for and collect red dragon scales from red dragon corpses.

facts.fact: Reading a non-cursed scroll of enchant armor on red dragon scales will convert them into red dragon scale mail.
facts.detect: Having a non-cursed scroll of enchant armor and wearing red dragon scales.
facts.action: Use a non-cursed scroll of enchant armor on red dragon scales to upgrade them.

facts.fact: Uncontrolled polymorph while wearing red dragon scales will turn the wearer into a red dragon.
facts.detect: Attempting uncontrolled polymorph while wearing red dragon scales.
facts.action: Avoid uncontrolled polymorph while wearing red dragon scales to prevent turning into a red dragon.

facts.fact: Red dragon scales provide infravision (in NetHack 3.7.0).
facts.detect: Wearing red dragon scales and noticing improved vision in dark areas.
facts.action: Wear red dragon scales to gain infravision and better navigate dark areas.

facts.fact: Reflection causes magical rays and certain gaze attacks to bounce back from the hero or monster.
facts.detect: Messages such as 'But it reflects from your !' or 'It reflects from your !'
facts.action: Seek out and equip items that grant reflection, such as an amulet of reflection, shield of reflection, or silver dragon scales.

facts.fact: Reflection protects against Medusa's stoning gaze, turning Medusa to stone if she can see the hero.
facts.detect: Encountering Medusa and seeing the message 'Medusa doesn't seem to notice that her gaze was reflected.'
facts.action: Prioritize obtaining reflection before entering areas where Medusa may be found.

facts.fact: Reflection can be obtained from various items, with priority order being shield, wielded artifact weapon, amulet, body armor, and polymorphed silver dragon scales.
facts.detect: Equipping items such as a shield of reflection, wielding the Longbow of Diana, or wearing silver dragon scale mail.
facts.action: Equip the highest priority item for reflection based on the hero's role and playstyle.

facts.fact: Silver dragon scale mail grants high AC and does not interfere with spellcasting, making it ideal for Wizards and Monks.
facts.detect: Equipping silver dragon scale mail.
facts.action: Wear silver dragon scale mail if the hero is a Wizard or Monk and prioritizes AC and spellcasting.

facts.fact: An amulet of reflection grants no AC but is the lightest source of reflection and does not interfere with spellcasting.
facts.detect: Equipping an amulet of reflection.
facts.action: Wear an amulet of reflection if the hero is a Monk or other role that does not plan to wear body armor or shields.

facts.fact: Regeneration accelerates the normal healing rate so that a hero or monster gains 1 HP on every turn that they would normally not do so.
facts.detect: Wearing a ring of regeneration or wielding The Staff of Aesculapius (for extrinsic regeneration), or eating a ring of regeneration (for intrinsic regeneration).
facts.action: Equip a ring of regeneration or wield The Staff of Aesculapius to gain extrinsic regeneration, or eat a ring of regeneration to gain intrinsic regeneration.

facts.fact: Extrinsic regeneration from a worn ring of regeneration burns nutrition faster on every odd turn.
facts.detect: Decrease in nutrition level on odd turns while wearing a ring of regeneration.
facts.action: Monitor nutrition level and manage food supply carefully when wearing a ring of regeneration.

facts.fact: Intrinsic regeneration from eating a ring of regeneration burns nutrition faster on every odd turn.
facts.detect: Decrease in nutrition level on odd turns after eating a ring of regeneration.
facts.action: Monitor nutrition level and manage food supply carefully after eating a ring of regeneration.

facts.fact: Some monsters have intrinsic regeneration, such as all werecreatures, Archon, vampire bat, all Les, all Ts, all Vs, Wizard of Yendor, and all Riders.
facts.detect: Encountering these monsters in the game.
facts.action: Be cautious when fighting these monsters as they can regenerate health.

facts.fact: Regeneration that does not burn nutrition directly is generally referred to as 'hungerless regeneration'.
facts.detect: Noticing a lack of nutrition burn while having regeneration.
facts.action: Seek out sources of hungerless regeneration to avoid nutrition burn.

facts.fact: Praying while standing on an altar causes better or different outcomes.
facts.detect: Standing on an altar and using the #pray command
facts.action: Stand on an altar before praying to increase the chance of beneficial outcomes.

facts.fact: Sacrificing on a coaligned altar can improve your relationships with your god, including your luck.
facts.detect: Standing on a coaligned altar and using the #offer command
facts.action: Sacrifice on a coaligned altar to improve your luck and relationship with your god.

facts.fact: Sacrificing on a non-coaligned altar may convert it or lower your luck, or convert you if your alignment is not positive.
facts.detect: Standing on a non-coaligned altar and using the #offer command
facts.action: Avoid sacrificing on non-coaligned altars unless you are sure of the outcome.

facts.fact: Donating money to a peaceful priest in a temple can grant intrinsic protection or other benefits.
facts.detect: Standing next to a peaceful priest in a temple and using the #chat command
facts.action: Donate money to a peaceful priest to gain intrinsic protection or other benefits.

facts.fact: Praying when your god is angry or your luck is negative will cause your god to smite you.
facts.detect: Feeling angry or seeing messages like 'Your god is angry with you.'
facts.action: Avoid praying when your god is angry or your luck is negative.

facts.fact: The remove command is used to remove amulets, rings, and eyewear, but not armor.
facts.detect: The bot will notice it is wearing an amulet, ring, or eyewear.
facts.action: Use the remove command to take off amulets, rings, or eyewear, but use the take off command for armor.

facts.fact: You cannot remove an item if it is cursed.
facts.detect: The bot will know if an item is cursed.
facts.action: Do not attempt to remove a cursed item.

facts.fact: You cannot remove a ring if you are wearing cursed gloves.
facts.detect: The bot will know if it is wearing cursed gloves.
facts.action: Do not attempt to remove a ring if wearing cursed gloves.

facts.fact: Pressing shift+r when only one accessory is equipped will remove it without prompting.
facts.detect: The bot will notice it has only one accessory equipped.
facts.action: Be cautious when removing the last accessory, especially if it is crucial like a ring of levitation.

facts.fact: With paranoid_remove option set, you will always be prompted before removing the last accessory.
facts.detect: The bot will know if the paranoid_remove option is set.
facts.action: If paranoid_remove is set, the bot can safely remove the last accessory without risk.

facts.fact: Press ctrl+a to repeat previous command.
facts.detect: None, as it is a general command.
facts.action: Use ctrl+a to repeat previous commands like zapping wands, untrapping boxes, dipping potions, or firing ranged weapons.

facts.fact: Wands can be quickly wrested by zapping them once and then holding down ctrl+a.
facts.detect: Message indicating wand zapping.
facts.action: After zapping a wand, hold down ctrl+a to repeatedly zap it until something interesting happens.

facts.fact: Repeatedly #untrapping a box to make sure it is safe to open becomes much less annoying with this command.
facts.detect: Message indicating untrapping a box.
facts.action: After untrapping a box once, use ctrl+a to repeatedly untrap it until it is safe to open.

facts.fact: When #dipping potions into a fountain or pool to convert them to potions of water, it is usually necessary to dip them twice.
facts.detect: Message indicating dipping a potion into a fountain or pool.
facts.action: After dipping a potion once, use ctrl+a to dip it again.

facts.fact: Ranged weapons can be fired in the same direction for several turns in a row with the repeat command.
facts.detect: Message indicating firing a ranged weapon.
facts.action: After firing a ranged weapon, use ctrl+a to fire it repeatedly in the same direction.

facts.fact: Dragon corpses provide intrinsic resistances based on their color.
facts.detect: Eating a dragon corpse and checking the message for the resistance gained.
facts.action: Eat dragon corpses to gain resistances, especially yellow for acid, white for cold, green for poison, red for fire, and black for disintegration.

facts.fact: Dragon scale mail and lower dragon scales provide reliable extrinsic resistances.
facts.detect: Wearing dragon scale mail or lower dragon scales.
facts.action: Equip dragon scale mail or lower dragon scales to gain resistances.

facts.fact: Alchemy smock provides acid and poison resistance.
facts.detect: Wearing an alchemy smock.
facts.action: Wear an alchemy smock to gain acid and poison resistance.

facts.fact: Cloak of magic resistance provides magic resistance.
facts.detect: Wearing a cloak of magic resistance.
facts.action: Wear a cloak of magic resistance to gain magic resistance.

facts.fact: Ring of shock resistance provides shock resistance.
facts.detect: Wearing a ring of shock resistance.
facts.action: Wear a ring of shock resistance to gain shock resistance.

facts.fact: Resting can be interrupted by a hostile monster appearing in the hero's sight or attacking the hero.
facts.detect: A monster appears on the map or attacks the hero.
facts.action: Stop resting and prepare to fight or run.

facts.fact: Resting stops when the hero's hit points or power reach their maximum value.
facts.detect: Message 'You are in full health.' or 'You feel full of energy.'
facts.action: Continue resting if needed, but check surroundings for potential threats.

facts.fact: Resting is safer for restoring health and energy in shops to avoid uncovering mimics.
facts.detect: Being in a shop.
facts.action: Rest instead of searching in shops to avoid mimics.

facts.fact: Resting is more ideal for situations where a hero cannot readily become unburdened while waiting to restore HP.
facts.detect: Carrying very heavy items or waiting for a pet to move.
facts.action: Rest to restore HP and energy without becoming unburdened.

facts.fact: Using numeric prefixes when waiting for multiple turns is recommended.
facts.detect: Willing to wait for multiple turns.
facts.action: Use numeric prefixes to wait for multiple turns.

facts.fact: While wearing an amulet of restful sleep, the hero will fall asleep sometime within 100 turns after they put it on.
facts.detect: You yawn.
facts.action: Avoid putting on the amulet of restful sleep or remove it if worn to prevent unexpected sleep.

facts.fact: A hero that has intrinsic restful sleep will randomly fall asleep with the same effects.
facts.detect: You fall asleep.
facts.action: If the bot detects intrinsic restful sleep, it should avoid situations that could disturb it or lead to dangerous sleep states.

facts.fact: Sleep resistance will not cure the condition, but prevents the hero from actually falling asleep.
facts.detect: You are immune to sleep.
facts.action: Equip items that provide sleep resistance to prevent falling asleep.

facts.fact: While asleep, the hero regenerates hit points at an increased rate of 1 additional HP each turn.
facts.detect: You fall asleep.
facts.action: If the bot is in a safe area, it can allow itself to fall asleep to regenerate hit points.

facts.fact: Quaffing a non-cursed potion of restore ability or inhaling its vapors will restore lowered attributes and lost experience levels.
facts.detect: Message: 'Wow! This makes you feel good!' or 'Wow! This makes you feel!'
facts.action: Drink non-cursed potion of restore ability or inhale its vapors to restore attributes and levels.

facts.fact: Quaffing from a magical fountain has a 7/10 chance of restoring attributes if luck is not negative.
facts.detect: Message: 'Wow! This makes you feel good!' or 'Wow! This makes you feel!'
facts.action: Drink from magical fountains to restore attributes and levels.

facts.fact: Casting the restore ability spell at Skilled or higher in healing spells restores all lowered attributes and lost levels.
facts.detect: Message: 'Wow! This makes you feel good!' or 'Wow! This makes you feel!'
facts.action: Cast restore ability spell at Skilled or higher in healing spells to restore attributes and levels.

facts.fact: Applying a non-cursed unicorn horn can raise one or more lowered attributes by up to 3 points.
facts.detect: Message: 'Wow! This makes you feel good!'
facts.action: Apply non-cursed unicorn horn to restore attributes.

facts.fact: Magical fountain quaffing effect behaves exactly as a blessed potion of restore ability does.
facts.detect: Message: 'Wow! This makes you feel good!'
facts.action: Drink from magical fountains to restore attributes and levels.

facts.fact: When a monster is revived, it is restored to full health, with maximum hit points; part of that is then deducted if the corpse was partly eaten.
facts.detect: Messages indicating a corpse has revived, such as 'Your ' corpse suddenly comes alive!', 'A ' suddenly appears!', or 'A ' rises from the dead!'
facts.action: Avoid reviving corpses, especially those of dangerous monsters like trolls or Riders, unless absolutely necessary and when you are prepared for full health revival.

facts.fact: Pets that died while tame usually have a 1 in (tameness+1) chance of becoming untame upon revival. If it becomes untame, it will become either hostile or peaceful with a 1/2 chance of each.
facts.detect: Message 'Your pet ' suddenly comes to life!' or similar indicating a pet corpse has revived.
facts.action: Avoid reviving pet corpses unless you are prepared for the pet to become hostile or untame.

facts.fact: Most actions that try to dispose of a Rider corpse will instead instantly resurrect it. Among other actions, this includes teleporting it, tinning it, or picking it up.
facts.detect: Message 'Your ' corpse suddenly comes alive!' or similar indicating a Rider corpse has revived.
facts.action: Avoid picking up, tinning, or teleporting Rider corpses to prevent resurrection.

facts.fact: Trolls and the Riders have the ability to revive themselves; that is, they will often resurrect a few turns after they are killed.
facts.detect: Message 'A ' rises from the dead!' or similar indicating a troll or Rider has revived.
facts.action: Ensure trolls and Riders are killed in a way that prevents them from reviving, such as using a wand of undead turning or the turn undead spell.

facts.fact: Corpses can also be revived with the cursed Book of the Dead (possible for illiterates), but this method has drawbacks.
facts.detect: Possession of a cursed Book of the Dead or being illiterate.
facts.action: Avoid using the cursed Book of the Dead to revive corpses due to potential drawbacks.

facts.fact: A Rider will revive from their corpse with a 3/5 chance each turn, guaranteed revival after 500 turns, or in response to certain actions (tinning kit, picking up, sacrificing, boulder placement, teleportation).
facts.detect: Message 'The corpse evades your grasp.' or 'A Rider revives.'
facts.action: Avoid tinning, picking up, sacrificing, placing boulders, or teleporting Rider corpses.

facts.fact: Rider corpses do not rot and eating them is instantly fatal, causing revival even if the eater survives via life saving.
facts.detect: Message 'Eating that is instantly fatal.'
facts.action: Avoid eating Rider corpses.

facts.fact: The Riders possess teleport control with a 12/13 chance of placing them adjacent to the hero if teleported.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel a strange presence nearby.'
facts.action: Avoid teleporting Riders or using teleportation near them.

facts.fact: Riders have touch attacks that deal damage and can stun the hero if both attacks land in a round.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel a chill...' or 'You feel a wave of hunger...'
facts.action: Use blessed unicorn horn or other healing to escape and re-position.

facts.fact: Riders have low base HP and can be defeated with strong non-elemental attacks and highly-enchanted weapons.
facts.detect: Low HP and resistance to elemental attacks.
facts.action: Use magic missile, highly-enchanted weapons, or wand of death.

facts.fact: It takes 101 steps while riding to exercise the riding skill by 1 skill point.
facts.detect: The bot can notice this by tracking the number of steps taken while riding.
facts.action: The bot should ride its pet to gain riding skill points, especially if it plans to ride extensively.

facts.fact: A hero riding at Unskilled level has a -2 to-hit penalty, while Basic skill reduces the penalty to -1.
facts.detect: The bot can detect its riding skill level from its inventory or status screen.
facts.action: The bot should aim to reach at least Basic riding skill to reduce the penalty.

facts.fact: Horses can grow up into a 20-speed horse and then a 24-speed warhorse, which can be further increased to 32 via wand of speed monster.
facts.detect: The bot can detect the type of its steed and its current speed.
facts.action: The bot should use a wand of speed monster to increase its steed's speed if it has one.

facts.fact: If riding with the skill at Unskilled level or restricted, you can apply a bullwhip downward to snag items.
facts.detect: The bot can detect its riding skill level and the presence of a bullwhip.
facts.action: The bot should use a bullwhip to pick up items if it has an unskilled riding skill.

facts.fact: If you ride a non-flying steed downstairs while burdened, you will fall off the saddle and injure both legs.
facts.detect: The bot can detect its burden level and the type of its steed.
facts.action: The bot should avoid going downstairs while burdened if it is riding a non-flying steed.

facts.fact: You cannot mount a steed while hallucinating.
facts.detect: Maybe you should find a designated driver.
facts.action: Avoid mounting a steed until hallucination ends.

facts.fact: Dismounting an unnamed steed gives the message 'You've been through the dungeon on a with no name.'
facts.detect: You've been through the dungeon on a with no name.
facts.action: Note the dismounting of an unnamed steed.

facts.fact: Hallucination changes the message for dismounting an unnamed steed to 'It felt good to get out of the rain.'
facts.detect: It felt good to get out of the rain.
facts.action: Recognize this as a dismounting message during hallucination.

facts.fact: Rings of protection are chargeable and have a 5% chance to cause ring hunger if worn and are the hero's only source of extrinsic protection.
facts.detect: Wearing a ring of protection and noticing a decrease in nutrition points.
facts.action: Ensure you have another source of protection or charge the ring to +1 to avoid ring hunger.

facts.fact: Rings of hunger are 90% generated cursed and cause voracious hunger.
facts.detect: Message 'You are ravenously hungry!' or 'You are starving!'
facts.action: Avoid wearing or immediately remove the ring if identified.

facts.fact: Rings of conflict are 90% generated cursed and cause conflict.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel a sudden urge to kill something.'
facts.action: Avoid wearing or immediately remove the ring if identified.

facts.fact: Rings of teleportation are 90% generated cursed and cause teleportitis.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel a sudden urge to teleport somewhere.'
facts.action: Avoid wearing or immediately remove the ring if identified.

facts.fact: Chargeable rings have a risk of exploding when charged, especially at high enchantments.
facts.detect: Message 'The ring explodes in a shower of sparks!' or 'The ring is too highly charged to charge further.'
facts.action: Be cautious when charging rings, especially those with high enchantments.

facts.fact: Essential rings are free action, levitation, and conflict.
facts.detect: Identify rings of free action, levitation, and conflict.
facts.action: Wear these rings as they make the game easier.

facts.fact: Conflict ring causes 50% extra hunger but saves your life in heavy fights.
facts.detect: Wearing conflict ring and observing increased hunger and effectiveness in fights.
facts.action: Wear conflict ring during heavy fights.

facts.fact: Levitation ring allows easy crossing of water levels and the planes of Air and Fire.
facts.detect: Identify levitation ring and observe water levels or planes of Air and Fire.
facts.action: Wear levitation ring when crossing water or Air/Fire planes.

facts.fact: Free action ring protects from paralysis when fighting high-level spellcasters.
facts.detect: Fighting high-level spellcasters and observing protection from paralysis.
facts.action: Wear free action ring when fighting high-level spellcasters.

facts.fact: Useful rings like protection, warning, regeneration, slow digestion, teleportation, and polymorph control are good to keep in inventory.
facts.detect: Identify useful rings and observe their effects.
facts.action: Keep useful rings in inventory and wear them as needed.

facts.fact: Chance of your god helping you if you pray with exactly 0 alignment is 1% for negative luck and 99% for positive luck.
facts.detect: Player's alignment is exactly 0 and praying.
facts.action: Pray only when alignment is positive to maximize divine assistance.

facts.fact: Chance of kicking down a door is influenced by luck and character stats, with higher luck increasing the chance.
facts.detect: Attempting to kick a door.
facts.action: Increase luck to improve chances of kicking down doors.

facts.fact: Chance of angering your god by praying in Gehennom increases with higher alignment and decreases with higher luck.
facts.detect: Praying in Gehennom with positive alignment.
facts.action: Avoid praying in Gehennom with high alignment unless luck is high.

facts.fact: Chance of a blessed projectile not breaking when thrown is influenced by luck, with higher luck greatly increasing the chance.
facts.detect: Throwing a blessed projectile.
facts.action: Increase luck to reduce the chance of blessed projectiles breaking.

facts.fact: Chance of being petrified if your saddle slips off or is destroyed is influenced by luck, with higher luck greatly reducing the chance.
facts.detect: Riding a steed that can petrify on touch.
facts.action: Increase luck to reduce the risk of petrification.

facts.fact: Rodents are neutral animals that can be seen via infravision and lack hands with the exception of the wererat, which is chaotic and has a human form.
facts.detect: Wererat in human form
facts.action: Be cautious around wererats in human form as they can transmit lycanthropy and summon other rats.

facts.fact: The rabid rat is fairly fast and can inflict debilitating damage, attribute loss or even an early YASD with its bites unless you find a source of poison resistance.
facts.detect: Rabid rat
facts.action: Avoid close combat with rabid rats and find poison resistance before engaging.

facts.fact: Rodents primarily attack using bites.
facts.detect: Rodent bite attack
facts.action: Wear gloves or use a shield to protect against bite damage.

facts.fact: The wererat is the weakest of the werecreatures, but is one of the biggest threats among the rodents due to the lycanthropy they can transmit.
facts.detect: Wererat
facts.action: Avoid contact with wererats and find a cure for lycanthropy if infected.

facts.fact: A hero that can make it to Minetown or Sokoban is usually capable of handling wererats and other rodents from that point.
facts.detect: Arrival at Minetown or Sokoban
facts.action: Continue to Minetown or Sokoban to gain better equipment and skills to handle rodents.

facts.fact: The Rogue level consists of a 3x3 grid, each cell of which may contain a room or a corridor node.
facts.detect: The map changes to a 3x3 grid layout with rooms and corridors.
facts.action: Adapt movement and exploration strategies to fit the 3x3 grid layout.

facts.fact: Doors are represented as '+' and act like open doorways, meaning you can not walk diagonally through them.
facts.detect: Encounter a '+' symbol on the map.
facts.action: Avoid diagonal movement through '+' symbols.

facts.fact: Food is represented as ':' and monsters do not leave corpses.
facts.detect: Encounter ':' on the map or notice lack of corpses after killing monsters.
facts.action: Collect food represented by ':' and be aware that monsters do not drop items.

facts.fact: Armor is represented as ']' and hostile monsters cannot tunnel through rock.
facts.detect: Encounter ']' on the map or notice monsters unable to tunnel through rock.
facts.action: Identify armor by ']' and be aware of monster movement limitations.

facts.fact: There is a named ghost guarding a fake bones pile with a cheap plastic imitation of the Amulet of Yendor.
