facts.detect: Encounter a ghost named after one of the creators of Rogue.
facts.action: Be cautious around the ghost and explore the area for the fake Amulet.

facts.fact: The Rogue quest involves fighting the Master Assassin for the Master Key of Thievery.
facts.detect: Encounter with the Master Assassin
facts.action: Prepare to fight the Master Assassin and obtain the Master Key of Thievery.

facts.fact: The Thieves' Guild Hall is no-teleport and has undiggable walls and floor.
facts.detect: Cannot dig or teleport
facts.action: Avoid using teleportation or digging to escape or explore.

facts.fact: The Assassins' Guild Hall has a cursed scroll of teleportation.
facts.detect: Cursed scroll of teleportation
facts.action: Avoid picking up or using the cursed scroll of teleportation.

facts.fact: The Stronghold of the Master Assassin is no-teleport and has undiggable walls.
facts.detect: Cannot dig or teleport
facts.action: Prepare for a prolonged fight as escape options are limited.

facts.fact: The Stronghold of the Master Assassin contains four sharks in a pool.
facts.detect: Pool with sharks
facts.action: Avoid the pool with sharks to prevent unwanted encounters.

facts.fact: About 7/8 of generated monsters will be nymphs, with hazards of losing your weapon and armor and having your wands used against you.
facts.detect: Encountering nymphs and losing items
facts.action: Use daggers or darts to eliminate nymphs from a distance and avoid melee combat.

facts.fact: Guardian nagas are common and can inflict paralysis.
facts.detect: Encountering guardian nagas
facts.action: Use a ring of free action or polymorph into a form that avoids melee attacks.

facts.fact: The home level is time-consuming to navigate, with chameleons potentially turning into dangerous monsters.
facts.detect: Chameleons turning into dangerous monsters
facts.action: Acquire magic resistance and engrave Elbereth if dangerous monsters appear.

facts.fact: The goal level is split into multiple sections by non-diggable walls.
facts.detect: Non-diggable walls separating sections
facts.action: Polymorph into a xorn to phase through walls or use a drum of earthquake to wake the Master Assassin.

facts.fact: Aggravate the Master Assassin by quaffing a cursed potion of invisibility or reading a cursed spellbook.
facts.detect: Quaffing a cursed potion of invisibility or reading a cursed spellbook
facts.action: Aggravate the Master Assassin to make him warp to you.

facts.fact: Valkyrie starts with cold resistance
facts.detect: cold resistance
facts.action: No action needed, as this is a passive benefit.

facts.fact: Valkyrie gains stealth at level 3
facts.detect: Level 3 message
facts.action: Explore cautiously to avoid monsters.

facts.fact: Valkyrie gains speed at level 7
facts.detect: Level 7 message
facts.action: Move faster to explore and avoid traps.

facts.fact: Valkyrie can be lawful or neutral
facts.detect: Alignment selection prompt
facts.action: Choose lawful alignment for better weapon mastery.

facts.fact: Valkyrie can be human or dwarf
facts.detect: Race selection prompt
facts.action: Choose dwarf for better starting attributes.

facts.fact: Lawful Valkyries have easy access to early artifacts (Excalibur) and an easy quest with an excellent quest artifact (the Orb of Fate) plus intrinsic cold resistance.
facts.detect: Finding Excalibur in the early game, encountering the Orb of Fate during the quest, and noticing cold resistance.
facts.action: Prioritize finding Excalibur and completing the quest to obtain the Orb of Fate. Use cold resistance to your advantage.

facts.fact: Valkyries start with powerful physical combat options from the very beginning.
facts.detect: Starting with a spear or dwarvish spear.
facts.action: Focus on melee combat and use your starting weapon effectively.

facts.fact: Tourists have a stack of +2 darts and an expensive camera, which are good ranged weapons for the early game.
facts.detect: Starting with +2 darts and an expensive camera.
facts.action: Use +2 darts for ranged attacks and the camera to evade non-Elbereth respecting monsters.

facts.fact: Tourists have one of the best quest artifacts, the Platinum Yendorian Express Card.
facts.detect: Completing the tourist quest and obtaining the Platinum Yendorian Express Card.
facts.action: Focus on the quest to obtain the Platinum Yendorian Express Card.

facts.fact: Tourists can use nearly any weapon effectively.
facts.detect: Noticing the ability to wield any weapon without penalty.
facts.action: Experiment with different weapons to find the most effective ones.

facts.fact: Rolling boulder traps can generate as early as the second floor of the dungeon.
facts.detect: Click! You trigger a rolling boulder trap!
facts.action: Be cautious when exploring new levels, especially the second floor and beyond.

facts.fact: A boulder set rolling by this trap can disappear midway through rolling if, for example, it fills a pit, hole or trap door, or it is caught by a giant that was in the way.
facts.detect: You see a boulder start to roll.
facts.action: Avoid standing in the path of a rolling boulder and be prepared to move out of the way if a boulder starts rolling.

facts.fact: Rolling boulder traps can be destroyed by activating the trap when there is no suitable boulder on a launch square.
facts.detect: Fortunately for you, no boulder was released.
facts.action: If you find a suspiciously placed boulder, move it out of the way to disarm the trap.

facts.fact: When you see a suspiciously placed boulder, it is often a good idea to defuse any potential rolling boulder traps by moving the boulder (so that it is no longer on a launch square).
facts.detect: A suspiciously placed boulder.
facts.action: Move the boulder to a safe location to disarm the trap.

facts.fact: A boulder trap will not trigger its boulder to roll if the path is blocked by a wall, or the boulder is moved off the launch square by anything other than the trap itself.
facts.detect: A boulder is moved off the launch square.
facts.action: Move the boulder off the launch square to prevent the trap from triggering.

facts.fact: Most levels contain between 5 and 10 rooms, with occasional appearances of levels with as few as 4 or as many as 12.
facts.detect: Counting the number of rooms on the current level.
facts.action: Explore all possible areas thoroughly as the number of rooms can vary widely.

facts.fact: The chance of a room being lit depends solely on the level difficulty, with fewer lit rooms deeper into the dungeon.
facts.detect: Checking the lighting condition of a room.
facts.action: Be prepared for more dark rooms as you go deeper, and use light sources accordingly.

facts.fact: Rooms can be as small as 2x3 and hence tucked into places you would not expect them.
facts.detect: Exploring small, unexpected areas on the map.
facts.action: Search thoroughly in small, unexplored areas for hidden rooms.

facts.fact: Try using the terrain command to show the map without monsters or objects - the stairs may be hidden under a monster or object.
facts.detect: Using the terrain command and noticing hidden stairs.
facts.action: Use the terrain command to reveal hidden stairs.

facts.fact: Fall down a pit or hole to go to a lower level, then explore back up.
facts.detect: Falling down a pit or hole.
facts.action: Deliberately fall down a pit or hole to explore lower levels and then return.

facts.fact: Rubbing a magic lamp can summon a djinni.
facts.detect: You see a puff of smoke
facts.action: Prepare to deal with a djinni if you rub a magic lamp.

facts.fact: Rubbing an unidentified gem on a blessed, identified touchstone can identify the gem.
facts.detect: scritch, scritch
facts.action: Rub unidentified gems on a blessed, identified touchstone to identify them.

facts.fact: Rubbing a brass lantern produces a message indicating nothing happens.
facts.detect: Rubbing the electric lamp is not particularly rewarding. Anyway, nothing exciting happens.
facts.action: Do not expect any special effects from rubbing a brass lantern.

facts.fact: Rust monsters and disenchanters are designated internally by the macro S_RUSTMONST.
facts.detect: Not directly detectable by the bot, but useful for understanding the internal mechanics.
facts.action: Understand that rust monsters and disenchanters belong to the same class for game mechanics.

facts.fact: Rust monsters erode non-proofed metallic equipment.
facts.detect: Encountering a rust monster or seeing equipment rust.
facts.action: Equip proofed or non-metallic armor and weapons.

facts.fact: Disenchanters drain enchantment from armor and weapons.
facts.detect: Encountering a disenchanter or noticing a decrease in weapon or armor enchantment.
facts.action: Avoid or kill disenchanters, use proofed or non-metallic equipment.

facts.fact: 2-3 rust monsters or disenchanters are generated in the central room of the Castle at level creation.
facts.detect: Entering the central room of the Castle.
facts.action: Be prepared to deal with rust monsters or disenchanters upon entering the Castle.

facts.fact: Disenchanters are difficult to hit reliably and sap enchantments from weapons.
facts.detect: Encountering a disenchanter and noticing difficulty in hitting it.
facts.action: Avoid or kill disenchanters, use proofed or non-metallic weapons.

facts.fact: A rust trap sprays water, potentially rusting unprotected iron items and damaging iron golems.
facts.detect: A gush of water hits you!
facts.action: Wear a cloak to protect body armor and avoid rusting of iron items.

facts.fact: If polymorphed into an iron golem, the player takes damage equal to the golem's maximum HP and reverts to natural form.
facts.detect: You are covered with rust!
facts.action: Avoid polymorphing into iron golems near rust traps.

facts.fact: Gremlins can multiply by using rust traps.
facts.detect: Gremlin multiplies
facts.action: Avoid traps in areas with gremlins.

facts.fact: Iron golems are instantly destroyed by rust traps.
facts.detect: falls to pieces!
facts.action: Avoid rust traps if iron golems are nearby.

facts.fact: Rust traps can be used to blank scrolls and spellbooks and dilute potions.
facts.detect: A gush of water hits you!
facts.action: Use rust traps to blank scrolls and spellbooks and dilute potions by wielding them and removing other rustable gear.

facts.fact: s represents an arachnid or centipede (cave spider, centipede, giant spider, scorpion, Scorpius)
facts.detect: s on the map
facts.action: Prepare for combat with appropriate weapons and armor, especially fire resistance for scorpions

facts.fact: S represents a snake (garter snake, snake, water moccasin, pit viper, python, cobra)
facts.detect: S on the map
facts.action: Prepare for combat with appropriate weapons and armor, especially fire resistance for cobras

facts.fact: Press s to search for hidden monsters, traps, secret doors and passages
facts.detect: No specific detection needed, as the bot can choose to search at any time
facts.action: Use s to search when exploring new areas or when unsure about the safety of the area

facts.fact: Press S to save your game and quit
facts.detect: No specific detection needed, as this is a game control
facts.action: Use S to save the game when in a safe place or before attempting dangerous actions

facts.fact: A sacrifice generally requires a corpse that is fresh to be 'prepared' via the #offer extended command while standing on the altar. This involves touching the corpse, whether it is in the hero's inventory or already on the altar, so offering a cockatrice or chickatrice corpse will result in immediate stoning unless the hero is wearing gloves.
facts.detect: Message: 'You are stoned!' or 'You are turned to stone!' when offering a cockatrice or chickatrice corpse without gloves.
facts.action: Wear gloves before attempting to offer a cockatrice or chickatrice corpse.

facts.fact: A corpse being offered for sacrifice must be aged no more than 50 turns since its creation (or removal from an ice box, if it was created in a normally-generated one) to be accepted as a sacrifice and consumed.
facts.detect: Message: 'The corpse is too old to be used as a sacrifice.'
facts.action: Ensure the corpse is less than 50 turns old before attempting to sacrifice it.

facts.fact: Sacrificing the corpse of a unicorn, a former pet that died while tame or a monster belonging to the hero's race has differing and often drastic adjustments to its value, including whether or not the sacrifice is to the hero's god or another god.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel a sense of inadequacy.' or 'The gods seem tall.' when sacrificing a unicorn or a pet.
facts.action: Avoid sacrificing unicorns or former pets to any god, especially not to the hero's own god.

facts.fact: If the hero attempts to sacrifice a corpse with no value, usually a corpse that is too old as described above, nothing happens regardless of who the altar's deity is.
facts.detect: Message: 'The corpse is too old to be used as a sacrifice.'
facts.action: Do not attempt to sacrifice corpses that are too old.

facts.fact: Sacrificing a pet to a co-aligned god at their altar after it died while tame has a value of -1, which will anger them. The corpse will not be consumed in this case, and the hero is given the aggravate monster intrinsic along with a -3 penalty to alignment record.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel a sense of inadequacy.' or 'The gods seem tall.' when sacrificing a pet.
facts.action: Avoid sacrificing pets to any god.

facts.fact: Sacrificing a unicorn of the hero's alignment will always anger the hero's god and cause them to smite the hero, regardless of the outcome.
facts.detect: Sacrificing a unicorn corpse of the hero's alignment on an altar.
facts.action: Avoid sacrificing a unicorn of the hero's alignment to prevent smiting and alignment penalties.

facts.fact: Sacrificing a unicorn on an altar matching its own alignment will anger that altar's god into smiting the hero, and the hero also loses one point of wisdom.
facts.detect: Sacrificing a unicorn of the altar's alignment on an altar.
facts.action: Avoid sacrificing a unicorn of the altar's alignment to prevent smiting and wisdom loss.

facts.fact: Sacrificing on a high altar not belonging to the hero's god will not initiate a conversion attempt for that altar or the hero, and will also bring the full wrath of that altar's god upon the hero.
facts.detect: Sacrificing on a high altar of a different god.
facts.action: Avoid sacrificing on high altars of gods other than the hero's god to prevent smiting and penalties.

facts.fact: If a sacrifice of negative value is made at a cross-aligned altar, a conversion attempt will not occur: the altar's god is angered and smites the hero.
facts.detect: Sacrificing a corpse of negative value on a cross-aligned altar.
facts.action: Avoid sacrificing items of negative value on cross-aligned altars to prevent smiting.

facts.fact: Attempting same-race sacrifice on a high altar that is not chaotic while the hero is not chaotic will immediately raise the anger of that altar's god to maximum and prompt them to smite the hero.
facts.detect: Performing same-race sacrifice on a high altar of a different alignment.
facts.action: Avoid performing same-race sacrifice on high altars of different alignments to prevent smiting.

facts.fact: You have received a gift, and your prayer timeout has been increased. You may not safely pray.
facts.detect: You have received a gift, and your prayer timeout has been increased.
facts.action: Do not pray until the prayer timeout is reset.

facts.fact: Your alignment was negative and has been increased by the level of the corpse, to a maximum of zero. Sacrifice again to see if it is safe to pray.
facts.detect: You feel partially absolved.
facts.action: Sacrifice again to check if it is safe to pray.

facts.fact: Your base luck has been increased and is not negative. Unless you have a cursed luckstone, you may safely pray.
facts.detect: You glimpse a four-leaf clover at your feet.
facts.action: Pray if your luck is not negative and you do not have a cursed luckstone.

facts.fact: You attempted to sacrifice a former pet at an altar, and its corpse was not consumed.
facts.detect: So this is how you repay loyalty?
facts.action: Do not sacrifice former pets.

facts.fact: You performed same-race sacrifice as a non-chaotic hero while not in the form of a demon. The blood floods the altar, which vanishes in a cloud! You'll regret this infamous offense!
facts.detect: You'll regret this infamous offense! The blood floods the altar, which vanishes in a cloud!
facts.action: Avoid performing same-race sacrifice as a non-chaotic hero while not in the form of a demon.

facts.fact: A sanctuary (co-aligned temple) is a place where monsters will not attack you, but will flee from you.
facts.detect: The message 'You are in a sanctuary.' or finding a temple with the same alignment as your character.
facts.action: Retreat to a sanctuary to recover HP, identify items, or manage a stash.

facts.fact: After completing the first level of Sokoban, use spare boulders to block off the part of the room that contains the down staircase.
facts.detect: Completing the first level of Sokoban and having spare boulders.
facts.action: Block off the down staircase with boulders to create a safe area.

facts.fact: Hiding in a closet and locking the door can provide a safe area.
facts.detect: Finding a closet and having a key or the ability to lock doors.
facts.action: Hide in a closet and lock the door to avoid monsters.

facts.fact: Finding a room with doors in all doorways and locking them can create a safe area.
facts.detect: Finding a room with doors in all doorways and having a wand of locking or the wizard lock spell.
facts.action: Lock all doors in the room to create a safe area.

facts.fact: A safe area with a downward staircase is valuable once the level is cleared.
facts.detect: Finding a safe area with a downward staircase after clearing the level.
facts.action: Withdraw into the safe area when injured from combat in the level below.

facts.fact: Each Samurai starts with a +0 katana (wielded), a +0 short sword (alternate weapon), a +0 yumi, and 26-45 ya (quivered).
facts.detect: The bot starts with these items in its inventory.
facts.action: Use the katana for melee combat and the yumi with ya for ranged attacks. Prioritize shooting ya over melee if the enemy is out of melee range.

facts.fact: Samurai get a +1 to-hit bonus when firing any arrow from a bow, and gain another +1 to-hit when firing ya.
facts.detect: The bot notices an increase in accuracy when shooting ya or arrows.
facts.action: Use ya for ranged attacks to take advantage of the increased accuracy.

facts.fact: Samurai can perform a shattering blow while wielding a katana without wearing a shield.
facts.detect: The bot is wielding a katana and not wearing a shield.
facts.action: When attacking with a katana and no shield equipped, use the shattering blow technique.

facts.fact: Samurai start with Basic skill in long swords, short swords, bows, and martial arts.
facts.detect: The bot starts with Basic skill in these weapon types.
facts.action: Train in long swords to potentially obtain Excalibur, and continue to improve skills in bows and martial arts.

facts.fact: The Samurai's quest sees them fighting Ashikaga Takauji for The Tsurugi of Muramasa, an artifact tsurugi.
facts.detect: The bot encounters Ashikaga Takauji in the quest.
facts.action: Avoid melee combat with Ashikaga Takauji to prevent the risk of instant death from The Tsurugi of Muramasa.

facts.fact: The Samurai quest involves fighting Ashikaga Takauji for the Bell of Opening and the Tsurugi of Muramasa.
facts.detect: Encounter with Ashikaga Takauji
facts.action: Prepare to fight Ashikaga Takauji and retrieve the Tsurugi of Muramasa.

facts.fact: The Castle of the Taro Clan is the home level with Lord Sato and eight roshi.
facts.detect: Lord Sato and roshi
facts.action: Speak to Lord Sato and prepare to fight roshi.

facts.fact: The Shogun's Castle has eight ninja, nine wolves, and one random d.
facts.detect: Ninja, wolves, and random d
facts.action: Be cautious of ninja and wolves, and prepare to fight them.

facts.fact: The Donjon of Ashikaga Takauji contains five samurai, five ninja, four wolves, nine stalkers, and two random d.
facts.detect: Ashikaga Takauji and various enemies
facts.action: Prepare for a final battle with Ashikaga Takauji and all enemies.

facts.fact: Random monsters on the quest levels include 55% wolves, 14% random d, and 14% stalker.
facts.detect: Wolves, random d, and stalker
facts.action: Be prepared to fight these common enemies.

facts.fact: A sanctuary is a co-aligned temple where you can receive sanctuary from its priest if your alignment is greater than -4.
facts.detect: Entering a temple and seeing a priest with a positive reaction message.
facts.action: Maintain an alignment greater than -4 to receive sanctuary from the priest.

facts.fact: Monsters will not enter a sanctuary if you have received sanctuary from its priest.
facts.detect: Not seeing any monsters entering the temple area.
facts.action: Stay within the sanctuary to avoid monster attacks.

facts.fact: Monsters within a sanctuary will not attack you in melee and will flee as if you were standing on a respected Elbereth square.
facts.detect: Monsters within the temple fleeing or not attacking you.
facts.action: Use the sanctuary to avoid melee combat with monsters.

facts.fact: Only certain monsters ignore sanctuary, including Riders, high priests, all {{monclasssym|A}}, and all peaceful monsters.
facts.detect: Seeing Riders, high priests, or monsters of class A entering or attacking within the temple.
facts.action: Be cautious of these monsters as they do not respect sanctuary.

facts.fact: Sartan tannin has Sting attacks that drain strength, dexterity, and charisma (1d14 each).
facts.detect: Sartan tannin symbol (&)
facts.action: Avoid melee combat with Sartan tannin if possible, use ranged attacks or spells.

facts.fact: Sartan tannin has Tentacle attack that deals 10d6 elemental acid damage.
facts.detect: Sartan tannin symbol (&)
facts.action: Wear acid-resistant armor and carry a healing potion.

facts.fact: Sartan tannin has high AC (-23) and resistances to cold, shock, poison, acid, petrification, and disease.
facts.detect: Sartan tannin symbol (&)
facts.action: Use high-damage attacks or spells to bypass its resistances.

facts.fact: Sartan tannin has the ability to create stinking clouds while afflicted with rotting.
facts.detect: Stinking cloud effect
facts.action: Use a unicorn horn or other means to cure rotting before engaging.

facts.fact: Sartan tannin has infravision and can see invisible.
facts.detect: Sartan tannin symbol (&)
facts.action: Avoid hiding or using invisibility when near Sartan tannin.

facts.fact: A fleeing monster has a 25% chance of recovering per monster move, unless it has a predetermined duration.
facts.detect: Monster moves away from player but stops after a few moves.
facts.action: Use multiple scare methods to ensure monsters stay scared.

facts.fact: A monster that is 'scared' cannot attack; this status property can be seen via probing.
facts.detect: Using a stethoscope on a monster.
facts.action: Use a stethoscope to check if a monster is scared before approaching.

facts.fact: A fleeing monster may attack you in melee if it blunders into you when you are invisible or have displacement, or if it is confused, stunned, blinded, or cornered.
facts.detect: Monster blunders into player while player is invisible or has displacement.
facts.action: Avoid being invisible or using displacement when surrounded by scared monsters.

facts.fact: Monsters will still use ranged attacks while fleeing.
facts.detect: Monster uses wand or breath weapon while fleeing.
facts.action: Be prepared for ranged attacks from scared monsters.

facts.fact: A monster will stop fleeing when any time has expired. If the scaring is untimed, it will stop fleeing 4% of the time on each move it makes, if its hit points are at maximum.
facts.detect: Monster stops fleeing after several moves.
facts.action: Use timed scare methods for critical situations.

facts.fact: Quantum mechanics have a 5% chance of being generated with a special large box containing Schroedinger's Cat, which is either alive or dead.
facts.detect: Quantum mechanic with a large box
facts.action: Open the box to observe the state of Schroedinger's Cat

facts.fact: When the box is opened, there is a 50% chance of generating a peaceful live housecat named 'Schroedinger's Cat' near the player.
facts.detect: Message: The housecat inside the box is still alive!
facts.action: Tame the cat if it is peaceful and alive

facts.fact: If Schroedinger's Cat is generated as dead, it will be a hostile housecat corpse.
facts.detect: Message: The housecat inside the box is dead!
facts.action: Avoid or prepare to fight the hostile housecat corpse

facts.fact: Neither telepathy nor monster detection will show a live cat in the box, nor will food detection show its corpse.
facts.detect: Using telepathy or food detection on the box
facts.action: Use a wand of probing to check the box

facts.fact: Ascension with an unopened box containing Schroedinger's Cat will reveal whether or not the cat was alive or dead.
facts.detect: Carrying an unopened box to the ascension level
facts.action: Ascend with the unopened box to reveal the cat's state

facts.fact: Ascending with the minimum possible score is one of the more difficult unofficial conducts.
facts.detect: Playing as a pacifist, avoiding certain actions like consulting the Oracle, #untrapping squeaky board traps, eating tripe rations, or quaffing from sinks.
facts.action: Avoid actions that give score points, such as killing monsters, identifying items, or using certain items in ways that give score.

facts.fact: Do not ascend with your starting alignment to minimize score.
facts.detect: Player's alignment is not the same as the starting alignment.
facts.action: Convert to a different alignment before offering the Amulet of Yendor.

facts.fact: Before offering the Amulet of Yendor, drop all gold, valuable gems, amulets and artifacts.
facts.detect: Player drops all gold, valuable gems, amulets, and artifacts before offering the Amulet.
facts.action: Drop all valuable items before offering the Amulet to minimize score.

facts.fact: The lowest possible score one can achieve when ascending overall in 3.6.0 and later versions is 12200.
facts.detect: Player ascends with the lowest possible score.
facts.action: Strive to achieve the lowest possible score by following the conduct rules.

facts.fact: Certain artifacts are worth less than their weight in gold for score purposes.
facts.detect: Player carries artifacts that weigh more than one unit.
facts.action: Carry gold instead of artifacts that are worth less than their weight in gold.

facts.fact: Scrolls of identify, light, enchant weapon, enchant armor, and remove curse are easy to identify by price.
facts.detect: Price of the scroll
facts.action: Use these scrolls when identified to maximize benefits.

facts.fact: Scrolls of fire, destroy armor, scare monster, teleportation, amnesia, create monster, earth, taming, genocide, punishment, and stinking cloud are inconvenient and dangerous.
facts.detect: Price of the scroll
facts.action: Avoid reading these scrolls unless absolutely necessary and you have identified them.

facts.fact: Scrolls of earth are guaranteed in the first level of Sokoban.
facts.detect: Location in Sokoban
facts.action: Identify scrolls of earth by their guaranteed presence in Sokoban.

facts.fact: Scrolls of teleportation are the only ones generated inside closets.
facts.detect: Location inside closets
facts.action: Identify scrolls of teleportation by their location inside closets.

facts.fact: Scrolls of scare monster are placed under the Sokoban prize and the chest with the wand of wishing at the Castle.
facts.detect: Location under Sokoban prize or Castle chest
facts.action: Identify scrolls of scare monster by their location under specific items.

facts.fact: If a scroll of demonology is read while not confused, it can summon various types of demons with different probabilities. For example, vrock has a 35% chance if not cursed, and a 30% chance if cursed.
facts.detect: Reading a scroll of demonology and observing the summoned demon type.
facts.action: Avoid reading a scroll of demonology unless in a controlled environment or with a specific strategy to deal with summoned demons.

facts.fact: If the scroll is blessed, there is a 50% chance of summoning a tame demon, otherwise it is hostile. If cursed, 2-4 hostile demons are summoned.
facts.detect: Checking the scroll's beatitude before reading.
facts.action: Do not read cursed scrolls of demonology, and only read blessed scrolls in a safe area.

facts.fact: If a named demon is generated, it will always be hostile to lawful players.
facts.detect: Summoning a named demon (e.g., Balrog, Nalfeshnee).
facts.action: Avoid reading scrolls of demonology if there is a chance of summoning a named demon.

facts.fact: If confused, reading a cursed scroll will attempt to summon a named demon with a 40% chance of a demon lord and 60% chance of a demon prince.
facts.detect: Being confused and reading a cursed scroll.
facts.action: Avoid reading cursed scrolls of demonology while confused.

facts.fact: If a scroll of demonology is read by a monster, it can create 1-12 demons if cursed or the monster is confused, otherwise 1-4 demons.
facts.detect: Observing a monster reading a scroll of demonology.
facts.action: Avoid having monsters read scrolls of demonology, especially in dangerous areas.

facts.fact: Scrolls of enchant weapon are common, useful, and easy to price ID, with their unique base price of 60.
facts.detect: Scroll with base price of 60
facts.action: Use to enchant weapons, especially early in the game.

facts.fact: Scrolls of enchant armor are one of the most valuable scrolls in the game, with a base price of 80.
facts.detect: Scroll with base price of 80
facts.action: Use to enchant armor, especially early in the game.

facts.fact: Scrolls of teleportation are a good escape item, particularly in the early game.
facts.detect: Scroll with base price of 100
facts.action: Use to teleport away from danger.

facts.fact: Scrolls of scare monster can save your life against anything from killer bees to Demogorgon.
facts.detect: Scroll with base price of 100
facts.action: Keep in a container for emergency use.

facts.fact: Scrolls of identify should be kept and used to identify items that are difficult to identify safely.
facts.detect: Scroll with base price of 5
facts.action: Use to identify items.

facts.fact: All sea monsters are flagged as amphibious and capable of living and hiding in pools and moats. They will become scared and gradually lose HP with a 7/8 chance on each move when stranded on land.
facts.detect: The bot notices sea monsters moving towards pools or moats, or sea monsters on land losing health.
facts.action: The bot should avoid engaging sea monsters on land and try to lure them into water or use ranged attacks.

facts.fact: Sea monsters can be stranded on land using wands of cold, fire, or a scroll of earth, making them easier to deal with.
facts.detect: The bot uses a wand of cold, fire, or a scroll of earth near a sea monster.
facts.action: The bot should use these items to trap sea monsters on land and attack them safely.

facts.fact: Sea monsters can grapple and drown heroes, especially eels and kraken. Greased outer armor or an oilskin cloak prevents this.
facts.detect: The bot encounters a sea monster that can grapple, such as an eel or kraken.
facts.action: The bot should equip greased outer armor or an oilskin cloak to prevent drowning.

facts.fact: Sea monsters are vulnerable to sleep spells and wands due to their lack of MR score.
facts.detect: The bot has a wand of sleep or a spell to put sea monsters to sleep.
facts.action: The bot should use sleep spells or wands to immobilize sea monsters.

facts.fact: Heroes can avoid sea monsters by running away, especially on the Plane of Water.
facts.detect: The bot is on the Plane of Water or encounters a sea monster.
facts.action: The bot should run away from sea monsters to avoid combat.

facts.fact: Pressing the 's' key searches the 8 squares surrounding you for secret doors, secret passages, hidden or invisible monsters, and hidden traps.
facts.detect: Pressing 's' key
facts.action: Use the 's' key to search for hidden features and monsters

facts.fact: Wearing a pair of lenses or wielding Excalibur increases the chance of finding secret doors and passages.
facts.detect: Wearing lenses or wielding Excalibur
facts.action: Equip lenses or wield Excalibur to improve search success rate

facts.fact: Automatic searching property reveals traps and dungeon features but not monsters.
facts.detect: Wielding Excalibur or wearing a ring of searching
facts.action: Use automatic searching to find traps and dungeon features

facts.fact: Early characters have a roughly 22% chance of missing a door after 10 searches.
facts.detect: Early game with low Luck
facts.action: Use a numeric prefix before the search command (e.g., '22s') to maximize success

facts.fact: Searching is a critical skill for zen conduct players to detect monsters and navigate safely.
facts.detect: Playing as a zen conduct player
facts.action: Search after almost every step to detect monsters and navigate safely

facts.fact: Secret passages are represented by {{lightgray| }} and appear as solid rock until exposed.
facts.detect: The bot will notice secret passages as solid rock until they are exposed.
facts.action: The bot should attempt to expose secret passages using the search command or other methods mentioned to reveal hidden corridors.

facts.fact: Monsters and pets won't step on a secret passage square, and the square blocks thrown objects.
facts.detect: The bot will notice that monsters and pets do not move through areas that should be corridors.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious and avoid throwing objects into potentially secret passage areas.

facts.fact: Secret passages can be exposed by searching, applying a stethoscope, reading a blessed scroll of magic mapping, casting detect unseen, zapping a wand of secret door detection, or digging.
facts.detect: The bot will notice the need to use these methods when it encounters solid rock where a corridor should be.
facts.action: The bot should use the search command or other listed methods to expose secret passages.

facts.fact: Secret passages are more difficult to expose than secret doors.
facts.detect: The bot will notice that standard methods for opening doors do not work on secret passages.
facts.action: The bot should use more specific methods for exposing secret passages as listed.

facts.fact: A sedge hat grants protection from the acid rain monster spell.
facts.detect: A few drops of liquid/viscous liquid hit your/wide straw hat
facts.action: Wear the sedge hat if you are in an area where acid rain is common or expected.

facts.fact: Monks start the game with a non-cursed +0 sedge hat.
facts.detect: Starting as a Monk
facts.action: Keep the sedge hat as it provides acid rain protection and may be enchanted.

facts.fact: Zhi ren monks are always generated with a paper sedge hat with a 4/7 chance of being enchanted.
facts.detect: Encountering Zhi ren monks
facts.action: Steal or take the sedge hat from Zhi ren monks if you need acid rain protection or an enchanted hat.

facts.fact: Roshis are always generated with sedge hats.
facts.detect: Encountering Roshis
facts.action: Steal or take the sedge hat from Roshis if you need acid rain protection.

facts.fact: Player monster monks are always generated with sedge hats.
facts.detect: Encountering player monster monks
facts.action: Steal or take the sedge hat from player monster monks if you need acid rain protection.

facts.fact: Monsters with see invisible will not misdirect their attacks towards you or another invisible monster and are not subject to the -2 to-hit penalty against invisible targets.
facts.detect: Encountering monsters with the listed names such as mind flayer, master mind flayer, black light, etc.
facts.action: Avoid engaging in combat with these monsters while invisible to prevent penalties and ensure successful attacks.

facts.fact: One possible effect of sitting on a throne with positive Luck is to gain see invisible as an intrinsic.
facts.detect: Sitting on a throne and having positive Luck.
facts.action: Sit on a throne with positive Luck to potentially gain see invisible as an intrinsic.

facts.fact: Eating a stalker corpse or tin while already invisible gives permanent see invisible and invisibility.
facts.detect: Encountering a stalker corpse or tin while invisible.
facts.action: Eat a stalker corpse or tin while invisible to gain permanent see invisible and invisibility.

facts.fact: Temporary see invisible can anger peaceful monsters that have made themselves invisible if you bump into them.
facts.detect: Bumping into invisible peaceful monsters.
facts.action: Avoid bumping into invisible peaceful monsters to prevent angering them.

facts.fact: See invisible becomes most useful during the mid-game stages when encountering stalkers and spellcasting monsters that can render themselves invisible.
facts.detect: Encountering stalkers or spellcasting monsters that can become invisible.
facts.action: Prioritize obtaining see invisible during the mid-game stages.

facts.fact: Sessile monsters have a movement speed of zero and never move of their own volition.
facts.detect: Monster names such as Oracle, spotted jelly, blue jelly, red mold, green mold, brown mold, and yellow mold.
facts.action: Leave them alone or use them to block access to certain squares.

facts.fact: Tame sessile monsters may be displaced with a 1/7 chance.
facts.detect: Tame sessile monster blocking a path.
facts.action: Try to displace the tame sessile monster if it blocks a path.

facts.fact: Killing high-level sessile monsters can be frustrating as missiles thrown at them cannot be retrieved until they are killed.
facts.detect: Missiles stuck in a sessile monster.
facts.action: Use rocks or junk to kill sessile monsters to avoid losing missiles.

facts.fact: Polymorphing into a sessile monster usually results in the polymorph time expiring or being killed by a hostile monster.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a sessile monster form.
facts.action: Avoid polymorphing into a sessile monster unless you have a way to end the polymorph safely.

facts.fact: Sessile monsters can be used to protect a boulder fort from giants.
facts.detect: Giants approaching a boulder fort.
facts.action: Place sessile monsters to block giants from reaching the boulder fort.

facts.fact: Shaktari has 6 physical weapon attacks dealing 2d4 damage each.
facts.detect: Encountering a Shaktari on the level
facts.action: Avoid or prepare for a high-damage encounter with a Shaktari by ensuring you have high AC, MR, and hitpoints.

facts.fact: Shaktari has resistances to fire, poison, and acid.
facts.detect: Attempting to attack a Shaktari with fire, poison, or acid damage
facts.action: Use physical or other elemental attacks that are not fire, poison, or acid to damage the Shaktari.

facts.fact: Shaktari has seeinvis and infravision attributes.
facts.detect: Being invisible or using a light source near a Shaktari
facts.action: Avoid being detected by a Shaktari while invisible or ensure you have a light source to avoid infravision detection.

facts.fact: Shaktari is a hostile, nasty, and slithy monster.
facts.detect: Encountering a Shaktari on the level
facts.action: Be prepared for aggressive behavior from the Shaktari and be cautious when approaching.

facts.fact: Shaktari does not leave a corpse after death.
facts.detect: Killing a Shaktari
facts.action: Be aware that no corpse will drop from a killed Shaktari, so do not rely on corpse drops for items or experience.

facts.fact: Shalosh tannah have a 1/9 chance each turn to produce 1-3 strange larvae that grow into demons.
facts.detect: Strange larvae appearing in adjacent squares
facts.action: Quickly kill the shalosh tannah to prevent larvae from growing into dangerous demons.

facts.fact: Shalosh tannah have a Reach 3d6 Flesh hook attack that traps the target, restricting movement.
facts.detect: Being hit by a flesh hook attack
facts.action: Avoid close combat and use ranged attacks or spells to damage the shalosh tannah from a distance.

facts.fact: Shalosh tannah have resistance to acid, cold, shock, poison, and petrification.
facts.detect: Attacking the shalosh tannah with acid, cold, shock, poison, or petrification-based attacks
facts.action: Use fire-based attacks or other weaknesses to damage the shalosh tannah.

facts.fact: Shalosh tannah cause host madness, periodically reducing Dexterity to 3 and causing Nauseated status.
facts.detect: Periodic Dexterity reduction and Nauseated status
facts.action: Use potions of cure sickness or other remedies to counteract the effects of host madness.

facts.fact: Shalosh tannah are amphibious and have breathless attribute.
facts.detect: Shalosh tannah moving through water or not requiring to breathe
facts.action: Be prepared for the shalosh tannah to move through water and not be affected by drowning.

facts.fact: Chameleons, doppelgangers and sandestins have a 1/6 chance of changing shape every turn, even while asleep.
facts.detect: Monster name (chameleon, doppelganger, sandestin)
facts.action: Wear a ring of protection from shape changers to force them into their normal form.

facts.fact: Werecreatures will randomly alternate between their human and animal forms, even while asleep.
facts.detect: Monster name (wererat, werejackal, werewolf)
facts.action: Wear a ring of protection from shape changers to force them into their normal form.

facts.fact: Vampires are often encountered in the form of a vampire bat and can shift to fog cloud form to cross obstacles.
facts.detect: Monster name (vampire, vampire lord)
facts.action: Wear a ring of protection from shape changers to force them into their normal form.

facts.fact: Mimics will take the appearance of various objects and dungeon features to catch the player off-guard.
facts.detect: Interacting with an object that turns out to be a mimic
facts.action: Be cautious when interacting with objects, especially in dark or unexplored areas.

facts.fact: Examining a shapeshifter with a stethoscope or probing will identify them as shapeshifters.
facts.detect: Using a stethoscope or probing on a suspicious monster
facts.action: Use a stethoscope or probing to identify shapeshifters before engaging them.

facts.fact: A shattering blow can destroy a monster's weapon with a base 2.5% chance when attacking a monster wielding a weapon.
facts.detect: 's shatters from the force of your blow!
facts.action: Continue attacking monsters with weapons to potentially destroy their weapons and scare them off.

facts.fact: To perform a shattering blow, the hero must be wielding a two-handed weapon or a katana as a Samurai, and their skill in that weapon must be at Skilled or higher.
facts.detect: Wielding a two-handed weapon or katana as a Samurai with a skill of Skilled or higher.
facts.action: Ensure you are wielding a two-handed weapon or katana and have the required skill level to maximize the chance of performing a shattering blow.

facts.fact: If a shattering blow occurs, the target's wielded weapon is destroyed unless it is flimsy or an artifact weapon.
facts.detect: 's shatters from the force of your blow!
facts.action: Target monsters with non-flimsy, non-artifact weapons to maximize the chance of destroying their weapons.

facts.fact: A shattering blow has a higher chance of occurring if the target's weapon is more eroded than the attacker's.
facts.detect: Checking the erosion level of the target's weapon compared to the attacker's.
facts.action: Target monsters with more eroded weapons to increase the chance of a shattering blow.

facts.fact: After a shattering blow, the monster will turn to flee 75% of the time and become scared for 2d3 turns.
facts.detect: Monster flees or becomes scared after the message 's shatters from the force of your blow!
facts.action: Exploit the fleeing and scared state of the monster to safely deal damage or avoid combat.

facts.fact: Wearing a shield requires a hero or monster to have hands and not be tiny in size, and is incompatible with wielding a two-handed weapon or performing two weapon combat.
facts.detect: Checking inventory and weapon type, noticing if the bot is wielding a two-handed weapon or attempting two-weapon combat.
facts.action: Avoid wearing a shield if wielding a two-handed weapon or attempting two-weapon combat.

facts.fact: Wearing any shield reduces a hero's spellcasting success rate, with the reduction dependent on the shield's weight.
facts.detect: Checking inventory for shield weight and noticing spellcasting success rate.
facts.action: Choose lighter shields to minimize spellcasting penalty.

facts.fact: The small shield, shield of shock resistance, and shield of drain resistance have the lowest spellcasting penalty.
facts.detect: Identifying the type of shield in inventory.
facts.action: Prioritize these shields if spellcasting is important.

facts.fact: The shield of reflection provides reflection, an important property for heroes not planning to utilize two-weapon combat.
facts.detect: Checking inventory for shield of reflection.
facts.action: Consider using shield of reflection if not planning to use two-weapon combat.

facts.fact: Elven shield can be enchanted to +7 and is sought out by heroes maximizing AC.
facts.detect: Checking inventory for elven shield and enchantment level.
facts.action: Use elven shield if maximizing AC and enchantment is possible.

facts.fact: A shield of drain resistance grants 1 base AC and drain resistance.
facts.detect: The bot can notice this when it is wearing the shield and is attacked by a draining monster or spell, and survives without losing experience levels or intrinsic properties.
facts.action: The bot should prioritize finding and equipping a shield of drain resistance if it encounters one, especially if it plans to fight draining monsters or use magic.

facts.fact: Shields of drain resistance make up 1.2% of all randomly generated armor.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this by noting the rarity of finding such a shield in the game.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious and save any wooden shield it finds for later identification, as it could be a shield of drain resistance.

facts.fact: The spellcasting penalty for a worn shield of drain resistance is much lower than most other shield types due to its low weight.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this by noticing a lower spellcasting penalty when wearing the shield compared to other shields.
facts.action: The bot should consider wearing the shield of drain resistance if it plans to cast spells while in combat.

facts.fact: The shield of drain resistance shares a base price of 50zm with the shield of shock resistance.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this by noting the price of the shield when it is sold or bought.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious and test the shield for drain resistance if it finds a wooden shield with a price of 50zm.

facts.fact: Grid bugs can be used to test for a shield of shock resistance with their bite.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this by encountering grid bugs and testing the shield with their bite.
facts.action: The bot should test any wooden shield it finds with grid bugs to determine if it is a shield of drain resistance or shock resistance.

facts.fact: A shield of shock resistance grants 1 base AC and shock resistance.
facts.detect: Item name: shield of shock resistance
facts.action: Equip the shield of shock resistance to gain shock resistance and protect rings and wands from shock damage.

facts.fact: Shields of shock resistance make up 1.2% of all randomly generated armor.
facts.detect: Not directly detectable, but known from the wiki.
facts.action: Prioritize finding and equipping a shield of shock resistance if you encounter one.

facts.fact: The shield of shock resistance protects rings and wands from destruction by shock damage 99% of the time.
facts.detect: Item name: shield of shock resistance
facts.action: Equip the shield of shock resistance to protect valuable rings and wands from shock damage.

facts.fact: The spellcasting penalty for a worn shield of shock resistance is much lower than most other shield types due to its low weight.
facts.detect: Item name: shield of shock resistance
facts.action: Equip the shield of shock resistance to minimize spellcasting penalty.

facts.fact: Shirts make up 1% of all randomly generated armor.
facts.detect: Randomly generated armor in the game
facts.action: If found, consider enchanting it for extra AC once magic resistance or unchanging is obtained.

facts.fact: Shirts confer no base AC on their own, but can be enchanted into a lightweight source of extra AC.
facts.detect: Enchanted shirt
facts.action: Enchant the shirt to increase AC, especially after obtaining magic resistance or unchanging.

facts.fact: Shirts are a popular target for polypiling since they are non-magical.
facts.detect: Polypiling armor
facts.action: Use polypiling to obtain shirts, especially in the Castle and Fort Ludios where there is a guaranteed amount of armor.

facts.fact: The Castle and Fort Ludios always guarantee a sufficient amount of armor, and the Castle's armor storeroom has a 13.13% chance of containing a shirt.
facts.detect: Exploring the Castle and Fort Ludios
facts.action: Focus on these locations to find shirts for polypiling.

facts.fact: Random general store items in Orcus Town may also have a shirt among them.
facts.detect: Visiting Orcus Town's general store
facts.action: Check the general store in Orcus Town for shirts.

facts.fact: Shock damage can occur from various sources including rays of lightning, shocking explosions, lightning breath weapons, lightning from an angry god, lightning from Mjollnir, container traps, and sitting on a throne.
facts.detect: Messages like 'The door splinters!', 'You get zapped!', 'You shock yourself!', 'You are jolted by a surge of electricity!', 'The of lightning hits you!', 'You are blinded by the flash!', 'Your turns to dust and vanishes!', 'Your breaks apart and explodes!', 'The air around you crackles with electricity!', 'A(n) electric shock shoots through your body!'
facts.action: Equip shock resistance or reflection to avoid damage and item destruction. Avoid using Mjollnir unless protected. Be cautious around container traps and avoid sitting on thrones.

facts.fact: Shock damage has a 1/3 chance per item of destroying rings and wands in open inventory unless the source is an engulfing attack, explosion attack, or passive attack.
facts.detect: Messages like 'Your turns to dust and vanishes!', 'Your breaks apart and explodes!'
facts.action: Keep valuable items in the backpack and avoid open inventory when facing shock damage sources.

facts.fact: Rays of lightning and shocking explosions can destroy doors.
facts.detect: Message 'The door splinters!'
facts.action: Avoid using wands of lightning near doors or use them cautiously.

facts.fact: Magic cancellation can block the effects of melee shock attacks that do not engulf targets, and cancellation disables the electric effects of most attacks.
facts.detect: Monster attacks that deal shock damage.
facts.action: Equip high magic cancellation (MC3) to block melee shock attacks.

facts.fact: Flesh golems hit by shock damage will restore an amount of HP equal to (dam + 5)/6, rounded up and capped at their maximum HP.
facts.detect: Polymorph into a flesh golem or see a flesh golem taking damage.
facts.action: If polymorphed into a flesh golem, take advantage of shock damage to heal.

facts.fact: Shock hound has a breath attack that deals 3d5 shock damage
facts.detect: A shock hound appears on the map with the symbol 'd'
facts.action: Avoid getting too close to shock hounds or use shock resistance to mitigate the breath attack

facts.fact: Shock hounds are infravision-capable
facts.detect: The shock hound is visible in dark areas due to infravision
facts.action: Be cautious in dark areas where infravision is needed to see the shock hound

facts.fact: Shock hounds are genocidable
facts.detect: The player can use the 'G' command to genocide shock hounds
facts.action: Genocide shock hounds if they are a significant threat

facts.fact: Shock hounds have a resistance to shock damage
facts.detect: The shock hound survives a shock attack that would normally be harmful
facts.action: Use other forms of damage or weapons to defeat shock hounds

facts.fact: Shock hounds are hostile and have a speed of 14
facts.detect: The shock hound moves towards the player or attacks on sight
facts.action: Stay away from shock hounds or prepare to fight them if encountered

facts.fact: Shock resistance protects against spheres, vortices, grid bugs, dragons, eels, Mjollnir, lightning bolts, and shock traps.
facts.detect: Encountering monsters or traps listed, or receiving attacks from them.
facts.action: Seek out and eat corpses or globs that grant intrinsic shock resistance, or equip extrinsic sources.

facts.fact: Intrinsic shock resistance can be obtained by eating specific corpses and globs with varying difficulty and chance.
facts.detect: Monster names like 'brown pudding', 'black pudding', 'gelatinous cube', 'flesh golem', 'Chromatic Dragon', 'electric eel', 'storm giant', and 'blue dragon'.
facts.action: Eat corpses or globs of these monsters to gain intrinsic shock resistance.

facts.fact: Extrinsic shock resistance is granted by wearing a ring of shock resistance, blue dragon scales or scale mail, or wielding a shield of shock resistance.
facts.detect: Item names like 'ring of shock resistance', 'blue dragon scales', 'blue dragon scale mail', and 'shield of shock resistance'.
facts.action: Equip these items to gain extrinsic shock resistance.

facts.fact: Extrinsic shock resistance has a 99/100 chance of protecting open inventory from shock damage.
facts.detect: Noticing that your inventory is protected from shock damage.
facts.action: Ensure you have extrinsic shock resistance equipped to protect your inventory.

facts.fact: You gain intrinsic shock resistance by eating certain corpses or tins, or by being crowned by your god.
facts.detect: Messages like 'Your health currently feels amplified.' or 'You feel grounded in reality.'
facts.action: Eat corpses or tins that grant intrinsic shock resistance or seek divine favor.

facts.fact: Shops have a base 3/DL chance of being created on any dungeon level between level 2 and Medusa's Island inclusively, with the exception of the Oracle level.
facts.detect: Presence of a shop on a level
facts.action: Explore levels for shops to buy useful items or restock on food and potions

facts.fact: Shops can be closed, indicated by the message 'Closed for inventory' outside the shop door. The door will be locked.
facts.detect: Message 'Closed for inventory' and locked door
facts.action: Find an unlocking tool or pay 400 zorkmids to enter

facts.fact: Mimics are most likely to appear in shops, disguised as items.
facts.detect: Item that looks out of place or suspicious
facts.action: Be cautious and check items before picking them up

facts.fact: Shopkeepers are 50% faster than a normal character's base speed and will keep close to their shop's entrance, making it difficult to walk out with unpaid items.
facts.detect: Shopkeeper's presence near the entrance
facts.action: Avoid stealing from shops or ensure items are paid for before leaving

facts.fact: Attempting to leave a shop with unpaid items will anger the shopkeeper, summon Keystone Kops, and add the value of the items to your debt.
facts.detect: Unpaid items in inventory
facts.action: Pay for items before leaving the shop or avoid stealing

facts.fact: If you are a Tourist below experience level 15, you are considered a 'sucker' and will be charged 3/2 more in shops.
facts.detect: Character class is Tourist and experience level is below 15.
facts.action: Avoid buying items in shops until reaching level 15 or higher.

facts.fact: If you are hungry, the price of food and comestibles is doubled; if weak from hunger, tripled; if fainting from hunger, quadrupled.
facts.detect: Player's hunger status is 'hungry', 'weak', or 'fainting'.
facts.action: Avoid buying food in shops when hungry; eat before entering shops.

facts.fact: Artifacts are bought for four times their already-inflated base cost.
facts.detect: Item is identified as an artifact.
facts.action: Avoid buying artifacts in shops; consider stealing them instead.

facts.fact: If you are invisible and do not want to wait until you are visible again, you can use a non-cursed mummy wrapping to safely enter or exit a shop.
facts.detect: Player is invisible and has a non-cursed mummy wrapping.
facts.action: Use a non-cursed mummy wrapping to safely enter or exit a shop while invisible.

facts.fact: Scrolls of scare monster turn to dust when picked up if cursed or previously picked up and dropped, incurring a charge for the destroyed item.
facts.detect: Player picks up a scroll of scare monster that turns to dust.
facts.action: Avoid picking up scrolls of scare monster in shops unless absolutely necessary.

facts.fact: Dwarvish short sword is a weapon that uses the short sword skill.
facts.detect: dwarvish short sword
facts.action: Prioritize equipping a dwarvish short sword if found, as it is a high-quality short sword specific to dwarves.

facts.fact: Short swords weigh 30 aum and have a base price of 10 zorkmids.
facts.detect: short sword, dwarvish short sword, elven short sword, orcish short sword
facts.action: Recognize the weight and value of short swords to manage inventory weight and value appropriately.

facts.fact: Food poisoning occurs if the hero eats a tainted corpse or glob, unless they are in the form of a ghoul.
facts.detect: Message: 'Ulch - that was tainted!' or 'You feel deathly sick.'
facts.action: Avoid eating corpses or globs that are old or of uncertain age. If already sick, use remedies like eucalyptus leaves, blessed unicorn horn, or prayer.

facts.fact: Illness can occur from applying a cursed unicorn horn or being hit by certain monsters' attacks.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel deathly sick.' or 'You are sick from illness.'
facts.action: Avoid cursed unicorn horns and be cautious around monsters like Juiblex, Demogorgon, Pestilence, and Scorpius. Use remedies like eucalyptus leaves, blessed unicorn horn, or prayer.

facts.fact: Sickness can be cured by applying a non-cursed unicorn horn, quaffing a blessed potion of healing or extra/full healing, praying, casting cure sickness spell, eating eucalyptus leaves, vomiting for food poisoning, invoking the Staff of Aesculapius, polymorphing into a ghoul/fungus/mold, or being hit by a nurse's attack.
facts.detect: Status line or enlightenment message indicating sickness.
facts.action: Carry eucalyptus leaves, blessed unicorn horn, potions of healing, and have the cure sickness spell ready. Keep a bag of holding with spare potions and remedies.

facts.fact: Sitting on a throne has a 1/3 chance of curing sickness.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel much, much better.'
facts.action: Sit on a throne if available and feeling sick.

facts.fact: Green dragon scale mail grants immunity to illness in NetHack 3.7.0.
facts.detect: Not applicable in 3.6.7
facts.action: Not applicable in 3.6.7

facts.fact: Silver-hating monsters will not pick up silver weapons or armor, but will pick up other silver items.
facts.detect: Silver-hating monsters ignoring silver weapons or armor but picking up other silver items like silver wands of speed monster.
facts.action: Use silver weapons and armor against silver-hating monsters to deal extra damage.

facts.fact: Creatures vulnerable to silver are called silver-hating monsters, including all Vampires, Shades, major and minor demons (except tengu), and lycanthropes.
facts.detect: Encountering monsters like Vampires, Shades, major and minor demons, and lycanthropes.
facts.action: Equip silver weapons and armor to deal extra damage to these monsters.

facts.fact: Silver weapons deal an extra d20 damage to silver-hating monsters.
facts.detect: Attacking silver-hating monsters with silver weapons.
facts.action: Ensure silver weapons are used against silver-hating monsters for maximum damage.

facts.fact: Silver arrows deal silver damage only if shot from a bow.
facts.detect: Using silver arrows from a bow.
facts.action: Use silver arrows from a bow for silver damage against silver-hating monsters.

facts.fact: You are vulnerable to silver if polymorphed into a silver-hating monster or affected by lycanthropy.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a silver-hating monster or being affected by lycanthropy.
facts.action: Avoid silver items and weapons if vulnerable to silver damage.

facts.fact: Silver dragon scale mail (SDSM) confers reflection and base AC of 9.
facts.detect: Item name: silver dragon scale mail
facts.action: Equip silver dragon scale mail to gain reflection and high AC.

facts.fact: Uncontrolled polymorph while wearing SDSM will revert them to scales and turn the wearer into a silver dragon.
facts.detect: Message: You feel a strange tingling sensation.
facts.action: Avoid uncontrolled polymorphs while wearing SDSM.

facts.fact: Silver dragon scale mail is one of the two most coveted types of dragon scale mail, with the other being gray dragon scale mail.
facts.detect: Item name: silver dragon scale mail
facts.action: Prioritize obtaining silver dragon scale mail for its reflection and AC.

facts.fact: Reflection protects from rays but not touch of death spell.
facts.detect: Message: You feel a sudden chill.
facts.action: Ensure magic resistance before encountering high-level hostile spellcasters.

facts.fact: Silver dragon scale mail keeps the amulet and shield slots free.
facts.detect: Item name: silver dragon scale mail
facts.action: Equip silver dragon scale mail to keep amulet and shield slots open.

facts.fact: Silver dragon scales have an AC of 3 and provide reflection.
facts.detect: Item name: silver dragon scales
facts.action: Equip silver dragon scales for their AC and reflection properties.

facts.fact: Silver dragon scales can be wished for or found in bones.
facts.detect: Item name: silver dragon scales in bones level or wish list
facts.action: Wish for or seek out silver dragon scales if available.

facts.fact: A silver dragon has a 1/3 chance of leaving behind dragon scales upon death.
facts.detect: Monster name: silver dragon corpse
facts.action: Search for silver dragon corpses to find scales.

facts.fact: Reading a non-cursed scroll of enchant armor on silver dragon scales converts them into silver dragon scale mail.
facts.detect: Item name: silver dragon scales, scroll of enchant armor
facts.action: Use a scroll of enchant armor on silver dragon scales to upgrade them.

facts.fact: Uncontrolled polymorph while wearing silver dragon scales will turn the wearer into a silver dragon.
facts.detect: Message: You feel a strange transformation coming over you.
facts.action: Avoid uncontrolled polymorph while wearing silver dragon scales.

facts.fact: Dropping rings into a sink will cause them to be lost down the drain, with a message that enables you to identify the ring.
facts.detect: Message indicating the ring type after dropping it into the sink
facts.action: Drop rings into the sink to identify them

facts.fact: Kicking a sink can summon a black pudding, which is dangerous but slow enough to avoid if you are careful.
facts.detect: Message 'A black ooze gushes up from the drain!'
facts.action: Avoid kicking sinks if you are at low experience levels

facts.fact: Kicking a sink can summon a foocubus of opposite sex to the hero, which can be beneficial if you can control it.
facts.detect: Message 'The dishwasher returns!'
facts.action: Be prepared to deal with a foocubus if you kick a sink

facts.fact: Quaffing from a sink can produce a random uncursed potion, which can have various effects depending on the potion type.
facts.detect: Message indicating the quaffing outcome
facts.action: Avoid quaffing from sinks unless you are prepared for potential negative effects

facts.fact: Quaffing from a sink can produce a ring, which is a potential reward but also risky due to other possible outcomes.
facts.detect: Message 'You find a ring in the sink!'
facts.action: Consider kicking the sink instead of quaffing to get a ring

facts.fact: Sister has a difficulty of 12 and level 9, with 201 experience points.
facts.detect: Encounter a sister on the level 9 or higher.
facts.action: Prioritize killing the sister for experience and loot, but be cautious due to her difficulty level.

facts.fact: Sister has a resistance to sleep.
facts.detect: Attempt to put the sister to sleep.
facts.action: Avoid using sleep spells or items on the sister.

facts.fact: Sister can see invisible creatures.
facts.detect: The sister does not react to your invisibility.
facts.action: Do not rely on invisibility to avoid the sister.

facts.fact: Sister is a peaceful monster.
facts.detect: The sister does not attack you initially.
facts.action: Avoid provoking the sister unless necessary.

facts.fact: Sister is collectable.
facts.detect: The sister is present on the level.
facts.action: Consider collecting the sister for later use or sacrifice.

facts.fact: A hero will fail to sit with no effect if they are riding.
facts.detect: You are already sitting on mount.
facts.action: Dismount before attempting to sit.

facts.fact: A hero will fail to sit with no effect if they are levitating.
facts.detect: You tumble in place.
facts.action: Land before attempting to sit.

facts.fact: A hero will fail to sit with no effect if they are engulfed.
facts.detect: There are no seats in here!
facts.action: Escape engulfment before attempting to sit.

facts.fact: A hero will fail to sit with no effect if they are being held or are stuck to a monster.
facts.detect: won't offer lap.
facts.action: Free yourself from the monster before attempting to sit.

facts.fact: A hero will fail to sit with no effect if they are on the Plane of Water.
facts.detect: There are no cushions floating nearby.
facts.action: Do not attempt to sit on the Plane of Water.

facts.fact: Most skills in NetHack have four possible levels: Unskilled, Basic, Skilled and Expert.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the situation by checking its skill level in the 'enhance' command menu.
facts.action: The bot should enhance its weapon and spellcasting skills to Basic or higher to improve combat effectiveness and reduce failure rates.

facts.fact: Weapon-based skills use twice as many skill slots as unarmed and non-weapon-based skills.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the situation by checking its skill slots and the number of successful uses required to advance a skill.
facts.action: The bot should prioritize enhancing non-weapon skills first to conserve skill slots for weapon skills.

facts.fact: Heroes with weapons of a certain skill class in their inventory will start with Basic skill level in that skill.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the situation by checking its inventory for weapons and the corresponding skill level in the 'enhance' command menu.
facts.action: The bot should enhance its weapon skills to Basic or higher to improve combat effectiveness.

facts.fact: Spellcasting skills are trained by successfully casting a spell, and increase the 'use' counter by an amount equal to the spell's level.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the situation by checking its spellcasting skills and the number of successful uses required to advance a skill.
facts.action: The bot should cast spells to train its spellcasting skills and enhance them to Basic or higher to reduce failure rates.

facts.fact: A hero's riding skill affects their ability to apply a saddle to an eligible steed, as well as their to-hit and damage for attacks made while they are mounted.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the situation by checking its riding skill level and whether it can apply a saddle to a steed or attack while mounted.
facts.action: The bot should enhance its riding skill to Basic or higher to improve its ability to apply a saddle and attack while mounted.

facts.fact: A hero that is asleep cannot move for the duration of the status, and their normal rate of nutrition burn is decreased by 9/10.
facts.detect: The bot notices it is unable to move and receives messages indicating it is dreaming.
facts.action: The bot should try to avoid falling asleep by using sleep resistance or free action if available.

facts.fact: A monster attacking the hero has a 1/10 chance per attack of waking them up.
facts.detect: The bot notices it is attacked by a monster.
facts.action: The bot should try to avoid being attacked by monsters while asleep.

facts.fact: A lawful Knight attacking a sleeping monster takes a -1 penalty to alignment record.
facts.detect: The bot is a lawful Valkyrie and notices it is attacking a sleeping monster.
facts.action: The bot should avoid attacking sleeping monsters to maintain alignment.

facts.fact: A sleeping monster will wake up if attacked by another monster, unless the sleep was applied through magic or an attack.
facts.detect: The bot notices another monster attacking a sleeping monster.
facts.action: The bot should avoid situations where other monsters can attack sleeping monsters.

facts.fact: Nymphs, jabberwocks, and leprechauns have a 50% chance of waking up on each move if the hero is in their line of sight and within a 10-square radius.
facts.detect: The bot notices it is near a nymph, jabberwock, or leprechaun that is asleep.
facts.action: The bot should move stealthily or avoid these monsters to prevent them from waking up.

facts.fact: Sleep resistance prevents being put to sleep by various means including wands of sleep, potions of sleeping, sleeping gas traps, orange dragons' breath attacks, wearing an amulet of restful sleep, or reading a dull spellbook.
facts.detect: Messages such as 'You feel wide awake.', 'You feel awake!', 'You yawn. You don't feel sleepy.', 'You are enveloped in a cloud of gas!'
facts.action: Eat corpses or tins of certain monsters to gain sleep resistance if not an elf or monk. For elves, reach level 4 to gain intrinsic sleep resistance.

facts.fact: Eating a corpse or tin of an elf (67% chance) or other listed monsters can grant sleep resistance.
facts.detect: Messages such as 'You feel wide awake.' after eating a corpse or tin.
facts.action: Eat corpses or tins of listed monsters to gain sleep resistance.

facts.fact: Elves gain sleep resistance at level 4.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel awake!' when reaching level 4 as an elf.
facts.action: Continue playing as an elf to gain sleep resistance at level 4.

facts.fact: Sleep resistance can be lost through level drain.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel tired!' after level drain.
facts.action: Avoid level drain by not engaging in risky behavior or using items that cause level drain.

facts.fact: Orange dragons have a 100% chance to grant sleep resistance when eaten.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel wide awake.' after eating an orange dragon corpse or tin.
facts.action: Eat orange dragon corpse or tin to gain sleep resistance.

facts.fact: A sleeping gas trap puts you to sleep for up to 25 turns, unless you have sleep resistance or are polymorphed into a naturally breathless monster.
facts.detect: A cloud of gas puts you to sleep!
facts.action: Carry a wakefulness potion or use a wand of wakefulness to counteract the effect.

facts.fact: Monsters, including your steed, are also subject to the trap's effect.
facts.detect: suddenly falls asleep!
facts.action: Avoid riding a steed near sleeping gas traps or dismount before approaching them.

facts.fact: Dig a pit into the ground while standing on the trap, then fill the pit.
facts.detect: Standing on a sleeping gas trap.
facts.action: Dig a pit to remove the trap.

facts.fact: Sliming transforms a hero into a green slime in nine turns, shortened to four if the hero has digested a green slime.
facts.detect: Messages: 'You don't feel very well.', 'You are turning a little green.', 'Your limbs are getting oozy.', 'Your skin begins to peel away.', 'You are turning into a green slime.'
facts.action: Immediately use a source of fire damage to burn away the slime (e.g., wand of fire, scroll of fire, fire trap, flaming sphere, fire breath).

facts.fact: Monsters that can breathe fire will burn away the slime when afflicted.
facts.detect: Monster with fire breath (e.g., salamander, fire elemental).
facts.action: If slimed, transform into a fiery monster or use fire breath to burn away the slime.

facts.fact: Prayer can remove slime outside of Gehennom.
facts.detect: Being outside of Gehennom and slimed.
facts.action: Pray to remove the sliming effect.

facts.fact: An amulet of unchanging will immediately abort the sliming process.
facts.detect: Possession of an amulet of unchanging.
facts.action: Wear the amulet of unchanging if slimed.

facts.fact: Controlled polymorphing into a fiery monster renders the hero immune to subsequent sliming attacks.
facts.detect: Possession of controlled polymorph.
facts.action: Polymorph into a fiery monster (e.g., salamander) if slimed.

facts.fact: The sling is the only launcher weapon to use the sling skill.
facts.detect: Weapon type: launcher
facts.action: Use a sling to train the skill and fire rocks or gem objects.

facts.fact: Firing rocks and other gem objects from a sling uses and trains the skill.
facts.detect: Item type: rock or gem
facts.action: Use rocks or gem objects as ammunition in the sling.

facts.fact: They can be multishot.
facts.detect: Aiming at multiple targets
facts.action: Aim at multiple targets to use multishot.

facts.fact: Artifact stones and gems can be fired from a sling.
facts.detect: Artifact stone or gem in inventory
facts.action: Use artifact stones or gems as ammunition in the sling.

facts.fact: The Heart of Ahriman deals slightly more damage when slung, though doing so is typically a bad idea.
facts.detect: Heart of Ahriman in inventory
facts.action: Avoid using the Heart of Ahriman as ammunition in the sling.

facts.fact: Slithy monsters have no legs, so they cannot kick, wear boots, ride a steed, or jump (except with the spell of jumping).
facts.detect: Monster name from the list of slithy monsters (e.g., Wraith, Couatl, Nymph, Salamander, Marilith, Geryon)
facts.action: Avoid engaging in combat that relies on kicking or jumping. Do not attempt to wear boots or ride a steed against slithy monsters.

facts.fact: A slithy monster which is medium or smaller in physical size can move through iron bars.
facts.detect: Iron bars on the map and a slithy monster of medium or smaller size (e.g., Wraith, Nymph)
facts.action: Be cautious when near iron bars as slithy monsters of medium or smaller size can pass through them, potentially trapping you or allowing them to escape.

facts.fact: Slow digestion nullifies the ordinary consumption of one nutrition point per turn.
facts.detect: You have slower digestion.
facts.action: Wear the ring of slow digestion to prevent normal hunger.

facts.fact: If a monster attempts to engulf and digest you while you have slow digestion, you will be expelled immediately.
facts.detect: You get regurgitated!
facts.action: Wear the ring of slow digestion to avoid being digested by monsters.

facts.fact: Putting on a source of slow digestion while being digested will also cause that monster to spit you out.
facts.detect: You get regurgitated!
facts.action: Wear the ring of slow digestion if you are being digested by a monster.

facts.fact: Having slow digestion while polymorphed into a monster with a digestion attack will prevent you from digesting enemies; monsters you engulf will be regurgitated instead.
facts.detect: You get regurgitated!
facts.action: Wear the ring of slow digestion if polymorphed into a monster with a digestion attack to avoid digesting enemies.

facts.fact: A hero hit by a slowing attack has a 1/4 chance of losing intrinsic speed and any temporary boosts to speed, which also affects dexterity.
facts.detect: Messages such as 'You feel slower.' or 'You feel less quick.'
facts.action: Carry extra sources of speed such as a wand of speed monster or a tin of quantum mechanic meat.

facts.fact: Monsters hit by a slowing attack will always have their speed affected: fast monsters return to normal speed, and normal-speed monsters become abnormally slow.
facts.detect: Observing the speed change in monsters after they are hit by a slowing attack.
facts.action: Use this to your advantage by targeting fast monsters to slow them down.

facts.fact: Magic cancellation can block the effects (but not damage) of slowing attacks if they also block the attack type.
facts.detect: Equipping magic cancellation and noticing that the slowing effect is blocked.
facts.action: Equip magic cancellation if you expect to encounter slowing attacks.

facts.fact: Monsters with slowing attacks include skeletons (touch attack), shades (touch attack), and beholders (gaze attack).
facts.detect: Encountering these monsters in the game.
facts.action: Be prepared with speed-restoring items when facing these monsters.

facts.fact: You can smell monsters only if you are not polymorphed into any blob, sphere, jelly, vortex, light, elemental, fungus, or pudding.
facts.detect: None, this is a general rule.
facts.action: Avoid polymorphing into any of the listed forms if you want to detect monsters by smell.

facts.fact: You notice a bovine smell.
facts.detect: Message: You notice a bovine smell.
facts.action: Prepare to fight a rothe or minotaur.

facts.fact: You smell steam.
facts.detect: Message: You smell steam.
facts.action: Prepare to fight a steam vortex.

facts.fact: You smell fish.
facts.detect: Message: You smell fish.
facts.action: Prepare to fight a sea monster.

facts.fact: The smells like it could be tainted!
facts.detect: Message: The smells like it could be tainted!
facts.action: Do not eat the food item.

facts.fact: Quaffing a smoky potion has a 1/(13 + 2n) chance of producing a djinni, where n is the number of djinn created in the game.
facts.detect: Quaffing a smoky potion and seeing a djinni appear.
facts.action: Bless smoky potions before quaffing to increase the chance of getting a wish.

facts.fact: Blessed smoky potions have a 4/(65 + 10n) chance of granting a wish.
facts.detect: Quaffing a blessed smoky potion and seeing a djinni appear.
facts.action: Prioritize blessing and quaffing smoky potions to maximize wish chances.

facts.fact: Milky potions have a 1/(13 + 2n) chance of summoning a hostile ghost.
facts.detect: Quaffing a milky potion and being paralyzed for 3 turns.
facts.action: Avoid quaffing milky potions unless absolutely necessary or in a safe environment.

facts.fact: Quaffing a milky potion renders the player immobile for 3 turns unless blind.
facts.detect: Quaffing a milky potion and being unable to move.
facts.action: Blind yourself before quaffing milky potions to avoid paralysis.

facts.fact: Smoky potions of healing or extra healing should be alchemized to full healing instead of quaffed.
facts.detect: Identifying a smoky potion as healing or extra healing.
