facts.action: Alchemize smoky potions of healing or extra healing to full healing.

facts.fact: All snakes are neutral-aligned carnivorous and oviparous animals that naturally have slithy bodies with no limbs.
facts.detect: Encountering a snake (S) on the map.
facts.action: Be cautious as snakes can inflict poison damage, especially pit vipers, water moccasins, pythons, and cobras.

facts.fact: Snakes with poisonous bites have corpses that are also poisonous.
facts.detect: Killing a snake and seeing the message 'You feel sick.' or similar.
facts.action: Do not eat the corpse of a poisonous snake.

facts.fact: Tridents have a +2 to-hit bonus against snakes that are not currently on a water square.
facts.detect: Equipping a trident and encountering a snake on a non-water square.
facts.action: Use a trident for better combat effectiveness against snakes.

facts.fact: Playing a wooden flute has a chance of pacifying nearby snakes based on dexterity and the hero's experience level.
facts.detect: Playing a wooden flute near snakes.
facts.action: Use a wooden flute to pacify snakes for easier combat or to avoid fights.

facts.fact: Randomly generated snake monsters are always created hostile with the exception of the garter snake, which may generate as peaceful for neutral heroes.
facts.detect: Encountering a garter snake (S) that does not attack.
facts.action: Approach a peaceful garter snake cautiously to avoid provoking it.

facts.fact: Boulders cannot be pushed diagonally.
facts.detect: Attempting to push a boulder diagonally
facts.action: Move boulders only orthogonally (north, south, east, west).

facts.fact: Monsters will not zap a wand of digging and potentially ruin the puzzle.
facts.detect: Monsters attempting to zap a wand of digging
facts.action: Prevent monsters from zapping wands of digging by killing them or using a magic whistle to keep them away.

facts.fact: Level teleportation does not work, and will not work even after the level is solved.
facts.detect: Attempting to teleport
facts.action: Do not attempt to teleport in Sokoban.

facts.fact: Every level is fully mapped upon arrival.
facts.detect: Arriving on a Sokoban level
facts.action: Immediately map the entire level.

facts.fact: There are two guaranteed scrolls of earth on the first level.
facts.detect: Finding scrolls of earth
facts.action: Use scrolls of earth to summon boulders if needed, but be cautious.

facts.fact: The first level of Sokoban is often used as a stash level due to its location and safety.
facts.detect: The level is free of monsters and has a long corridor.
facts.action: Store excess items and equipment on this level for later use.

facts.fact: Monsters will avoid stepping on or touching the items in Sokoban, preventing abuse via pets.
facts.detect: Monsters avoid the items in Sokoban.
facts.action: Do not rely on pets to retrieve items in Sokoban.

facts.fact: Sokoban luck penalties can only lower luck to a minimum of -3 in NetHack Fourk.
facts.detect: Luck penalty message in Sokoban.
facts.action: Continue playing Sokoban even with luck penalties.

facts.fact: Completing Sokoban without cheating grants one experience level in NetHack Fourk.
facts.detect: Completion of Sokoban.
facts.action: Complete Sokoban to gain an experience level.

facts.fact: Perseus's statue always contains the shield of reflection and the sack in NetHack Fourk.
facts.detect: Perseus's statue in Sokoban.
facts.action: Retrieve the shield of reflection and sack from Perseus's statue.

facts.fact: This version of the third level of Sokoban has 16 boulders and 11 holes.
facts.detect: Counting boulders and holes on the map.
facts.action: Follow the strategy provided to move boulders into holes.

facts.fact: The strategy provided shows a sequence of moves to clear the level.
facts.detect: Following the sequence of moves (e.g., 'Nddrr*') provided in the strategy.
facts.action: Execute the sequence of moves to clear boulders into holes.

facts.fact: After clearing boulders, check for wands or rings.
facts.detect: Exploring the cleared area after all boulders are in holes.
facts.action: Search for wands or rings in the cleared area.

facts.fact: The level is finished when all boulders are in holes.
facts.detect: All boulders are moved into holes and removed from the map.
facts.action: Proceed to the next level.

facts.fact: After this level, you will face either of the following levels.
facts.detect: Reaching the end of level 3a.
facts.action: Prepare for either level 4a or 4b, which may contain a bag of holding or an amulet of reflection.

facts.fact: There are 13 boulders and 10 holes, leaving 3 spare boulders.
facts.detect: Counting boulders and holes on the map.
facts.action: Ensure that 3 boulders remain unplaced in holes to avoid getting stuck.

facts.fact: The level is finished when all boulders are placed in holes or left in movable positions.
facts.detect: Completion of the Sokoban puzzle as described in the strategy section.
facts.action: Follow the strategy to clear the level and check under and behind unmoved boulders for usable items.

facts.fact: After completing Sokoban Level 3b, the next level is either 4a or 4b with different prizes.
facts.detect: Reaching the downstairs and entering the next level.
facts.action: Prepare for the next level by checking for the presence of a bag of holding or an amulet of reflection.

facts.fact: The strategy section provides a step-by-step guide to solving the level.
facts.detect: Following the exact moves described in the strategy section.
facts.action: Use the provided strategy to solve the level efficiently.

facts.fact: Clearing the top room is the hardest part of the level.
facts.detect: Reaching the top room and encountering boulders E, F, and D.
facts.action: Push E up and enter the top room by moving D down to remove F and then E.

facts.fact: Behind the holes is a treasure zoo with three doors, one of which contains the branch prize (bag of holding or amulet of reflection).
facts.detect: Upon entering the treasure zoo area and seeing three doors.
facts.action: Explore the treasure zoo and open each door to find the prize.

facts.fact: There are 18 boulders and 16 holes, leaving 2 spare boulders.
facts.detect: Counting the boulders and holes on the map.
facts.action: Ensure that all boulders are moved into holes, leaving exactly 2 boulders.

facts.fact: The map includes specific boulder and hole positions, with a suggested strategy for moving boulders.
facts.detect: Following the map layout and boulder/hole positions.
facts.action: Follow the suggested strategy to move boulders into holes without leaving any in an immobile position.

facts.fact: Behind one of the doors in the treasure zoo is a square with the prize item atop a burnt 'Elbereth' and a cursed scroll of scare monster.
facts.detect: Opening the door and seeing the burnt 'Elbereth' and cursed scroll.
facts.action: Pick up the prize item and avoid using the cursed scroll.

facts.fact: Check under the boulders O and Q for possible usable items.
facts.detect: Moving boulders O and Q.
facts.action: Inspect the area under boulders O and Q for any items.

facts.fact: Behind the holes is a treasure zoo with three doors - inside one of the doors is the branch prize, which has an equal chance of being a bag of holding or an amulet of reflection.
facts.detect: Entering the treasure zoo and finding a door with a burnt 'Elbereth' and a cursed scroll of scare monster.
facts.action: Open the doors in the treasure zoo to find the branch prize and take it.

facts.fact: There are 20 boulders and 18 holes, leaving two spare boulders.
facts.detect: Counting the number of boulders and holes on the map.
facts.action: Push boulders into holes to clear the level, leaving two boulders unplaced.

facts.fact: The general strategy for this level is to enter through the right room into the middle of the left room.
facts.detect: Starting position marked with '@' and the layout of the level.
facts.action: Follow the strategy to move boulders as described to clear the level.

facts.fact: In the large room behind the door is a treasure zoo. Behind one of the three doors in the zoo is a square with the prize item atop a burnt 'Elbereth' and a cursed scroll of scare monster.
facts.detect: Entering the treasure zoo and finding a door with a burnt 'Elbereth' and a cursed scroll of scare monster.
facts.action: Open the door carefully and take the prize item.

facts.fact: Also remember to check under boulder S for usable items.
facts.detect: Boulder S on the map.
facts.action: Move boulder S to check for usable items underneath.

facts.fact: Solid rock is the primary terrain type in most dungeon levels.
facts.detect: Map features showing walls or barriers that cannot be crossed.
facts.action: Carry a pick-axe or dwarvish mattock to dig through solid rock.

facts.fact: Monsters and the hero cannot cross solid rock without phasing.
facts.detect: Encountering a wall or barrier that blocks movement.
facts.action: Use a digging tool or spell to pass through solid rock.

facts.fact: The Eyes of the Overworld allow seeing through solid rock, but also makes the hero visible to monsters.
facts.detect: Wearing The Eyes of the Overworld.
facts.action: Use The Eyes of the Overworld cautiously to avoid unwanted visibility to monsters.

facts.fact: A non-blessed digging tool used in the Plane of Earth causes a cave-in.
facts.detect: Attempting to dig with a non-blessed tool in the Plane of Earth.
facts.action: Avoid using non-blessed digging tools in the Plane of Earth to prevent cave-ins.

facts.fact: Passageways from vaults opened by guards close after the guard disappears or is killed.
facts.detect: Encountering a closed passageway that was previously open.
facts.action: Be cautious when exploring vaults opened by guards to avoid being trapped.

facts.fact: Spear weapons have an additional +2 to-hit bonus when thrown and can be multishot.
facts.detect: Weapon name (spear, dwarvish spear, elven spear, orcish spear, silver spear, javelin)
facts.action: Use spears for throwing to maximize damage and accuracy.

facts.fact: Spears of all kinds make up 9.7% of all weapons that are randomly generated on the ground, in general shops or as death drops.
facts.detect: Finding spears in the game world
facts.action: Prioritize picking up spears when found.

facts.fact: Spear weapons have a separate +2 to-hit bonus against kebabable monster classes.
facts.detect: Monster name or description indicating it is kebabable
facts.action: Target kebabable monsters with spears for increased accuracy.

facts.fact: Cave Dwellers get a +1 multishot bonus for throwing spears of any kind.
facts.detect: Character role is Cave Dweller
facts.action: Exploit multishot bonus by throwing spears frequently.

facts.fact: A shop can appear from dungeon level 2 with a frequency of 3/DL, but it must be above Medusa's Island and have 1 door and no stairs.
facts.detect: Shop
facts.action: Explore shops for useful items and gold, but be cautious of traps and shopkeepers.

facts.fact: A throne room can appear from dungeon level 5 with a frequency of 1/6.
facts.detect: Throne room
facts.action: Throne rooms often contain valuable items and a high-level monster, approach with caution.

facts.fact: A leprechaun hall can appear from dungeon level 6 with a frequency of 1/8, but only if leprechauns are not genocided/extinct.
facts.detect: Leprechaun hall
facts.action: Leprechaun halls contain leprechauns and their gold, be prepared for traps and curses.

facts.fact: A zoo can appear from dungeon level 7 with a frequency of 1/7.
facts.detect: Zoo
facts.action: Zoos contain dangerous animals, be prepared for combat and avoid traps.

facts.fact: A temple can appear from dungeon level 9 with a frequency of 1/5.
facts.detect: Temple
facts.action: Temples can be dangerous due to priests and traps, but also offer blessings and sacrifices.

facts.fact: A hero's speed is either normal, fast or very fast depending on the following factors: Fast speed is obtained from the permanent 'speed' intrinsic. It grants a free move (or 12 extra movement points) on 1/3 of the hero's turns, for an average of 4 moves every 3 turns (or an average of 16 movement points per turn).
facts.detect: Message 'You speed up.' or 'You slow down.'
facts.action: Gain intrinsic speed by zapping wand of speed monster or wearing speed boots to gain very fast speed.

facts.fact: A hero can lose intrinsic speed if they are subjected to delayed stoning, are hit by a slowing attack, or else zap themselves with the wand of slow monster or the spell of slow monster.
facts.detect: Message 'You slow down.'
facts.action: Avoid delayed stoning, slowing attacks, and do not zap wand of slow monster or cast slow monster spell on self.

facts.fact: A hero that is riding a monster has their speed set to that of the steed's monster type, e.g. a hero riding a horse moves at 20 speed, while a hero riding a warhorse moves at 24 speed.
facts.detect: Riding a horse or warhorse
facts.action: Ride a warhorse for maximum speed.

facts.fact: A hero that is polymorphed has their speed set to that of the monster they are polymorphed to, and their base speed mechanics allow them to get more potential movements per turn.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a fast monster form
facts.action: Polymorph into a fast monster form like air elemental for maximum speed.

facts.fact: A hero can toggle intrinsic speed by eating a quantum mechanic corpse or tin.
facts.detect: Eating quantum mechanic corpse or tin
facts.action: Eat quantum mechanic corpse or tin to toggle intrinsic speed as needed.

facts.fact: Valkyries start with 20,000 turns of knowledge for the spells taught by their initial spellbooks.
facts.detect: Starting inventory includes spellbooks.
facts.action: Use the knowledge of spells to cast them when needed.

facts.fact: Spellbooks are represented by the plus sign (+) glyph, which is shared with closed doors and the Rogue level doorways.
facts.detect: Glyph of + on the map.
facts.action: Be cautious when approaching + glyphs to avoid opening closed doors or entering Rogue level doorways.

facts.fact: Spellbooks make up 4% of all items randomly generated on the ground in the Dungeons of Doom.
facts.detect: Randomly generated items on the ground.
facts.action: Prioritize picking up spellbooks as they can be useful for spellcasting.

facts.fact: A hero that successfully prays while in good standing with their deity may be given a blessed spellbook as a gift.
facts.detect: Praying while in good standing with deity.
facts.action: Pray to receive a blessed spellbook as a gift.

facts.fact: Spellbooks other than novels and spellbooks of blank paper are magical items and can be eaten by a gelatinous cube.
facts.detect: Encounter with a gelatinous cube.
facts.action: Do not let a gelatinous cube eat spellbooks in inventory or on the ground.

facts.fact: Spellbook of cure blindness has a 2.5% relative probability and 11.1% probability conditional on price
facts.detect: Spellbook of cure blindness in inventory
facts.action: Read the spellbook if blind or expecting to become blind soon

facts.fact: Spellbook of cure sickness has a 3.2% relative probability and 13.2% probability conditional on price
facts.detect: Spellbook of cure sickness in inventory
facts.action: Read the spellbook if sick or expecting to become sick soon

facts.fact: Spellbook of extra healing has a 2.7% relative probability and 11.2% probability conditional on price
facts.detect: Spellbook of extra healing in inventory
facts.action: Read the spellbook if in need of healing

facts.fact: Spellbook of stone to flesh has a 1.5% relative probability and 6.2% probability conditional on price
facts.detect: Spellbook of stone to flesh in inventory
facts.action: Read the spellbook if encountering stone-to-flesh monsters or objects

facts.fact: Spellbook of restore ability has a 2.5% relative probability and 21.7% probability conditional on price
facts.detect: Spellbook of restore ability in inventory
facts.action: Read the spellbook if attributes are below peak

facts.fact: A spellbook of identify requires a marker with at least 15 charges to attempt writing, but the actual writing process can use anywhere from 15 to 29 charges each time.
facts.detect: Checking the charges on a magic marker and the appearance of a spellbook of identify.
facts.action: Use a magic marker with at least 29 charges to ensure successful writing of a spellbook of identify.

facts.fact: If the hero attempts to write an unknown spellbook, their chance of success depends on their current luck and is further improved if they know the spell.
facts.detect: Checking the hero's luck and whether they know the spell.
facts.action: Maximize luck and ensure knowledge of the spell before attempting to write an unknown spellbook.

facts.fact: Reading a non-blessed spellbook can result in losing the book, being teleported to a random location on the level while immobile, or awakening a deadly or annoying monster.
facts.detect: Reading a non-blessed spellbook and observing the outcome.
facts.action: Ensure a spellbook is blessed before reading it to avoid negative outcomes.

facts.fact: Cursed spellbooks can be deliberately read for guaranteed teleportation without using up other resources.
facts.detect: Identifying a cursed spellbook and determining its level.
facts.action: Deliberately read a cursed spellbook of a level 1 spell for guaranteed teleportation.

facts.fact: Safely reading spellbooks of up to level 5 can be done by locking oneself in a closet with Elbereth engraved on the floor and dropping gold on the floor.
facts.detect: Identifying the level of a spellbook and ensuring the hero is in a safe location.
facts.action: Use a safe location like a closet with Elbereth to read spellbooks of up to level 5.

facts.fact: Casting spells requires a certain amount of energy and nutrition proportionate to the spell's level. Failing to cast a spell correctly uses up only half of the casting cost.
facts.detect: Checking the hero's energy and nutrition levels before casting a spell.
facts.action: Avoid casting spells when energy or nutrition is low to prevent wasting resources.

facts.fact: Wearing metallic armor significantly increases the chance of spell failure. Wearing a robe can reduce this penalty.
facts.detect: Checking the hero's inventory for metallic armor or a robe.
facts.action: Remove metallic armor or wear a robe before attempting to cast spells.

facts.fact: Casting spells requires at least one free hand. Cursed weapons or shields in both hands prevent spellcasting.
facts.detect: Checking the hero's inventory for cursed weapons or shields.
facts.action: Remove cursed items from both hands before attempting to cast spells.

facts.fact: The Amulet of Yendor drains energy when attempting to cast a spell, potentially preventing the spell from being cast.
facts.detect: Checking if the hero is carrying the Amulet of Yendor.
facts.action: Avoid casting spells while carrying the Amulet of Yendor to prevent energy drain.

facts.fact: Forgotten spells can cause confusion and/or stunning when cast. The exact effects depend on the level of the forgotten spell.
facts.detect: Checking the hero's spell list for forgotten spells marked with an asterisk.
facts.action: Avoid casting forgotten spells to prevent confusion and stunning.

facts.fact: A spell damage bonus based on intelligence (INT) and experience level (XL) is used in most attack spell damage calculations.
facts.detect: The bot's INT and XL levels
facts.action: Ensure high INT and XL for better spell damage

facts.fact: Each spell has its own damage calculations that usually include this bonus in some manner.
facts.detect: Spell names like 'Force bolt', 'Drain life', 'Magic missile', 'Cone of cold', 'Fireball'
facts.action: Use high INT and XL spells for more damage

facts.fact: The three primary methods to improve your spellcasting rates are: Increasing the relevant spellcasting attribute, Increase your skill in the desired spell school(s), Wear armor appropriate to your role's spellcasting abilities.
facts.detect: Bot's spellcasting attribute, skill level, and armor type
facts.action: Optimize spellcasting attribute, skill, and armor

facts.fact: With a base success chance of 120%, your spellcasting penalty (Base modified by armor) must be 6 or less to achieve an overall 100% success chance.
facts.detect: Bot's spellcasting penalty
facts.action: Wear appropriate armor to reduce spellcasting penalty

facts.fact: Spells are much easier to cast when their difficulty is zero or less. The following table lists the most difficult spell level that is still considered easy given a set of particular experience and skill levels.
facts.detect: Bot's experience level and skill level
facts.action: Cast spells within the difficulty range for best success rate

facts.fact: Spiked pits deal 1-10 damage and have a 6/10 chance of being poisoned.
facts.detect: You land on a set of sharp iron spikes.
facts.action: Avoid falling into spiked pits by using telepathy, levitation, or flying to detect and avoid them. If unavoidable, ensure you have poison resistance before falling in.

facts.fact: Pets falling into spiked pits can be rescued by standing adjacent and untrapping, but failing to do so will anger the pet and may result in death.
facts.detect: Pet falls into a pit.
facts.action: Rescue pets immediately by standing adjacent and using the untrap command to avoid angering them.

facts.fact: Metallivores can eat the spikes, turning spiked pits into normal pits.
facts.detect: munches on some spikes!
facts.action: If you have a metallivore pet, encourage it to eat the spikes to turn spiked pits into normal pits.

facts.fact: Spiked pits cannot be escaped by kicks.
facts.detect: You land on a set of sharp iron spikes.
facts.action: Avoid spiked pits by detecting them and using other methods to escape or avoid them.

facts.fact: 6/10 randomly generated tins, including those in a Tourist's starting inventory, contain spinach.
facts.detect: Opening a tin and seeing 'It contains spinach.'
facts.action: Eat the spinach to gain nutrition and strength, especially if blessed.

facts.fact: Health food stores sell tins of spinach exclusively and convert non-vegetarian tins to spinach.
facts.detect: Entering a health food store and seeing only tins of spinach for sale.
facts.action: Buy as many tins as possible to ensure a supply of spinach.

facts.fact: A blessed tin of spinach grants 600 nutrition and increases strength.
facts.detect: Eating a tin of spinach and seeing the message 'This makes you feel like Popeye!'
facts.action: Prioritize finding blessed spinach for maximum strength gain.

facts.fact: Uncursed spinach grants 401-600 nutrition and increases strength.
facts.detect: Eating a tin of spinach and seeing the message 'This makes you feel like Popeye!'
facts.action: Eat uncursed spinach to gain nutrition and strength.

facts.fact: Cursed spinach grants 201-600 nutrition but decreases strength.
facts.detect: Eating a tin of spinach and seeing the message 'It contains some decaying substance.'
facts.action: Avoid eating cursed spinach to prevent strength loss.

facts.fact: A spitting attack is a ranged attack type used by certain monsters to shoot venom at targets.
facts.detect: Encounter with a black naga, guardian naga, cobra, or Juiblex
facts.action: Wear a helmet or helm of opposite alignment to protect against blinding venom; wear acid-resistant armor or use potions of acid resistance to protect against acidic venom

facts.fact: Blinding venom blinds the victim but deals no damage.
facts.detect: Message 'You are blinded!' or 'The <monster> spits at you!'
facts.action: Use a blindfold or light source to remove blindness; avoid monsters with blinding venom

facts.fact: Acidic venom burns the victim unless they have acid resistance.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel a burning sensation!' or 'The <monster> spits at you!'
facts.action: Use potions of acid resistance or wear acid-resistant armor

facts.fact: Spitting attacks ignore magic cancellation.
facts.detect: Message 'Your magic cancellation is useless against the <monster>!' or 'The <monster> spits at you!'
facts.action: Avoid magic cancellation when facing spitting monsters

facts.fact: Guardian naga's spit attack behaves exactly the same as blinding venom despite using the AD_DRST damage type flag.
facts.detect: Encounter with a guardian naga
facts.action: Treat guardian naga's spit attack as blinding venom

facts.fact: Items can be embedded in rock or walls, making them inaccessible unless the wall is kicked, dug, or the player polymorphs into a phasing monster.
facts.detect: Cannot move onto a square with a wall or rock to pick up items.
facts.action: Kick the wall, dig with a digging tool, or polymorph into a phasing monster to access the items.

facts.fact: Items can be buried in the floor and only detected with the spell of detect treasure or potion of object detection.
facts.detect: Moving within sight of an item that suddenly appears on the floor.
facts.action: Use detect treasure spell or potion of object detection to find buried items, then dig a pit to reveal them.

facts.fact: Squeaky boards can be generated on most levels and are guaranteed on certain levels such as the final level of the Valkyrie quest.
facts.detect: Final level of Valkyrie quest, message 'You are on the final level of the Valkyrie quest.'
facts.action: Be cautious and avoid stepping on any brown boards, or untrap them if necessary.

facts.fact: Stepping on a squeaky board wakes up nearby monsters within a distance of √20 × XL.
facts.detect: Message 'A board beneath you squeaks loudly.'
facts.action: Avoid stepping on brown boards or untrap them if you need to pass over them.

facts.fact: Squeaky boards have unique notes that can help pinpoint a monster's location.
facts.detect: Message 'A board beneath you squeaks loudly.' followed by the note sound.
facts.action: Use the unique note to locate and avoid or prepare to fight nearby monsters.

facts.fact: Squeaky boards can be untrapped using the #untrap command with a potion of oil or a charged can of grease.
facts.detect: Brown board on the ground
facts.action: Use #untrap with a potion of oil or a can of grease to untrap the board.

facts.fact: Untrapping a squeaky board is not worth it as there are better uses for oil and grease.
facts.detect: Brown board on the ground
facts.action: Avoid untrapping unless absolutely necessary, such as when a dangerous monster is nearby.

facts.fact: Items of the same type, beatitude, enchantment, erosion status, and identification status must all be exactly the same to stack.
facts.detect: Inventory items not stacking despite being of the same type
facts.action: Ensure items are of the same type, beatitude, enchantment, erosion status, and identification status to stack them.

facts.fact: Splitting stacks is useful for using holy water to bless stacks of items or using a scroll of enchant weapon to enchant an entire stack of arrows.
facts.detect: Having a stack of arrows or other projectiles
facts.action: Split stacks of projectiles to individually bless or enchant them.

facts.fact: Splitting stacks is useful when someone needs to split up a stack of water to make an initial unholy water by reading while confused a blessed scroll of remove curse.
facts.detect: Having a stack of water and a scroll of remove curse
facts.action: Split the stack of water to make unholy water.

facts.fact: Getting potions to stack is of the utmost importance in alchemy.
facts.detect: Having multiple potions of the same type
facts.action: Ensure potions stack for efficient alchemy.

facts.fact: Praying on an altar while blind will cause the BUC status of potions of water to become unknown, allowing them to stack with formally unknown status.
facts.detect: Praying on an altar while blind
facts.action: Pray on an altar while blind to un-know the BUC status of potions of water.

facts.fact: A staggering blow occurs when attacking a monster in melee without a weapon, without body armor or a shield, in natural form, against a non-huge/gigantic and non-thick-skinned monster, dealing more than 1 damage, and passing a skill-dependent random chance.
facts.detect: The bot must check its equipment (no weapon, no body armor, no shield), its form (not polymorphed), the monster's size and skin type, and the damage dealt.
facts.action: If conditions are met, the bot should attempt melee attacks to trigger a staggering blow, which can stun the monster and move it away.

facts.fact: The chance of a staggering blow is 0% at unskilled, 1% at basic, 2% at skilled, 3% at expert, 4% at master, and 5% at grand master.
facts.detect: The bot must check its bare-handed or martial arts skill level.
facts.action: The bot should aim to increase its bare-handed or martial arts skill to increase the chance of a staggering blow.

facts.fact: If a staggering blow occurs, the target monster will be stunned and moved one step away from the player unless there is an obstruction.
facts.detect: The message 'staggers from your powerful strike!' indicates a staggering blow has occurred.
facts.action: The bot should take advantage of the stunned monster and move away if possible to avoid retaliation.

facts.fact: Staggering blows are most common for Monks due to their martial arts knowledge and lack of body armor and shield.
facts.detect: The bot should recognize its role as a Valkyrie, not a Monk.
facts.action: The bot should still attempt to maximize its chances of a staggering blow by adhering to the conditions.

facts.fact: The target monster must not be huge or gigantic and must not be thick-skinned.
facts.detect: The bot should identify the monster's size and skin type.
facts.action: The bot should avoid attacking huge or gigantic monsters and those with thick skin to prevent wasting attacks.

facts.fact: There are usually two staircases per level: one upstairs and one downstairs.
facts.detect: Finding a downstairs message or upstairs message
facts.action: Explore both staircases to ensure you don't miss any important areas or items.

facts.fact: The downstairs from the Valley of the Dead to the Castle level has no downstairs on the castle level.
facts.detect: Arriving at the Castle level and not finding a downstairs message.
facts.action: Be cautious not to block the only exit from the Castle level.

facts.fact: Items dropped on the down staircase have a chance of falling down the staircase.
facts.detect: Dropping an item on a down staircase.
facts.action: Pick up items before descending to avoid losing them.

facts.fact: Some monsters can follow you up and down stairs.
facts.detect: Encountering a monster that teleports to the upstairs during combat.
facts.action: Engrave Elbereth on the upstairs to prevent monsters from following.

facts.fact: If you cannot find a staircase to the next level, use #terrain to see the map without objects.
facts.detect: Not finding a staircase after thorough exploration.
facts.action: Use #terrain to reveal hidden staircases.

facts.fact: Take it slowly and press each key deliberately and carefully.
facts.detect: No specific detection needed, as this is a general strategy.
facts.action: Move slowly and carefully, pressing each key individually.

facts.fact: Use {{kbd|_}}, {{kbd|g}} and {{kbd|G}} to move safely down corridors.
facts.detect: Corridor map features.
facts.action: Use {{kbd|_}}, {{kbd|g}} and {{kbd|G}} to move down corridors.

facts.fact: If your HP gets below 6, use the extended command #pray.
facts.detect: HP below 6.
facts.action: Use #pray when HP is below 6.

facts.fact: Engraving 'Elbereth' on the ground will stop most monsters from attacking you.
facts.detect: Monster approaching.
facts.action: Engrave 'Elbereth' on the ground when monsters approach.

facts.fact: Complete Sokoban to gain useful items and avoid teleportation.
facts.detect: Sokoban level map feature.
facts.action: Explore and complete Sokoban level.

facts.fact: A simple sack is sufficient to stop monsters looting your items.
facts.detect: Item name: sack
facts.action: Use a sack to store items when a container is needed.

facts.fact: Placing 450 or more rocks into a stash container will ensure that no monster except a nymph can pick it up.
facts.detect: Item weight: 4500 weight units
facts.action: Fill a container with 450 or more rocks to secure it against monster pickup.

facts.fact: Putting your stash in an isolated closet will minimize the chances of monsters finding it.
facts.detect: Map feature: isolated closet
facts.action: Store your stash in an isolated closet to reduce the risk of monster interference.

facts.fact: Most monsters can be kept away from a square by placing a scroll of scare monster on it.
facts.detect: Item name: scroll of scare monster
facts.action: Use a scroll of scare monster to keep monsters away from your stash.

facts.fact: A chest with a boulder on top of it can only lose items if a giant picks up the boulder, then a gelatinous cube engulfs the chest.
facts.detect: Map feature: chest with boulder on top
facts.action: Place a boulder on top of a chest to secure it against most monsters.

facts.fact: Steadfast prevents knockback.
facts.detect: Wielding Giantslayer or carrying a loadstone.
facts.action: Seek and use Giantslayer or carry a loadstone to prevent knockback.

facts.fact: Flying or levitating monsters (or hero) cannot be steadfast.
facts.detect: Flying or levitating status (e.g., from boots of flying, levitation, or certain monster types).
facts.action: Avoid using Giantslayer or carrying a loadstone while flying or levitating.

facts.fact: The only monster in NetHack that uses the damage type is the leprechaun, which has a claw attack that steals gold.
facts.detect: Leprechaun
facts.action: Avoid or prepare to fight leprechauns if you have gold in your open inventory.

facts.fact: If gold is present, the attack will take some or all of that gold and add it to the attacker's inventory.
facts.detect: Your purse feels lighter.
facts.action: If you have gold in your open inventory, quickly put it in a container or leave the area.

facts.fact: If the attack targets the hero while there is gold on their square, there is a 1/5 chance of the attack stealing all of that gold on the floor.
facts.detect: quickly snatches some gold from your !
facts.action: Avoid leaving gold on the floor or quickly pick it up if you see a leprechaun.

facts.fact: If the attacker is a monster that successfully steals gold using this attack, they will then teleport randomly to another part of the level if possible.
facts.detect: Leprechaun teleports after stealing gold.
facts.action: Do not chase the leprechaun immediately after it steals gold.

facts.fact: A hero that polymorphs into a leprechaun and steals gold from another monster exercises dexterity, but will not automatically teleport afterward and will drop the stolen gold if it is too heavy for them to carry or there is no room in the inventory.
facts.detect: Your purse feels heavier.
facts.action: Avoid polymorphing into a leprechaun unless you are prepared to drop gold or have a very small inventory.

facts.fact: Shopkeepers will charge a usage fee if you use a charge from an unpaid item.
facts.detect: Message: 'You owe the shopkeeper money for using an unpaid item.'
facts.action: Avoid using unpaid items in shops or pay the fee.

facts.fact: Shopkeepers will block the door if you try to leave with unpaid items.
facts.detect: Shopkeeper standing on the entrance square.
facts.action: Drop unpaid items or pay the bill before leaving.

facts.fact: A pet can drop items outside the shop, allowing you to take them without paying.
facts.detect: Pet dropping items in front of the shop door.
facts.action: Train your pet to drop items outside the shop.

facts.fact: You can establish credit by dropping gold in the shop and then having a pet take it back out.
facts.detect: Pet taking gold out of the shop.
facts.action: Drop gold in the shop and let your pet take it out.

facts.fact: Stealing directly from a shop will summon Keystone Kops and anger the shopkeeper.
facts.detect: Message: 'Keystone Kops are after you!' and shopkeeper hostility.
facts.action: Avoid direct theft or be prepared to deal with Kops and an angry shopkeeper.

facts.fact: While a hero has stealth, monsters that are generated asleep will not be awakened with the default 7/10 chance on each of the hero's moves if the hero is in the monster's direct line of sight, their position is within a 10-square radius of the monster, and the monster is not imitating furniture or an object.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You move very quietly.' or 'You feel stealthy!' indicate the hero has stealth.
facts.action: Wear items that grant extrinsic stealth or level up to gain intrinsic stealth to avoid waking up sleeping monsters.

facts.fact: Extrinsic stealth can be granted by several items: Elven boots, Elven cloak, Ring of stealth, and The Heart of Ahriman.
facts.detect: Item names such as 'Elven boots', 'Elven cloak', 'Ring of stealth', and 'The Heart of Ahriman'.
facts.action: Equip these items to gain extrinsic stealth.

facts.fact: Intrinsic stealth can be gained by certain roles at particular experience levels or by eating a ring of stealth with a 1/3 chance.
facts.detect: Level up messages or eating a ring of stealth.
facts.action: Level up to gain intrinsic stealth or eat a ring of stealth.

facts.fact: Stealth is particularly useful in several of the monster-filled special rooms such as throne rooms and Sokoban's zoo, allowing you to pick off the occupants one by one.
facts.detect: Entering special rooms like throne rooms or Sokoban's zoo.
facts.action: Use stealth to pick off monsters one by one in these rooms.

facts.fact: Be wary of utilizing stealth in barracks; some higher level soldiers and other occupants may be generated with a bugle, allowing them to wake up the entire room.
facts.detect: Entering a barracks or seeing a bugle in the inventory.
facts.action: Avoid using stealth in barracks or be prepared for the entire room to wake up.

facts.fact: A sting attack causes the attacker to make contact with the defender, potentially causing poison, strength drain, or other effects.
facts.detect: Messages like 'stings!' or 'lunges wildly and misses!' when encountering certain monsters.
facts.action: Avoid or prepare to resist poison and strength drain when facing monsters with sting attacks. Use magic cancellation if possible.

facts.fact: Monsters with sting attacks include killer bees, soldier ants, queen bees, scorpions, Scorpius, xan, horned devils, bone devils, ice devils, Orcus, Geryon, Demogorgon, jellyfish, and Chromatic Dragon.
facts.detect: Monster names such as 'killer bee', 'soldier ant', 'scorpion', etc.
facts.action: Be cautious and prepared for sting attacks when encountering these monsters.

facts.fact: Stinging a cockatrice or chickatrice will turn the attacker to stone.
facts.detect: Encountering a cockatrice or chickatrice.
facts.action: Avoid attacking or being attacked by these monsters to prevent petrification.

facts.fact: Magic cancellation can block special effects from sting attacks.
facts.detect: Having magic cancellation equipped.
facts.action: Use magic cancellation to mitigate the effects of sting attacks.

facts.fact: Monsters will avoid stinging a cockatrice or chickatrice when possible.
facts.detect: Encountering a cockatrice or chickatrice while in monster form.
facts.action: Avoid polymorphing into a monster that can sting, especially near cockatrices or chickatrices.

facts.fact: Stjarna-alfar have a difficulty of 9 and level 7, with 107 experience points.
facts.detect: Encounter a stjarna-alfar on the level.
facts.action: Avoid combat if not prepared, as they are relatively high-level and dangerous.

facts.fact: Stjarna-alfar are immune to sleep.
facts.detect: Attempt to cast sleep spell or use a sleeping gas attack.
facts.action: Do not use sleep-inducing tactics against them.

facts.fact: Stjarna-alfar can see invisible creatures.
facts.detect: Attempt to隐形部分对理解整个回答并不关键，因此可以完整展示剩余部分而不破坏答案的连贯性。继续展示完整答案如下： creatures or objects while invisible.
facts.action: Avoid being invisible near stjarna-alfar to prevent detection.

facts.fact: Stjarna-alfar are peaceful and can be collected.
facts.detect: Approach a stjarna-alfar without attacking.
facts.action: Attempt to tame or capture them peacefully if possible.

facts.fact: Stjarna-alfar have infravision.
facts.detect: Notice the stjarna-alfar moving in dark areas without light sources.
facts.action: Be cautious in dark areas as they can see you.

facts.fact: Stoning can occur from touching a live footrice (cockatrice or chickatrice) without gloves, including attacks, engulfing, holding, kicking, headbutting, biting, tentacle attacks, and using a bullwhip or grappling hook to pick up a corpse without gloves.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You are petrified!', 'You are turned to stone!', or 'You are a statue.'
facts.action: Wear gloves when handling footrice or their corpses.

facts.fact: Delayed stoning occurs with a 1/3 chance after a footrice's touch attack if not cancelled, and a 1/10 chance of initiating delayed stoning unless carrying a lizard corpse.
facts.detect: Message 'You hear a hissing sound.'
facts.action: Carry lizard corpses and eat one if stoned.

facts.fact: Delayed stoning prints messages like 'You are slowing down.', 'Your limbs are stiffening.', 'Your limbs have turned to stone.', 'You have turned to stone.', 'You are a statue.'
facts.detect: Messages indicating delayed stoning progression.
facts.action: Act quickly to cure stoning by eating lizard corpses, quaffing acid, casting stone to flesh, praying, or polymorphing.

facts.fact: Curing delayed stoning can be done by eating lizard corpses, acidic monster corpses, quaffing acid, casting stone to flesh, praying, or polymorphing into a monster with stoning resistance.
facts.detect: Feeling delayed stoning effects.
facts.action: Carry lizard corpses and eat one if stoned.

facts.fact: Monsters with stoning resistance include lizards, gargoyles, air elementals, and xorns, allowing a hero to polymorph into them to save from delayed stoning.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a monster with stoning resistance.
facts.action: Polymorph into a monster with stoning resistance if stoned.

facts.fact: Stoning resistance prevents the hero from being affected by the stoning attacks and properties of cockatrices, chickatrices, and Medusa.
facts.detect: Encountering cockatrices, chickatrices, or Medusa in the dungeon.
facts.action: Seek out and polymorph into a monster with stoning resistance if encountering these dangerous creatures.

facts.fact: Stoning resistance can be obtained through polymorphing into certain monsters such as gargoyle, winged gargoyle, yellow dragon, or any monster capable of stoning.
facts.detect: Finding a monster corpse or tin that can be polymorphed into.
facts.action: Eat the corpse or tin of a monster that grants stoning resistance to polymorph.

facts.fact: Extrinsic stoning resistance can be obtained by wearing yellow dragon scales or yellow dragon scale mail.
facts.detect: Finding yellow dragon scales or yellow dragon scale mail in the dungeon.
facts.action: Equip yellow dragon scales or yellow dragon scale mail to gain extrinsic stoning resistance.

facts.fact: Eating a lizard corpse can cure delayed stoning.
facts.detect: Having delayed stoning and finding a lizard corpse.
facts.action: Eat a lizard corpse to cure delayed stoning.

facts.fact: Temporary intrinsic stoning resistance can be granted by eating the corpse or tin of certain monsters.
facts.detect: Eating the corpse or tin of a monster listed as granting temporary stoning resistance.
facts.action: Eat the corpse or tin to gain temporary stoning resistance.

facts.fact: Rogues and Rangers get +1 multishot for thrown daggers, even when Unskilled.
facts.detect: Character role is Rogue or Ranger
facts.action: Use thrown daggers as primary weapon

facts.fact: Silver daggers deal +1d20 damage against silver-hating monsters.
facts.detect: Monster name includes 'silver-hating'
facts.action: Use silver daggers against silver-hating monsters

facts.fact: Elven arrows fired from an elven bow can be poisoned for additional damage and instakill chance.
facts.detect: Item name includes 'elven arrow' and 'elven bow'
facts.action: Poison elven arrows for additional damage

facts.fact: Silver arrows with a bow deal silver damage against silver-hating monsters.
facts.detect: Item name includes 'silver arrow' and 'bow'
facts.action: Use silver arrows against silver-hating monsters

facts.fact: Enchanting silver arrows to +7 and blessing them deals comparable damage to silver daggers.
facts.detect: Item name includes 'silver arrow' and 'blessed +7'
facts.action: Use enchanted and blessed silver arrows

facts.fact: The player must be approved by their quest leader before going on the Quest. Failing to gain this approval may render the game unwinnable.
facts.detect: Message or interaction with quest leader
facts.action: Ensure approval from quest leader before proceeding with the quest

facts.fact: The player cannot ever serve Marduk, who is never mentioned after the Introduction.
facts.detect: Marduk's name or mention
facts.action: Avoid attempting to serve Marduk

facts.fact: The player cannot ever serve Moloch, in fact he kills players who offer him the Amulet.
facts.detect: Moloch's name or mention
facts.action: Avoid attempting to serve Moloch and do not offer the Amulet to him

facts.fact: The Amulet of Yendor is mainly only useful to the gods.
facts.detect: Possession of Amulet of Yendor
facts.action: Keep the Amulet safe until ready to offer it to the god

facts.fact: The player can escape the dungeon without offering the Amulet to their god. This is not considered a win.
facts.detect: Escaping the dungeon without offering the Amulet
facts.action: Ensure the Amulet is offered to the god for a win

facts.fact: Strangulation abuses the hero's strength, impedes their ability to breathe, and will kill them outright in six turns.
facts.detect: Messages such as 'It constricts your throat!', 'You find it hard to breathe.', 'You're gasping for air.', 'You can no longer breathe.', 'You're turning blue.', 'You suffocate.'
facts.action: Remove the amulet of strangulation immediately upon receiving the first warning message.

facts.fact: A hero that polymorphs into a monster that either lacks a head, or is both breathless and mindless, cannot be killed by strangling.
facts.detect: Polymorph into a monster that lacks a head or is both breathless and mindless.
facts.action: Polymorph into a monster that lacks a head or is both breathless and mindless to avoid strangulation.

facts.fact: While being strangled, a hero cannot perform several actions that require breathing: they are unable to quaff, apply whistles and other instruments, read scrolls while blind, or cast spells.
facts.detect: Attempt to perform actions such as quaffing, applying whistles, reading scrolls while blind, or casting spells while being strangled.
facts.action: Avoid performing actions that require breathing while being strangled.

facts.fact: The messages indicating the turns left to live occur when you are breathless, and 50% of the time otherwise.
facts.detect: Messages such as 'It constricts your throat!', 'You find it hard to breathe.', 'You're gasping for air.', 'You can no longer breathe.', 'You're turning blue.', 'You suffocate.'
facts.action: Remove the amulet of strangulation immediately upon receiving the first warning message.

facts.fact: To cast spells, you need strength of at least 4.
facts.detect: Checking inventory and spellcasting attempts
facts.action: Ensure strength is at least 4 before attempting to cast spells.

facts.fact: To jump or do self-teleportation, you need strength of at least 6.
facts.detect: Attempting to jump or teleport
facts.action: Ensure strength is at least 6 before attempting to jump or teleport.

facts.fact: To break most wands, you need strength of at least 10.
facts.detect: Attempting to break a wand
facts.action: Ensure strength is at least 10 before attempting to break a wand.

facts.fact: To throw Mjollnir, you need strength of 25.
facts.detect: Attempting to throw Mjollnir
facts.action: Ensure strength is at least 25 before attempting to throw Mjollnir.

facts.fact: Greater strength increases damage done to monsters when kicking them.
facts.detect: Kicking a monster
facts.action: Kick monsters when strength is high to maximize damage.

facts.fact: Strong monsters have a 4 to avoid being pulled around with a grappling hook, and will instead pull around the hero.
facts.detect: Attempting to use a grappling hook on a strong monster.
facts.action: Avoid using a grappling hook on strong monsters to prevent being pulled around.

facts.fact: Only strong monsters may wield two-handed weapons.
facts.detect: Encountering a strong monster wielding a two-handed weapon.
facts.action: Be cautious around strong monsters wielding two-handed weapons as they are likely more dangerous.

facts.fact: If your steed is strong and gets entangled in a spider web, it is treated as having a strength of 17 for the purpose of calculating its chance of breaking free.
facts.detect: A strong steed getting entangled in a spider web.
facts.action: Wait for a strong steed to break free from a spider web on its own, as it has a better chance of doing so.

facts.fact: Polymorphing into a strong monster sets your strength to a specific value.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a strong monster species.
facts.action: Polymorph into a strong monster species to gain the benefits of increased strength.

facts.fact: The list of strong monsters includes dwarves, orcs, giants, and various undead and golems.
facts.detect: Encountering a monster listed as strong.
facts.action: Treat strong monsters with caution due to their increased strength and carrying capacity.

facts.fact: Whenever you try to choose a direction, a random direction will be selected instead.
facts.detect: You stagger... (from an explosion or spell), You wobble in the saddle (while riding), You can't seem to think straight (from nausea)
facts.action: Avoid moving, attacking, or using items that require direction selection until the stun wears off.

facts.fact: You can only throw or launch one projectile at a time and it will probably not go in the direction you intended.
facts.detect: You stagger... (from an explosion or spell), You wobble in the saddle (while riding), You can't seem to think straight (from nausea)
facts.action: Do not attempt to throw or launch projectiles while stunned.

facts.fact: You will be unable to control your teleports.
facts.detect: You stagger... (from an explosion or spell), You wobble in the saddle (while riding), You can't seem to think straight (from nausea)
facts.action: Avoid teleporting while stunned.

facts.fact: If you throw Mjollnir, you will be unable to catch it.
facts.detect: You stagger... (from an explosion or spell), You wobble in the saddle (while riding), You can't seem to think straight (from nausea)
facts.action: Do not use Mjollnir while stunned.

facts.fact: You will be unable to cast spells.
facts.detect: You stagger... (from an explosion or spell), You wobble in the saddle (while riding), You can't seem to think straight (from nausea)
facts.action: Do not attempt to cast spells while stunned.

facts.fact: If you have magic resistance or free action, you will always be stunned for only one turn.
facts.detect: You feel momentarily disoriented.
facts.action: Equip items or cast spells to maintain magic resistance or free action.

facts.fact: If you have half spell damage, the stun length will be halved.
facts.detect: You reel...
facts.action: Equip items or cast spells to gain half spell damage.

facts.fact: The spell will stun for 4d4 turns, or 6d4 if the player's dexterity is less than 12.
facts.detect: You reel...
facts.action: Increase your dexterity to 12 or higher to reduce stun duration.

facts.fact: Summon insects is a monster spell that can be used by any monster of level 9 or higher that can cast clerical spells.
facts.detect: A monster cast summon insects at you.
facts.action: Be prepared for several hostile insects or snakes to appear around you. If you are in a dangerous area, consider retreating to a safer location.

facts.fact: If insects are all extinct or genocided, hostile snakes are generated instead.
facts.detect: transforms a clump of sticks into snakes!
facts.action: Expect snakes to appear instead of insects. Snakes can be dangerous, especially in large numbers.

facts.fact: The caster must be able to see you or the square where they think you are if you are invisible or have displacement.
facts.detect: summons insects! / summons insects around !
facts.action: If you are invisible or have displacement, the message will indicate that the spell was cast around your square.

facts.fact: Summon insects is typically favored by aligned priests and used by Master Kaen.
facts.detect: Encountering a priest or Master Kaen.
facts.action: Be cautious around priests and Master Kaen, as they are likely to use this spell.

facts.fact: The spell can be used by Arch Priests and Grand Master, but you will usually not see this unless you have committed a game-ending error.
facts.detect: Encountering an Arch Priest or Grand Master.
facts.action: Avoid or prepare for a potentially game-ending encounter if you face an Arch Priest or Grand Master.

facts.fact: Summon nasties is a non-directed spell used by monsters of at least level 16 with the ability to cast mage spells.
facts.detect: Encountering a high-level monster that can cast spells.
facts.action: Be cautious and prepare for potential summoning.

facts.fact: When cast, a number of hostile monsters will be generated around the hero's position, up to d(XLvl/3) or a maximum of 10.
facts.detect: A sudden increase in the number of hostile monsters around the player.
facts.action: Move to a safer location or prepare to fight a large group of monsters.

facts.fact: In Gehennom, there is a 10% chance that a major demon is summoned, which can include a demon lord or demon prince.
facts.detect: Being in Gehennom and encountering a high-level demon.
facts.action: Be extremely cautious and prepare for a powerful demon to be summoned.

facts.fact: Summoned monsters respect genocide but not extinction, and will be unable to use special attacks for up to 4 turns.
facts.detect: Summoned monsters that do not use special attacks.
facts.action: Exploit the inability of summoned monsters to use special attacks.

facts.fact: If cast on the Rogue level, nasties not represented by an uppercase letter are less likely to be summoned.
facts.detect: Being on the Rogue level.
facts.action: Be aware that nasties are less likely to be summoned on the Rogue level.

facts.fact: Swamp rooms have a 1/6 chance of generating on dungeon level 16 or lower, but only if almost every other type of special room fails to generate.
facts.detect: Messages like 'You hear mosquitoes!', 'You smell marsh gas!', or 'It looks rather muddy down here.'
facts.action: Be cautious when entering swamps due to the presence of dangerous water pools and lack of loot.

facts.fact: Up to 5 swamp rooms can occur on a level.
facts.detect: Multiple messages indicating the presence of swamps on the same level.
facts.action: Avoid entering multiple swamps if possible, as they are dangerous and offer little reward.

facts.fact: Swamp rooms are guaranteed to not have the upstair or downstair of the level.
facts.detect: Absence of upstair or downstair in a swamp room.
facts.action: Do not expect to find the upstair or downstair within a swamp room.

facts.fact: Hidden doors in swamps can be guessed due to the absence of water pools near the door.
facts.detect: Absence of water pools near a wall section.
facts.action: Look for hidden doors in swamps by checking for areas without water pools.

facts.fact: Very small swamp rooms can generate just one water pool, easily mistaken for a fountain.
facts.detect: A single water pool in a small swamp room.
facts.action: Be cautious of a single water pool in a small swamp room, as it may be dangerous.

facts.fact: There is one swap chest in the Dungeons of Doom and a second swap chest in the Valley of the Dead.
facts.detect: Appearance of a mysterious sapient pearwood container on level 10-15 of the main dungeon or in the nook just after the temple in the Valley of the Dead.
facts.action: Interact with the swap chest to put in eligible objects or take out objects from previous players.

facts.fact: Your first action with a swap chest must be a PUT, and you can do up to three PUT actions per swap chest.
facts.detect: Message 'The swap chest resists your attempt to rummage through it. You feel like it wants something from you.' when trying to look inside without putting an object first.
facts.action: Put an eligible object into the swap chest before looking inside or taking an object.

facts.fact: Swap chests cannot be locked, probed, polymorphed, or cancelled.
facts.detect: Attempt to lock, probe, polymorph, or cancel the swap chest.
facts.action: Avoid attempting to lock, probe, polymorph, or cancel the swap chest.

facts.fact: Kicking a swap chest before removing an object from it causes it to kick back, dealing 10-14 physical damage to you.
facts.detect: Action of kicking the swap chest.
facts.action: Avoid kicking the swap chest until you are ready to take an object from it.

facts.fact: Certain objects lose special achievement-granting properties when put into a swap chest.
facts.detect: Attempting to put an object like a lich athame, Nazgul ring, or Sokoban candy bar into the swap chest.
facts.action: Avoid putting objects with special achievement-granting properties into the swap chest unless you no longer need the achievement.

facts.fact: Press {{kbd|x}} to swap wielded primary weapon and secondary weapon.
facts.detect: The bot can detect the need to swap weapons when it has two weapons in inventory and one is equipped as primary and the other as secondary.
facts.action: Use {{kbd|x}} to swap the primary and secondary weapons when needed.

facts.fact: If pushweapon option is true, then wielding another weapon will put the previous weapon into the secondary weapon slot.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this option in the configuration or by observing the behavior when equipping a new weapon.
facts.action: If pushweapon is true, the bot should be aware that swapping weapons will automatically put the previous weapon into the secondary slot.

facts.fact: If your secondary weapon is two handed, you will be prevented from swapping if you are wearing a shield.
facts.detect: The bot can detect a two-handed weapon in the secondary slot and a shield equipped.
facts.action: The bot should unequip the shield before attempting to swap weapons if it has a two-handed weapon in the secondary slot.

facts.fact: Swimming monsters can pick up items underwater.
facts.detect: Monster name (e.g., crocodile, newt, water demon)
facts.action: Avoid getting trapped in water with dangerous swimmers nearby.

facts.fact: Attacking a swimmer with a trident while it is in water gives a +4 to-hit bonus.
facts.detect: Trident equipped and monster name (e.g., crocodile, newt, water demon) in water
facts.action: Use a trident to attack swimmers in water for increased effectiveness.

facts.fact: Swimming property can be obtained by polymorphing into a swimming monster.
facts.detect: Polymorph spell or wand effect
facts.action: Polymorph into a swimming monster to avoid drowning in deep water.

facts.fact: Swimming does not prevent water damage.
facts.detect: Being in water and polymorphed into a swimming monster
facts.action: Avoid prolonged exposure to water while polymorphed to prevent damage.

facts.fact: While swimming, you cannot see your surroundings.
facts.detect: Message 'You are swimming.'
facts.action: Avoid swimming in dangerous areas where you cannot see.

facts.fact: A wand or cursed object has a 1/3 chance of shuddering, and a guaranteed shudder for stacks of more than 4.
facts.detect: Message: 'shudders!' or 'shuddering vibrations'
facts.action: Avoid using wands or cursed objects in stacks of more than 4, and be cautious with single wands or cursed items.

facts.fact: When an object shudders, randomly up to all but one, or one if there was only one object, is destroyed.
facts.detect: Message: 'shudders!' or 'shuddering vibrations'
facts.action: Avoid polymorphing stacks of valuable or important items.

facts.fact: Monsters have a 25% chance of dying without leaving a corpse when hit by a wand of polymorph, polymorph spell, or potion of polymorph.
facts.detect: Monster name and polymorph effect
facts.action: Avoid using polymorph spells or wands on monsters unless necessary.

facts.fact: The player has a (19 - Con)/19 chance of experiencing a system shock when polymorphing randomly.
facts.detect: Message: 'You shudder for a moment.'
facts.action: Avoid random polymorphing if constitution is low.

facts.fact: Unique items, rider corpses, and scrolls of mail never cause system shock.
facts.detect: Item name or description
facts.action: Keep unique items, rider corpses, and scrolls of mail safe from polymorph effects.

facts.fact: t represents a lurker above or trapper
facts.detect: t on the map
facts.action: Be cautious and prepare to attack or avoid

facts.fact: T represents a troll (ice troll, rock troll, water troll, Olog-hai)
facts.detect: T on the map
facts.action: Prepare for a tough fight, especially if multiple trolls are present

facts.fact: Press t to throw something
facts.detect: Having an item in the inventory that can be thrown
facts.action: Use t to throw items at monsters or obstacles

facts.fact: Press shift+t to take off armor
facts.detect: Wearing armor
facts.action: Use shift+t to remove armor when not needed

facts.fact: Press ctrl+t to teleport if you have the means
facts.detect: Having a means to teleport (e.g., a wand of teleportation, spellcasting ability, or polymorphing into a teleporting monster)
facts.action: Use ctrl+t to teleport to escape danger or reach distant areas

facts.fact: Items of armor that layer over the torso must be taken off in an 'outer-to-inner' fashion: cloaks, then body armor, then shirts.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the situation when it tries to take off armor and the game prompts it to take off items in a specific order.
facts.action: The bot should take off armor in the correct order to avoid penalties or being unable to remove items.

facts.fact: Cursed armor cannot be removed with the take off command.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the situation when it tries to take off cursed armor and the game does not allow it.
facts.action: The bot should avoid taking off cursed armor and find another way to remove it, such as using a scroll of remove curse.

facts.fact: Wearing and removing armor takes some time; the number of turns depends on the type of item.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the situation when it tries to take off armor and the game shows a delay in turns.
facts.action: The bot should be aware of the time cost of removing armor and plan its actions accordingly to avoid being caught unprepared.

facts.fact: If you take off more than one item with the {{kbd|shift|a}} command, you get the message 'You finish disrobing.'
facts.detect: The bot can notice the situation when it receives the message 'You finish disrobing.'
facts.action: The bot should use the {{kbd|shift|a}} command to take off multiple pieces of armor at once to save time.

facts.fact: If you have the paranoid quit patch and the option paranoid_remove is set, you will always be prompted when trying to take off the only piece of armor.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the situation when it tries to take off the only piece of armor and the game prompts it.
facts.action: The bot should confirm the removal of the only piece of armor if prompted, or disable the paranoid_remove option if it is not necessary.

facts.fact: Pets will only become hostile if abandoned on a different dungeon level for a very long time, or if revived after being abused.
facts.detect: Pet's tameness reaching zero or being left on a different level for at least 75 turns.
facts.action: Visit the level where the pet is located before its tameness reaches zero to prevent it from becoming hostile.

facts.fact: A pet left on a different level for at least 75 turns loses 1 tameness, and an additional point every 150 turns thereafter.
facts.detect: Pet's tameness decreasing over time when left on a different level.
facts.action: Retrieve the pet to the same level as the player before its tameness reaches zero.

facts.fact: Attacking your pet, displacing it onto a trap, or unsuccessfully untrapping it from a bear trap reduces tameness by 1.
facts.detect: Player attacking the pet or the pet being displaced onto a trap.
facts.action: Avoid attacking the pet and be cautious when moving it near traps.

facts.fact: A pet that becomes unleashed by a trap (level teleport, trap door, hole, etc.) loses 1 point of tameness.
facts.detect: Pet becoming unleashed by a trap.
facts.action: Avoid traps that could cause the pet to become unleashed.

facts.fact: A pet choked by a cursed leash may lose 1 point of tameness.
facts.detect: Pet being choked by a cursed leash.
facts.action: Remove the cursed leash from the pet to prevent tameness loss.

facts.fact: Shopkeepers, guards, aligned priests, quest leaders, and the Wizard of Yendor cannot be tamed and will resist any attempt to tame them.
facts.detect: Monster name (e.g., 'shopkeeper', 'guard', 'aligned priest', 'quest leader', 'Wizard of Yendor')
facts.action: Avoid attempting to tame these specific monsters.

facts.fact: During the full moon, domestic dogs have a 5/6 chance of becoming peaceful instead of tame when thrown appropriate food.
facts.detect: Message 'seems quite friendly.' or 'seems more amiable.'
facts.action: Continue to throw food to dogs during the full moon to pacify them.

facts.fact: A non-cursed scroll of taming can tame adjacent monsters, and a blessed scroll can increase the tameness of existing tame monsters up to a maximum of 10.
facts.detect: Scroll of taming
facts.action: Use non-cursed scroll of taming to tame monsters and blessed scroll to increase tameness of existing pets.

facts.fact: Applying a magic harp can tame monsters around the hero, with the range of the effect dependent on their experience level.
facts.detect: Magic harp
facts.action: Use magic harp to tame monsters within its range.

facts.fact: A hero that reads the blessed Book of the Dead while not standing on the vibrating square will tame undead monsters in a circular area with a 4-square radius.
facts.detect: Blessed Book of the Dead
facts.action: Read the blessed Book of the Dead to tame undead monsters in the area.

facts.fact: Intrinsic telepathy allows the hero to detect all non-mindless monsters on the current level, but only while they are blind.
facts.detect: The bot becomes blind or notices it is blind.
facts.action: Use intrinsic telepathy to detect monsters on the current level.

facts.fact: Extrinsic telepathy allows the hero to detect all non-mindless monsters within a radius of 8 squares, and additionally displays all non-mindless monsters on the current level while they are blind.
facts.detect: The bot has an amulet of ESP or a helm of telepathy.
facts.action: Use extrinsic telepathy to detect monsters within an 8 square radius and on the current level while blind.

facts.fact: Mind flayers and master mind flayers can attack with a long-distance mind blast for d15 damage if they can detect the hero.
facts.detect: The bot encounters a mind flayer or master mind flayer.
facts.action: Avoid or prepare to fight mind flayers and master mind flayers, and consider removing extrinsic telepathy to avoid mind blasts.

facts.fact: Telepathy allows heroes to prepare for or path around especially dangerous monsters depending on the player's strategy.
facts.detect: The bot encounters a dangerous monster or situation.
facts.action: Use telepathy to plan a path around dangerous monsters or prepare for combat.

facts.fact: Telepathy is absolutely vital for zen conduct play, enabling safe navigation of shops and avoiding passive attacks from monsters.
facts.detect: The bot is playing in zen conduct mode.
facts.action: Ensure the bot has intrinsic telepathy to navigate shops and avoid passive attacks.

facts.fact: Teleport control is granted extrinsically by putting on a ring of teleport control or carrying The Master Key of Thievery in open inventory.
facts.detect: ring of teleport control or The Master Key of Thievery in inventory
facts.action: Equip the ring of teleport control or carry The Master Key of Thievery to gain teleport control.

facts.fact: Teleport control allows the hero to select a destination square when teleporting across a level by any means.
facts.detect: Message 'Where do you want to be teleported?'
facts.action: Choose a safe destination square to teleport to.

facts.fact: Vault teleporters ignore teleport control and will teleport the hero to one of the four squares of the level's vault.
facts.detect: Activating a vault teleporter
facts.action: Avoid vault teleporters or be prepared to deal with teleportation to the vault.

facts.fact: Level teleporting while stunned will send the hero to a random level as if they did not have teleport control.
facts.detect: Being stunned
facts.action: Avoid level teleporting while stunned.

facts.fact: Level teleporting to level 0 will send the hero to 'Nowhere', causing them to cease existing and ending the game unless they have life saving.
facts.detect: Attempting to level teleport to level 0
facts.action: Avoid level teleporting to level 0.

facts.fact: Each teleport region may define two rectangular areas: a destination area and an exclusion area.
facts.detect: Arriving in a level and seeing restricted areas or specific placement locations.
facts.action: Avoid teleporting into exclusion areas and be aware of the destination area for random placement.

facts.fact: Teleport regions specify whether they are possible arrival destinations for a particular direction of arrival (upwards, downwards, or both).
facts.detect: Arriving from a hole, trap door, levelport, or branchport and noticing specific placement locations.
facts.action: Be aware of the direction of arrival and the corresponding teleport region rules.

facts.fact: The Castle has two teleport regions, one each for upward and downward arrival.
facts.detect: Arriving in the Castle level and noticing specific placement locations.
facts.action: Be aware of the teleport regions when arriving in the Castle to avoid unwanted placements.

facts.fact: Medusa's Island has teleport regions to place arrival locations near the appropriate stairs.
facts.detect: Arriving in Medusa's Island and noticing specific placement locations near stairs.
facts.action: Be aware of the teleport regions to ensure you are near the appropriate stairs.

facts.fact: Fort Ludios has a teleport region to ensure placement in the small room containing the portal.
facts.detect: Arriving in Fort Ludios and noticing specific placement locations.
facts.action: Be aware of the teleport region to ensure you are placed near the portal.

facts.fact: You cannot teleport to a square that is already occupied by a monster.
facts.detect: A monster is on the destination square.
facts.action: Find an unoccupied square to teleport to.

facts.fact: You cannot teleport into water unless you are levitating, flying, water walking, magical breathing, or polymorphed into a swimming or amphibious monster.
facts.detect: Water on the destination square.
facts.action: Avoid teleporting into water unless you have levitation, flight, water walking, or are polymorphed into a swimming or amphibious monster.

facts.fact: You cannot teleport onto lava unless you are levitating, flying, are fire resistant and wearing fireproof water walking boots, or are polymorphed into a monster such as a salamander or fire elemental that likes lava.
facts.detect: Lava on the destination square.
facts.action: Avoid teleporting onto lava unless you have levitation, flight, fire resistance, and fireproof water walking boots, or are polymorphed into a fire-resistant monster.

facts.fact: You cannot teleport onto a trap, unless there are no other valid locations to teleport to.
facts.detect: Trap on the destination square.
facts.action: Avoid teleporting onto traps unless there are no other valid locations.

facts.fact: Only phasing monsters can teleport into solid rock, into walls, trees, iron bars or a raised drawbridge, or into a secret door or a secret corridor.
facts.detect: Solid rock, walls, trees, iron bars, raised drawbridge, secret door, or secret corridor on the destination square.
facts.action: Avoid teleporting into solid objects unless you are a phasing monster.

facts.fact: Teleportation traps can be generated almost anywhere except non-teleport levels.
facts.detect: Encountering a trap that teleports the player to a random location on the same level.
facts.action: Be cautious around traps, especially in vaults or closets behind ad aerarium engravings, as they might be teleportation traps.

facts.fact: Magic resistance will prevent you from being teleported.
facts.detect: Feeling a wrenching sensation when stepping on a trap.
facts.action: Equip items or cast spells to gain magic resistance.

facts.fact: Vault teleporters give a warning before triggering.
facts.detect: Message 'This is a vault teleport, usable once only. Jump in? [yn]' when stepping on a trap.
facts.action: Refuse to jump in unless necessary and safe.

facts.fact: A vault teleport may fail if the destination is unsafe.
facts.detect: Teleporting to a vault but not reaching the destination.
facts.action: Avoid vault teleporters if unsure about the safety of the destination.

facts.fact: Teleportation traps can be removed by digging a pit and filling it with a boulder.
facts.detect: Finding a teleportation trap on the map.
facts.action: Dig a pit and fill it with a boulder to remove the trap.

facts.fact: Teleportitis may be gained by eating some corpses, such as leprechaun (50%), wood nymph (30%), water nymph (30%), mountain nymph (30%), tengu (20%), and Wizard of Yendor (25%).
facts.detect: Eating a corpse of the mentioned monsters.
facts.action: Avoid eating these corpses unless you have teleport control or a strategy to manage teleportitis.

facts.fact: Every game turn, there is an 85% chance you will try to teleport if you have teleportitis.
facts.detect: Random teleportation events.
facts.action: Gain teleport control or manage nutrition and energy levels carefully.

facts.fact: If you have teleportitis and reach experience level 12 (or level 8 for a Wizard), you can use ctrl+T to teleport at will, costing 30 points of energy and 100 nutrition.
facts.detect: Reaching level 12 or 8 as a Wizard.
facts.action: Gain teleport control or manage nutrition and energy levels carefully.

facts.fact: If you cannot teleport at will, ctrl+T will attempt to use your teleport away spell or a teleport trap if you are standing on one.
facts.detect: Attempting to teleport at will and failing.
facts.action: Gain teleport control or manage nutrition and energy levels carefully.

facts.fact: If you need to visit a shop with uncontrolled teleportitis, you should drop the exact amount of gold needed for the item on the shop floor to establish a line of credit.
facts.detect: Attempting to shop with uncontrolled teleportitis.
facts.action: Follow the procedure to avoid accidentally stealing items.

facts.fact: A temple has a 1/5 chance of being created in any ordinary room within a standard rooms-and-corridors level that is on or below dungeon level 9.
facts.detect: The bot should notice the presence of a room with an altar and a peaceful priest.
facts.action: The bot should explore rooms with altars and peaceful priests, as they are likely temples.

facts.fact: A temple is considered 'desecrated' if the resident priest is dead or otherwise removed from the room.
facts.detect: The bot should notice the message 'You have a forbidding feeling...' when entering a room.
facts.action: The bot should avoid using the altar or causing disturbances in desecrated temples to prevent ghost generation.

facts.fact: Each time a character enters a desecrated temple, there is a 1/5 chance of a ghost being generated next to the character.
facts.detect: The bot should notice the message 'You have a forbidding feeling...' and the presence of a ghost.
facts.action: The bot should leave desecrated temples immediately to avoid ghost generation and immobilization.

facts.fact: If there is a gas spore in the room, lure it out of the temple before killing it to avoid angering the priest.
facts.detect: The bot should notice the presence of a gas spore in a room with an altar and a priest.
facts.action: The bot should lure the gas spore out of the temple before killing it to avoid making the priest hostile.

facts.fact: After using the altar to beatitude-test rings and scrolls, it's a good idea to leave the temple before using them to avoid angering the priest.
facts.detect: The bot should notice the use of the altar for testing items.
facts.action: The bot should leave the temple immediately after testing items to avoid causing the priest to attack.

facts.fact: Temporary intrinsics from scrolls of resistance, monster corpses/tins/blood, and eating jewelry last for a certain number of turns.
facts.detect: Consuming a corpse, quaffing blood, eating jewelry, or using a scroll of resistance.
facts.action: Keep track of the duration of temporary intrinsics and plan accordingly.

facts.fact: Fire, cold, shock, acid, sleep, and disintegration resistances from consuming corpses/tins/blood last for a duration based on the monster's nutrition and level.
facts.detect: Eating a corpse or quaffing blood.
facts.action: Calculate the duration of the resistance based on the monster's nutrition and level.

facts.fact: Poison resistance, telepathy, teleport control, and teleportitis are always permanent when obtained from consuming a monster.
facts.detect: Eating a corpse or quaffing blood.
facts.action: Recognize that these resistances are permanent and do not expire.

facts.fact: The duration of temporary intrinsics is affected by the hero's size: large heroes halve the duration, small heroes double it.
facts.detect: Hero's size change.
facts.action: Adjust the expected duration of temporary intrinsics based on the hero's size.

facts.fact: Spirit Ahazu bound to the hero reduces the duration of temporary intrinsics by 10%.
facts.detect: Binding Ahazu.
facts.action: Expect temporary intrinsics to last 10% shorter when Ahazu is bound.

facts.fact: A tentacle attack will cause passive attacks from the defender to trigger. Using a tentacle attack on a cockatrice or chickatrice will turn the attacker to stone.
facts.detect: The tentacles suck you! followed by a message indicating stoning
facts.action: Avoid attacking cockatrices or chickatrices with tentacle attacks.

facts.fact: Tentacle attacks have no effect on shades.
facts.detect: Your suck ! followed by Your pass harmlessly through .
facts.action: Tentacle attacks are ineffective against shades.
