facts.action: Use a polymorph trap or wand to change into a monster that can pass through walls.

facts.fact: Kicking a solid rock wall may dislodge embedded items.
facts.detect: Solid rock wall ({{lightgray| }}) with embedded items.
facts.action: Kick the wall to dislodge the item.

facts.fact: Wands have a 1 in 3 chance of exploding when subjected to shock damage.
facts.detect: Explosion sound or message when zapping a wand.
facts.action: Avoid zapping wands when your HP is low or when surrounded by dangerous monsters.

facts.fact: Cursed wands have a 1% chance of exploding if zapped.
facts.detect: Explosion sound or message when zapping a cursed wand.
facts.action: Avoid zapping cursed wands unless absolutely necessary.

facts.fact: Wands of digging can create pits and holes when broken, affecting your square and adjacent squares.
facts.detect: Message indicating pits or holes are created when breaking a wand.
facts.action: Avoid breaking wands of digging unless in a safe area.

facts.fact: Wands of create monster will spawn 9 monsters when broken.
facts.detect: Message indicating monsters are spawned when breaking a wand.
facts.action: Avoid breaking wands of create monster unless in a safe area.

facts.fact: Wands of death will cause an explosion of death damage when broken, identifying the wand.
facts.detect: Message indicating an explosion of death damage when breaking a wand.
facts.action: Avoid breaking wands of death unless in a safe area.

facts.fact: Wands of fire, lightning, and cold provide a powerful ranged attack and can be used to engrave Elbereth.
facts.detect: Item name: wand of fire, lightning, or cold
facts.action: Use these wands to attack monsters from a distance and engrave Elbereth for protection.

facts.fact: Wands of make invisible, teleportation, and cancellation have identical messages when engraving.
facts.detect: Message: 'The engraving on the vanishes!'
facts.action: Use a junk scroll or potion to differentiate between these wands.

facts.fact: Wands of teleportation, make invisible, and cancellation can be identified by zapping them at a junk scroll and a visible undead monster.
facts.detect: Monster: visible undead, Item: junk scroll
facts.action: Zap the wand at both to determine its identity.

facts.fact: Wands of opening can be identified by zapping them at a locked container or door.
facts.detect: Item: locked container or door
facts.action: Zap the wand to see if it unlocks the container or door.

facts.fact: Wands of polymorph can be identified by zapping them at a monster or object.
facts.detect: Monster or object in vicinity
facts.action: Zap the wand to see if it polymorphs the target.

facts.fact: A wand of stasis blocks teleportation on the current dungeon level for {{rn1|21|10}} turns.
facts.detect: When teleporting fails unexpectedly, especially when trying to escape from dangerous situations or monsters.
facts.action: Use the wand of stasis to block teleportation for monsters, but be aware that it also blocks the hero's ability to teleport.

facts.fact: Wands of stasis are generated as blessed {{frac|34}} of the time and cursed {{frac|34}} of the time, and will otherwise be uncursed.
facts.detect: Checking the wand's blessed, cursed, or uncursed status.
facts.action: If the wand is blessed or cursed, it may be beneficial to use it immediately or try to alter its status to uncursed if possible.

facts.fact: Wands of stasis are generated as part of wizard starting inventory.
facts.detect: Checking inventory upon starting as a wizard.
facts.action: If starting as a wizard, be aware of the wand of stasis in inventory and its potential uses.

facts.fact: Zapping a wand of stasis on a level where stasis is already in effect will extend the duration.
facts.detect: Noticing that teleportation is already blocked and zapping the wand.
facts.action: Use the wand to extend the stasis duration if needed.

facts.fact: Engraving with a wand of stasis has the same effect as zapping it.
facts.detect: Engraving a message and noticing that teleportation fails.
facts.action: Use engraving to identify and activate the wand of stasis.

facts.fact: Wand of wishing: See the wand's page for full details. These wands are always good to have.
facts.detect: Wand of wishing
facts.action: Keep the wand of wishing for late-game use or to obtain necessary extrinsics.

facts.fact: Wand of death: A very powerful offensive tool.
facts.detect: Wand of death
facts.action: Use the wand of death as a last-ditch weapon against difficult opponents or endgame threats.

facts.fact: Wand of teleportation: Useful both as an escape item and for teleporting enemies away.
facts.detect: Wand of teleportation
facts.action: Use the wand of teleportation to escape dangerous situations or to teleport enemies away.

facts.fact: Wand of polymorph: Since self polymorph is of limited duration, this wand is useful early on for polymorphing pets or polypiling, and later in order to polyself into a metallivore for jewelry eating.
facts.detect: Wand of polymorph
facts.action: Use the wand of polymorph to polymorph pets or polypile, and later to polyself into a metallivore.

facts.fact: Wand of striking and wand of magic missile: The low damage potential of these wands for ranged attacks makes them less useful as the game progresses.
facts.detect: Wand of striking or wand of magic missile
facts.action: Use and drop these wands early on if you don't have better ranged options.

facts.fact: Wielding Sting provides warning of orcs, meaning all monsters of orc class and any other orcish monster (zombies, mummies).
facts.detect: You are aware of the presence of orcs.
facts.action: Wield Sting to detect orc-related threats.

facts.fact: Wielding Grimtooth provides warning of elves, meaning all elven monsters, elven zombies, and elven mummies.
facts.detect: You are aware of the presence of elves.
facts.action: Wield Grimtooth to detect elven-related threats.

facts.fact: Polymorphing into a vampire or vampire lord provides warning of humans and elves, meaning all monsters of human class, and human zombies and mummies.
facts.detect: You are aware of the presence of humans and elves.
facts.action: Polymorph into a vampire or vampire lord to detect human and elven-related threats.

facts.fact: Polymorphing into a purple worm provides warning of shriekers.
facts.detect: You are aware of the presence of shriekers.
facts.action: Polymorph into a purple worm to detect shriekers.

facts.fact: Warning of humans may be more useful because humans make up a larger fraction of monsters.
facts.detect: You are aware of the presence of humans.
facts.action: Polymorph into a vampire or vampire lord to detect human-related threats.

facts.fact: Warning can be obtained as an extrinsic by wearing a ring of warning or carrying an artifact that grants warning, such as the Orb of Fate or the Master Key of Thievery.
facts.detect: Message: 'Your left/right ring glows !' or 'Your rings both glow !' when wearing a ring of warning.
facts.action: Equip a ring of warning or an artifact that grants warning to detect nearby hostile monsters.

facts.fact: Warning reveals the location of nearby hostile monsters within a ten-tile radius that are at least level 4, marked with numbers from 1 to 5.
facts.detect: Numbers or colored question marks on the map indicating the presence of hostile monsters.
facts.action: Use warning to navigate safely and avoid high-level monsters.

facts.fact: Moving near a hiding monster such as a piercer or trapper while possessing warning will cause you to take a second look close by, revealing the monster.
facts.detect: Taking a second look near a hiding monster.
facts.action: Approach hiding monsters with caution and use warning to reveal them.

facts.fact: Warning produces messages to alert you when you are standing on ice that is going to melt in under 15 turns.
facts.detect: Messages like 'The ice seems very soft and slushy.'
facts.action: Avoid standing on ice that is about to melt.

facts.fact: Warning is a useful property to pair with other means of detecting hostile monsters, such as extrinsic telepathy.
facts.detect: Having both warning and telepathy.
facts.action: Combine warning with telepathy to cover gaps in detection.

facts.fact: Water walls are present on the Plane of Water and in special levels like the Big Room.
facts.detect: Encountering a level with a description mentioning 'Plane of Water' or 'Big Room'.
facts.action: Avoid entering water walls unless necessary, and use appropriate traversal strategies.

facts.fact: Levitation, flight, and water walking boots do not function inside water walls.
facts.detect: Attempting to levitate, fly, or use water walking boots while standing on a water wall.
facts.action: Find an alternative method to cross water walls, such as using a wand of digging or a levitation spell.

facts.fact: Walking into a water wall will always submerge you, similar to walking into a moat.
facts.detect: Attempting to walk into a water wall.
facts.action: Avoid walking into water walls unless you have a way to cross them safely.

facts.fact: Water walls cannot be frozen or boiled away outside the Plane of Water.
facts.detect: Attempting to freeze or boil a water wall outside the Plane of Water.
facts.action: Do not attempt to freeze or boil water walls outside the Plane of Water.

facts.fact: Pushing a boulder into a water wall can remove it outside the Plane of Water.
facts.detect: Having a boulder and standing next to a water wall outside the Plane of Water.
facts.action: Push a boulder into the water wall to remove it.

facts.fact: Wax is flammable.
facts.detect: Item name: wax candle or tallow candle
facts.action: Store wax candles/tallow candles in a safe place to avoid accidental fires.

facts.fact: A hero polymorphed into a gelatinous cube can eat wax objects, breaking vegan conduct.
facts.detect: Polymorphed into a gelatinous cube and eating wax objects.
facts.action: Avoid eating wax objects if maintaining vegan conduct is important.

facts.fact: Polypiling enough wax objects may result in the creation of a straw golem.
facts.detect: Polypiling multiple wax objects.
facts.action: Consider polypiling wax objects to potentially create a straw golem, which can be useful for fall-through purposes.

facts.fact: Most weapons are wielded with 'w' and used to hit enemies; you cannot wield a weapon if you are handless or tiny.
facts.detect: The bot will not have hands or will be tiny.
facts.action: The bot should avoid situations where it loses hands or shrinks to tiny size.

facts.fact: Some weapons are missiles that are designed to be thrown or shot with 't', and others require a launcher to be wielded in order to shoot them as ammo.
facts.detect: The weapon name or description indicates it is a missile or requires a launcher.
facts.action: The bot should use 't' to throw or shoot missiles and ensure it has the correct launcher for ammo-based weapons.

facts.fact: Poisonable weapons are generated as poisoned 1% of the time.
facts.detect: The weapon is described as poisoned.
facts.action: The bot should avoid using poisoned weapons and find a way to neutralize or replace them.

facts.fact: A weapon can be made erodeproof by wielding it as a primary weapon and reading a scroll of enchant weapon while confused.
facts.detect: The weapon is eroding or has a high chance of erosion.
facts.action: The bot should find a scroll of enchant weapon and read it while confused to make the weapon erodeproof.

facts.fact: Weapons have different hit dice against monsters depending on whether they are small or large.
facts.detect: The monster size is noted as small or large.
facts.action: The bot should choose weapons that are effective against the size of the monsters it faces.

facts.fact: Unwielding a weapon is viable if you must take on weapon-hazardous monsters such as acid blobs or rust monsters in melee, provided you lack a resistant weapon (e.g. a silver weapon or unicorn horn).
facts.detect: Encountering acid blobs or rust monsters, or having no silver weapon or unicorn horn.
facts.action: Unwield your weapon when facing acid blobs or rust monsters if you do not have a resistant weapon.

facts.fact: A majority of the most threatening monsters you will face - the Wizard of Yendor, the high priest of Moloch, and many of the Astral Plane denizens - are at least medium-sized.
facts.detect: Encountering the Wizard of Yendor, the high priest of Moloch, or Astral Plane denizens.
facts.action: Prepare to fight medium-sized or larger monsters, especially in the late game and end game.

facts.fact: Most of the demon princes in Gehennom are large minus the dangerous but rarely-seen Dispater.
facts.detect: Encountering demon princes in Gehennom.
facts.action: Be prepared to fight large-sized monsters, especially demon princes in Gehennom.

facts.fact: A weapon-tool has an accompanying weapon skill and can be enchanted under the same rules as regular weapons.
facts.detect: Item name (pick-axe, grappling hook, unicorn horn)
facts.action: Use weapon-tools as weapons to gain weapon skill and enchantment benefits.

facts.fact: A cursed weapon-tool will weld to the hand(s) of a hero or monster that wields one.
facts.detect: Cursed status of a weapon-tool
facts.action: Avoid wielding cursed weapon-tools to prevent welding.

facts.fact: The dwarvish mattock functions as a pick-axe but is considered a weapon, not a weapon-tool.
facts.detect: Item name (dwarvish mattock)
facts.action: Treat the dwarvish mattock as a weapon for weapon skill and conduct purposes.

facts.fact: Axes and battle-axes can be used to chop down doors.
facts.detect: Item name (axe, battle-axe)
facts.action: Use axes and battle-axes to chop down wooden doors.

facts.fact: Using a weapon-tool breaks the weaponless conduct.
facts.detect: Weaponless conduct status
facts.action: Avoid using weapon-tools if maintaining weaponless conduct is important.

facts.fact: You never hit with a wielded weapon if you follow the weaponless conduct.
facts.detect: Checking inventory for weapons or seeing a weapon symbol (})
facts.action: Avoid wielding any weapon, except for specific actions like forcing open chests.

facts.fact: You may still fight bare-handed, throw weapons, throw rocks, and use other offensive techniques such as wands and spells.
facts.detect: Inventory includes bare hands, rocks, or offensive items like wands and spellbooks.
facts.action: Use bare hands, throw weapons, or use offensive items for combat.

facts.fact: The best weapons to throw are daggers, followed by darts.
facts.detect: Inventory includes daggers or darts.
facts.action: Use daggers or darts for ranged attacks.

facts.fact: Avoid the bow, crossbow, sling, and aklys because wielding them will likely result in hitting a monster.
facts.detect: Inventory includes bow, crossbow, sling, or aklys.
facts.action: Do not wield these ranged weapons.

facts.fact: Valkyrie's preferred ranged weapon is dagger (Expert).
facts.detect: Inventory includes daggers.
facts.action: Use daggers for ranged attacks.

facts.fact: Items of armor that layer over the torso must be worn in an 'inner-to-outer' fashion: shirts, then body armor, then cloaks.
facts.detect: Item descriptions or inventory list
facts.action: Wear armor in the correct order to avoid penalties or issues.

facts.fact: Use the {{kbd|shift|T}} command to take off worn armor.
facts.detect: Worn armor in inventory
facts.action: Use shift-T to remove armor when necessary.

facts.fact: Wearing and removing armor takes some time; the number of turns depends on the type of item.
facts.detect: Armor type in inventory
facts.action: Plan actions to avoid critical moments when equipping or removing armor.

facts.fact: To wear accessories such as rings or amulets, use {{kbd|shift|P}} to put on the item.
facts.detect: Accessories in inventory
facts.action: Use shift-P to equip accessories.

facts.fact: You can determine the bonus of enchanted armor by wearing it to see the change in armor class.
facts.detect: Change in armor class message
facts.action: Wear armor to identify its enchantment level.

facts.fact: A web is a type of non-magical trap that appears in NetHack and uses a double quotation mark glyph ("), preventing movement.
facts.detect: The map feature with a double quotation mark ("")
facts.action: Avoid stepping on it or use a wand of fire to burn it away if you have one.

facts.fact: A hero stepping onto a web square and being caught will be trapped for 0-12 turns, depending on their strength.
facts.detect: Message: 'You stumble into spider web!' or 'You float into spider web!' or 'You lead into spider web!'
facts.action: If you have Sting, escape in 1 turn. Otherwise, wait it out or burn the web if you have a wand of fire.

facts.fact: A hero with a strength of 18/50 or higher can destroy a web instantly upon stepping on it.
facts.detect: Your strength is 18/50 or higher
facts.action: Step on the web to destroy it.

facts.fact: Giant spiders and other specified monsters can move into webs without becoming stuck.
facts.detect: A giant spider or other specified monster (cave spider, amoeboid monster, whirly monster) is present
facts.action: Let them move through webs to clear a path.

facts.fact: Webs can be burnt away using a wand of fire.
facts.detect: You have a wand of fire
facts.action: Use the wand to burn away webs.

facts.fact: Carrying too much weight increases the hero's encumbrance, which can render them burdened, stressed, or worse, and lowers their movement speed.
facts.detect: Hero's movement speed decreases, or messages like 'You are burdened', 'You are stressed', etc.
facts.action: Drop or store heavy items to reduce encumbrance.

facts.fact: A bag of holding reduces the weight of its contents by half for an uncursed bag and by 75% for a blessed bag.
facts.detect: Bag of holding in inventory.
facts.action: Use a blessed bag of holding to store heavy items.

facts.fact: The weight of a loadstone is 500 aum.
facts.detect: Loadstone in inventory.
facts.action: Avoid picking up loadstones or drop them if encumbered.

facts.fact: The weight of a human corpse is 1450 aum.
facts.detect: Human corpse on the ground.
facts.action: Avoid picking up human corpses unless absolutely necessary.

facts.fact: The weight of a boulder is 6000 aum.
facts.detect: Boulder on the ground.
facts.action: Avoid picking up boulders.

facts.fact: Werecreatures are chaotic and omnivorous humans that can shapeshift between human and animal forms, and can infect heroes with lycanthropy via their bite attack.
facts.detect: Message: You feel feverish.
facts.action: Avoid melee combat with werecreatures in animal form and carry a silver weapon if possible.

facts.fact: Werecreature corpses are poisonous and eating them will cause lycanthropy.
facts.detect: Message: You feel feverish after eating a corpse or tin.
facts.action: Avoid eating corpses or tins of werecreatures.

facts.fact: Werecreatures can summon up to 5 monsters of the same or similar species when in melee range.
facts.detect: Message: The summons help!
facts.action: Be prepared to deal with multiple monsters if a werecreature summons help.

facts.fact: Heroes infected with lycanthropy will drop excess weight and armor that cannot be worn in animal form, and destroy body armor if turning into a werewolf.
facts.detect: Message: You feel feverish and notice changes in your inventory.
facts.action: Avoid lycanthropy to retain full use of equipment.

facts.fact: Silver weapons deal significant damage to werecreatures.
facts.detect: Monster name: Silver weapon
facts.action: Carry a silver weapon to effectively deal with werecreatures.

facts.fact: Dipping into a pool, moat, or uncursed potion of water will always wet an object, but never the contents of containers.
facts.detect: You are standing next to a pool, moat, or uncursed potion of water.
facts.action: Dip objects into the water to wet them, but avoid dipping containers to prevent diluting their contents.

facts.fact: A potion of acid will explode if dipped into water, dealing d10 damage.
facts.detect: You have a potion of acid in your inventory.
facts.action: Avoid dipping a potion of acid into water to prevent explosion.

facts.fact: Scrolls and spellbooks become blank when wet, but the Book of the Dead cannot become blank.
facts.detect: You have scrolls or spellbooks in your inventory.
facts.action: Dip scrolls or spellbooks into water to make them blank, but avoid dipping the Book of the Dead.

facts.fact: Iron objects might become one step more rusty when wet (50% chance).
facts.detect: You have iron objects in your inventory.
facts.action: Be cautious when wetting iron objects, as they may rust.

facts.fact: Fountains can curse items or summon dangerous monsters.
facts.detect: You are near a fountain.
facts.action: Avoid dipping in fountains unless prepared to deal with curses or dangerous monsters.

facts.fact: The '/ (what is) command can be used to identify unknown objects or symbols on the map.
facts.detect: Cursor select prompt: 'Specify unknown object by cursor? [ynq] (q)'
facts.action: Use the cursor to select an unknown symbol and press '/' to get information about it.

facts.fact: Pressing '?' during cursor select provides movement instructions to navigate the map.
facts.detect: Cursor select prompt: 'Please move the cursor to an unknown object. (For instructions type a ?)'
facts.action: Press '?' to get movement instructions and navigate to an unknown symbol.

facts.fact: Pressing 'm' or 'M' during cursor select moves the cursor to the next monster.
facts.detect: Cursor select prompt: 'Use 'm' or 'M' to move the cursor to next monster.'
facts.action: Press 'm' or 'M' to find and identify the next monster on the map.

facts.fact: Pressing 'a' or 'A' during cursor select moves the cursor to the next interesting object.
facts.detect: Cursor select prompt: 'Use 'a' or 'A' to move the cursor to anything interesting.'
facts.action: Press 'a' or 'A' to find and identify the next interesting object on the map.

facts.fact: Pressing 'x' or 'X' during cursor select moves the cursor to an unexplored location.
facts.detect: Cursor select prompt: 'Use 'x' or 'X' to move the cursor to unexplored location.'
facts.action: Press 'x' or 'X' to explore uncharted areas of the map.

facts.fact: All whirlies have an engulfing attack.
facts.detect: When the bot encounters a fog cloud, dust vortex, ice vortex, energy vortex, steam vortex, or air elemental.
facts.action: Avoid being engulfed by these monsters, possibly by using ranged attacks or spells, or by moving to a safe location.

facts.fact: Applying a stethoscope inside a whirly monster may fail.
facts.detect: When the bot attempts to use a stethoscope inside a whirly monster.
facts.action: Avoid using a stethoscope inside a whirly monster.

facts.fact: Whirly monsters can pass unharmed through spider webs, bear traps, and iron bars.
facts.detect: When the bot encounters a whirly monster near a spider web, bear trap, or iron bar.
facts.action: Be aware that whirlies can move through these obstacles without harm.

facts.fact: You cannot be punished while whirly.
facts.detect: When the bot is polymorphed into a whirly monster.
facts.action: If punished, becoming a whirly can remove the punishment.

facts.fact: Whirly monsters may be generated on the Plane of Air.
facts.detect: When the bot teleports or descends to the Plane of Air.
facts.action: Be prepared to encounter whirlies on the Plane of Air.

facts.fact: White dragon scale mail provides cold resistance and base AC of 9.
facts.detect: Wearing white dragon scale mail
facts.action: Equip white dragon scale mail to gain cold resistance and improve AC.

facts.fact: Uncontrolled polymorph while wearing white dragon scale mail will revert them to scales and turn the wearer into a white dragon.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a white dragon
facts.action: Avoid uncontrolled polymorph while wearing white dragon scale mail.

facts.fact: White dragon scale mail provides slow digestion.
facts.detect: Wearing white dragon scale mail
facts.action: Equip white dragon scale mail to benefit from slow digestion.

facts.fact: Valkyries start with cold resistance, making white dragon scale mail less useful.
facts.detect: Character is a Valkyrie
facts.action: Do not prioritize obtaining white dragon scale mail.

facts.fact: White dragon scales confer 3 base AC and cold resistance.
facts.detect: Wearing white dragon scales
facts.action: Wear them if you need cold resistance or AC boost.

facts.fact: White dragon scales dropped by a white dragon are always generated +0 and uncursed.
facts.detect: Finding uncursed white dragon scales
facts.action: Pick them up if you need cold resistance or AC boost.

facts.fact: Reading a non-cursed scroll of enchant armor on white dragon scales will convert them into white dragon scale mail.
facts.detect: Reading a scroll of enchant armor while wearing white dragon scales
facts.action: Convert them into scale mail if you have a scroll of enchant armor.

facts.fact: Uncontrolled polymorph while wearing white dragon scales will turn the wearer into a white dragon.
facts.detect: Polymorphing while wearing white dragon scales
facts.action: Avoid polymorphing while wearing them to prevent turning into a white dragon.

facts.fact: White dragon scales provide slow digestion.
facts.detect: Wearing white dragon scales
facts.action: Wear them if you need to keep fed and have cold resistance.

facts.fact: Never explore while Burdened or worse. Speed is a major issue.
facts.detect: Status message indicating Burdened or worse condition
facts.action: Drop excess items or find a safe place to rest and wait until unburdened

facts.fact: Every room has a way out. If none is apparent, search for it by hitting s on every step along the wall or at the dead end of a corridor.
facts.detect: Reaching a room with no apparent exit
facts.action: Search every wall and dead end for a secret door or passage

facts.fact: Every level has a way down. Look on the map for a large, empty area where an additional, undiscovered room might fit and search along adjacent walls or suspiciously shaped corridors.
facts.detect: Exploring a level without finding stairs
facts.action: Search for hidden stairs by searching walls and suspiciously shaped corridors

facts.fact: Darts, arrows, and rocks on the ground may be traps. Beware, these may be poisoned and cause insta-death.
facts.detect: Seeing darts, arrows, or rocks on the ground
facts.action: Avoid stepping on them and be cautious of poison resistance

facts.fact: There is no need to drink water. In fact, quaffing potions of water is a big waste of resources.
facts.detect: Seeing a potion of water
facts.action: Avoid drinking potions of water and save them for other uses

facts.fact: A wide-angle disintegration beam is the follow-up attack from an angry god if you survive a lightning bolt and have no disintegration resistance.
facts.detect: The bot will receive a message indicating the god's wrath and the disintegration beam attack.
facts.action: Prioritize obtaining disintegration resistance or reflection before angering the god.

facts.fact: If the bot is engulfed by a shock-resistant monster, the disintegration beam will hit the monster instead.
facts.detect: Engulfed by a shock-resistant monster (e.g., energy vortex).
facts.action: Avoid angering the god while engulfed by a shock-resistant monster.

facts.fact: The bot's shield, cloak, and body armor will be disintegrated unless they provide reflection or disintegration resistance.
facts.detect: The bot's equipment being disintegrated after the beam attack.
facts.action: Equip items with disintegration resistance or reflection.

facts.fact: If the bot is wearing a shirt and no body armor or cloak, the shirt will be disintegrated.
facts.detect: The bot's shirt being disintegrated after the beam attack.
facts.action: Wear body armor or cloak to protect the shirt.

facts.fact: The bot will be killed outright by the beam if there is no disintegration resistance, but life saving will prevent death.
facts.detect: The bot's HP dropping to zero after the beam attack.
facts.action: Ensure life saving is available before angering the god.

facts.fact: Press w to wield a weapon.
facts.detect: The bot can notice the situation when it needs to attack a monster or use a ranged weapon.
facts.action: The bot should press 'w' to wield a weapon before attacking or using a ranged weapon.

facts.fact: You can wield items other than weapons, such as a pick-axe, tin opener, polearm, lance, or lamp.
facts.detect: The bot can detect these items in its inventory.
facts.action: The bot should wield these items when needed, such as using a pick-axe to open a tin or wielding a lamp to light up dark areas.

facts.fact: Wielding a cursed item can remove the curse using an uncursed scroll of remove curse or unskilled spell.
facts.detect: The bot can detect a cursed item in its inventory and an uncursed scroll of remove curse.
facts.action: The bot should wield the cursed item and use an uncursed scroll of remove curse to remove the curse.

facts.fact: Wielding a cockatrice or chickatrice corpse can be used as a potent weapon, but requires gloves to avoid petrification.
facts.detect: The bot can detect a cockatrice or chickatrice corpse in its inventory and gloves in its equipment.
facts.action: The bot should wield the cockatrice or chickatrice corpse if it has gloves equipped.

facts.fact: Certain artifact weapons give special effects when wielded, such as magic resistance, hungerless regeneration, and drain resistance.
facts.detect: The bot can detect artifact weapons in its inventory.
facts.action: The bot should wield these artifact weapons to benefit from their special effects.

facts.fact: Using #wipe removes the offending gunk from your face in one quarter of the time it would take to disappear normally.
facts.detect: Your face is blinded by a cream pie, blinding venom, or a cursed towel.
facts.action: Use the #wipe command to quickly remove the gunk from your face.

facts.fact: Attempting to use #wipe when there is nothing to wipe off will result in the message 'Your face is already clean'.
facts.detect: Message: 'Your face is already clean'.
facts.action: Do nothing, as there is no need to wipe your face.

facts.fact: Applying a non-cursed towel can do the same in one move, but #wipe has the advantage of being always available.
facts.detect: Item: non-cursed towel.
facts.action: Use a non-cursed towel to remove the gunk from your face if available.

facts.fact: Once you have telepathy or warning, it is usually better to simply wait the blinding out and keep fighting.
facts.detect: Intrinsic: telepathy or warning.
facts.action: Wait for the blinding to wear off instead of using #wipe.

facts.fact: Monks and vegetarians who can't easily get intrinsic telepathy may find #wipe handy more often.
facts.detect: Character: monk or vegetarian without intrinsic telepathy.
facts.action: Use #wipe more frequently if you are a monk or vegetarian without intrinsic telepathy.

facts.fact: Wisdom is exercised by engraving Elbereth with correct capitalization
facts.detect: The bot should notice when it successfully engraves 'Elbereth' with correct capitalization
facts.action: The bot should engrave 'Elbereth' to increase wisdom

facts.fact: Wisdom is exercised by discovering a trap on an object or door
facts.detect: The bot should notice when it discovers a trap on an object or door
facts.action: The bot should actively search for traps to increase wisdom

facts.fact: Wisdom is exercised by quaffing holy water while not chaotic
facts.detect: The bot should notice when it quaffs holy water and is not chaotic
facts.action: The bot should quaff holy water to increase wisdom

facts.fact: Wisdom is exercised by detecting gold, food, or the map layout via any means
facts.detect: The bot should notice when it detects gold, food, or the map layout
facts.action: The bot should use detection spells or items to increase wisdom

facts.fact: Wisdom is abused by being confused or hallucinating (once every five turns)
facts.detect: The bot should notice when it becomes confused or hallucinates
facts.action: The bot should avoid actions that lead to confusion or hallucination to prevent wisdom loss

facts.fact: A wand of wishing grants a total of three wishes.
facts.detect: Engraving or zapping a wand of wishing
facts.action: Use the wand of wishing to engrave or zap for wishes

facts.fact: A blessed magic lamp grants 0.8 wishes on average.
facts.detect: Rubbing a blessed magic lamp
facts.action: Rub a blessed magic lamp to get a wish

facts.fact: A blessed smoky potion grants, on average, 4/65 + 10d wishes.
facts.detect: Quaffing a blessed smoky potion
facts.action: Quaff a blessed smoky potion to get a wish

facts.fact: Sitting on a throne grants about 1/3 wishes.
facts.detect: Sitting on a throne
facts.action: Sit on a throne to get a wish

facts.fact: The Castle always has a wand of wishing in a chest in one of the four corner rooms.
facts.detect: Exploring the Castle
facts.action: Search the Castle for a wand of wishing

facts.detect: Wand of wishing with unknown charges

facts.fact: The best early wish is either 'blessed greased +2 gray dragon scale mail' or 'blessed greased +2 silver dragon scale mail', depending on whether you need magic resistance or reflection.
facts.detect: Early game, need for magic resistance or reflection
facts.action: Wish for the appropriate dragon scale mail

facts.fact: If you encounter a wand of wishing in a shop, you can wish for 5000 zorkmids to buy the wand and leave with a profit.
facts.detect: Wand of wishing in a shop
facts.action: Wish for 5000 zorkmids

facts.fact: Avoid wishing for cross-aligned quest artifacts as they will evade your grasp and fall to the floor.
facts.detect: Cross-aligned quest artifact name

facts.fact: Avoid wishing for dragon scale mail in the mid to late game if you can confidently write cursed scrolls of genocide.
facts.detect: Mid to late game, need for dragon scale mail
facts.action: Wish for an uncursed magic marker instead

facts.fact: Monsters will never wish for items they cannot use, such as a chickatrice corpse for monsters lacking gloves and stoning resistance.
facts.detect: Monster lacking gloves or stoning resistance attempting to pick up a chickatrice corpse.
facts.action: Ignore the monster's attempt to wish for a chickatrice corpse.

facts.fact: Wishing for artifacts has a success rate of 1/(X + 1), where X is the number of previous artifact wishes made.
facts.detect: Attempting to wish for an artifact.
facts.action: Consider the number of previous artifact wishes before attempting another.

facts.fact: Certain artifacts cannot be wished for, such as the Lifestealer, which is always generated in the possession of Vlad the Impaler.
facts.detect: Attempting to wish for Lifestealer.
facts.action: Do not wish for Lifestealer.

facts.fact: Monsters will randomly wish for items such as blessed erodeproofed amulet of life saving or blessed erodeproofed cloak of magic resistance.
facts.detect: Monster using a wand of wishing or smoky potion.
facts.action: Be prepared for the monster to gain powerful items.

facts.fact: Monsters will not wish for items that grant properties they already have.
facts.detect: Monster with high stats or properties using a wand of wishing.
facts.action: Expect the monster to wish for something else.

facts.fact: The difficulty of killer bees and soldier ants has increased to 6 and 7 respectively.
facts.detect: Encountering killer bees or soldier ants in the early game.
facts.action: Avoid or prepare for combat with these monsters by ensuring you have appropriate weapons and armor.

facts.fact: A Wizard should prioritize obtaining a luckstone or other luck-boosting item in the mid-game.
facts.detect: Reaching experience level 14 without a luckstone.
facts.action: Seek out Mines' End or Sokoban to find a luckstone or other luck-boosting items.

facts.fact: Most Wizards should have Magicbane by the mid-game, which provides strong effects even if not the primary melee weapon.
facts.detect: Finding Magicbane in the game.
facts.action: Wield Magicbane to take advantage of its magic resistance and curse nullification properties.

facts.fact: The Eye of the Aethiopica, the quest artifact, is extremely useful for energy regeneration and branchporting.
facts.detect: Completing the Wizard quest and obtaining the Eye of the Aethiopica.
facts.action: Use the Eye's abilities to farm altars, lure wraiths, and create favorable combat scenarios.

facts.fact: The finger of death should have a reliable success rate in the late game, allowing for saving wand charges for dire encounters.
facts.detect: Reaching a high enough level to cast finger of death reliably.
facts.action: Use finger of death to conserve wand charges for critical situations.

facts.fact: The Lonely Tower has eight apprentices spread throughout the tower.
facts.detect: Encountering apprentices in the Lonely Tower.
facts.action: Engage in dialogue with Neferet the Green and her apprentices to gain encouragement and hints.

facts.fact: The Lonely Tower has six random traps on the level.
facts.detect: Stepping on a trap and triggering it.
facts.action: Be cautious and use tools like a wand of cancellation or a magic marker to detect and disarm traps.

facts.fact: The Tower of Darkness has an anti-magic trap in the innermost chamber.
facts.detect: Stepping on a trap and being unable to use magic.
facts.action: Avoid the innermost chamber or disarm the trap before entering.

facts.fact: The Dark One's Dungeon has eight vampire bats, eleven random B, and eight random i.
facts.detect: Encountering these monsters on the level.
facts.action: Be prepared with ranged attacks or spells to deal with these hostile monsters.

facts.fact: The Dark One is immune to most magical attacks.
facts.detect: Chatting with Neferet the Green or encountering the Dark One.
facts.action: Focus on physical attacks or the Eye of the Aethiopica to defeat the Dark One.

facts.fact: There is a high chance of encountering a polymorph trap on the home level.
facts.detect: Message: 'You step on a polymorph trap!'
facts.action: Be cautious and prepared for polymorphing into a different form, possibly an out-of-depth monster.

facts.fact: The locate level moat has a roughly 12% chance of blocking off the tower.

facts.action: Use a pet or a bridge to cross the moat if it blocks the path.

facts.fact: Newt and Pug on the goal level are likely to have useful items.

facts.action: Use a pet to kill Newt or Pug to obtain useful items like an athame.

facts.fact: Players should avoid alignment record and murder penalties when seeking items from Newt and Pug.
facts.detect: Message: 'You gain alignment record penalty.' or 'You gain murder penalty.'
facts.action: Use a pet to kill Newt or Pug instead of killing them directly.

facts.detect: Arriving at a level with a magic portal and a central tower surrounded by a maze.

facts.fact: The bottom level of the Wizard's Tower contains a vampire lord, a random lich, and dangerous monsters like giant eels and krakens in the moat.
facts.detect: Encountering a vampire lord or a lich, or seeing giant eels and krakens in the moat.

facts.fact: The middle level of the Wizard's Tower contains a random amulet in a small room and various traps.

facts.fact: The top level of the Wizard's Tower contains the Wizard of Yendor standing on the Book of the Dead, surrounded by dangerous monsters and traps.
facts.detect: Encountering the Wizard of Yendor or seeing the Book of the Dead.
facts.action: Use a mind flayer's psychic blast, a drum of earthquake, or a magic whistle to avoid combat.

facts.fact: The top level of the Wizard's Tower has squeaky boards around the Wizard of Yendor.

facts.fact: Gelatinous cubes will engulf and eat any wooden items they come across.
facts.detect: Gelatinous cube on the map
facts.action: Avoid letting gelatinous cubes come into contact with wooden items.

facts.fact: Polyself into a gelatinous cube allows you to eat wooden items, which can be occasionally useful for eating wooden rings to gain intrinsics.
facts.detect: Wooden rings in inventory
facts.action: Polymorph into a gelatinous cube to eat wooden rings for intrinsics.

facts.fact: All worms are slithy, carnivorous animals that are large or bigger and have no limbs.

facts.fact: Wounded legs reduces dexterity by one and carrying capacity by 100 aum, and prevents jumping, kicking, and riding.

facts.fact: Successful prayer can heal wounded legs, considered a minor trouble by the hero's deity.

facts.fact: A hero reading a non-cursed scroll of enchant armor that targets worn yellow dragon scales will convert them into mail, with a blessed scroll adding a point of enchantment.
facts.detect: Reading a scroll of enchant armor while wearing yellow dragon scale mail
facts.action: Use a blessed scroll of enchant armor to increase the enchantment of yellow dragon scale mail.

facts.fact: Uncontrolled polymorph while wearing yellow dragon scale mail will revert them to scales and turn the wearer into a yellow dragon.
facts.detect: Polymorphing into a yellow dragon
facts.action: Avoid uncontrolled polymorph while wearing yellow dragon scale mail.

facts.fact: Yellow dragon scale mail is not randomly generated, though it can be wished for or found in bones.
facts.detect: Wishing for yellow dragon scale mail or finding bones
facts.action: Wish for or seek bones containing yellow dragon scale mail.

facts.fact: Player monsters that are not monks generated on the Astral Plane have a 9/10 chance of generating with yellow dragon scale mail as their initial body armor.
facts.detect: Generating on the Astral Plane as a player monster
facts.action: Check for yellow dragon scale mail as initial body armor.

facts.fact: Yellow dragon scales grant acid resistance and 3 base AC.
facts.detect: Wearing yellow dragon scales
facts.action: Wear yellow dragon scales for acid resistance and AC bonus.

facts.fact: Yellow dragon scales have a 1/3 chance of being dropped by a yellow dragon's corpse.
facts.detect: Yellow dragon corpse
facts.action: Search yellow dragon corpse for yellow dragon scales.

facts.fact: Yellow dragon scales can be converted into yellow dragon scale mail by reading a scroll of enchant armor.
facts.detect: Wearing yellow dragon scales and having a scroll of enchant armor
facts.action: Read scroll of enchant armor to convert yellow dragon scales into yellow dragon scale mail.

facts.fact: Uncontrolled polymorph while wearing yellow dragon scales will turn the wearer into a yellow dragon.
facts.detect: Polymorph message while wearing yellow dragon scales
facts.action: Avoid uncontrolled polymorph while wearing yellow dragon scales.

facts.fact: Yellow dragon scales provide stoning resistance in NetHack 3.7.0.
facts.detect: Wearing yellow dragon scales in NetHack 3.7.0
facts.action: Wear yellow dragon scales for stoning resistance in NetHack 3.7.0.

facts.fact: Yendorian army members are chaotic and can follow the player to other levels.
facts.detect: Encountering soldiers, sergeants, lieutenants, or captains in the dungeon.
facts.action: Avoid chaotic alignment effects and be cautious when moving to new levels.

facts.fact: Yendorian army members have low monster magic resistance.
facts.detect: Observing that soldiers, sergeants, lieutenants, or captains are not avoiding magical attacks.
facts.action: Use magic or wands with magical effects against them.

facts.fact: Yendorian army members can generate with bugles, especially sergeants and above.
facts.detect: Finding a bugle in the inventory of a sergeant, lieutenant, or captain.
facts.action: Collect bugles for potential use in the Astral or Ethereal planes.

facts.fact: Yendorian army members can generate with C-ration and K-ration food items.
facts.detect: Finding C-ration or K-ration in the inventory of a soldier, sergeant, lieutenant, or captain.
facts.action: Collect and eat C-rations and K-rations for quick nutrition.

facts.fact: Yendorian army members can be bribed with gold to become peaceful.
facts.detect: Having gold and encountering soldiers, sergeants, lieutenants, or captains.
facts.action: Bribe them to block hallways and control monster movement.

facts.fact: The Yeoman quest involves fighting Colonel Blood for The Crown of Saint Edward.
facts.detect: Colonel Blood
facts.action: Search for and defeat Colonel Blood to obtain the Crown of Saint Edward.

facts.fact: The home level is London, with a Chief Yeoman Warder and 11 Yeoman Warders.
facts.detect: Chief Yeoman Warder
facts.action: Speak to the Chief Yeoman Warder to receive the quest.

facts.fact: The locate level is The inner ward, with peaceful watch captains, watchmen, and prisoners.
facts.detect: Watch captain
facts.action: Explore the inner ward carefully to avoid angering the watchmen.

facts.fact: The goal level is The Sword Room, where Colonel Blood is located.
facts.detect: Sword Room
facts.action: Proceed to the Sword Room to confront Colonel Blood.

facts.fact: The quest nemesis is Colonel Blood, who will try to divert attention.
facts.detect: Colonel Blood's maledictions
facts.action: Ignore distractions and focus on finding the Crown of Saint Edward.

facts.fact: Hitting a floating eye in melee combat, then getting nibbled to death by a newt while paralyzed
facts.detect: Floating eye, newt, paralysis message
facts.action: Avoid melee combat with floating eyes and be cautious around newts when paralyzed

facts.fact: Not noticing that your character has gotten weak from hunger, then being attacked while fainted
facts.detect: Hunger messages, fainting message
facts.action: Eat food to maintain high nutrition and avoid fainting

facts.fact: Touching, eating, fighting bare-handed, or otherwise manipulating a cockatrice, its corpse, or its egg
facts.detect: Cockatrice, cockatrice corpse, cockatrice egg
facts.action: Avoid touching or eating cockatrice-related items

facts.fact: Drowning in water or lava
facts.detect: Water or lava on the map
facts.action: Avoid walking into water or lava

facts.fact: Dying in possession of an identified amulet of life saving, but not wearing it simply because you forgot to put it on
facts.detect: Identified amulet of life saving in inventory
facts.action: Wear the amulet of life saving when in danger

facts.fact: You feel that eating was a bad idea.
facts.detect: Eating a cat or dog corpse
facts.action: Avoid eating cats or dogs unless you are an orc or Caveman

facts.fact: You feel less attractive.
facts.detect: Gremlin attack at night
facts.action: Avoid gremlins at night

facts.fact: You feel very firm.
facts.detect: Eating a black dragon corpse
facts.action: Eat black dragon corpse to gain disintegration resistance

facts.fact: You feel sensitive!
facts.detect: Reaching XL 7 as a Monk or XL 15 as a Caveman, Healer, Priest, or Wizard
facts.action: Be cautious of level drain

facts.fact: You feel healthy.
facts.detect: Reaching XL 3 as a Monk or eating a quasit or killer bee corpse
facts.action: Gain poison resistance

facts.fact: You feel your magical energy drain away. | You stepped on an anti-magic trap and your energy was drained.
facts.detect: Message: You feel your magical energy drain away.
facts.action: Avoid stepping on traps or use magic resistance to prevent energy drain.

facts.fact: You feel momentarily lethargic. | As above, but your maximum energy was already 0.
facts.detect: Message: You feel momentarily lethargic.
facts.action: Avoid stepping on traps or use magic resistance to prevent energy drain.

facts.fact: You feel sluggish. | You stepped on an anti-magic trap, but had magic resistance and instead took damage that was less than 1/4 of your HP.
facts.detect: Message: You feel sluggish.
facts.action: Use magic resistance to avoid damage from anti-magic traps.

facts.fact: You feel very lethargic. | As above, but the resulting damage was at least 1/4 of your HP.
facts.detect: Message: You feel very lethargic.
facts.action: Use magic resistance to avoid damage from anti-magic traps.

facts.fact: You feel unbearably torpid! | As above, but you were killed by the implosion from HP loss.
facts.detect: Message: You feel unbearably torpid!
facts.action: Avoid stepping on traps or use magic resistance to prevent energy drain.

page: You have a normal feeling for a moment, then it passes.

facts.fact: You are hallucinating.
facts.detect: You have a normal feeling for a moment, then it passes.
facts.action: Prepare for potential hallucination effects such as seeing objects as other objects, or monsters as peaceful. Use tools like a unicorn horn or a blessed hallucinogen antidote if available.

page: You have a strange feeling for a moment then it passes

facts.fact: Scroll of destroy armor produces the message if you are not wearing any armor.
facts.detect: Message: 'You have a strange feeling for a moment then it passes.'
facts.action: Do not read the scroll if you are not wearing armor.

facts.fact: Scroll of enchant armor produces the message if you are not wearing any armor.
facts.detect: Message: 'You have a strange feeling for a moment then it passes.'
facts.action: Do not read the scroll if you are not wearing armor.

facts.fact: Scroll of food detection produces the message if there is no food on the level.
facts.detect: Message: 'You have a strange feeling for a moment then it passes.'
facts.action: Do not read the scroll if you are hungry and there is no food on the level.

facts.fact: Scroll of gold detection produces the message if there is no gold on the level.
facts.detect: Message: 'You have a strange feeling for a moment then it passes.'
facts.action: Do not read the scroll if you are in a level where you expect to find gold and there is none.

facts.fact: Potion of object detection produces the message if there are no objects on the level.
facts.detect: Message: 'You have a strange feeling for a moment then it passes.'
facts.action: Do not drink the potion if you are on a level where you expect to find objects and there are none.

facts.fact: You hear the howling of the CwnAnnwn...|You have less than 1/10 of your maximum hit points left.
facts.detect: You hear the howling of the CwnAnnwn
facts.action: Seek immediate healing or retreat to safety.

facts.fact: You hear the wailing of the Banshee...|You have only 1 hit point left.
facts.detect: You hear the wailing of the Banshee
facts.action: Seek immediate healing or retreat to safety.

facts.fact: You hear a zap.|An unseen monster zapped a wand.
facts.detect: You hear a zap
facts.action: Look for the source of the zap and prepare to defend yourself.

facts.fact: You hear a chugging sound.|An unseen monster drank a potion.
facts.detect: You hear a chugging sound
facts.action: Look for the source of the sound to identify the monster and its potential threat.

facts.fact: You hear a door unlock and open.|A monster opened an unseen door that was locked.
facts.detect: You hear a door unlock and open
facts.action: Be cautious and prepare for a possible ambush.

facts.fact: A non-directional wand will immediately take effect when zapped.
facts.detect: Selecting a non-directional wand such as wand of light or wand of wishing
facts.action: Zap the wand immediately to use its effect

facts.fact: A directional wand will prompt the player for a direction to zap the wand in.
facts.detect: Selecting a directional wand such as wand of striking
facts.action: Choose a direction to zap the wand

facts.fact: A cursed wand with charges has a 100% chance of exploding when zapped.
facts.detect: Selecting a cursed wand
facts.action: Avoid zapping cursed wands to prevent damage

facts.fact: Zapping a wand will identify it if the hero can see its effects.
facts.detect: Zapping a wand
facts.action: Zap wands to identify them

facts.fact: Monsters can zap wands to attack the hero with certain wands.
facts.detect: Messages like ' zaps a !' or 'You hear a zap.'
facts.action: Be prepared for attacks from wands when monsters are nearby

facts.fact: All zombies are chaotic, mindless humanoid undead that possess unbreathing and infravision, and are inedible.
facts.detect: Monster name: 'zombie'
facts.action: Avoid eating zombie corpses and be cautious of their infravision.

facts.fact: A hero of experience level 6 or higher that uses the #turn command to turn back undead has a chance of instantly destroying zombies if they are close enough, or else pacifying them if the hero is chaotic.
facts.detect: Hero level >= 6 and using #turn command near a zombie.
facts.action: Use #turn command to destroy or pacify zombies when level 6 or higher.

facts.fact: Zombies can follow a hero to another level if they are adjacent.
facts.detect: Adjacent to a zombie and moving to a new level.
facts.action: Avoid moving to a new level when adjacent to a zombie.

facts.fact: Zombies are frequently found in graveyards, where they are always generated hostile and asleep.
facts.detect: Entering a graveyard.
facts.action: Be cautious and prepared for combat when entering graveyards.

facts.fact: Zombies are considered corpseless, with a special case that generates an aged corpse of their living counterpart when they would leave a corpse upon 'death'.
facts.detect: Zombie corpse left behind after combat.
facts.action: Do not eat zombie corpses and be aware that they leave aged corpses of their living counterparts.

facts.fact: All monsters in the zombie monster class are chaotic, mindless humanoid undead that possess unbreathing and infravision.
facts.detect: Monster name (e.g., 'kobold zombie', 'dwarf zombie')
facts.action: Approach with caution, especially if the bot is not a martial role or does not have infravision.

facts.fact: All monsters in the zombie monster class have cold resistance, sleep resistance and poison resistance.
facts.detect: Monster name (e.g., 'kobold zombie', 'dwarf zombie')
facts.action: Avoid using cold, sleep, or poison attacks on these monsters.

facts.fact: All monsters in the zombie monster class are inedible—the ghoul is special cased with the ability to eat old and tainted corpses and stale eggs, but will not starve for lack of nutrition.
facts.detect: Monster name (e.g., 'kobold zombie', 'dwarf zombie')
facts.action: Do not attempt to eat any corpse left by a zombie.

facts.fact: Zombie monsters commonly populate graveyards, where they are always generated hostile and asleep at level creation, and typically make up more than half of a graveyard's monsters.
facts.detect: Entering a graveyard level
facts.action: Be cautious and prepared for a large number of hostile zombies.

facts.fact: Digging up a grave has a 1/5 chance of generating a non-skeleton zombie monster.
facts.detect: Digging up a grave
facts.action: Be prepared for a zombie to appear after digging up a grave.

facts.fact: A zoo can be randomly generated on any level in the main branch beneath level 6, with a one in seven chance unless the level already has a shop, a throne room, or a leprechaun hall.
facts.detect: You hear a sound reminiscent of an elephant stepping on a peanut.
facts.action: Check for a zoo and prepare to use stealth or pets to manage the sleeping monsters.

facts.fact: The top floor of Sokoban always has a zoo at the end of the fourth floor, with the closets containing the Sokoban prize behind it.
facts.detect: You are on the top floor of Sokoban and have reached the end of the fourth floor.
facts.action: Expect a zoo and prepare to manage it carefully to reach the Sokoban prize.

facts.fact: Fort Ludios has a zoo in the frontmost section of the level, which is the first room the player must pass through.
facts.detect: You enter Fort Ludios and hear an alarm sound.
facts.action: Be prepared for immediate combat without stealth as the alarm wakes all monsters.

facts.fact: In the Tourist quest, a zoo can be found on the eastern end of the locate level, the Thieves' Guild Hall.
facts.detect: You are in the Thieves' Guild Hall and hear a zoo sound.
facts.action: Expect a zoo and manage it carefully to avoid being overwhelmed.

facts.fact: The middle level of the Wizard's Tower has a large zoo that must be crossed to reach the upstair.
facts.detect: You are on the middle level of the Wizard's Tower and hear a zoo sound.
facts.action: Expect a large zoo and manage it carefully to reach the upstair.

facts.fact: Gold pieces are a special type of object with weight and take up an inventory slot when dropping items, but have no BUC status.
facts.detect: Item symbol $ in inventory
facts.action: Manage inventory weight and slot usage carefully to avoid encumbrance

facts.fact: Monsters that love gold have a 1/5 chance of being generated with some in their inventory and will try to pick up any gold they come across.
facts.detect: Monster name (e.g., leprechaun, orc)
facts.action: Be cautious around gold-loving monsters and avoid dropping gold near them

facts.fact: Gold can be used to establish credit in shops by dropping it on the floor inside the shop.
facts.detect: Shop floor
facts.action: Drop gold to establish credit and avoid selling items accidentally

facts.fact: Gold can be used to detect hidden mimics in shops by throwing a single gold piece in their direction.
facts.detect: Suspected mimic location
facts.action: Throw a gold piece to safely reveal mimics

facts.fact: Gold can be used to pacify angry shopkeepers and specific monsters by offering gold as a bribe.
facts.detect: Angry shopkeeper or specific monster
facts.action: Offer gold to pacify and avoid combat

facts.fact: Abbots have a 'claw' attack, a kick attack that can stun targets, and the ability to cast one clerical monster spell during each of their turns.
facts.detect: Abbot's attack messages (e.g., 'The abbot claws you!', 'The abbot kicks you and you are stunned!')
facts.action: Avoid close combat with abbots and use ranged attacks or spells if possible. If stunned, wait for the stun to wear off before retaliating.

facts.fact: Eating an abbot corpse or tin always causes hallucination.
facts.detect: Eating an abbot corpse or tin
facts.action: Avoid eating abbot corpses or tins to prevent hallucination.

facts.fact: Directly killing an abbot results in a -4 luck penalty, a MAX/8 alignment record penalty, and your god becoming angry.
facts.detect: Killing an abbot
facts.action: Avoid killing abbots unless absolutely necessary, as it will anger your god and cause significant penalties.

facts.fact: Abbots become angry if they see you attack a peaceful monster or kill the Grand Master.
facts.detect: Abbot's anger message (e.g., 'The abbot is angry!')
facts.action: Avoid attacking peaceful monsters or killing the Grand Master in the presence of abbots to prevent them from becoming hostile.

facts.fact: Eight abbots are generated within the dwelling of the Grand Master on the Monk quest home level.
facts.detect: Entering the Grand Master's dwelling
facts.action: Be prepared for a group of eight abbots when entering the Grand Master's dwelling and plan your strategy accordingly.

facts.fact: An acid blob has a passive attack that has a 1/2 chance of triggering when it is attacked in melee, dealing acid damage against attackers without acid resistance.
facts.detect: Attacking an acid blob in melee and receiving acid damage.
facts.action: Use ranged attacks or non-corroding weapons to avoid acid damage and corrosion.

facts.fact: Being splashed by an acid blob's passive acid can corrode the hero's armor and weapons.
facts.detect: Armor or weapon corrosion message after attacking an acid blob.
facts.action: Equip erode-resistant or non-corroding armor and weapons before engaging acid blobs.

facts.fact: Eating an acid blob corpse or tin cures stoning and can grant temporary acid or stoning resistance.
facts.detect: Eating an acid blob corpse or tin and receiving a message about curing stoning or gaining resistance.
facts.action: Eat acid blob corpses or tins to cure stoning and gain temporary resistances.

facts.fact: Acid blobs can generate in large numbers when reading a scroll of create monster while confused.
facts.detect: Reading a scroll of create monster while confused and seeing multiple acid blobs appear.
facts.action: Avoid reading scrolls of create monster while confused to prevent large acid blob spawns.

facts.fact: Acid blobs can block paths and ooze under doors.
facts.detect: Seeing an acid blob blocking a door or path.
facts.action: Use ranged attacks or magic to displace acid blobs from blocking paths.

facts.fact: An air elemental has a single engulfing attack that batters the target with debris for physical damage.
facts.detect: You are pummeled with debris!
facts.action: Use a bugle or wand of scare monster to make the air elemental release you if engulfed. Equip half physical damage resistance or high AC.

facts.fact: Air elementals are the fastest monsters in the game with a speed of 36.
facts.detect: The air elemental moves very quickly on the map.
facts.action: Use a wand of sleep or slow monster to reduce its speed and give yourself time to escape or attack.

facts.fact: Air elementals on the Plane of Air have up to three times as many hit points.
facts.detect: The air elemental appears on the Plane of Air.
facts.action: Use a wand of polymorph to change it into a less dangerous form or escape by teleportation.

facts.fact: Air elementals are mindless and cannot be detected by telepathy.
facts.detect: The air elemental approaches without any warning message.
facts.action: Equip a warning item or use a wand of scare monster to avoid engagement.

facts.fact: Air elementals do not leave a corpse upon death.
facts.detect: The air elemental disappears without a corpse after being killed.
facts.action: Do not waste time searching for a corpse or loot.

facts.fact: An Aleax has two weapon attacks and a kick attack, and possesses cold resistance, sleep resistance, shock resistance, and poison resistance.
facts.detect: Encountering an Aleax on the map
facts.action: Avoid engaging in combat with an Aleax unless necessary, as it has multiple attacks and resistances.

facts.fact: An Aleax is always generated with a blessed erodeproof long sword that has an enchantment ranging from +0 to +3, and has a 20% chance of being made into either Demonbane or Sunsword.
facts.detect: Finding a blessed erodeproof long sword with an Aleax
facts.action: If the sword is not Demonbane or Sunsword, consider taking it for its erodeproof and blessed properties, especially if you need a better weapon.

facts.fact: An Aleax is always generated with an uncursed erodeproof +0 shield, which is a shield of reflection 25% of the time and a large shield otherwise.
facts.detect: Finding an uncursed erodeproof shield with an Aleax
facts.action: Take the shield, especially if it is a shield of reflection, as it provides good protection against attacks.

facts.fact: Randomly generated Aleaxes will be peaceful towards lawful characters with a non-negative alignment record.
facts.detect: Chatting to an Aleax and receiving the message 'You chatted to an Aleax.'
facts.action: Chat with Aleaxes to ensure they remain peaceful and do not attack.

facts.fact: An Aleax can see invisible, picks up weapons and food, has infravision, and can be seen via infravision.
facts.detect: Observing an Aleax's behavior on the map
facts.action: Be cautious around Aleaxes as they can see invisible items and creatures, and may pick up useful items like weapons and food.

facts.fact: An Angel has a magic resistance (MR) of 55 and can cast magic missile (2d6 damage) with a 0d6 in melee range.
facts.detect: Angel casting magic missile or melee combat
facts.action: Avoid melee combat and use magic resistance or wands/rays that bypass MR (like fireball) to attack.

facts.fact: An Angel is generated with a blessed erodeproof long sword with an enchantment ranging from +0 to +3, and has a 5% chance of being made into either Demonbane or Sunsword.
facts.detect: Angel wielding a long sword
facts.action: Steal or take the sword if possible, especially if it is an artifact.

facts.fact: An Angel is generated with an uncursed erodeproof +0 shield, which is a shield of reflection 25% of the time.
facts.detect: Angel with a shield of reflection
facts.action: Avoid using wands or rays that can be reflected back.

facts.fact: Angels serving the hero's deity are usually peaceful, while renegade Angels are peaceful towards cross-aligned heroes, and all others are hostile.
facts.detect: Angel with the hero's deity symbol or cross-aligned symbol
facts.action: Approach peacefully if the Angel is serving the hero's deity or is cross-aligned.

facts.fact: Upon reaching the Astral Plane, a hero with a good enough alignment record will have a tame guardian Angel generated next to them, which can turn hostile if the hero generates conflict.
facts.detect: Entering Astral Plane and seeing a guardian Angel
facts.action: Avoid conflict and keep the guardian Angel peaceful.

facts.fact: An ape has two claw attacks and a bite attack.
facts.detect: Ape monster symbol (Ape)
facts.action: Avoid melee combat with apes unless well-prepared or well-armored.

facts.fact: Apes can be tamed with bananas.
facts.detect: Bananas item
facts.action: Use bananas to tame apes if in danger or need a pet.

facts.fact: Apes respect Elbereth.
facts.detect: Ape monster symbol (Ape) near Elbereth engraving
facts.action: Engrave Elbereth to stop apes from attacking.

facts.fact: Apes can be generated in groups.
facts.detect: Multiple Ape monster symbols (Ape) on the map
facts.action: Avoid or prepare for multiple apes if encountered.

facts.fact: Apes can be scared and will flee.
facts.detect: Ape monster symbol (Ape) near a source of fear (e.g., spell or item)
facts.action: Use fear-inducing items or spells to make apes flee.

facts.fact: Apprentices are generated with a 2/3 chance of carrying a potion of healing.
facts.detect: When an apprentice is generated, there is a 2/3 chance to see a message indicating they have a potion of healing.
facts.action: If an apprentice is encountered, the bot should attempt to safely take the potion of healing from them.

facts.fact: Apprentices have a MR score of 30, making them harder to hit with magic.
facts.detect: When an apprentice is encountered, the bot can notice their high MR score.
facts.action: The bot should avoid using magic attacks against apprentices and use physical attacks instead.

facts.fact: Killing a peaceful apprentice causes a -4 luck penalty and angers the hero's god.
facts.detect: After killing an apprentice, the bot will receive a message indicating a -4 luck penalty and that the hero's god is angry.
facts.action: The bot should avoid killing peaceful apprentices unless absolutely necessary.

facts.fact: Apprentices are generated in the Lonely Tower during the Wizard quest.
facts.detect: When entering the Lonely Tower during the Wizard quest, the bot will encounter apprentices.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious and prepared for encounters with apprentices in the Lonely Tower.

facts.fact: Apprentices can pick up magical items and are seen via infravision.
facts.detect: When an apprentice picks up a magical item, the bot can see this happen via infravision.
facts.action: The bot should be wary of apprentices picking up magical items and try to retrieve them before the apprentice does.

facts.fact: The Arch Priest is always generated as peaceful and is not a valid polymorph form or genocide target.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter a peaceful Arch Priest in the Great Temple, adjacent to the unaligned altar.
facts.action: Avoid conflict with the Arch Priest unless necessary for quest entry or if the bot has a strong enough character to handle the encounter.

facts.fact: The Arch Priest has a strong weapon attack, a kick attack, and will attempt to cast two clerical monster spells during each of his turns.
facts.detect: The bot will see the Arch Priest attacking with a weapon and casting spells.
facts.action: Prepare for a multi-faceted attack from the Arch Priest, including physical and magical damage.

facts.fact: The Arch Priest possesses fire resistance, shock resistance, sleep resistance, and poison resistance.
facts.detect: The bot will notice that the Arch Priest is unaffected by fire, shock, sleep, or poison attacks.
facts.action: Avoid using fire, shock, sleep, or poison attacks against the Arch Priest.

facts.fact: The Arch Priest is always generated with a +4 robe and a +4 mace.
facts.detect: The bot will see the Arch Priest carrying a +4 robe and a +4 mace.
facts.action: Steal or take the +4 robe and +4 mace from the Arch Priest if possible and safe to do so.

facts.fact: An arch-lich has a powerful cold touch attack and will attempt to cast one mage monster spell during each of their turns.
facts.detect: Encounter with an arch-lich on the map
facts.action: Equip cold protection (e.g., cloak of magic resistance, cold resistance spell) and prepare to fight from a distance or use a high-dexterity character to throw a potion of paralysis.

facts.fact: Arch-liches possess cold resistance, sleep resistance, poison resistance, fire resistance, and shock resistance.
facts.detect: Observing the arch-lich's resistance to various attacks
facts.action: Focus on exploiting weaknesses other than cold, such as using fire or shock attacks if available.

facts.fact: An arch-lich is covetous and capable of warping, and desires the Book of the Dead.
facts.detect: Message indicating the arch-lich is covetous and warping
facts.action: Block the upstair to prevent warping and occupy it to keep the arch-lich at bay.

facts.fact: An arch-lich never leaves a corpse when killed - if killed by any method that ordinarily leaves a corpse, a message is printed about their body crumbling to dust.
facts.detect: Message indicating the arch-lich's body crumbling to dust
facts.action: No action required, but note that no corpse means no items or experience points.

facts.fact: Randomly-generated arch-liches have a 1/3 chance of being generated with either an athame or a quarterstaff, with the weapon's enchantment raised by 1-3 points if it is below +2 and a 1/4 chance of it being erosion-proofed.
facts.detect: Encountering an arch-lich with a weapon
facts.action: Be cautious as the weapon may be enchanted and erosion-proofed, making it dangerous to take.

facts.fact: Archeologists can tunnel through walls with a pick-axe or dwarvish mattock.
facts.detect: The bot should notice the presence of a pick-axe or dwarvish mattock in its inventory.
facts.action: If the bot has a pick-axe or dwarvish mattock, it should use it to tunnel through walls to potentially find secret passages or shortcuts.

facts.fact: Archeologists generated on the Astral Plane will have a cheap plastic imitation of the Amulet of Yendor.
facts.detect: The bot should encounter a hostile archeologist on the Astral Plane.
facts.action: If the bot encounters a hostile archeologist on the Astral Plane, it should attempt to take the cheap plastic imitation of the Amulet of Yendor from the archeologist.

facts.fact: Archeologists generated on the Astral Plane have a chance of generating with a long sword that can turn into Vorpal Blade.
facts.detect: The bot should encounter a hostile archeologist on the Astral Plane with a long sword.
facts.action: If the bot encounters a hostile archeologist on the Astral Plane with a long sword, it should be cautious and attempt to avoid or disarm the archeologist.

facts.fact: Archeologists generated on the Astral Plane have a chance of generating with a bullwhip.
facts.detect: The bot should encounter a hostile archeologist on the Astral Plane with a bullwhip.
facts.action: If the bot encounters a hostile archeologist on the Astral Plane with a bullwhip, it should be cautious and attempt to avoid or disarm the archeologist.

facts.fact: Archeologists generated on the Astral Plane have a chance of generating with valuable gems.
facts.detect: The bot should encounter a hostile archeologist on the Astral Plane.
facts.action: If the bot encounters a hostile archeologist on the Astral Plane, it should attempt to take any valuable gems from the archeologist.

facts.fact: Archons have a difficulty of 26 and a level of 19, making them one of the most powerful randomly generated monsters in NetHack.
facts.detect: Monster difficulty and level information
facts.action: Avoid direct confrontation with Archons unless you are at a very high experience level (at least 45) or have powerful artifacts like Vorpal Blade.

facts.fact: Blue dragons are hostile and will attack on sight.

facts.fact: Any form of ranged attack can dispose of a brown mold easily.

facts.fact: Brown puddings do not leave a corpse but may drop a glob of brown pudding upon death.

facts.detect: The bot will encounter centipedes during the Tourist or Ranger quest.

facts.fact: Centipedes are generated hostile.

facts.fact: A chameleon has a 6/10 chance per turn of polymorphing into another form.

facts.detect: Breath weapon attack

facts.detect: Attacking with fire, shock, cold, sleep, disintegration, poison, acid, or magic
facts.action: Avoid using attacks that she is resistant to.

facts.detect: Eating her corpse or tin
facts.action: Do not eat her corpse or tin unless you are prepared to handle the poison and potential resistance gain.

facts.detect: Chromatic Dragon picking up items or moving towards the quest artifact

facts.fact: Eating a cockatrice corpse is safe if you have stoning resistance.

facts.detect: Entering the Wizard quest level
facts.action: Be prepared for a fight with the Dark One upon entering the level.

facts.fact: The Dark One has a high magic resistance (80) and can cast mage spells.
facts.detect: Dark One's spell casting
facts.action: Use wands of death, fireball, or cone of cold to defeat the Dark One.

facts.fact: The Dark One should be fought from the upstairs to prevent him from getting there first.
facts.detect: Dark One's movement towards upstairs
facts.action: Use teleport control or block the stairs to fight the Dark One from upstairs.

facts.fact: Death is a unique monster with a difficulty level of 34 and appears on the Astral Plane.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter Death on the Astral Plane, and the message 'You see a Death.' will appear.
facts.action: Avoid engaging Death directly unless necessary, as it is very dangerous. Focus on reaching the high altar of the hero's alignment and ascending.

facts.fact: Death's touch attack has a 1/4 chance of failing and can reduce the hero's maximum HP.
facts.detect: The message 'You feel a chill...' or 'You feel a sudden pain...' will appear when hit by Death's touch.
facts.action: Equip magic resistance to mitigate the worst effects of Death's touch attack.

facts.fact: Death has teleport control and a 12/13 chance of teleporting adjacent to the hero.
facts.detect: The bot will notice Death teleporting to an adjacent square.
facts.action: Maintain distance from Death to avoid its deadly touch and teleport control.

facts.fact: Death's corpse cannot be eaten and will revive if an attempt is made.
facts.detect: The message 'You feel a chill...' or 'You feel a sudden pain...' will appear if the bot attempts to eat Death's corpse.
facts.action: Avoid eating Death's corpse and ensure it is not eaten by any other means.

facts.fact: Death possesses many resistances but is not immune to disintegration.
facts.detect: The bot will notice that disintegration attacks do not harm Death.
facts.action: Avoid using disintegration attacks on Death, as it will not be effective.

facts.fact: Demiliches have a cold touch attack and will attempt to cast one mage monster spell during each of their turns.
facts.detect: Encounter a demilich on the map.
facts.action: Equip cold protection (e.g., cloak of magic resistance, cold resistance amulet) and prepare for spellcasting.

facts.fact: Demiliches possess cold resistance, sleep resistance, and poison resistance.
facts.detect: Attempt to use cold-based attacks or poison on a demilich.
facts.action: Switch to non-cold, non-poison damage types or use magic resistance.

facts.fact: Demiliches are poisonous to eat, which primarily comes up if they are digested by another monster.
facts.detect: Another monster digests a demilich corpse.
facts.action: Avoid being digested by monsters or eating demilich corpses.

facts.fact: Demiliches never leave a corpse when killed - if killed by any method that ordinarily leaves a corpse, a message is printed about their body crumbling to dust.
facts.detect: Message: 'The demilich crumbles to dust.'
facts.action: Do not rely on demilich corpses for anything.

facts.fact: Demiliches can cast curse items, destroy armor, and drain strength; they can also summon nasties.
facts.detect: Demilich casting a spell or summoning monsters.
facts.action: Use magic resistance and prepare for summoned monsters.

facts.fact: Demogorgon is a unique monster with a difficulty level of 57 and level 50.
facts.detect: Demogorgon, symbol: Demogorgon
facts.action: Avoid or prepare extensively before encountering Demogorgon.

facts.fact: Demogorgon can cast one mage monster spell per round, has a life-draining sting, and two disease-inducing claw attacks.
facts.detect: Life-draining sting, disease-inducing claw attacks
facts.action: Carry items to cure diseases and have a means of escape.

facts.fact: Demogorgon possesses fire resistance, poison resistance, drain resistance, and death resistance.
facts.detect: Fire, poison, drain, and death attacks
facts.action: Prepare for other types of attacks such as disease, stoning, or disintegration.

facts.fact: Demogorgon can only be summoned by demon gating via Orcus, Juiblex, or Yeenoghu, or by the summon nasties spell.
facts.detect: Orcus, Juiblex, Yeenoghu, summon nasties spell
facts.action: Eliminate these summoners as soon as possible to prevent Demogorgon's summoning.

facts.fact: Demogorgon will follow the player to another level if standing next to the player.
facts.detect: Demogorgon adjacent to the player
facts.action: Teleport, paralyze, or gain distance to avoid being followed.

facts.fact: A dingo is a carnivorous canine animal that can be seen via infravision.
facts.detect: Infravision
facts.action: Use infravision to detect dingoes in dark areas.

facts.fact: Dingoes do not bark, and their corpses and tins are safe to eat.
facts.detect: Dingo corpse or tin
facts.action: Eat dingo corpses or tins for nutrition when hungry.

facts.fact: Dingoes are always generated hostile.
facts.detect: Hostile dingo approaching
facts.action: Prepare to fight or avoid hostile dingoes.

facts.fact: Dingoes make up 24/175 of the monsters randomly generated on the Samurai quest.
facts.detect: Samurai quest level
facts.action: Be prepared for dingoes on Samurai quest levels.

facts.fact: Dingo corpses provide 200 nutrition, less than jackals and coyotes (250 nutrition).
facts.detect: Dingo corpse
facts.action: Eat dingo corpses for nutrition but prioritize other sources if available.

facts.fact: Disenchanters possess a claw attack and a passive attack that can disenchant equipment.
facts.detect: A weapon or piece of armor seems less effective after combat with a disenchanter.
facts.action: Avoid using enchanted weapons or armor against disenchanters. Use unenchanted tools or weapons.

facts.fact: Disenchanters have an AC of -10, making them difficult to hit.
facts.detect: Disenchanter is present in Gehennom and has a very low AC.
facts.action: Use ranged attacks, magic, or sleep spells to avoid close combat.

facts.fact: Disenchanters can be created by the summon nasties spell.
