facts.action: Do not eat the ring unless it is identified and has a positive enchantment to avoid a charisma penalty.

facts.fact: Foocubi (incubus and succubus) have a CHA/20 chance of offering to put the ring on one of the hero's fingers or asking for it.
facts.detect: Incubus offers to put the ring on one of your fingers or succubus asks for the ring.
facts.action: If the ring is identified and has a positive enchantment, let the foocubus wear it to improve charisma temporarily.

facts.fact: Dropping a ring of adornment down a sink produces a distinct message unless the hero is blind.
facts.detect: The faucets flash brightly for a moment.
facts.action: Drop the ring down a sink to identify it if it is unidentified.

facts.fact: A ring of aggravate monster is undesirable in the great majority of circumstances and is typically relegated to polypile fodder.
facts.detect: Item name: Ring of aggravate monster
facts.action: Polypile the ring to avoid its negative effects.

facts.fact: Knights can use the ring to awaken certain monsters and avoid caitiff penalties to alignment record.
facts.detect: Character class: Knight
facts.action: Wear the ring temporarily to awaken specific monsters and avoid alignment penalties.

facts.fact: Players can wear the ring temporarily to lure monsters to certain areas, such as fodder for sacrifice on an altar or for obtaining specific monster corpses.
facts.detect: Desire to lure monsters to specific areas
facts.action: Wear the ring temporarily to increase the difficulty of monsters generated in the desired area.

facts.fact: Wearing the ring can make it easier to generate a ki-rin or Archon to tame, as these monsters do not generate in Gehennom but are often too difficult for the Dungeons of Doom.
facts.detect: Desire to tame a ki-rin or Archon
facts.action: Wear the ring to increase the likelihood of generating these monsters.

facts.fact: The ring can decrease level difficulty in very deep dungeon levels due to the level difficulty cap of 50 after doubling.
facts.detect: Deep dungeon levels (e.g., Moloch's Sanctum)
facts.action: Wear the ring to potentially decrease level difficulty in very deep levels.

facts.fact: A hero putting on the ring gains the cold resistance property, which lowers or nullifies cold damage from certain attacks, wands and hazards.
facts.detect: Your finger feels warm!
facts.action: Equip the ring of cold resistance as soon as it is identified to gain cold resistance.

facts.fact: A hero eating the ring has a 3/4 chance of successfully absorbing its magic and gaining intrinsic cold resistance.
facts.detect: Eating the ring of cold resistance.
facts.action: Eat the ring of cold resistance to gain intrinsic cold resistance if the bot has no other use for the ring.

facts.fact: Monsters will not wear this ring.
facts.detect: Finding the ring on the ground or in a shop.
facts.action: Pick up the ring of cold resistance if found, as it is safe from monster use.

facts.fact: General stores and jewelers shops can sell rings of cold resistance.
facts.detect: Entering a general store or jeweler's shop.
facts.action: Buy a ring of cold resistance if available and needed.

facts.fact: Wizards may be given a ring of cold resistance as one of the two random rings in their starting inventory.
facts.detect: Starting the game as a wizard.
facts.action: Check inventory for a ring of cold resistance if starting as a wizard.

facts.fact: A hero putting on the ring will generate conflict, causing all monsters within line of sight and a radius of eight squares to attack the nearest monster, including them if they are close enough.
facts.detect: Monsters start attacking each other and the hero upon putting on the ring.
facts.action: Avoid wearing the ring in crowded or dangerous areas. Use it in open spaces or when surrounded by weaker monsters.

facts.fact: Every even-numbered turn that a hero wears the ring, their nutrition is decremented by 1.
facts.detect: Nutrition level decreases every other turn while wearing the ring.
facts.action: Ensure there is plenty of food available before using the ring and eat regularly while wearing it.

facts.fact: A hero eating the ring has a 1/3 chance of successfully absorbing its magic and gaining intrinsic conflict.
facts.detect: Attempting to eat the ring.
facts.action: Do not eat the ring unless absolutely necessary and there are no other options for conflict.

facts.fact: Dropping a ring of conflict into a sink will produce a unique message.
facts.detect: The message 'You hear loud noises coming from the drain.'
facts.action: Use this method to identify the ring safely.

facts.fact: Monsters will not wear this ring.
facts.detect: Monsters do not put on rings.
facts.action: Do not worry about monsters equipping the ring.

facts.fact: A hero putting on the ring gains the fire resistance property, which lowers or nullifies fire damage from certain attacks, wands and hazards.
facts.detect: Your finger feels cool!
facts.action: Equip the ring of fire resistance as soon as it is identified to gain fire resistance.

facts.fact: Flammable items have a 99/100 chance of being protected from destruction by fire damage when the hero wears a ring of fire resistance.
facts.detect: Flammable items in inventory
facts.action: Wear the ring of fire resistance when carrying flammable items to protect them from fire damage.

facts.fact: A hero eating the ring has a 1/3 chance of successfully absorbing its magic and gaining intrinsic fire resistance.
facts.detect: Eating the ring of fire resistance
facts.action: Eat the ring of fire resistance if it is unidentified and you are in a safe environment to test it.

facts.fact: Dropping a ring of fire resistance into a sink will cause the message 'The hot water faucet flashes brightly for a moment.'
facts.detect: The hot water faucet flashes brightly for a moment.
facts.action: Drop the ring into a sink to identify it as a ring of fire resistance.

facts.fact: A ring of free action protects the hero from most sources of sleep and paralysis, including paralyzing container traps, potions of paralysis or sleeping, paralyze and stun monster spells, and paralyzing monster attacks.
facts.detect: Messages such as 'You momentarily stiffen', 'You stiffen momentarily', 'You momentarily stiffen under's gaze!', 'You stiffen momentarily under's gaze', 'You stiffen briefly', 'grabs you, but you quickly free yourself!'
facts.action: Wear the ring of free action to protect against paralysis and sleep effects.

facts.fact: The ring does not protect against paralysis from fear, lightning rays, fumbling, or turn undead via the #turn command.
facts.detect: Encountering a ghost or skeleton, being hit by lightning rays, fumbling, or using the #turn command.
facts.action: Avoid situations that can cause paralysis from fear, lightning rays, fumbling, or turn undead.

facts.fact: Eating the ring has a 1/3 chance of successfully absorbing its magic and granting intrinsic sleep resistance.
facts.detect: Eating the ring and receiving the message 'You feel strangely refreshed.'
facts.action: Eat the ring if you need sleep resistance and are willing to risk losing the ring.

facts.fact: Rings of free action are useful in Gehennom, Orcus's level, Moloch's Sanctum, and the Astral Plane due to the presence of paralyzing monsters and traps.
facts.detect: Entering these areas and encountering paralyzing monsters or traps.
facts.action: Wear the ring when entering these dangerous areas.

facts.fact: Monsters will not wear this ring.
facts.detect: Finding the ring in a monster's inventory or seeing a monster use a paralyzing attack.
facts.action: Pick up the ring if dropped by a monster.

facts.fact: A ring of gain constitution alters the hero's constitution by its enchantment while worn, up to a maximum of 25.
facts.detect: Item name: Ring of gain constitution
facts.action: Wear the ring to increase constitution and carrying capacity, especially before gaining experience levels to improve HP gains.

facts.fact: Eating a ring of gain constitution has a 1/3 chance of successfully absorbing its magic, providing a temporary bonus or penalty to constitution based on the ring's enchantment.
facts.detect: Message: You feel stronger/weaker (depending on the enchantment).
facts.action: Eat the ring if you are in a safe environment and need a temporary boost to constitution.

facts.fact: Monsters will not wear this ring.
facts.detect: N/A (monsters do not wear rings)
facts.action: Do not worry about monsters taking this ring.

facts.fact: Charging the ring increases its enchantment if using a non-cursed source, and decreases it if using a cursed source.
facts.detect: Item name: Ring of gain constitution and a source of charging (such as a battery or wand of charging)
facts.action: Charge the ring with a non-cursed source to increase its effectiveness.

facts.fact: A ring of gain strength auto-identifies when worn.
facts.detect: Message: You feel stronger/weaker.
facts.action: Wear the ring to identify it.

facts.fact: A hero eating the ring has a 1/3 chance of successfully absorbing its magic and gaining a temporary bonus or penalty to strength.
facts.detect: Message: You feel stronger/weaker.
facts.action: Eat the ring to identify it and gain temporary strength bonus/penalty.

facts.fact: Dropping a ring of gain strength down a sink produces two distinct messages depending on the ring's enchantment.
facts.detect: Message: The water flow seems now weaker/stronger.
facts.action: Drop the ring down a sink to identify its enchantment.

facts.fact: A ring of gain strength can be used to boost damage and carrying capacity for heroes with low strength.
facts.detect: Hero's strength is below optimal for carrying and fighting.
facts.action: Wear the ring to boost strength and carrying capacity.

facts.fact: A ring of gain strength that modifies the hero's strength is auto-identified when put on or removed.
facts.detect: Message: You feel stronger/weaker.
facts.action: Put on or remove the ring to auto-identify it.

facts.fact: 9 out of 10 rings of hunger are generated cursed.
facts.detect: Message upon putting on the ring: 'You feel very hungry.'
facts.action: Avoid wearing the ring unless it is identified as uncursed or blessed.

facts.fact: A hero eating the ring has a 1/3 chance of successfully absorbing its magic and gaining intrinsic voracious hunger.
facts.detect: Message upon eating the ring: 'You feel very hungry.'
facts.action: Eat the ring if you are prepared to deal with the voracious hunger intrinsic.

facts.fact: Dropping the ring onto a sink may cause any other items on that sink's square to vanish.
facts.detect: Message upon dropping the ring into a sink: 'Suddenly, [item name] vanishes from the sink!'
facts.action: Use a junk item to test if a ring is a ring of hunger by dropping it into a sink.

facts.fact: A non-cursed ring of hunger can be used to make room for a meal consisting of several large corpses.
facts.detect: Having several large corpses and a non-cursed ring of hunger.
facts.action: Wear the ring temporarily to eat large corpses when you do not have an amulet of magical breathing.

facts.fact: The ring of hunger is primarily used as polyfodder outside of specific scenarios.
facts.detect: Identifying the ring as a ring of hunger.
facts.action: Use the ring as polyfodder to polymorph into a form that benefits from voracious hunger.

facts.fact: A hero putting on the ring gains a flat, enchantment-based to-hit bonus or penalty.
facts.detect: Wearing the ring and observing combat outcomes.
facts.action: Wear the ring if it provides a positive to-hit bonus, especially early in the game.

facts.fact: A hero eating the ring has a 1/3 chance of successfully absorbing its magic and gaining a permanent to-hit bonus or penalty.
facts.detect: Eating the ring and observing combat outcomes.
facts.action: Eat the ring if it is positively enchanted and you are early in the game.

facts.fact: If the bonus from absorbing a positively-enchanted ring's power by eating it would place the hero at 10 or more points of increased to-hit, the bonus is reduced to a random number between 1 and that ring's enchantment.
facts.detect: Eating the ring and observing combat outcomes.
facts.action: Eat the ring only if it is highly positively enchanted and you are early in the game.

facts.fact: For most other heroes that reach the mid-game, the ring becomes a polyfodder candidate once they obtain a luckstone or other luck item and maximize their luck.
facts.detect: Obtaining a luckstone or other luck item.
facts.action: Do not eat or wear the ring once you have a luckstone or other luck item.

facts.fact: Enlightenment will give a message about the ring's enchantment if worn.
facts.detect: Using enlightenment while wearing the ring.
facts.action: Use enlightenment to identify the ring's enchantment.

facts.fact: A ring of increase damage provides a flat, enchantment-based bonus or penalty to melee and projectile weapon damage, as well as unarmed combat damage.
facts.detect: Wearing the ring and observing damage output changes.
facts.action: Enchant the ring to increase damage output, especially useful for multi-hitting attacks.

facts.fact: Eating a ring of increase damage has a 1/3 chance of permanently increasing damage bonus or penalty.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel a surge of power.' when eating the ring.
facts.action: Eat the ring if it has a positive enchantment and you are not near max damage bonus.

facts.fact: If the ring's enchantment is 10 or more, the bonus from eating it is reduced to a random number between 1 and the ring's enchantment.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel a surge of power, but it is not as great as you had hoped.'
facts.action: Do not eat the ring if it has an enchantment of 10 or more.

facts.fact: If the ring's enchantment is 20 or more, there is a chance of gaining only a single extra point of increased damage.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel a surge of power, but it is barely noticeable.'
facts.action: Do not eat the ring if it has an enchantment of 20 or more.

facts.fact: If the ring's enchantment is 40 or more, no bonus is gained from eating it.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel a surge of power, but nothing happens.'
facts.action: Do not eat the ring if it has an enchantment of 40 or more.

facts.fact: Wizards may be given a ring of invisibility as one of the two random rings in their starting inventory.
facts.detect: Checking the starting inventory if the bot is a wizard.
facts.action: Wear the ring of invisibility to gain extrinsic invisibility.

facts.fact: Nazgul will always generate with a cursed ring of invisibility.
facts.detect: Encountering a Nazgul.
facts.action: Avoid the cursed ring of invisibility and do not wear it.

facts.fact: A hero eating the ring has a 1/3 chance of absorbing its magic and gaining permanent intrinsic invisibility.
facts.detect: Having the ring of invisibility in inventory.
facts.action: Eat the ring to attempt to gain permanent intrinsic invisibility.

facts.fact: A ring of invisibility is trivial to wear-test for and identify after curse testing.
facts.detect: Testing the ring for curses.
facts.action: Wear-test the ring to identify it.

facts.fact: The ring of invisibility can still be useful to obtain permanent see invisible from stalker corpses.
facts.detect: Encountering a stalker corpse.
facts.action: Use the ring of invisibility to gain permanent see invisible from a stalker corpse.

facts.fact: A hero putting on a ring of levitation will begin levitating above the ground, auto-identifying the ring.
facts.detect: The message 'You feel strangely light.' or 'You feel strangely heavy.' when putting on the ring.
facts.action: Wear the ring to automatically identify it and gain levitation.

facts.fact: A hero eating a ring of levitation has a 1/3 chance of absorbing its magic and granting intrinsic levitation for 10-200 turns.
facts.detect: The message 'You feel strangely light.' or 'You feel strangely heavy.' after eating the ring.
facts.action: Eat the ring if you lack a source of levitation and are willing to risk losing the ring.

facts.fact: A worn cursed ring of levitation is considered a major trouble for purposes of prayer, and a successful prayer will uncurse the ring.
facts.detect: The message 'Your god is displeased with you.' or 'Your god is pleased with you.' when praying.
facts.action: Pray to uncurse the ring if it is cursed and causing trouble.

facts.fact: A blessed ring of levitation is a common wish for the future ascension kit of heroes who obtain the Castle's wand of wishing and lack any source of levitation.
facts.detect: Lack of any source of levitation and possession of the Castle's wand of wishing.
facts.action: Wish for a blessed ring of levitation if you lack a source of levitation and have the wand of wishing.

facts.fact: A hero risks being instantly drowned if they are hit by lightning or any shock attacks while over water while wearing a cursed ring of levitation.
facts.detect: Being over water and wearing a cursed ring of levitation.
facts.action: Avoid wearing a cursed ring of levitation over water or ensure it is blessed to avoid drowning.

facts.fact: A ring of poison resistance is given to wizards (non-orcish) as one of the two random rings in their starting inventory.
facts.detect: Starting inventory check for wizard character
facts.action: If the bot is a wizard and finds a ring in its starting inventory, it should identify and wear the ring of poison resistance if available.

facts.fact: General stores and jewelers shops can sell rings of poison resistance.
facts.detect: Visiting a general store or jeweler's shop
facts.action: If the bot needs poison resistance and does not have it, it should purchase a ring of poison resistance from a general store or jeweler's shop.

facts.fact: A hero eating the ring has a 1/3 chance of successfully absorbing its magic and gaining intrinsic poison resistance.
facts.detect: Eating the ring of poison resistance
facts.action: If the bot has the ring and needs intrinsic poison resistance, it should attempt to eat the ring to gain intrinsic poison resistance.

facts.fact: Dropping a ring of poison resistance into a sink produces a distinct message: 'You smell rotten.'
facts.detect: Message 'You smell rotten.' after dropping a ring into a sink
facts.action: If the bot needs to identify a ring, it can drop it into a sink to identify it as a ring of poison resistance.

facts.fact: A ring of polymorph is generated as cursed 90% of the time.
facts.detect: The bot can notice this when the ring is identified as cursed.
facts.action: The bot should avoid wearing an unidentified ring of polymorph due to the high chance of it being cursed.

facts.fact: Wearing a ring of polymorph can result in polymorphitis, which has a 100% chance of polymorphing the hero each turn.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this when it starts polymorphing into various forms.
facts.action: The bot should remove the ring immediately upon noticing polymorphing effects.

facts.fact: Dropping a ring of polymorph into a sink will transform the sink into a random dungeon feature.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this when it sees the message 'The sink transforms into a !'.
facts.action: The bot should avoid dropping the ring into sinks to prevent unintended transformations.

facts.fact: If the hero has polymorph control, they can choose the form they change into.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this when it has identified the ring of polymorph control.
facts.action: The bot should pair the ring of polymorph with a ring of polymorph control to safely polymorph into powerful forms.

facts.fact: Eating the ring has a 33% chance of successfully absorbing its magic and granting intrinsic polymorphitis.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this when it eats the ring and notices the polymorphing effects.
facts.action: The bot should avoid eating the ring unless it is prepared to deal with polymorphing effects.

facts.fact: Wearing a ring of polymorph control grants extrinsic polymorph control, allowing the player to choose the form of the monster they wish to change into when polymorphed, except when stunned, unconscious, or under special cases.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel in control.' when polymorphed while wearing the ring.
facts.action: Wear the ring of polymorph control to gain control over polymorphing.

facts.fact: Eating the ring of polymorph control has a 1/3 chance of granting intrinsic polymorph control.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel in control.' after eating the ring.
facts.action: Eat the ring of polymorph control to potentially gain intrinsic polymorph control.

facts.fact: If a hero has lycanthropy and would change between forms while wearing the ring, the player is given a prompt asking if they wish to do so; declining will leave the hero in their current form.
facts.detect: Prompt: 'Do you want to change form?' when wearing the ring and near a full moon.
facts.action: Respond to the prompt to control lycanthropy transformations.

facts.fact: The ring of polymorph control is one of the safer 300zm rings, but it is difficult to test for due to the dangers of random, uncontrolled polymorph.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel a sudden urge to change into a monster.' when wearing an unidentified ring of polymorph.
facts.action: Avoid wearing unidentified rings of polymorph until they are identified as safe.

facts.fact: The odds of a ring that is price-identified and tested for beatitude being a ring of polymorph control is 32.1% for non-cursed rings and 90.0% if it is not a ring of teleport control or conflict.
facts.detect: Price-identify and test for beatitude of rings.
facts.action: Use price identification and beatitude testing to increase the likelihood of identifying a ring of polymorph control.

facts.fact: A ring of protection increases AC by its enchantment and magic cancellation by 1, regardless of enchantment.
facts.detect: Wearing the ring and checking AC or magic cancellation.
facts.action: Wear the ring to improve AC and magic cancellation.

facts.fact: Eating a ring of protection has a 1/3 chance of adding its enchantment to intrinsic protection, with diminishing returns.
facts.detect: Finding a ring of protection and considering eating it.
facts.action: Eat the ring if it has a positive enchantment and intrinsic protection is below 10.

facts.fact: A worn +0 ring of protection causes ring hunger if it is the hero's only source of extrinsic protection.
facts.detect: Wearing a +0 ring of protection and having no other sources of extrinsic protection.
facts.action: Avoid wearing a +0 ring of protection if it is the only source of extrinsic protection.

facts.fact: The ring's enchantment can be altered by charging, and wearing the ring will only cause ring hunger if it has a non-zero enchantment.
facts.detect: Wearing a charged ring of protection.
facts.action: Charge the ring to avoid ring hunger if it has a non-zero enchantment.

facts.fact: Enlightenment messages provide information about the cumulative enchantment of worn rings of protection.
facts.detect: Receiving enlightenment messages while wearing rings of protection.
facts.action: Monitor enlightenment messages to assess the effectiveness of worn rings of protection.

page: Ring of protection from shape changers

facts.fact: A ring of protection from shape changers causes most shape changers and other similar monsters to lose their shifting ability while the ring is worn.
facts.detect: Encountering a chameleon, doppelganger, sandestin, vampire, werecreature, mimic, or any monster with a digestion attack that is unable to shift forms or summon help.
facts.action: Equip the ring as soon as it is identified to prevent shape changers from shifting into dangerous forms or summoning help.

facts.fact: Werecreatures are forced into their human form a majority of the time and cannot summon help or infect the hero with lycanthropy.
facts.detect: Encountering a werecreature that does not summon help or shift into animal form.
facts.action: Equip the ring to prevent werecreatures from summoning help or infecting the hero with lycanthropy.

facts.fact: Mimics are de-cloaked and cannot disguise themselves.
facts.detect: Encountering a mimic that is not disguised as an object.
facts.action: Equip the ring to prevent mimics from disguising themselves.

facts.fact: Monsters with a digestion attack will not polymorph when swallowing a shape changer whole.
facts.detect: A pet with a digestion attack swallowing a chameleon or doppelganger whole without polymorphing.
facts.action: Equip the ring to prevent pets with digestion attacks from polymorphing when swallowing shape changers.

facts.fact: A hero eating the ring has a 1/3 chance of successfully absorbing its magic and gaining protection from shape changers as an intrinsic.
facts.detect: Eating a ring of protection from shape changers.
facts.action: Eat the ring to attempt to gain the intrinsic protection from shape changers.

facts.fact: A hero putting on the ring gains the regeneration extrinsic, which enhances their natural hit point regeneration and restores one HP on any turn that they would not normally regain HP
facts.detect: The hero notices an increase in HP regeneration when wearing the ring
facts.action: Wear the ring when in low HP states to recover faster

facts.fact: The ring of regeneration burns 1 point of nutrition on every odd-numbered turn in addition to ring hunger
facts.detect: The hero notices a decrease in nutrition while wearing the ring
facts.action: Remove the ring when at full HP to conserve nutrition

facts.fact: A hero eating the ring has a 1/3 chance of successfully absorbing its magic and gaining intrinsic regeneration
facts.detect: The hero attempts to eat the ring and notices a sudden increase in HP regeneration
facts.action: Eat the ring if there is a need for intrinsic regeneration and the hero is willing to risk losing nutrition

facts.fact: If you have to stop to gain HP back, it is usually cheaper in terms of nutrition to do it with the ring of regeneration
facts.detect: The hero is in a situation where they need to recover HP and notices that they are low on nutrition
facts.action: Use the ring to recover HP when in combat-heavy scenarios or when low on nutrition

facts.fact: The ring of regeneration prints a distinct message when dropped down a sink
facts.detect: The hero drops the ring down a sink and sees the message 'The sink looks as good as new.'
facts.action: Use this method to identify the ring if unsure

facts.fact: A hero putting on the ring of searching gains the automatic searching extrinsic, which searches all adjacent squares once after each action the hero takes.
facts.detect: ring of searching
facts.action: Equip the ring of searching to automatically search adjacent squares after each action.

facts.fact: A hero eating the ring has a 3/4 chance of successfully absorbing its magic and gaining intrinsic automatic searching.
facts.detect: ring of searching
facts.action: Eat the ring of searching if you do not have a sink nearby to drop it in, to potentially gain intrinsic automatic searching.

facts.fact: Dropping a ring of searching on a sink square will print a distinct message and never causes the ring to be lost down the drain or buried beneath the sink.
facts.detect: You thought your ring got lost in the sink, but there it is!
facts.action: Drop the ring of searching in a sink to safely store it without risk of losing it.

facts.fact: A ring of see invisible grants the see invisible extrinsic property, allowing the hero to see invisible monsters.
facts.detect: Message: 'Suddenly you are transparent, but there!' when wearing an unidentified ring while invisible.
facts.action: Wear the ring to see invisible monsters, especially when approaching potentially dangerous situations like hostile spellcasters.

facts.fact: Wizards may start with a ring of see invisible as one of their two random rings.
facts.detect: Starting inventory check.
facts.action: If starting as a wizard, check inventory for the ring and use it to detect invisible monsters early in the game.

facts.fact: A hero eating the ring has a 1/3 chance of successfully absorbing its magic and gaining intrinsic see invisible.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel strangely transparent.' when eating the ring.
facts.action: Eat the ring if you are in a safe area and need the see invisible property permanently.

facts.fact: Dropping a ring of see invisible down a sink will produce a distinct message.
facts.detect: Message: 'You see some air in the sink.'
facts.action: Drop the ring down a sink to identify it if you are unsure.

facts.fact: Price identification can be useful to sort through most 150zm rings, since they are mostly safe to wear and a ring of see invisible will auto-identify if an invisible hero wears it.
facts.detect: Price of the ring is 150zm.
facts.action: Wear the ring while invisible to auto-identify it.

facts.fact: A hero putting on the ring gains the extrinsic shock resistance property, which lowers or nullifies shock damage from certain attacks, wands and hazards.
facts.detect: Your finger feels numb!
facts.action: Equip the ring of shock resistance when facing monsters that use wands of lightning, or when encountering energy vortices and shocking spheres.

facts.fact: The ring of shock resistance itself is completely immune to destruction from shock damage.
facts.detect: N/A (inherent property)
facts.action: Keep the ring of shock resistance in your inventory to protect it from shock damage.

facts.fact: A hero eating the ring has a 1/3 chance of successfully absorbing its magic and gaining intrinsic shock resistance.
facts.detect: You feel a strange tingling sensation.
facts.action: Eat the ring of shock resistance if you are in a safe environment and have no other way to identify it.

facts.fact: Testing for a ring of shock resistance is naturally difficult without significant danger to the hero or their inventory.
facts.detect: N/A (general knowledge)
facts.action: Use grid bugs to test for shock resistance without risking your inventory.

facts.fact: Dropping a spare ring down a sink will print a distinct message if it is a ring of shock resistance.
facts.detect: Static electricity surrounds the sink.
facts.action: Drop a spare ring into a sink to identify it as a ring of shock resistance.

facts.fact: A hero that puts on the ring of slow digestion gains the slow digestion property, which nullifies the ordinary consumption of one nutrition point per turn that hero experiences.
facts.detect: You gain the slow digestion property when you put on the ring.
facts.action: Equip the ring of slow digestion to prevent hunger and starvation.

facts.fact: If a monster engulfs and tries to digest a hero wearing this ring, the hero will be expelled immediately.
facts.detect: You get regurgitated!
facts.action: Wear the ring of slow digestion to avoid being digested by monsters.

facts.fact: Dropping a ring of slow digestion onto a sink will not lose or bury the ring, and will prompt the player to type-name it if it is unidentified.
facts.detect: The ring is regurgitated!
facts.action: Drop the ring into a sink to type-identify it if it is unidentified.

facts.fact: Wearing the ring is also useful to prevent engulfing by purple worms and other digesting monsters.
facts.detect: You are engulfed by a purple worm or similar monster.
facts.action: Wear the ring of slow digestion to avoid being digested by engulfing monsters.

facts.fact: The ring of slow digestion is highly valued among most players, often to the point of being worth a wish once all other parts of a standard kit are accounted for.
facts.detect: The bot is playing as a lawful dwarvish Valkyrie and is trying to ascend.
facts.action: Prioritize finding and keeping the ring of slow digestion as part of the ascension kit.

facts.fact: A hero putting on a ring of stealth grants the hero extrinsic stealth.
facts.detect: Picking up or equipping a ring of stealth
facts.action: Equip the ring of stealth to gain extrinsic stealth

facts.fact: A hero eating the ring of stealth has a 1/3 chance of absorbing its magic and gaining intrinsic stealth.
facts.detect: Eating the ring of stealth
facts.action: Eat the ring of stealth to potentially gain intrinsic stealth

facts.fact: Monsters will not wear this ring.
facts.detect: Observing monsters in the game
facts.action: No action needed, but note that monsters do not use this ring

facts.fact: A hero putting on the ring of sustain ability gains the sustain ability extrinsic, which prevents their current ability scores from being changed by exercise, abuse or any other method, except for strength gain or loss from nutrition levels and polymorphing into their own race.
facts.detect: Identify the ring through testing or enlightenment.
facts.action: Equip the ring to prevent stat loss from sustained stat abuse or deliberate actions that would otherwise lower stats.

facts.fact: Monsters will not wear this ring.
facts.detect: Notice that monsters do not wear the ring.
facts.action: Pick up the ring if found on a monster's corpse.

facts.fact: A hero eating the ring gains no effect from it.
facts.detect: Attempt to eat the ring.
facts.action: Do not eat the ring.

facts.fact: The ring of sustain ability can prevent the intelligence drain from a mind flayer's attacks, but it does not prevent the hero from becoming brainless if they are drained of intelligence while they are at the minimum of 3.
facts.detect: Encounter a mind flayer.
facts.action: Wear the ring when fighting a mind flayer to prevent intelligence drain.

facts.fact: The ring of sustain ability gives a unique message when dropped down a sink: 'The water flow seems fixed.'
facts.detect: Drop the ring down a sink.
facts.action: Retrieve the ring from the sink to avoid losing it.

facts.fact: A hero putting on a ring of teleport control gains the teleport control extrinsic, allowing them to control their destination square when teleporting while wearing the ring.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel more in control.' when putting on the ring.
facts.action: Equip the ring of teleport control to gain control over teleportation.

facts.fact: A hero eating the ring has a 1/3 chance of successfully absorbing its magic and gaining intrinsic teleport control.
facts.detect: Message: 'You feel more in control.' after eating the ring.
facts.action: Eat the ring if you have no other way to identify or use it, but be aware of the 2/3 chance of wasting it.

facts.fact: A ring of teleport control can be identified by attempting teleportation while wearing it, allowing you to choose a destination square.
facts.detect: Attempting to teleport while wearing the ring and being able to choose a destination square.
facts.action: Use a known teleport trap, scroll, or wand to test if the ring grants teleport control.

facts.fact: Dropping a ring of teleport control down a sink will produce a unique message.
facts.detect: Message: 'The sink looks like it is being beamed aboard somewhere.' when dropping the ring down a sink.
facts.action: Drop the ring down a sink to identify it.

facts.fact: The ring of teleport control is useful when combined with teleportitis or a means of level teleportation.
facts.detect: Having teleportitis or a means of level teleportation.
facts.action: Seek out and use items or methods that induce teleportitis or allow level teleportation while wearing the ring of teleport control.

facts.fact: A ring of teleportation is generated as cursed 90% of the time.
facts.detect: Cursed status of the ring when identified
facts.action: Avoid wearing cursed rings of teleportation to prevent teleportitis and potential danger.

facts.fact: A hero eating the ring has a 1/3 chance of successfully absorbing its magic and gaining intrinsic teleportitis.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel strangely light.' when eating the ring
facts.action: Eat the ring if you have teleport control or are willing to risk teleportitis.

facts.fact: Dropping a ring of teleportation down a sink will print a message and teleport the sink to another valid square on the level.
facts.detect: Message 'The sink vanishes.'
facts.action: Avoid dropping rings of teleportation down sinks to prevent unintended teleportation.

facts.fact: A hero that has a known source of teleport control is in far less danger from this and can informally identify a non-cursed ring more reliably.
facts.detect: Having teleport control
facts.action: Wear a non-cursed ring of teleportation if you have teleport control to identify it.

facts.fact: Once the player gains teleport control and can teleport at will, the ring of teleportation can potentially be a great boon as a navigation aid and escape item.
facts.detect: Reaching teleport control and teleport at will
facts.action: Use the ring of teleportation as a navigation aid and escape item once you have teleport control.

facts.fact: A ring of warning grants the hero the ability to detect the presence of most hostile monsters beyond their sight.
facts.detect: Number glyphs or colored question marks appear when wearing the ring in areas with unseen hostile monsters.
facts.action: Wear the ring of warning to detect unseen hostile monsters and avoid surprise attacks.

facts.fact: Wizards may start with a ring of warning as one of their two random rings.
facts.detect: Starting inventory includes a ring of warning.
facts.action: Keep the ring of warning if found in starting inventory.

facts.fact: General stores and jewelers shops can sell rings of warning.
facts.detect: Visit general stores or jewelers shops.
facts.action: Purchase a ring of warning if available.

facts.fact: A hero eating the ring has a 1/3 chance of successfully absorbing its magic and gaining intrinsic warning.
facts.detect: Eat the ring of warning.
facts.action: Eat the ring of warning to gain intrinsic warning if it is not needed.

facts.fact: Dropping the ring down a sink produces a distinct message: 'The sink glows white for a moment.'
facts.detect: The message 'The sink glows white for a moment.' appears.
facts.action: Avoid dropping the ring down a sink to preserve it.

facts.fact: Monks start the game with a +1 robe, and Priests start the game with a +0 robe.
facts.detect: Checking the inventory at the start of the game.
facts.action: Monks should keep the +1 robe, while Priests should keep the +0 robe unless they have a better cloak.

facts.fact: Aligned priests, high priests, and the Arch Priest each have a 6/7 chance of generating with a robe.
facts.detect: Encountering an aligned priest, high priest, or the Arch Priest.
facts.action: Prioritize killing or siccing a pet on these priests to obtain a robe.

facts.fact: Player monsters that are not monks have an effective ~4.45% chance of generating with a robe as their initial cloak.
facts.detect: Finding a player monster's grave.
facts.action: Check player monster graves for a robe.

facts.fact: A robe grants 2 base AC and MC2, and confers a spellcasting bonus.
facts.detect: Wearing a robe and attempting to cast spells.
facts.action: Use a robe to enhance spellcasting, especially for characters with metal armor penalties.

facts.fact: Wizards may want a robe to offset the spellcasting penalty from gauntlets of power.
facts.detect: Wearing gauntlets of power and attempting to cast spells.
facts.action: Wear a robe to reduce the spellcasting penalty from gauntlets of power.

facts.fact: Rocks are a stackable stone that can be used as a projectile weapon by throwing or firing from a sling.
facts.detect: Item name: rock
facts.action: Use rocks as a weapon against sessile or slow-moving foes with dangerous melee or passive attacks, such as molds, floating eyes, and jellies.

facts.fact: Hitting statues and boulders with digging tools, a wand of striking, or a force bolt spell will shatter them into several rocks.
facts.detect: Message: You shatter the statue/boulder into several rocks.
facts.action: Use digging tools, wand of striking, or force bolt spell on statues and boulders to obtain rocks.

facts.fact: Reading a scroll of earth while confused will cause several rocks to fall.
facts.detect: Message: Several rocks fall from the ceiling.
facts.action: Avoid reading a scroll of earth while confused to prevent falling rocks.

facts.fact: Rocks can be transformed into meatballs by using the stone to flesh spell.
facts.detect: Item name: rock, spell: stone to flesh
facts.action: Use the stone to flesh spell to turn rocks into meatballs for pet training or food generation.

facts.fact: Rocks can be polypiled into valuable gems.
facts.detect: Item name: rock, spell or wand: polymorph
facts.action: Polypile rocks into gems for selling or for luck with unicorns.

facts.fact: Rubber hoses are not randomly generated.
facts.detect: None, as rubber hoses do not appear randomly in the dungeon.
facts.action: Do not expect to find rubber hoses randomly in the dungeon.

facts.fact: Keystone Kops have a 6/32 (18.75%) chance of generating with a rubber hose.
facts.detect: Encounter with a Keystone Kop carrying a rubber hose.
facts.action: If a Keystone Kop is carrying a rubber hose, consider taking it for its unique properties.

facts.fact: Rubber hoses do more damage than the bullwhip against small and large monsters.
facts.detect: Combat with small or large monsters.
facts.action: Use the rubber hose against small or large monsters for better damage.

facts.fact: Rubber hoses are not rendered ineffective by thick-skinned monsters.
facts.detect: Combat with thick-skinned monsters.
facts.action: Use the rubber hose against thick-skinned monsters as it remains effective.

facts.fact: Rubber hoses lack the bullwhip's other utilities such as disarming monsters.
facts.detect: Attempting to disarm a monster.
facts.action: Do not use the rubber hose for disarming monsters, as it lacks this utility.

facts.fact: A runesword is a type of weapon that appears in NetHack, made of iron, and uses the broadsword skill.
facts.detect: runed broadsword
facts.action: Identify and pick up the runesword if found, as it is a valuable weapon for a broadsword user.

facts.fact: Pelias, the quest leader for the Barbarian quest, is always generated with a +5 runesword.
facts.detect: Encounter Pelias during the Barbarian quest.
facts.action: Prepare to fight Pelias knowing he will have a +5 runesword, which can be a powerful weapon to acquire.

facts.fact: A runesword has the same base damage dice as a broadsword but is lighter and has a higher base cost.
facts.detect: Compare the weight and cost of a runesword to a broadsword.
facts.action: Consider the runesword as a viable weapon option due to its lighter weight, even though it costs more.

facts.fact: Monsters will prefer the runesword to a dwarvish mattock.
facts.detect: Notice monsters wielding runeswords over dwarvish mattocks.
facts.action: Be cautious when encountering monsters wielding runeswords, as they may be more dangerous.

facts.fact: A hero with Stormbringer may use a runesword as a passable off-hand weapon for two-weapon combat.
facts.detect: Find a runesword while carrying Stormbringer.
facts.action: Use the runesword as an off-hand weapon for two-weapon combat if you have Stormbringer.

facts.fact: Archaeologists and Rogues start each game with an uncursed, empty sack.
facts.detect: Starting inventory includes an uncursed, empty sack.
facts.action: Keep the sack for inventory management and protection of fragile items.

facts.fact: Sacks make up 3.5% of all tools that are randomly generated on the ground, in general shops or as death drops.
facts.detect: Finding a sack in the dungeon or in a shop.
facts.action: Pick up the sack for inventory management and protection of fragile items.

facts.fact: A sack protects its contents from the direct effects of fire, cold, shock, and cancellation.
facts.detect: Noticing that items inside a sack are not affected by these effects.
facts.action: Store fragile or valuable items inside a sack for protection.

facts.fact: A sack that is thrown, kicked, or dropped while levitating or on a down stair may have any fragile contents inside be damaged or broken.
facts.detect: Throwing, kicking, or dropping a sack while levitating or on a down stair.
facts.action: Avoid throwing, kicking, or dropping a sack in such situations to prevent damage to its contents.

facts.fact: A sack can be greased to offer some additional protection against water damage.
facts.detect: Having a sack and grease available.
facts.action: Grease the sack to protect its contents from water damage.

facts.fact: Knights start each game with a saddled pony.
facts.detect: Starting the game as a Knight and seeing a saddled pony in the starting inventory.
facts.action: Ride the saddled pony to explore and travel faster.

facts.fact: Saddles are quite rare, making up 0.5% of all randomly-generated tools.
facts.detect: Noticing the scarcity of saddles in the game.
facts.action: Prioritize finding or creating a saddle if planning to ride a steed.

facts.fact: Attempting to saddle a minion will always fail.
facts.detect: Attempting to saddle a minion and receiving the message 'I think would mind.'
facts.action: Avoid attempting to saddle minions.

facts.fact: Attempting to saddle a footrice will always fail and turn the hero to stone if not wearing gloves.
facts.detect: Attempting to saddle a footrice and receiving the message 'You can't saddle such a creature.'
facts.action: Avoid attempting to saddle footrices and ensure gloves are worn if considering it.

facts.fact: A cursed saddle cannot be removed via looting and prevents manual dismounting.
facts.detect: Attempting to remove a cursed saddle and receiving the message 'You can't remove the saddle.'
facts.action: Use alternative methods to remove a cursed saddle, such as feeding the steed a mimic corpse or praying to the god.

facts.fact: Scale mail provides an AC of 4.
facts.detect: Item name: scale mail
facts.action: Equip scale mail to improve AC.

facts.fact: Scale mail weighs 250 units.
facts.detect: Item weight: 250
facts.action: Consider the weight when deciding to wear scale mail, especially in early game.

facts.fact: Scale mail is better than ring mail, which has the same weight but 1 less AC.
facts.detect: Item name: ring mail
facts.action: Prefer scale mail over ring mail for better AC.

facts.fact: Scale mail is inferior to elven mithril-coat and dwarvish mithril-coat.
facts.detect: Item names: elven mithril-coat, dwarvish mithril-coat
facts.action: Seek out elven mithril-coat or dwarvish mithril-coat as an upgrade.

facts.fact: Scale mail can be found in general stores and used armor dealerships.
facts.detect: Shop type: general store, used armor dealership
facts.action: Visit these shops to purchase scale mail if needed.

facts.fact: All Healers start each game with a +0 scalpel as their weapon.
facts.detect: Starting inventory includes a +0 scalpel
facts.action: Keep the scalpel as a backup weapon against acid blobs and other corrosive/rusting monsters until a better weapon is found.

facts.fact: Scalpels are not suitable for throwing like other knives and have a -2 to-hit penalty when thrown.
facts.detect: Attempting to throw the scalpel
facts.action: Avoid throwing the scalpel and use it only for melee combat.

facts.fact: Scalpels are roughly on par with orcish daggers and are not especially strong themselves.
facts.detect: Comparing scalpel damage (1d3) to orcish dagger damage
facts.action: Upgrade to a better melee weapon as soon as possible.

facts.fact: Scalpels are erosion-proofed, making them useful against acid blobs and rust monsters.
facts.detect: Encountering acid blobs or rust monsters
facts.action: Use the scalpel against acid blobs and rust monsters until a better weapon is found.

facts.fact: Early-game Healers can use their scalpel to train the knife skill on gas spores.
facts.detect: Encountering gas spores
facts.action: Train the knife skill on gas spores while monitoring HP with the stethoscope and healing when necessary.

facts.fact: A scimitar is a one-handed melee weapon that uses the saber skill and is made of iron.
facts.detect: curved sword
facts.action: Identify and pick up scimitars as they are a viable weapon for a lawful dwarvish Valkyrie, especially if you have the saber skill.

facts.fact: Mordor orcs have a 3/5 chance of being generated with a scimitar.
facts.detect: Mordor orc with a scimitar
facts.action: Be cautious when encountering Mordor orcs, as they are more likely to be armed with a scimitar, which can be dangerous.

facts.fact: Orc-captains have a 2/3 chance of being generated with Mordor orc weapons, giving them an effective 6/10 chance of generating with scimitars.
facts.detect: Orc-captain with a scimitar
facts.action: Treat orc-captains with caution, as they frequently wield scimitars which can pose a significant threat.

facts.fact: The statue of Perseus on Medusa's Island has a 1/2 chance of containing a blessed +2 scimitar.
facts.detect: Statue of Perseus on Medusa's Island
facts.action: Explore Medusa's Island and check the statue of Perseus for a blessed +2 scimitar, which can be a powerful weapon.

facts.fact: In variants that incorporate the Pirate role patch, Pirates know the scimitar as a cutlass.
facts.detect: Cutlass
facts.action: If playing a variant with the Pirate patch, recognize that a scimitar is referred to as a cutlass.

facts.fact: Scrolls of amnesia make up 3.5% of all randomly-generated scrolls.
facts.detect: Scroll of amnesia in inventory or identified scroll with base price of 200zm
facts.action: Avoid reading unless scrolls of amnesia are already identified or in a situation where respecing skills is beneficial

facts.fact: A hero reading a scroll of amnesia forgets the identities of monsters on the current level.
facts.detect: Messages: 'Thinking of Maud you forget everything else.' or 'Who was that Maud person anyway?'
facts.action: Do not read if in a dangerous level or without a safe fallback plan

facts.fact: The hero loses a number of levels in their skills, three if the scroll is blessed or five otherwise.
facts.detect: Skill levels dropping after reading
facts.action: Use blessed scrolls for respecing skills to avoid losing critical skills

facts.fact: If the scroll is not blessed, the hero may forget some or all of their spells.
facts.detect: Spells disappearing from known spells list
facts.action: Avoid reading unless willing to risk losing spells

facts.fact: Scrolls of amnesia can be written with a magic marker taking up 4 to 7 charges.
facts.detect: Magic marker with charges between 4 and 7
facts.action: Use magic marker to write scrolls of amnesia if planning to respec skills

facts.fact: Scrolls of blank paper make up 2.8% of all scrolls randomly generated on the ground, in general shops or as death drops.
facts.detect: Finding scrolls of blank paper in various locations.
facts.action: Carry scrolls of blank paper and a magic marker to write scrolls when needed.

facts.fact: Scrolls of blank paper can be created by getting other scrolls wet or by zapping them with a wand or spell of cancellation.
facts.detect: Having scrolls and a wand of cancellation or being near water.
facts.action: Use a wand of cancellation on scrolls to create scrolls of blank paper.

facts.fact: Scrolls of blank paper and scrolls of enchant weapon both have a base cost of 60 zm.
facts.detect: Noticing the cost of 60 zm for a scroll.
facts.action: Use price identification to distinguish scrolls of enchant weapon from other scrolls.

facts.fact: A hero reading a scroll of blank paper auto-identifies it without using up the scroll or breaking the illiterate conduct.
facts.detect: Reading a scroll and seeing the message 'This scroll seems to be blank.'
facts.action: Read unidentified scrolls to auto-identify scrolls of blank paper.

facts.fact: Scrolls of blank paper can be used to write other scrolls by applying a magic marker to them.
facts.detect: Having scrolls of blank paper and a magic marker.
facts.action: Use magic marker on scrolls of blank paper to write scrolls.

facts.fact: Scrolls of charging make up 1.5% of all scrolls randomly generated on the ground, in shops or as death drops.
facts.detect: Finding a scroll of charging in inventory or on the ground
facts.action: Keep the scroll for charging valuable items later

facts.fact: If the hero is not confused and reads a scroll of charging, the player is prompted to choose an item to charge from their inventory.
facts.detect: Reading a scroll of charging while not confused
facts.action: Choose a valuable item to charge, such as a wand of death or magic marker

facts.fact: If the hero is confused and reads a scroll of charging, a non-cursed scroll will set their current energy to its maximum.
facts.detect: Reading a scroll of charging while confused
facts.action: Use the scroll to restore energy if low

facts.fact: A cursed scroll of charging will set the number of charges on the item to zero.
facts.detect: Choosing to charge an item with a cursed scroll
facts.action: Avoid using cursed scrolls to charge items

facts.fact: Scrolls of charging are not as high-priority of a wish candidate for players in NetHack 3.7.0 due to changes in wand of wishing mechanics.
facts.detect: Finding a wand of wishing
facts.action: Prioritize wishing for necessary items immediately and use scrolls of charging later

facts.fact: A scroll of confuse monster causes your hands to glow red when read, indicating the next non-lethal hit will confuse the target monster.
facts.detect: Your hands begin to glow red.
facts.action: Use the scroll to confuse monsters before engaging in melee combat.

facts.fact: A blessed scroll of confuse monster adds 2-9 more uses, or only one more use if you have at least 40 stored.
facts.detect: Your hands glow a brilliant red.
facts.action: Prioritize using blessed scrolls to maximize the number of uses.

facts.fact: Reading a cursed scroll of confuse monster will confuse you for up to 100 turns.
facts.detect: You feel confused.
facts.action: Avoid reading cursed scrolls of confuse monster.

facts.fact: Confusing a monster generally makes it much less likely to attack you directly.
facts.detect: appears confused.
facts.action: Use the scroll to confuse monsters before they attack you.

facts.fact: A blessed scroll of confuse monster can cure confusion if read while confused.
facts.detect: A red glow surrounds your head.
facts.action: Use a blessed scroll to cure confusion if you are confused.

facts.fact: A blessed scroll will always generate a monster one time.
facts.detect: Blessed scroll of create monster
facts.action: Use the scroll to generate a single monster for experience or sacrifice.

facts.fact: An uncursed scroll has a 73% chance of creating a monster 2-5 times, and will otherwise create a monster once.
facts.detect: Uncursed scroll of create monster
facts.action: Use the scroll to generate 2-5 monsters for experience or sacrifice, but be prepared for a single monster if it fails.

facts.fact: A cursed scroll has a 73% chance of creating monsters 14-17 times, and will otherwise create monsters 13 times.
facts.detect: Cursed scroll of create monster
facts.action: Avoid using the scroll unless in a safe area or with escape items like a wand of digging or teleportation.

facts.fact: Reading a scroll of create monster while confused has a 73% chance of creating 14 to 17 acid blobs, and will otherwise create 13 acid blobs.
facts.detect: Confused state and scroll of create monster
facts.action: Use the scroll to create acid blobs as a buffer against strong monsters, but only if in a safe area.

facts.fact: A scroll of destroy armor targets and attempts to destroy one piece of worn armor when read.
facts.detect: Message indicating a piece of armor has been destroyed (e.g., 'Your cloak crumbles and turns to dust!')
facts.action: Avoid reading the scroll unless it is necessary to destroy unwanted or cursed armor.

facts.fact: Reading a cursed scroll of destroy armor lowers the enchantment of cursed armor to a minimum of -7 and stuns the hero for 10-19 turns.
facts.detect: Message indicating the hero's skin vibrates ('Your vibrates.')
facts.action: Avoid reading cursed scrolls of destroy armor unless it is necessary to lower the enchantment of cursed armor.

facts.fact: Reading a non-cursed scroll of destroy armor while confused removes erosion-proofing on a piece of armor.
facts.detect: Message indicating the hero's skin itches ('Your skin itches.')
facts.action: Avoid reading scrolls of destroy armor while confused unless it is necessary to remove erosion-proofing.

facts.fact: Reading a scroll of destroy armor while not wearing armor abuses strength and constitution.
facts.detect: Message indicating the hero's bones itch ('Your bones itch.')
facts.action: Avoid reading the scroll if not wearing any armor.

facts.fact: Scrolls of destroy armor make up 4.5% of all randomly-generated scrolls.
facts.detect: Encountering a scroll of destroy armor in the game.
facts.action: Be cautious when reading unidentified scrolls, as there is a chance it could be a scroll of destroy armor.

facts.fact: A scroll of earth will create 9 boulders - 8 around the reader and one on top of their head - while an uncursed scroll of earth will create 8 boulders around the reader without dropping one on them, and a cursed scroll will create a single boulder over the reader's head.
facts.detect: The ceiling rumbles you!
facts.action: Identify the scroll's beatitude before reading it to avoid taking damage from boulders.

facts.fact: Reading a scroll of earth on a Sokoban level before solving that floor will decrease the hero's luck by 1.
facts.detect: The ceiling rumbles you!
facts.action: Avoid reading scrolls of earth on Sokoban levels until they are solved to maintain luck.

facts.fact: Intelligent monsters may be generated with a scroll of earth as an offensive item if they are generated wearing a hard helm.
facts.detect: Monster with a hard helm reading a scroll of earth.
facts.action: Prioritize killing intelligent monsters with hard helms before they can use the scroll.

facts.fact: Scrolls of earth can be used to create 'boulder forts' to deal with dangerous monsters or hordes of monsters.
facts.detect: Presence of dangerous monsters or hordes.
facts.action: Use blessed scrolls of earth to create boulder forts to safely deal with dangerous monsters.

facts.fact: Scrolls of earth can be used to fill trapdoors, holes, and moats.
facts.detect: Presence of trapdoors, holes, or moats.
facts.action: Use scrolls of earth to fill trapdoors, holes, or moats to safely cross large bodies of water or block off areas.

facts.fact: A scroll of enchant armor has a 6.3% chance of appearing in randomly-generated scrolls.
facts.detect: Finding a scroll of enchant armor in randomly generated scrolls or in shops.
facts.action: Store the scroll for later use when the bot has armor to enchant.

facts.fact: A hero that reads a scroll of enchant armor while not confused will auto-identify the scroll if it targets worn armor.
facts.detect: Reading a scroll of enchant armor and receiving a message about the armor's enchantment.
facts.action: Use the scroll immediately if it targets worn armor to avoid losing the scroll.

facts.fact: Worn armor with an enchantment of +4 or greater has a high chance of evaporating when targeted by a non-cursed scroll of enchant armor.
facts.detect: Armor with an enchantment of +4 or greater.
facts.action: Avoid using non-cursed scrolls of enchant armor on armor with an enchantment of +4 or greater.

facts.fact: A non-cursed scroll of enchant armor can increase the enchantment of non-magical items and elven armor by multiple points at once.
facts.detect: Non-magical items or elven armor with an enchantment of +3 or lower.
facts.action: Prioritize enchanting non-magical items and elven armor with non-cursed scrolls of enchant armor.

facts.fact: Confused heroes reading a scroll of enchant armor will make targeted armor erosion-proof and repair erosion damage.
facts.detect: Being confused and having a scroll of enchant armor.
facts.action: Use the scroll to repair erosion damage on armor.

facts.fact: Reading a scroll of enchant armor while wearing armor can repair damage on a worn piece of armor.
facts.detect: Your [armor] is as good as new!
facts.action: Use scroll of enchant armor on damaged armor to repair it.

facts.fact: Reading a cursed scroll of enchant armor while confused removes erosion-proofing from a worn piece of armor.
facts.detect: Your [armor] is covered by a mottled black glow!
facts.action: Avoid reading cursed scrolls of enchant armor while confused.

facts.fact: Reading a scroll of enchant armor while confused and blind affects a worn piece of armor.
facts.detect: Your [armor] feels warm for a moment.
facts.action: Avoid reading scrolls of enchant armor while confused and blind.

facts.fact: Reading a scroll of enchant armor while not wearing any armor causes your skin to glow then fade.
facts.detect: Your skin glows then fades.
facts.action: Do not use scroll of enchant armor if not wearing armor.

facts.fact: Reading a scroll of enchant armor while not wearing armor and being a beginner causes a feeling that passes.
facts.detect: You have a feeling for a moment, then it passes.
facts.action: Do not use scroll of enchant armor if not wearing armor and are a beginner.

facts.fact: A scroll of enchant weapon can increase the enchantment of the wielded weapon by one point if uncursed, decrease by one point if cursed, and potentially increase by more than one point if blessed.
facts.detect: Reading a scroll of enchant weapon and observing the weapon's enchantment change.
facts.action: Use uncursed scrolls to increase weapon enchantment to +5, then use blessed scrolls to try to increase to +7.

facts.fact: A weapon at +6 enchantment or higher has a 2/3 chance of evaporating when enchanted by a non-cursed scroll of enchant weapon.
facts.detect: Weapon enchantment is +6 or higher.
facts.action: Avoid using non-cursed scrolls of enchant weapon on weapons with +6 or higher enchantment.

facts.fact: Reading a non-cursed scroll of enchant weapon while wielding a worm tooth will transform it into a crysknife.
facts.detect: Wielding a worm tooth.
facts.action: Use non-cursed scrolls of enchant weapon to transform worm tooth into crysknife.

facts.fact: Reading a cursed scroll of enchant weapon while wielding a crysknife will turn it back into a worm tooth.
facts.detect: Wielding a crysknife.
facts.action: Avoid using cursed scrolls of enchant weapon on crysknives.

facts.fact: Reading a scroll of enchant weapon while confused will make the weapon erodeproof and fix any existing damage.
facts.detect: Being confused.
facts.action: Use non-cursed scrolls of enchant weapon while confused to erodeproof and repair weapon damage.

facts.fact: A scroll of fire causes an explosion in a 3x3 area, with the location dependent on the scroll's beatitude: blessed scrolls allow the hero to choose the center, while cursed and uncursed scrolls center the explosion on the reader.
facts.detect: Message: 'Where do you want to center the explosion?' or 'The scroll erupts in a tower of flame!'
facts.action: If holding a blessed scroll of fire, choose a safe location to center the explosion, such as an empty area far from valuable items or yourself.

facts.fact: Reading a scroll of fire while confused will always ignite the scroll in the reader's hands, dealing 1 HP of damage to the hero.
facts.detect: Message: 'You read the scroll while confused and burn your .'
facts.action: Avoid reading scrolls of fire while confused to prevent self-inflicted damage.

facts.fact: Scrolls of fire can be used to cure sliming for both heroes and monsters caught in the explosion.
facts.detect: Message: 'The slime that covers you is burned away!'
facts.action: If slimed, use a scroll of fire to cure the sliming, but be cautious of the explosion damage.

facts.fact: Monsters with fire resistance may read a scroll of fire to damage adjacent heroes.
facts.detect: Monster reads a scroll of fire while adjacent to the hero.
facts.action: Avoid being adjacent to monsters that might read a scroll of fire, especially if they have fire resistance.

facts.fact: Scrolls of fire make up 6.5% of all randomly-generated scrolls.
facts.detect: Finding a scroll of fire in inventory or in shops.
facts.action: Be cautious when reading unidentified scrolls of fire due to the risk of explosion damage.

facts.fact: A non-cursed scroll of food detection detects and reveals the location of all comestibles on the level, including food that is buried, submerged, inside a container, or in the inventory of a monster.
facts.detect: Message: 'Your starts to tingle and you smell food.'
facts.action: Read the scroll to find all food sources on the level, including those in containers or monster inventories.

facts.fact: Reading a blessed scroll of food detection grants the food appraisal intrinsic to the hero if they do not currently possess it.
facts.detect: Message: 'Your starts to tingle and you smell food.' or 'Your twitches then starts to tingle.'
facts.action: Read a blessed scroll to gain food appraisal and detect all food sources on the level.

facts.fact: Reading a cursed scroll of food detection or being confused and reading a scroll of any beatitude will detect all potions on the level.
facts.detect: Message: 'Your starts to tingle and you smell food.' or 'Your twitches.'
facts.action: If confused or reading a cursed scroll, use the scroll to detect potions instead of food.

facts.fact: The scroll will auto-identify itself when used.
facts.detect: Scroll of food detection is used.
facts.action: No specific action needed, as the scroll auto-identifies.

facts.fact: Monsters will not read this scroll.
facts.detect: No monsters are observed reading the scroll.
facts.action: No specific action needed, as monsters do not use the scroll.

facts.fact: Roughly ~1.5% of all scrolls found in the dungeon will be scrolls of genocide.
facts.detect: Finding a scroll of genocide in the dungeon.
facts.action: Keep the scroll safe and use it wisely, especially when dealing with dangerous monsters or preparing for ascension.

facts.fact: Reading a scroll of any beatitude will auto-identify it.
facts.detect: Reading a scroll of genocide.
facts.action: Ensure you are not confused before reading the scroll to avoid accidental genociding of your own role.

facts.fact: Uncursed scrolls of genocide allow you to genocide a chosen monster species.
facts.detect: Choosing to genocide a specific monster species.
facts.action: Use this to eliminate troublesome or dangerous monster species, such as soldier ants or sea monsters.

facts.fact: Cursed scrolls of genocide summon 4-6 monsters of the chosen species.
facts.detect: Choosing to genocide a specific monster species.
facts.action: Use this to summon desired monsters for taming or experience gain, such as wraiths or dragons.

facts.fact: There is a small alignment penalty for a lawful character that genocides any human species.
facts.detect: Genociding a human species.
facts.action: Avoid genociding human species if you are lawful to maintain alignment.

facts.fact: Reading an uncursed scroll of gold detection detects and reveals the location of all gold golems and gold pieces on the level.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel very greedy, and sense gold!' or 'You notice some gold between your feet.'
facts.action: Use the scroll to locate gold pieces and gold golems, which can help in finding vaults and treasure zoos.

facts.fact: Reading a blessed scroll of gold detection detects gold pieces and also reveals other items made of gold.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel very greedy, and sense gold!' or 'You notice some gold between your feet.'
facts.action: Use the scroll to locate gold pieces and other gold items, which can help in finding vaults and treasure zoos.

facts.fact: Reading a cursed scroll or reading any scroll while confused detects and reveals the location of all traps on the level.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel worried about your future financial situation.' or 'You feel materially poor.' or 'You feel very greedy.' or 'You feel entrapped.'
facts.action: Use the scroll to detect traps, which can help in avoiding dangerous traps and finding the magic portal to the Quest branch.

facts.fact: Scrolls of gold detection can be written with a magic marker using 4 to 7 charges.
facts.detect: Having a magic marker and scrolls of gold detection.
facts.action: Write scrolls of gold detection to save weight and prepare for later use in the mid-game and end-game.

facts.fact: Monsters will not read scrolls of gold detection.
facts.detect: No monster will pick up or read the scroll.
facts.action: Leave scrolls of gold detection in the dungeon as they will not be used by monsters.

facts.fact: Scrolls of identify make up 18% of all randomly-generated scrolls.
facts.detect: Finding a stack of unidentified scrolls in inventory
facts.action: Prioritize reading scrolls of identify to maximize item identification

facts.fact: A blessed scroll of identify will always identify at least two items if the hero's luck is positive.
facts.detect: Having positive luck and a blessed scroll of identify
facts.action: Use blessed scrolls of identify to identify multiple items

facts.fact: If a scroll of any beatitude is read while confused, it will auto-identify itself with no further effect.
facts.detect: Message: You identify this as an identify scroll.
facts.action: Avoid reading scrolls of identify while confused

facts.fact: Scrolls of identify are the only scroll with a base price of 20zm, making price identification trivial.
facts.detect: Price of unidentified scrolls in shops
facts.action: Use price identification to identify scrolls of identify

facts.fact: A cursed scroll of identify will only identify one item.
facts.detect: Cursed scroll of identify
facts.action: Avoid using cursed scrolls of identify unless necessary

facts.fact: A scroll of light creates a permanent light radius around the hero when read: 5 squares for uncursed, 9 squares for blessed, and darkens a 5-square area for cursed.
facts.detect: Message 'A lit field surrounds you!' for blessed or uncursed, 'You are surrounded by darkness!' for cursed.
facts.action: Use blessed or uncursed scroll to light up dark areas, avoid cursed scrolls unless necessary.

facts.fact: Cursed scroll of light extinguishes light sources except Sunsword, gold dragon scales, and gold dragon scale mail.
facts.detect: Message 'Your [lamp/lantern/candle]'s flame is extinguished.'
facts.action: Avoid using cursed scrolls unless in possession of Sunsword, gold dragon scales, or gold dragon scale mail.

facts.fact: Scroll of light auto-identifies if the hero can see its effects.
facts.detect: Immediate effect of lighting or darkening.
facts.action: Use the scroll to auto-identify it.

facts.fact: Reading a scroll of light while confused will summon tame black or yellow lights.
facts.detect: Message 'Lights appear all around you!' or 'Tiny lights sparkle in the air momentarily.'
facts.action: Avoid reading scrolls of light while confused unless necessary.

facts.fact: Scrolls of light are the only type of scroll with a base price of 50zm.
facts.detect: Price of 50zm when found in shops or inventory.
facts.action: Use this price to identify scrolls of light.

facts.fact: Reading an uncursed scroll of magic mapping maps the entire level and reveals all secret passages, while a blessed scroll additionally reveals any secret doors present on the level.
facts.detect: Message: 'A map coalesces in your mind!' followed by the map revealing all secret passages and secret doors.
facts.action: Use an uncursed or blessed scroll of magic mapping to fully explore and map the current level, especially before descending to new levels.

facts.fact: Reading a cursed scroll of magic mapping will only reveal 7 of the level's squares at random.
facts.detect: Message: 'Unfortunately, you can't grasp the details.'
facts.action: Avoid using cursed scrolls of magic mapping as they provide very limited information and can be dangerous if used on non-mappable levels.

facts.fact: Reading a scroll of magic mapping on a non-mappable level confuses the hero for up to 30 more turns.
facts.detect: Message: 'Your mind is filled with crazy lines!' followed by 'Your spins in bewilderment.' if not hallucinating.
facts.action: Do not use scrolls of magic mapping on non-mappable levels such as Medusa's Island or Gehennom to avoid confusion.

facts.fact: Scrolls of mail are never generated randomly in the dungeon.
facts.detect: Scroll of mail not appearing randomly in the dungeon.
facts.action: Ignore the possibility of finding scrolls of mail randomly in the dungeon.

facts.fact: Scrolls of mail cannot be made into other scrolls or merge into a paper golem via polypiling.
facts.detect: Attempting to polypile scrolls of mail.
facts.action: Avoid polypiling scrolls of mail as they will turn into junk mail.

facts.fact: Scrolls of mail cannot be blanked by cancellation, acid damage or getting them wet.
facts.detect: Applying cancellation, acid, or water to a scroll of mail.
facts.action: Do not attempt to blank scrolls of mail as it has no effect.

facts.fact: Reading a scroll of mail that is wished for, written, created by polypiling, or else discovered in a bones file has no effect other than to print a message.
facts.detect: Reading a scroll of mail not delivered by a mail daemon.
facts.action: Avoid reading such scrolls to preserve illiterate conduct.

facts.fact: Scrolls of mail still disappear when read.
facts.detect: Reading a scroll of mail.
facts.action: Be aware that the scroll will disappear after reading.

facts.fact: A scroll of punishment chains a heavy iron ball to the hero if uncursed, and increases the weight of an already-chained ball by 160 aum if uncursed and the hero is already punished.
facts.detect: Message: You feel guilty (for a blessed scroll) or no message (if confused)
facts.action: Avoid reading unidentified scrolls to prevent being punished, especially early in the game when carrying capacity is crucial.

facts.fact: A cursed scroll of punishment chains a heavy iron ball to the hero, or increases the weight of an already-chained ball by 320 aum if the hero is already punished.
facts.detect: Message: You feel a heavy weight on your leg (for a cursed scroll)
facts.action: Avoid reading unidentified scrolls to prevent being heavily punished, especially early in the game.

facts.fact: A blessed scroll of punishment prints a message with no other effect, regardless of whether the hero is already punished or confused.
facts.detect: Message: You feel guilty
facts.action: Safe to read if you have identified it as blessed and are not confused.

facts.fact: Monks and wizards may start with a scroll of punishment in their inventory.
facts.detect: Inventory check at the start of the game
facts.action: If you start with a scroll of punishment, consider selling it to a general store, second-hand bookstore, or rare books shop.

facts.fact: Scrolls of punishment make up 1.5% of all randomly-generated scrolls.
facts.detect: Not directly detectable, but useful for understanding scroll generation probabilities.
facts.action: Be cautious with unidentified scrolls, as there is a 1.5% chance it could be a scroll of punishment.

facts.fact: A scroll of remove curse can be given to Monks and Wizards as a starting inventory item.
facts.detect: Starting inventory includes a scroll of remove curse.
facts.action: Keep the scroll in inventory for potential curse removal.

facts.fact: Scrolls of remove curse make up 6.5% of all randomly-generated scrolls.
facts.detect: Finding a scroll of remove curse in a general store, second-hand bookstore, or rare books shop.
facts.action: Purchase and keep the scroll for potential curse removal.

facts.fact: An uncursed scroll of remove curse uncurses all equipped items.
facts.detect: Equipped items are cursed and need to be uncursed.
facts.action: Use an uncursed scroll of remove curse to uncurse all equipped items.

facts.fact: A blessed scroll of remove curse uncurse all cursed items in the inventory.
facts.detect: Inventory contains cursed items.
facts.action: Use a blessed scroll of remove curse to uncurse all cursed items.

facts.fact: Confused readings of blessed scrolls of remove curse can create holy water and unholy water.
facts.detect: Hero is confused and has a blessed scroll of remove curse.
facts.action: Use the confused scroll to potentially create holy or unholy water.

facts.fact: A scroll of scare monster can be used without being read and can scare monsters when standing on it.
facts.detect: Standing on a scroll of scare monster or seeing it on the ground.
facts.action: Stand on the scroll to scare monsters around you.

facts.fact: Picking up a cursed scroll of scare monster will cause it to disintegrate.
facts.detect: Picking up a cursed scroll of scare monster.
facts.action: Avoid picking up cursed scrolls of scare monster.

facts.fact: Scrolls of scare monster can be used to defend stashes and prevent monsters from moving onto the square.
facts.detect: Placing a scroll of scare monster under a stash.
facts.action: Use a scroll of scare monster to protect stashes.

facts.fact: Scrolls of scare monster can be used in conjunction with reverse genocide to obtain multiple desired corpses.
facts.detect: Having a scroll of scare monster and a small enclosed area.
facts.action: Use the scroll to scare and kill specific monsters for corpses.

facts.fact: Monks and wizards may start with a scroll of scare monster in their inventory.
facts.detect: Starting inventory of a Monk or Wizard character.
facts.action: Use the scroll strategically for its benefits.

facts.fact: Scrolls of stinking cloud make up 1.5% of all randomly-generated scrolls.
facts.detect: Not directly detectable by the bot, but useful for understanding scroll rarity.
facts.action: None specific, but the bot should be aware of the rarity when searching for scrolls.

facts.fact: When read, the scroll will auto-identify and prompt you to select a square on the dungeon map.
facts.detect: Message: 'You smell rotten eggs.'
facts.action: Select a square to place the cloud, considering the beatitude of the scroll.

facts.fact: Blessed scrolls will create a larger cloud and do more damage; cursed scrolls give a smaller cloud and do less damage.
facts.detect: Scroll identification or inventory message indicating blessed/uncursed/cursed status.
facts.action: Use blessed scrolls for maximum effect, especially in crowded areas or against tough monsters.

facts.fact: The cloud will damage monsters unless they are nonliving, unbreathing, or have poison resistance.
facts.detect: Monster types and their resistances.
facts.action: Target monsters that lack poison resistance for maximum effect.

facts.fact: Peaceful monsters caught in the poison gas will become hostile.
facts.detect: Peaceful monsters turning hostile after being exposed to the cloud.
facts.action: Use the scroll cautiously around peaceful monsters to avoid unnecessary hostility.

facts.fact: A scroll of taming can tame monsters within an 11x11 area if read while confused.
facts.detect: Message: 'The neighborhood friendlier.' or 'The neighborhood unfriendlier.'
facts.action: Use a scroll of taming while confused to tame distant monsters.

facts.fact: Reading a cursed scroll of taming turns peaceful monsters hostile within an 11x11 area if read while confused.
facts.detect: Message: 'The neighborhood unfriendlier.'
facts.action: Avoid reading cursed scrolls of taming while confused.
