facts.fact: A scroll of taming auto-identifies if its effects are seen on monsters within vision.
facts.detect: Message: 'The neighborhood friendlier.' or 'The neighborhood unfriendlier.'
facts.action: Read a scroll of taming to auto-identify it.

facts.fact: Non-cursed scrolls of taming are useful for pacifying important peaceful monsters that were angered.
facts.detect: Angered peaceful monster in vicinity
facts.action: Use a non-cursed scroll of taming to pacify angered peaceful monsters.

facts.fact: The scroll of taming's messages are unique and can be used to informally identify it.
facts.detect: Message: 'Nothing interesting happens.' or 'Nothing interesting seems to happen.'
facts.action: Read an unidentified scroll to check for unique taming messages.

facts.fact: A scroll of teleportation is generated in closets with no door that are not on non-teleport levels.
facts.detect: Finding a closet with no door on a non-teleport level.
facts.action: Search the closet to find the scroll of teleportation.

facts.fact: A cursed scroll of teleportation is generated in the hidden lower-left section of the Rogue quest locate level.
facts.detect: Being in the hidden lower-left section of the Rogue quest locate level.
facts.action: Avoid reading the scroll if found in this area.

facts.fact: Reading a non-cursed scroll of teleportation teleports the reader to another square on the same level.
facts.detect: Reading a scroll of teleportation.
facts.action: Use teleport control to choose a safe destination if available.

facts.fact: Reading a cursed scroll of teleportation or a non-cursed scroll while confused will cause the reader to level teleport.
facts.detect: Being confused or reading a cursed scroll.
facts.action: Avoid reading the scroll if confused or if it is cursed.

facts.fact: Monsters will only read the scroll while scared.
facts.detect: Seeing a scared monster.
facts.action: Avoid the monster if it is scared and holding a scroll.

facts.fact: A shield of reflection is the sole magical shield in the game and provides 2 base AC and extrinsic reflection.
facts.detect: polished silver shield
facts.action: Pick up and equip the shield of reflection to gain the reflection property and AC bonus.

facts.fact: The shield of reflection will auto-identify if it is seen reflecting a ray or gaze attack.
facts.detect: message indicating the shield reflected a ray or gaze attack
facts.action: Continue to use the shield as it has auto-identified.

facts.fact: Archons are always generated with a shield of reflection.
facts.detect: Encountering an archon
facts.action: Steal or take the shield of reflection from the archon if possible.

facts.fact: The shield of reflection is more ideal for ascension kits of heroes that cannot or do not wish to twoweapon or cast spells.
facts.detect: Character build that does not rely on twoweaponing or spellcasting
facts.action: Equip the shield of reflection as part of the ascension kit.

facts.fact: Spare shields of reflection are quite good for powerful humanoid pets to protect them against rays from random wands or breath weapons.
facts.detect: Powerful humanoid pets in the inventory or level
facts.action: Equip a spare shield of reflection on a powerful humanoid pet to protect it.

facts.fact: Barbarians have a 1/2 chance of starting each game with a +0 short sword as their one-handed weapon.
facts.detect: Starting game as a Barbarian and checking inventory for a short sword.
facts.action: If starting with a short sword, consider it as a primary weapon until better options are found.

facts.fact: Rogues start each game with a +0 short sword as their primary weapon.
facts.detect: Starting game as a Rogue and checking inventory for a short sword.
facts.action: If starting with a short sword, use it as a primary weapon until better options are found.

facts.fact: Samurai start each game with a +0 wakizashi as their secondary melee weapon.
facts.detect: Starting game as a Samurai and checking inventory for a wakizashi.
facts.action: If starting with a wakizashi, use it as a secondary weapon until better options are found.

facts.fact: Watchmen and soldiers have a 2/3 chance of generating with a short sword.
facts.detect: Encountering Watchmen or soldiers.
facts.action: Be prepared to fight Watchmen or soldiers who may be armed with short swords.

facts.fact: Ninja have a 3/4 chance of generating with a short sword as their melee weapon.
facts.detect: Encountering Ninja.
facts.action: Be prepared to fight Ninja who may be armed with short swords.

facts.fact: Shuriken are a type of weapon that appears in NetHack, made of iron, and appears as a throwing star when unidentified.
facts.detect: Item name 'shuriken' or appearance 'throwing star'
facts.action: Identify shuriken as a weapon and consider using it for ranged attacks if you have the skill or can train it.

facts.fact: Shuriken are ineffective in melee and must be used by throwing or firing them.
facts.detect: Attempting to melee attack with a shuriken
facts.action: Avoid melee combat with shuriken and use them for ranged attacks.

facts.fact: Shuriken gain bonuses from a hero's strength, can misfire if cursed, and have a chance of mulching upon hitting a target based on their enchantment, their beatitude and the hero's luck.
facts.detect: Checking weapon properties or attempting to throw a cursed shuriken
facts.action: Enchant shuriken and ensure they are not cursed before using them.

facts.fact: Monks, ninja, and player monster monks gain a +1 multishot bonus when throwing shuriken.
facts.detect: Character class 'Monk' or 'Ninja'
facts.action: Use shuriken for multishot attacks if you are a Monk or Ninja.

facts.fact: Shuriken are best employed against dangerous melee-range threats such as mind flayers.
facts.detect: Encountering a mind flayer or similar dangerous melee threat
facts.action: Use shuriken to attack dangerous melee threats from a distance.

facts.fact: Silver arrows make up 1.2% of all randomly-generated weapons.
facts.detect: Finding a silver arrow in a randomly generated pile of weapons or in a shop.
facts.action: Collect silver arrows if found, as they are effective against silver-hating monsters.

facts.fact: Silver arrows deal +1d20 damage against silver-hating monsters.
facts.detect: Encountering a silver-hating monster such as a werewolf or vampire.
facts.action: Use silver arrows against silver-hating monsters for increased damage.

facts.fact: Silver arrows are rare and hard to amass without using wishes.
facts.detect: Noticing a lack of silver arrows in shops or randomly generated piles.
facts.action: Consider using wishes to obtain silver arrows if they are needed for a specific strategy.

facts.fact: With maximized luck, a small stack of silver arrows can last a long time.
facts.detect: Having a small stack of silver arrows and high luck.
facts.action: Use silver arrows sparingly and strategically with high luck to maximize their effectiveness.

facts.fact: Silver daggers deal +d20 damage to silver-hating monsters due to their material.
facts.detect: Encountering a silver-hating monster (e.g., a vampire, lich, or other undead/demon)
facts.action: Use silver daggers against silver-hating monsters for increased damage.

facts.fact: Silver daggers are erosion-proof.
facts.detect: Attempting to erode a silver dagger
facts.action: Do not attempt to erode silver daggers as they cannot be eroded.

facts.fact: Silver daggers are stackable and can be thrown.
facts.detect: Having multiple silver daggers in inventory
facts.action: Use silver daggers for throwing against distant enemies or for ranged attacks.

facts.fact: Silver daggers are among the deadliest weapon options in Gehennom when highly enchanted.
facts.detect: Entering Gehennom with a stack of highly enchanted silver daggers
facts.action: Use enchanted silver daggers as primary ranged attack weapons in Gehennom.

facts.fact: Silver daggers deal 1d4 extra damage against major demons and undead when blessed.
facts.detect: Blessing a silver dagger and encountering a demon or undead
facts.action: Use blessed silver daggers against demons and undead for increased damage.

facts.fact: Silver sabers make up 0.6% of all randomly generated weapons.
facts.detect: Finding a silver saber on the ground, in a general shop, or as a death drop.
facts.action: Pick up the silver saber if you find one, as it is a rare and valuable weapon.

facts.fact: Watch captains and Yendorian army captains have a roughly 50% chance of being generated with a silver saber.
facts.detect: Encountering a watch captain or Yendorian army captain.
facts.action: Consider killing the watch captain if you need a silver saber, but be cautious of alignment penalties.

facts.fact: A silver saber deals 1d8 damage versus all monsters with a +1d20 damage bonus against silver-hating monsters.
facts.detect: Encountering silver-hating monsters such as shades, demons, werecreatures, and vampires.
facts.action: Use the silver saber against silver-hating monsters to maximize damage.

facts.fact: Monsters that do not hate silver prefer a silver saber to a morning star and prefer a scimitar or better to the silver saber.
facts.detect: Encountering monsters with a silver saber.
facts.action: Steal or take the silver saber from monsters that do not hate silver if you need one.

facts.fact: A silver spear is a stackable one-handed weapon that can be thrown and used in melee, and uses the spear skill.
facts.detect: Weapon name: silver spear
facts.action: Equip and use the silver spear if you have the spear skill and it is available.

facts.fact: Silver spears deal additional damage to silver-hating monsters.
facts.detect: Monster type: silver-hating
facts.action: Use the silver spear against silver-hating monsters for increased damage.

facts.fact: Silver spears are one of the few non-restricted options available to Monks.
facts.detect: Role: Monk
facts.action: Consider using the silver spear as a primary weapon if you are a Monk.

facts.fact: The silver spear does only one point less damage on average against small or medium monsters than a silver saber.
facts.detect: Weapon type: silver saber
facts.action: If you have a silver saber, consider using the silver spear as a secondary weapon for its damage output.

facts.fact: Silver spears deal the same base damage against large monsters as other silver weapons.
facts.detect: Monster size: large
facts.action: Use the silver spear against large monsters for its consistent damage.

facts.fact: Skeleton keys make up 8% of all randomly-generated tools.
facts.detect: Finding a key in a general store or hardware store, or in a shopkeeper's inventory.
facts.action: Pick up the skeleton key if found, as it is useful for locking and unlocking doors and containers.

facts.fact: There is a (70+Dex)% chance of success for unlocking doors and a (75+Dex)% chance for unlocking containers.
facts.detect: Checking the hero's dexterity level and the type of lock (door or container).
facts.action: Use the skeleton key to lock or unlock doors and containers when the hero's dexterity is high enough to ensure a high success rate.

facts.fact: A hero applying a skeleton key to a door in Minetown in view of a watch member has a 1/3 chance during each action of being interrupted and warned.
facts.detect: Being in Minetown and seeing a watch member nearby.
facts.action: Avoid using the skeleton key on doors in Minetown when a watch member is nearby to prevent angering the watch.

facts.fact: A hero that applies a skeleton key on a mimic disguised as a door will uncover the mimic.
facts.detect: Attempting to use a skeleton key on a door and seeing a mimic appear.
facts.action: Be cautious when using a skeleton key on doors, especially if mimics are suspected.

facts.fact: Intelligent monsters with hands will pick up a skeleton key and use it to unlock locked doors.
facts.detect: Seeing an intelligent monster with hands pick up a skeleton key.
facts.action: Prevent intelligent monsters from obtaining the skeleton key to avoid them unlocking doors.

facts.fact: Nameable fruits make up 7.5% of all comestibles randomly generated on the ground, in general shops or as death drops.
facts.detect: Finding a fruit named 'slime mold', 'paddle cactus', or 'dwarven root' on the ground or in a shop.
facts.action: Eat the fruit to gain 250 nutrition and a single turn to consume it.

facts.fact: Applying a charged horn of plenty has a 6.9% chance of generating one or two nameable fruits.
facts.detect: Using a horn of plenty and seeing the message 'You hear a faint tinkling sound.'
facts.action: Check the ground for nameable fruits after using the horn.

facts.fact: Eating the nameable fruit grants 250 nutrition and takes a single turn to consume it.
facts.detect: Picking up a fruit and eating it.
facts.action: Eat the fruit when hungry to gain nutrition.

facts.fact: A hero can throw nameable fruits to tame domestic herbivorous monsters and pacify domestic carnivores.
facts.detect: Seeing a domestic herbivorous or carnivorous monster on the map.
facts.action: Throw a nameable fruit at the monster to tame or pacify it.

facts.fact: To wish for a nameable fruit, the player must input 'fruit' regardless of its current name.
facts.detect: Wishing for a fruit.
facts.action: Wish for 'fruit' to receive a nameable fruit.

facts.fact: Cave Dwellers start with a +2 sling and one stack each of rocks and flint stones to use as ammunition.
facts.detect: Starting character is a Cave Dweller and inventory check shows +2 sling, rocks, and flint stones.
facts.action: Use the +2 sling with flint stones for ranged attacks early in the game.

facts.fact: Slings make up 4% of all weapons that are randomly generated on the ground.
facts.detect: Finding a sling in the dungeon.
facts.action: Pick up and use the sling if no better weapon is available, especially if rocks or flint stones are available.

facts.fact: Hobbits have a 1/3 chance of being generated with a sling and either rocks or flint stones as ammo.
facts.detect: Starting character is a Hobbit and inventory check shows a sling with rocks or flint stones.
facts.action: Use the sling with rocks or flint stones for ranged attacks early in the game.

facts.fact: Flint stones are the best projectiles for slinging by far due to their 1d6 damage.
facts.detect: Inventory check shows flint stones.
facts.action: Prioritize using flint stones as ammunition for the sling.

facts.fact: Cave Dwellers that avoid using their starting flint stones until they have maximum luck can bless them and have them last for a significant portion of the game.
facts.detect: Character is a Cave Dweller with maximum luck and inventory check shows flint stones.
facts.action: Bless flint stones and use them for ranged attacks.

facts.fact: Valkyries start each game with a +3 small shield.
facts.detect: Starting equipment message mentioning a +3 small shield
facts.action: Wear the +3 small shield immediately as it provides a significant AC boost and is enchanted.

facts.fact: A small shield grants 1 base AC.
facts.detect: Checking the AC value of the small shield
facts.action: Keep the small shield equipped for its AC and lower spellcasting penalty.

facts.fact: The small shield is worth wearing for a long time due to its high enchantment.
facts.detect: Checking the enchantment level of the small shield
facts.action: Continue to use the small shield for its high enchantment and low spellcasting penalty.

facts.fact: The small shield is the easiest of the three wooden shields to identify.
facts.detect: Buying or selling a small shield in a shop
facts.action: Identify the small shield when it auto-identifies in a shop.

facts.fact: An elven shield may be a superior option for certain builds depending on the character's exact needs.
facts.detect: Finding an elven shield
facts.action: Consider switching to an elven shield if it provides a better balance of AC and spellcasting penalty.

facts.fact: Snickersnee is an artifact katana with +1d8 damage bonus to all monsters.
facts.detect: Snickersnee (item name)
facts.action: Pick up and wield Snickersnee if found, as it provides significant damage bonus.

facts.fact: Snickersnee can be applied at a distance once per turn as a free action.
facts.detect: Snickersnee (item name) and hero skill in long sword
facts.action: Use Snickersnee's ranged attack ability to engage or disengage from combat safely.

facts.fact: Snickersnee is the first guaranteed sacrifice gift for Samurai.
facts.detect: Samurai role
facts.action: Sacrifice to obtain Snickersnee if playing as a Samurai.

facts.fact: Snickersnee requires a sacrifice of at least 8 value.
facts.detect: Sacrifice value
facts.action: Ensure sacrifice value is at least 8 to obtain Snickersnee.

facts.fact: Snickersnee is a decent first artifact weapon for Samurai and lawful heroes.
facts.detect: Samurai or lawful hero role
facts.action: Use Snickersnee as a primary weapon until a better artifact can be obtained.

facts.fact: Dwarven Valkyries start each game with a dwarvish spear of the same enchantment as a +1 spear for human Valkyries.
facts.detect: Starting inventory includes a dwarvish spear.
facts.action: Keep the starting dwarvish spear as it is a valuable weapon.

facts.fact: Spears have a +2 to-hit bonus when thrown and can be multishot.
facts.detect: Throwing a spear.
facts.action: Use the spear for ranged attacks to take advantage of the +2 to-hit bonus and multishot capability.

facts.fact: Watchmen and soldiers in the Yendorian army have a 1/3 chance of being generated with a spear as their primary weapon.
facts.detect: Encountering watchmen or soldiers.
facts.action: Be prepared for the possibility of these enemies wielding spears.

facts.fact: Guards have a 1/7 chance of generating with a spear as their secondary weapon.
facts.detect: Encountering guards.
facts.action: Be cautious as guards may have spears as secondary weapons.

facts.fact: Salamanders have a 6/7 chance of generating with a spear.
facts.detect: Encountering salamanders.
facts.action: Expect salamanders to be armed with spears.

facts.fact: Speed boots grant 1 AC and extrinsic very fast speed.
facts.detect: You feel yourself speed up when putting on speed boots.
facts.action: Equip speed boots to gain movement speed and AC.

facts.fact: Wearing speed boots gives an extra six movement points per turn, plus a 1/3 chance of an additional six movement points.
facts.detect: You feel yourself speed up when putting on speed boots.
facts.action: Use speed boots to move faster and potentially avoid or outmaneuver monsters.

facts.fact: Speed boots are the only source of extrinsic speed that doesn't time out.
facts.detect: You feel yourself speed up when putting on speed boots.
facts.action: Keep speed boots equipped for sustained speed advantage.

facts.fact: Blessed fixed +2 or +3 speed boots are a common early wish.
facts.detect: Wish for speed boots with +2 or +3 enchantment.
facts.action: Wish for speed boots with +2 or +3 enchantment for better speed.

facts.fact: Speed boots are valuable in turncount speedrunning.
facts.detect: You feel yourself speed up when putting on speed boots.
facts.action: Use speed boots to reduce turn count in speedruns.

facts.fact: A spellbook of blank paper can be used to write a brand new spellbook of any spell you currently know by using a magic marker.
facts.detect: Item name: spellbook of blank paper, item name: magic marker
facts.action: Use a magic marker on a spellbook of blank paper to create a new spellbook of a known spell.

facts.fact: Blank spellbooks can be acquired by blanking regular spellbooks, for example by dipping them into a fountain.
facts.detect: Exact message text: You dip the spellbook into the fountain.
facts.action: Dip a regular spellbook into a fountain to obtain a spellbook of blank paper.

facts.fact: A general store, a rare books store, and a second-hand bookstore sometimes have blank spellbooks for sale.
facts.detect: Shop type: general store, rare books store, second-hand bookstore
facts.action: Visit these shops to purchase a spellbook of blank paper.

facts.fact: When writing, the beatitude of the resulting spellbook is affected by the beatitude of both the spellbook of blank paper and the magic marker.
facts.detect: Item name: spellbook of blank paper, item name: magic marker
facts.action: Ensure the spellbook of blank paper and the magic marker are blessed before writing a new spellbook.

facts.fact: Wizards have a better chance of guessing at a spell they don't know and writing it successfully.
facts.detect: Character class: Wizard
facts.action: If playing as a Wizard, attempt to write unknown spells on a spellbook of blank paper.

facts.fact: The spellbook of cancellation allows the casting of the cancellation spell, which works like the wand of cancellation.
facts.detect: Spellbook of cancellation
facts.action: Collect and use the spellbook to cancel items, especially if you have high magic power and are facing monsters with high magic resistance.

facts.fact: The spell requires 64 turns of magic power to cast.
facts.detect: Magic power level
facts.action: Ensure you have enough magic power before attempting to cast the spell.

facts.fact: The spell cannot cancel the wand of cancellation or the wand of nothing.
facts.detect: Wand of cancellation or wand of nothing
facts.action: Do not attempt to cancel these wands with the spell.

facts.fact: The spellbook of cancellation cannot be cancelled into a spellbook of blank paper.
facts.detect: Spellbook of cancellation
facts.action: Keep this spellbook safe as it cannot be converted into a blank spellbook.

facts.fact: At higher experience levels, the spell has a significant advantage in passing monster magic resistance checks compared to the wand of cancellation.
facts.detect: High experience level
facts.action: Use the spell instead of the wand of cancellation when you have a high experience level.

facts.fact: The spellbook of cause fear is a level 3 enchantment spell that takes 8 actions to read.
facts.detect: The bot will find a spellbook with the name 'cause fear' in its inventory or on the ground.
facts.action: If the bot has the spellbook and is in a situation where it needs to deal with multiple monsters or has sleep resistance to deal with, it should read the spellbook to learn the spell of cause fear.

facts.fact: The spell of cause fear scares non-tame monsters that fail a roll against their MR score, causing them to flee.
facts.detect: The bot will see messages like 'The monster flees in fear!' or 'The monster is too scared to move.'
facts.action: The bot should use the spell to scare monsters away when it encounters dangerous or numerous monsters, especially if it is low on hit points or has limited ranged attack options.

facts.fact: Monsters that are fleeing have a 25% chance of recovering each turn if they are at full HP.
facts.detect: The bot will see monsters that were previously scared start to move again after a few turns.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious and ready to use the spell again or use other means to keep monsters scared or immobilized.

facts.fact: Monsters that are immobile and scared by the spell will be indicated with a message.
facts.detect: The bot will see messages like 'The monster is too scared to move.'
facts.action: The bot should be aware that immobile scared monsters can still be attacked or manipulated.

facts.fact: The spell of cause fear is less commonly used by most heroes, who prefer tools like bugles or wands of sleep for scaring monsters.
facts.detect: The bot will not see other players or guides recommending the spell of cause fear as a primary method for dealing with monsters.
facts.action: The bot should consider using the spell of cause fear as a supplementary tactic, especially in situations where other methods are unavailable or less effective.

facts.fact: The spellbook of charm monster is a level 3 enchantment spell that takes 8 turns to read.
facts.detect: Spellbook of charm monster
facts.action: Read the spellbook to learn the spell of charm monster if you are a lawful dwarvish Valkyrie and have the ability to train enchantment spells.

facts.fact: The spell of charm monster can pacify or tame monsters adjacent to the hero.
facts.detect: Adjacent monsters
facts.action: Cast the spell to pacify or tame dangerous monsters, especially in pinch situations or when dealing with angry shopkeepers or aligned priests.

facts.fact: The spell of charm monster behaves the same as reading a non-cursed scroll of taming.
facts.detect: Scroll of taming
facts.action: Use the spell as an alternative to scrolls of taming when you have the spellbook and can cast it reliably.

facts.fact: The spell can help turn the tables on a hostile spellcaster by turning some or all of the freshly summoned monsters against them.
facts.detect: Hostile spellcaster summoning monsters
facts.action: Cast the spell to turn summoned monsters against the hostile spellcaster.

facts.fact: The spell can pacify or tame late-game monsters such as dragons, minotaurs, purple worms, and mastodons.
facts.detect: Late-game monsters
facts.action: Use the spell to pacify or tame powerful monsters in the late game.

facts.fact: The spellbook of clairvoyance is a level 3 divination spell that takes 8 actions to read.
facts.detect: Spellbook of clairvoyance in inventory
facts.action: Read the spellbook to learn the spell of clairvoyance if the bot has the time and is at least level 3 in divination spells.

facts.fact: When cast, the spell grants clairvoyance and maps a roughly-circular 19-by-11 area centered on the hero's location.
facts.detect: Casting the spell of clairvoyance
facts.action: Use the spell to map the area around the bot, especially before exploring new areas or when unsure of the surroundings.

facts.fact: At Basic skill or lower, the spell marks the location of monsters in the mapped area with an I glyph, and any items detected within the area are described by their object types.
facts.detect: Basic skill in divination spells
facts.action: If the bot has Basic skill or lower, the spell will still provide useful information about the immediate surroundings, marking monsters and item types.

facts.fact: If the hero casts the spell while wearing a cornuthaum as any role other than a Wizard, the helm will block the spell.
facts.detect: Wearing a cornuthaum
facts.action: Remove the cornuthaum before attempting to cast the spell of clairvoyance.

facts.fact: The spell of clairvoyance is not blocked on non-mappable levels unlike magic mapping spells or scrolls.
facts.detect: Being on a non-mappable level
facts.action: Use the spell of clairvoyance to map the area if the bot is on a non-mappable level, such as The Catacombs.

facts.fact: The spellbook of cone of cold is a level 4 attack spell that takes 23 actions to read.
facts.detect: Reading a spellbook of cone of cold
facts.action: Allocate time to read the spellbook if you have the actions available and are at a safe location.

facts.fact: At Basic or lower skill level, the spell behaves like a wand of cold, dealing (XL/2+1)d6 cold damage.
facts.detect: Casting the spell and seeing the damage output
facts.action: Use the spell to deal damage to monsters, especially those lacking cold resistance.

facts.fact: At Skilled or higher, the spell creates 2 to 9 3x3 explosions centered on a chosen square.
facts.detect: Choosing a square to cast the spell
facts.action: Target a square with monsters to deal significant damage, especially if they have fire resistance but not cold resistance.

facts.fact: The spell can freeze water and lava, turning them into ice and solid rock respectively.
facts.detect: Seeing water or lava turn into ice or solid rock
facts.action: Use the spell to create safe paths over water or lava.

facts.fact: The spell can bounce off walls and destroy doors.
facts.detect: Seeing the spell hit a wall or door
facts.action: Use this property to hit monsters behind walls or to destroy doors.

facts.fact: The spellbook of confuse monster can be read to learn the spell of confuse monster, which is a level 2 enchantment spell in NetHack 3.6.7.
facts.detect: Reading the spellbook of confuse monster.
facts.action: Read the spellbook to learn the spell of confuse monster if it is available and you have the necessary skill level.

facts.fact: When the spell of confuse monster is cast at Basic or lower skill, the hero's hands glow red, signifying a 'charge'.
facts.detect: Your hands begin to glow red.
facts.action: Use the spell to confuse monsters in melee combat, but be cautious as it may not be effective against high MR monsters.

facts.fact: At Skilled or higher skill, the spell replicates the blessed scroll and applies 2-9 charges of the ability, reduced to 1 if the hero has 40 or more charges already stored.
facts.detect: Your hands glow a brilliant red.
facts.action: Use the spell to confuse monsters in melee combat, but be cautious as it may not be effective against high MR monsters.

facts.fact: If the hero casts the spell while polymorphed into any form other than human or elf, they will confuse themselves for up to 100 turns.
facts.detect: You feel confused.
facts.action: Avoid casting the spell while polymorphed into non-human or elf forms to prevent self-confusion.

facts.fact: The spell of confuse monster is fairly niche and loses much of its effectiveness as the hero encounters monsters with high MR scores more frequently.
facts.detect: Encountering monsters with high MR scores.
facts.action: Prefer other spells or wands that are more effective against high MR monsters.

facts.fact: The spellbook of create familiar is a level 6 clerical spell and takes 44 actions to read.
facts.detect: Spellbook of create familiar
facts.action: If the bot has sufficient clerical skill and the spellbook, it should read it to attempt to create a familiar.

facts.fact: An aligned priest can be generated with the spellbook of create familiar as one of their spellbooks.
facts.detect: Encountering an aligned priest with a spellbook of create familiar
facts.action: Steal the spellbook if possible or kill the priest to obtain it.

facts.fact: The spell of create familiar creates a monster adjacent to the hero with a 1/3 chance of being an appropriate monster type for the role.
facts.detect: Creating a familiar
facts.action: If the familiar created is beneficial, keep it; otherwise, consider polymorphing it or using it for other purposes.

facts.fact: The hero's Clerical skill level improves the odds of getting better familiars.
facts.detect: Checking the hero's Clerical skill level
facts.action: Increase Clerical skill level to improve the chances of creating a better familiar.

facts.fact: Wearing a Ring of aggravate monster can summon stronger familiars.
facts.detect: Possession of a Ring of aggravate monster
facts.action: Wear the ring to attempt to summon stronger familiars, but be cautious of diminishing returns.

facts.fact: The spellbook of create monster is a level 2 clerical spell that takes 5 actions to read.
facts.detect: Reading the spellbook of create monster.
facts.action: Use the spell to create monsters for sacrifice or to obtain useful items, but be cautious of summoning dangerous monsters.

facts.fact: The spell has a 72/73 chance of creating a single monster and a 73 chance of creating 2-5 monsters.
facts.detect: Observing the number of monsters created after casting the spell.
facts.action: Evaluate the risk versus reward of casting the spell based on the number of monsters created.

facts.fact: The spell is less ideal for generating nutrition compared to the wand of create monster due to lower chances and limits on the number of monsters created.
facts.detect: Noticing the lack of edible corpses or useful items dropped by created monsters.
facts.action: Avoid using the spell for nutrition generation unless in a situation where other food sources are scarce.

facts.fact: Coaligned temples are generally among the best areas for altar farming with the spell due to sanctuary.
facts.detect: Entering a coaligned temple sanctuary.
facts.action: Cast the spell in a coaligned temple sanctuary to safely farm monsters for sacrifice.

facts.fact: The spell is mission-critical for extinctionist conducts, especially for Wizards with The Eye of the Aethiopica.
facts.detect: Having The Eye of the Aethiopica and aiming for extinctionist conduct.
facts.action: Use the spell extensively to create large amounts of monsters for extinctionist play.

facts.fact: The spellbook of cure blindness is a level 2 healing spell that takes 4 actions to read.
facts.detect: The item name 'Spellbook of cure blindness' in inventory or on the ground.
facts.action: If blind, read the spellbook to cure blindness. Otherwise, consider polypiling or blanking the spellbook if it is not needed.

facts.fact: Priests may start with this spellbook, while Wizards may receive it as their starting non-force bolt spellbook.
facts.detect: Starting inventory or message 'You are a Wizard and your starting spellbook is a spellbook of cure blindness.'
facts.action: If a Wizard, check if the starting spellbook is a spellbook of cure blindness and plan accordingly.

facts.fact: There are multiple methods to cure blindness, including unicorn horns and spells of healing (at Skilled) and extra healing.
facts.detect: Inventory of unicorn horns or message 'You are skilled in spellcasting.'
facts.action: If other blindness curing items or spells are available, prioritize them over the spellbook of cure blindness.

facts.fact: The spellbook is rarely of much value outside on-demand confusion.
facts.detect: Feeling confused or seeing the message 'You are confused.'
facts.action: If confused, consider reading the spellbook to cure confusion.

facts.fact: The spellbook is a prime candidate for polypiling or blanking and overwriting.
facts.detect: Having the spellbook and not needing it for blindness or confusion.
facts.action: Polypile or blank the spellbook to make space for more useful items.

facts.fact: The spellbook of cure sickness is a level 3 healing spell that cures all forms of sickness, including food poisoning and illness, and stops sliming.
facts.detect: Spellbook of cure sickness
facts.action: Read the spellbook to learn the spell of cure sickness if available, especially if the bot is slimed or poisoned.

facts.fact: The spellbook of cure sickness makes up 3.25% of randomly-generated spellbooks.
facts.detect: Finding a spellbook of cure sickness in randomly generated locations.
facts.action: Prioritize reading the spellbook of cure sickness if found, as it is highly valuable for curing sickness and sliming.

facts.fact: High-level Healers with 18 wisdom can cast this spell with 0% failure rates, even while wearing metallic armor without a robe.
facts.detect: Bot's character level and wisdom score, and whether the bot is wearing metallic armor without a robe.
facts.action: If the bot is a high-level Healer with 18 wisdom, the spell can be cast safely even while wearing metallic armor without a robe.

facts.fact: The spellbook of detect food is a level 2 divination spell that can be read to learn the spell of detect food.
facts.detect: Reading a spellbook of detect food.
facts.action: Read the spellbook to learn the spell of detect food.

facts.fact: Casting the spell of detect food at Skilled or higher skill level grants the food appraisal intrinsic.
facts.detect: Casting the spell of detect food and having a skill level of Skilled or higher.
facts.action: Cast the spell of detect food to gain the food appraisal intrinsic.

facts.fact: The spell of detect food does not drain nutrition when cast.
facts.detect: Casting the spell of detect food while low on nutrition.
facts.action: Cast the spell of detect food to find food without losing nutrition.

facts.fact: The spell of detect food can be used to check for the corpses of reviving monsters such as trolls.
facts.detect: Seeing a corpse of a reviving monster like a troll.
facts.action: Cast the spell of detect food to check if the troll has resurrected.

facts.fact: Spellbooks of detect food make up 3% of all randomly-generated spellbooks.
facts.detect: Finding a spellbook of detect food in a general store, second-hand bookstore, or rare books store.
facts.action: Keep the spellbook of detect food for later use.

facts.fact: The spellbook of detect monsters is a level 1 divination spell that takes 3 actions to read.
facts.detect: Reading a spellbook of detect monsters.
facts.action: Read the spellbook to learn the spell of detect monsters.

facts.fact: At Skilled or higher level, the spell grants passive monster detection for 21-60 turns.
facts.detect: Hero's divination skill level is Skilled or higher.
facts.action: Cast the spell to gain passive monster detection.

facts.fact: Casting the spell while hallucinating will display monsters as their hallucinated identities.
facts.detect: Hero is hallucinating.
facts.action: Avoid casting the spell if hallucinating to prevent confusion.

facts.fact: The spell is most effective when combined with magic mapping.
facts.detect: Hero has magic mapping.
facts.action: Use magic mapping in conjunction with detect monsters spell.

facts.fact: Spellbooks of detect monsters make up 4.3% of all randomly-generated spellbooks.
facts.detect: Finding a spellbook of detect monsters in a randomly-generated location.
facts.action: Keep the spellbook for later use.

facts.fact: The spellbook of detect treasure is a level 4 divination spell that takes 17 actions to read.
facts.detect: The bot will notice the spellbook in its inventory or find it in a general store, second-hand bookstore, or rare book store.
facts.action: The bot should read the spellbook to learn the spell of detect treasure if it has the necessary skill level and energy.

facts.fact: The spell of detect treasure emulates the uncursed potion of object detection at Basic level or lower, displaying the current position of all objects on the level.
facts.detect: The bot will see a message indicating that it has cast the spell and will navigate through the displayed map of objects.
facts.action: The bot should cast the spell to detect objects on the level, especially to find gold, bones, and the Castle chest with the wand of wishing.

facts.fact: At Skilled or higher level, the spell emulates the blessed potion of object detection, showing full object appearances and learning inventory items.
facts.detect: The bot will notice that it has learned the appearance of all items in its inventory after casting the spell.
facts.action: The bot should cast the spell to gain full object appearances and learn inventory items, especially when navigating Gehennom and mapping stair locations.

facts.fact: Buried objects will have their glyphs vanish when the bot moves adjacent to them, and digging down with a pick-axe on their formerly-marked square will reveal them.
facts.detect: The bot will see the glyph of a buried object vanish when it moves adjacent to it.
facts.action: The bot should dig down with a pick-axe on the formerly-marked square to reveal buried objects.

facts.fact: The spell is useful when combined with a means of magic mapping to scope out the level and prioritize specific locations.
facts.detect: The bot will notice that it has the means of magic mapping, such as a spell or item.
facts.action: The bot should use the spell in conjunction with magic mapping to prioritize specific locations and navigate Gehennom.

facts.fact: The spellbook of detect unseen is a level 3 divination spell that takes 10 actions to read.
facts.detect: The bot will notice the spellbook in its inventory and see its level when examining it.
facts.action: The bot should prioritize reading the spellbook to learn the spell of detect unseen, especially if it needs to navigate areas with hidden traps or secret doors.

facts.fact: The spell of detect unseen reveals undiscovered secret doors, uncloaks mimics, reveals hiding monsters, reveals traps, and marks the location of invisible monsters within an 8-square radius.
facts.detect: The bot will notice changes in the dungeon layout, such as newly revealed secret doors, uncloaked mimics, and marked locations of invisible monsters.
facts.action: The bot should cast the spell of detect unseen before entering potentially dangerous areas or when unsure about the dungeon layout.

facts.fact: The spell of detect unseen can penetrate through clouds on the Plane of Air and water on the Plane of Water.
facts.detect: The bot will be on the Plane of Air or Plane of Water and notice the spell's effect on the environment.
facts.action: The bot should cast the spell of detect unseen when on these planes to ensure it can navigate safely.

facts.fact: The spell of detect unseen has no effect if the hero is engulfed.
facts.detect: The bot will be engulfed by a monster or in a dangerous situation where it cannot cast the spell.
facts.action: The bot should avoid being engulfed or find a way to escape engulfment before attempting to cast the spell.

facts.fact: The spell of detect unseen is useful for finding dangerous traps, detecting magic portals, and finding the temple entrance in Moloch's Sanctum.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter situations where it needs to find traps, portals, or the temple entrance.
facts.action: The bot should cast the spell of detect unseen in these situations to ensure safety and progress.

facts.fact: The spellbook of dig is a level 5 matter spell and takes 32 actions to read.
facts.detect: Reading the spellbook of dig
facts.action: Do not read the spellbook of dig unless you are a Caveman or have a specific need for a forgettable spell to confuse enemies.

facts.fact: The spell of dig has a similar effect to zapping a wand of digging, firing a ray that digs through walls and creates holes in the floor.
facts.detect: Casting the spell of dig
facts.action: Use the spell of dig sparingly and only when you have no other digging tools or when you need to dig through walls.

facts.fact: Casting the spell of dig is power-intensive and less useful than wands of digging due to its high level and limited utility.
facts.detect: Having a wand of digging
facts.action: Prefer wands of digging over the spell of dig for digging tasks.

facts.fact: The spell of dig is almost guaranteed to be useless to Cavemen due to their high spellcasting penalty.
facts.detect: Being a Caveman
facts.action: Only read the spellbook of dig if you are a Caveman and have no other digging tools.

facts.fact: The Wizard of Yendor on the Plane of Earth will have a spellbook of dig, intended as a backup digging tool.
facts.detect: Encountering the Wizard of Yendor on the Plane of Earth
facts.action: Take the spellbook of dig from the Wizard of Yendor as a backup digging tool if you have no other options.

facts.fact: Spellbooks of drain life make up 1% of all spellbooks randomly generated on the ground, in general shops or as death drops.
facts.detect: Finding a spellbook of drain life in inventory or on the ground.
facts.action: If found, read the spellbook to learn the spell of drain life, as it can be useful for draining levels from monsters and enchantment from items.

facts.fact: Successfully casting the spell prompts the player for a cardinal direction to fire the beam in.
facts.detect: After casting the spell, the game will prompt for a direction to aim the beam.
facts.action: Choose a direction to aim the beam at a monster or item, aiming at monsters without drain resistance for level and HP drain.

facts.fact: A cloaked mimic hit by the spell of drain life will uncloak and take damage as normal.
facts.detect: Seeing a mimic uncloak after being hit by the spell.
facts.action: Use the spell to reveal mimics and damage them.

facts.fact: A hero casting the spell at themselves will drain one experience level unless they have drain resistance.
facts.detect: Casting the spell on oneself.
facts.action: Avoid casting the spell on oneself unless intentionally trying to lower experience level.

facts.fact: The spell of drain life is more unusual compared to most other attack spells: it does not deal much in the way of direct damage, but the level drain it inflicts makes it much better for extended battles against spellcasters, covetous monsters and other persistent hostiles such as trolls that lack drain resistance.
facts.detect: Encountering spellcasters, covetous monsters, or trolls.
facts.action: Use the spell to drain levels from these monsters to weaken them over time.

facts.fact: Healers start each game with a blessed spellbook of extra healing.
facts.detect: Starting inventory check
facts.action: Keep the spellbook of extra healing for its healing properties and bless it if not already blessed.

facts.fact: Spellbooks of extra healing make up 2.7% of all randomly-generated spellbooks.
facts.detect: Finding a spellbook of extra healing in a general store, second-hand bookstore, or rare book store.
facts.action: Purchase and keep the spellbook of extra healing for its healing properties.

facts.fact: The spell of extra healing heals for 6d8 HP and cures blindness not from cream pie or blinding venom.
facts.detect: Casting the spell on a blinded monster or self.
facts.action: Use the spell to heal and cure blindness when necessary.

facts.fact: A lawful hero gains a +1 bonus to alignment record for each pet or peaceful that they heal with the spell.
facts.detect: Healing a pet or peaceful monster.
facts.action: Heal pets or peaceful monsters to gain alignment bonuses.

facts.fact: Pestilence takes 3d8 damage from the spell, halved due to MR.
facts.detect: Casting the spell on Pestilence.
facts.action: Avoid using the spell on Pestilence to prevent unnecessary damage.

facts.fact: The spellbook of finger of death is a level 7 attack spell that takes 82 actions to read.
facts.detect: Reading the spellbook of finger of death.
facts.action: Read the spellbook to learn the spell if you have the time and energy to do so.

facts.fact: Spellbooks of finger of death make up 0.5% of all randomly-generated spellbooks.
facts.detect: Finding a spellbook of finger of death in a store or randomly generated.
facts.action: Purchase or keep the spellbook if you are a Wizard or have the intention to become one.

facts.fact: The finger of death spell behaves identically to zapping a wand of death.
facts.detect: Casting the finger of death spell.
facts.action: Be extremely careful about the direction you cast the spell to avoid killing yourself or your pets.

facts.fact: The finger of death spell can instantly kill any hero or monster that it hits unless they have magic resistance or reflection.
facts.detect: Encountering a monster that lacks magic resistance or reflection.
facts.action: Use the finger of death spell to kill threatening monsters like minotaurs, wizards of Yendor, and high priests.

facts.fact: Some monsters like Archons, Angels, and Death are immune to the finger of death spell.
facts.detect: Encountering an Archon, Angel, or Death.
facts.action: Avoid using the finger of death spell against these monsters and use other methods like magic missiles.

facts.fact: The spellbook of fireball is inherently fireproof and cannot be destroyed by sources of fire damage.
facts.detect: The bot will not see the spellbook of fireball being destroyed by fire sources.
facts.action: The bot can safely carry and use the spellbook of fireball without fear of it being destroyed by fire.

facts.fact: At Basic or lower, the spell behaves like a ray of fire, creating a 3x3 explosion centered on the first obstacle or monster hit.
facts.detect: The bot will see messages like 'is caught in the fireball!' or 'You are caught in the fireball!'.
facts.action: The bot should be cautious when casting the spell to avoid hitting itself or allies.

facts.fact: At Skilled or higher, the spell produces 2 to 9 3x3 explosions centered on and around the targeted square.
facts.detect: The bot will see messages like 'Your mind fails to lock onto that location!' or 'The spell dissipates over the distance!'.
facts.action: The bot should aim carefully and ensure it can see the target square to avoid wasting the spell.

facts.fact: The fireball spell deals 12d6 fire damage to a hero or monster caught in the explosion, with spell damage bonuses applied against monsters.
facts.detect: The bot will see messages like 'is caught in the fireball!' or 'You are caught in the fireball!'.
facts.action: The bot should use the spell to target fire-resistant or high-MR monsters effectively.

facts.fact: A Knight carrying the Magic Mirror of Merlin in open inventory deals double damage to monsters when casting the spell.
facts.detect: The bot will see the item 'Magic Mirror of Merlin' in its inventory.
facts.action: The bot should equip the Magic Mirror of Merlin to maximize damage output.

facts.fact: All Flame Mages start the game with a spellbook of flame sphere.
facts.detect: Starting inventory includes Spellbook of Flame Sphere
facts.action: Learn and use the spellbook to create flaming spheres for offense and defense.

facts.fact: When cast, the spell creates a tame flaming sphere - if cast at Skilled level, two flaming spheres are created, and if cast at Expert, three are created.
facts.detect: Player's skill level in spellcasting
facts.action: Increase spellcasting skill to create multiple flaming spheres for more effective combat.

facts.fact: Flaming spheres created by this spell are considered spell beings: monsters killed by exploding flaming spheres are considered the responsibility of the player character, i.e. they gain experience from monsters the sphere killed, as well as any blame if the sphere attacks a peaceful monster.
facts.detect: Exploding flaming spheres killing monsters
facts.action: Control the position of flaming spheres to avoid attacking peaceful monsters and gain experience from killed monsters.

facts.fact: Discretion is the better part of valor in utilizing the flame sphere spell: do not allow summoned spheres to drift near shopkeepers or other similar peacefuls, e.g. by trying to attack mimics in shops with them, and exercise caution if moving while blind to avoid killing pet spheres.
facts.detect: Presence of shopkeepers or peaceful monsters
facts.action: Avoid using flaming spheres near peaceful monsters to prevent alignment and luck penalties.

facts.fact: Attacking a shopkeeper with a flaming sphere will anger them, but unlike other attacks from outside their shop, it will not trigger the 'hot pursuit' behavior that causes them to leave their shop and chase you.
facts.detect: Attacking a shopkeeper with a flaming sphere
facts.action: Use flaming spheres to safely kill shopkeepers without triggering hot pursuit.

facts.fact: Wizards start every game with a blessed spellbook of force bolt and cannot receive a second one as their secondary spellbook.
facts.detect: Player character is a Wizard and starts with a blessed spellbook of force bolt.
facts.action: If the bot is a Wizard, it should keep the spellbook of force bolt and use it for its offensive and utility purposes.

facts.fact: Spellbooks of force bolt make up 3.5% of all randomly-generated spellbooks.
facts.detect: Bot finds a spellbook of force bolt in a randomly generated location.
facts.action: Bot should read the spellbook of force bolt to learn the spell of force bolt.

facts.fact: Successfully casting the spell prompts the player for a cardinal direction to shoot the force bolt in, and behaves similarly to the wand of striking.
facts.detect: Bot casts the spell of force bolt.
facts.action: Bot should aim the force bolt in a direction that avoids peaceful monsters and shopkeepers.

facts.fact: A hero zapping the spell at themselves will take 2d12 damage and abuse strength unless they have magic resistance.
facts.detect: Bot attempts to cast force bolt on itself.
facts.action: Bot should avoid casting force bolt on itself unless it has magic resistance.

facts.fact: Zapping the spell downward wipes 2-8 letters from any engraving on that square, and doing so over a trap door will shatter the door and turn it into a hole.
facts.detect: Bot zaps downward and sees an engraving or a trap door.
facts.action: Bot should avoid zapping downward near trap doors or important engravings.

facts.fact: The spellbook of freeze sphere creates a tame freezing sphere which explodes at an enemy.
facts.detect: Spellbook of freeze sphere
facts.action: Use the spell to summon a freezing sphere to attack enemies, especially useful for attacking cross-aligned unicorns with two or three spheres.

facts.fact: Freezing spheres can cause problems if left uncontrolled, as they can kill peaceful monsters and shopkeepers, leading to negative consequences such as shopkeepers' anger and loss of alignment.
facts.detect: Shopkeepers or peaceful monsters being killed by a freezing sphere
facts.action: Control the movement of freezing spheres carefully, especially in shops and near peaceful monsters, to avoid unwanted consequences.

facts.fact: Freezing spheres do not affect undead or ice vortices.
facts.detect: Encountering undead or ice vortices
facts.action: Avoid using freezing spheres against undead or ice vortices, as they will not be affected.

facts.fact: Attacking a shopkeeper with a freezing sphere will anger them but will not trigger the 'hot pursuit' behavior.
facts.detect: Shopkeeper being attacked by a freezing sphere
facts.action: Exploit this behavior to safely kill shopkeepers with numerous freezing spheres by standing diagonally next to an open shop door.

facts.fact: Freezing spheres do not show up through telepathy while blind.
facts.detect: Being blind
facts.action: Exercise caution while blind to avoid accidentally killing a freezing sphere, as it will have the same consequences as killing a pet.

facts.fact: The spellbook of haste self is a level 3 escape spell that takes 10 actions to read.
facts.detect: Reading a spellbook of haste self.
facts.action: Read the spellbook to learn the spell of haste self if you have the time and energy, especially if you are a Barbarian or have a need for very fast speed.

facts.fact: Casting haste self gives the hero several turns of very fast speed, with the number of turns depending on the hero's skill level in escape spells.
facts.detect: Casting the spell of haste self.
facts.action: Cast the spell when you need to move quickly, such as when escaping from dangerous situations or when you need to cover a lot of ground quickly.

facts.fact: A hero with The Eye of the Aethiopica or the Mitre of Holiness can cast haste self on themselves several times to obtain enough turns of speed to last for a majority of the game.
facts.detect: Possessing The Eye of the Aethiopica or the Mitre of Holiness.
facts.action: Use these items to repeatedly cast haste self to maintain a high speed for extended periods, freeing up an armor slot for other useful items.

facts.fact: Most heroes will prefer speed boots as their source of very fast speed, but the spell can be useful for those who also need jumping boots.
facts.detect: Equipping speed boots or jumping boots.
facts.action: Consider using the spell of haste self if you need both very fast speed and jumping, but prioritize speed boots if you only need speed.

facts.fact: Beware that any effects which remove speed, such as stoning or slowing attacks, will remove all accumulated turns of speed.
facts.detect: Being affected by stoning or slowing attacks.
facts.action: Avoid using haste self if you are likely to encounter effects that remove speed, or be prepared to recast the spell if necessary.

facts.fact: Healing spell heals 6d4 HP and cures blindness at Skilled or higher.
facts.detect: Message: ' looks better.'
facts.action: Cast healing spell on self or tame/peaceful monsters to heal HP and cure blindness.

facts.fact: Casting healing on a tame or peaceful monster yields an alignment bonus.
facts.detect: Message: ' looks better.' followed by alignment change.
facts.action: Cast healing on tame or peaceful monsters to gain alignment points.

facts.fact: Pestilence takes 3d4 damage from healing spell.
facts.detect: Monster name: 'Pestilence'
facts.action: Avoid casting healing on Pestilence.

facts.fact: Healing spell is directional and can be used to heal pets.
facts.detect: Message: ' looks better.'
facts.action: Use healing spell to heal pets, especially in early-game or for pacifist players.

facts.fact: Healing spell is most useful when natural regeneration is impractical or dangerous.
facts.detect: Deep dungeon levels or polymorphed into a monster.
facts.action: Cast healing spell when natural regeneration is slow or impossible.

facts.fact: The spellbook of identify can be read to learn the spell of identify, which takes 14 actions to read.
facts.detect: The bot will see the spellbook of identify in its inventory or find it in a store.
facts.action: Read the spellbook of identify to learn the spell of identify.

facts.fact: The spell of identify can identify at least one item in the hero's open inventory that is not fully identified.
facts.detect: The bot will have unidentified items in its inventory.
facts.action: Cast the spell of identify to identify items in the inventory.

facts.fact: At Skilled or higher level, the spell of identify has a 20% chance of identifying one, two, three, four, or all items in open inventory that are not fully identified.
facts.detect: The bot will have a high skill level in divination spells.
facts.action: Cast the spell of identify to maximize the number of items identified.

facts.fact: The spell of identify is considered the most useful utility spell in the game, reducing the amount of management required for inventory throughout the game.
facts.detect: The bot will have a spellbook of identify in its inventory.
facts.action: Use the spell of identify to manage inventory more efficiently.

facts.fact: Finding a relatively safe spot to cast the spell of identify is ideal, particularly if your worn armor needs to be adjusted or removed for casting.
facts.detect: The bot will need to adjust or remove worn armor for casting.
facts.action: Find a safe spot to cast the spell of identify.

facts.fact: A spellbook of invisibility is always generated in a chest within a random closet on the middle level of Vlad's Tower.
facts.detect: Chest in a closet on the middle level of Vlad's Tower
facts.action: Search for and read the spellbook of invisibility to learn the spell of invisibility.

facts.fact: The spell of invisibility lasts for 31 to 45 turns unless the player is wearing a mummy wrapping.
facts.detect: Casting the spell of invisibility
facts.action: Use the spell of invisibility to become invisible for a limited time.

facts.fact: The spellbook of invisibility is one of the special spellbooks for Rangers.
facts.detect: Player character is a Ranger
facts.action: Prioritize finding and reading the spellbook of invisibility as it is a special spell for Rangers.

facts.fact: Spellbooks of invisibility make up 2.5% of all randomly-generated spellbooks.
facts.detect: Finding a spellbook in a general store, second-hand bookstore, or rare book store
facts.action: Read the spellbook of invisibility to learn the spell of invisibility.

facts.fact: A hero casting the spell of invisibility at any skill level becomes invisible for 31 to 45 turns.
facts.detect: Casting the spell of invisibility
facts.action: Use the spell of invisibility to become invisible for a limited time.

facts.fact: The spellbook of jumping is a level 1 escape spell that can be read to learn the spell of jumping.
facts.detect: Finding a spellbook of jumping in inventory or on the ground.
facts.action: Read the spellbook to learn the spell of jumping.

facts.fact: The spell of jumping allows the hero to jump to a target square they can see, bypassing traps and potentially hostile monsters.
facts.detect: Being in a situation where a trap or hostile monster blocks the path.
facts.action: Cast the spell of jumping to bypass the obstacle.

facts.fact: Jumping through the spell is possible even with encumbrance, low strength, low nutrition levels, or wounded legs.
facts.detect: Feeling encumbered, having low strength, low nutrition, or wounded legs.
facts.action: Cast the spell of jumping to move despite these conditions.

facts.fact: Jumping can be used to escape from webs, beartraps, and certain types of traps.
facts.detect: Being trapped in a web or beartrap.
facts.action: Cast the spell of jumping to free oneself from the trap.

facts.fact: Jumping is useful for crossing certain special levels like Medusa's Island, but caution is needed around underwater creatures.
facts.detect: Being on Medusa's Island or near underwater creatures.
facts.action: Use the spell of jumping to cross the level, but be cautious around water.

facts.fact: The spellbook of knock is a level 1 matter spell that can be read to learn the spell of knock.
facts.detect: Finding a spellbook of knock in inventory or on the ground.
facts.action: Read the spellbook to learn the spell of knock.

facts.fact: Casting the spell of knock has the same effects as zapping a wand of opening, including opening and unlocking doors, containers, and drawbridges.
facts.detect: Encountering a locked door, container, or drawbridge.
facts.action: Cast the spell of knock to open or unlock the obstacle.

facts.fact: Casting the spell of knock can free a hero from traps such as webs, beartraps, and pits.
facts.detect: Being trapped in a web, beartrap, or pit.
facts.action: Cast the spell of knock to free oneself from the trap.

facts.fact: Casting the spell of knock can free a hero from lava or cooled lava that traps them.
facts.detect: Being trapped in lava or cooled lava.
facts.action: Cast the spell of knock to free oneself from the lava.

facts.fact: Casting the spell of knock can be used to escape from an engulfing monster.
facts.detect: Being engulfed by a monster.
facts.action: Cast the spell of knock to escape from the engulfing monster.

facts.fact: The spellbook of levitation is a level 4 escape spell that takes 14 actions (roughly 12 turns) to read.
facts.detect: Reading a spellbook of levitation
facts.action: Read the spellbook to learn the spell of levitation when you have enough charges and turns available.

facts.fact: Casting the spell of levitation at Basic skill or lower gives you levitation for 10 to 149 turns, while at Skilled or higher it gives 250 to 299 turns and the ability to land at will.
facts.detect: Checking your escape skill level before casting
facts.action: Ensure you are at least Skilled in escape spells to gain the ability to land at will.

facts.fact: Levitation overrides flight and you will get warning messages when your levitation is about to expire.
facts.detect: Warning messages about levitation expiring
facts.action: Watch for warning messages and plan your movements accordingly to avoid getting stuck in midair.

facts.fact: Levitation is typically used to cross water or lava safely, but it is wiser to use the ring of levitation or levitation boots for more predictable levitation.
facts.detect: Encountering water or lava
facts.action: Use the ring of levitation or levitation boots instead of the spell for crossing water or lava.

facts.fact: If stuck in midair, you can land using a sink, a blessed potion of levitation, or by raising the spell to Skilled and casting it again.
facts.detect: Being stuck in midair
facts.action: Find a sink or blessed potion of levitation to land, or raise your escape skill to Skilled and recast the spell.

facts.fact: The spellbook of light can be read to learn the spell of light, which permanently lights a 5-square radius area around the hero.
facts.detect: Reading a spellbook of light or finding a message indicating the spell has been cast.
facts.action: Read the spellbook of light to light dark areas permanently.

facts.fact: Gremlins caught in the light will take up to 5 points of damage.
facts.detect: Seeing gremlins in the lit area.
facts.action: Be cautious around gremlins in lit areas; they may attack.

facts.fact: The spell will not light anything if the hero is engulfed, underwater, or on the Plane of Water.
facts.detect: Being in a state of engulfment, underwater, or on the Plane of Water.
facts.action: Avoid casting the spell in these conditions.

facts.fact: On the Rogue level, casting the spell in an unlit room will always light the entire room.
facts.detect: Being on the Rogue level and in an unlit room.
facts.action: Cast the spell to light the entire room.

facts.fact: The spell of light is a stellar utility for nearly any hero capable of casting it somewhat reliably.
facts.detect: Having the spell of light and being in a dark area.
facts.action: Use the spell to light dark areas and aid in exploration and combat.

facts.fact: The spellbook of lightning teaches the lightning spell, dealing (xplev/2+1)d6 damage to non-shock-resistant targets.
facts.detect: Spellbook of lightning
facts.action: If found, learn and use the spell to attack non-shock-resistant monsters, especially if wands of lightning are scarce or dangerous to use.

facts.fact: The spell can be reflected.
facts.detect: When casting, if a monster reflects the spell back at you.
facts.action: Avoid casting lightning at monsters that are known to reflect spells or have high magic resistance.

facts.fact: Magic resistance doesn't stop the spell.
facts.detect: Monsters with high magic resistance.
facts.action: Use the spell against monsters with high magic resistance since it will still be effective.

facts.fact: The spellbook of magic mapping can be read to learn the spell of magic mapping, which replicates the effect of reading an uncursed scroll of magic mapping.
facts.detect: Message: 'A map coalesces in your mind!' when casting the spell.
facts.action: Learn and cast the spell of magic mapping to reveal the layout of the current dungeon level.

facts.fact: Casting the spell of magic mapping on a non-mappable level will cause the hero to become confused for 30 turns.
facts.detect: Message: 'Your spins as blocks the spell!' when attempting to cast on a non-mappable level.
facts.action: Avoid casting the spell on non-mappable levels to prevent confusion.

facts.fact: The spell of magic mapping requires Basic skill in divination spells to reliably cast.
facts.detect: Hero's divination spells skill level.
facts.action: Ensure divination spells skill is at least Basic before attempting to cast the spell.

facts.fact: The spell of magic mapping can reveal the location of the magic portal on the Plane of Water if it was previously located.
facts.detect: Knowledge of the magic portal's previous location.
facts.action: Use the spell to locate the magic portal if it was previously known.

facts.fact: The spell of magic mapping can alert the hero to potential bones levels if the mapped level or its contents seem out of the ordinary.
facts.detect: Unusual items, clusters of rocks, discarded armor or weapons, out-of-depth monsters, or missing guaranteed spawns.
facts.action: Be cautious and investigate further if the mapped level seems unusual.

facts.fact: The spellbook of magic missile is a level 2 attack spell that takes 4 actions to read.
facts.detect: Spellbook of magic missile item name
facts.action: Read the spellbook to learn the spell of magic missile if the bot has enough turns and power points.

facts.fact: Spellbooks of magic missile make up 4.5% of all spellbooks randomly generated on the ground.
facts.detect: Finding spellbooks on the ground
facts.action: Prioritize picking up spellbooks of magic missile when found.

facts.fact: Successfully casting the spell prompts the player for a cardinal direction to fire the magic missiles in.
facts.detect: Prompt for cardinal direction when casting magic missile
facts.action: Choose a direction that targets enemies or bounces off walls to hit multiple enemies.

facts.fact: A hero hit by a rebounding ray abuses strength unless they have magic resistance or reflection.
facts.detect: Rebounding ray hitting the bot
facts.action: Avoid casting magic missile in directions where it might rebound onto the bot.

facts.fact: A hero that zaps themselves with the spell will take 4d6 damage unless they have magic resistance.
facts.detect: Self-casting magic missile
facts.action: Avoid self-casting magic missile unless the bot has magic resistance.

facts.fact: The spellbook of polymorph allows you to cast the polymorph spell, which changes any monster, item, or player it hits into something else of its type.
facts.detect: Spellbook of polymorph
facts.action: Collect and use the spellbook to polymorph items or monsters when strategically beneficial.

facts.fact: Casting polymorph at a monster is usually a bad idea as it will frequently generate out-of-depth monsters.
facts.detect: Out-of-depth monster names
facts.action: Avoid casting polymorph at monsters unless it's a specific situation like an air elemental.

facts.fact: Casting polymorph at pets allows you to reroll pet forms until you get a strong one.
facts.detect: Pet monster name
facts.action: Use polymorph on pets to improve their form, but be cautious of system shock.

facts.fact: Polymorphing junk items can generate something useful, a process called polypiling.
facts.detect: Junk item
facts.action: Polymorph junk items to generate useful items, especially with The Eye of the Aethiopica.

facts.fact: Polymorphed items will have the same BUC status and enchantments, and spellbooks will have fewer uses.
facts.detect: Polymorphed item
facts.action: Be cautious when polypiling, as items may not improve and can even be destroyed.

facts.fact: The spellbook of protection can be read to learn the spell of protection, which grants a bonus to AC and raises magic cancellation to a minimum of MC1.
facts.detect: Message 'The around you begins to shimmer with a haze.' when casting the spell for the first time.
facts.action: Read the spellbook of protection to learn the spell and cast it to gain AC and magic cancellation.

facts.fact: The spell of protection grants progressively less AC on subsequent castings depending on the hero's current AC and protection level.
facts.detect: Message 'The haze around you becomes more dense.' when casting the spell while already protected by it.
facts.action: Cast the spell again to maintain protection, but be aware that the benefit decreases with each casting.

facts.fact: The spell of protection wears off at a rate of 1 point every 10 turns, slowed to 1 point every 20 turns if cast at Expert skill.
facts.detect: Message 'The haze around you becomes less dense.' when the spell is wearing off.
facts.action: Recast the spell before it wears off completely to maintain protection.

facts.fact: Monks have a 1/3 chance of starting with a spellbook of protection as their initial spellbook.
facts.detect: Starting inventory includes a spellbook of protection.
facts.action: Learn and use the spellbook of protection to compensate for the lack of armor in the early game.

facts.fact: Spellbooks of protection make up 1.8% of all randomly-generated spellbooks.
facts.detect: Finding a spellbook of protection in a randomly-generated pile of books.
facts.action: Read the spellbook to learn the spell and use it to gain AC and magic cancellation.

facts.fact: The spellbook of remove curse can be read to learn the spell of remove curse, which is a level 3 clerical spell.
facts.detect: The bot can detect the spellbook of remove curse in its inventory or find it in a store.
facts.action: The bot should read the spellbook to learn the spell of remove curse if it is a lawful dwarvish Valkyrie, as it can be used to remove curses from items.

facts.fact: Casting the spell of remove curse at Basic skill or lower uncurses all cursed items from the hero's applicable worn items, wielded weapons, quivered projectile ammunition or weapons, tied leashes, and carried loadstones.
facts.detect: The bot can detect cursed items in its inventory or worn equipment.
facts.action: The bot should cast the spell of remove curse at Basic skill or higher to uncursed necessary items, especially if it is wearing cursed metallic armor or wielding cursed weapons.

facts.fact: Casting the spell of remove curse at Skilled or higher uncurses all cursed items in a hero's open inventory.
facts.detect: The bot can detect cursed items in its inventory.
facts.action: The bot should train its clerical spellcasting skill to Skilled or higher to efficiently uncursed all items in its inventory.

facts.fact: The hero must not be stunned or unable to speak and must have at least one free hand in order to cast the spell of remove curse.
facts.detect: The bot can detect if it is stunned or unable to speak, or if it has no free hand.
facts.action: The bot should avoid casting the spell of remove curse if it is stunned, unable to speak, or has no free hand.

facts.fact: Wearing cursed metallic armor can cause major setbacks for casting the spell of remove curse.
facts.detect: The bot can detect cursed metallic armor in its worn equipment.
facts.action: The bot should remove cursed metallic armor before attempting to cast the spell of remove curse.

facts.fact: The spellbook of restore ability is a level 4 healing spell that takes 17 actions (roughly 15 turns) to read.
facts.detect: The bot will find a spellbook with the name 'restore ability'.
facts.action: The bot should prioritize reading this spellbook if it has the time and is in a safe location.

facts.fact: Casting the spell of restore ability at Skilled or higher restores all attributes up to their peaks at once.
facts.detect: The bot will notice its skill level in healing spells.
facts.action: The bot should aim to increase its skill level in healing spells to maximize the benefits of the spell.

facts.fact: The spell of restore ability can restore lost attributes even while wearing a source of sustain ability.
facts.detect: The bot will be wearing a source of sustain ability (e.g., a robe or helm of brilliance).
facts.action: The bot should use the spell if it is wearing a source of sustain ability and needs to restore attributes.

facts.fact: The spell of restore ability is the Monk's default crowning gift, unless they are carrying the spellbook or wielding an artifact when they are crowned.
facts.detect: The bot will be a Monk and will be crowned.
facts.action: The bot should ensure it is not carrying the spellbook or wielding an artifact when it is crowned to receive the spellbook as a gift.

facts.fact: The spell of restore ability can be used to circumvent dangers arising from item theft or destruction, as well as from the horn or potion becoming un-blessed or even cursed.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter situations where items are stolen or cursed.
facts.action: The bot should consider using the spell in such situations to restore attributes without relying on items that might be stolen or cursed.

facts.fact: The spellbook of sleep is a level 1 enchantment spell that takes 3 actions to read.
facts.detect: Reading a spellbook of sleep
facts.action: Read the spellbook to learn the spell of sleep for its offensive and defensive capabilities.

facts.fact: Monks have a 1/3 chance of being given a spellbook of sleep as their starting spellbook.
facts.detect: Starting inventory includes a spellbook of sleep
facts.action: If a Monk, use the spellbook to learn the spell of sleep due to the Monk's sleep resistance.

facts.fact: The spell of sleep can put monsters to sleep for (XL/2 + 1)d25 turns unless they have sleep resistance, succeed a roll against their MR score, or are already asleep or otherwise immobilized.
facts.detect: Casting the spell of sleep
facts.action: Use the spell to immobilize monsters for easier combat or to facilitate a retreat.

facts.fact: A hero that zaps themselves with the spell will fall asleep for up to 50 turns unless they have sleep resistance.
facts.detect: Casting the spell on oneself
facts.action: Avoid casting the spell on oneself unless sleep resistance is guaranteed.

facts.fact: The spell of sleep can be used to stop thieving monsters such as nymphs and leprechauns from escaping.
facts.detect: Encountering thieving monsters
facts.action: Use the spell to immobilize thieving monsters to prevent them from stealing items.

facts.fact: The spellbook of slow monster is a level 2 enchantment spell that takes 4 actions to read.
facts.detect: Reading a spellbook of slow monster
facts.action: Read the spellbook to learn the spell of slow monster if it can be used effectively against fast monsters or those with sleep resistance.

facts.fact: The spell of slow monster can be used to slow down monsters, reducing their speed to 2/3 of their normal speed unless they succeed a roll against their MR score.
facts.detect: Facing a fast monster or a monster with sleep resistance
facts.action: Cast the spell of slow monster in the direction of the approaching monster to slow it down.

facts.fact: When cast on a whirly monster (vortex or air elemental) that is engulfing the hero, the spell forces the monster to release the hero immediately.
facts.detect: Being engulfed by a vortex or air elemental
facts.action: Cast the spell of slow monster to be released from the engulfing monster.

facts.fact: Zapping the spell on oneself removes any intrinsic speed the hero has.
facts.detect: Zapping the spell on oneself
facts.action: Avoid zapping the spell on oneself unless it is necessary to escape from an engulfing monster.

facts.fact: The spell of slow monster can be used to uncloak disguised mimics in shops.
facts.detect: Encountering a mimic in a shop
facts.action: Cast the spell of slow monster to uncloak the mimic without affecting the shop items.

facts.fact: Healers are guaranteed to start with a blessed spellbook of stone to flesh.
facts.detect: Starting inventory includes a blessed spellbook of stone to flesh.
facts.action: Keep the spellbook safe and use it when necessary, especially for nutrition management and boulder removal.

facts.fact: Casting stone to flesh on a boulder turns it into a huge chunk of meat; rocks, gray stones, and valuable non-glass gems become meatballs.
facts.detect: Encountering boulders, rocks, or valuable non-glass gems.
facts.action: Use the spell to turn boulders into meat for sustenance and to manage inventory by turning unwanted items into meatballs.

facts.fact: When cast on yourself, any ongoing stiffening process is cancelled, and any susceptible items in open inventory are transformed as well.
facts.detect: Feeling stiff or petrified, or having items in inventory that could be affected by stone to flesh.
facts.action: Cast the spell on yourself to cancel petrification and transform unwanted items in inventory.

facts.fact: Stone to flesh can save you from petrification, at the risk of affecting your open inventory.
facts.detect: Feeling petrified or seeing a message indicating petrification.
facts.action: Cast the spell on yourself to save from petrification, but be cautious with inventory management.

facts.fact: Stoning a monster and then forcing the reverse process to fail is a way to bypass the normal corpse generation odds.
facts.detect: Having a monster statue and a need to bypass corpse generation odds.
facts.action: Transport the statue to a small level and fill it with created monsters before casting stone to flesh to manipulate corpse generation.

facts.fact: Casting teleport away at yourself teleports you to a random square on the current level unless you are on a no-teleport level.
facts.detect: Being on a level with no-teleport designation or seeing the message 'You feel a strange force pushing you back.'
