facts.action: Avoid casting teleport away on yourself if you are on a no-teleport level or if you see the message indicating you are being pushed back.

facts.fact: The spell can be used to teleport monsters, similar to a wand of teleportation, but it costs nutrition and Pw.
facts.detect: Seeing a monster and deciding to teleport it away.
facts.action: Use the spell to teleport away monsters when you do not need their experience, intrinsics, or death drops, especially during the ascension run.

facts.fact: Teleport control allows you to control your destination when teleporting yourself.
facts.detect: Having the teleport control intrinsic or using a source that grants teleport control.
facts.action: Use teleport control to aim for a safer location when teleporting yourself.

facts.fact: The spell benefits from hungerless casting.
facts.detect: Having the hungerless casting intrinsic or using a source that grants hungerless casting.
facts.action: Cast the spell without worrying about hunger penalties if you have hungerless casting.

facts.fact: The spell costs the same amount of power as teleporting at will as of NetHack 3.6.2.
facts.detect: Having the ability to teleport at will or seeing the message 'You feel a strange force pulling you forward.'
facts.action: Use the spell as an alternative to teleport at will if you have teleport control and hungerless casting.

facts.fact: The spellbook of turn undead is a level 6 clerical spell that takes 50 actions to read.
facts.detect: Reading a spellbook of turn undead.
facts.action: If the bot has the time and energy, it can read the spellbook to learn the spell of turn undead.

facts.fact: The spell of turn undead behaves similarly to zapping a wand of undead turning.
facts.detect: Casting the spell of turn undead.
facts.action: The bot can use the spell to deal damage and scare undead monsters, or to revive corpses of fallen pets or large hostile monsters.

facts.fact: A Knight carrying the Magic Mirror of Merlin deals double damage to monsters when casting the spell of turn undead.
facts.detect: Carrying the Magic Mirror of Merlin while casting the spell.
facts.action: If the bot is a Knight and has the Magic Mirror of Merlin, it can use the spell more effectively against undead monsters.

facts.fact: The spell can revive corpses into their appropriate monsters, including the ghost of a hero whose bones are found.
facts.detect: Reviving a corpse or bones with the spell.
facts.action: The bot can use the spell to revive corpses or bones for various purposes, such as obtaining fresh corpses or resurrecting a fallen pet.

facts.fact: The spell can be used to farm unicorns and adult dragons for unicorn horns and dragon scales, but with significant drawbacks.
facts.detect: Reviving unicorns or dragons with the spell.
facts.action: The bot should avoid using the spell to farm unicorns and dragons for horns and scales due to the low drop rates and non-magical status of the items.

facts.fact: The spellbook of wizard lock is a level 2 matter spell that can be read to learn the spell of wizard lock.
facts.detect: Spellbook of wizard lock in inventory
facts.action: Read the spellbook to learn the spell of wizard lock if it is beneficial for the current situation.

facts.fact: The spell of wizard lock can be used to lock doors, drawbridges, and containers, and can create locked doors in doorways within room walls.
facts.detect: Encountering a door, drawbridge, or container that needs to be locked
facts.action: Use the spell of wizard lock to secure areas or escape from monsters.

facts.fact: Zapping the spell downward while over a hole will convert it into a trap door.
facts.detect: Being over a hole
facts.action: Use the spell of wizard lock to turn a hole into a trap door for safety.

facts.fact: The spell of wizard lock can be used to train up skill in matter spells.
facts.detect: Having low matter spell skill
facts.action: Use the spell of wizard lock to train up matter spell skill if needed.

facts.fact: The spell of wizard lock can be used to prevent monsters from rummaging through unlocked containers.
facts.detect: Unlocked containers with valuable items
facts.action: Use the spell of wizard lock to lock containers with valuable items to prevent monster rummaging.

facts.fact: A spetum is a two-handed polearm that appears as a forked polearm when unidentified.
facts.detect: forked polearm
facts.action: Identify the weapon as a spetum when encountering it as a forked polearm.

facts.fact: Watchmen and soldiers may be generated with a spetum.
facts.detect: Encountering watchmen or soldiers
facts.action: Be prepared to fight or avoid watchmen and soldiers who may be carrying a spetum.

facts.fact: Trolls have an effective 8/7 chance of being generated with a spetum.
facts.detect: Encountering a troll
facts.action: Be cautious when encountering a troll, as it has a high chance of being armed with a spetum.

facts.fact: The spetum is the lightest of the polearms at 50 aum.
facts.detect: Weight of the spetum when picked up
facts.action: Consider equipping the spetum for its light weight and damage output.

facts.fact: The spetum deals respectable average damage versus small monsters and has the best average damage against large monsters tied with the halberd.
facts.detect: Encountering small or large monsters
facts.action: Use the spetum effectively against small and large monsters due to its balanced damage output.

facts.fact: All Samurai start the game with non-cursed +0 splint mail, which will be rustproof.
facts.detect: Starting equipment message mentioning splint mail
facts.action: Keep the starting splint mail as it is rustproof and provides good AC.

facts.fact: Splint mail makes up 6.2% of all armor randomly generated on the ground.
facts.detect: Finding splint mail on the ground
facts.action: Pick up splint mail if found, as it provides a good AC bonus.

facts.fact: Mercenaries with a target AC value of 2 or lower have a 2/3 chance of being generated with splint mail.
facts.detect: Encountering mercenaries with AC 2 or lower
facts.action: Check if mercenaries are wearing splint mail, as it is common for them.

facts.fact: Player monster barbarians, knights, priests, and valkyries have a 1/10 chance of forcing splint mail in place of their initial body armor.
facts.detect: Starting equipment message for these roles
facts.action: If starting with splint mail, keep it as it provides a good AC bonus.

facts.fact: Splint mail is the second-heaviest type of armor at 400 aum, after plate mail.
facts.detect: Wearing splint mail and noticing weight
facts.action: Look for lighter armor upgrades like banded mail or mithril-coat as soon as possible.

facts.fact: Eating a sprig of wolfsbane cures lycanthropy.
facts.detect: Eating a sprig of wolfsbane when lycanthropy is detected.
facts.action: Eat a sprig of wolfsbane to cure lycanthropy.

facts.fact: Priests and Priestesses start with 1-2 uncursed sprigs of wolfsbane.
facts.detect: Starting inventory includes sprigs of wolfsbane.
facts.action: Keep the sprigs of wolfsbane for potential lycanthropy cure.

facts.fact: Sprigs of wolfsbane are rare and make up 0.7% of all randomly-generated comestibles.
facts.detect: Finding a sprig of wolfsbane in the dungeon.
facts.action: Collect and keep sprigs of wolfsbane for potential lycanthropy cure.

facts.fact: Sprigs of wolfsbane are very low in nutrition but are also very light.
facts.detect: Checking the weight and nutrition of a sprig of wolfsbane.
facts.action: Carry a couple of sprigs of wolfsbane without worrying about weight or nutrition.

facts.fact: General stores, delicatessens and health food stores can sell sprigs of wolfsbane.
facts.detect: Visiting a general store, delicatessen, or health food store.
facts.action: Buy sprigs of wolfsbane if available.

facts.fact: Statues generated as part of a normal dungeon level deeper than level 3 may randomly contain a single spellbook.
facts.detect: Checking the contents of a statue deeper than level 3.
facts.action: Break statues deeper than level 3 to check for spellbooks.

facts.fact: Statues on deeper dungeon levels have a greater probability of containing a spellbook.
facts.detect: Level number.
facts.action: Increase the priority of breaking statues as the dungeon level increases.

facts.fact: Statue traps are indistinguishable from regular statues normally.
facts.detect: Moving onto a statue's square or searching next to it.
facts.action: Be cautious when moving onto a statue's square or searching next to it.

facts.fact: Using the stone to flesh spell on a statue of a fleshy monster will turn it into that monster.
facts.detect: Applying the stone to flesh spell on a statue.
facts.action: Avoid using stone to flesh on statues unless you are prepared to deal with the monster.

facts.fact: Statues can be polymorphed into other kinds of statues or into boulders, unconditionally destroying their contents.
facts.detect: Applying polymorph on a statue.
facts.action: Avoid polymorphing statues to prevent losing potential spellbooks.

facts.fact: Applying a stethoscope towards an adjacent wall tile with a secret door or passage reveals it.
facts.detect: Applying the stethoscope to a wall tile
facts.action: Use the stethoscope to reveal secret doors and passages

facts.fact: Applying a stethoscope to another monster will show you their name, alignment, experience level, hit points, armor class, and miscellaneous attributes.
facts.detect: Adjacent monster
facts.action: Use the stethoscope to gather information about adjacent monsters

facts.fact: Applying the stethoscope to your character displays your experience level, HP, and AC, and any of the listed properties.
facts.detect: Applying the stethoscope to yourself
facts.action: Use the stethoscope to monitor your own status

facts.fact: Blind heroes can use the stethoscope to remove I symbols without using up an action by searching or running into one normally.
facts.detect: I symbol on the map
facts.action: Use the stethoscope to safely decloak mimics

facts.fact: An important use of the stethoscope is monitoring your pet's health.
facts.detect: Pet nearby
facts.action: Use the stethoscope to monitor your pet's health and experience level

facts.fact: Stilettos are extremely rare, making up 0.5% of all randomly-generated weapons.
facts.detect: Finding a stiletto in a general store, used armor dealership, or antique weapon outlet.
facts.action: If found, consider keeping it as a backup weapon due to its rarity and potential value.

facts.fact: Salamanders have a 1/21 chance of being generated with a stiletto.
facts.detect: Encountering a Salamander with a stiletto.
facts.action: Be cautious as Salamanders with stilettos are more dangerous due to the weapon's properties.

facts.fact: Sting is an artifact elven dagger with a +d5 to-hit bonus and doubles damage against orcs.
facts.detect: Wield Sting and encounter orcs; observe damage and to-hit bonus.
facts.action: Wield Sting when fighting orcs to maximize damage and efficiency.

facts.fact: Sting warns of orcs by glowing blue when wielded.
facts.detect: Notice blue glow when wielding Sting near orcs.
facts.action: Use Sting's glow to detect orcs before they are visible.

facts.fact: Sting allows escape from webs in one move if wielded.
facts.detect: Wield Sting while trapped in a web and observe escape.
facts.action: Wield Sting when in danger of being trapped in webs.

facts.fact: Sting does not cause an artifact blast for non-orcish chaotic heroes.
facts.detect: Wield Sting as a chaotic hero and observe no artifact blast.
facts.action: Wield Sting without fear of artifact blast if chaotic and not orcish.

facts.fact: Naming Sting can force an early Stormbringer via sacrifice.
facts.detect: Name an elven dagger as Sting early in the game.
facts.action: Name an elven dagger as Sting to force an early Stormbringer via sacrifice.

facts.fact: Stormbringer is an artifact weapon that deals extra damage to monsters without drain resistance and drains their life, healing the wielder by half of the HP reduction.
facts.detect: Messages: 'Your bloodthirsty blade attacks!', 'The blade draws the blood from !', 'The blade drains your !', 'You feel an unholy blade drain your !'
facts.action: Be cautious when wielding Stormbringer around pets and peaceful monsters to avoid accidental attacks. Ensure pets are drain resistant or have high health to withstand accidental hits.

facts.fact: Stormbringer grants drain resistance to the wielder and is immune to the effects of the drain life spell.
facts.detect: Weapon properties and messages when attacked by drain life spell.
facts.action: Wield Stormbringer to gain drain resistance and protect against drain life spells.

facts.fact: Stormbringer is intelligent and chaotic-aligned, and can be wished for or found in bones levels.
facts.detect: Artifact weapon properties and bones level items.
facts.action: Wish for or seek Stormbringer in bones levels if you are chaotic and looking for a powerful weapon.

facts.fact: Twoweaponing Stormbringer with a silver weapon is effective against drain-resistant monsters that are also silver haters.
facts.detect: Monster properties and weapon types.
facts.action: Use Stormbringer in combination with a silver weapon for effective combat against specific monster types.

facts.fact: Stormbringer is bloodthirsty and will attack peaceful monsters and pets without confirmation if the hero attempts to move onto their square.
facts.detect: Messages: 'Your bloodthirsty blade attacks!'
facts.action: Unwield Stormbringer or switch to a secondary weapon when not in combat to avoid attacking pets and peaceful monsters.

facts.fact: Studded leather armor provides 3 base AC and MC1.
facts.detect: Item name: studded leather armor
facts.action: Equip studded leather armor for its AC and MC1 properties.

facts.fact: Studded leather armor does not inhibit spellcasting.
facts.detect: Item name: studded leather armor
facts.action: Equip studded leather armor if spellcasting is a priority.

facts.fact: Studded leather armor is a common body armor choice for early Wizards and other builds focused on combat spellcasting.
facts.detect: Item name: studded leather armor
facts.action: Consider equipping studded leather armor if focusing on spellcasting.

facts.fact: Studded leather armor is eventually replaced with a mithril-coat or dragon scale mail.
facts.detect: Item name: studded leather armor
facts.action: Plan to replace studded leather armor with better options as the game progresses.

facts.fact: Studded leather armor is generated with a 9/125 chance among all randomly generated armor.
facts.detect: Item name: studded leather armor
facts.action: Be aware that studded leather armor is relatively common in the game.

facts.fact: Sunsword has a base 1d8 x2 damage and +1d5 to-hit bonus, and it doubles damage against undead.
facts.detect: Sunsword name, monster or item name, weapon stats
facts.action: Equip Sunsword if encountered and it is better than current weapon, especially against undead.

facts.fact: Sunsword acts as a light source with a radius of 3 squares if blessed, 2 squares if uncursed, and 1 square if cursed.
facts.detect: Sunsword name, light radius
facts.action: Use Sunsword as a light source in dark areas, especially when exploring new levels.

facts.fact: Reading a blessed or cursed scroll of light while wielding Sunsword can bless or curse it.
facts.detect: Scroll of light name, Sunsword name
facts.action: Avoid reading scrolls of light while wielding Sunsword unless you want to change its bless/cursed status.

facts.fact: Invoking Sunsword can create a blinding beam that scares gremlins and deals extra damage.
facts.detect: Sunsword name, invoke ability
facts.action: Use invoke ability to blind monsters or scare gremlins, especially in dark areas.

facts.fact: Sunsword protects the wielder from light-based blindness.
facts.detect: Sunsword name, light-based blindness
facts.action: Wield Sunsword if facing light-based blindness.

facts.fact: The Eyes of the Overworld grant magic resistance and astral vision when worn.
facts.detect: The item is named 'The Eyes of the Overworld' and is a pair of lenses.
facts.action: Wear the Eyes of the Overworld to gain magic resistance and astral vision.

facts.fact: Astral vision allows seeing through walls and doors, but also makes the wearer vulnerable to gaze attacks.
facts.detect: Using astral vision while on a level with monsters.
facts.action: Be cautious when using astral vision, especially in Gehennom and around monsters like umber hulks and Medusa.

facts.fact: Invoking the Eyes of the Overworld grants enlightenment, useful for tracking prayer timeout and identifying rings and amulets.
facts.detect: The option to invoke the Eyes of the Overworld.
facts.action: Invoke the Eyes of the Overworld to gain enlightenment.

facts.fact: The Eyes of the Overworld will not shatter under normal circumstances.
facts.detect: The item is named 'The Eyes of the Overworld'.
facts.action: Do not worry about the Eyes breaking when using them.

facts.fact: Players attempting the zen conduct should not wear The Eyes of the Overworld.
facts.detect: The player is attempting the zen conduct.
facts.action: Do not wear the Eyes of the Overworld if following the zen conduct.

facts.fact: The Heart of Ahriman is generated on the goal level of the Barbarian quest, placed on the same square as Thoth Amon along with the Bell of Opening.
facts.detect: Thoth Amon and the Bell of Opening on the same square as an artifact.
facts.action: Retrieve the Heart of Ahriman if it is beneficial for the bot's strategy.

facts.fact: When thrown as a projectile weapon, The Heart of Ahriman has +d5 to-hit and does double damage to the monster it hits when fired from a sling.
facts.detect: The Heart of Ahriman in inventory and a sling equipped.
facts.action: Use the Heart of Ahriman as a projectile weapon if a sling is available and the situation allows for it.

facts.fact: Invoking The Heart of Ahriman toggles controlled levitation on or off, allowing the player to use the '>' key to return to the ground.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel a surge of power, but nothing seems to happen.'
facts.action: Invoke the Heart of Ahriman to toggle levitation if needed.

facts.fact: The Heart of Ahriman resists item-cursing effects 4/5 of the time.
facts.detect: No message, inferred from artifact properties.
facts.action: Carry the Heart of Ahriman to resist item-cursing effects.

facts.fact: In NetHack Fourk, invoking the Heart of Ahriman uncurses items as a scroll of remove curse.
facts.detect: NetHack Fourk version and message 'You feel a surge of power, but nothing seems to happen.'
facts.action: Invoke the Heart of Ahriman to uncursed items if in NetHack Fourk.

facts.fact: The Longbow of Diana grants telepathy while carried and reflection while wielded.
facts.detect: Carrying the Longbow of Diana or wielding it.
facts.action: Wield the Longbow of Diana to gain reflection and use the amulet and shield slots for other purposes.

facts.fact: The Longbow of Diana creates arrows with the same beatitude as the bow when invoked.
facts.detect: Invoking the Longbow of Diana.
facts.action: Invoke the Longbow of Diana to create arrows, especially if you need blessed arrows.

facts.fact: A blessed Longbow will create up to 21 arrows per invoke, while a cursed Longbow will create at most 11 arrows per invoke.
facts.detect: Checking the beatitude of the Longbow of Diana.
facts.action: Ensure the Longbow of Diana is blessed to maximize the number of arrows created.

facts.fact: The Longbow of Diana provides a +d5 to-hit bonus when firing arrows.
facts.detect: Wielding the Longbow of Diana.
facts.action: Use the Longbow of Diana to improve your to-hit chance when firing arrows.

facts.fact: The Longbow of Diana is generally regarded as one of the weaker chaotic artifacts.
facts.detect: Understanding the context of the artifact's reputation.
facts.action: Prioritize other artifacts or strategies if the Longbow of Diana does not fit your playstyle.

facts.fact: The Magic Mirror of Merlin grants magic resistance and telepathy while carried.
facts.detect: Carrying the artifact grants these intrinsic properties.
facts.action: Pick up and carry the Magic Mirror of Merlin to gain magic resistance and telepathy.

facts.fact: A Knight carrying the Magic Mirror of Merlin deals double damage with certain wands and spells.
facts.detect: Using the specified wands or casting the specified spells.
facts.action: Use the wand of striking, cast force bolt, use the wand of undead turning, cast turn undead, cast sleep, cast drain life, cast magic missile, cast cone of cold (Basic or lower skill), cast fireball (Basic or lower skill), or cast finger of death while carrying the Magic Mirror of Merlin.

facts.fact: The Magic Mirror of Merlin always generates blessed on the Knight quest goal level.
facts.detect: Finding the Knight quest artifact on the quest level.
facts.action: Ensure the Magic Mirror of Merlin is blessed before using it.

facts.fact: The Magic Mirror of Merlin speaks a random rumor when applied or wielded.
facts.detect: Applying or wielding the artifact.
facts.action: Use the artifact to receive a random rumor, which can be true or false depending on the artifact's alignment.

facts.fact: The Magic Mirror of Merlin does not shatter under normal circumstances.
facts.detect: Using the artifact normally.
facts.action: No action needed, as the artifact is durable.

facts.fact: The Master Key of Thievery grants warning, teleport control, and half physical damage while carried.
facts.detect: Carrying the Master Key of Thievery.
facts.action: Keep the Master Key of Thievery in inventory to benefit from its properties.

facts.fact: When locking or unlocking a door or container with the Master Key of Thievery, door traps and container traps are automatically detected and can be removed.
facts.detect: Attempting to lock or unlock a door or container.
facts.action: Use the Master Key of Thievery to lock or unlock doors and containers to detect and remove traps.

facts.fact: Untrapping doors and chests manually will always succeed when wielding the Master Key of Thievery.
facts.detect: Attempting to untrap a door or chest.
facts.action: Wield the Master Key of Thievery to untrap doors and chests.

facts.fact: Wielding the Master Key of Thievery without gloves will hint at the presence of unseen traps nearby.
facts.detect: Wielding the Master Key of Thievery without gloves.
facts.action: Wear gloves when wielding the Master Key of Thievery to avoid trap warnings.

facts.fact: Invoking the Master Key of Thievery and selecting an adjacent door or container removes all traps from that object.
facts.detect: Invoking the Master Key of Thievery near a door or container.
facts.action: Invoke the Master Key of Thievery near a door or container to remove all traps.

facts.fact: The Mitre of Holiness grants fire resistance while carried and worn.
facts.detect: Carrying or wearing the Mitre of Holiness
facts.action: Wear the Mitre of Holiness to gain fire resistance.

facts.fact: The Mitre of Holiness halves physical damage from undead and demons for Priests.
facts.detect: Encountering undead or demons
facts.action: Wear the Mitre of Holiness when facing undead or demons.

facts.fact: The Mitre of Holiness can be used to identify a helm of brilliance.
facts.detect: Possession of a helm of brilliance
facts.action: Use the naming artifacts trick with the Mitre of Holiness to identify the helm of brilliance.

facts.fact: The Mitre of Holiness restores energy when invoked.
facts.detect: Feeling low on energy
facts.action: Invoke the Mitre of Holiness to restore energy.

facts.fact: The Mitre of Holiness is generated shatterproof on the Priest quest level.
facts.detect: Picking up the Mitre of Holiness on the Priest quest level
facts.action: Ensure the Mitre of Holiness is shatterproof before using it.

facts.fact: The Orb of Detection grants magic resistance, telepathy, and half spell damage while carried.
facts.detect: Carrying the Orb of Detection
facts.action: Keep the Orb of Detection in inventory to benefit from its properties.

facts.fact: Applying the Orb of Detection functions the same as any crystal ball for detecting magic portals.
facts.detect: Applying the Orb of Detection
facts.action: Use the Orb of Detection to detect magic portals when needed.

facts.fact: Invoking the Orb of Detection toggles intrinsic invisibility on or off.
facts.detect: Invoking the Orb of Detection
facts.action: Use the Orb of Detection to toggle invisibility when necessary.

facts.fact: The Orb of Detection is always generated on the goal level of the Archeologist quest, where it is placed on the same square as the Minion of Huhetotl.
facts.detect: Reaching the goal level of the Archeologist quest
facts.action: Find and defeat the Minion of Huhetotl to obtain the Orb of Detection.

facts.fact: An Archeologist can reliably use their quest artifact to reveal all dungeon features on the current level by entering the glyph of any one such feature when applying a crystal ball.
facts.detect: Applying the Orb of Detection on a level with known dungeon features
facts.action: Use the Orb of Detection to reveal all dungeon features on the current level.

facts.fact: The Orb of Fate is the Valkyrie quest artifact and is always generated with 5 charges on the goal level of the Valkyrie quest, placed on the same square as Lord Surtur.
facts.detect: Upon reaching the goal level of the Valkyrie quest, the bot will encounter Lord Surtur and the Orb of Fate.
facts.action: Retrieve the Orb of Fate and keep it in the main inventory to benefit from its effects.

facts.fact: While carried, the Orb of Fate grants warning, half spell damage, half physical damage, and acts as a luckstone.
facts.detect: The bot will notice increased defensive capabilities and the ability to detect approaching monsters.
facts.action: Carry the Orb of Fate in the main inventory to benefit from its defensive and detection properties.

facts.fact: Applying the Orb of Fate allows for selective detection of items, objects, and dungeon features, with an intelligence check for Valkyries (d8) and other roles (d16).
facts.detect: The bot will attempt to apply the Orb of Fate and notice the detection results based on its intelligence.
facts.action: Use the Orb of Fate to detect traps, magic portals, and the vibrating square if the bot's intelligence is high enough.

facts.fact: Invoking the Orb of Fate causes the hero to level teleport.
facts.detect: The bot will notice the option to level teleport when invoking the Orb of Fate.
facts.action: Use the Orb of Fate to teleport to desired levels, especially with teleport control.

facts.fact: Reading the Orb of Fate breaks illiterate conduct and reveals the divine signature of the god Odin.
facts.detect: Upon reading the Orb of Fate, the bot will receive the message 'It is signed: Odin.'
facts.action: Read the Orb of Fate to confirm its identity and break illiterate conduct if necessary.

facts.fact: The Platinum Yendorian Express Card is the Tourist quest artifact and is guarded by the Master of Thieves.
facts.detect: Encountering the Master of Thieves in the northwestern-most room of the Tourist quest level.
facts.action: Prepare to fight the Master of Thieves, who lacks resistances beyond stoning resistance and the magic resistance from picking up the Card.

facts.fact: The Platinum Yendorian Express Card confers magic resistance, telepathy, and half spell damage while carried.
facts.detect: Carrying the Platinum Yendorian Express Card.
facts.action: Use the Card's properties to enhance survival and spell resistance.

facts.fact: Invoking the Card allows charging of items, with blessed charging being particularly powerful.
facts.detect: Invoking the Card while holding items that can be charged.
facts.action: Use the Card to charge wands of wishing or magic markers for Tourists, and other essential items for non-Tourists.

facts.fact: The Platinum Yendorian Express Card is a luxury for neutral non-Tourists but can be a spare wish item.
facts.detect: Having a spare wish and being a neutral non-Tourist.
facts.action: Wish for the Platinum Yendorian Express Card if it fits into the strategy and survival is assured.

facts.fact: The Card is useful for various conducts, such as illiterate, liquid-diet foodless, and pacifist conducts.
facts.detect: Playing a conduct that benefits from the Card's properties.
facts.action: Prioritize the Card for conduct play to charge essential items.

facts.fact: The Sceptre of Might is the prize for completing the Caveman quest and generates blessed on the quest goal level.
facts.detect: The bot will find the Sceptre of Might on the level where the Chromatic Dragon is generated, and it will be blessed.
facts.action: Pick up and wield the Sceptre of Might as soon as it is found.

facts.fact: While wielded, the Sceptre of Might grants magic resistance and +d5 to-hit, and deals double damage against cross-aligned monsters.
facts.detect: The bot will notice the magic resistance and increased damage when wielding the Sceptre of Might.
facts.action: Wield the Sceptre of Might during combat against cross-aligned monsters.

facts.fact: Invoking the Sceptre of Might toggles conflict on or off, and conflict caused by the Sceptre does not cause nutrition drain.
facts.detect: The bot will see messages like 'You feel like a rabble-rouser.' or 'You feel the tension decrease around you.'
facts.action: Invoke the Sceptre of Might to toggle conflict on or off as needed.

facts.fact: The Sceptre of Might is a great weapon for lawful characters against most non-silver hating monsters.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter lawful characters and non-silver hating monsters.
facts.action: Use the Sceptre of Might as the primary weapon against these monsters.

facts.fact: Erosion-proofing and a backup source of magic resistance are recommended due to the Wizard of Yendor stealing the Sceptre.
facts.detect: The bot will encounter the Wizard of Yendor.
facts.action: Ensure the Sceptre of Might is erosion-proofed and have a backup source of magic resistance.

facts.fact: The Staff of Aesculapius grants hungerless regeneration and drain resistance when wielded.
facts.detect: Wield the staff and notice no hunger increase.
facts.action: Wield the staff to avoid hunger and gain drain resistance.

facts.fact: The staff deals double damage to monsters without drain resistance and drains levels from them.
facts.detect: Notice damage output and level drain effect on monsters.
facts.action: Use the staff against monsters lacking drain resistance.

facts.fact: Invoking the staff heals the hero by half of the HP required to return them to full health and cures sickness, blindness, and sliming.
facts.detect: Invoke the staff and notice HP increase and status cure.
facts.action: Invoke the staff to heal and cure status effects.

facts.fact: The staff resists 80% of item curses.
facts.detect: Notice the staff is not cursed when checking with #name or #tip.
facts.action: Use the staff even if it appears cursed.

facts.fact: The staff does not block spellcasting while cursed.
facts.detect: Notice spellcasting is not blocked when using a spell.
facts.action: Use the remove curse spell to uncurse the staff.

facts.fact: The Tsurugi of Muramasa acts as a luckstone when carried and provides bisection protection when wielded.
facts.detect: Carrying the Tsurugi of Muramasa or wielding it.
facts.action: Carry the Tsurugi of Muramasa to benefit from its luckstone effect and wield it for bisection protection.

facts.fact: The Tsurugi of Muramasa has a 5% chance of bisection, which instantly kills medium-size or smaller monsters and doubles damage against large monsters.
facts.detect: Wielding the Tsurugi of Muramasa and encountering a monster.
facts.action: Be cautious when using the Tsurugi of Muramasa against medium-size or smaller monsters due to the bisection risk.

facts.fact: The Tsurugi of Muramasa is generated on the goal level of the Samurai quest and is always a +0 artifact.
facts.detect: Reaching the goal level of the Samurai quest.
facts.action: Retrieve the Tsurugi of Muramasa from Ashikaga Takauji's square.

facts.fact: The Tsurugi of Muramasa resists the curse items monster spell 80% of the time.
facts.detect: Wielding a cursed Tsurugi of Muramasa.
facts.action: Use #tip to regain use of hands if the Tsurugi of Muramasu becomes cursed.

facts.fact: The Tsurugi of Muramasa deals +d8 bonus damage against all monsters.
facts.detect: Wielding the Tsurugi of Muramasa and attacking a monster.
facts.action: Benefit from the +d8 bonus damage when attacking monsters.

facts.fact: Tins make up 7.5% of all randomly-generated comestibles.
facts.detect: Randomly generated food item
facts.action: Prioritize opening tins for nutrition and intrinsics, but avoid if weak from hunger due to low nutritional value.

facts.fact: Tins containing spinach have a high chance of increasing strength.
facts.detect: Tin of spinach
facts.action: Eat spinach tins to increase strength, especially if blessed.

facts.fact: Cursed tins have a 12.5% chance of exploding.
facts.detect: KABOOM!! The tin was booby-trapped!
facts.action: Avoid opening cursed tins unless necessary.

facts.fact: Tins of nurse meat can fully heal the player.
facts.detect: Tin of nurse meat
facts.action: Eat tins of nurse meat to fully heal, but be cautious of choking if satiated.

facts.fact: Tins made with a tinning kit have a chance to be rotten or homemade.
facts.detect: Tin opener or tinning kit
facts.action: Use a tinning kit to make tins of valuable corpses for intrinsics.

facts.fact: Archaeologists have a 1/10 chance of starting the game with a tin opener, while Tourists have a 1/4 chance.
facts.detect: Starting character is an Archaeologist or Tourist
facts.action: Check inventory for a tin opener at the start of the game

facts.fact: Applying or wielding a tin opener before opening a tin reduces the number of turns required to open it: 0-2 turns if cursed, 0 or 1 turns if uncursed, and 0 turns if blessed.
facts.detect: Inventory contains a tin opener and a tin
facts.action: Apply or wield the tin opener before opening a tin

facts.fact: A cursed tin opener will weld to the player's hand when wielded.
facts.detect: Attempting to wield a cursed tin opener
facts.action: Avoid wielding a cursed tin opener

facts.fact: Using a blessed tin opener guarantees that a tin is opened immediately.
facts.detect: Inventory contains a blessed tin opener and a tin
facts.action: Use the blessed tin opener to open a tin

facts.fact: A tin whistle has a 10% chance of being randomly generated on the ground, in general shops, or as a death drop. Watchmen have a 2/3 chance of generating with a tin whistle. Vault guards will always generate with cursed tin whistles.
facts.detect: Finding a tin whistle on the ground, in shops, or as a death drop; encountering a watchman or vault guard.
facts.action: Identify the whistle by applying it. If it's cursed and you're inside a vault, be prepared for a guard to appear.

facts.fact: Applying a tin whistle creates noise that attracts pets and awakens sleeping monsters within a radius of about 4 squares at level 1, increasing to 24 squares at level 30.
facts.detect: Applying a tin whistle and observing the reaction of pets and monsters.
facts.action: Use the whistle to attract pets or wake up sleeping monsters before attacking them to avoid violating the code of conduct.

facts.fact: Applying a cursed tin whistle inside a vault will summon a guard.
facts.detect: Applying a cursed tin whistle inside a vault.
facts.action: Avoid using cursed whistles inside vaults to prevent summoning guards.

facts.fact: A tin whistle can be used underwater, but it has no effect.
facts.detect: Applying a whistle while underwater.
facts.action: Use the whistle underwater to identify it, but be aware it won't have any effect.

facts.fact: Applying a tin whistle produces a distinct message ('high whistling sound' for non-cursed/blessed, 'shrill whistling sound' for cursed).
facts.detect: The message 'You produce a high whistling sound' or 'You produce a shrill whistling sound'.
facts.action: Use the message to identify the whistle's beatitude.

facts.fact: Archaeologists start the game with an uncursed tinning kit.
facts.detect: Starting inventory message
facts.action: Use the tinning kit to preserve food and gain intrinsics early in the game.

facts.fact: Tinning kits make up 1.5% of all tools that are randomly generated on the ground, in general shops or as death drops.
facts.detect: Finding a tinning kit in the dungeon or in a shop
facts.action: Pick up and use the tinning kit to preserve food and gain intrinsics.

facts.fact: Applying a charged tinning kit to an intact corpse will create a tin of that monster, which uses up a charge and removes the corpse.
facts.detect: Having a tinning kit and an intact corpse in inventory or on the ground
facts.action: Use the tinning kit to tin the corpse and preserve it for later consumption or intrinsic gain.

facts.fact: Tinning a corpse owned by a shopkeeper will cause them to bill the hero for that corpse.
facts.detect: Attempting to tin a corpse near a shopkeeper
facts.action: Avoid tinning corpses near shopkeepers to prevent being billed.

facts.fact: Tinning a troll will permanently stop it from reviving.
facts.detect: Killing a troll and having a tinning kit
facts.action: Tin the troll corpse to prevent it from reviving.

facts.fact: A tooled horn is a type of tool that appears in NetHack and is made of bone.
facts.detect: Item name: tooled horn
facts.action: Carry it for potential use in waking up or scaring monsters, or for playing specific notes.

facts.fact: Elven Priests and Wizards have a 6/35 chance of starting the game with a tooled horn as their instrument.
facts.detect: Character class: Elven Priest or Wizard
facts.action: If starting as an Elven Priest or Wizard, check inventory for a tooled horn.

facts.fact: A hero applying a tooled horn that chooses to improvise with it will produce noise that has a range dependent on their experience level.
facts.detect: Message: You produce a frightful, grave sound.
facts.action: Use the tooled horn to scare monsters or wake up sleeping monsters within range.

facts.fact: A hero that applies a tooled horn while stunned, confused or hallucinating will automatically improvise with it.
facts.detect: Status: stunned, confused, or hallucinating
facts.action: Avoid using the tooled horn when in these states to prevent unintended consequences.

facts.fact: A hero cannot apply a tooled horn if they are subjected to strangulation, if they are in the form of a sea monster, or if they are in the form of any monster that is tiny in size, unbreathing, cannot speak, lacks a head, or can only buzz.
facts.detect: Status: strangulation, sea monster form, tiny form, unbreathing form, cannot speak, lacks a head, can only buzz
facts.action: Do not use the tooled horn under these conditions.

facts.fact: All Archeologists start the game with an uncursed touchstone and knowledge of the touchstone's appearance.
facts.detect: Starting inventory and knowledge of touchstone appearance
facts.action: Use the touchstone to identify gems and manage inventory

facts.fact: Touchstones make up 1/125 (0.8%) of all gems randomly generated on the ground, within solid rock or as death drops.
facts.detect: Finding a gray stone in inventory or on the ground
facts.action: Rub the touchstone on gems to identify them

facts.fact: Applying a touchstone to a gem will leave streaks of that gem's color on the touchstone for valuable gems and scratch marks for worthless glass.
facts.detect: Message 'You see streaks on the stone(s)' or 'You make scratch marks on the stone(s)'
facts.action: Use the touchstone to informally identify gems

facts.fact: A blessed touchstone will immediately identify gems and auto-identify the touchstone.
facts.detect: Message 'You see streaks on the stone(s)' or 'You make scratch marks on the stone(s)'
facts.action: Rub gems on the touchstone to identify them

facts.fact: Rubbing a touchstone on an iron item produces a distinct noise 'scritch, scritch'.
facts.detect: Message 'scritch, scritch'
facts.action: Use the touchstone to identify iron items

facts.fact: A towel can be used to clean hands or face from gunk or slippery fingers, but only if the towel is not cursed and the hero is not polymorphed into a form lacking hands.
facts.detect: Message 'You've got the glop off.' or 'Your feels clean now.'
facts.action: Use a towel to clean hands or face if dirty and towel is not cursed.

facts.fact: Applying a cursed towel has a 1/3 chance of making hands slippery and a 1/3 chance of applying gunk to the face for up to 13 turns.
facts.detect: Message 'Yecch! Your gunk on it!' or 'Your !'
facts.action: Avoid using cursed towels to clean hands or face.

facts.fact: A towel can be worn to blind the hero, and removing it restores sight if it was the only blinding item.
facts.detect: Message 'You are now wearing a towel around your head.' or 'You were wearing a towel.'
facts.action: Use a towel to blind temporarily if needed, but remove it to see again.

facts.fact: A wet towel can be used as an improvised weapon dealing 1 to its wetness level damage, with a chance to lose wetness on each hit.
facts.detect: Wetness level of the towel
facts.action: Use a wet towel as a weapon if no better options are available.

facts.fact: Wearing a cursed towel cannot be removed manually and is considered a major trouble.
facts.detect: Message 'You cannot remove your cursed towel.'
facts.action: Pray to remove a cursed towel if it is the only blinding item.

facts.fact: Tridents have a +4 to-hit bonus against swimming monsters that currently occupy water squares, and have a secondary +2 to-hit bonus against any snake monster or sea monster that can swim but is not currently in water.
facts.detect: Encounter with a swimming monster or snake monster in or out of water.
facts.action: Use a trident when fighting swimming monsters or snake monsters, especially in water squares.

facts.fact: Salamanders have an effective 9.52% chance of generating with a trident.
facts.detect: Encounter with a salamander.
facts.action: If a salamander is encountered, check if it is wielding a trident.

facts.fact: Horned devils have a 75% chance of generating with a trident.
facts.detect: Encounter with a horned devil.
facts.action: If a horned devil is encountered, there is a high chance it is wielding a trident.

facts.fact: A hero eating a trident while polymorphed into a metallivore produces YAFM and exercises wisdom.
facts.detect: Polymorph into a metallivore and find a trident.
facts.action: Eat a trident while polymorphed into a metallivore to gain wisdom experience and satisfaction.

facts.fact: Eating a tripe ration grants 200 nutrition.
facts.detect: Item name: tripe ration
facts.action: Eat tripe ration when hungry to gain significant nutrition.

facts.fact: If a hero is not a Caveperson, an orc, or a non-humanoid carnivorous monster, eating a tripe ration has a 50% chance of giving nausea.
facts.detect: Message: Yak - dog food!
facts.action: Avoid eating tripe ration if not an orc or carnivorous non-humanoid.

facts.fact: Tripe rations are a treat for carnivorous pets such as dogs and housecats, and increases the pet's apport when fed to them.
facts.detect: Pet type: dog or housecat
facts.action: Feed tripe ration to carnivorous pets to increase apport.

facts.fact: Entering a shop that has tripe before your pet does can be useful even if you don't plan to buy the tripe: allowing your pet to eat tripe that you've recently handled raises apport.
facts.detect: Shop item: tripe ration
facts.action: Enter shop with tripe ration to increase pet's apport.

facts.fact: Non-orcish heroes can reliably use tripe as a source of confusion for reading scrolls.
facts.detect: Item name: tripe ration
facts.action: Eat tripe ration to confuse scrolls if not an orc.

facts.fact: Trollsbane deals double damage against trolls and has +1d5 to-hit.
facts.detect: Encounter with trolls and wield Trollsbane
facts.action: Use Trollsbane against trolls for increased damage and accuracy

facts.fact: Trollsbane prevents troll corpses from reviving while wielded.
facts.detect: Killing a troll and observing corpse behavior
facts.action: Wield Trollsbane to prevent troll corpses from reviving

facts.fact: Trollsbane grants hungerless regeneration while wielded.
facts.detect: Wielding Trollsbane and observing hunger status
facts.action: Wield Trollsbane to avoid hunger penalties

facts.fact: Trollsbane is generated with +2 enchantment when randomly generated or gifted.
facts.detect: Receiving Trollsbane as a gift or finding it randomly
facts.action: Check the enchantment level of Trollsbane upon acquisition

facts.fact: Trollsbane is particularly useful in the Barbarian quest due to the abundance of trolls.
facts.detect: Entering the Barbarian quest
facts.action: Carry Trollsbane for the Barbarian quest

facts.fact: A tsurugi is a two-handed melee weapon with a +2 to-hit bonus and deals 1d16 damage against small monsters and 1d8+2d6 against large monsters.
facts.detect: The bot will identify the item as a 'long samurai sword'.
facts.action: If the bot finds a long samurai sword, it should pick it up and use it as a weapon due to its high damage and to-hit bonus.

facts.fact: Tsurugi are not randomly generated but can be wished for and appear in bones files.
facts.detect: The bot will find a long samurai sword in bones files or receive a message indicating a wish has granted a tsurugi.
facts.action: If the bot has the opportunity to wish, it should consider wishing for a tsurugi due to its superior stats.

facts.fact: The tsurugi is made of metal and is erosion-proof.
facts.detect: The bot will see the material listed as 'metal' when identifying the weapon.
facts.action: The bot should note the erosion-proof property and use the tsurugi in water or acidic environments without fear of rusting.

facts.fact: The tsurugi is the base item for the Tsurugi of Muramasa, which can revert to a plain tsurugi in bones files.
facts.detect: The bot will find a long samurai sword in bones files.
facts.action: If the bot finds a long samurai sword in bones files, it should consider it a potential Tsurugi of Muramasa and treat it with caution.

facts.fact: The tsurugi's high damage and to-hit bonus make it a powerful weapon, but it is not obtainable outside of wishing or bones files.
facts.detect: The bot will identify the weapon's stats and compare them to other weapons.
facts.action: If the bot has the opportunity to wish, it should prioritize wishing for a tsurugi due to its superior stats.

facts.fact: Barbarians have a 50% chance of starting the game with a +0 two-handed sword as their primary weapon.
facts.detect: Starting inventory message mentioning a two-handed sword
facts.action: Use the two-handed sword if it is the best weapon available, considering its weight and damage.

facts.fact: Two-handed swords make up 2.2% of all randomly generated weapons.
facts.detect: Finding a two-handed sword on the ground or in a shop
facts.action: Evaluate the weapon's enchantment and consider equipping it if it is better than the current weapon.

facts.fact: Giant humanoids other than ettins have a 10% chance of generating with a two-handed sword.
facts.detect: Encountering a giant humanoid with a two-handed sword
facts.action: Be cautious as the weapon can deal significant damage.

facts.fact: Croesus is always generated with a two-handed sword.
facts.detect: Encountering Croesus
facts.action: Prepare for a challenging fight as Croesus will have a powerful weapon.

facts.fact: Two-handed swords deal 1d12 damage versus small monsters and 3d6 versus large monsters.
facts.detect: Attacking a monster with a two-handed sword
facts.action: Use the two-handed sword effectively against large monsters for its high damage.

facts.fact: Unicorn horns can cure multiple negative status properties when applied.
facts.detect: Messages like 'This makes you feel great!', 'This makes you feel better!', 'What a relief!', 'A cloud of darkness falls upon you.', 'You feel worse.', 'You feel deathly sick.', 'You suddenly feel confused.', 'You stagger...', 'Oh wow! Everything looks so cosmic!', 'You are unable to hear anything.'
facts.action: Apply the unicorn horn to cure negative status properties.

facts.fact: Applying a cursed unicorn horn can inflict sickness, blindness, hallucination, confusion, stunning, or deafness.
facts.detect: Message 'You feel deathly sick.', 'You feel worse.', 'A cloud of darkness falls upon you.', 'You suddenly feel confused.', 'You stagger...', 'Oh wow! Everything looks so cosmic!', 'You are unable to hear anything.'
facts.action: Avoid applying cursed unicorn horns unless necessary.

facts.fact: Unicorn horns can be used to identify potions by dipping them.
facts.detect: Potion of sickness changes to potion of fruit juice, potion of blindness, confusion, or hallucination changes to uncursed potion of water.
facts.action: Use unicorn horns to identify potions.

facts.fact: Unicorn horns can be used to cure status effects for intelligent pets with hands.
facts.detect: Pet is confused or has other status ailments.
facts.action: Give a unicorn horn to an intelligent pet with hands.

facts.fact: Unicorn horns can be used to dip-test for polymorph potions.
facts.detect: Potion of polymorph.
facts.action: Use a spare unicorn horn to dip-test for polymorph potions.

facts.fact: A Uruk-hai shield is a type of shield that appears in NetHack, made of iron and appears as a white-handed shield when unidentified.
facts.detect: white-handed shield appearance
facts.action: Identify the shield to confirm it is a Uruk-hai shield before equipping it.

facts.fact: Uruk-hai have a 3/5 chance of being generated with an Uruk-hai shield.
facts.detect: Encountering Uruk-hai
facts.action: If you encounter Uruk-hai, there is a high chance they will be carrying an Uruk-hai shield.

facts.fact: Orc-captains have a 2/5 chance of being generated with Uruk-hai armor, giving them an effective 6/25 chance of generating with Uruk-hai shields.
facts.detect: Encountering orc-captains
facts.action: If you encounter orc-captains, there is a moderate chance they will be carrying an Uruk-hai shield.

facts.fact: While worn, an Uruk-hai shield grants 1 base AC.
facts.detect: Checking the AC value when wearing the shield
facts.action: Use the shield temporarily for its AC value, but replace it with a lighter or better shield as soon as possible.

facts.fact: The Uruk-hai shield is mainly useful as racial equipment for racial conducts involving orcs.
facts.detect: Checking racial conducts involving orcs
facts.action: If you are playing a character with orc-related racial conducts, consider using the Uruk-hai shield to fulfill these conducts.

facts.fact: Vorpal Blade has a 5% chance of instantly killing monsters it hits by beheading them, dealing damage equal to twice the monster's HP.
facts.detect: Vorpal Blade !
facts.action: Wield Vorpal Blade to quickly dispatch dangerous monsters or to avoid prolonged combat.

facts.fact: If a monster (including the hero) would be beheaded with Vorpal Blade and has a head, but they are also unsolid, the sword will slice through the neck without beheading them and deal normal damage.
facts.detect: Vorpal Blade slices through 's neck.
facts.action: Avoid using Vorpal Blade against unsolid monsters to prevent normal damage.

facts.fact: Vorpal Blade is a very dangerous weapon to find in the hands of a monster, especially in the Astral Plane.
facts.detect: A monster wielding Vorpal Blade.
facts.action: Avoid close combat with monsters wielding Vorpal Blade and attack from a distance if possible.

facts.fact: A neutral hero may receive Vorpal Blade as a possible sacrifice gift.
facts.detect: Sacrificing a monster with a value of at least 5.
facts.action: Sacrifice a monster with a value of at least 5 to potentially receive Vorpal Blade.

facts.fact: If you kill a monster wielding Vorpal Blade but do not plan on using it, leave it in a well-protected container.
facts.detect: Killing a monster wielding Vorpal Blade.
facts.action: Store Vorpal Blade in a well-protected container to prevent enemies from obtaining it.

facts.fact: A voulge is a two-handed polearm that appears as a pole cleaver when unidentified.
facts.detect: pole cleaver
facts.action: Identify the weapon as a voulge when found.

facts.fact: Watchmen and soldiers may be generated with a voulge.
facts.detect: Encountering watchmen or soldiers
facts.action: Be prepared to fight for the voulge if encountered.

facts.fact: The voulge is the second-heaviest polearm after both the halberd and lucern hammer.
facts.detect: Weight of the voulge compared to other polearms
facts.action: Consider the weight when deciding to wield the voulge.

facts.fact: The voulge has relatively high damage against small monsters but low average damage against large monsters.
facts.detect: Type of monsters encountered
facts.action: Use the voulge more against small monsters and less against large ones.

facts.fact: The ranseur deals the same damage with 2/5 of the weight.
facts.detect: Comparing the voulge to the ranseur
facts.action: Prefer the ranseur over the voulge if available.

facts.fact: Zapping a wand of acid shoots an acidic ray that can corrode iron and copper weapons and armor, and destroy doors.
facts.detect: Corroded weapon or armor message, destroyed door
facts.action: Avoid using wand of acid on iron or copper weapons and armor, and do not zap at doors.

facts.fact: There is a 1/6 chance of affecting the target's weapon and a separate 1/6 chance of affecting the target's armor when an acid ray hits a target.
facts.detect: Corroded weapon or armor message
facts.action: Be cautious when using wand of acid in combat, especially against enemies wielding iron or copper weapons and armor.

facts.fact: Zapping yourself with the wand deals 8d6 damage unless you have acid resistance.
facts.detect: Self-zapping message
facts.action: Do not self-zap unless you have acid resistance or are prepared to take the damage.

facts.fact: Applying a wand of acid to break it causes an explosion of noxious gas dealing double the ray's damage to you and surrounding creatures.
facts.detect: Explosion of noxious gas message
facts.action: Avoid breaking the wand unless necessary and in a safe environment.

facts.fact: Engraving with a wand of acid returns the message 'The bugs on the seem to be covered in goo!'
facts.detect: Engraving message
facts.action: Use this message to identify the wand without self-identifying it.

facts.fact: Wands of cancellation make up 4.5% of all randomly-generated wands.
facts.detect: Finding a wand of cancellation in a general store or 'quality apparel and accessories' shop, or in a wizard's starting inventory.
facts.action: Avoid picking up a wand of cancellation unless absolutely necessary, as it can cause a bag of holding to explode and lose a significant amount of items.

facts.fact: Putting a wand of cancellation that has charges or any bag containing the charged wand into a bag of holding will cause a magical explosion that destroys the wand, along with the bag of holding and its contents.
facts.detect: Having a bag of holding and a wand of cancellation in inventory.
facts.action: Do not place a wand of cancellation or a bag containing it into a bag of holding to avoid losing items and the bag itself.

facts.fact: Breaking a charged wand of cancellation by applying it, or wresting one last charge from an applied wand, will cause an explosion that deals damage and cancels monsters and items.
facts.detect: Applying a wand of cancellation.
facts.action: Avoid applying a wand of cancellation to prevent accidental explosions and item loss.

facts.fact: Engraving with a wand of cancellation will always remove the engraving on the current square unless it is on a headstone.
facts.detect: Engraving over existing writing on the floor.
facts.action: Do not engrave with an unidentified wand that causes existing writing to vanish, as it could be a wand of cancellation.

facts.fact: A wand of cancellation can be used to uncurse bones containers and avoid losing any items in a bag of holding.
facts.detect: Finding bones containers or a bag of holding with cursed items.
facts.action: Use a wand of cancellation to uncurse bones containers or items in a bag of holding to prevent item loss.

facts.fact: Wands of cold make up 4% of all randomly-generated wands.
facts.detect: Finding a wand of cold in inventory or in a shop.
facts.action: Keep the wand for its offensive and utility uses, especially for dealing with cold-vulnerable monsters and for crossing water or lava.

facts.fact: Zapping a wand of cold deals 6d6 damage to monsters and an additional +6d3 bonus damage to monsters with cold vulnerability.
facts.detect: Seeing a monster with fire resistance but not cold resistance.
facts.action: Use the wand against such monsters to maximize damage.

facts.fact: Breaking a wand of cold by applying it will create a damaging magical explosion of cold in a 3×3 square centered on the hero.
facts.detect: Applying the wand.
facts.action: Avoid breaking the wand unless necessary, as it can deal significant damage.

facts.fact: A wand of cold can be used to destroy doors without producing noise.
facts.detect: Encountering a locked or trapped door.
facts.action: Use the wand to silently destroy the door and proceed.

facts.fact: A wand of cold can freeze water and lava, allowing the hero to cross them.
facts.detect: Encountering water or lava.
facts.action: Use the wand to create ice bridges to cross.

facts.fact: Wands of create monster have a 4.5% chance of appearing in randomly-generated wands and can be found in general stores and 'quality apparel and accessories' shops.
facts.detect: Finding a wand of create monster in inventory or in shops.
facts.action: Pick up and store the wand for later use, especially near altars or for creating food sources.

facts.fact: Zapping a wand of create monster has a 22/23 chance of creating a single monster and a 1/23 chance of creating 2-9 monsters.
facts.detect: Zapping the wand and observing the number of monsters created.
facts.action: Use the wand near altars or for creating food sources, but be cautious of the risk of creating multiple monsters.

facts.fact: Breaking a wand of create monster with one charge left will create nine monsters and deal 1 to (4x) damage.
facts.detect: Applying the wand and observing the explosion and monster creation.
facts.action: Avoid breaking the wand unless you are prepared to handle the resulting monsters and damage.

facts.fact: Wands of create monster are often found in monster inventories, especially when the monster is at low health.
facts.detect: Encountering a monster with a wand of create monster in its inventory.
facts.action: Quickly kill the monster to prevent it from zapping the wand and creating more monsters.

facts.fact: Maximizing the number of monsters created from a wand involves breaking it with one charge left, but this requires survival of the resulting monsters and damage.
facts.detect: Having a wand of create monster with one charge left and being near an altar or prepared for monster creation.
facts.action: Break the wand if you can survive the resulting monsters and damage, otherwise use it normally.

facts.fact: Wands of death are among the rarest wands, making up 0.5% of all randomly-generated wands.
facts.detect: Finding a wand of death in a general store or 'quality apparel and accessories' shop.
facts.action: Immediately identify and store the wand of death for emergency use only.

facts.fact: Zapping a wand of death in a given direction fires a ray of death magic that instantly kills almost any hero or monster it hits, but death and monsters with magic resistance, reflection, or death resistance are unaffected.
facts.detect: Seeing a message indicating a monster or hero has been instantly killed by a ray.
facts.action: Avoid using the wand of death unless you have magic resistance or reflection.

facts.fact: Breaking a charged wand of death by applying it will cause an explosion referred to as a 'death field' that deals anywhere between 1 and (16x) damage.
facts.detect: Applying a wand of death.
facts.action: Never apply a wand of death unless absolutely necessary.

facts.fact: Orcus is always generated with a wand of death.
facts.detect: Encountering Orcus.
facts.action: Be extremely cautious around Orcus and avoid engaging unless you have magic resistance or reflection.

facts.fact: A hero zapping a wand of death directly at themselves suffers an instadeath, ignoring magic resistance or reflection.
facts.detect: Zapping a wand of death at yourself.
facts.action: Never use a wand of death on yourself unless you are polymorphed into a form immune to death rays.

facts.fact: A wand of digging generates with 4 to 8 charges.
facts.detect: Checking the wand's charge level.
facts.action: Use the wand sparingly to conserve charges.

facts.fact: Zapping the wand downward creates a hole, and doing this on an undiggable floor creates a pit.
facts.detect: Seeing the message 'You dig a pit in the floor.'
facts.action: Avoid zapping downward on undiggable floors to prevent falling into a pit.

facts.fact: Zapping the wand in a maze level will limit the ray's effect to one square.
facts.detect: Being in a maze level.
facts.action: Use the wand cautiously in maze levels to avoid wasting charges.

facts.fact: Zapping the wand while engulfed by a non-whirly monster sets the monster's current HP to 1 and expels the hero.
facts.detect: Being engulfed by a monster.
facts.action: Use the wand to escape from engulfing monsters.

facts.fact: Breaking a charged wand of digging by applying it will cause an explosion that deals damage and creates pits or holes.
facts.detect: Applying the wand.
facts.action: Avoid applying the wand to prevent damage and creation of dangerous pits.

facts.fact: Wands of enlightenment make up 1.5% of all randomly-generated wands and can be found in general stores and 'quality apparel and accessories' shops.
facts.detect: Finding a wand of enlightenment in inventory, general store, or 'quality apparel and accessories' shop.
facts.action: Keep the wand of enlightenment for later use when you need to check your character stats or identify worn items.

facts.fact: Zapping the wand of enlightenment exercises wisdom and grants enlightenment, displaying the current status and properties of the hero.
facts.detect: Zapping the wand of enlightenment.
facts.action: Use the wand of enlightenment to check your character stats and properties, especially before praying to ensure it is safe to do so.

facts.fact: Breaking a wand of enlightenment by applying it will have no effect.
facts.detect: Applying the wand of enlightenment.
facts.action: Do not attempt to use the wand of enlightenment by applying it, as it will not work and will not harm the wand.

facts.fact: The wand of enlightenment can informally identify the properties of worn items by comparing stats before and after wearing them.
facts.detect: Wearing an unidentified item and zapping the wand of enlightenment.
facts.action: Use the wand of enlightenment to identify worn items by comparing your stats before and after wearing them.

facts.fact: Wands of fire make up 4% of all randomly-generated wands.
facts.detect: Randomly generated wands in the game
facts.action: Be cautious when finding a wand of fire, especially early in the game when fire resistance is not readily available.

facts.fact: Zapping a wand of fire deals 6d6 damage to monsters and an additional +7 bonus damage to monsters with fire vulnerability.
facts.detect: Zapping a monster with a wand of fire
facts.action: Use the wand to deal significant damage to monsters, especially those with fire vulnerability.

facts.fact: Wands of fire have a 1/3 chance of burning vulnerable items in a target's open inventory.
facts.detect: Items in the inventory being partially burned or destroyed
facts.action: Avoid using the wand if you have important items in your inventory that could be destroyed.

facts.fact: Breaking a wand of fire by applying it creates a damaging magical explosion of fire in a 3×3 square.
facts.detect: Applying the wand
facts.action: Do not break the wand unless absolutely necessary, as it can cause significant damage and destroy important items.

facts.fact: The wand of fire can be used to destroy doors without creating noise.
facts.detect: Doors in the game
facts.action: Use the wand to silently destroy doors to enter rooms without waking up monsters.

facts.fact: A wand of light can permanently light the area within a 5-square radius around the hero.
facts.detect: A lit field surrounds you!
facts.action: Use the wand of light to light up dark areas and make navigation easier.

facts.fact: Wands of light are the most common type of wand, making up 9.5% of all randomly-generated wands.
facts.detect: Finding a wand of light in the inventory or in shops.
facts.action: Keep the wand of light for early game exploration and navigation.

facts.fact: Breaking a charged wand of light by applying it will cause an explosion that deals damage, lights the area, and blinds the hero and other monsters.
facts.detect: Explosion message when applying a charged wand of light.
facts.action: Avoid applying a wand of light if it has charges left to prevent accidental explosions.

facts.fact: Gremlins caught in the light from a wand of light will take up to 5 points of damage.
facts.detect: Gremlin damage message when using a wand of light.
facts.action: Use the wand of light to damage gremlins if they are present.

facts.fact: The wand of light auto-identifies if the hero can see the resulting light or if they can hear a gremlin react to it.
facts.detect: Hero can see light or hear gremlin reaction.
facts.action: Use the wand of light to auto-identify it.

facts.fact: Wands of lightning make up 4% of all wands randomly generated on the ground, in general shops or as death drops.
facts.detect: Finding a wand of lightning in inventory or on the ground
facts.action: Store the wand safely until needed for offensive or defensive purposes

facts.fact: The Cyclops will always be generated with a wand of lightning on his square.
facts.detect: Encountering a Cyclops
facts.action: Be cautious and prepare for potential lightning attacks

facts.fact: Zapping the wand in a given direction shoots a ray of lightning that deals 6d6 shock damage to targets without shock resistance that it hits, blinding them for up to 50 turns and potentially destroying monsters any rings and wands in their inventory.
facts.detect: Zapping a wand of lightning
facts.action: Use the wand carefully to avoid self-damage and item destruction

facts.fact: Breaking a wand of lightning by applying it will create a damaging magical explosion of shock in a 3×3 square centered on the hero, auto-identifying the wand and dealing shock damage equal to the remaining charges times 16 (before role-based reductions), while also potentially destroying wands and rings in the open inventory of affected monsters.
facts.detect: Applying a wand of lightning
facts.action: Avoid breaking the wand unless necessary and in a safe environment

facts.fact: Engraving with a wand of lightning will burn text into the ground and auto-identify it, as well as blinding the hero for d50 turns if applicable.
facts.detect: Engraving with a wand of lightning
facts.action: Cancel engraving prompt to avoid blinding

facts.fact: Wands of locking make up 2.5% of all randomly-generated wands.
facts.detect: Finding a wand of locking in a general store or 'quality apparel and accessories' shop, or in a wizard's starting inventory.
facts.action: Keep the wand of locking for its utility in locking doors, containers, and creating trap doors.

facts.fact: Zapping the wand of locking has the same effects as the wizard lock spell.
facts.detect: Using the wand and observing its effects on doors, drawbridges, and containers.
facts.action: Use the wand to secure areas, create trap doors, and repair broken locks.

facts.fact: The wand will auto-identify if it locks or creates a door, locks a container or is zapped to create a trap door.
facts.detect: Receiving auto-identification messages such as 'Klunk!', 'The door locks!', etc.
facts.action: Continue using the wand for its intended purposes without needing to identify it further.

facts.fact: Applying a wand of locking to break it has no effect.
facts.detect: Attempting to break the wand by applying it.
facts.action: Do not waste actions trying to break the wand.

facts.fact: The wand of locking is useful for closing doors at a distance when securing a room or escaping from monsters.
facts.detect: Encountering situations where doors need to be closed or monsters need to be escaped from.
facts.action: Use the wand to lock doors and create barriers to escape or secure areas.

facts.fact: Wands of magic missile make up 5% of all randomly-generated wands.
facts.detect: Finding a wand of magic missile in a general store or 'quality apparel and accessories' shop.
facts.action: Use the wand for early-game ranged attacks, especially by bouncing the ray off walls to increase damage.

facts.fact: A hero zapping the wand at themselves takes 4d6 damage unless they have magic resistance.
facts.detect: Zapping the wand at oneself and receiving damage.
facts.action: Avoid zapping the wand at oneself unless necessary and have magic resistance equipped.

facts.fact: Breaking a charged wand of magic missile by applying it will cause an explosion that deals 1 to (4x) damage, blocked by magic resistance.
facts.detect: Applying a charged wand of magic missile.
facts.action: Avoid applying a charged wand of magic missile unless necessary and have magic resistance equipped.

facts.fact: Wands of magic missile are the least effective type of attack wand, lacking useful secondary effects beyond damage.
facts.detect: Using the wand and noticing it lacks secondary effects.
facts.action: Use the wand sparingly and only for its primary damage effect, preferring other wands for their secondary effects.

facts.fact: Some players throw the wand at intelligent monsters hoping they will use it over their innate attacks or ranged weaponry.
facts.detect: Seeing an intelligent monster with the wand.
facts.action: If possible, throw the wand at intelligent monsters to potentially exploit their use of it.

facts.fact: A wand of make invisible can render any monster permanently invisible, including the hero if zapped at themselves, unless the monster is wearing a mummy wrapping.
facts.detect: You feel rather itchy under your mummy wrapping.
facts.action: If you have a mummy wrapping, you can zap yourself with the wand to test if it is a wand of make invisible without becoming permanently invisible.

facts.fact: Breaking the wand by applying it has a 1/10 chance of giving the hero permanent invisibility.
facts.detect: A damaging magical blast occurs when the wand is broken.
facts.action: If you need permanent invisibility, consider breaking the wand, but be cautious as it can also cause damage.

facts.fact: Zapping a wand of make invisible at a mimic will uncloak it and make it invisible.
facts.detect: A mimic uncloaks and becomes invisible.
facts.action: If you encounter a mimic, you can use the wand to reveal its true form and make it invisible, making it easier to kill.

facts.fact: Zapping peaceful monsters with the wand will anger them.
facts.detect: A peaceful monster becomes hostile after being zapped.
facts.action: Avoid using the wand on peaceful monsters to prevent them from turning hostile.

facts.fact: The wand can remove engraved text on a square when zapped downward or used for engraving.
facts.detect: Engraved text disappears when the wand is used.
facts.action: Use the wand to remove hard-to-remove engraved text, such as a degraded burnt Elbereth.

facts.fact: A wand of nothing is the only wand that is not a magical item and has no effect beyond using up a charge when zapping or engraving with it.
facts.detect: No message is printed when using the wand.
facts.action: Ignore the wand as it has no use.

facts.fact: Wizards will never receive a wand of nothing as the random wand in their starting inventory.
facts.detect: Starting inventory does not contain a wand of nothing.
facts.action: Do not expect to find a wand of nothing in the starting inventory.

facts.fact: A wand of nothing can be either directional or non-directional, and all wands of nothing in a given game are of the same type.
facts.detect: Notice if the wand does not affect the surroundings when used.
facts.action: Recognize that the wand is non-directional if it does not affect the surroundings.

facts.fact: Non-directional wands of nothing are more ideal due to having more charges (which are carried over when polymorphing wands).
facts.detect: Identify the wand as non-directional.
facts.action: Use the wand as polyfodder if it is non-directional.

facts.fact: Price identification can be used to eliminate all other wands that produce no message when engraving.
facts.detect: Engrave with the wand and no message is printed.
facts.action: Use price identification to determine if the wand is a wand of nothing.

facts.fact: A wand of opening can unlock doors, containers, and drawbridges, and reveal secret doors.
facts.detect: Encountering a locked door, container, drawbridge, or secret door.
facts.action: Use the wand to unlock or open the obstacle.

facts.fact: Zapping the wand at a web or beartrap will release the trapped hero or monster.
facts.detect: Being trapped in a web or beartrap.
facts.action: Use the wand to free oneself or the trapped monster.

facts.fact: Zapping the wand downward while over a trap door or falling rock trap will activate it.
facts.detect: Standing over a trap door or falling rock trap.
facts.action: Avoid zapping the wand downward in such situations.

facts.fact: Zapping the wand downward while trapped in a pit or spiked pit will free the hero.
facts.detect: Being trapped in a pit or spiked pit.
facts.action: Use the wand to escape from the pit.

facts.fact: Zapping the wand at a monster engulfing the hero will cause the monster to expel the hero.
facts.detect: Being engulfed by a monster.
facts.action: Use the wand to escape from the engulfing monster.

facts.fact: Wands of polymorph make up 4.5% of all randomly-generated wands.
facts.detect: Finding a wand of polymorph in a randomly generated location or in a shop.
facts.action: Keep the wand for potential use in polypiling or emergency situations.

facts.fact: A hero zapping the wand of polymorph at themselves will polymorph, ignoring any sources of magic resistance.
facts.detect: The message 'You zap yourself with a wand of polymorph.'
facts.action: Use polymorph control to choose a form or break the wand to polymorph monsters and items around you.

facts.fact: Breaking a charged wand of polymorph by applying it will cause an explosion that deals damage and polymorphs items and monsters.
facts.detect: The message 'You break the wand of polymorph.'
facts.action: Use this as a last resort to escape dangerous situations or to polymorph pets into stronger forms.

facts.fact: A hero that either zaps the wand downward or engraves with it while an engraving is present will change it to a random engraving.
facts.detect: The message 'The engraving now reads:'
facts.action: Use this to change engravings, but be cautious as it can also polymorph items on the square.

facts.fact: Polymorphing hostile monsters is generally a last-ditch attempt, as it can create even more dangerous out-of-level monster types.
facts.detect: Encountering a hostile monster.
facts.action: Consider using the wand of polymorph as a last resort if other options are unavailable.

facts.fact: A wand of probing can reveal information about monsters and items in its path without angering peaceful monsters or waking sleeping ones.
facts.detect: Zapping the wand in any direction except upwards.
facts.action: Use the wand to check for hidden items or peaceful monsters before engaging in combat.

facts.fact: Zapping a wand of probing downward reveals the contents of any containers and statues on the hero's square, as well as buried items.
facts.detect: Zapping the wand downward.
facts.action: Use the wand downward to check for buried items or the contents of containers and statues.

facts.fact: Zapping the wand at oneself reveals HP, status, alignment record, and other stats similar to a stethoscope, along with inventory and contents of containers.
facts.detect: Zapping the wand at oneself.
facts.action: Use the wand on oneself to check health and inventory status.

facts.fact: Zapping the wand at a container with Schroedinger's Cat will reveal a unique message but not the cat's status.
facts.detect: Zapping a container with Schroedinger's Cat.
facts.action: Avoid wasting charges on containers with Schroedinger's Cat.

facts.fact: The wand of probing can be used to locate and identify invisible monsters in its path.
facts.detect: Encountering an invisible monster.
facts.action: Use the wand to identify and locate invisible monsters.

facts.fact: A wand of secret door detection detects all undiscovered secret doors, mimics, hiding monsters (including submerged sea monsters), and traps in a radius of 8 squares within the hero's line of sight.
facts.detect: The bot notices secret doors, mimics, hiding monsters, and traps being revealed within an 8-square radius.
facts.action: Use the wand of secret door detection to reveal hidden features and avoid traps.

facts.fact: The wand's effects can penetrate clouds on the Plane of Air, but will have no effect if the hero is engulfed.
facts.detect: The bot is on the Plane of Air and notices clouds.
facts.action: Use the wand while on the Plane of Air to detect hidden features through clouds, but avoid using it while engulfed.

facts.fact: Formally identifying the wand of secret door detection is very easy, with the only potential hurdle being a non-directional wand of nothing: both wands will appear to produce the same effects unless the former actually reveals anything hidden.
facts.detect: The bot uses the wand and notices that it reveals hidden features.
facts.action: If the wand reveals hidden features, it is confirmed to be a wand of secret door detection.

facts.fact: The wand of secret door detection is an invaluable tool for trap detection throughout the game.
facts.detect: The bot encounters a new level or area with potential traps.
facts.action: Use the wand of secret door detection to detect traps before proceeding.

facts.fact: In NetHack Fourk, the wand of secret door detection's range depends on the user's wand skill: at Unskilled, the wand only affects squares adjacent to the zapper, while at Basic it affects the area within a 5-square radius; at Skilled, it affects a 9-square radius, at Expert it affects a 15-square radius, and at Master it affects the entire level.
facts.detect: The bot notices that it is playing NetHack Fourk and has a wand of secret door detection.
facts.action: Use the wand according to the bot's current wand skill level to maximize its effectiveness.

facts.fact: Wands of sleep make up 5% of all randomly-generated wands.
facts.detect: Finding a wand of sleep in inventory or in shops.
facts.action: Keep the wand of sleep for later use in combat or for escaping dangerous situations.
