facts.fact: Zapping a wand of sleep in a given direction will auto-identify the wand and emit a ray that puts any hero or monster it hits to sleep for 6d25 turns unless they have sleep resistance.
facts.detect: Zapping the wand and seeing the message 'The sleep ray hits ...'.
facts.action: Use the wand of sleep to put monsters to sleep before attacking them or to escape from dangerous situations.

facts.fact: Breaking a charged wand of sleep by applying it, or wresting one last charge from an applied wand, will cause an explosion that deals anywhere between 1 and (4x) damage.
facts.detect: Applying the wand and seeing an explosion message.
facts.action: Avoid applying the wand unless absolutely necessary, as it can cause damage and put the hero to sleep.

facts.fact: Engraving with a wand of sleep gives a somewhat distinct message, which it shares with the wand of death.
facts.detect: Engraving with the wand and seeing the message 'The bugs on the stop moving!'.
facts.action: Use this message to identify the wand of sleep if it is unidentified.

facts.fact: A hero with a wand of sleep can use it to defeat or escape difficult non-resistant monsters.
facts.detect: Encountering a non-resistant monster.
facts.action: Use the wand of sleep to put the monster to sleep before attacking or escaping.

facts.fact: Wands of slow monster make up 5% of all randomly-generated wands.
facts.detect: Checking inventory or finding a wand of slow monster in a general store or 'quality apparel and accessories' shop.
facts.action: Keep the wand for use against faster low-MR threats and whirly monsters.

facts.fact: Zapping a wand of slow monster has the same effect as the spell of slow monster: any targets hit by the beam lose intrinsic speed, and monsters without intrinsic speed will have their monster speed abnormally lowered to 2/3 of their normal speed.
facts.detect: Seeing a message like ' seems to be moving slower.' when zapping a monster.
facts.action: Use the wand against faster monsters to gain an advantage.

facts.fact: Zapping a whirly monster engulfing the hero with the wand will disrupt their form if they do not resist the effects, forcing them to expel the hero.
facts.detect: Being engulfed by a whirly monster and seeing the message 'A huge hole opens up...' after zapping the wand.
facts.action: Use the wand to escape from whirly monsters.

facts.fact: A hero that slows down themselves or any monster with the wand will auto-identify it.
facts.detect: Zapping a monster or oneself and seeing the message 'You disrupt !' or 'You slow down.'
facts.action: Use the wand to auto-identify it.

facts.fact: Engraving with a wand of slow monster gives a unique message if the hero is not blind.
facts.detect: Seeing the message 'The bugs on the slow down!' after engraving.
facts.action: Use engraving to trivially identify the wand.

facts.fact: Wands of speed monster make up 4.5% of all randomly-generated wands.
facts.detect: Finding a wand of speed monster in a general store or 'quality apparel and accessories' shop.
facts.action: Buy or pick up the wand if you need to gain intrinsic speed or speed up pets and steeds.

facts.fact: Zapping the wand in a given direction grants any targets in its path intrinsic speed, uncloaking any mimics hit by the beam.
facts.detect: Seeing a mimic uncloak or a message indicating a monster or pet has sped up.
facts.action: Use the wand to speed up pets or steeds, or to uncloak mimics.

facts.fact: A hero that obtains speed from zapping themselves will also exercise dexterity, while monsters zapped with the wand can resist this effect dependent on their MR score.
facts.detect: Noticing a message indicating resistance or a lack of speed gain.
facts.action: Use a stethoscope or wand of probing to check if a pet already has intrinsic speed before zapping.

facts.fact: Peaceful monsters zapped with the wand will become angry.
facts.detect: Seeing a peaceful monster become hostile after being zapped.
facts.action: Avoid zapping peaceful monsters with the wand to prevent angering them.

facts.fact: Engraving with a wand of speed monster gives a unique message if the hero is not blind.
facts.detect: Receiving the message 'The bugs on the floor speed up!' when engraving.
facts.action: Use the unique message to identify the wand without needing to zap it.

facts.fact: Wands of striking are generated as blessed 34 of the time and cursed 34 of the time, and will otherwise be uncursed.
facts.detect: Checking the wand's status message upon pickup
facts.action: If blessed, use it cautiously in combat; if cursed, avoid using it unless necessary.

facts.fact: A hero zapping the wand of striking upward has a 2/3 chance of dislodging a rock from the ceiling and cause it to fall on the hero's head, dealing up to 6 damage.
facts.detect: Zapping the wand upward
facts.action: Avoid zapping the wand upward unless in an area without a ceiling or wearing a hard helm.

facts.fact: Zapping the wand downward wipes out 2-8 letters from any engraving on that square, and doing so over a trap door will shatter the door and turn it into a hole.
facts.detect: Zapping the wand downward
facts.action: Avoid zapping the wand downward over trap doors to prevent falling into holes.

facts.fact: A hero zapping the wand at themselves takes 2d12 damage and abuse their strength unless they have magic resistance, and will auto-identify the wand.
facts.detect: Zapping the wand at oneself
facts.action: Avoid zapping the wand at oneself unless auto-identification is necessary and the hero has magic resistance.

facts.fact: Breaking a charged wand of striking by applying it, or wresting one last charge from an applied wand, will cause an explosion that deals (X+1)d6 damage.
facts.detect: Applying the wand
facts.action: Avoid applying the wand unless necessary and be prepared for an explosion.

facts.fact: A wand of teleportation is a type of wand that appears in NetHack with 4 to 8 charges.
facts.detect: Item name: Wand of teleportation
facts.action: Keep the wand for escape and strategic relocation of enemies or items.

facts.fact: A hero zapping themselves with a wand of teleportation will teleport themselves unless they are on a no-teleport level, auto-identifying the wand.
facts.detect: Message: You materialize in a different location!
facts.action: Use the wand to escape dangerous situations or relocate enemies.

facts.fact: Monsters will use this wand defensively to escape from the hero while they are at low enough HP.
facts.detect: Monster behavior: Enemy monster teleports away
facts.action: Be cautious when enemies are low on health, they may teleport away.

facts.fact: Breaking a charged wand of teleportation by applying it will cause an explosion that deals damage and teleports monsters and items.
facts.detect: Action: Apply wand of teleportation
facts.action: Avoid breaking the wand unless in a desperate situation.

facts.fact: A hero can teleport themselves out of a situation where they are surrounded by hostiles, or free themselves from engulfing monsters such as air elementals.
facts.detect: Situation: Surrounded by enemies or engulfed by a monster
facts.action: Use the wand to teleport out of danger.

facts.fact: Wands of undead turning make up 5% of all randomly-generated wands.
facts.detect: Finding a wand of undead turning in inventory or in shops.
facts.action: Keep the wand for potential use in reviving corpses or turning undead.

facts.fact: A hero zapping a wand of undead turning will revive corpses and rejuvenate eggs in their inventory.
facts.detect: Zapping the wand at oneself and noticing corpses or eggs in inventory.
facts.action: Use the wand to revive valuable corpses or rejuvenate eggs for potential use.

facts.fact: Breaking a charged wand of undead turning by applying it will revive corpses and rejuvenate eggs within the explosion range.
facts.detect: Applying the wand and observing corpses or eggs in the vicinity.
facts.action: Avoid applying the wand unless necessary to avoid unintended revivals.

facts.fact: The wand of undead turning can be used to revive the corpse of a fallen pet.
facts.detect: Finding a pet's corpse.
facts.action: Revive the pet if it is beneficial to have it back.

facts.fact: Zapping the wand at oneself will stun an undead polymorphed hero for up to 30 turns.
facts.detect: Zapping the wand at oneself while polymorphed into an undead form.
facts.action: Avoid zapping the wand at oneself if polymorphed into an undead form.

facts.fact: The wand of water auto-identifies with the message 'You fire off a powerful jet of water!'
facts.detect: You fire off a powerful jet of water!
facts.action: Identify the wand as a wand of water when this message is received.

facts.fact: Zapping yourself with a wand of water drenches you and your items in water.
facts.detect: You get drenched!
facts.action: Avoid zapping yourself with the wand unless you have a specific reason to do so, such as needing to extinguish a fire or clean bloody tiles.

facts.fact: Zapping a drawbridge results in the message 'Splash!' and does nothing.
facts.detect: Splash!
facts.action: Do not waste charges on drawbridges.

facts.fact: Zapping a fiery monster with a wand of water deals 12d6 damage.
facts.detect: Fiery monster name
facts.action: Use the wand to damage fiery monsters.

facts.fact: Zapping an earth elemental with a wand of water transforms it into a mud elemental.
facts.detect: Earth elemental
facts.action: Transform earth elementals into mud elementals to potentially weaken them.

facts.fact: A game started in explore mode will start the hero with an uncursed wand of wishing that has 3 charges.
facts.detect: Starting in explore mode and checking inventory.
facts.action: Keep the wand of wishing and use it wisely for critical wishes.

facts.fact: Wands of wishing are among the rarest wand types, and make up 0.5% of all wands randomly generated on the ground.
facts.detect: Finding a wand with a base cost of 500 in a shop or on the ground.
facts.action: Purchase or pick up the wand of wishing if found.

facts.fact: Zapping or engraving with a charged wand of wishing will auto-identify the wand and allow a hero that has at least zero luck to make a wish.
facts.detect: Zapping or engraving with a wand of wishing.
facts.action: Use the wand of wishing to make a wish if you have at least zero luck.

facts.fact: Recharging a wand of wishing adds a single charge, but attempting to recharge a wand of wishing a second time causes it to explode.
facts.detect: Attempting to recharge a wand of wishing.
facts.action: Recharge the wand of wishing only once to add a single charge.

facts.fact: A wand of wishing is always generated in a chest within one of the turrets of the Castle at level creation.
facts.detect: Exploring the Castle and finding a chest within one of the turrets.
facts.action: Search for and take the wand of wishing from the chest.

facts.fact: A war hammer is a one-handed melee weapon that can also be thrown, and uses the hammer skill.
facts.detect: Weapon name 'war hammer' in inventory or on the ground
facts.action: Pick up and wield the war hammer if it is better than the current weapon, especially if the bot is a Valkyrie.

facts.fact: Valkyries have a 50.64% chance of generating with a war hammer as their weapon.
facts.detect: Bot character generation message mentioning 'war hammer'
facts.action: If generated with a war hammer, consider keeping it as the primary weapon due to the high chance of being a Valkyrie.

facts.fact: The war hammer deals 1d4+1 damage to small monsters and 1d4 damage to large monsters.
facts.detect: Weapon name 'war hammer' in inventory
facts.action: Use the war hammer for melee combat, but be aware it may not be the most effective weapon against large monsters.

facts.fact: A hero can use a wielded war hammer to shatter iron bars with a chance dependent on the hero's strength, whether they throw the weapon or force-fight with it, and the war hammer's own enchantment.
facts.detect: Iron bars on the map
facts.action: Attempt to shatter iron bars with the war hammer if necessary to progress.

facts.fact: The war hammer has a +2 to-hit bonus when thrown.
facts.detect: Weapon name 'war hammer' in inventory
facts.action: Consider throwing the war hammer at distant enemies or for ranged combat.

facts.fact: Water walking boots grant water walking, allowing the wearer to walk across water safely.
facts.detect: The bot can notice this by attempting to walk on water and seeing if it can do so without sinking.
facts.action: The bot should equip water walking boots if found to safely cross water and lava (if fireproofed).

facts.fact: Water walking boots can be used to cross lava, but must be fireproofed to avoid destruction and damage.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this by attempting to cross lava while wearing water walking boots and observing if they are destroyed or if the bot takes fire damage.
facts.action: The bot should fireproof water walking boots before attempting to cross lava.

facts.fact: Water walking boots have no impact on a steed's ability to cross water.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this by riding a steed and attempting to cross water without the steed being able to do so.
facts.action: The bot should not rely on water walking boots to cross water while riding a steed.

facts.fact: Water walking boots are non-trivial to identify, as they do not display a message when worn and have no obvious effects.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this by attempting to price identify the boots or by testing them on water.
facts.action: The bot should attempt to price identify the boots or test them on water to confirm their properties.

facts.fact: Water walking boots are generated within a niche on the middle floor of Vlad's Tower during normal level creation.
facts.detect: The bot can detect this by reaching the middle floor of Vlad's Tower and finding a niche.
facts.action: The bot should search the niche on the middle floor of Vlad's Tower for water walking boots.

facts.fact: Werebane is an artifact silver saber that prevents lycanthropy when wielded.
facts.detect: The bot can detect Werebane by its name and description when found in the dungeon.
facts.action: The bot should pick up and wield Werebane if found, especially if it is in an area with werecreatures or if the bot is concerned about lycanthropy.

facts.fact: Werebane deals double damage against werecreatures and has a +1d5 to-hit bonus.
facts.detect: The bot can detect werecreatures by their names (e.g., werewolf, werejackal) and should be aware of the damage bonus when fighting them.
facts.action: The bot should prioritize using Werebane when fighting werecreatures to maximize damage output.

facts.fact: A silver saber has a 1/20 chance of becoming Werebane if no other artifacts have been generated.
facts.detect: The bot can detect a silver saber by its name and should be aware of the possibility of it becoming Werebane.
facts.action: The bot should pick up and keep any silver sabers it finds, as they have a chance to become the powerful Werebane.

facts.fact: Werebane can be obtained as a sacrifice gift, but requires a sacrifice of at least 4 value.
facts.detect: The bot can detect the option to sacrifice and should be aware of the value requirement for obtaining Werebane.
facts.action: The bot should consider sacrificing to obtain Werebane if it has accumulated at least 4 value and is in an area with werecreatures or lycanthropy risks.

facts.fact: Werebane is a fine option in the early game for characters that would ordinarily have trouble with werewolves and other werecreatures.
facts.detect: The bot can detect the presence of werecreatures in the dungeon and should be aware of its early game utility.
facts.action: The bot should prioritize using Werebane in the early game if it encounters werecreatures.

facts.fact: A wooden flute has a 1/6 chance of being the starting instrument for Elven Clerics and Wizards.
facts.detect: Starting inventory includes a wooden flute if character is an Elven Cleric or Wizard.
facts.action: Keep the wooden flute as it can be useful for pacifying snakes and playing the Castle drawbridge passtune.

facts.fact: A wooden flute has a 0.4% chance of being randomly generated on the ground, in general shops, or as death drops.
facts.detect: Finding a wooden flute in the dungeon, shop, or as a death drop.
facts.action: Pick up the wooden flute and keep it for potential use in pacifying snakes or playing the Castle drawbridge passtune.

facts.fact: Playing a wooden flute can pacify nearby snakes if the hero's experience level plus a dexterity roll is 25 or higher.
facts.detect: Nearby snakes in the dungeon.
facts.action: Use the wooden flute to pacify snakes if the hero's level and dexterity allow.

facts.fact: A hero cannot apply a wooden flute if they are stunned, confused, hallucinating, strangulated, in the form of a sea monster, tiny, unbreathing, cannot speak, lacks a head, or can only buzz.
facts.detect: Hero's current status or form.
facts.action: Avoid using the wooden flute if in any of the mentioned conditions.

facts.fact: A hero cannot apply a wooden flute while underwater.
facts.detect: Being in water.
facts.action: Do not use the wooden flute while underwater.

facts.fact: A wooden harp has a 0.4% chance of randomly generating on the ground, in general shops, or as death drops.
facts.detect: Finding a wooden harp on the ground, in a general shop, or as a death drop.
facts.action: Pick up the wooden harp to potentially use it to pacify nymphs or play the Castle drawbridge passtune.

facts.fact: Applying a wooden harp while not confused and with a high enough sum of experience level and dexterity roll can pacify nearby nymphs.
facts.detect: Seeing nymphs nearby and having a high enough experience level and dexterity.
facts.action: Apply the wooden harp to pacify nymphs and avoid combat.

facts.fact: A hero cannot apply a wooden harp while underwater.
facts.detect: Being underwater and attempting to apply the wooden harp.
facts.action: Avoid applying the wooden harp while underwater.

facts.fact: Playing the passtune for the Castle drawbridge on a wooden harp exercises wisdom.
facts.detect: Being near the Castle drawbridge and knowing the passtune.
facts.action: Play the passtune on the wooden harp to enter the Castle.

facts.fact: A wooden harp can be distinguished from a magic harp by the messages produced when playing it.
facts.detect: Receiving messages like 'The harp twangs.' or 'The harp produces a lilting melody.'
facts.action: Use the wooden harp to distinguish it from a magic harp.

facts.fact: A worm tooth can be turned into a powerful crysknife by reading a non-cursed scroll of enchant weapon while wielding it.
facts.detect: Scroll of enchant weapon
facts.action: Read a non-cursed scroll of enchant weapon while wielding a worm tooth to create a crysknife.

facts.fact: Worm teeth are generated by killing a long worm in a manner that leaves a corpse.
facts.detect: Long worm corpse
facts.action: Kill long worms to obtain worm teeth.

facts.fact: Long worms are rare and generally only spawn if the average of the player's level and the dungeon level is 10 or higher.
facts.detect: Average of player level and dungeon level is 10 or higher
facts.action: Explore deeper levels or increase player level to encounter long worms.

facts.fact: Reverse genocide yields an average of 5 worm teeth per scroll.
facts.detect: Scroll of genocide
facts.action: Use reverse genocide to obtain worm teeth.

facts.fact: A crysknife can serve as a primary weapon for roles such as Healers.
facts.detect: Role is Healer
facts.action: Use a crysknife as a primary weapon if playing as a Healer.

facts.fact: Ya are high-quality projectiles for most bow-wielding roles on paper: they deal the most base damage out of all arrows (1d7 versus 1d6 for normal arrows), are the only arrows to have a to-hit bonus and are inherently erosion-proof.
facts.detect: Item name: ya or bamboo arrow
facts.action: Pick up ya if found, as they are better than normal arrows.

facts.fact: Samurai firing ya from a yumi gain a +1 multishot bonus.
facts.detect: Character class: Samurai
facts.action: If playing as a Samurai, use ya with a yumi for increased effectiveness.

facts.fact: Like with most projectiles that mulch, long-term use of ya requires gathering a fairly large stack of them, as well as maximizing luck and securing a luck item, before committing scrolls of enchant weapon to enchanting them.
facts.detect: Item name: ya and scrolls of enchant weapon
facts.action: Save scrolls of enchant weapon for ya if you have a large stack and are planning to use them extensively.
